rows.original: Well, fancy meeting an old friend. Although this is his home, so it's not that surprising when one thinks about it... Awkward silence falls over the room as all four kitsune stop their mealtime chatter, eyes turning towards you. It's nice to be the center of attention every now and then, but this is just getting embarrassing. At length, though, Hinata rises from his seat and gives you a small bow. "Ah, [pc.name]. I... I was not expecting a visit. Speak of the devil — I was just recounting our experiences to my superior." You'd have wished this reunion were under different circumstances, but you're kind of pressed for time at the moment. Hinata looks distinctly uncomfortable at all this, the expression of a man caught between a rock and a hard place. Scratching his twitching ears, he looks between you and the gray-furred kitsune at the head of the table before sighing. "Before we proceed, perhaps I should make introductions. [pc.name], this is Warden Azami Ishida, my superior; she is to me what I am to Yuzu and Kiri. Azami, this is [pc.name], the native I was telling you about. [pc.HeShe] has shown us exceptional kindness in the past, sharing what [pc.heShe] had to offer with Yuzu, Kiri and me when we were in need. Before you make any decisions, I humbly suggest that you should keep in mind we are indebted to [pc.himHer]." Azami says nothing, instead turning in her seat to face you. Slitted gray eyes flicker up and down the length of your body, then she sets down her bowl and chopsticks on the table before rising and bowing. "Thank you for returning my subordinates safely to their home, [pc.name]. From the bottom of my heart, you have my gratitude. They mean a lot to me." Aw, shucks. You just saw someone who needed help and couldn't turn away. "That they had to resort to banditry is reprehensible on its own, and moreover, you showed kindness to creatures most others would consider monsters. Given the circumstances under which you met, I can't say that your forbearance was insignificant. All of us wardens in this lodge are indebted to you." Not bad, not bad. Hmm, if she wants to repay the favor, could she just let you on through, then? That would help greatly. Azami's smile vanishes, and her ears curl downwards. "Ah..." That's a no, then. "Amongst my duties is that of concierge of this den; indebted to you as we are, I cannot just simply neglect my position. You have asked of me something which, alas, is impossible." It's a pity things turned out this way. A true pity, indeed. No, it would simply be too easy if she'd taken all those empty words about indebtedness to heart and been willing to look the other way while you passed them by. Simply too easy. "Unless you have a suitable reason for being here, you are trespassing. I keep on telling the young ones to shut the entrance after them when they leave, but they never obey with any regularity. Of course, being the kind of person who would show charity to the likes of us, I assume you would have one?" You're here on business from Lady Evergreen, retrieve something she lost. That's not going to be an adequate reason, is it? "Mercenary work? No, and doubly so since that tanuki is your client. Her ancestors and mine come from the same lands, and we have history between us, to put it lightly. Yuzu! Kiri!" In a flash, all four kitsune have set aside their meal and grabbed weapons from under the table, although it's clear that their heart isn't in the fight from the way they're carrying themselves. "I'm deeply sorry to have to detain you. We will endeavor to be gentle." It's a fight!
rows.translation: 哇，真是巧啊，竟然遇到了一个老朋友。虽然这里是他的家，仔细想想的话，这也并不奇怪…… 房间里顿时陷入了尴尬的沉默，四个狐妖都停止了用餐时的交谈，目光全都转向了你。偶尔成为众人关注的焦点确实挺不错的，但这次的情况未免有点尴尬了。终于，日向从座位上站了起来，向你微微鞠了一躬。 啊， [pc.name]. 我……我本来没料到会有人来拜访。真是说曹操曹操到——我刚才还在跟我的上级讲述我们的经历呢。 你肯定希望这次重聚能发生在其他情况下，但眼下你确实时间紧迫。 日向看着这一切，明显显得很不自在，那表情就像是一个被逼入绝境的人。他挠了挠自己不停抽动的耳朵，目光在你和坐在桌首的那只灰毛狐妖之间来回移动，最后叹了口气。 在继续之前，或许我应该先做一下介绍。 [pc.name]这位是我的上司，荒岛绫美警部；她对我来说，就如同我对柚子和桐人一样重要。绫美，这位是 [pc.name]就是我之前跟你提到的那个本地人。 [pc.HeShe] 它在过去曾向我们展现出无与伦比的善意，与我们分享了许多东西。 [pc.heShe] 在我们遇到困难时，是柚子、桐和我也一起提供了帮助。在您做出任何决定之前，我恳请您记住，我们是欠他们一个人情债的。 [pc.himHer]." 浅美没有说话，而是转过身来面对你。她那灰色的眼睛上下扫视着你的全身，然后她把碗和筷子放在桌上，站起身来行礼。 感谢你们将我的下属们安全地送回了他们的家园， [pc.name]发自内心地，我对你表示衷心的感谢。他们对我的意义非同寻常。 哎呀，真糟糕。你刚刚遇到了一个需要帮助的人，而你却没能拒绝帮助他们。 他们不得不诉诸抢劫行为，这一事实本身就已经令人谴责；更何况，你还对那些被大多数人视为怪物的生物表现出了善意。考虑到你与它们相遇时的种种情况，我必须承认，你的宽容与忍耐绝非微不足道。我们这个驻地里的所有守卫，都欠你一个人情。 还不错，还不错。嗯，如果她想报答你的话，让她让你通过不就行了吗？那样会帮大忙的。” 然而，阿兹米的笑容立刻消失了，她的耳朵也耷拉了下来。 啊…… 那可不行。 我的职责之一就是管理这个地方；既然我们欠你人情，我就不能忽视自己的职责。但你要求的这件事，唉，实在是不可能做到。 真是太遗憾了，事情竟然发展成了这样。真的，太可惜了……不，这么说简直太轻描淡写了。 简单 如果她真的把那些关于感激之情的空话放在心上，而且在你无视这些话的时候愿意选择睁一只眼闭一只眼的话……那简直太容易了。 除非你在这里有正当理由，否则你就是擅自闯入。我一直告诉那些年轻人，他们离开后要关上入口，但他们从来都不认真遵守。当然，既然你是一个会对我们这样的人表现出善意的人，我想你肯定也有正当理由吧？ 你是受常青女士的委托前来办事的，目的是取回她丢失的东西。这样的理由似乎还不够充分，不是吗？ 雇佣兵的工作？绝对不行，尤其是当那个狸猫还是你的委托人时。她的祖先和我的祖先都来自同样的地方，我们之间有着一段历史……这么说吧，Yuzu！Kiri！ 转眼间，那四只狐妖都放下了手中的食物，从桌子底下拿起了武器。不过从他们行动的样子来看，显然他们对这场战斗并没有太大的热情。 非常抱歉不得不让您等待，我们会尽量轻柔地处理这件事。 这是一场激烈的战斗！
rows.raw: ' Well, fancy meeting an old friend. Although this is his home, so it's not that surprising when one thinks about it... Awkward silence falls over the room as all four kitsune stop their mealtime chatter, eyes turning towards you. It's nice to be the center of attention every now and then, but this is just getting embarrassing. At length, though, Hinata rises from his seat and gives you a small bow. "Ah, [pc.name]. I... I was not expecting a visit. Speak of the devil — I was just recounting our experiences to my superior." You'd have wished this reunion were under different circumstances, but you're kind of pressed for time at the moment. Hinata looks distinctly uncomfortable at all this, the expression of a man caught between a rock and a hard place. Scratching his twitching ears, he looks between you and the gray-furred kitsune at the head of the table before sighing. "Before we proceed, perhaps I should make introductions. [pc.name], this is Warden Azami Ishida, my superior; she is to me what I am to Yuzu and Kiri. Azami, this is [pc.name], the native I was telling you about. [pc.HeShe] has shown us exceptional kindness in the past, sharing what [pc.heShe] had to offer with Yuzu, Kiri and me when we were in need. Before you make any decisions, I humbly suggest that you should keep in mind we are indebted to [pc.himHer]." Azami says nothing, instead turning in her seat to face you. Slitted gray eyes flicker up and down the length of your body, then she sets down her bowl and chopsticks on the table before rising and bowing. "Thank you for returning my subordinates safely to their home, [pc.name]. From the bottom of my heart, you have my gratitude. They mean a lot to me." Aw, shucks. You just saw someone who needed help and couldn't turn away. "That they had to resort to banditry is reprehensible on its own, and moreover, you showed kindness to creatures most others would consider monsters. Given the circumstances under which you met, I can't say that your forbearance was insignificant. All of us wardens in this lodge are indebted to you." Not bad, not bad. Hmm, if she wants to repay the favor, could she just let you on through, then? That would help greatly. Azami's smile vanishes, and her ears curl downwards. "Ah..." That's a no, then. "Amongst my duties is that of concierge of this den; indebted to you as we are, I cannot just simply neglect my position. You have asked of me something which, alas, is impossible." It's a pity things turned out this way. A true pity, indeed. No, it would simply be too easy if she'd taken all those empty words about indebtedness to heart and been willing to look the other way while you passed them by. Simply too easy. "Unless you have a suitable reason for being here, you are trespassing. I keep on telling the young ones to shut the entrance after them when they leave, but they never obey with any regularity. Of course, being the kind of person who would show charity to the likes of us, I assume you would have one?" You're here on business from Lady Evergreen, retrieve something she lost. That's not going to be an adequate reason, is it? "Mercenary work? No, and doubly so since that tanuki is your client. Her ancestors and mine come from the same lands, and we have history between us, to put it lightly. Yuzu! Kiri!" In a flash, all four kitsune have set aside their meal and grabbed weapons from under the table, although it's clear that their heart isn't in the fight from the way they're carrying themselves. "I'm deeply sorry to have to detain you. We will endeavor to be gentle." It's a fight!'

rows.original: Well, fancy seeing them here. You thought you were rid of these fluffballs the last time you sent them packing into the woods. Guess they made it home after all, eh? Silence as all four pairs of slitted eyes turn towards you. Then, with exact and careful deliberation, Hinata wipes his mouth, sets down his bowl and chopsticks, and narrows his gaze. "You." Why yes, it's you. Nice place they've got here. Guess he's finally getting something to eat on his own instead of having to steal it off others, right? More silence. Yuzu and Kiri look torn between whether to scream in rage or burst into tears, and Hinata's fists are balled so tightly his knuckles have turned white, but neither of the make a move towards you. At length, the gray-furred kitsune at the head of the table turns in her seat to face you, studying your person with slitted golden eyes. "Ah. My name is Azami Ishida, and these three are my responsibility. They have spoken much of you, native." Did they leave in the parts where they were engaging in banditry in the Old Forest? "They left nothing out. Banditry is indeed reprehensible, even given the circumstances they found themselves in... I will apologize for any problems they've caused you." She stands and gives you a small bow. Sorry, you're not the kind to be bought off by a sob story. "Of course, of course." Azami's voice is ever so calm and dry, carefully devoid of emotion. "In a world like this, one cannot trust monsters; one needs to be hard-hearted in order to survive. Your actions were perfectly understandable. "Thus, I trust you will extend this same understanding when we are equally hard-hearted in detaining you for your trespass. Our debt to you will be repaid with the exact same coin with which you have been so kind as to bestow upon us." While she was speaking, the other kitsune have set aside their meal and drawn weapons from under the table; Azami herself whistles sharply, and a beautifully carved bow of foreign make materializes in her hands. "Please, allow us to settle all accounts here and now as Lord Keros teaches." It's a fight!
rows.translation: 哇，真是没想到会见到你。 他们 就在这里。你上次把那些毛茸茸的小家伙们赶到树林里的时候，还以为自己已经摆脱了它们的纠缠，没想到它们最终还是回到了家里，对吧？ 四周一片寂静，四对裂开的眼睛都转向了你。然后，经过一番仔细而慎重的考虑，日向擦了擦嘴，放下了碗和筷子，眯起了眼睛。 你。 没错，就是你。他们这里的环境真不错啊。看来他终于可以自己找东西吃了，而不必再从别人那里抢东西了，对吧？ 又是一阵沉默。柚子和桐人似乎都在纠结是该愤怒地尖叫还是突然哭出来，而日向的拳头握得如此紧，以至于指关节都变成了白色，但他们两个人都没有向你靠近一步。 终于，坐在桌首的那只灰毛狐妖转过身来，用那双金色的眼睛仔细端详着你。 啊，我叫石田朝美，这三个人由我负责照顾。他们经常提到你，这位本地人。 他们是在那些在旧森林里从事抢劫活动的地区离开的吗？ 他们没有遗漏任何细节。无论处于何种处境，抢劫行为确实都是不可原谅的……对于他们给您带来的任何麻烦，我表示歉意。 她站起身来，向你微微鞠了一躬。 抱歉，你并不是那种会被悲惨的故事所打动的类型。 当然，当然。 阿兹米的声音总是那么平静而干涩，刻意地不含任何情感色彩。 在这个世界上，人们无法信任怪物；要想生存下去，就必须变得冷酷无情。你的行为完全是可以理解的。 因此，我相信当我们因为您的违规行为而同样严厉地扣留您时，您也会理解我们的做法。我们欠您的债，将会用您曾经慷慨地赐予我们的同样的方式来偿还。 就在她说话的时候，其他那些狐妖们已经放下了手部中的食物，从桌子下面取出了武器；而阿扎米自己也吹了一声尖锐的口哨，一把制作精良、外观精美的异国风格弓便出现在她的手部中。 请允许我们按照凯罗斯大人的教导，现在就了结所有的账目。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

rows.original: It can't be that bad, right? Just some ordinary people enjoying a perfectly ordinary meal. Engrossed as they are, perhaps you could even sneak by them without anyone noticing... "Ishida-Dono! Look!" All hopes of that are dashed when the blonde in the quartet drops her bowl of rice on the table and points straight at you, shrieking at the top of her lungs as white, fluffy grains scatter all over the dishes. Talk about melodramatic, but it gets the point across beautifully; in a flash, all three of her friends are on their feet and have weapons drawn and readied. With how loud that scream was — and on such a tiny fox-girl, too — you wouldn't be surprised if the entire den heard that. "I keep on telling the young ones to shut the door on their way out,"the gray-furred one amongst them says with a sigh. She's clearly the leader of this little troupe, taking point as the four of them cautiously draw close. "'Something's going to get in someday,' I tell them, and they never listen. Well, it's happened." Look, can't you talk this over? You're simply here on behalf of Mistress Evergreen, trying to find this bag that she lost — "Oh. A mercenary, and in the tanuki's employ to boot. You've gone from not having a legitimate reason to be here, to actually being a menace; if you were hoping to help your case, I'm afraid you've achieved negative results if anything. See, as concierge of this den, I can't just let anyone who wanders in just waltz by, especially when other people are out, and doubly so when I'm eating. "Yuzu! Kiri! Hinata! Assist me in apprehending this trespasser. We'll decide what to do with [pc.himHer] afterwards." With that, the four of them move in on you in earnest. Like it or not, it's a fight!
rows.translation: 应该不会那么糟糕吧？只不过是一些普通人正在享用一顿再普通不过的饭菜而已。他们专心致志地吃饭，说不定你甚至可以悄悄从他们身边走过，而根本不会被注意到…… 石田大人！快看！ 当那四个女孩中的金发女孩把碗里的米饭摔在桌上，然后直指你的方向，用尽全力尖叫起来时，所有这些希望都破灭了。白色的米粒四处散落，落在各种盘子上。真是太夸张了，但这种表现方式却把意思表达得淋漓尽致——转眼间，她的三个朋友全都站了起来，拔出了武器，准备战斗。考虑到那尖叫声有多响亮，再加上那个身材娇小的狐狸女孩发出的声音，整个狐狸洞里的人应该都能听到吧。 我一直告诉那些年轻人，出门的时候一定要把门关上。其中那只灰毛的动物叹了口气说道。显然，她是这个小群体的领导者，当他们四只小心翼翼地靠近时，她走在最前面。 总有一天会出问题的，”我总是这么告诉他们，但他们从来都不听。好吧，现在问题果然发生了。 听着，你们就不能好好商量一下吗？你不过是代表常青女士夫人来这儿，想找回她丢失的那个包而已 哦，原来是个雇佣兵，而且还受那只狸猫的雇佣。你本来就没有正当理由出现在这里，现在却成了一个麻烦人物；如果你本来是想为自己争取一些有利条件的话，恐怕你非但没有达到目的，反而弄巧成拙了。你看，作为这个巢穴的管理员，我不可能让随便什么人都能随便进来，尤其是在其他人都在场的时候，更何况我还在吃饭呢。 柚子！切里！日向！帮帮我抓住这个闯入者吧。之后再决定该如何处理他 [pc.himHer] 之后。 就这样，他们四个人真的开始向你发起了攻击。无论你愿不愿意，都是如此。 这是一场激烈的战斗。!

rows.original: [var0|You've done it, bitter as the deed might have been. Yuzu, Kiri, Hinata and Azami lie in crumpled, groaning heaps about the wardens' lodge, laid low by the battle. Miraculously, their simple meal of pickled vegetables and grilled fish has escaped all harm throughout the pitched fighting, as picture-perfect as it was but minutes ago. It was clear... their heart wasn't in it, indeed. They didn't want to fight you; even now, you're not completely sure they aren't feigning injury, creating a situation where you can pass while they keep some semblance of honor intact. [party.has etheryn| "I kind of feel sorry for them," Ryn says as she steps over a whimpering Yuzu, the blonde kitsune lying face-down on the floor. "It'd have been nice if they'd been willing to stand aside and let us pass, but... I understand where they're coming from." You understand, too, but it doesn't make the situation any more palatable. Perhaps... perhaps when you return, you'll be able to even the score with these four. ] With the warden and her underlings out of the way, there's nothing blocking your path further into the tree-den... |With a pained yelp, the last of the foxy wardens goes down, crumpling into a heap on the floor. You whirl around and scan the remainder of the lodge, but there aren't any foes left standing — twitching and moaning, collapsed and down for the count, but not standing. The blonde girl, Yuzu, sniffles quietly with her head in her hands, but that aside there's no further movement from any of them. [party.has etheryn| "I kind of feel sorry for them," Ryn says as she steps over a comatose Azami. "Maybe it's just because we're so similar..." Bah, nonsense. She's nothing like these mangy mutts — they got everything they deserved, and maybe a little more for good measure. It would've been much more pleasant if this whole altercation could've been avoided, but as things stood it was inevitable. ] Miraculously, their simple meal of pickled vegetables and grilled fish has escaped all harm throughout the pitched fighting, as picture-perfect as it was but minutes ago. One way or the other, the warden and her underlings are out of the picture, leaving the path onward into the tree open to you.]
rows.translation: [var0|你终于做到了，尽管这个过程可能充满了艰辛。柚子、桐、日向和茜都倒在了守卫小屋周围，身体扭曲着，发出痛苦的呻吟声——这场激烈的战斗让她们都受了重伤。奇迹般的是，在那场激烈的交战中，她们刚才吃的那些简单的腌菜和烤鱼却完好无损，依然保持着几分钟前那完美的状态。 很明显……他们确实没有认真对待这场战斗。他们并不想与你交战；即便现在，你也无法完全确定他们没有在假装受伤，只是想制造一种局面，让你能够通过，同时他们也能保留一些体面。 [party.has etheryn| 我有点为他们感到难过。 当瑞恩跨过地上面朝下呜咽着的尤祖时，她说道。那只金发狐妖就躺在那里。 如果他们能愿意让开道路让我们通过，那就再好不过了，但是……我理解他们的立场。 你也是明白的，但这并不能让这种情况变得好受一些。或许……或许等你回来之后，就能和这四个人扯平了。 ] 既然狱长和她的手部下都已经不在路上了，那么你继续深入这个树洞也就不会再遇到任何阻碍了…… |随着一声痛苦的尖叫，最后一只狐妖守卫倒下了，瘫软在地板上。你迅速转身，扫视了小屋里的其他地方，却发现已经没有敌人还站着了——他们都在抽搐、呻吟，全都倒下了，再也没有人站立着。那个金发女孩悠兹正双手部抱头，小声抽泣着，除此之外，其他人都再也没有任何动静了。 [party.has etheryn| 我有点为他们感到难过。 瑞恩一边说着，一边从昏迷不醒的浅美身上跨了过去。 也许只是因为我们太相似了…… Bah，胡说八道。她根本和那些肮脏的杂种狗不一样——它们完全是活该受到这样的对待，甚至可能还少受点才算便宜它们。如果这场争执能够避免的话，事情会顺利得多，但在这种情况下，它是不可避免的。 ] 奇迹般地，他们那简单的菜肴——腌制的蔬菜和烤鱼——在激烈的战斗中毫发无损，依然保持着几分钟前那完美的状态。不管怎样，狱长和她的手部下都已经不在场了，这样你们就可以继续前进，通往那棵树了。]
rows.raw: " [var0|You've done it, bitter as the deed might have been. Yuzu, Kiri, Hinata and Azami lie in crumpled, groaning heaps about the wardens' lodge, laid low by the battle. Miraculously, their simple meal of pickled vegetables and grilled fish has escaped all harm throughout the pitched fighting, as picture-perfect as it was but minutes ago. It was clear... their heart wasn't in it, indeed. They didn't want to fight you; even now, you're not completely sure they aren't feigning injury, creating a situation where you can pass while they keep some semblance of honor intact. [party.has etheryn| "I kind of feel sorry for them," Ryn says as she steps over a whimpering Yuzu, the blonde kitsune lying face-down on the floor. "It'd have been nice if they'd been willing to stand aside and let us pass, but... I understand where they're coming from." You understand, too, but it doesn't make the situation any more palatable. Perhaps... perhaps when you return, you'll be able to even the score with these four. ] With the warden and her underlings out of the way, there's nothing blocking your path further into the tree-den... |With a pained yelp, the last of the foxy wardens goes down, crumpling into a heap on the floor. You whirl around and scan the remainder of the lodge, but there aren't any foes left standing — twitching and moaning, collapsed and down for the count, but not standing. The blonde girl, Yuzu, sniffles quietly with her head in her hands, but that aside there's no further movement from any of them. [party.has etheryn| "I kind of feel sorry for them," Ryn says as she steps over a comatose Azami. "Maybe it's just because we're so similar..." Bah, nonsense. She's nothing like these mangy mutts — they got everything they deserved, and maybe a little more for good measure. It would've been much more pleasant if this whole altercation could've been avoided, but as things stood it was inevitable. ] Miraculously, their simple meal of pickled vegetables and grilled fish has escaped all harm throughout the pitched fighting, as picture-perfect as it was but minutes ago. One way or the other, the warden and her underlings are out of the picture, leaving the path onward into the tree open to you.]"

rows.original: [var0|Damn it. You struggle, trying to will your limbs into moving, but all the fight's left you. The spirit is willing, the flesh is weak and all that — there's a note of sad finality as Hinata grabs you by under the shoulders, disarms you, then starts binding your wrists together. [party.som||[party.compNames] suffers the same fate, similarly disarmed and trussed up in short order, Kiri working with a grim reluctance that only makes this whole thing worse.|[party.compNames] suffer the same fate, similarly disarmed and trussed up in short order, Kiri working with a grim reluctance that only makes this whole thing worse.] "It's over. I wish... I wish you hadn't come here." Yuzu won't look you in the eye, her ears downcast as she watches Hinata tie you up. "So... what do we do with [party.hasCompanions|them|[pc.himHer]], Lady Azami?" "Gods. I..." Azami shakes her head, bites her lip. "We'll take [party.hasCompanions|them|[pc.himHer]] to the Shrine Mother, throw [party.hasCompanions|them|[pc.himHer]] on her mercy. I'll... I'll put in a good word. It's the least I can do." Yuzu doesn't look very happy with this outcome; no one does. You're in no position to complain when Kiri comes up with a makeshift stretcher-cum-palanquin and loads you up on it, [party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] following after soon enough|either]. As you feel yourself being lifted up and away, something hard and heavy lands on the back of your skull, and the world rapidly blackens and spins; these foxes sure do know their craft. "I'm really sorry," is the last thing you hear Azami say. "On behalf of me and my subordinates, I hope you can find it in yourself to forgive us." Well, damn.|Damn it. You collapse face-first into one of the cushions, and the foxes are immediately upon you, biting, wrestling and pinning you into submission. You struggle and kick, trying to give as good as you're getting, but with you outnumbered the outcome was never in doubt. [party.som||Seeing you go down, [party.compNames] has a go of it, trying to salvage the situation, but is soon similarly overpowered by the sheer ferocity of fluff.|Seeing you go down, [party.compNames] have a go of it, trying to salvage the situation, but are soon similarly overpowered by the sheer ferocity of fluff. ] "That's enough," Azami commands, snapping her fingers. "Restrain [party.hasCompanions|them|[pc.himHer]]. I just want to get this over with and have a bit of peace." As one, Yuzu, Kiri and Hinata stop the brawl, the latter pulling you upright and tying together your wrists and ankles with a length of deceptively thin cord. [party.hasCompanions |Kiri does the same to [party.compNames], her expression set into a mask of grim distaste. ] "Your orders, Ishida-Dono?" "It is not our place to pass judgement when there are those more competent to do so easily at hand; our job is merely to apprehend. We'll throw [party.hasCompanions|them|[pc.himHer]] on the Shrine Mother's mercy...she'll be far more thorough than we could ever be." That satisfies Azami's underlings well enough, and they run off to fetch what looks like a makeshift stretcher-cum-palanquin. The trio are definitely cold and businesslike as they dump you unceremoniously atop it; it would arguably have been much better if they'd been openly gloating about their victory. This... this is just disturbing. [party.has arona| "Damn it!" Arona grunts, tugging at the cord binding her limbs together. You can see her hefty muscles straining at the bonds, bulging with effort; for all her strength, she's unable to break what ought to be no more than simple threads. "Seven-damned soul-sucking brush-tails and their dirty tricks..." ] As you feel yourself being lifted up and away, something hard and heavy lands on the back of your skull, and the world rapidly blackens and spins; these foxes sure do know their craft. "Farewell. Maybe one of these days I'll get to have a meal from start to finish without being interrupted." She's that obsessed with food that she's thinking of it even now? "No, I merely place far more value on my time with my subordinates than I do on time wasted dealing with the likes of you." ]
rows.translation: [var0|该死。你拼命挣扎，试图强迫自己的四肢动起来，但已经没有了力气。意志虽然坚定，身体却已经虚弱不堪——当日向你抓住肩膀，解开你的武装，然后开始将你的手腕绑在一起时，你只觉得一种悲哀的宿命感油然而生。 [party.som||[party.compNames] 基里也遭遇了同样的命运，很快就被缴械并捆绑起来。她在执行这些动作时表现出了极度的不情愿，这种情绪反而让整个情况变得更加糟糕。|[party.compNames] 基里同样遭遇了同样的命运，很快就被缴械并捆绑起来。她在执行这些动作时表现出了极度的不情愿，这种情绪反而让整个情况变得更加糟糕。] 一切都结束了。我真希望……真希望你当初没有来到这里。 柚子不敢直视你的眼睛，她低着头，看着日向把你绑起来。 那么……我们该怎么做呢？ [party.hasCompanions|他们|[pc.himHer]]阿扎米女士？ 天啊，我…… 阿兹米 shakes her head and bites her lip. 我们就选这个吧。 [party.hasCompanions|他们|[pc.himHer]] 献给圣母，抛掷吧 [party.hasCompanions|他们|[pc.himHer]] 就看她的决定了。我会……我会帮她说句话的。这是我最起码能做的。 柚子对这样的结果似乎并不满意，其实没人会满意。当桐人拼凑出一张临时用的担架，然后把你抬上去的时候，你根本没有任何资格抱怨。 [party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] 不久之后，他们便跟了上来。|要么]就在你感觉自己被抬离地面的瞬间，有什么坚硬而重型的东西砸在了你的后脑勺上，整个世界立刻陷入了黑暗，开始旋转起来……这些狐狸确实精通它们的“技艺”。 我真的很抱歉。 这是你最后听到的阿扎米说的话。 我代表我本人以及我的下属们，真心希望您能宽恕我们。 哎呀，真糟糕。|该死。你面朝下摔在其中一个垫子上，那些狐狸立刻扑了上来，又是咬你，又是扭打你，最终把你压倒在地。你拼命挣扎、踢打，试图反击，但由于人数处于劣势，结果早已注定。 [party.som||看着你倒下， [party.compNames] 他尝试着扭转局面，但很快就被那些烦人的琐事彻底压倒了。|看着你倒下， [party.compNames] 他们尝试着扭转局面，但很快就被那些烦人的小麻烦彻底压倒了。 ] 够了。 阿扎米打了个响指，发出了命令。 克制自己。 [party.hasCompanions|他们|[pc.himHer]]我只是想尽快把这件事解决掉，然后能过上平静的生活。 柚子、桐和日向三人一起制止了这场斗殴，后者将你扶起来，然后用一根看似细软的绳子将你的手腕和脚踝绑在了一起。 [party.hasCompanions |基里也对……做了同样的事。 [party.compNames]她的表情凝固成了一副充满厌恶的面具。 ] 有什么吩咐，石田大人？ 当有更合适的人能够轻易地做出判断时，我们根本没有资格妄加评论；我们的职责仅仅是执行任务而已。我们会把 [party.hasCompanions|他们|[pc.himHer]] 看在圣母的份上……她肯定会做得比我们任何人都更彻底。 这样足以让浅见的手下们感到满意了，他们立刻跑去拿来了一个看起来像是临时拼凑而成的担架。这三个人动作冷淡而高效，毫不客气地将你放到了上面；说实话，如果他们能公开表现出对胜利的得意之情，反而会让人感觉好一些。这种……这种态度实在令人不安。 [party.has arona| 该死！ 阿罗娜发出低沉的呻吟声，用力拉扯着束缚着她四肢的绳子。你可以看到她那结实的肌肉在绳子的束缚下拼命用力，肌肉因过度用力而凸起；尽管她力气很大，却依然无法挣断这些本应只是普通的绳子。 那些该死的吸血蝙蝠和他们的卑鄙手段…… ] 就在你感觉自己被抬离地面的瞬间，有什么坚硬而重型的东西砸在了你的后脑勺上，整个世界立刻陷入了黑暗，开始旋转起来——这些狐狸确实精通它们的本领啊。 再见了。也许有一天，我能够安心地吃一顿饭，而不会被任何事情打扰。 她对食物简直到了痴迷的程度，现在都在想着食物吗？ 不，我更看重与下属共度的时光，而不是浪费时间去应付你们这样的人。 ]

rows.original: Leaving the wardens' lodge, you follow the maze-like path of hallways further into the depths of the tree. The wood is strangely solid under your feet — hard, but with almost a strange sponginess to its uppermost layer, like cork. Blocked-off sections of hallway mean you have to weave in and out of several rooms that show signs of habitation with recently filled lanterns and trunks full of freshly folded clothes, but the residents are out at the moment, much to your relief. That is, until you reach what immediately strikes you as some kind of workshop. The closest resemblance you can put to the place is Ogrish's smithy, but the orc would never let his workspace descend into such chaos. You almost step on several angular pieces of wood joined together on your way in, kicking more out of the way as you do your best to creep through the large chamber. For some reason, it's rather dark in here compared to even the hallways outside... [party.has cait| Cait wrinkles her nose at the mess and sniffs. "Can't say I approve of this. Calla would throw a fit if she saw a mess as extensive as this one..." ] Through the gloom, you take note of several large shapes lining the walls, furniture of some sort, clearly of a practical bent. Smoothing planes, saws, sandpaper — carpentry tools dominate the racks on the walls, followed closely by ones for metalworking. Guess there's no shortage of wood around these parts, after all... [party.has berwyn| Hugging himself, Berwyn nevertheless follows you resolutely through the gloomy chamber. "Somehow, this reminds me of Mistress' tower." ] Click, click... The quiet, rhythmic sound draws your attention, and you turn your gaze towards its source — a lone workbench against the far wall, lit by a pair of lanterns hanging from its headboard. Seated at it is a lone eight-tailed kitsune, hunched over the workbench's surface and tinkering away at something that's rather fine and intricate. The soft, flickering light from the lanterns doesn't extend very far past his bespectacled face, and his ears twitch every so often as he works, smoothing out the ball-socket joint laid out before him. Your previous experience with Azami and her wardens has left you rather cautious, but — That particular train of thought is interrupted when the kitsune speaks in that strange, lilting mother tongue the fox-people use, tapping an empty spot on the workbench beside him. [silly| 「マイ、私のお茶を出してくれる？」 ] You've absolutely no idea what he wants, if he wants anything, or even if he's noticed you in the first place. Those questions are answered when the kitsune reaches out a hand for the empty spot where he'd expected something to be placed, finds empty space, and after a little dancing around with his delicate fingers realizes that there's nothing there to begin with and turns around to see you, a slight frown on his face. "You're not Mai. Neither do you have my tea." No, and no. "You made all that noise, didn't you, outsider? Thanks to you, I can't think straight, and I have so much work to do! Plus, I was really looking forward to Mai's tea..." [party.has arona| Arona grins a toothy, tusky grin, stepping forward to tower over the diminutive kitsune. "Well then, little fox, why don't you work on playing with your toys? Don't mind us, we're just passing through." | You have an idea. Since he's so busy, why doesn't he work on letting you pass through, then? You'll be out of his fur in no time, and a little fox like him'll have all the peace and quiet he wants to play with his toys. ] You're not sure what exactly it was about those words that provoked the kitsune, but boy is he pissed, his ears turning forward and face turning a rather garish shade of red. Hopping off his stool, the kitsune draws himself to his full height — which can't be an inch above five feet four at best — and plants his balled fists akimbo. "Ohh, those are big words you're slinging about there, [party.has arona|green-skinned muscle-brain|[pc.race]]! I'm not so absent-minded as to know you're not supposed to be here!" [party.has arona| Arona just guffaws at the outburst. "Hey, [pc.name], this one's really cute. You mind if we take him home as a pet or something? I know exactly what to feed him!" ] Yes, you're not supposed to be here, and what is he going to do about it? "Well, for starters, this." The kitsune snaps his fingers, and blue, brilliant-hued foxfire flares into existence, illuminating the workshop. Plain wooden marionettes of the sort Ogrish would use to display his wares line the walls, although you can see hinges and sockets where joints would be if they were human. The little red-headed fox-man concentrates again, and this time there's a definite thrum of power in the air, faint wisps of blue flame threading through the air like gossamer filaments carried by the wind. [party.has cait| Cait's eyes suddenly snap wide, and the gem in her staff flares a radiant pink. "[pc.name]! Don't let him get that spell off! I'll try to hold him while you —" | [pc.cl blackmage whitemage| There's no time to determine exactly what kind of magic he's working, but there's little doubt it's bad news. You've got to stop him before — | While you're not that well-versed in the magical arts, the sheer amount of power sloshing around about the room leaves little doubt what he's doing is bad news for you. You've got to stop him before — ] ] Even as you rush forward with your [pc.weapon] drawn, the little silver-furred kitsune flicks his wrists, and several of the marionettes spring to life, moving jerkily as they rush to defend their master. You can see the strings connecting him to his automatons, tendrils of eerie blue flame that extend from his fingers to the marionettes' limbs. "I will say, I haven't had the chance to really test out the workshop's defenses; I suppose I should thank you [party.som||both |all ]for coming along. Komari was never on board with the whole idea — 'Kazuo, you're just being paranoid. You're perfectly safe here. No one's going to come in and mess with your work.' Well, the joke's on her." So, golems? You swing your [pc.weapon] straight at the little eight-tailed kitsune, but one of the puppets steps in to take the blow for him. There's a satisfying thump as your [pc.weapon] strikes solid wood and the jerky construct flies apart — only for its constituent pieces to start reassembling themselves several seconds later. [party.has berwyn| "Big whoop," Berwyn drawls, a smug smirk plastered all over his face like a kid who's just realized he's got more marbles than anyone else on the playground. "Your golems are wooden. My elementals are stone. Guess what's harder?" Kazuo sniffs, and you can hear the condescension in that single gesture. "I would never create something as crude and unrefined as a golem, northerner, nor be as lazy and barbaric as you to simply rip something from nature and call it your own. These are puppets." "Po-tay-to, po-tah-to, old man." ] "Don't worry, that's not all." Kazuo makes a clasping motion with his hands, and the assorted junk on the benches and floor starts to rise and swirl, joined by the same burning blue threads. Within moments, order's arisen out of the workshop's absolute chaos, seemingly innocuous widgets and gadgets assembling themselves about the kitsune's body into a massive monstrosity of wood and metal. Immense, humanoid — almost like a suit of full armor, but with far more moving parts. Actually, come to think of it, it looks just like a giant puppet... [party.comp brint berwyn |"Careful, now." Eyes not leaving the mechanical puppet housing the artificer, Brint readies his [brint.weapon]. "I've seen enough of the womenfolks' handiwork to know something of their craft. If this is engineering, it isn't just that." |Berwyn's smug smirk has faded ever so slightly as he takes in the beast of wood and steel before him. "Well then, I guess this makes the fight fair. It wouldn't be fun if I kept that overwhelming advantage now, would it, old man?" ] "Now then," Kazuo says, his voice muffled from within his creation, "you outsiders really should have picked on someone your own size." It's a fight!
rows.translation: 离开守卫的小屋后，你沿着那些宛如迷宫般的走廊，继续深入这棵巨树的内部。踩在木头上，你会感到一种奇怪的质感——木质坚硬，但最表层却仿佛带有某种海绵般的弹性，就像软木一样。 走廊中那些被封闭起来的区域意味着你必须穿梭于几间显然有人居住的房间之中——这些房间里摆放着刚刚点燃的灯笼，还有装满刚叠好的衣物的箱子，但幸运的是，此刻那些居住者都不在家。 直到你走进那个乍看之下就像某种作坊的地方。这个地方最接近的比喻就是奥格瑞什的铁匠铺，但那个兽人绝不会让自己的工作场所变得如此混乱。当你走进去的时候，差点被几块拼接在一起的木头绊倒，还不得不把更多的木块踢到一边，才能勉强穿过那个宽敞的大房间。 不知为何，这里甚至比外面的走廊还要昏暗…… [party.has cait| 凯特看到这一片混乱，皱了皱鼻子，然后闻了闻。 我得说，我并不赞成这样。如果卡拉看到这么一片混乱，她肯定会大发雷霆的…… ] 在昏暗的轻型线中，你注意到墙壁上排列着几样大型物件，显然都是某种实用家具。墙上的架子上摆满了刨子、锯子和砂纸等木工工具，紧随其后的还有金属加工工具。想来这一带确实不缺木材吧…… [party.has berwyn| 虽然瑟瑟发抖，但贝尔温还是坚定地跟在你身后，穿过那昏暗的房间。 不知为何，这让我想起了女主人所在的塔楼。 ] 咔嗒，咔嗒…… 这种安静而有节奏的声音吸引了你的注意，你将目轻型转向声源——那是一张独自摆放在远处的工作台，台面上悬挂着两盏灯笼，为它提供了轻型源。坐在工作台前的是一只八尾狐，它正弯腰在台面上摆弄着一些看起来非常精致、复杂的物品。 灯笼发出的柔和轻型芒在他戴眼镜的脸上方才勉强能够照亮周围的一小片区域。在他忙碌地修理那些球形关节部件时，他的耳朵偶尔会微微抽动一下。 由于你之前与阿兹米以及她的守卫们有过一些经历，因此你现在显得相当谨慎，但是—— 当那只狐妖用那种狐妖族特有的、奇特而轻快的母语说话时，他的思绪被打断了。它轻轻敲了敲他身旁工作台上的一个空位。 [silly| 「マイ、私のお茶を出してくれる？」 ] 你根本不知道他到底想要什么，他是否真的有什么需求，甚至都不确定他是否一开始就注意到了你。只有当那只狐妖伸出手部去，试图触碰到那个他原本以为应该有什么东西的地方，却发现那里空无一物；然后他用自己纤细的手部指在那个地方摸索了一会儿，最终意识到那里本来就什么都没有时，他才会转过头来看你，脸上还会带着一丝疑惑的表情。 你不是舞。你也没有我的茶。 不，绝对不行。 你搞出了那么大的动静，对吧，外人？多亏了你，我现在根本无法集中注意力，还有那么多工作要做呢！更何况，我本来还很期待喝舞子的茶呢…… [party.has arona| 阿罗娜露出满口獠牙的灿烂笑容，向前迈步，将身材矮小的狐妖远远地甩在身后。 那好吧，小狐狸，你去玩你的玩具吧。别管我们，我们只是路过而已。 | 你有个主意。既然他这么忙，为什么不想办法让你通过呢？这样你很快就能离开他的地盘，而像他这样的小狐狸也能安静地玩他的玩具了。 ] 你并不清楚到底是那些话中的哪些内容惹恼了那只狐妖，但天啊，它的反应确实令人震惊。 愤怒至极他的耳朵向前竖起，脸也变成了那种相当鲜艳的红色。那只狐妖从凳子上跳下来，站直了身体——他的身高最多也就五英尺四英寸左右——然后双拳紧握在身前。 哦，那些是 大的 你说的那些话 [party.has arona|皮肤黝黑、肌肉发达、头脑聪明的人|[pc.race]]! 我才不呢 所以 心不在焉，完全忘了自己不应该在这里！ [party.has arona| 阿罗娜听到这番话后，只是哈哈大笑起来。 嘿， [pc.name]这个真的太可爱了。我们能不能把它带回家当宠物养呢？我知道该喂它什么食物！ ] 是的，你本来就不应该在这里，而且……到底发生了什么？ 他 你打算怎么解决这个问题呢？ 嗯，首先， 这个." 那只狐妖精灵打了个响指，顿时蓝色的、轻型芒璀璨的狐火腾空而起，照亮了整个工作间。墙上排列着一些朴素的木制提线木偶——那种奥格里什会用来展示自己商品的类型。不过，如果你仔细观察的话，会发现那些应该有人类关节的地方其实装有铰链和插槽。这个红发的小狐妖精灵再次集中精力，这一次，空气中确实弥漫着强烈的能量波动，淡蓝色的火焰如同被风带动的丝丝轻纱，在空气中飘荡着。 [party.has cait| 凯特的眼睛突然睁得大大的，她手中的法杖上的宝石发出了耀眼的粉红色光芒。 "[pc.name]! 别让他释放那个咒语！我会尽力拖住他，而你—— | [pc.cl blackmage whitemage| 现在根本没有时间去弄清楚他正在使用哪种魔法，但可以肯定的是，这绝不是什么好消息。你必须在他行动之前阻止他—— | 虽然你对魔法并不十分精通，但房间里弥漫着的那种强大力量显然说明，他的所作所为对你来说绝非好事。你必须尽快阻止他—— ] ] 即使你奋勇向前 [pc.weapon] 当那银毛小狐拉动操纵杆时，几个木偶立刻活了过来，它们动作笨拙地冲了出去，保护起它们的主人。你瞧 看到 那些将他与他的自动人连接起来的细丝，是一缕缕诡异的蓝色火焰，从他的手部指延伸到那些木偶的四肢上。 我得说，我还没有机会去尝试 真的吗 测试一下这个工坊的防御系统吧；我想我应该感谢你。 [party.som||两者都 |所有 ]感谢你的支持。其实小丸子从一开始就不赞成这个主意——“和夫，你只是多虑了。你在这里完全安全，没人会来打扰你的工作。”嗯，现在看来，这话反而证明她是错的。 所以，就是这些魔像吗？你挥动你的 [pc.weapon] 直接冲向了那只八尾小狐妖，但其中一个木偶站了出来，替它挡下了这一击。当你看到那个木偶被击中的瞬间，会有一种令人满足的撞击声 [pc.weapon] 敲击坚硬的木头，那结构脆弱的物体立刻分崩离析——但几秒钟后，它的各个部件又开始重新组合起来。 [party.has berwyn| 没什么了不起的。 贝尔温慢条斯理地说道，脸上挂着得意的笑容，就像一个刚刚发现自己拥有的弹珠比操场上其他任何人都多的孩子一样。 你的傀儡都是木头做的。而我的元素生物却是 石头猜猜什么更难？ 和也吸了吸鼻子，然后 听到 那个举动中所流露出的居高临下的态度。 我永远不会创造出像魔像这样粗糙、不精致的东西，也不会像你们北方人那样懒惰、野蛮，仅仅从自然界中夺取某些东西就称之为自己的财产。这些 木偶." 土豆，土豆，老爷爷。 ] 别担心，还没完呢。 和夫双手部一合，那些散落在长凳和地面上的各种杂物便开始缓缓升起、旋转起来，那些燃烧着蓝色轻型芒的丝线也加入了其中。不一会儿，原本混乱不堪的工作室里便恢复了秩序——那些看似普通的零件和装置自动聚集在那只狐妖的身躯周围，最终形成了一具由木头和金属构成的巨大怪物。 庞大而呈人形——几乎就像一套完整的盔甲，只不过它的活动部件要多得多。 其实仔细想想，它看起来简直就像一个巨大的木偶…… [party.comp brint berwyn |小心，现在。 布林特的目光始终紧盯着那个装有制造者的机械傀儡，同时他也在做着准备。 [brint.weapon]. 我已经看够了女性们那些‘手部艺’，因此对她们的能力也有所了解。如果这算得上是工程技术的话，那它根本算不上工程技术。 只是 那个。 |当贝林看到眼前这座由木头和钢铁构成的庞然巨物时，他那得意的笑容已经稍微收敛了一些。 那么，我想这样的话比赛就公平了吧。如果我现在还保持着那种压倒性的优势，那就太没意思了，不是吗，老兄？ ] 那么， 和夫说道，他的声音从他的创造物内部传了出来，听起来有些闷闷的。 你们这些外人真该找和自己体型相仿的人来欺负才对。 这是一场激烈的战斗！
rows.raw: " Leaving the wardens' lodge, you follow the maze-like path of hallways further into the depths of the tree. The wood is strangely solid under your feet — hard, but with almost a strange sponginess to its uppermost layer, like cork. Blocked-off sections of hallway mean you have to weave in and out of several rooms that show signs of habitation with recently filled lanterns and trunks full of freshly folded clothes, but the residents are out at the moment, much to your relief. That is, until you reach what immediately strikes you as some kind of workshop. The closest resemblance you can put to the place is Ogrish's smithy, but the orc would never let his workspace descend into such chaos. You almost step on several angular pieces of wood joined together on your way in, kicking more out of the way as you do your best to creep through the large chamber. For some reason, it's rather dark in here compared to even the hallways outside... [party.has cait| Cait wrinkles her nose at the mess and sniffs. "Can't say I approve of this. Calla would throw a fit if she saw a mess as extensive as this one..." ] Through the gloom, you take note of several large shapes lining the walls, furniture of some sort, clearly of a practical bent. Smoothing planes, saws, sandpaper — carpentry tools dominate the racks on the walls, followed closely by ones for metalworking. Guess there's no shortage of wood around these parts, after all... [party.has berwyn| Hugging himself, Berwyn nevertheless follows you resolutely through the gloomy chamber. "Somehow, this reminds me of Mistress' tower." ] Click, click... The quiet, rhythmic sound draws your attention, and you turn your gaze towards its source — a lone workbench against the far wall, lit by a pair of lanterns hanging from its headboard. Seated at it is a lone eight-tailed kitsune, hunched over the workbench's surface and tinkering away at something that's rather fine and intricate. The soft, flickering light from the lanterns doesn't extend very far past his bespectacled face, and his ears twitch every so often as he works, smoothing out the ball-socket joint laid out before him. Your previous experience with Azami and her wardens has left you rather cautious, but — That particular train of thought is interrupted when the kitsune speaks in that strange, lilting mother tongue the fox-people use, tapping an empty spot on the workbench beside him. [silly| 「マイ、私のお茶を出してくれる？」 ] You've absolutely no idea what he wants, if he wants anything, or even if he's noticed you in the first place. Those questions are answered when the kitsune reaches out a hand for the empty spot where he'd expected something to be placed, finds empty space, and after a little dancing around with his delicate fingers realizes that there's nothing there to begin with and turns around to see you, a slight frown on his face. "You're not Mai. Neither do you have my tea." No, and no. "You made all that noise, didn't you, outsider? Thanks to you, I can't think straight, and I have so much work to do! Plus, I was really looking forward to Mai's tea..." [party.has arona| Arona grins a toothy, tusky grin, stepping forward to tower over the diminutive kitsune. "Well then, little fox, why don't you work on playing with your toys? Don't mind us, we're just passing through." | You have an idea. Since he's so busy, why doesn't he work on letting you pass through, then? You'll be out of his fur in no time, and a little fox like him'll have all the peace and quiet he wants to play with his toys. ] You're not sure what exactly it was about those words that provoked the kitsune, but boy is he pissed, his ears turning forward and face turning a rather garish shade of red. Hopping off his stool, the kitsune draws himself to his full height — which can't be an inch above five feet four at best — and plants his balled fists akimbo. "Ohh, those are big words you're slinging about there, [party.has arona|green-skinned muscle-brain|[pc.race]]! I'm not so absent-minded as to know you're not supposed to be here!" [party.has arona| Arona just guffaws at the outburst. "Hey, [pc.name], this one's really cute. You mind if we take him home as a pet or something? I know exactly what to feed him!" ] Yes, you're not supposed to be here, and what is he going to do about it? "Well, for starters, this." The kitsune snaps his fingers, and blue, brilliant-hued foxfire flares into existence, illuminating the workshop. Plain wooden marionettes of the sort Ogrish would use to display his wares line the walls, although you can see hinges and sockets where joints would be if they were human. The little red-headed fox-man concentrates again, and this time there's a definite thrum of power in the air, faint wisps of blue flame threading through the air like gossamer filaments carried by the wind. [party.has cait| Cait's eyes suddenly snap wide, and the gem in her staff flares a radiant pink. "[pc.name]! Don't let him get that spell off! I'll try to hold him while you —" | [pc.cl blackmage whitemage| There's no time to determine exactly what kind of magic he's working, but there's little doubt it's bad news. You've got to stop him before — | While you're not that well-versed in the magical arts, the sheer amount of power sloshing around about the room leaves little doubt what he's doing is bad news for you. You've got to stop him before — ] ] Even as you rush forward with your [pc.weapon] drawn, the little silver-furred kitsune flicks his wrists, and several of the marionettes spring to life, moving jerkily as they rush to defend their master. You can see the strings connecting him to his automatons, tendrils of eerie blue flame that extend from his fingers to the marionettes' limbs. "I will say, I haven't had the chance to really test out the workshop's defenses; I suppose I should thank you [party.som||both |all ]for coming along. Komari was never on board with the whole idea — 'Kazuo, you're just being paranoid. You're perfectly safe here. No one's going to come in and mess with your work.' Well, the joke's on her." So, golems? You swing your [pc.weapon] straight at the little eight-tailed kitsune, but one of the puppets steps in to take the blow for him. There's a satisfying thump as your [pc.weapon] strikes solid wood and the jerky construct flies apart — only for its constituent pieces to start reassembling themselves several seconds later. [party.has berwyn| "Big whoop," Berwyn drawls, a smug smirk plastered all over his face like a kid who's just realized he's got more marbles than anyone else on the playground. "Your golems are wooden. My elementals are stone. Guess what's harder?" Kazuo sniffs, and you can hear the condescension in that single gesture. "I would never create something as crude and unrefined as a golem, northerner, nor be as lazy and barbaric as you to simply rip something from nature and call it your own. These are puppets." "Po-tay-to, po-tah-to, old man." ] "Don't worry, that's not all." Kazuo makes a clasping motion with his hands, and the assorted junk on the benches and floor starts to rise and swirl, joined by the same burning blue threads. Within moments, order's arisen out of the workshop's absolute chaos, seemingly innocuous widgets and gadgets assembling themselves about the kitsune's body into a massive monstrosity of wood and metal. Immense, humanoid — almost like a suit of full armor, but with far more moving parts. Actually, come to think of it, it looks just like a giant puppet... [party.comp brint berwyn |"Careful, now." Eyes not leaving the mechanical puppet housing the artificer, Brint readies his [brint.weapon]. "I've seen enough of the womenfolks' handiwork to know something of their craft. If this is engineering, it isn't just that." |Berwyn's smug smirk has faded ever so slightly as he takes in the beast of wood and steel before him. "Well then, I guess this makes the fight fair. It wouldn't be fun if I kept that overwhelming advantage now, would it, old man?" ] "Now then," Kazuo says, his voice muffled from within his creation, "you outsiders really should have picked on someone your own size." It's a fight!"

rows.original: Maybe there's something useful in all this mess...
rows.translation: 也许在这堆混乱的事物中，确实藏着一些有用的东西……
rows.raw: "Maybe there's something useful in all this mess... "

rows.original: The smell of burning embers fills the air. Was it there a moment ago? You don't remember, ducking out of the way as the living suit of strange, full-bodied armor smashes its pincer-like fist in the spot you were standing seconds ago. Whirling around, you have your [pc.weapon] at the ready, but your foe hasn't moved, instead half-crouched as more puppets swarm in from the sidelines to defend their master. What is he doing? Then without warning, something explodes from within the living armor, wisps of foxfire seeping from its joints. Another small explosion rocks the construct, and this time it shatters into so much debris, its creator simply unable to maintain the focus needed to hold it together. Coughing and wheezing, Kazuo's thrown forward out of the wreckage of his invention and face-down onto the floor, his robes still smouldering and spectacles cracked. The eight-tailed kitsune curses and tries to push himself off the ground, only to be stopped short by his marionettes collapsing all about him. Without the ghostly fire sustaining them, the constructs return to their inert state, raining their component pieces onto their creator. [party.has berwyn| Grinning triumphantly, Berwyn steps up and taps the back of the kitsune's head with the base of his staff. "So much for that, old man; despite all appearances, rock still beats paper. I've the better constructs, and you can't deny it now, can you?" Kazuo makes several angry fox noises, barks and yips interspersed with choice phrases from his mother tongue. You don't understand the language, but he nevertheless gets his meaning across just fine. ] The artificer spits soot out of his mouth, the bitter taste of foxfire-charred wood clearly not to his liking. "Beaten by [party.som|a young punk|a couple of young punks|a bunch of young punks]..." [party.has arona| "Young punks, eh?" Arona steps up, lowering her [arona.weapon] so that the business end is mere inches from Kazuo's face. "After all that you said, you're still the one on the ground here amidst your broken toys, soul-sucker. It's adorable." ] That's right. Now that he's brought all that he has to bear against you and still failed, is he going to insist on stopping you? "Don't be so hasty, now." Kazuo raises a hand off the ground and you step back, wondering just what he's got up his sleeve. Bringing it down on the floorboards with a firm smack, you hear the loud snap of a flame sparking into existence — and a large plume of choking dark smoke billows outward to consume him. By the time it's dissipated, there's no sign of the kitsune artificer, and that suits you just fine. You spend a little while longer searching through Kazuo's workshop, checking it over for any sign of Evergreen's little bag, but no luck. Nah, that would have been far too easy... while it would've made sense for something like the bountiful bag to be of interest to an artificer like him, you'll just have to search deeper in this den of foxes.
rows.translation: 空气中弥漫着燃烧余烬的味道。刚才这里也有这种味道吗？你想不起来了——就在几秒钟前，那套外形怪异、结构复杂的盔甲用它那像钳子一样的拳头猛击你刚才站立的地方，你不得不迅速躲开。现在你转过身来，发现 [pc.weapon] 已经准备就绪，但你的敌人却纹丝未动，反而半蹲着，与此同时，更多的傀儡从侧翼涌来，保护他们的主人。 他在干什么？ 然后，毫无征兆地，那具活体铠甲内部突然发生了爆炸，一阵阵狐火从它的关节处渗了出来。 又一次小小的爆炸震撼了这个构造物，这一次它碎成了无数碎片，它的创造者根本无法再维持所需的能量来让这些碎片保持在一起。咳嗽着、喘息着，和夫从自己发明的残骸中被抛了出来，面朝下摔在地板上，他的长袍仍在燃烧，眼镜也摔坏了。 八尾狐发出咒骂，试图将自己从地面推起来，但却因为周围的傀儡们全都崩溃了而无法得逞。没有了那股幽灵之火的支持，这些傀儡又恢复了无生命的状态，它们的零部件纷纷落回到了创造者的身上。 [party.has berwyn| 贝尔温得意地笑着走上前，用法杖的杖底轻敲了敲那只狐妖的脑袋。 就这样吧，老兄；尽管表面上看似不然，但石头终究还是比纸强。我的构造更加精良，这一点你现在总不能否认了吧？ 和夫发出了几声愤怒的狐狸叫声，同时夹杂着用他的母语说出的几句经典台词。虽然你听不懂这种语言，但他仍然把意思表达得非常清楚。 ] 这位工匠从嘴里吐出烟灰，显然，被狐火烧焦的木头带来的那股苦味让他非常不悦。 被……击败 [party.som|一个年轻的混混|几个年轻的混混|一群年轻的混混]..." [party.has arona| 小混混们，是吧？ 阿罗娜走上前，低下了身子。 [arona.weapon] 这样一来，那个商务方面的东西就离和夫的脸只有几英寸的距离了。 说了这么多，最终还是你自己躺在这里，周围满是破碎的玩具，真是个吸魂怪 可爱极了." ] 没错。既然他已经使出了所有手段来对付你，却仍然失败了，他还会继续坚持要阻止你吗？ 现在先别这么急。 和夫将一只手举到空中，你不由得后退了几步，心中充满疑惑——他究竟打算做什么。当他将那只手重重地落在地板上时，你听到一声剧烈的爆裂声，火焰瞬间燃了起来，与此同时，一股浓重的黑烟也腾涌而出，将他整个人吞没了。 等到那些雾气散去时，已经找不到那个狐妖工匠的踪迹了，而这对你来说恰恰是好事。 你又花了些时间在和雄的工作室里搜寻，仔细检查每一个角落，希望能找到那个常青女士的小袋子，但最终还是一无所获。 不，那样做未免太简单了……虽然像“丰饶袋”这样的物品确实会吸引像他这样的工匠，但你还是得在这片“狐妖窝”里再深入搜寻一番才行。
rows.raw: " The smell of burning embers fills the air. Was it there a moment ago? You don't remember, ducking out of the way as the living suit of strange, full-bodied armor smashes its pincer-like fist in the spot you were standing seconds ago. Whirling around, you have your [pc.weapon] at the ready, but your foe hasn't moved, instead half-crouched as more puppets swarm in from the sidelines to defend their master. What is he doing? Then without warning, something explodes from within the living armor, wisps of foxfire seeping from its joints. Another small explosion rocks the construct, and this time it shatters into so much debris, its creator simply unable to maintain the focus needed to hold it together. Coughing and wheezing, Kazuo's thrown forward out of the wreckage of his invention and face-down onto the floor, his robes still smouldering and spectacles cracked. The eight-tailed kitsune curses and tries to push himself off the ground, only to be stopped short by his marionettes collapsing all about him. Without the ghostly fire sustaining them, the constructs return to their inert state, raining their component pieces onto their creator. [party.has berwyn| Grinning triumphantly, Berwyn steps up and taps the back of the kitsune's head with the base of his staff. "So much for that, old man; despite all appearances, rock still beats paper. I've the better constructs, and you can't deny it now, can you?" Kazuo makes several angry fox noises, barks and yips interspersed with choice phrases from his mother tongue. You don't understand the language, but he nevertheless gets his meaning across just fine. ] The artificer spits soot out of his mouth, the bitter taste of foxfire-charred wood clearly not to his liking. "Beaten by [party.som|a young punk|a couple of young punks|a bunch of young punks]..." [party.has arona| "Young punks, eh?" Arona steps up, lowering her [arona.weapon] so that the business end is mere inches from Kazuo's face. "After all that you said, you're still the one on the ground here amidst your broken toys, soul-sucker. It's adorable." ] That's right. Now that he's brought all that he has to bear against you and still failed, is he going to insist on stopping you? "Don't be so hasty, now." Kazuo raises a hand off the ground and you step back, wondering just what he's got up his sleeve. Bringing it down on the floorboards with a firm smack, you hear the loud snap of a flame sparking into existence — and a large plume of choking dark smoke billows outward to consume him. By the time it's dissipated, there's no sign of the kitsune artificer, and that suits you just fine. You spend a little while longer searching through Kazuo's workshop, checking it over for any sign of Evergreen's little bag, but no luck. Nah, that would have been far too easy... while it would've made sense for something like the bountiful bag to be of interest to an artificer like him, you'll just have to search deeper in this den of foxes."

rows.original: You gasp hard as the living armor's pincer-like hand slams into your chest, cold metal knocking the wind out of you and sending your [pc.weapon] flying. You dart to the side, looking to retrieve your fallen weapon and get back into the fight, but before you know it, the construct's steely grip is upon you, pinning your arms to your sides. "Who's 'little' now, huh? Still think these are mere toys?" Gods, he sure does have an inferiority complex... [party.som|| You look around for [companion1.name], hoping that [companion1.heShe]'s in a position to get you out of this predicament. No such luck; [companion1.name] is caught in the living armor's other hand, struggling against its vice-like grip to little avail. | You look around for [companion1.name], hoping that [companion1.heShe]'s in a position to get you out of this predicament. No such luck; [companion1.name] is caught in the living armor's other hand, struggling against its vice-like grip to little avail. [companion2.name] isn't in much of a better position either, trapped under one of the construct's feet and swarmed by the many puppets Kazuo's summoned to his aid. ] [party.has berwyn| "And as for you," Kazuo continues, smacking Berwyn against the ground and sending the dog-boy yelping in pain, "let that teach you that experience and finesse will outplay sheer strength every time. Power is nothing if you can't direct it to useful ends — a lesson you've learned a little too late, punk. Paper beats rock; let that sink into whatever you natives pass for a brain." ] Before you know it, you find yourself lifted up and in front of what passes for a helmet in this mechanical monstrosity of wood and metal. How the artificer is seeing you from within is anyone's guess, considering there aren't any visor slits in it like a normal full helm would, but he goes through the motions of studying you anyway. "Gods damn it," Kazuo mutters, more to himself than anyone else. "I'm getting too old for this nonsense. I'll let Komari sort you out and be done with it, and maybe, just maybe, Mai will be punctual with my tea for once." With you still in his steely grasp, Kazuo turns and stomps out of his workshop and into the hallways, the footfalls of his living armor echoing ominously. The last thing you see before you lose it is the sight of [party.som |the nightmarish puppet marching along behind you, their strings gleaming in the dim orange light. |[companion1.name], trussed up by a multitude of puppet strings wound about [companion1.hisHer] body. Kazuo's puppet horde has picked [companion1.himHer] up like a sack of meat and is marching behind their master in eerie lockstep, bringing your friends to share your fate. |[companion1.name] and [companion2.name], trussed up in a multitude of glimmering puppet strings wound about their bodies. Kazuo's puppet horde has picked them up and is marching behind their master in eerie lockstep, bringing your friends to share your fate. ]
rows.translation: 当那具活体铠甲的钳状手猛地抓住你的胸膛时，你不禁剧烈地喘息起来——冰冷的金属带来的冲击力让你彻底失去了呼吸的能力 [pc.weapon] 你迅速向旁边闪避，试图捡起掉落的武器重新投入战斗，但还没等你反应过来，那个机械构造物就已经用它钢铁般的爪子抓住了你，将你的双臂紧紧固定在身体两侧。 现在谁才是‘小家伙’呢，哈？还觉得这些只是普通的玩具吗？ 天啊，他确实有很严重的自卑情结…… [party.som|| 你环顾四周，寻找着 [companion1.name]，希望如此 [companion1.heShe]有人有能力帮你摆脱这种困境。可惜，并没有这样的机会。 [companion1.name] 被活体护甲的另只手抓住，拼命挣扎想要摆脱它那如同钳子一般的束缚，但却毫无效果。 | 你环顾四周，寻找着 [companion1.name]，希望如此 [companion1.heShe]有人有能力帮你摆脱这种困境。可惜，并没有这样的机会。 [companion1.name] 被活体护甲的另一只手抓住，拼命挣扎想要摆脱它那如同绞索一般的束缚，但却毫无效果。 [companion2.name] 他的处境也好不到哪里去，被那个建筑物的足部踩在下面，同时还被和雄召唤出来的许多傀儡围住了。 ] [party.has berwyn| 至于 你," 和夫继续用力将贝尔温摔在地上，那只狗男孩疼得大叫起来。 让这件事告诉你：经验与技巧永远比单纯的力量更有效。如果你不能将力量运用到有用的地方，那么力量就毫无意义——这个教训你学得有点太晚了，小子。纸能打败石头，把这个道理记在你们这些土包子们的脑子里吧。 ] 不知不觉间，你发现自己被抬了起来，站在这个由木头和金属构成的机械怪物面前——那个东西勉强可以算作是一顶头盔。至于制造这个头盔的人是如何从里面观察你的，那就只有天知道了，因为这个头盔上并没有像普通全盔那样的面甲缝隙，但他还是照例仔细地打量了你一番。 该死的！ 和别人相比，和也更多是在自言自语。 我年纪大了，不再适合干这种无聊的事了。就让小Mari来处理你们吧，这样或许……也许，舞终于会按时给我送茶来了。 当你的身体仍被他那钢铁般有力的手臂紧紧抓住时，和夫转身大步走出了他的工作室，走进了走廊里，他那仿佛由活生生的人或金属构成的“盔甲”所发出的足部步声，回荡着令人不寒而栗的声响。在失去意识之前，你最后看到的，就是这一幕 [party.som |那个噩梦般的木偶跟在你身后行进，它的线在昏暗的橙色光线中闪闪发光。 |[companion1.name]被无数根缠绕在身上的牵线牢牢控制着 [companion1.hisHer] 卡佐的傀儡大军已经行动起来了。 [companion1.himHer] 它们像一袋肉一样被提起来，然后以诡异的步伐跟在它们的主人后面行进，让你的朋友们也陷入与你相同的命运之中。 |[companion1.name] 以及 [companion2.name]他们的身上缠绕着无数闪闪发轻型的牵线，仿佛被束缚成了木偶。和夫的木偶大军将这些人类抓了起来，现在正以诡异的步伐跟在他们的主人身后行进，让你的朋友们也陷入了与你相同的命运之中。 ]

rows.original: With how much of a wreck the artificer's workshop is, maybe there's something that you can use here. No, probably because of how messy it is — there might be something missed that isn't hidden away... Aha! Buried beneath a pile of wooden limbs and loose string is a small box with a distinctly antiseptic smell to it. You prise open the lid, and indeed are rewarded with a number of useful tinctures — though you aren't able to read the language on the various jars and bottles, the distinctive scent alone is enough to confirm the identity of several common concoctions in the Marches. The job of artificer must be a rather painful one if he was getting cuts and scrapes that often...
rows.translation: 看那个工匠的工作室乱成那样，说不定还能找到些什么能用的东西吧。不过，大概没什么吧 因为 可以想象，那里一定是一片混乱——或许有些东西被遗漏了，并没有被藏起来…… 啊哈！在一堆木头残骸和散落的绳子下面，你发现了一个散发着浓烈消毒气味的小盒子。你掀开盖子，果然看到了几种非常有用的药水。虽然你看不懂那些罐子和瓶子上写的是什么文字，但仅凭那些独特的气味，你就能够认出这些是在边境地区常见的药剂。 如果一个工匠经常受到割伤和擦伤，那么他的工作肯定相当辛苦吧……

rows.original: Leaving the artificer's workshop, you're introduced yet again to the maze-like network of hallways that form the interior of the kitsune den. At this point, it's hard to shake off the feeling that the place is alive... but of course it's alive, it's a giant tree. Did you think it wasn't alive? Maybe the den itself is confounding you... This stretch of hallway is long and winding, the smell of sap getting stronger now; do these people live with this all the time? It's not an unpleasant scent, carried by the constant draft that rushes in from behind you, but the floral, perfumy scent makes the mind wander... [var0|come to think of it, you know this fragrance. It's the one Kiyoko wears on her person; the thought is more than a little melancholy.] ...And wandering your mind must have been, because you don't hear the heavy footsteps until they're almost upon you. Snapping out of your thoughts, you look up and down the hallway's length for something to hide behind or a room to duck into, but no such luck. Retreat is a theoretical possibility, but you wouldn't be able to round the last corner you passed to evade whoever's bearing down on you. [party.som| |You're not the only one to be affected by this strange place. [party.compNames] looks around blearily, as if [companion1.heShe]'d just woken up from a pleasant dream. The sound of impending danger is no less pressing, though, and at a sharp glance from you [companion1.heShe] makes ready with [companion1.hisHer] weapon and steels [companion1.himHer]self for the inevitable. |You're not the only one to be affected by the aura of this strange place. [party.compNames] look woozy and bleary, as if they'd just woken up from a pleasant dream. The heavy footsteps snap them back to alertness soon enough, though, and they quickly take up position by your side, ready for what at this point is inevitable. ] When he does appear, though, you're almost disappointed. A single black-furred, five-tailed kitsune rounds the corner, outfitted in full-body armor consisting of what looks like numerous interlocking red-painted plates over a gambeson. He's tall for a kitsune, which means he's merely slightly short by Marches standards, and kind of lanky to boot. The armor's made in a style clearly native to his homeland — the helmet even has little ears on it like those of catfolk make do, instead of folding one's ears under the interior in lupine fashion. But what strikes you about this fellow is how young he looks — not because of his build or anything, but the poor bastard's a pretty boy, with a baby face under an unkempt shock of hair that's in sharp contrast with the military neatness with which he carries himself. [party.comp arona atugia |[silly |Arona just chuckles at the sight. "Lumia's tits, really now? What sick bastard sends a baby like this to fight? This is what passes for a warrior amongst these ginger-tailed soul-suckers?" |"Hey, I didn't know these ginger-tailed soul-suckers actually had warriors!" Arona exclaims without the slightest attempt at subtlety whatsoever. "Wonder if they're any good; I'm already getting a chub just thinking about it. Hope he's less of a pushover than those we've met so far, although I'm not holding out hope for it. You need to eat more meat than what this boy's been getting to build any kind of muscle." ] |"I'm not likin' the looks 'o this," Atugia whispers to you. "We might be in f'r a bit o' trouble." No doubt she's seen some things in her time, but you'd like to hear her reasoning. "Sure, he ain't got much in the way of mass, but the way he carries himself makes my hackles rise. Leastways, he ain't no stranger to shedding blood; muscle ain't much good if y' don't got the will to use it." ] The black-furred kitsune's carrying a curved longsw — no, it's a greatsword in his left hand by the lacquered scabbard, and freezes for a fraction of a second as he spots you, his entire body tensing as his eyes narrow and ears fold back. "Barbarians, in great-great-grandmother's house." [party.has arona |"Damn right you've got one here." Arona smiles, all tusks and teeth. "You going to do something about it with that pretty face of yours? Bet it's pretty good for sucking cock, and I'm already getting a good stiffy just thinking of how much of a fight you'll put up." | [pc.bg barbarian |Suuure. You are a barbarian, but somehow you don't think that's what he meant by it. |Of course. To the likes of him, you would be a barbarian, wouldn't you? Wouldn't have mattered who you were, where you came from or your upbringing... you're just a plain old barbarian. ] ] You briefly consider a parley, then drop the idea as a soft hiss of steel on silk reaches you. The kitsune has drawn his greatsword, letting the scabbard fall to the floor, and is rapidly closing the distance between you in big, easy strides. "I told great-great-grandmother it'd happen someday, and now it has. Maybe she won't dismiss me out of hand any more after I bring your heads to her! Maybe she'll respect me for once!" With that, the black-furred kitsune charges with all the tact and zeal of a hungry glory hound, sword gripped in both hands and poised for a downward strike. [party.manyCompanions |"Is he crazy?" [companion1.name] says, steeling [companion1.himHer]self as your foe bears down on you. "He's outnumbered three to one!" He must be quite skilled to be confident in taking on all of you at once. And if he's crazy... well, that just makes him all the more dangerous. You'll have to be on your toes with this one... ] It's a fight!
rows.translation: 离开工匠的工作室后，你再次走进了那由迷宫般的走廊构成的九尾妖巢内部。此时，你很难摆脱这样的感觉：这个地方仿佛是有生命的 过程 它是有生命的，它是一棵巨大的树。你难道以为它 不是 还活着吗？也许就是这个洞穴本身在迷惑你…… 这段走廊又长又曲折，现在那股树液的味道越来越浓了……这些人真的是一直生活在这种环境中吗？这种气味并不难闻，而且有从你身后不断吹来的微风将它带进来，但这种带有花香的芬芳气息确实会让人思绪飘远…… [var0|仔细想来，你 知道 这种香味……正是清子身上使用的那种味道；一想到这一点，我就不由得感到一阵 melancholy。] ……你的脑海中肯定在胡思乱想，因为直到那些重型的脚步声几乎逼近你时，你才终于注意到它们的存在。你猛然回过神来，沿着走廊四处张望，试图找到可以躲藏的地方或一间可以躲进去的房间，但却一无所获。虽然理论上你可以选择撤退，但当你已经过了最后一个拐角之后，就再也无法躲开那些正在追捕你的人了。 [party.som| |不止你一个人受到了这个奇怪地方的影响。 [party.compNames] 茫然地环顾四周，仿佛 [companion1.heShe]我刚刚从一个美好的梦中醒来。然而，那种迫在眉睫的危险感依然十分强烈，当你突然转向我看去的时候 [companion1.heShe] 准备好……以便 [companion1.hisHer] 武器与钢材 [companion1.himHer]为不可避免的事情做好准备。 |受到这个奇怪地方所散发出的气息影响的人，不止你一个。 [party.compNames] 他们看起来有些迷迷糊糊、视线不清，仿佛刚刚从一个美好的梦中醒来。然而，重型的脚步声很快让他们恢复了清醒，他们迅速站在你的身边，准备迎接此时已不可避免的事情。 ] 然而，当它真正出现时，你反而会感到有些失望。只见一只全身覆盖着黑色毛皮、拥有五条尾巴的狐妖从拐角处出现了，它穿着一套由许多红色涂漆的金属板相互连接而成的全身铠甲。 对于一只狐妖来说，他的个子已经算比较高的了；按照马奇们的标准来看，他只是稍微矮了一点而已，而且身体还显得有点瘦长。他所穿的盔甲明显是按照他家乡的传统风格制作的——甚至连头盔上都有像猫族那样的小耳朵，而不是像狼族那样把耳朵折在头盔内部。 但让你注意到这个家伙的地方，是他的年轻外表——并非因为他的体型或什么其他原因，而是因为这个可怜的家伙确实是个帅气的男孩，一张娃娃脸搭配着一头乱蓬蓬的头发，这与他身上所展现出的军人般的整洁形象形成了鲜明的对比。 [party.comp arona atugia |[silly |看到这一幕，阿罗娜只是淡淡地笑了笑。 卢米娅的胸部？真的吗？到底哪个变态会发这种东西 宝宝 就这样战斗吗？ 这个 在这些红尾巴的吸血鬼当中，他算得上是真正的战士吗？ |嘿，我之前根本不知道这些红尾巴的吸血鬼居然还有战士！ 阿罗娜毫无掩饰地大声喊了出来。 不知道他们到底有多厉害；光是想想就让我觉得有点紧张。希望这个家伙不会像我们之前遇到的那些人那样好对付，不过其实我也不抱太大希望。要想长出肌肉，你得吃比这个男孩现在吃的更多的肉才行。 ] |我不太喜欢这个外观。 阿图吉娅在你耳边低语。 我们可能遇到了一些麻烦。 毫无疑问，她在这些年里见过了许多事情，但你还是想听听她的解释。 没错，他的体格并不强壮，但他的行事作风确实让我感到不安。至少，他并不害怕流血；如果没有使用的决心，再强的肌肉也毫无用处。 ] 那只黑毛狐妖的左手部中握着一把镶有漆饰护手部的弯曲长剑。当他看到你的那一刻，他整个身体瞬间绷紧了，眼睛眯成了一条线，耳朵也向后折叠，静止了那一瞬间。 野蛮人啊，真是远古时代的遗留。 [party.has arona |没错，你这里确实有一个。 阿罗娜露出了笑容，露出的全是獠牙和牙齿。 你就用你那张漂亮的脸蛋去做点什么吧？我打赌，你肯定很擅长口交吧……光是想象你会如何抵抗，我就已经兴奋得不行了。 | [pc.bg barbarian |当然。你没问题。 是 一个野蛮人，但不知为何，你并不认为他真的是这个意思。 |当然。对于他这样的人，你 会 你就是一个野蛮人，不是吗？无论你是谁，来自哪里，或者有着怎样的成长经历……你本质上就是一个野蛮人而已。 ] ] 你短暂地考虑过进行谈判，但当一阵钢铁与丝绸摩擦发出的轻响传入耳中时，你立刻放弃了这个想法。那只狐妖已经拔出了他的巨剑，将剑鞘扔在了地上，然后以大步流星的速度迅速向你逼近。 我 告诉了 我的高祖母啊，这种事总有一天会发生的，而现在它终于实现了。也许当我把你们的头带给她的时候，她不会再立刻拒绝我了吧？也许这一次，她会尊重我吧！ 说着，这只黑毛狐妖便以一种饥渴的猎犬般的敏捷与狂热冲了上来，双手部紧握着剑，准备向下劈砍。 [party.manyCompanions |他是不是疯了？ [companion1.name] 说着，便下定了决心。 [companion1.himHer]当你将自身视为敌人并向你袭来时 他的兵力对比是三比一啊！ 他肯定拥有高超的本领，否则不可能有信心同时对付你们所有人。而如果他是个疯子……那么，他只会变得更加危险。面对这样的人，你们必须保持高度警惕…… ] 这是一场激烈的战斗！
rows.raw: " Leaving the artificer's workshop, you're introduced yet again to the maze-like network of hallways that form the interior of the kitsune den. At this point, it's hard to shake off the feeling that the place is alive... but of course it's alive, it's a giant tree. Did you think it wasn't alive? Maybe the den itself is confounding you... This stretch of hallway is long and winding, the smell of sap getting stronger now; do these people live with this all the time? It's not an unpleasant scent, carried by the constant draft that rushes in from behind you, but the floral, perfumy scent makes the mind wander... [var0|come to think of it, you know this fragrance. It's the one Kiyoko wears on her person; the thought is more than a little melancholy.] ...And wandering your mind must have been, because you don't hear the heavy footsteps until they're almost upon you. Snapping out of your thoughts, you look up and down the hallway's length for something to hide behind or a room to duck into, but no such luck. Retreat is a theoretical possibility, but you wouldn't be able to round the last corner you passed to evade whoever's bearing down on you. [party.som| |You're not the only one to be affected by this strange place. [party.compNames] looks around blearily, as if [companion1.heShe]'d just woken up from a pleasant dream. The sound of impending danger is no less pressing, though, and at a sharp glance from you [companion1.heShe] makes ready with [companion1.hisHer] weapon and steels [companion1.himHer]self for the inevitable. |You're not the only one to be affected by the aura of this strange place. [party.compNames] look woozy and bleary, as if they'd just woken up from a pleasant dream. The heavy footsteps snap them back to alertness soon enough, though, and they quickly take up position by your side, ready for what at this point is inevitable. ] When he does appear, though, you're almost disappointed. A single black-furred, five-tailed kitsune rounds the corner, outfitted in full-body armor consisting of what looks like numerous interlocking red-painted plates over a gambeson. He's tall for a kitsune, which means he's merely slightly short by Marches standards, and kind of lanky to boot. The armor's made in a style clearly native to his homeland — the helmet even has little ears on it like those of catfolk make do, instead of folding one's ears under the interior in lupine fashion. But what strikes you about this fellow is how young he looks — not because of his build or anything, but the poor bastard's a pretty boy, with a baby face under an unkempt shock of hair that's in sharp contrast with the military neatness with which he carries himself. [party.comp arona atugia |[silly |Arona just chuckles at the sight. "Lumia's tits, really now? What sick bastard sends a baby like this to fight? This is what passes for a warrior amongst these ginger-tailed soul-suckers?" |"Hey, I didn't know these ginger-tailed soul-suckers actually had warriors!" Arona exclaims without the slightest attempt at subtlety whatsoever. "Wonder if they're any good; I'm already getting a chub just thinking about it. Hope he's less of a pushover than those we've met so far, although I'm not holding out hope for it. You need to eat more meat than what this boy's been getting to build any kind of muscle." ] |"I'm not likin' the looks 'o this," Atugia whispers to you. "We might be in f'r a bit o' trouble." No doubt she's seen some things in her time, but you'd like to hear her reasoning. "Sure, he ain't got much in the way of mass, but the way he carries himself makes my hackles rise. Leastways, he ain't no stranger to shedding blood; muscle ain't much good if y' don't got the will to use it." ] The black-furred kitsune's carrying a curved longsw — no, it's a greatsword in his left hand by the lacquered scabbard, and freezes for a fraction of a second as he spots you, his entire body tensing as his eyes narrow and ears fold back. "Barbarians, in great-great-grandmother's house." [party.has arona |"Damn right you've got one here." Arona smiles, all tusks and teeth. "You going to do something about it with that pretty face of yours? Bet it's pretty good for sucking cock, and I'm already getting a good stiffy just thinking of how much of a fight you'll put up." | [pc.bg barbarian |Suuure. You are a barbarian, but somehow you don't think that's what he meant by it. |Of course. To the likes of him, you would be a barbarian, wouldn't you? Wouldn't have mattered who you were, where you came from or your upbringing... you're just a plain old barbarian. ] ] You briefly consider a parley, then drop the idea as a soft hiss of steel on silk reaches you. The kitsune has drawn his greatsword, letting the scabbard fall to the floor, and is rapidly closing the distance between you in big, easy strides. "I told great-great-grandmother it'd happen someday, and now it has. Maybe she won't dismiss me out of hand any more after I bring your heads to her! Maybe she'll respect me for once!" With that, the black-furred kitsune charges with all the tact and zeal of a hungry glory hound, sword gripped in both hands and poised for a downward strike. [party.manyCompanions |"Is he crazy?" [companion1.name] says, steeling [companion1.himHer]self as your foe bears down on you. "He's outnumbered three to one!" He must be quite skilled to be confident in taking on all of you at once. And if he's crazy... well, that just makes him all the more dangerous. You'll have to be on your toes with this one... ] It's a fight!"

rows.original: The kitsune warrior stumbles back with a yelp, his curved greatsword slipping from his grip and landing on the floor with a clang. Seeing this opening, you move to seize the opportunity and press the attack, [party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] right behind you as you charge forward|knowing that you might not get another chance]. Even with you throwing him to the ground and raining blows on his helmet and chestpiece with your [pc.weapon], he's incredibly tenacious and simply refuses to submit, almost managing to turn the tables once or twice as he attempts to throttle you with his bare hands. [party.has arona |"Stay down, damn it!" It's hard to tell whether Arona's trying to knock out the kitsune warrior or flat-out kill him, considering how vigorously she's applying her [arona.weapon] to the task. "Just give up already, you little bastard!" ] Eventually, though, you catch the kitsune on the back of his helmet with a solid smack and he stops struggling, falling limp as he rolls over face-down on the ground. Even his tails aren't twitching any more, and it's only then that you allow yourself to relax and catch your breath. [party.comp cait brint |"I-is he dead?" Cait asks in a quiet, subdued voice. There's blood on her staff where she'd been clubbing the kitsune, and her face is more than a little pale. Maybe he is. Maybe he isn't. You really don't want to risk him coming to and launching straight back into that suicidal fury; helping him might actually worsen his chances of survival. Cait doesn't look like she's buying this in the slightest, but nevertheless nods and turns away from the ugly sight. It must be hard for someone schooled since young in the teachings of Mallach to harden her heart like this, no matter how necessary... |On his part, Brint's leaning against a wall, lungs heaving as he wipes the sweat off his brow. "Khaaaak. I feel like I've drunk a whole cask of bloodwine and taken on an entire regiment of Chargers in the colosseum. Little fox guy just didn't know when to give up. Maybe he didn't know how." Hope he's the exception to his kind and not the norm, then. Brint takes a huge pull from his waterskin and exhales a plume of mist. "I kinda like him. Reminds me of some of the gladiators who'd pass through the village when I was growing up — they're the sort who also don't know when to give up, although probably for different reasons. It'd be a real shame if we've ended up killing this little guy." Maybe, but either way you don't want to stick around to find out. ] One way or the other, you don't want to linger here a moment longer than is absolutely necessary. When you feel you've recovered enough to not be completely useless should something surprise you in the hallways, you make like a tree and leave quickly, [party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] hurrying along behind you|just in case someone comes along to investigate the commotion, amongst other more unsavoury things].
rows.translation: 那只九尾狐战士发出一声惨叫，踉跄着后退，他那把弯曲的大剑从手部中滑落，发出叮当的声响落在地上。看到这个机会，你立刻抓住时机，发动了攻击。 [party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] 就在你向前冲动的瞬间，它紧随其后。|知道你可能不会再有第二次机会了。]即使你把他摔倒在地，用拳头连续击打他的头盔和胸甲 [pc.weapon]他有着惊人的坚韧不拔的精神，坚决不肯屈服。有几次，他甚至试图用赤手部扼住你的喉咙，差点就反败为胜了。 [party.has arona |趴下，快趴下！ 很难判断阿罗娜到底是想击晕那只狐人战士，还是想直接杀死他，因为她的攻击力度实在太大 [arona.weapon] 能够胜任这项任务。 干脆放弃吧，你这个小混蛋！ ] 最终，你还是狠狠地拍在了那只狐妖的头盔上，它立刻停止了挣扎，软软地倒在地上，面朝下躺着，就连它的尾巴也不再动了。直到那时，你才放松下来，喘了口气。 [party.comp cait brint |他、他死了吗？ 凯特用一种轻声而压抑的语气问道。她的法杖上沾满了她用来击打那只狐妖的血迹，她的脸色也显得异常苍白。 “也许他会醒过来，也许不会……你真的不想冒险让他再次陷入那种自杀式的狂怒之中吧；帮助他反而可能会降低他生存的机会。 凯特看起来丝毫不相信这一切，但还是点了点头，然后转开了视线，不再去看那丑陋的场景。对于一个从小就接受马拉赫教义熏陶的人来说，要想让自己的心变得如此冷漠，想必是非常困难的，无论这种冷漠是多么必要。.. |布林特靠在墙上，喘着粗气，一边擦着额头上的汗水。 哈……我感觉自己就像喝下了一整桶血酒，还在斗兽场里与一整个冲锋队展开了激战。那个小狐狸根本不知道什么时候该放弃，也许他根本不知道该如何放弃。 但愿他是同类中的例外，而不是普遍现象。 布林特从水袋中喝了一大口水，然后呼出一团雾气。 我有点喜欢他。他让我想起我小时候那些经常经过我们村庄的角斗士们——他们也是那种从不知道什么时候该放弃的人，只不过原因可能不同吧。如果我们最终杀死了这个孩子，那就太可惜了。 也许吧，但不管怎样，你肯定不想留下来等着验证这个结果。 ] 无论如何，你都不应该在这里多待片刻，除非确实有必要的原因。当你觉得自己已经恢复到足以应对走廊里可能出现的任何意外情况时，就应该立刻离开。 [party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] 急匆匆地跟在你后面。|以防有人过来调查这场骚动，以及其他一些不那么光彩的事情。].

rows.original:
When defeated, it's wise to hope that your enemy is an evil man. He'll want to gloat, savour his victory, watch you squirm. Triumph to such a person isn't worth much if his enemy is spared the emptiness and sting of defeat.

        A good man, or at least a self-righteous one, will kill you without another word.
        
        Sensing that you no longer have the strength to resist him, the kitsune warrior raises his greatsword, readying a flamboyant overhead stroke to finish you off. He certainly has a sense for theaterics...
        
        As the keenly honed edge is about to bite deep into your neck, though, a brilliant amber light emerges from the amulet and its orb, shielding you from the killing blow. Sparks scrape from tortured metal as the kitsune grits his teeth, pressing his weight against the magical shield as if willing to penetrate it by sheer force of will alone, but it holds.
        
        Kiyoko just saved your life...
        
        However, the problem of your bruises and bleeding out is far from solved. As you feel your strength ebb from you, your only thought is how ironic it would be for you to be saved by Kiyoko, only to succumb to exsanguination...
rows.translation:
当失败时，最好希望自己的敌人是个邪恶之人。那样他就会想要炫耀自己的胜利，享受那种成就感，看着你痛苦挣扎。对于这样的人来说，如果他的敌人没有体验到失败的空虚与痛苦，那么他的胜利也就没有什么意义了。

        一个好人，或者至少是一个自以为正义的人，会不发一语就杀了你。

察觉到你已经没有力气反抗他了，那只狐人战士举起了他的巨剑，准备用一记华丽的挥砍动作来终结你的生命。 他的戏剧性表现力确实令人印象深刻……

然而，就在那锋利无比的武器即将刺中你的脖颈时，护身符及其球体突然发出了耀眼的琥珀色轻型芒，将你从那致命一击中拯救了出来。 当狐妖咬紧牙关，用尽全力压迫那面魔法盾时，金属上迸发出火花；他仿佛仅凭意志力就能穿透那面盾牌，但它依然坚不可摧。

清子刚刚救了你的命。然而，你身上的淤伤和出血问题远未得到解决。当你感到体力逐渐衰竭时，你唯一在想的，就是如果最终是由清子救了你，却又因为失血过多而死去，那该有多具有讽刺意味。..
