|我和孩子们把一切都处理得很好。你知道，当这一切开始的时候，我决定尝试重现我母亲曾经用来照顾我和我的兄弟姐妹的那种方式，结果效果非常好。孩子们得到了照顾、饮食也得到了保障，同时还得到了足够的关爱和关注。虽然这种方式可能与你习惯的有所不同，但在我看来，没有必要重新发明轮子——事实上，我甚至让这种方式变得更好了。 哦？ 清子点了点头。 当一只有意向成为母亲的红狐决定独自行动时，她并不会独自完成这一切；通常，她的几只兄弟姐妹也会跟着一起。它们会帮助她照料各种事务，让那个地方变得适合小狐狸幼崽的成长。当然，它们的数量也会因此增加，但大多数九尾狐并没有那么强大的…… 你看到清子用舌头舔了舔嘴唇 作为一位母亲，生育能力当然是非常重要的。我必须承认，星界空间在这方面确实提供了巨大的帮助——拥有一个能够随着家庭规模扩大而自动扩展的‘家’，实在是非常方便，更不用说那些自动完成的洗衣任务了。这些功能让我有更多的时间来照顾孩子们。 这也让她有更多时间来增加他们的人数。 嘿嘿…… 清子微微歪着头，把耳朵向前折叠。 如果那是你想要的，我当然不会拒绝和你一起玩。 |我和孩子们现在过得非常开心，真的非常感谢你的关心。我已经很久很久没有这种感觉了，孩子们整天都洋溢着幸福的笑容。刚开始做这份工作的时候，我还有点担心自己是否能够像我母亲那样给予孩子们他们所需要的关爱，但后来一切似乎都变得顺其自然了。现在我甚至都不用去思考这些事情，一切都会自然而然地得到解决。 就像她总是意外怀孕一样，对吧？ 正是这样。你明白我的意思吧。虽然这确实需要我付出一些努力，但过程实在太有趣了，以至于这些努力简直都不算什么。 啊，能够将自己热爱的事情作为职业来从事，真是太棒了。一般来说，熟悉某事物反而会让人对其产生厌倦感，但显然，这对你的那个九尾狐老婆以及她那一大群孩子来说并不适用。 有时候它们会很安静、很平静，而有时候则会到处乱跑。不过至少它们的哥哥姐姐们正在逐渐学会承担责任——当我们终于离开这里的时候，它们肯定会需要这些能力的。 是的…… 就像我说的，我很开心，孩子们也很开心。你们不必担心我们，去做你们该做的事情吧。] ]
rows.raw: " [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 4 8 16 24 32|[rand|"I'd be lying if I said I wasn't at least a little worried about the whole thing," Kiyoko admits. "I mean, for my tummy to swell up so quickly and my baby to grow into a child almost instantly... it's just not what I'm used to seeing. What does this place do to children? To me? Is it somewhere where I'd want to raise sons and daughters?" You pat Kiyoko on the shoulder and tell her that it's going to be all right. "I appreciate the sentiment, [pc.name], but the fact is that neither of us are sure of that." The kitsune flattens her fox ears against her head and rubs her temples. "Yes, I understand that there's little I can really do about the situation save do my best to raise Kinu well, but I'm not completely rational about this, you know?" Saying nothing, you continue to pat Kiyoko on the shoulder, slowly moving up to her head. It's all you can do to fight the melancholy creeping up on the usually peppy kitsune. "I mean, how much time have I lost without spending those years that I would've with our child as an infant? Sure, on the good side it means I don't have to deal with whole baskets of dirty diapers like I did for my brothers and sisters when they were young, but... well, babies have their moments. I really did like my siblings when they were babies; they were all so cute and fuzzy. "But listen to me go on like this, worrying about what I can't change. My situation's improved so much already, and all I can think about is how it might get worse. "I'd like to think I'm not one to scare easily, [pc.name]. But I do remember at least two times when I've been shaken to my core: first, when I realized I was trapped here in the Astral Plane, and secondly, when it hit home that I'm now responsible for more than just myself." |"I can't really decide whether Kinu takes more after me or you," Kiyoko says after some thought. "Little tyke's a kitsune all right, with the playfulness to match, but there's more to someone than their exterior, after all." Is kitsune blood that strong? Kiyoko shrugs. "I don't know. Never seen anyone breed with someone who wasn't a kitsune as well. And to be honest, even if I did, it's not as we did things the... um, conventional way, or at least in terms of what really happened." There's no need for undue worry, now. By all appearances, the daughter you and her made together is a perfectly normal and happy youngster. "I hope..." |"I suppose I'd better get to remembering all the things I used to do when Mother made me babysit my siblings. That knowledge is going to get put to use in good time." A gleam creeps into your eye. Oh? Kiyoko smiles, a warm, indeterminate smile that could turn naughty any moment. "Somehow, [pc.name], I get the distinct feeling that I'm not going to have the one and only kit to my name, thank you very much." Why, is that a divination she just made? A prediction of the future? And what are the odds on that, if she doesn't mind you asking? "Well, we diviners never say to be completely certain, but the chances of that are about as close to perfect as one can get." [kiyoko.pregStage 1|She rubs the rounded swell of her womb for emphasis. ] ] |[rand|So, how are the kids treating her? "You know how they say that two children aren't that much more work than one?" Not really, but it's an interesting saying. "Or how three aren't that much more work than two? Or how four aren't that much more work than three?" Yeah, you can see where this is going. "They have their good and bad days, and I have mine," Kiyoko continues with a sigh of resignation, then nods at you. "Like my own mother before me, I have to learn to take it all in stride. At least I've done this before, so I'm no stranger to juggling the care of several children." |"I've been drawing up a proper education for the children," Kiyoko tells you. "It's been hard to decide on an exact curriculum, but I hope to get things down soon enough." She's got to be a good teacher, isn't she? After all, she taught herself so many things while stuck on the Astral Plane. "Learning something yourself is one thing, imparting knowledge to another is something else altogether, although I won't say that there isn't overlap between the two. Thankfully, the children seem studious enough and willing to learn." They certainly take after their mother, then. "My main concern is practical real-life experience they'll need once you get us out of here," Kiyoko adds. "The forest beyond the hilltop might be endless, but in terms of variety it's actually very limited. I'd rather my sons and daughters not grow up stunted in that regard." |"To be completely honest, I'm quite thankful for the Astral Plane providing us with what we need," Kiyoko tells you after pausing to sip her tea. "Having so many of those needling little daily tasks done for you does make caring for a great number of children all the more possible." Yeah, you can see how leaving a dirty heap of clothes and finding fresh laundry in the cabinet would help. A nod. "Of course, I still assign chores; it took some working out, but I've got a good schedule going. Working the orchards, dusting and cleaning, cooking, making small repairs. I actually have to ask the plane itself to not fix those bits so the children can get to them, but I think it's a vitally important part of their education to realize that one day, not everything is going to fall into their lap when they want it." Living in a place which is pretty much as close as one can get to paradise... "Yes," Kiyoko says, finishing the thought for you. "It's a slow, painful death — if not of the body, then of the spirit. They won't suffer from crushing loneliness like I did, but it'll be an uphill battle to keep them from ending up utterly spoilt." Like how the Belharan Empire was just before its fall? Kiyoko wrinkles her nose daintily. "Something like that." ] |[rand|Her family's starting to get bigger these days, isn't it? Kiyoko wiggles her ears and smiles demurely at you. "Yes, it is. And I suppose I should thank you for that. I wasn't planning on this when I first made that proposal, and even for some time after I thought of the children as... by-products of your energy transferral. "Now, of course, I'm properly shamed for even entertaining such thoughts. Being a big sister is similar to being a mother in some aspects, but very different in others; I shouldn't have brought all of my expectations to the fold." From what you've seen of her, she's been the doing her utmost to be the best mother that she possibly can be. "I don't know about that, and even if it were true — well, is my best enough? But what I'm getting at, though, is that even though it has its ups and downs, this family that you've given me has been a source of constant joy in what ought to be this prison of mine. I can be grateful for as much." |"Not too long ago, I finished drawing up a system for putting some of the older children in charge of their younger brothers and sisters." Much like the one her own mother instituted, right? Kiyoko nods. "More or less. It worked rather well for me — after all, delegation is key everywhere, and a large family like this is no exemption. I only have so many hands and tails, after all!" And has it worked out well? "So far. At least this has been tried and tested, and I only need to step in when actual emergencies arise, instead of personally taking care of every single little chore and hiccup. How do you think I still get time to fold origami, do calligraphy and play the koto?" |"If you haven't noticed already, the cabin's begun to change." You think you have, but it's more and interior than an exterior thing, is it? Kiyoko shakes her head. "Remember, orbs of transference were created as weapons with which armies of kitsune were to be smuggled. The Astral Plane is perfectly capable of housing, feeding and otherwise providing for the needs of a literal army — and it changes itself to suit that fact." Right... "Whatever happens, we'll always be adequately provided for, so you don't have to worry about us. Focus on your efforts beyond this little realm." You will. ] |[rand|"You know how some women say they're turning into their mothers?" Yes, but they usually mean it in a derogatory sense, don't they? "Oh? And how do you know I don't mean it as such?" Aw, come on. You've been around her for long enough, known her in much more than one sense of the word... she didn't think that you wouldn't be able to read her, did she? That, and the fact that she's smiling in her oh-so-demure way. "I am?" She was. For being a servant of a trickster deity, she's not very tricksy. Nor very self-aware, either, which probably precludes the first. "No, I suppose not. But back to the point — to put it in a better light, at least I'm turning into the bits of my mother which I admired, and not the bits that I didn't, which is a small mercy. Perhaps it'd be better to say that I'm turning into an idealized version of my mother." Well, then. If that's what Kiyoko wants, you're not going to stop her. In fact, you hope that she surpasses her mother — something which you think she's well on the way to doing. "The compliment's appreciated." |You know... "Yes, [pc.name]?" Kiyoko sips at her tea. "A coin for your thoughts?" It's rather interesting as to how her figure hasn't deteriorated, but rather, improved with keeping. Having this many children would wreck most other womens' bodies. Kiyoko just shrugs and smiles ineffably, her ears twitching. "Most other women don't have their newborns grow into children at the breast, either. Or have their pregnancies progress this quickly. Or... well, you get the idea. The Astral Plane was never quite meant for long-term living on the scale of years, so strange things happen. I'm only grateful for this small mercy, you know?" Oh, definitely. Has she looked into the origins of this? She is a diviner, after all. "I think I did mention trying, but after losing all my leads I'm just content to take what's been given to me and not worry too much about what I can't change. I suppose if I'm going to have to look the part of a mother, I might as well be pleasing to the eye instead of the other way around, right?" No doubt about that! Kiyoko laughs. "Besides — and let's be honest here — can you visualize a fat kitsune? I don't think I can; Keros would never stand for it." |How goes the kits' education? Kiyoko practically beams at the question. "They're very talented, I swear; they seem to be able to pick up any skill or learning with much less effort than anyone else I'd know. Even with a century or two's worth of headstart on them, I'm sure it'd only take decades for them to catch up with me." That's marvelous! "I don't think this ability came from me, [pc.name], this affinity for learning. You seem to be able to pick up new knowledge and activities with relative ease compared to other people... almost as drastically as our children do. This is an ability the kitsune as a people would be very glad to have. "But I digress. I'm trying to do what I did for my younger siblings all that time ago — a well-rounded education, moreso now that I've the tools to do so. Mathematics, music, natural lore... although I will say that without a reference, history has been a bit of a bother. I try to frame it as a set of stories, rather than just dates and facts to be memorized — works better with the kits that way." You nod and gesture for her to go on. "A few of our children show some magical promise, so I'll see about that when they get older. When I eventually get out of here... when we do, that is, I want them to be useful to kitsune society. That's the ultimate goal of all this." As always, you're thankful for all her efforts in caring for your issue while you're away. "I'm just doing what a mother does, [pc.name]. Well, any respectable mother. There's no need to thank me at all — I'm just glad that all the things I learned to stave off boredom, to keep myself sane in this prison have actually turned out to have some use in the end." ] |[rand|"You know," Kiyoko says with a smile, "if I were out for good from this gilded cage of mine, I could very well be in the running for being a proper den matron." The name does suggest the qualifications, you suppose. Are you right? Kiyoko thinks a moment. "In a way. It's not strictly true that a den matron has to be the most prolific mother in the community — there's no rule stating as such — but once she gets the position she's pretty much propositioned by most of the males the den has to offer, and plenty others from other dens to boot. The mixing of blood is supposed to prevent excessive inbreeding, you see." Hrm. "Either way, if a den matron isn't one by the time she's named one, she'll be so in short order. As for me... well, I've enough children of my own that I could set up my own den all by myself." Better give her a few more, then. Can't have too many hands around to start striking the earth once she gets out of here. Kiyoko smiles sweetly at you and wiggles her large, fluffy ears, but says nothing. |"I'm glad all this has happened. Now, I'm still not very happy about being stuck in here for as long as I've been, and if I could I would have avoided it, but since it meant I got the opportunity to meet you and be a mother to so many children... it may just have been worth it." You're glad she thinks that way. All that's in the past now; there's a bright future ahead of her. Kiyoko nods. "To be able to see anything other than a perfect world... it's a relief. Perfection, especially when one has not earned it, is anything but. For the longest duration of my imprisonment here, I wanted for nothing, yet I had no reason to keep on existing as I was. I forced myself to pull through each day, each moment; I pretended to be excited that the highlight of my day was sitting down for hours on end and doing scroll painting... "But now, instead of living for nothing or even for myself, I've been given the opportunity to live for others. Instead of teaching myself to scroll paint for its own sake, I now teach the kits, and I learn as they do... to be given a meaning to exist, that's one of the greatest gifts both you and the children have bestowed upon me." You really didn't have such lofty goals in mind when you started making gifts of your chi to her. All you wanted was to - "Does it really matter why you did it? All that matters is that you did, and for that I'm grateful." Kiyoko closes her eyes and sips at her tea, and you see her lip tremble. "Please, continue doing what you're doing... and I'll work hard to support you from the rear." All right, you'll do just that. |"I think my mother would've been proud of me," Kiyoko says after some thought. "While I didn't quite become the famed diviner which she'd hoped for me to become by sending me off, I've nevertheless made something of myself." That can't be denied, yes. The Astral Plane sure has changed a lot ever since you first entered the place. "I think she'd have liked you too, [pc.name]. Then again, she liked anyone who was plenty virile, and I don't think you're lacking in proof of that." Kiyoko laughs and waves a hand dismissively. "At least you won't have to deal with any pesky in-laws in my case — chances are they're all dead by now." The world's changed since the Godswar by leaps and bounds. Even if she returned to her homeland once she's free, it's almost certain that it won't be as she remember it. "I don't know about that. Going back, I mean. It's far more likely that I'd ask the Trickster himself for permission to find someplace to settle and form a den in this locale. I think I've warmed up to the place some, and I'm sure he wouldn't mind having a presence around, no matter how small." ] |[rand|"I'd like to think I've gotten everything under control now," Kiyoko informs you, giving you a sagely nod as she picks a piece of candy off the plate. "At this point, most matters resolve themselves without my intervention, I've delegated most of the tasks to the eldest of our children, and I've raised them well enough to function without need for my constant oversight. I like to think I've succeeded as a mother in raising obedient, useful, and productive children, for what it's worth." She really is gearing up to be a den mother, isn't she? Kiyoko doesn't reply immediately, but stares out of the window for a second or two before finishing the last of her tea and licking her lips very, very slowly. "I suppose it's not too far off from actuality, is it? All that really remains is for Keros to give me his seal of approval; that's the only thing which is lacking. "But of course, it also means that I've more free time to do the things I truly enjoy, instead of dealing with endless squabbles and petty complaints. Things such as making more kits. Oh, there's no rush... but neither should one pause to rest on one's laurels, yes? There's always room for improvement." |How are the children treating her these days? By the looks of it, she's surpassed her mother several times over in terms of quantity. "Quantity, yes. Quality... well, I hesitate to make that judgement. My mother did produce me, after all — that's quite a hard achievement to top." Was that just a backhanded compliment she made there? Kiyoko just smiles. "But yes, to answer your question, [pc.name], the children are treating me just fine. By and large, they are respectful and obedient, with much potential for power... I don't want to venture guesses as to what came from which side of the family, but suffice to say that your seed and my womb work very, very well together." That's a polite way of putting it... but you are glad things have worked out well in the end. "Please, I do urge to continue. You and I... we're both doing very good work. It'd be a shame if either of us decided enough was enough." The kitsune dips her head ever so slightly and gives you a wink. |"Save for finally getting out of here on a permanent basis, I don't think there's anything else I could possibly ask for, [pc.name]. Ever since you arrived in my little world, the boons that have been granted to me are manifold — family, memories... and plenty of fun times. I know there're those who disdain the company of others, but when you've been to one extreme, it's hard to want to go back — I lost all my appetite for solitude after an eternity of it stuck in this gilded cage. "And speaking of cages... while I suppose I'm still imprisoned here, at least I don't mind it that much any more. Oh, I'd still like to get both myself and the orb fixed for the sake of the kits, but if it were up to me and me only... I don't think I care any more. Most people live bound in chains of their own making; even as I am, I think I'm considerably freer than most people are." It's a comfortable, idyllic life with the children, isn't it? Kiyoko nods. "Even afterwards... after my release... I still think I'd like to join you in your adventures, to project myself from the orb or even be with you in the flesh and offer you succor when you lay yourself down to rest. Even if physical distance separates us, there's no reason we can't meet in our dreams, there's no reason why you and I can't keep this arrangement going. I do find fighting alongside you rather... invigorating, plus I do get to test out the spells and abilities I devise. Plus, by this point, I'm not going to deny that I absolutely delight in receiving your chi and nurturing it within me, [pc.name]. Wouldn't have done it so many times if I didn't enjoy it, right? "So yes, don't worry about the kits and I; we're fine as we are. Focus your energies on the tasks which lie ahead of you... although if you have some left over for a faithful fox like me, I wouldn't be against taking some of that load off you."] |[rand|Kiyoko considers the question for a moment before setting down her tea and giving you a stupid, playful grin. "Even after all that we've been through, it still gladdens my heart every time you ask about the children. It's just — well — I just like hearing you pose the question." How many are there at this point, anyway? Sure, you've caught sight of some of the kits on the way in, but you'd never be able to count them all! Seventy-five? More? Who knows? "That's for me to know and for you to count." Well, if they could all assemble and stay in one place without zipping around all the time... "Trust me, these children don't have any setting besides off and full speed. I think they get that from their mother." |"The children and I are handling things very well. You know, when all of this started, I made a decision to try and recreate the system that my own mother used to have for managing me and my siblings, and it's worked out well. The children are cared for, fed, and given adequate love and attention. It's probably a little different from what you're used to, but the way I see things, there's no need to reinvent the wheel. If anything, I've made it even better." Oh? Kiyoko nods. "When a prospective den mother strikes out on her own, she doesn't do it alone; usually, several of her brothers and sisters come along for the ride. They help her take care of things and make the place suitable for little fox kits to grow up in. Of course, they add to their number, too, but most kitsune don't have the sheer —" you see Kiyoko run her tongue across her lips- "reproductive capacity a den mother does. I won't deny that the Astral Plane has been an immense help in this regard — it's nice to have a house that grows along with your family, not to mention the self-doing laundry. It gives me more time to tend to the children." And it also gives her more time to put towards adding to their number. "Ehehe..." Kiyoko tilts her head slightly and folds her ears forward. "I won't say no to playing with you, if that's what you want." |"The children and I couldn't be any better, thank you for asking. I haven't felt better in a long, long time, if ever, and the kits are all happy smiles all day. When I was new at this, I worried a bit as to whether I'd be able to give the kits all the attention they needed like my mother used to be able to do, but things just seem to have worked themselves out. I don't even need to think about things now, everything just falls into place of its own accord." Inasmuch the same way as she keeps on finding herself pregnant, right? "Exactly. You know what I'm talking about. Not that it doesn't require any effort on my part, but it's so enjoyable that it may as well not." Ah, to be able to do something you love for a living. Familiarity is supposed to breed contempt, but clearly that doesn't apply to your kitsune slut-wife and her enormous brood of children. "Sometimes they're quiet and calm, and sometimes they're running all over the place. At least their older brothers and sisters are well on the way to learning responsibility. They'll need it when we finally get out of here." Yes... "Like I said, I'm happy, and so are the children. Don't worry about us, and do what you need to do."] ]"

rows.original: Ask about the kits in general.
rows.translation: 一般来说，可以了解一下这些套件的相关信息。

rows.original: So... "Yes, [pc.name]?" The second time you met Kiyoko — that time when you caught her having a soak in the spring — she mentioned something about freeing her from her prison. When you questioned her about it, she mentioned needing to check her notes, and that's when you woke up... "Right. It was so long ago that I did that work, and I had to go look it up again; thanks for reminding me about the matter. While stuck here, I did manage to come up with the beginnings of an idea which might let me temporarily manifest outside the orb for short durations, but it required someone else's aid. And since there was no one else in here with me and I'd long given up hope of anyone else coming along..." her voice trails off, and she looks straight at you. You nod and motion for Kiyoko to go on. "Remember what I was telling you, that my body, my physicality was ripped from me? Where I come from, magical theory holds that there are two forms of energy everyone possesses in varying amounts: chi, the energy of the body, and ki, the energy of the spirit. When I attempted to escape into the Astral Plane with the dark magic on my heels, the former was ripped from me, although the latter escaped unharmed. That's why I'm essentially what might amount to be a spirit right now, and it's why I can't leave the orb, even though you can pass freely back and forth. It's all conjecture, of course, but it's the best explanation I have." [pc.cl whitemage blackmage|Now, now. You'd like to consider yourself fairly well-read, and when it comes to the subject of magics you don't remember ever coming across any mention of %"bodily energy" or the like. "I'm not surprised. Like I said, it's not a concept that's found parlance amongst your scholars, or at least, it wasn't when I was still out and about. I think they have something similar in Jassira, but not so far north..." ] So that means you can't smash the orb and be done with it. Kiyoko sighs and crosses her arms under her breasts. "Oh, if it were only that simple. If I thought smashing the orb would have worked; I'd have asked you to do just that a long time ago. No, it's a gate, not a vessel, and even if it were, who knows what might happen to me? "Short of Keros himself fixing both the orb and me, the only solution I saw was for someone else to share their chi with me. It's not a light thing to ask of someone, and I didn't want to scare you off with that kind of talk." You nod warily. All this talk of essence and energy sharing... it does make her sound like some kind of succubus or vampire. Another sigh, deeper than the first. "Perhaps; it is rather close. There's one crucial difference, though: the word share, instead of steal. I'm no thief, I won't take anything you don't give of your own free will. Like I said, it's not a light thing to ask someone to give away their chi — while it'll regenerate on its own over time with proper care, lose too much of it at once and you'll weaken, even die. I'd be disappointed, but understand perfectly if you refused. "That's why I had to check my notes. Considering how weighty this subject is, I had to be sure of what I was speaking of before I discussed this with you. I... don't know if I can offer you anything in return, but if this does work — and it should, according to what I've been able to figure — then I'd be indebted to you. A kitsune always repays owed favors." It should work, she says. Kiyoko looks pensive and bites her lip. "That's right. As is obvious, I've never actually had the chance to try it, so... well, unforeseen circumstances are always possible, even for a diviner." So, let's say you wanted to lend her a hand. How would you go about transferring some of your, uh, chi, was it? Bodily essence? At first, Kiyoko doesn't respond, color slowly creeping into the kitsune's cheeks. You wonder if you've made some kind of unintentional gaffe at first, but she raises her head and sniffs at the air with her dainty little nose. "You'd need to fuck me," comes the blunt reply. [pc.hasCock|"Or if you'd rather, I can fuck you and milk you for what you're worth." [pc.dcb|Heh. You'd like to see her try.|Uh...|Ooh, sounds sexy!] "Come to think of it, that was one of my mother's favorite sayings," Kiyoko continues with a weak half-grin on her face. "Really. 'I'll suck out all your semen!' It sounds better in its original language, I assure you. The translation doesn't do it justice." Look, this is getting quite awkward. Kiyoko waves a hand dismissively. "Oh, please. It was going to be awkward no matter what." [pc.mf||Question, though. Um. how did she know? About what you have, if she gets your drift. "I sniffed for it. We kitsune can smell these things if we put our minds to it. Which, frankly, doesn't hurt one bit — with my kind being as pretty as we are, there're a fair number of traps and hopelessly ladylike fox-boys hanging around." Kiyoko gets a faraway look in her eyes, and smacks her lips. "Ah, those were good times. But my point stands. Don't worry, I won't be able to tell anyone even if I wanted to."] |"Although you don't quite have the equipment for what I had in mind. At least, I can't smell it on you. A lot of our fox boys are rather... ladylike by conventional standards, if you know what I mean. Having a good nose helps." And while you might regret asking the question, what did she have in mind, anyway? Kiyoko looks straight at you, this gentle and apparently unassuming little kitsune, and smiles. "Well, if it were up to me, as a starter I'd bind you up all nice and tight in my tails, then wring out and suck up every last drop of your semen." Uncomfortable silence. Did she really have to say that? "It's like telling a bad fortune. Honesty is the beast — I mean, best — policy here, because if you lie, chances are you'll be making more trouble for yourself down the road." ] And there's no other way to go about this, is there? "There are other ways to go about transferring one's chi to a recipient. However, they'd require that I already have some kind of physical form, which I don't have right now. The act of copulation — no, breeding is perhaps one of the most primal and forceful ways in which one gives of one's own life-force to another to be nurtured. "Like I mentioned back then, I'm not going to fault you if you find this distasteful. It's not likely that you share kitsune mores on these matters, after all. While the harpies were considerably more relaxed on these matters than we were, other peoples weren't. We had to adjust our methods accordingly." So let's get this straight. In order to break her out of her prison, however temporarily, she needs to have this bodily energy she speaks of — and you're the only source of it around. What happens when you finally give her enough of it? How much is enough? "If my spellcrafting isn't wrong, I should be able to materialize outside the orb for limited periods of time," Kiyoko replies. "Not on a permanent basis, like I said, but the more chi you give me, the longer I'll be able to do it. The rest... well, I'll say it again: theory is one thing, and practice is another. I can only hope for both our sakes that it turns out well." You nod. "To reiterate, [pc.name], I know that this is a great favor I'm asking of you; to place your trust in a servant of Keros is no small undertaking. If and when you feel comfortable doing this... just bring up the topic with me. I won't force you to do anything you don't want to — you already do a lot for me by simply visiting and allowing me to share your company. After being alone for so long, that means more to me than you can imagine. "Now... shall we talk about something more cheery? The time will come when we will need to return to this subject, but it is — probably — not now."

没错，那已经是很久以前的事了，我当时做了那些工作，现在得重新去查阅一下资料；多亏你提醒了我这件事。虽然被困在这里，但我还是想出了一个初步的方案——或许可以让我暂时离开这个轻型球，出去短时间活动一下，不过这需要别人的帮助。而这里除了我之外没有其他人，而且我也早就放弃了还会有人来救我的希望…… 她的声音渐渐低了下去，然后她直视着你的眼睛。 你点了点头，示意清子继续说下去。 还记得我告诉过你吗？我的身体，我的肉体，其实是被强行从我身上夺走的。在我出生的地方，有一种魔法理论认为，每个人体内都存在着两种形式的能量，只不过这些能量的数量各不相同 气身体的能量，以及 ki那就是精神的能量。当我试图带着那些暗影魔法逃往星界时，前者被从我身上夺走了，而后者却毫发无损地逃走了。因此，现在我本质上已经变成了一种类似于“精神”的存在，也正是这个原因，我无法离开那个轻型球，尽管你们可以自由地进出它。当然，这一切都只是猜测，但这是我目前能想到的最佳解释。 [pc.cl whitemage 哦，要是真的那么简单该多好。如果我认为砸碎那个球体就能解决问题，我早就让你这么做了。不，那其实是一个通道，而不是一个容器；而且就算它是容器，谁又能知道这样做会对我带来什么后果呢？ 除非凯罗斯亲自修复那个球体以及我自身的问题，否则我所能想到的唯一解决办法就是让其他人来分担他们的责任。 气 跟我一起来吧。这样的请求对任何人来说都不是一件容易的事，我本来也不想用那种话把你吓跑的。 虽然在得到适当的照顾后，它会逐渐恢复，但如果你一次性失去太多，就会变得虚弱，甚至可能死亡。我会感到失望，但如果你拒绝帮忙，我也完全能够理解。 这就是为什么我需要查看我的笔记。考虑到这个话题的重要性，我在和您讨论之前必须确保自己了解得非常清楚。我……不知道能否以什么方式回报您，但如果这种方法真的有效的话——根据我目前的了解，应该是有效的——那么我就会欠您一个人情。毕竟，狐妖总是会报答别人对自己的帮助的。 它 应该 工作吧，”她说。 清子显得若有所思，咬着嘴唇。 没错。正如大家所看到的，我其实从来都没有机会 尝试一下吧。 It was so long ago that I did that work, and I had to go look it up again; thanks for reminding me about the matter. While stuck here, I did manage to come up with the beginnings of an idea which might let me temporarily manifest outside the orb for short durations, but it required someone else's aid. And since there was no one else in here with me and I'd long given up hope of anyone else coming along..." her voice trails off, and she looks straight at you. You nod and motion for Kiyoko to go on. "Remember what I was telling you, that my body, my physicality was ripped from me? Where I come from, magical theory holds that there are two forms of energy everyone possesses in varying amounts: chi, the energy of the body, and ki, the energy of the spirit. When I attempted to escape into the Astral Plane with the dark magic on my heels, the former was ripped from me, although the latter escaped unharmed. That's why I'm essentially what might amount to be a spirit right now, and it's why I can't leave the orb, even though you can pass freely back and forth. It's all conjecture, of course, but it's the best explanation I have." [pc.cl whitemage blackmage|Now, now. I think they have something similar in Jassira, but not so far north..." ] So that means you can't smash the orb and be done with it. Kiyoko sighs and crosses her arms under her breasts. rows.translation: 也许是时候直接了当地问这个狐狸精到底想要什么了……

rows.original: Kiyoko perks up at the suggestion, her many tails curling about herself. [rand|"You want to talk? I'm good with us talking. It's probably one of my favorite things to do these days... didn't know how much I missed the sound of someone else's voice until I did, you know?" |"Simply enjoying a pleasant conversation with someone whose company you appreciate is a boon to be savoured, Yes, it's indeed one of the simple pleasures of life, one of the many bricks from which fulfilment is built. Now, did you have a particular topic in mind, [pc.name]?" |"I'd like that very much, thank you. In fact, I would be honored to have a simple conversation with you over tea and sweets." That's pushing it a little, isn't it? "Not when you've learned to appreciate another person's company as keenly as I do. Please, steer the conversation however you wish." ]

rows.original: [flags.KIYOKO_MEAL_TS |You mention you wouldn't mind settling down to talk with Kiyoko over another hearty meal. The kitsune gives you a thin, genial smile and rises from her seat at the low table. "Of course, [pc.name]; I would be delighted and honored to display my culinary skills. Cooking is much more gratifying when you do it for someone else other than yourself, after all. Please bear with me a moment; I shall return shortly." |You know this might sound odd, given how she's mentioned before that no one actually needs to eat in this pocket dimension, but you'd like to sample some of her food, if she doesn't mind cooking. It'd help you to get to know her better, and having a conversation over a meal has a certain something or the other to it, a relaxing atmosphere that can't quite be matched otherwise. "There's no need to be sheepish about it, [pc.name]. I understand the point you're driving at, and agree wholeheartedly. Of course I would be more than pleased to exercise my culinary skills for your benefit — it's not as if I have anywhere else to be, after all. Please, wait here. I'll return shortly." ] Kiyoko is good to her word. After about half an hour of waiting, the kitsune returns with a large tray balanced in her hands, and sets it down on the low table. Now that you can see what's on it, it appears to be [rand|a large plate on which a lobster has been laid out belly-up. The belly and legs have been cut open and removed, revealing the raw meat in the bowl of its armored back; surrounding it are thinly sliced pieces of salmon and shelled shrimp, just as raw as the lobster is. The entire dish has been garnished with carrot strands, cucumber wedges and lemon slices, all arranged with quite the artistic flair. "Don't worry. Despite being raw, everything is safe to eat as-is. The vinegar and spices do more than just flavor the food, after all." |two bowls full of what appear to be thick, slippery wheat noodles in clear broth. There aren't that many toppings — a sprinkle of herbs for garnish and what looks to be two rectangles of golden-brown fried... things. It's certainly unlike any food you'd ever find up in the Frost Marches. "If you're wondering, that's reputedly the favorite food of Lord Keros himself — he enjoys thin fried tofu a lot, as the stories go. I share the taste, as do a lot of other kitsune — or pretend to in order to flatter the Trickster. The broth, too, that's also something I can get behind." |two large bowls of sliced beef strips, cooked with onions and in some kind of dark sauce. The aroma rising from the steaming rice it's been topped over is heavenly, and you smell just a hint of strong ginger somewhere in the mix. Topped with a raw egg, there's a certain down-to-earth charm to the dish. "I decided to come up with something simple today, something that a northerner might be able to enjoy without worry. Please, tuck in." |a large plate of what looks to be balls of sticky rice dough. As you watch, Kiyoko breaks open one of them to reveal the sweet dark stuffing inside, a warm smile spreading on her face before she gleefully pops both halves into her mouth and chews with utter bliss. "I used to love red bean mochi a lot when I was young. Still do. I'm... I'm hoping you can share that love with me, [pc.name]." |a piping hot pot of broth, around which have been laid several small plates of beef, mushrooms and vegetables. Signaling for you to wait, Kiyoko cooks several pieces of the beef in the charcoal-fired hot pot until the broth begins to turn meaty, then adds in the remaining vegetables one by one until you've got a steaming hot meaty vegetable soup. Aah... "We'd do this a lot when we first arrived on this continent under Keros' orders," Kiyoko explains. "A hot pot is great for warming the skin under one's fur... and even better when shared with other people, the more the merrier. It makes one feel all warm and good inside..." |an enormous pile of golden-brown pouches stuffed to bursting. Through the pouches' open front, you can see their contents: rice, grated carrots, small black seeds and diced vegetables, topped with small portions of scrambled eggs. Kiyoko seats herself across from you, leans forward[kiyoko.pregStage 2| as much as her round, pregnant tummy will allow ], and takes a deep breath to savour the steaming fragrance rising from the food. Even seated where you are, you can smell it too: heated oil, vinegar, and something or the other you can't quite put words to. Looking back up, Kiyoko's face has gone all dreamy, and she heaves a long, trembling sigh. [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3|"Ooooooohhhh. Inarizushi. I have such a weakness for this." It does look good, and smells just as heavenly. You can tell the extra love and effort she put into making these. Kiyoko blushes a little, and the kitsune folds her ears forward. "They... they just bring back good memories, you know? When I was little, I would always try and sneak a bite when Mother was making inarizushi. No matter what magic I used to hide myself, she'd always spot me and send me off with a rap of her spoon. "Didn't mean I gave up there, of course. I'd get one of my brothers or sisters to distract her while I helped myself... we'd split the haul later. Haha, it seems all so long ago..." There's a moment of awkward silence as Kiyoko's expression falls, and then she perks up again as if nothing had ever happened. "Enough of that, there's no reason to ruin the flavor of food this good with such talk. Let's dig in!" Now that's something you can agree with! |"What are you waiting for? Let's eat!" Barely have you picked up your utensils that Kiyoko eagerly digs into the small mountain of fried rice pouches, applying herself with a feral, practically gluttonous abandon that would put the most ravenous lupine or minotaur to shame. Kiyoko has been a number of things in the time that you've known her, but this picture of sheer, simple-minded efficiency is something else altogether. "Ehe... it's kind of rude to stare at people when they're eating, you know." Well, you wouldn't think it rude, not when she's so... enthusiastic about it. "I'm pregnant! I need to eat lots! So I made lots!" Even if that were true considering the nature of the Astral Plane, you don't think she's that pregnant to warrant- "I'm not listening!" Kiyoko squeals, pulling her large, foxy ears flat against her hair. "I'm not listening! I'm a growing mother, and growing foxy mothers must have inarizushi! You made me like this, so it's your fault that I'm being a pig!" Fine! If she's going to be so petulant and childish about it, the only way to stop her is to finish all the food before she can overeat! |It's then that the kitsune finally breaks down — not even bothering to pick up the utensils on the tray, Kiyoko grabs three of the stuffed fried pouches and tries to cram them into her dainty little mouth all at once. Wait, isn't she going to choke if she eats that quickly? Can she even choke? Kiyoko swallows, then moves to stuff her face with another one of the fried rice pouches before catching herself, aiming a most petulant, pouty expression directly at you. Seeing her talk with a mouth full of food is something. "I'm huuuungrrrrryy. I'm pregnant. Your kit is making me hungry. I want inarizushi. Your kit wants inarizushi. Don't even try to stop us." You weren't going to, but what she said — doesn't that mean that she's just using your visit as an excuse to- "It's two against one," Kiyoko says, patting her big, round belly with oily fingers. "You're not going to stop us!" [pc.isDK|Oh, you are going to stop her. And the only way to do that is to eat it all before she does. Kiyoko sticks her little pink tongue out at you. "Mine!" Without further ado, she begins to prodigiously scarf down the food as quickly as she can.|Oh no no no no. You're smart enough not to get between someone with that particular look on her face and her food. That's just going to be more trouble than it's worth.] ] Between the two of you, it doesn't take long for the miniature mountain of rice-stuffed pockets to disappear. The food isn't real — no matter how many you chow down on, you never seem to feel any fuller, but Kiyoko's presence is very much there. The kitsune doesn't say anything as she stuffs her face, but the sheer enthusiasm with which she does it and her animated demeanour tell you more than words ever could. "Ooh... ehe... I think I may have overeaten. But even if I have, I don't think I'm going to allow myself to regret a single moment of it." Kiyoko wipes away broken grains of rice from her cheeks and grins stupidly at you. Was all this just an excuse for her to give herself a treat? "Oh, don't be like that. I needed it, and by the looks of you, so did you. I just... this particular dish has special meaning for me, and I wanted to share it with someone I cared for." Pretty words to hide tricky intentions. "Oh, boo." Kiyoko snaps her fingers, and the dirty dishes rise off the low table and settle on the sideboard, out of the way. "Come on, now that I've had a nice meal, I'm feeling much more playful, or anything else you might want to get up to. Got any ideas?" ] [flags.KIYOKO_MEAL_TS||You've got to ask, though, what are those utensils over there? Those sticks, for lack of a better word to describe them? Hope you didn't give offense, but... "Hah, of course. You wouldn't know what chopsticks are. Just feel free to ignore them and use the spoon — I want you to feel comfortable, not cause you distress. The oversight is entirely mine."] The two of you spend a little time together, eating and chatting away the next hour or so as the meal gradually disappears before you. It's delightfully flavorful in quite the exotic way — Kiyoko is clearly an exceptional cook, and you don't think you could ever sample such tastes anywhere in the Frost Marches. However, the nature of the food is quite apparent — no matter how much you eat, you don't seem to feel any fuller. Nevertheless, that wasn't the point, was it? No, the smiling, demure kitsune on the other side of the table was the point, and she seems rather content with the whole exercise as the two of you pick the tray clean and finish up with a bit more tea. "Very satisfactory," Kiyoko says as she clears away the dirty dishes with a snap of her fingers. "It's always a pleasure to share a meal with you, [pc.name]." No, no, the pleasure is yours. A laugh. "If you say so. Come now, then — we've still plenty of time ahead of us. I'll let you take the lead — what would you like to do?"
rows.translation: [flags.KIYOKO_MEAL_TS |你说你很乐意在另一顿美餐之后，坐下来和清子好好聊聊。那只狐妖向你露出了一个友善的微笑，然后从那张矮桌旁的座位上站了起来。 当然， [pc.name]能够展示我的烹饪技艺，我会感到非常高兴和荣幸。毕竟，为别人做饭带来的满足感要比为自己做饭大得多。请稍等片刻，我马上就回来。 |你知道，考虑到她之前说过实际上没有人会这样做，这么说可能会听起来有点奇怪 需求 在这个口袋维度里吃饭确实挺有趣的，但如果你想品尝她做的食物的话，只要她不介意做饭的话。这样可以帮助你更好地了解她，而且边吃饭边聊天也有它独特的魅力，那种轻松的氛围是其他方式无法替代的。 没必要为此感到害羞， [pc.name]我完全理解你的意思，也完全同意。当然，能够为你的需要施展我的烹饪技艺，我会感到非常高兴——毕竟我也没有其他地方可去。请在这里稍等，我马上就会回来。 ] 清子确实说到做到了。大约等了半个小时后，那只狐妖手部里端着一个大托盘回来了，然后把它放在了矮桌上。现在你们可以看到托盘里装着什么了，看起来是 [rand|一块大盘子上，一只龙虾被翻过来摆放着。它的腹部和腿部都被切开并去掉，露出了背部甲壳下的生肉；周围摆着切成薄片的三文鱼和去壳的虾，这些食材也都和龙虾一样是生的。整道菜还用胡萝卜丝、黄瓜片和柠檬片进行了装饰，摆放得相当有艺术感。 别担心。虽然这些食材都是生的，但直接食用也是安全的。毕竟，醋和香料的作用可不仅仅是调味而已。 |两碗清汤中漂浮着看似浓稠而滑溜的面条。配料并不多——只是撒上一些香草作为装饰，还有看起来像是两块金黄色的炸……东西。这种食物肯定与你在霜冻边境地区能找到的任何食物都不一样。 如果你好奇的话，据说那正是凯罗斯大人最喜欢的食物——据传说，他非常喜欢吃薄煎豆腐。我和很多其他狐妖一样，也喜欢这种味道；或者至少是装作喜欢，以便讨好这位调皮的神明。至于那汤汁，我也非常认可它的美味。 |两大碗切好的牛肉条，与洋葱一起用某种深色的酱料烹制而成。覆盖在热气腾腾的米饭上的香气令人陶醉，还能隐约闻到其中掺杂着的浓烈姜味。再加上一个生鸡蛋，这道菜便增添了一种朴实而诱人的魅力。 今天我决定准备一些简单的东西，一些北方人应该能够毫无负担地享受的食物。请开始享用吧。 |一大盘看起来像是粘米团的东西。你看着，清子拆开了其中一个，露出了里面甜美的黑色馅料，她脸上露出了温暖的笑容，然后开心地把两半都放进嘴里，津津有味地咀嚼起来。 我小时候非常喜欢红豆团子，现在依然喜欢。我……我希望你也能和我一起分享这份喜爱。 [pc.name]." |一锅热气腾腾的高汤，上面摆放着几小盘牛肉、蘑菇和蔬菜。基约子示意你稍等，她先将几块牛肉放入炭火火锅中煮，直到高汤开始带有肉香，然后再依次加入剩下的蔬菜，最终就制成了一锅热气腾腾、肉香四溢的蔬菜汤。 啊…… 在凯罗斯的命令下，我们刚来到这片大陆时，经常做这样的事情。 清子解释道。 火锅确实很适合用来温暖身体……而当和别人一起分享时，效果会更加显著，人数越多越开心。吃火锅会让人体内充满温暖与舒适的感觉…… |一大堆金棕色的袋子，被塞得满满当当。透过这些袋子敞开的开口，你可以看到里面的内容：大米、胡萝卜丝、小黑籽以及切块的蔬菜，上面还撒着少量炒鸡蛋。清子坐在你对面，身体微微前倾[kiyoko.pregStage 2| 在她的圆滚滚、隆起的肚子允许的范围内 ]她深吸一口气，尽情享受着从食物中散发出来的热气与香气。即使是你坐在那里，也能闻到这种味道：热油、醋，还有其他一些难以用言语形容的成分。 当她再次抬起头时，清子的脸上浮现出一丝恍惚的神情，然后她长长地叹了口气，声音带着颤抖。 [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3|"哦哦哦哦哦哦哦……. 猫耳坠。我有了。 这样的 对此，他们确实存在弱点。 它看起来确实很漂亮，闻起来也香极了。你能感受到她为制作这些付出了多少额外的心血和努力。 清子微微脸红了，而那只狐狸则把耳朵向前搭了起来。 它们……它们总能唤起美好的回忆，你知道吗？小时候，每当妈妈在做鱼籽寿司的时候，我总会偷偷地想尝上一口。无论我使出什么诡计来隐藏自己，妈妈总能发现我，然后用勺子轻轻敲打我的头，把我赶走。 当然，我并不是说我在那里放弃了。我会让我的某个兄弟姐妹去分散她的注意力，而我就趁机拿走我的那份……之后我们再把东西分掉。哈哈，感觉那些事都已经发生很久很久以前了…… 一阵尴尬的沉默出现了，因为清子的表情瞬间变得黯淡下来，但很快她又恢复了往常的神情，仿佛什么都没发生过一样。 够了，没必要用这种话破坏这么美味食物的味道。我们开始吃饭吧！ 这个观点，确实没有人会反对吧！ |还在等什么？我们开始吃饭吧！ 你刚拿起餐具，清子就迫不及待地开始翻找那小堆炸饭袋，她的动作狂热而近乎贪婪，这种进食速度就连最饿的狼或牛头怪也会感到羞愧。在你们相识的这段时间里，清子展现出了许多不同的面貌，但这种纯粹而高效的表现方式，确实是一种全新的形象。 呃……在别人吃饭的时候盯着他们看，其实有点不礼貌吧。 嗯，当你看到她对这件事如此……热情时，你就不会觉得这有什么不礼貌的地方了。 我怀孕了！我需要多吃点！所以我就做了很多食物！ 即使考虑到星界本身的特性，你也不认为她会那样做吧。 那个 足以说明问题 我才不听呢！ 清子尖叫着，把她那又大又像狐狸耳朵的耳朵贴在头发上。 我才不听呢！我可是个正在成长的母亲，而正在成长的母亲们肯定需要这种东西吧！都是你让我变成这样的，所以 你的 都是因为我太贪吃了！ 好吧！如果她非得这么任性、这么孩子气地对待这件事，那么唯一的办法就是在她吃太多之前把所有食物都吃完！ |就在这时，那只狐妖终于崩溃了——基约科甚至都懒得去拿盘子里的餐具，直接抓起了三个炸馅小包，试图把它们全部塞进自己那小小的嘴里。 等等，她吃得这么快，不会噎到吧？她真的会噎到吗？ 清子咽下食物后，又赶紧拿起另一个炒饭袋子往嘴里塞，然后突然停住动作，冲着你露出一个极其撒娇、嘟着嘴的表情。 看到她边吃东西边说话，真是有趣极了。 我 呜呜呜……我怀孕了。你的装备让我感到非常饿……我想吃海苔卷。你的装备也想要海苔卷……别想阻止我们。 你本来并不打算去的，但她说的话——难道不意味着她只是把你的到访当作一个借口而已吗？ 现在是二对一了。 清子用沾满油渍的手指轻轻拍打着自己圆滚滚的大肚子，说道。 你们不可能阻止我们！ [pc.isDK|哦，你啊 是 必须阻止她。而唯一的办法就是在她之前把所有东西都吃掉。 清子把她那小小的粉红色舌头伸了出来，对着你。 我的！ 她没有再犹豫，开始以极快的速度大口吃起食物来。|哦不不不不。你这么聪明，应该知道当一个人露出那种表情时，最好不要去打扰她和她的食物。那样只会惹来更多的麻烦，根本不值得。] ] 你们两个一起，那些装满米饭的小点心很快就全被吃光了。这些食物可真是不经吃啊 真实的 — 无论你吃多少，似乎永远也吃不饱，但清子的存在感却是非常强烈的。那只狐妖一边大口吃东西，一边什么也没说，但她那充满热情的样子以及活泼的神情，所传达的信息远比任何言语都要丰富。 哦……嘿嘿……我想我可能是吃得太多了。不过就算真的这样，我也绝不会让自己为其中的任何一刻感到后悔。 清子擦去脸颊上沾着的碎米粒，然后傻乎乎地对你笑了笑。 难道这一切，只不过是她想给自己找个借口来享受一番罢了？ 哦，别这样。我需要它，而看你的样子，你也需要它。只是……这道菜对我有着特殊的意义，我想和我在乎的人一起分享它。 漂亮的话用来掩盖险恶的意图。 哦，不好了。 清子打了个响指，那些脏盘子便从矮桌上飘起来，落在了边柜上，不再碍事。 来吧，既然我已经吃了一顿美餐，现在变得心情愉悦多了，什么有趣的事情都愿意尝试。你有什么主意吗？ ] [flags.KIYOKO_MEAL_TS||不过，你肯定想知道，那边那些工具是什么吧？那些棍子，实在找不到更好的词来形容它们了……希望我没有冒犯到你们，但是…… 哈，当然。你肯定不知道筷子是什么吧。直接忽略它们，用勺子就行——我可是希望你能舒服地用餐，而不是感到不便。这个疏忽完全是我的责任。] 你们俩一起度过了这段时光，边吃饭边聊天，大约一个小时的时间就这样过去了。食物在你们面前逐渐被吃光，而它的味道却异常美味——显然，清子是一位非常出色的厨师，你觉得自己绝对不可能在霜冻边境的任何地方尝到这样的美味。 然而，这种食物的特性其实相当明显——无论你吃多少，似乎都不会感到有任何饱腹感。 不过，这其实并不是重点，对吧？重点在于坐在桌子对面的那个面带微笑、举止端庄的狐妖，她看起来对整个过程相当满意，因为你们俩把盘子里的食物吃得一干二净，还喝了几杯茶。 非常令人满意。 清秀的女孩一边用手部指弹了弹那些脏盘子，一边说道。 能与您共进晚餐，总是件令人愉快的事。 [pc.name]." 不，不，这份荣幸应该属于您。 一阵笑声。 如果你这么认为的话，那我们就现在开始吧——我们还有很多时间。让我来带头吧，你想先做些什么呢？

As you watch, Kiyoko breaks open one of them to reveal the sweet dark stuffing inside, a warm smile spreading on her face before she gleefully pops both halves into her mouth and chews with utter bliss. "I used to love red bean mochi a lot when I was young. Still do. I'm... I'm hoping you can share that love with me, [pc.name]." |a piping hot pot of broth, around which have been laid several small plates of beef, mushrooms and vegetables. Signaling for you to wait, Kiyoko cooks several pieces of the beef in the charcoal-fired hot pot until the broth begins to turn meaty, then adds in the remaining vegetables one by one until you've got a steaming hot meaty vegetable soup. Aah... "We'd do this a lot when we first arrived on this continent under Keros' orders," Kiyoko explains. "A hot pot is great for warming the skin under one's fur... and even better when shared with other people, the more the merrier. It makes one feel all warm and good inside..." |an enormous pile of golden-brown pouches stuffed to bursting. Through the pouches' open front, you can see their contents: rice, grated carrots, small black seeds and diced vegetables, topped with small portions of scrambled eggs. Kiyoko seats herself across from you, leans forward[kiyoko.pregStage 2| as much as her round, pregnant tummy will allow ], and takes a deep breath to savour the steaming fragrance rising from the food. Even seated where you are, you can smell it too: heated oil, vinegar, and something or the other you can't quite put words to. Looking back up, Kiyoko's face has gone all dreamy, and she heaves a long, trembling sigh. [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3|"Ooooooohhhh. Inarizushi. I have such a weakness for this." It does look good, and smells just as heavenly. You can tell the extra love and effort she put into making these. Kiyoko blushes a little, and the kitsune folds her ears forward. "They... they just bring back good memories, you know? When I was little, I would always try and sneak a bite when Mother was making inarizushi. No matter what magic I used to hide myself, she'd always spot me and send me off with a rap of her spoon. "Didn't mean I gave up there, of course. I'd get one of my brothers or sisters to distract her while I helped myself... we'd split the haul later. Haha, it seems all so long ago..." There's a moment of awkward silence as Kiyoko's expression falls, and then she perks up again as if nothing had ever happened. "Enough of that, there's no reason to ruin the flavor of food this good with such talk. Let's dig in!" Now that's something you can agree with! |"What are you waiting for? Let's eat!" Barely have you picked up your utensils that Kiyoko eagerly digs into the small mountain of fried rice pouches, applying herself with a feral, practically gluttonous abandon that would put the most ravenous lupine or minotaur to shame. Kiyoko has been a number of things in the time that you've known her, but this picture of sheer, simple-minded efficiency is something else altogether. "Ehe... it's kind of rude to stare at people when they're eating, you know." Well, you wouldn't think it rude, not when she's so... enthusiastic about it. "I'm pregnant! I need to eat lots! So I made lots!" Even if that were true considering the nature of the Astral Plane, you don't think she's that pregnant to warrant- "I'm not listening!" Kiyoko squeals, pulling her large, foxy ears flat against her hair. "I'm not listening! I'm a growing mother, and growing foxy mothers must have inarizushi! You made me like this, so it's your fault that I'm being a pig!" Fine! If she's going to be so petulant and childish about it, the only way to stop her is to finish all the food before she can overeat! |It's then that the kitsune finally breaks down — not even bothering to pick up the utensils on the tray, Kiyoko grabs three of the stuffed fried pouches and tries to cram them into her dainty little mouth all at once. Wait, isn't she going to choke if she eats that quickly? Can she even choke? Kiyoko swallows, then moves to stuff her face with another one of the fried rice pouches before catching herself, aiming a most petulant, pouty expression directly at you. Seeing her talk with a mouth full of food is something. "I'm huuuungrrrrryy. I'm pregnant. Your kit is making me hungry. I want inarizushi. Your kit wants inarizushi. Don't even try to stop us." You weren't going to, but what she said — doesn't that mean that she's just using your visit as an excuse to- "It's two against one," Kiyoko says, patting her big, round belly with oily fingers. "You're not going to stop us!" [pc.isDK|Oh, you are going to stop her. And the only way to do that is to eat it all before she does. Kiyoko sticks her little pink tongue out at you. "Mine!" Without further ado, she begins to prodigiously scarf down the food as quickly as she can.|Oh no no no no. You're smart enough not to get between someone with that particular look on her face and her food. That's just going to be more trouble than it's worth.] ] Between the two of you, it doesn't take long for the miniature mountain of rice-stuffed pockets to disappear. The food isn't real — no matter how many you chow down on, you never seem to feel any fuller, but Kiyoko's presence is very much there. The kitsune doesn't say anything as she stuffs her face, but the sheer enthusiasm with which she does it and her animated demeanour tell you more than words ever could. "Ooh... ehe... I think I may have overeaten. But even if I have, I don't think I'm going to allow myself to regret a single moment of it." Kiyoko wipes away broken grains of rice from her cheeks and grins stupidly at you. Was all this just an excuse for her to give herself a treat? "Oh, don't be like that. I needed it, and by the looks of you, so did you. I just... this particular dish has special meaning for me, and I wanted to share it with someone I cared for." Pretty words to hide tricky intentions. "Oh, boo." Kiyoko snaps her fingers, and the dirty dishes rise off the low table and settle on the sideboard, out of the way. "Come on, now that I've had a nice meal, I'm feeling much more playful, or anything else you might want to get up to. Got any ideas?" ] [flags.KIYOKO_MEAL_TS||You've got to ask, though, what are those utensils over there? Those sticks, for lack of a better word to describe them? Hope you didn't give offense, but... "Hah, of course. You wouldn't know what chopsticks are. Just feel free to ignore them and use the spoon — I want you to feel comfortable, not cause you distress. The oversight is entirely mine."] The two of you spend a little time together, eating and chatting away the next hour or so as the meal gradually disappears before you. It's delightfully flavorful in quite the exotic way — Kiyoko is clearly an exceptional cook, and you don't think you could ever sample such tastes anywhere in the Frost Marches. However, the nature of the food is quite apparent — no matter how much you eat, you don't seem to feel any fuller. Nevertheless, that wasn't the point, was it? No, the smiling, demure kitsune on the other side of the table was the point, and she seems rather content with the whole exercise as the two of you pick the tray clean and finish up with a bit more tea. "Very satisfactory," Kiyoko says as she clears away the dirty dishes with a snap of her fingers. "It's always a pleasure to share a meal with you, [pc.name]." No, no, the pleasure is yours. A laugh. "If you say so. Come now, then — we've still plenty of time ahead of us. I'll let you take the lead — what would you like to do?""

rows.original: "Oh? You're hungry?" Come on. She knows full well that no one actually needs to eat here on the Astral Plane. But that doesn't stop you from enjoying her company over a nice meal, and let's face it — it's always interesting to see what she can cook up from her home culture. Kiyoko stands and bows. "Thank you for the compliment, [pc.name]. It's always gratifying to be appreciated in this way; I have to reciprocate the favor somehow. Actually, I've been considering something now for all that you've been doing for me, and since you were kind enough to bring up the topic of a good meal, I think I can weave these two threads together." Oh? Seriously, though, you don't think it'll be strictly necessary... A playful laugh. "If you must, [pc.name], you can always praise me lots when we're done. It truly warms my heart to hear others speak well of me, although to be frank, who wouldn't?" All righty then. You'll be waiting with bated breath to see what she's going to cook up. "What I had in mind was a rather unique... well, it's not so much a dish, but rather a way of presenting and serving up the meal. The food is important, of course, but it's not just the meal that's important. Amongst us kitsune, it's considered quite an art form in and of itself. "Now, it'll take a little while longer than usual, I imagine. Please, do entertain yourself while I'm making the necessary preparations. I need to make sure the children are out playing and that we won't get walked in upon." Something the kits can't see? Now you're a little curious as to what Kiyoko has up her sleeve, but she clearly wants to keep it a surprise. Nodding, you watch as Kiyoko excuses herself from the room, then settle in for the wait. Shortly after, you hear the pattering of little feet heading for the cabin door, followed by the sounds of splashing water and kitchen utensils. There seems to be a lot of water being sloshed about — is it soup that she's preparing? You're not exactly sure how long you've been waiting; perhaps half an hour, although there are no clocks in the cabin to tell the time by. However, by and large Kiyoko's light footsteps return to the screen door and it slides open to reveal... ...Well. She's not wearing her sandals, for one. Nor does she have her socks on. Or anything else, for that matter. The only thing standing between your eyes and Kiyoko's orange-amber hair and fur is a thin red apron of flimsy fabric, [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3|which hugs her form and leaves little to the imagination. The little which is left to the imagination, you suspect, has been tastefully arranged in order to conceal what few flaws are on the kitsune's body — and the imagination is quite adept at filling in the blanks with the flattering. It's dainty, and suiting the stature of someone like Kiyoko. It promises so much more, especially if she were to turn around. It's kind of like a maid outfit, only... less. A lot less in some respects, but a lot more in others. Domestic and alluring. What's not to like? |which struggles to contain the kitsune's increasingly pregnant midriff. Considering that it was already form-fitting to begin with, that's quite a feat, and as a result Kiyoko's motherly curves are outlined plainly for your enjoyment. The bottom of her growing belly peeks out from under the apron's hem, and the barely-covered skin is somehow more alluring than it would've otherwise been had she been completely nude. Given how Kiyoko would've easily been able to find a fitting apron had she the mind to do so, there's no doubt that she's donned this getup on purpose. It is appropriately maternal and domestic, you have to admit, while still reminding you exactly how and why her tummy is growing... |and even that has been pushed up by the kitsune's heavily pregnant belly to the point where it only manages to cover just under half of the full, round dome, leaving her navel and everything below exposed. To be fair, it's not the belly's doing all alone. Kiyoko's engorged, milk-heavy breasts push against the apron from underneath, her fat nipples clearly outlined for you to see. Pressed so tightly together, her lady lumps are starting to leak — very, very slowly, but they still are, enough for two distinctly wet spots to form on the apron's fabric. Maternal, risque and domestic. Can things get even better than this? ] But that's not all. Balanced in Kiyoko's hands is a huge tray of sushi, sashimi, seaweed rolls, and other small finger foods. There're utensils, too, but as you watch Kiyoko set the table, you note that she's only doing so for one, and as she passes you, you catch a whiff of faintly scented soap. Did she take a quick bath to be more presentable? Hmm... she's not setting out the food, either. Wonder what she's got up her sleeve. Setting the tray down on the table, Kiyoko wiggles her large foxy ears playfully and bows. "Does this please you?" Yes, it's been very pleasing so far. It's a surprise, one supposes, and you're content to play along with whatever little game she's got in mind. You get no reply, but Kiyoko looks extremely smug as she, against all expectations, sits down on the table's edge and lies down on her back. Hair and tails alike fan out underneath her as she makes herself comfortable, and [kiyoko.pregStage 3|even though the weight of her kit-filled womb is pressing directly on her, the kitsune doesn't seem in the least bit discomfited. |she gives you an encouraging smile. ] "Would you do the honors of removing the tablecloth?" The tablecloth? Oh, she must mean the apron; you get the feeling you know where this is going, and it's to a good place. Even in Kiyoko's current position, it's not too hard to reach around and undo the apron strings, then rip the flimsy garment off her with a flourish before folding it up and setting it beside the table. "Now, would you please hand me that scroll on the tray?" It's not a very large one, which is why you must've overlooked it amongst the sumptuous spread arrayed on it, but once you start looking for it specifically it's not too hard to find the scroll in question. The rods have been encrusted with little sapphires, with larger ones tipping both ends of each rod, and as Kiyoko unfurls the paper you feel a faint surge of magic being worked... Huh. As one, the various foodstuffs rise off their dishes and clean off the tray. Some have a backing of fragrant leaves, others less so, and like a flock of birds on a tree, they waft through the air and alight on Kiyoko's naked body, perched precariously on her bare skin and fur wherever they can find purchase. The end result is rather artistic, for lack of a better word to put it — the colorful arrangement of sushi, sashimi and rolls against the kitsune's pale skin, complete with candy flowers and decorative herbs speaks of the time and effort that must've been spent in crafting the spell, if nothing else. You like this. It's very exotic, if nothing else; the garland of white flowers — you're not sure what exactly they are — is very fetching on her. Then there's the matter of the strategically placed bits of sushi covering her more delicate lady bits... you're looking forward to seeing how those taste. A flush of deep red creeps into Kiyoko's cheeks. "Really." Yes, indeed. "I spent the entirety of a night just getting the spell I just used correct. There were several mishaps, but here and now, I believe that all that effort was worth it. Please," she says, unable to keep a bright, mischievous smile off her lips. "I would be honored if you'd partake of the meal — and me — however you wish."
rows.translation: 哦？你饿了？ 得了吧，她心里很清楚其实根本没有人 需求 在星界这里用餐也是不错的选择。不过，这并不妨碍你和她一起享用美味的饭菜，而且说实话，看看她能运用自己家乡的文化做出什么美食，总是很有趣的。 清子站起身来，鞠了一躬。 谢谢你的夸奖， [pc.name]能够以这样的方式得到他人的认可，总是让人感到非常欣慰；我必须想办法回报这份善意。其实，考虑到你一直以来为我所做的一切，以及你刚才主动提出一起享用美餐的建议，我想我可以将这两件事结合起来处理。 哦？说真的，你不觉得这真的有必要吗…… 一阵轻松的笑声。 如果非得这样的话 [pc.name]每当我们完成任务后，你总能给予我很多表扬。听到别人夸奖我，真的让我感到非常开心，不过说实话，谁会不喜欢这样的赞美呢？ 好吧，那么你就等着瞧她会想出什么点子吧。 我想要的是一种相当独特的……嗯，与其说它是一道菜，不如说它是一种呈现和供应菜肴的方式。当然，食物本身也很重要，但关键并不在于此。 只是 这种用餐方式对我们狐族来说，简直是一种艺术形式。 现在，我想这个过程会比平时花费更长的时间。请在我就绪之前，先自己找点事情做吧。我需要确保孩子们都出去玩了，这样就不会有人突然闯进来打扰我们了。 那些小工具根本看不到的东西？现在你开始好奇京子到底藏了什么把戏，但她显然想把这个惊喜保留到最后一刻。你点了点头，看着京子离开房间，然后开始耐心等待。 不久之后，你听到了小足部丫匆匆走向小屋门的声音，紧接着便是水花四溅以及厨房用具碰撞发出的声响。看来有大量的水被泼来泼去——她是在准备汤吗？ 你也不太清楚自己已经等了多久；大概有半个小时吧，不过小屋里并没有时钟可以用来查看时间。不过，不久之后，清子的轻快的足部步声又传来了，门被推开了。……嗯，首先，她并没有穿凉鞋，也没有穿袜子。事实上，她身上什么衣服都没有穿。唯一挡在你视线和清子的橙黄色头发与皮毛之间的，只是一条薄薄的、材质稀薄的红色围裙而已。 [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3|这种设计完美贴合她的身体曲线，几乎没有任何多余的空间留给人们的想象。仅有那么一点点 是 这种设计完全取决于人们的想象力，而人们的想象力总是很擅长用美好的画面来掩盖狐妖身上那些为数不多的瑕疵。 这套服装非常精致，非常适合像清子这样的身材。它给人一种更多的期待，尤其是当她转过身来的时候。它有点像女仆装，只不过……差得远。在某些方面差得很多，但在其他方面又有着很多相似之处。 这种服装确实很适合居家穿着。 以及 如此诱人，还有什么不喜欢的呢？ |这条裙子实在难以遮盖雪女那日益凸出的腹部。考虑到它本来就贴身设计，能够做到这一点已经相当不错了，因此，清子的母性曲线就这样清晰地展现在了人们眼前，供大家欣赏。 她逐渐隆起的腹部从围裙的下摆处露了出来，那几乎被遮住的皮肤，反而比她如果完全裸露出来的时候更加诱人。 考虑到如果基约子真的想要的话，她完全能够轻松找到一条合适的围裙，因此毫无疑问，她这是故意穿上这样的装扮的。 它 是 确实，她表现得非常像一位母亲，也非常注重家庭生活，但你不得不承认，她还是会不断地提醒你，她的肚子为什么会在变大，以及到底是怎么变大的…… |甚至 那个 由于那只狐妖怀孕的腹部过于隆起，它的肚子只能覆盖整个圆顶的一半左右，导致肚脐以及腹部以下的所有部位都暴露在外。 公平地说，这并不是它的肚子本身的问题。 清子的胸部因为充满了乳汁而紧紧地贴在围裙上，那肥大的乳头清晰地显露在眼前。由于被挤压得过于紧密，她的乳房开始渗出乳汁——虽然速度非常慢，但确实有乳汁渗出，因此在围裙的布料上形成了两处明显的湿痕。 充满母性气息，略带挑逗意味 以及 太棒了。难道还有比这更好的事情吗？ ] 但不仅如此。在清子的手部中，端着一盘满满的大寿司、生鱼片、海苔卷以及其他各种小零食。桌上还摆放着餐具，但当你看着清子摆设餐具时，你会注意到她其实只为一人准备这些食物。而当她从你身边经过时，你会闻到一股淡淡的肥皂香味。 她是不是匆匆洗了个澡，想让自己看起来更得体些？嗯……她也没有开始准备食物。不知道她到底在打什么主意。 将托盘放在桌上，清子调皮地晃了晃自己那对大大的狐妖耳朵，然后鞠了一躬。 这样你满意了吗？ 是的，到目前为止，这一切都让人感到非常愉快。这确实是个意外的惊喜，而且你也很乐意配合她心中的这个小游戏来玩。 你没有得到任何回应，但清子却显得非常得意。出乎所有人的预料，她坐到了桌边，然后仰面躺了下来。她的头发和尾巴都散开在身后，她就这样舒舒服服地躺了下来 [kiyoko.pregStage 3|尽管她那装满小动物的肚子带来的重量直接压在身上，但这只九尾狐似乎丝毫没有感到不适。 |她向你露出了鼓励的微笑。 ] 请你来帮忙把桌布拿开吧？ 桌布？哦，她指的应该是围裙吧；你大概能猜到接下来会发生什么，而且结果肯定是很不错的。即使以清子的现状来说，要绕到背后解开围裙的绳子，然后利落地把它从她身上扯下来，再把它叠好放在桌子旁边，也并不是什么难事。 现在，请把托盘上的那卷卷轴递给我好吗？ 它并不是很大，因此在你看到那些摆放在那里的华丽物品时，很可能忽略了它。但一旦你开始专门寻找，找到那卷卷轴其实并不难。那些杆子上镶嵌着小小的蓝宝石，而每一根杆子的两端还镶嵌着较大的蓝宝石。当纪代子展开那张纸时，你会感觉到有一股微弱的魔力正在发挥作用…… 嗯，那些食物纷纷从盘子里飞起来，落在了托盘上。有些食物覆盖着芳香的叶子，而有些则没有；它们就像树上的鸟群一样，在空气中飘荡，然后落在了清子的裸露身上——那些能够附着的地方，它们都会小心翼翼地停留在她的皮肤和毛发上。 最终呈现的效果颇具艺术性，实在找不到更合适的词语来形容了——那些色彩缤纷的寿司、生鱼片和卷饼摆放在那只狐妖苍白的皮肤上，再加上糖果花和装饰性香草，这一切无不体现了制作这个法术所耗费的时间与精力。 你一定会喜欢这个的。至少它非常别具一格——那串白色花朵编成的花环，你甚至不确定它们到底是什么花，但戴在她身上确实非常漂亮。还有那些巧妙地摆放在关键位置的寿司……你肯定很期待尝尝它们到底是什么味道。 清子的脸颊突然泛起了深红色的晕红。 真的吗。 确实如此。 我花了一整晚的时间来确保我刚才使用的那个法术能够正确施展。过程中遇到了不少麻烦，但现在看来，所有的这些努力都是值得的。拜托了。 她说着，嘴角始终挂着那抹明亮而调皮的微笑。 如果您愿意与我们共进这顿饭，无论以何种方式与我相处，我都将感到无比荣幸。

rows.original:
Like it or not, Kiyoko is practically made for petting and stroking all over. Are all kitsune so fluffy and silky to the touch? Whether they are or not, the one in front of you definitely is, no doubt the result of plenty of fastidious grooming on the foxy lady's part.

        Just looking at her hair and fur makes your fingertips itch... and let's face it, after an eternity of being alone, she probably needs a good petting as much as you want to give one.
        
        So, how about it?
rows.translation:
不管你喜不喜欢，清子简直就是为让人爱抚、抚摸而存在的。所有的狐妖不都是摸起来这么柔软、丝滑吗？不管是不是这样，眼前的这只绝对是，这无疑是她那位细心照料她的主人花了大量时间精心打理的结果。

Kiyoko winks at you and gives you her best man-eating grin — which isn't very good since she isn't intimidating enough to pull it off, but at least it gets her intentions across as clear as day. "Oh, you might not be intending it, but I might have some very different ideas." Does she now? Well, you'll take things in stride as they happen. For now, though, how about a hug? Her fur looks so soft to the touch, it'd be a crime not to enjoy it. Good things are made better when they're shared with others, after all. "Does this apply to all good things? Because I've got a few others I'd like to share, too." In good time. All in good time. For now, though... Stepping from your seat, you close the distance between you and Kiyoko in a few broad steps, the kitsune vixen setting down her teacup and looking up at you expectantly as you stand over her. As dainty as the vixen is, it's no problem at all to catch her under her arms and hoist her to her feet, whereupon you close your arms about Kiyoko and pull her into a hug. "We should do this again sometime, although probably not too often. I'm not sure if my heart could take it."

清子向你露出了一个狡黠的笑容。 那我加入你们，你们不介意吧？ 哦？有什么特别的理由吗？ 那只狐妖露出了最天真的表情，仿佛在说 谁，我吗？ [pc.ra lupine catfolk|哦，我只需要确保你的毛不会堵塞排水管。如果发生了那种情况，可就麻烦了。 她真的认为你会那么做吗？ 哦，你看起来真是太邋遢了 [pc.name]我们不妨承认这一点吧；不过，我也不会指望你能达到我对于个人仪容的要求。恰恰因为这些，你才显得如此可爱啊。 |哦，没什么。我只是想确保你的安全而已；总不能让你在这么热的环境里待太久而中暑吧。泡个热水澡放松一下确实不错，但你也必须考虑到自己的安全。朋友是不会让朋友独自洗澡的。 ] [pc.isDK|你也回以一个狡黠的笑容，回应了清子的笑容。有没有人告诉她，她简直满口胡言？|你也回以一个微笑，然后摇了摇头。哦，别这样吧——她应该知道不该在你面前说这么多废话的。 ]她并没有在欺骗任何人，而且她自己也非常清楚这一点。 当然。我本来就不是想骗你……但是…… 清子以一种极具魅力的方式倚在桌子上，同时眨动着睫毛看着你。 ……如果有一只可爱又喜欢依偎在你身边的狐妖和你一起洗澡，你会觉得非常尴尬吗？ 不，大概不会吧。否则你也不会提起这个话题，对吧？ 清子开心地笑着，耳朵向前竖着，兴奋地摇来摇去。 那么，请您先开始吧。我需要先整理一下自己，稍后就会加入您。 还不错嘛。哈，站起来，离开房间，然后沿着原路走回小屋外。当你走到阳轻型下时，不禁眨了眨眼。沿着小路走一小段距离，就能来到温泉边。你慢慢脱掉衣服，把衣物整理好放在一旁，然后从温泉中取一些水，仔细清洗身体，之后再走进温泉里。 虽然可能并不完美，但至少现在你觉得自己已经足够干净了，可以负责任地和其他人一起泡澡，而不会把水弄得脏兮兮的。 天啊，这简直太棒了。在水面平静之下，那些轻柔的水流会轻轻按摩你的身体 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] 以一种极其奇妙的方式，你几乎能够感受到旅途中的种种疲惫与不适是如何在水流的带动下逐渐消失的。从水面上升的蒸汽为你的鼻腔和肺部带来了湿润的热气，让你呼吸变得格外顺畅。 啊，这才是生活啊。慢慢地，你将整个身体浸入水中，直到下巴都浸没进去，然后闭上眼睛，尽情享受这种美妙的体验。不久之后，草丛中传来的轻柔沙沙声吸引了你的注意，紧接着，清脆的脚步声表明纪代子正在向你走来。 当你抬头望去，你会看到她只裹着一条毛巾，皮肤和毛发上都闪烁着水珠的轻型芒。清子微微一笑，走向水边，而那只狐妖则任由毛巾飘落到地上。 [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3|她懒洋洋地走到水边，故意把脚尖放在水面上，耍着花招。 哦，天哪，确实比平时暖和了一些。 暖和吗？你觉得完全没问题啊。她应该直接进来吧。 天气变暖了，我并不感到意外；你觉得这样也很舒服，这也理所当然吧？毕竟，你就在里面，不是吗？ 哦天哪，真是太淫荡、太耸人听闻了……不过，要是还有其他人在场在意这些的话，或许才会这样吧……嗯，她为什么不能进去把水烧开呢？ 清子咯咯笑着，露出得意的表情，然后悄悄地跳进了水里。她下水时，水面上只泛起了微微的涟漪，随后她就舒舒服服地待在水里了。 |发现她在照顾你时总是流露出的那种温柔、充满母性的光芒 能量 她的身体上……那个隆起的腹部其实算不上她最吸引人的地方——当清子的头发和皮毛湿漉漉地贴在她的身上时，这只狐妖那逐渐显露出的母性曲线才真正成为了吸引人的焦点。 哈，简直就像她真的是一位母亲一样 制作完成 说真的，虽然有点开玩笑，但在温暖的阳光下，清子的头发和毛发确实看起来非常光亮动人——她自己也知道这一点，所以还不停地用手指梳理它们，以便让这些美丽的外表更加显眼。真的呢。 [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] 随着尾巴在身后摆动，清子优雅地踏入水中，当她潜入水面之下时，只留下了一丝细微的涟漪。从任何角度来看，她都真是一位十足的“狐妖妈妈”。 |她将那充满孕意的美丽身躯完全展现在众人面前。随着一声轻微的喘息，她摇摇摆摆地走进水中，将身体浸入水面之下，脸上洋溢着幸福的笑容，注视着你。 而你也在注视着她，观察着水波如何轻拂着她那饱满、浑圆的胸部，观察着她的头发和毛发在湿润后如何紧贴着她的身体曲线。你们就这样对视着，过了几分钟，纪代子突然笑了起来，将头发从脸上拨开。 嘿嘿，如果你一直盯着我看的话，我会觉得挺尴尬的…… 这就更有理由让你盯着看了——她慌乱的时候简直太可爱了。 ] 这真是太颓废、太有趣了，不是吗？ 这确实是你有幸体验过的最美好的事情之一。 在我家乡，洗澡这件事其实蕴含着许多礼仪和规矩，几乎可以说是一种仪式……但现在，只有我们两个人在这里。说实话，在这里待了这么久之后，真的很难记住所有那些规矩。我们还是专心享受当下吧，好吗？你看起来很累。 你可以尝试这样做。闭上眼睛，尽你最大的努力放松自己，把烦恼暂时抛到脑后，哪怕只是短短的片刻。在那种温暖的感觉的陪伴下 [pc.skin] 还有那轻柔的流水声，真的会让人感到 感受到 你的思绪逐渐平静下来，周围的一切都变得宁静而静止——直到有什么东西轻轻触到了你的脚。 嗯？你睁开眼睛，却发现一切似乎都正常无异：清子就坐在你对面，头微微后仰，肩膀靠在弹簧的边缘上。 不，又来了——在乳白色的水面上，一道阴影迅速闪过：她正在用尾巴逗弄你，想惹你生气呢。 真是个调皮的狐妖……不过她只是个爱玩耍、顽皮的狐妖罢了。如果你愿意的话，或许也可以加入她的游戏呢。..
rows.raw: " It's been a long day out in the waking world. Even though you're asleep, you can still feel aches and twinges in your muscles from the exertions of the day, ghosts of the physical translated into the spiritual. Perhaps, then, a soak in the hot springs out on the hillside would be in order; while you wouldn't really be having a rejuvenating bath, surely some warming of the soul is in order. Who knows, perhaps some of it might even carry over to your physical form? "Ha!" Kiyoko gives you a sly grin. "You don't mind if I join you, then?" Oh? Any particular reason why? The kitsune puts on her most innocent face, as if to say, who, me? [pc.ra lupine catfolk|"Oh, I just have to make sure that your shed fur doesn't clog up the drain. Lots of trouble if that happens." And she thinks that you're going to do that? "Oh, you're terribly scruffy, [pc.name]. Let's not try and deny that; I wouldn't expect you to stick to my standards of grooming, though. It's part of what makes you so adorable." |"Oh, not much. I should make sure that you're safe and all; wouldn't want you staying in too long and passing out from the heat. Relaxing with a hot bath might be nice, but you've got to consider your safety as well. Friends don't let friends bathe alone." ] [pc.isDK|You return Kiyoko's sly grin with one of your own. Has anyone told her that she's utterly full of bullshit?|You return Kiyoko's grin with one of your own and shake your head. Oh, come on — she knows better than to blow so much hot air in your face. ]She's not fooling anyone, and she knows that full well. "Of course. I wasn't trying to fool you, after all. But..." Kiyoko leans on the table in a very vulpine fashion and flutters her eyelashes at you. "... Would you be very affronted by the idea of an adorable, cuddly fox sharing your bath?" No, probably not. Otherwise, you wouldn't have brought it up, would you? Kiyoko beams, her ears pointed forward and wiggling energetically. "Then please, do go ahead first. I need to make myself presentable and will join you in a short while." Presentable. Hah. Standing, you leave the room and retrace your steps out of the cabin, blinking as you emerge into the warm sunshine. It's a short walk along the path to the hot springs, where you take your time disrobing and stacking your stuff out of the way before drawing a little water from the springs and scrubbing yourself off thoroughly before stepping in. It's not perfect, perhaps, but at least now you feel clean enough to share the bath with others responsibly without getting it all grimy. Gods, this is practically divine. The gentle currents under the water's calm surface rub at your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] in the most wonderful way, and you can practically feel the pains and aches of travel crumble away to be carried off by the water's flow. The steam that rises from the water's surface fills your nose and lungs with moist heat, and you breathe much easier for it. Ah, this is the life. Slowly, you submerge yourself all the way to your chin, and close your eyes to savour this sublime delight. It doesn't seem like very long before the soft rustle of grass draws your attention, followed by light footsteps as Kiyoko draws close. As you look up, you see her dressed in little but a towel, her skin and fur glistening with a sheen of water. Smiling faintly, Kiyoko approaches the water's edge, and the kitsune lets the towel flutter to the ground, [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3|lazily sashaying over to the water's edge where she makes a show of toeing the surface. "Oh my, I do believe it's a little warmer than usual." Warmer? It feels perfectly fine to you. She should just come on in. "I'm not surprised it's warmer, nor that it feels perfectly fine to you. After all, you're in it, aren't you?" Oh my. How salacious and scandalous. Or it would be, if there was anyone else around who cared... well, why shouldn't she get in and set the water to boiling? Kiyoko giggles and smirks, then slips into the water, her entry sending but the barest of ripples across the surface as she makes herself comfortable. |uncovering the soft, maternal glow that she always seems to gain when nurturing your ah, energy within her. The baby bump is the least of her assets — with Kiyoko's hair and fur wet and clinging to her body, all of the kitsune's increasingly motherly curves are laid out for your enjoyment. Hah, it's almost as if she was made for this. Half-joking aside, Kiyoko's hair and fur do look quite glossy and bright like this under the warm sunlight — and she knows it, running fingers through both to show them off better. All [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] of her tails flowing behind her, Kiyoko gracefully steps into the water, leaving the barest of ripples in her wake as she slides beneath the surface. Truly a foxy mama-to-be in every sense. |laying bare her gloriously pregnant body for all to see. With a small exhalation of effort, she waddles in and lowers herself beneath the water's surface, a beatific smile spreading on her face as she regards you. In turn, you regard her, observing the way the water laps at the cleavage of her ripe, heavy breasts, the way her hair and fur cling to the contours of her body when wet. The two of you stare at each other for a few more minutes, then Kiyoko laughs and smooths her hair away from her face. "Ehehe, I'll get embarrassed if you keep on staring..." All the more reason you should stare; she's adorable when flustered. ] "How delightfully decadent this is, isn't it?" It's one of the better things you've had the pleasure of experiencing, yes. "There's a lot more etiquette and decorum to this whole bathing thing where I come from — it's practically a ritual in and of itself — but here and now, it's just the two of us. Frankly, it's hard to remember everything after having been alone in here for so long. Let's focus on enjoying ourselves, all right? You look tired." You can get behind that. Closing your eyes, you do your best to relax and put your worries out of your mind, if only for a little while. Aided by the warmth caressing at your [pc.skin] and gentle trickle of running water, you can actually feel your mind emptying, calming and drawing still — up to the moment where something tickles against your foot. Huh? You open an eye, but nothing seems to be out of the ordinary; Kiyoko is sitting across you, head tilted back and shoulders reclining on the spring's edge. No, there it is again, a dart of a shadow under the milky water — she's teasing you with her tails, trying to get a rise out of you. What a naughty fox... but she's a naughty, playful fox. Maybe you could join in her game, if you felt like it..."
