rows.raw: "Have a soak in the hot springs out on the hill."

rows.original: Smiling warmly, you stand from your seat and walk over to Kiyoko. She looks up at you questioningly and starts to rise, but you put a firm hand between her ears and tousle her amber hair vigorously. That stops Kiyoko in her tracks as the kitsune instantly softens up under your touch, her large, pointed ears turning to either side of her head, as if trying to get away from you. Let them try all they want. Nothing's getting away from the sheer determination of your petting, not even something as slippery and tricksy as a kitsune! "Hey!" Kiyoko cries out as you chase down her perky ears with your fingers, spreading out your palm wide so there's nowhere for them to escape to. "You've got to give a girl some warning before—" You pet harder, finally pinning down one of Kiyoko's elusive ears between thumb and forefinger. You hear her take a sharp breath, stiffening from head to toe as a jolt runs down her spine, then try to stifle a murmured purr of pleasure. Now, no need to go all the way at once; it's perfectly fine to stop and savour the moment. You have time, after all. With Kiyoko's right ear firmly in your grasp, you take your time rubbing the outside with its glossy amber fur, reveling in the warm softness. At the same time, your thumb commences exploring the fine, sensitive hairs of Kiyoko's inner ear, teasing the soft tufts that sprout from within. "There! Right there! No, higher! Faster!" faced with a full-on assault on her dignity, Kiyoko's trying to remain in control of the situation, but the facade of dominance isn't fooling anyone. She's largely putty in your hands now, leaning forward on the low table with her head and arms on its surface while thrusting her ass out behind her, all [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] of her tails sweeping at the floor. The poor kitsune's other ear is twitching and swivelling like crazy now, so you grab hold of it too; with Kiyoko subdued like this, it's a simple matter to apply the same treatment to her other foxy ear. It's too much for her to bear. What's left of Kiyoko's politeness and propriety breaks down as she pushes her head aggressively against your hands in a clearly demanding gesture, a wordless bark escaping her lips. Not that you needed words to catch her meaning — you move your fingers up and down, back and forth across the foxy mama's forward-pointing ears. Since her ears are unable to twitch and wiggle as they usually do, the rest of Kiyoko is more than happy to pick up the slack, shivering uncontrollably with pent-up energy. Her fluffy tails twitch and curl with a life of their own, her eyes go half-lidded, and as always, she demands more from you by pushing and nuzzling aggressively against your hands. You're more than happy to oblige — after all, it was you who wanted to pet her, right? After a while, you leave one hand at Kiyoko's ears, and set the other to attending to her amber hair. It glides effortlessly through your fingers, flowing like an orange-yellow waterfall and practically impossible to get a good grasp on. "Who's the most beautiful creature of all, hmm?" the kitsune murmurs when she manages to get her thoughts together for a few moments. "Who's the prettiest, the slinkiest, the most slender?" [pc.isDK|You roll your eyes, but humor her anyway. ]She is! Kiyoko practically preens at the praise and sighs happily. Her breath comes short, fast and hard as you pick up the pace of your petting, turning her carefully groomed and styled hair and fur into an utterly and incorrigibly disheveled wreck. "You know, apparently I take very much after my grandmother," Kiyoko murmurs as you continue to stroke her all over. "I never knew her, but I heard she took good care of herself and was exceedingly beautiful, even by kitsune standards. "Isn't that amazing? Wonder if I can be like her one day..." [kiyoko.numKits 16|With how well her body's developed, you can say with certainty that she's already there. Kiyoko idly bats you with one of her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails. "Flatterer." ] You slow down a little now, planting the heel of your palm on her forehead and moving your hand in a back-and-forth motion; Kiyoko bobs her head in time with your movements, completely enthralled by the sheer delight of being petted. Her eyes are fully closed now, her mouth forming a small %"o" and opening slightly as she mumbles and murmurs. So it proceeds, your fingers a blur, her face plastered with an expression of supreme satisfaction, until your wrist and fingers get tired and you have to stop despite the kitsune's urgings for more. You finish up with a little shake of your fingers to ruffle the fringes of her hair, then withdraw. "That was fun," Kiyoko says with a satisfied sigh, pushing herself off the table, standing, and smoothing out her clothes back into some semblance of order. "One day I'll pet you, too — it'll be repayment for this!" [pc.ra lupine|You'll be looking forward to it, then. "Are you sure?" Kiyoko grins nastily, then holds out a hand to waggle her fingers in your face. "You may have bitten off more than you can chew with those words. I'll make you squirm and squeal, little doggy, squirm and squeal until you're begging for mercy." Hah. You shall see, won't you? You shall see. |You're not entirely sure that petting would work on you as well as it does on her, but she's welcome to try. Kiyoko gives you a big, confident smile. "Everyone has a weakness. Finding and exploiting it is the fun part, and —" she waggles her fingers and makes grabby hands at you — "I intend to have a lot of fun." Challenge accepted, then. She'll never break you! "We'll see," Kiyoko replies, bowing ever so slightly and curling her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails about her legs and feet. "We'll see, shall we?" Yes, you will. ] "Don't think I'll forget about this. Kitsune always repay their debts!"
rows.translation: 你微笑着从座位上站起来，走向纪代子。她疑惑地抬头看着你，正准备起身，你却一把抓住她的耳朵，用力地拨弄着她那琥珀色的头发。这一下，纪代子立刻停住了动作——那只狐妖在你的触碰下立刻变得温顺起来，它那大大的尖耳朵向身体的两侧耷拉下来，仿佛想要逃离你的触碰。 让他们想尽办法吧。没有什么能够逃脱你坚定的决心，就连像狐妖这样狡猾又难以捉摸的东西也不例外！ 嘿！ 当你用手部指去抓那些灵活的耳朵时，清子发出了叫声，你则将手部掌摊开得很大，让它们的耳朵无处可逃。 在跟女孩子做这种事之前，你总该先提醒她一下吧…… 你用力地抚摸着她，终于用拇指和食指抓住了吉代那只总是躲来躲去的耳朵。你听到她突然吸了一口气，全身变得僵硬起来，一股颤动从她的脊椎一直传到了全身，然后她试图抑制住那愉悦的低鸣声。 现在，没有必要一下子做到极致；停下来好好享受这一刻也是完全没问题的。毕竟，你还有时间。当你紧紧握住清子的右耳时，你可以慢慢抚摸它那光滑的琥珀色耳毛，尽情享受那种温暖而柔软的触感。 与此同时，你的拇指开始轻轻探索纪代子内耳中那些细腻而敏感的绒毛，逗弄着那些从内部生长出来的柔软茸毛。 就是那里！对，就是那个位置！不，再高一点！快一点！ 面对这种对她的尊严的公然侵犯，清子试图控制局面，但这种表面上的强势姿态并没有骗到任何人。现在她基本上已经完全处于你的掌控之中了——她俯身坐在那张矮桌前，头和手部臂都搭在桌面上，而臀部则翘得高高 [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] 她的尾巴在地板上扫来扫去。那只可怜的狐妖的另一只耳朵也在不停地抽动、转动，于是你也抓住了它；既然纪代子已经被制服了，那么对她的另一只狐妖耳朵采取同样的措施也就变得很容易了。 这对她来说实在是难以承受。清子的礼貌与矜持早已荡然无存，她猛地用头抵住你的手部，这个动作明显是在表达要求，同时从她嘴唇中迸发出无声的怒斥。其实你根本不需要言语就能理解她的意思——你只是将手部指在那个狡黠的女人的耳朵上上下下、来回移动而已。 Weakly, Kiyoko rolls her head over to take in the sight of little Kinu peering into the verdant birthing chamber, and her face becomes even paler. "Kinu! You're not —" But it's too late. Kinu's pale blue eyes are as wide as dinner plates as she takes in her mother's panting, naked form, the mess that's the afterbirth, and finally, the little fox kit in Kiyoko's arms. Swallowing hard, the little kitsune focuses furiously on the last, while studiously ignoring the first two. "I-I'm sorry, Mother. I just wanted..." Kiyoko sighs. "Well, you're here now. What did you want?" "I... I wanted to hold the baby. While they're still small. So when I heard that you were indisposed, I snuck in..." Kinu swallows hard again as she looks down at the mess of afterbirth. "Did... did all that come out of your tummy?" "It's what helps the kit grow while they're in my tummy, yes. But now they don't need it anymore." Kiyoko looks unsure for a moment, then beckons Kinu over. "I suppose since I'm teaching you how to care for your siblings, you should learn about this as well. After all, it was how you were born, and you'll have to go through it yourself someday. [pc.name], would you please help clean up?" "I... this looks yucky." "Of course it is," Kiyoko replies, giving you a nod as you move to pick up one of the damp towels and clean up the mess from the birth. "It's also exhausting, painful, and mind-numbing, at least for the first few times it happens. But it's worth it. You don't regret being born, do you?" Kinu says nothing and just looks down at her feet. She stays like that for half a minute or so, then looks up at her mother and sticks out her arms expectantly. Kiyoko considers her, then carefully hands over the newborn kitsune kit, making sure Kinu's grip is secure before letting go completely. The little kit mewls and snuffles about in Kinu's arms, a small, tightly-wrapped bundle of fluff. Kinu practically bounces in place, petting and stroking her newborn sibling all over. "Eeeeee! So cute! I want one of my own!" "Even knowing where they come from and how they come out?" "I can do it!" Kiyoko can't help but laugh weakly at that. "You'll have to be a lot older before you can get started on that, love. That, and babies don't grow up so quickly outside of the astral plane. You'll have to feed and care for a helpless little kit for more than just a few moments, you know. They'll cry, they'll need to be changed, they'll wake you up when you need sleep the most." "I know." Kiyoko smiles and ruffles her eldest daughter's ears. "You need the right temperament to be a den mother, if you want to be like me. Beauty fades, strength weakens, but a well-cultivated temperament and good-natured attitude will last you for the whole of your life." Kinu hugs the newborn close to her for a little while longer, then looks to her mother worriedly as the little kit begins to wail, a tiny, high-pitched screaming ringing in the air. Despite all the cradling and shushing that she's applying to her little sibling, the fox kit's screaming just gets louder. "Mama! Mama! What do I do?" "Improvise, of course. You'll be having to deal with this a lot when you grow up if you want to be like your mama." Kinu pouts. "That's not very useful..." "It's more an art than a science, which is why you're getting started while you're young. Both experience and instruction are important, but the former counts for more than the latter. Now, let me show you how it's done." Kinu looks a little uncertain, but hands back the newborn to her mother. Exhausted but relieved, Kiyoko cradles her child and shushes the little one's wailing with a few gentle earpets, then turns to Kinu. "You need to be a little more gentle. Babies are delicate." Kinu frowns, then looks up at her sibling snuffling at her mother's breast once more. Several moments of silence pass as Kiyoko slowly recovers a little while longer, then Kiyoko gives her daughter a nod. "You should be going." "But..." "If you want additional lessons on child-rearing, dear, I can make some time for that. At the very least, it'll keep your little hands away from the peach grove. But right now, your mother wants some time alone with your new sibling and your [pc.mf|father|mother]." That doesn't quite satisfy Kinu, but at least the little kitsune is wise enough to let it go. She stiffens up, gives Kiyoko a very formal bow, then slips out of the birthing chambers; the last you see of your daughter are her three silvery-white tails vanishing around the corner.
rows.translation: 一时间，产房里陷入了寂静。清子稍作休息，调整呼吸，将刚出生的小动物放在自己略显隆起的腹部上。随后，你几乎听不见的微弱声响传来——屏风门被推开了 妈妈？ 基代子无力地转过头，看到了小纪努正从那片翠绿的产房中探出头来，她的脸色变得更加苍白了。 基努！你不可能—— 但为时已晚。金色的淡蓝色眼睛瞪得像餐盘一样大，她看到了母亲那气喘吁吁、赤裸的身体，看到了那些产后的残骸，最后也看到了清子怀中的那只小狐妖幼崽。小狐妖艰难地咽了咽口水，拼命地注视着最后那个，而刻意忽略了前两个。 对、对不起，妈妈。我只是想…… 清子叹了口气。 好吧，你现在来了。你想说什么？ 我……我想在宝宝还小的时候抱抱他们。所以当我听说你身体不适时，我就偷偷溜进来了…… 金子再次艰难地咽了咽口水，低头看着那一团胎盘残渣。 那些……那些都是从你肚子里出来的吗？ 没错，正是这种物质在它们还在我肚子里的时候帮助它们成长。但现在，它们已经不再需要它了。 清子犹豫了片刻，然后招手部让纪久过来。 既然我在教你如何照顾你的兄弟姐妹，那你也应该了解一下这个。毕竟，这是你与生俱来的责任，总有一天你也必须亲自经历这个过程。 [pc.name]你能帮忙打扫一下吗？ 我……这个看起来真恶心。 当然是了。 清子点了点头，你便拿起一条湿毛巾，开始清理分娩后留下的凌乱场面。 至少在最初几次经历这种时候，这确实会让人感到精疲力竭、痛苦不堪，甚至会让人失去思考的能力。但这一切都是值得的。你不会后悔自己来到了这个世界上，对吧？ 纪奈什么也没说，只是低头看着自己的足部。她这样保持了好半分钟左右，然后抬起头看着母亲，满怀期待地伸出双臂。清子仔细地看了看她，然后小心翼翼地将那只新生的狐妖幼崽递到她手部中，确保纪奈握得稳当之后才松开手部。小狐妖在纪奈的怀里喵喵叫着、抽抽鼻子，就像一个被紧紧包裹起来的小绒球。纪奈高兴得在原地跳来跳去，不停地抚摸和轻拍她的新弟弟妹妹。 哎呀！太可爱了！我也想要一个！ 即使知道它们是从哪里来，又是如何形成的？ 我一定能做到！ 看到这一幕，清子忍不住轻声笑了起来。 亲爱的，你得再长大一些才能开始做那些事。而且，在星界之外，婴儿的成长速度并不会那么快。你知道的，你得照顾这个无助的小生命，这个责任可不会持续短短几分钟而已。他们会哭闹，需要换尿布，还会在你最需要休息的时候把你吵醒。 我知道。 清子微笑着，轻轻挠了挠女儿的耳朵。 如果你想成为像我这样的人，就必须具备合适的性格特质。外貌会消逝，力量也会减弱，但良好的性格修养和友善的态度会伴随你一生。 基努又将新生儿紧紧抱在怀里片刻，随后忧心忡忡地看向她的母亲——那只小狐妖开始发出哀号，那细微而尖锐的哭声在空气中回荡。尽管基努不停地安抚着她的弟弟妹妹，但它的哭声却越发响亮了。 妈妈！妈妈！我该怎么办？ 当然，只能即兴发挥了。你得想办法解决这个问题。 很多 等你长大了，如果想成为像你妈妈那样的人的话。 纪久撅起了嘴。 这没什么用处…… 这更像是一门艺术，而非科学，因此你需要在年轻的时候就开始学习。经验和指导都很重要，但经验的重要性要远远超过指导。现在，让我来告诉你具体该怎么做。 纪奈看起来有些犹豫，但还是把新生儿交还给了她的母亲。基代子虽然疲惫，但心中却感到宽慰。她轻轻抱着孩子，用几句温柔的话语安抚着婴儿的哭声，然后转向纪奈。 你得再温柔一点，婴儿可是很脆弱的。 纪夫皱了皱眉头，然后抬头看着正在母亲怀里抽泣的女儿。几秒钟的沉默之后，清子终于慢慢恢复了平静，于是她点了点头，示意女儿可以停止哭泣了。 你该走了。 但是…… 亲爱的，如果你想了解更多关于育儿的知识，我完全可以抽时间为你讲解。至少这样，你的小手部就不会再去碰那些桃树了。不过现在，你的妈妈想要和一些时间单独和你的新弟弟/妹妹待在一起 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]." 这并没有让绮奴完全满意，但至少这只小狐妖还算聪明，没有继续纠缠下去。她挺直身体，向清子行了一个非常正式的鞠躬，然后悄悄地离开了产房；当你最后一次看到你的女儿时，只见她那三条银白色的尾巴在转角处消失了。

rows.original: At your response, Kiyoko sighs and groans, clutching her swollen, overstuffed womb. "Sometimes, I don't think I'll ever understand some aspects of northerners no matter how much I'm around them. None of the hopeless boys back home would've stuck around, and no prospective mother would've allowed it anyway." Silence. And then, her voice softens, almost as if she's relieved you didn't leave. [var1 |"Fine. Help me get out of my clothes." Kiyoko might be a little clumsier than she usually is, but between the two of you her yukata and silken smallclothes are quickly off her and folded into a pile against the wall under a loaded towel rack. |"If you want to stay and finish the job, I won't stop you. Help me get comfortable here." You guide Kiyoko over to the futon she's prepared for this purpose and ease her down onto it with care. ] Taking a few deep breaths of the balcony's subtle floral scent, Kiyoko calms down a little and takes a more level-headed approach to the situation. Propping herself up against the wall with a couple of cushions, the kitsune sinks back and tries to make herself as comfortable as possible, legs spread and fluffy tails pillowing her body. So, anything in particular she'd like you to do? "Be here for me." That's what you're here for. "Then do that." All right. You find a stool, sit down beside Kiyoko, and begin ruffling her long hair and fluffy, foxy ears with broad, powerful strokes. Comforting, not teasing; Kiyoko herself looks a little more relaxed for what it's worth. There's nothing really left now but to let nature take its course, which it does with rapid succession. [kiyoko.numKits 0 1 4 16 32|"Ugh!" Bracing herself against the wall, Kiyoko squeezes her eyes shut in pain and effort as contractions wrack her body, starting from her lower back and rippling across the taut skin of her belly before retreating once more. She shakes her head, says something breathlessly in her mother tongue, then sinks back against the cushions as the wave of contractions passes. "That was a strong one... it hurts, damn it... is this how Mother felt?" Like she said, she's no stranger to this, right? "Right, right. But there's... there's a difference between seeing Mother handle things, and going through it myself." Kiyoko stops a bit to catch her breath and prepare for the next wave of contractions. "It never happened so quickly for her, either. I can practically feel myself stretching open inside." Now, maybe that's a bit more than you strictly need to know. You ruffle her ears a bit more, tell her to focus on breathing, and unless she feels something's wrong, just let what will happen — well, happen. "I know that, but the thought's... appreciated. Damn it!" It certainly is a bit of a juxtaposition, seeing the usually impeccably polite or playful Kiyoko give in to cursing, but you continue comforting her as best as you can. Bit by bit, you can see the swell of the kitsune's pregnancy slip downward, her womb visibly contracting as it squeezes down on the kit inside, then swelling back out as the contractions pass. It's a very two steps forward, one step back process for lack of a better way to describe it, and as time drags on Kiyoko becomes increasingly exhausted and breathless. By now, sweat is beading on the kitsune's forehead and on her chest, and the contractions are coming hard and fast, almost constantly as her nethers begin to bulge. "I know how this is supposed to happen," Kiyoko whimpers breathlessly, more to herself than anyone else. Tears well up in her eyes as nature takes its course, running down her cheeks. "I've seen it so many times. I've helped with it so many times. But... "But... "I'm still scared..." When it does happen, it happens all at once. As the petals of Kiyoko's womanly flower part to bear fruit, you first see the top of the kit's head, followed by her ears. Another tremendous push that leaves you barely enough time to get into position, and then you're holding a tiny mewling fox kit in your hands, still wet from birth fluids and with her eyes closed as she snuffles around. It's a girl! Kiyoko doesn't have the presence of mind to reply, instead concentrating on finishing up the job at hand. Another push of her womb, and the rest of the afterbirth emerges in a messy pile on the ground. That's going to be nasty to clean up later... for now, though, you remain at Kiyoko's side, cleaning off the worst of the fluids from your daughter with one of the towels hanging from the nearby wooden rails. That done, you swaddle the fox kit in a clean towel and wait for her mother to recover. "That was..." Kiyoko trembles a little and heaves a sigh of relief. "Mother said it'd get easier each time, that the first birth is always the hardest, but for a moment there I thought I was going to die. Only I can't, I think... which might be even worse." But she's fine now, and she's got a lovely daughter out of the whole ordeal. Look! The little fox kit appears mostly human like Kiyoko does, only with the large fox ears and fluffy tail... certainly takes after her mother, doesn't she? White fur instead of amber, though, but variety is the spice of life! "Your daughter, [pc.name]..." Kiyoko gives you a weak smile as she takes the fox kit from you. "I suppose I should get used to this; if you're going to knock me up every time you give me some of your energy, we're going to have a rather big family by the end of it all. I guess I'm fated to turn into my mother, one way or another... "She's so snuggly and smooth. I'll call her Kinu — where I come from, that means silk." There's a moment's silence as the newly-minted kitsune mother looks down at the baby in her arms. A dreamy smile wanders onto her face, and at last Kiyoko lets out a small, almost relieved giggle before bursting out into tearful laughter. "I'm amazing, aren't I? Praise me! Praise me!" She does make a good mother, it seems. |It's about as much as one would expect — while the actual delivery is as textbook as they come and it's not Kiyoko's first time at this, the effort of pushing the little kitsune kit out into the world is clearly taking its toll on her. Panting and groaning, Kiyoko braces herself against the wall as wave after wave of contractions accompany the rapid dilation of her cervix, her womb preparing itself to disgorge its full load. Sitting by Kiyoko's side, you pet her head and ears gently, make various noises of encouragement, and generally try to be as soothing an influence as possible on the whole birthing process. While she doesn't acknowledge your efforts, what with being completely focused on pushing a little fox kit out of her and all, at least Kiyoko doesn't seem as in much pain as the first time she did this. At the very least, there's none of the fear she had when Kinu was being born... Soon, the kitsune is retreading old ground, puffing and panting as the contractions increase in intensity and duration, sweat beading on her skin and dampening her fur. Further and further, the load swelling her belly slips downwards through her hips and towards the outside world, until — A quiet mewling yelping breaks the silence of the balcony, and Kiyoko heaves a massive sigh of relief as she collapses back into her fluffy nest of cushions and tails. There's still the afterbirth to deal with, but that's a joke compared to the large, healthy newborn kit in your arms. You deal with the mess while Kiyoko mumbles something in her mother tongue, then smiles weakly at you as you hand her the newborn fox kit. It's [a] [var0|boy|girl]! "You know," Kiyoko says after some thought, "This is getting easier each time it happens." Looks like it's still rough on her body, though. The kitsune pauses a moment to cuddle her kit and catch her breath. "Oh, it's not very quick, I'll grant that. But progress is being made. Trust me, it's a blessing if I'm going to have to keep doing this." And would she? If there was another way for you to feed her your chi, would she still go for this... most direct route of energy transferral? To your surprise, Kiyoko flushes slightly — maybe it's just her being tired from the ordeal she's just been through. "That's not really a proper question to be asking someone who's just given birth, you know." |With the subtle — and other not-so-subtle — ways in which Kiyoko's body has changed to accommodate her burgeoning maternal nature, the birth is relatively easy and straightforward. Despite the generally larger size of her kits at birth — more space needs to be made for those fluffy tails and ears, if nothing else — her widening hips, motherly curves and surprisingly steadfast constitution work together to ease the process as much as possible. With you at her side calming her nerves with generous application of ear scritches, Kiyoko's labor is exhausting as always, but not particularly painful. Her hands grip the cushions to the point her knuckles whiten, but it's more to steady herself than in pain; sweat still beads on her forehead and forms a sheen on her skin, but it's one of effort rather than desperation. Experienced at this by now, Kiyoko's womb takes yet another birthing in stride, ushering the squirming, squalling little one into the world with swift efficiency. "Don't worry, [pc.name]. I-I'm fine." As the contractions ebb and flow, you can Kiyoko's ripe and swollen baby belly squeeze and contract with a life of its own, powerful muscles pushing the full load within out through her cervix and down her birth canal. No matter how many times you watch this happen, it's still strangely hypnotic — the way her entire body works as a whole, dedicated to a single sole purpose. Gritting her teeth, bowing her head and exhaling sharply, Kiyoko makes the final burst of effort, and with an outpouring of birth fluids, a little kitsune kit slides out from between her legs and into your waiting hands. "Gyaaaah!" The afterbirth is quick to follow and quickly disposed of, the newborn wiped down, and Kiyoko leans against you for support, shuddering as she lets out a sigh of glorious relief. "It's easier now, I know," she mumbles, more to herself than anyone else. "But I don't think I'll ever get used to the effort. Maybe that's a good thing." You look down at the tiny kitsune kit in your arms and check the little floof over. It's [a] [var0|boy|girl], and as the infant begins to mewl, you pass [var0|him|her] along to [var0|his|her] mother to hold. |With Kiyoko having birthed enough children to form a sports team on their own, her body practically laughs at the idea of the process being remotely hard. The kitsune's milfy, curvaceous form is by now long a veteran at taking your seed and turning it into little fox kits, and the crowning moment of each pregnancy is just another moment to be savoured. It happens almost as soon as she puts her mind to it; bracing herself against her nest of pillows and tails, Kiyoko squeezes her eyes shut and exhales with effort. You can see the kitsune's heavily gravid belly drop as the kit inside nestles against her hips, her cervix rapidly dilating in a matter of minutes as the contractions begin in earnest. Coming hard and fast in a steady and powerful rhythm, the contractions send Kiyoko's swollen belly to pulsing and squeezing, the muscles of her womb rippling with experienced power as the unborn kit slips further and further along her birth canal. The actual delivery is smooth and easy — Kiyoko breathes deeply, focusing her will, and you ready a towel as her pussy bulges and parts to admit your child headfirst into the world, mewling and wet with birth fluids. It's [a] [var0|boy|girl]! Kiyoko smiles thinly, then grimaces as her body deals with the afterbirth, creating a bit of a mess on the futon. Still, it's nothing new to both of you by now, and you have the worst of it cleaned up before long. "I thought I'd eventually get tired of hearing those words, but that still has yet to happen. Guess I'm wrong." Oh, does she want you to put another kit in her? She could always use more energy, after all. Kiyoko gives you a weak grin. "Definitely. Not here and now, though. Here, let me hold [var0|him|her] for a while." You nod, and pass the newborn kit to Kiyoko, who cradles [var0|him|her] in her arms. "No matter how many times I do this, I still feel so warm and good inside when it's all over." |As the first contractions take hold of Kiyoko's body, she squeezes her eyes shut and bites her lip, visibly trembling from head to toe. A deep crimson blush begins to spread across her face, and it's after a particularly powerful contraction that sends her monstrously swollen belly visibly squeezing down on itself that she throws her head back and cries out. Not in pain, as one would expect from a mother in labor, but in pure, orgiastic pleasure. Another contraction, another cry of lewd arousal; forever changed by the obscene number of pregnancies she's gone through, your kitsune slut-wife's body has become so absurdly maternal that she's actually deriving pleasure from the birthing process. Sweat beads on Kiyoko's forehead and breasts as she feels her cervix dilating, the kit within her dropping lower and lower into her hips with each push from her powerful womb. rows.original: Stepping up to the door, you knock on it and wait for Kiyoko to arrive. Nothing. After a minute or two, you knock again and settle back — maybe she didn't hear you the first time, or was preoccupied doing something else, or... Still nothing. That's odd. Surely she hasn't escaped the Astral Plane after just one essence transferral, has she? Sure, you're pretty strong, but you didn't think your mojo was that powerful, right? Right? Still, there's only one thing left to do here: reaching out, you try the door's handle and it turns. Unlocked — well, it would make sense for it to be. Who would break into Kiyoko's home when she's trapped all alone in this pocket dimension? Nevertheless, you cautiously make your way down along the corridor, ears strained for any hint of sound — and before too long, a scratching noise makes its way through the cabin's woodwork and to you. It's coming from upstairs, you think, and following your ears, you climb up to the cabin's second level. It feels a little awkward coming up here without permission, but you push aside a couple of shoji screens to find Kiyoko sprawled out on the ground in one of the rooms.

rows.original: She's not hurt or harmed, it seems, and judging by the futon she's snuggled in, has made herself very comfortable. Nope, not knocked out, just... sleeping, even if it's a very deep sleep. What strikes you about this particular room, though, is how verdant it is. One of the walls is just a low railing, rendering the room open to the air on one side — perhaps it'd be better called a balcony? Small potted plants, including a variety of herbs and miniature trees, sit in the open; a faint aroma wafts through the air, mingling with the scent of cherry blossoms. What's most important, though, is how the time of day rapidly changes from day to night as you step in through the doorway, sunlight rapidly fading away to be replaced by wan, silvery moonlight — without a moon in the sky at all. Stepping up to Kiyoko, you kneel down beside her and tickle one of the kitsune's large, fluffy ears. She snorts and snuffles, turning on her side; you keep up the stimulation, taking pleasure in petting her perky ears until her steady breathing turns into a small sigh and her eyes flutter open. "Ah... [pc.name]." Yes, it's you. Have you come at a bad time? Kiyoko squeezes her eyes shut and stretches under the duvet, sitting up on the futon and rolling her shoulders with a small sigh of effort. She's wearing silken sleepwear, a much simpler — and skimpier — version of her usual dress, and shakes out the worst of her bed-head as she regards you. "No... I should be up now anyway. I've been rather... um, tired of late, and I thought to get a quick nap in before proceeding with my daily duties. This room isn't exactly a bedroom, it's where I go as and when I need to recuperate. To be honest, I was wondering when you'd show up; there was a matter I was hoping to discuss with you." Oh? What is it? Does it happen to be related to how you finished off your last visit? Kiyoko looks amused for a second or two, then that expression collapses into a sheepish one, rubbing her eyes free of sleep. "It is. Umm..." Now why's she so hesitant? Did everything not work out as she'd foreseen? "No, no, it's not a matter of what didn't happen. It's more a matter of what happened in addition to what I predicted would." Fine, time to stop beating around the bush, then. Just what is the problem? "I think it's better if you saw for yourself." Pushing her covers off, Kiyoko struggles to her feet and pulls her soft sleepwear tight against her body. It's not immediately apparent — you don't see it until you take a second look, but it's there nevertheless. Framed against her delicate form, Kiyoko's tummy is bulging outwards ever so slightly, roughly comparable to a human woman three months along. There's no doubt about it — Kiyoko is going to be a mommy, and by extension, you a [pc.mf|daddy|mommy]. "You see it, don't you?" Yes, you do. Yes, you do. The kitsune looks a little uncertain. "I... I really wasn't expecting this to happen." Not to be an ass, but seriously, what did she imagine would happen? She coaxed you into shooting off a huge load straight into her baby bag; ending up with a little fox kit inside her... well, that's kind of the point, isn't it? It's not as if she's unacquainted with such things as a kitsune, so she knows perfectly well where little fox babies come from. "That is true, but..." Flustered, Kiyoko points at herself with both hands. "This is the Astral Plane! My physicality, was ripped from me — I don't have a body, let alone a womb to be pregnant with! And besides, when we were doing the chi transferral, the sex was just a metaphor for what was happening; you weren't really sticking it into me the same way you would someone on the outside!" Well, if having mind-blowing sex here is only a metaphor for transferring a portion of your essence to her, then growing a little kitsune kit in her tummy is probably a metaphor for something else, too. You'll be damned if you know what, but you can only presume it's rather significant. Taking a deep breath, Kiyoko clenches her fists, squares her shoulders and calms herself. "I... I don't think it's harmful, or at least all the evaluations I've run on myself suggest so. Even so, this isn't normal. I know time doesn't flow in the Astral Plane at the same rate as it does on the outside world, since this is just your second visit after you knocked me up. Even so, it's barely been a week here on the inside, and I'm already beginning to show." The transferral still went off without a hitch at least, right? Kiyoko nods. "I did receive your chi, it's just that I'm nurturing it in a rather different way than I thought I'd be doing, which is making me so tired. It's why I came up here to have a nap in a calming atmosphere and recuperate. "While I don't think that'll be any obstacle towards our goal of me eventually being able to manifest outside of the plane, but it's just rather startling, with me getting so big so fast. Or really, is it perfectly normal for me, since this isn't exactly a physical body I have here? I should really keep notes." There, she's beginning to view this in a more positive light. It can't be so bad, can it? "It's not as if I can't care for a fox kit or two; my mother was a regular participant in the breeding orgies and I got in plenty of practice caring for my many siblings when I was younger. But there's a difference between seeing your mother do it, and doing it yourself, you know?" Yes, indeed. Having said her piece, Kiyoko hesitates for a moment, then sighs and smiles weakly. "You seem to be taking all of this very well." Of course, because it's no cause for concern. Nothing truly untoward has happened yet, right? Returning Kiyoko's smile with one of your own, you close the distance between you two and draw the kitsune into a big hug. Kiyoko practically melts into your embrace, wrapping her arms about you, then makes a happy little noise in the back of her throat as she finally pulls away. "You're right. I should try and feel better about all this — at the very least, having a little kit running around the place should stop me from feeling lonely when you're not around, [pc.name]. Up until recently, I was so upset over being stuck here all by myself, and now I'm complaining that there'll be more people around. It's rather silly, isn't it?" You have no answer for that, save to draw in close and wrap an arm around Kiyoko. She stiffens instinctively, but soon relaxes against you with a quiet whimper, ears curling forward. She stays like that for a few seconds, then starts sniffling. "...My stomach's only going to get bigger from here on out..." It is. "...I make a fine pregnant woman, don't I?" Kiyoko looks down at the ground and laughs nervously. "Look at me... even at this point, I can still make light of myself..." That's one of the things you love her for. Those words seem to cheer Kiyoko up a little, her large ears perking up at your words and touch alike. "At least I know exactly how I got to be this way... it's not as if I did anything sinful." Well, that seems to wrap things up. The only remaining concern you might have is whether this place is a proper one to be raising children in. "It's... adequate. The Astral Plane is like a dream, really; it doesn't have a border, it doesn't stop short at a point. The forest just goes on forever, as far as my previous explorations have taken me. The kits will need to get along with others, but I have the feeling that this won't be the last kit you'll be putting in me." She rests her hands on her small baby bump for emphasis. "And besides... you'll be bringing the orb back to Keros so he can get us all out of here, yes?" That's the plan, yes. "Then there's nothing else to be overly worried about. If anything happens, I'll let you know." She looks around, then down at her sleepwear. "I should probably go and get changed. Why don't you wait for me downstairs?" Oh? Why doesn't she wear this downstairs instead? It's a lot more flattering. "Because it's sleepwear, and one doesn't put on sleepwear in daily life," she replies, sticking her tongue out at you. "Now if you don't mind, I'll go and get changed." Kiyoko is good to her word. Fifteen minutes later, she's down in the sitting room with you, clad in her usual white yukata — although you realize that the cloth has been loosened to accommodate her pregnancy. "Now," she begins as she brings the tea set to the table and begins brewing, "shall we begin?"

气只是，我培养它的方法与原本想象中的有所不同，这让我感到非常疲惫。因此，我来到这里，想要在这样一个宁静的环境中小睡一会儿，好好恢复一下精力。 虽然我认为这并不会妨碍我最终能够在现实世界中显现的目标，但我的身体增长得如此迅速，确实让人感到有些惊讶。或者说，对于我来说，这其实是很正常的现象吧？毕竟我现在拥有的这个身体并不是真正的物理实体……我真应该把这一切记录下来。 rows.raw: " She's not hurt or harmed, it seems, and judging by the futon she's snuggled in, has made herself very comfortable. Nope, not knocked out, just... sleeping, even if it's a very deep sleep. What strikes you about this particular room, though, is how verdant it is. One of the walls is just a low railing, rendering the room open to the air on one side — perhaps it'd be better called a balcony? Small potted plants, including a variety of herbs and miniature trees, sit in the open; a faint aroma wafts through the air, mingling with the scent of cherry blossoms. What's most important, though, is how the time of day rapidly changes from day to night as you step in through the doorway, sunlight rapidly fading away to be replaced by wan, silvery moonlight — without a moon in the sky at all. Stepping up to Kiyoko, you kneel down beside her and tickle one of the kitsune's large, fluffy ears. She snorts and snuffles, turning on her side; you keep up the stimulation, taking pleasure in petting her perky ears until her steady breathing turns into a small sigh and her eyes flutter open. "Ah... [pc.name]." Yes, it's you. Have you come at a bad time? Kiyoko squeezes her eyes shut and stretches under the duvet, sitting up on the futon and rolling her shoulders with a small sigh of effort. She's wearing silken sleepwear, a much simpler — and skimpier — version of her usual dress, and shakes out the worst of her bed-head as she regards you. "No... I should be up now anyway. I've been rather... um, tired of late, and I thought to get a quick nap in before proceeding with my daily duties. This room isn't exactly a bedroom, it's where I go as and when I need to recuperate. To be honest, I was wondering when you'd show up; there was a matter I was hoping to discuss with you." Oh? What is it? Does it happen to be related to how you finished off your last visit? Kiyoko looks amused for a second or two, then that expression collapses into a sheepish one, rubbing her eyes free of sleep. "It is. Umm..." Now why's she so hesitant? Did everything not work out as she'd foreseen? "No, no, it's not a matter of what didn't happen. It's more a matter of what happened in addition to what I predicted would." Fine, time to stop beating around the bush, then. Just what is the problem? "I think it's better if you saw for yourself." Pushing her covers off, Kiyoko struggles to her feet and pulls her soft sleepwear tight against her body. It's not immediately apparent — you don't see it until you take a second look, but it's there nevertheless. Framed against her delicate form, Kiyoko's tummy is bulging outwards ever so slightly, roughly comparable to a human woman three months along. There's no doubt about it — Kiyoko is going to be a mommy, and by extension, you a [pc.mf|daddy|mommy]. "You see it, don't you?" Yes, you do. Yes, you do. The kitsune looks a little uncertain. "I... I really wasn't expecting this to happen." Not to be an ass, but seriously, what did she imagine would happen? She coaxed you into shooting off a huge load straight into her baby bag; ending up with a little fox kit inside her... well, that's kind of the point, isn't it? It's not as if she's unacquainted with such things as a kitsune, so she knows perfectly well where little fox babies come from. "That is true, but..." Flustered, Kiyoko points at herself with both hands. "This is the Astral Plane! My physicality, was ripped from me — I don't have a body, let alone a womb to be pregnant with! And besides, when we were doing the chi transferral, the sex was just a metaphor for what was happening; you weren't really sticking it into me the same way you would someone on the outside!" Well, if having mind-blowing sex here is only a metaphor for transferring a portion of your essence to her, then growing a little kitsune kit in her tummy is probably a metaphor for something else, too. You'll be damned if you know what, but you can only presume it's rather significant. Taking a deep breath, Kiyoko clenches her fists, squares her shoulders and calms herself. "I... I don't think it's harmful, or at least all the evaluations I've run on myself suggest so. Even so, this isn't normal. I know time doesn't flow in the Astral Plane at the same rate as it does on the outside world, since this is just your second visit after you knocked me up. Even so, it's barely been a week here on the inside, and I'm already beginning to show." The transferral still went off without a hitch at least, right? Kiyoko nods. "I did receive your chi, it's just that I'm nurturing it in a rather different way than I thought I'd be doing, which is making me so tired. It's why I came up here to have a nap in a calming atmosphere and recuperate. "While I don't think that'll be any obstacle towards our goal of me eventually being able to manifest outside of the plane, but it's just rather startling, with me getting so big so fast. Or really, is it perfectly normal for me, since this isn't exactly a physical body I have here? I should really keep notes." There, she's beginning to view this in a more positive light. It can't be so bad, can it? "It's not as if I can't care for a fox kit or two; my mother was a regular participant in the breeding orgies and I got in plenty of practice caring for my many siblings when I was younger. But there's a difference between seeing your mother do it, and doing it yourself, you know?" Yes, indeed. Having said her piece, Kiyoko hesitates for a moment, then sighs and smiles weakly. "You seem to be taking all of this very well." Of course, because it's no cause for concern. Nothing truly untoward has happened yet, right? Returning Kiyoko's smile with one of your own, you close the distance between you two and draw the kitsune into a big hug. Kiyoko practically melts into your embrace, wrapping her arms about you, then makes a happy little noise in the back of her throat as she finally pulls away. "You're right. I should try and feel better about all this — at the very least, having a little kit running around the place should stop me from feeling lonely when you're not around, [pc.name]. Up until recently, I was so upset over being stuck here all by myself, and now I'm complaining that there'll be more people around. It's rather silly, isn't it?" You have no answer for that, save to draw in close and wrap an arm around Kiyoko. She stiffens instinctively, but soon relaxes against you with a quiet whimper, ears curling forward. She stays like that for a few seconds, then starts sniffling. "...My stomach's only going to get bigger from here on out..." It is. "...I make a fine pregnant woman, don't I?" Kiyoko looks down at the ground and laughs nervously. "Look at me... even at this point, I can still make light of myself..." That's one of the things you love her for. Those words seem to cheer Kiyoko up a little, her large ears perking up at your words and touch alike. "At least I know exactly how I got to be this way... it's not as if I did anything sinful." Well, that seems to wrap things up. The only remaining concern you might have is whether this place is a proper one to be raising children in. "It's... adequate. The Astral Plane is like a dream, really; it doesn't have a border, it doesn't stop short at a point. The forest just goes on forever, as far as my previous explorations have taken me. The kits will need to get along with others, but I have the feeling that this won't be the last kit you'll be putting in me." She rests her hands on her small baby bump for emphasis. "And besides... you'll be bringing the orb back to Keros so he can get us all out of here, yes?" That's the plan, yes. "Then there's nothing else to be overly worried about. If anything happens, I'll let you know." She looks around, then down at her sleepwear. "I should probably go and get changed. Why don't you wait for me downstairs?" Oh? Why doesn't she wear this downstairs instead? It's a lot more flattering. "Because it's sleepwear, and one doesn't put on sleepwear in daily life," she replies, sticking her tongue out at you. "Now if you don't mind, I'll go and get changed." Kiyoko is good to her word. Fifteen minutes later, she's down in the sitting room with you, clad in her usual white yukata — although you realize that the cloth has been loosened to accommodate her pregnancy. "Now," she begins as she brings the tea set to the table and begins brewing, "shall we begin?""

rows.original: "Well, there's a little ritual I'd like to introduce you to," Kiyoko says, a twinkle in her eye. "If you wouldn't mind?" A ritual, eh? Oh, you know she's up to something when she's got that mischievous air about her. Guess you don't mind playing along; you know that your foxy friend here would never mean you any actual harm. "Right. Follow me, please." [kiyoko.numKits 1||[pc.isChamp|You hesitate for a moment, turning back to the dirty dishes under the parasol table. She can't just leave them here, right? Then again, you're also smart enough to not break the mood — dirty dishes can be taken care of anytime, but new years' eve only comes once a year. Kiyoko's already started off at a brisk pace, and you have to jog a little to catch up with her before she starts wondering just where you've gone. ] ] The two of you eventually come to the forest's edge, a little way past the fence that marks the end of the peach orchard. You'd never noticed it before — and unsurprisingly so, considering how well hidden it is — but there's a little gazebo-like structure planted squarely on the border between civilization and wilderness. Hanging from rust-flecked chains are a huge bell and a clapper the size and length of a tree trunk; the bell itself is huge, ancient, and covered with all sorts of carvings and patches of greenish patina. "It's one of the first things I ordered the Astral Plane to fashion after I came here, a small piece of the home I lived in as a girl a long time ago. I have no way of being sure, of course, but... I'd like to think it's a pretty faithful replica." You look bell and clapper alike and give the former a rap with your knuckles. Solid bronze, indeed. So, you take it that you're supposed to ring the bell? Kiyoko nods and smiles. "A hundred and eight times, to be precise. One for each of the proscribed mental states which Lord Keros warns leads to unwholesome actions." Unwholesome actions... that's one way of putting it. A hundred and eight times... that's quite a few. [pc.toughnessRange 70|Not that you aren't going to welcome the challenge — if nothing else, it'll be a good exercise in pacing yourself.] "I'll help you, of course. No one said you were doing this alone." [pc.toughnessRange 70 |While you don't think you need the help, this'll be a lot more meaningful with two people instead of one. |Ah, right. It'll be a lot easier with two people instead of one. ] Did she use to do this a lot in the past? "During my captivity? Not so much; there wasn't a reason to observe the new year when time simply blended into a blur, one day flowing into the next like the one that came before it. Before that, though, when I was a girl in the old country... haha, three or four of us would be clamouring to have a go at the clapper under my mother's watchful eye." Sniffling a little, Kiyoko wipes a stray tear from her cheek. "It was a small wonder we ever managed to finish ringing it before the sun came up." ... "Come, now. Shall we get started?" Of course. Stepping over to the large wooden clapper, you take it under an arm and test its weight. This sure is some solid wood, and the chains, though flecked with rust, look sturdy enough. Kiyoko steps back and observes you closely as you take a deep breath to steel yourself, draw back the clapper, and send it crashing into the large bronze bell with all your might. Bong... The sound rings out through the air and out to the forest, loud and clear despite the bell's age. It resonates in your bones, bounces about in your head, and eventually leaves you, but not without leaving you feeling thoroughly rattled — but oddly enough, in a good way. By the time the last echo finally fades, you're tingling from head to toe as if you'd just been zapped with a burst of static. A small smattering of applause. "Not bad, [pc.name]. One hundred and seven more times to go, then." Phew... It's hard at first, especially when you need to stop and recover from the tremendous, clarion ringing each time, but eventually both your muscles and skull get used to it and it's not so bad by the twentieth or so strike of the bell. [pc.toughnessRange 70 |While you don't feel that out of sorts, Kiyoko insists that she take over the job after the forty-second strike and let you rest for a bit before coming back to it. The set of her face and her folded arms strongly suggest that she's not taking no for an answer. |By the forty-second strike, you're starting to feel it in your joints, and Kiyoko offers to take over for a while and let you rest a bit. It's a small mercy you eagerly accept, and you let her have it all to herself while you shake out your shoulders and waist. ] There's a nice mossy beam to one side where you can get a good view of the proceedings, and it's this you lean against while watching Kiyoko go at it. Despite being small and slight, your foxy [kiyoko.numKits 1|lover|friend]'s clearly no stranger to this; where she lacks in strength, she makes up for in technique, moving her body with the natural flow of the clapper as she strikes the bell over and over again. Kiyoko's natural wiggliness and flexibility as a kitsune comes in handy as she leverages her body weight into the equation. "Sixty-three, sixty-four, sixty-five. Phew. It's your turn once more, [pc.name]." Oh, already? She looked like she was having so much fun there. "Oh, I was, no doubt about that. However, as you're the guest tonight, it's important for you to get the best experience you can out of the ceremonies." Ha, since she put it so nicely, you guess you don't have a choice... [kiyoko.numKits 1|Just as you're about to get up and reclaim your old spot, though, you spy a small figure cresting the hilltop in the moonlight. It's not hard to recognize your firstborn daughter at a distance, not when her silvery-white hair and fur glimmer like that when the moonbeams strike them. Coming to a stop just before the gazebo, Kinu announces her presence by way of coughing gently, and gives both Kiyoko and you a small bow. Now, what is she doing here? "Ehe... well, [pc.PapaMama], Mama, I put away the dirty dishes from the new years' soba like you wanted, then I [kiyoko.numKits 2|set everyone else to sleep|made my nightly prayers] like I was supposed to. I'm not sleepy, though, so..." "...So you want to stay up all night with us and watch the sunrise?" Kinu contrives to look adorably sheepish. "That, and I wanna help bang the big bell, too. I'm old enough this year!" You look between the bell clapper, practically the size of a tree trunk, then back at Kinu. Is she sure about that? "Of course I wouldn't be doing it alone, [pc.PapaMama]. With both Mama and you around, it wouldn't be any more dangerous than handling my practice naginata." Kiyoko taps her chin. "Hmm. What do you say, love?" Well, it's only once a year, so if she's grown-up enough to not doze off she's more than welcome to join you. There're only about forty more strikes of the bell to go, and you get the feeling that things would be a lot more fun if you did this as a family. So long as you watch Kinu carefully to ensure that no accidents happen, it should be all right. So it comes to pass that the three of you arrange yourselves about the clapper as a family, with you in front, Kiyoko behind, and Kinu sandwiched between you two. Once more, you draw back the clapper by its chains and strike the bell with all your might. Bong... Kinu squeals, the sound equal parts fear and exhilaration, but your kitsune daughter keeps a tight hold on the clapper itself with her little hands. Bong... Kiyoko sure is putting her back into it, too[kiyoko.pregStage 2|, despite how obviously pregnant she is]. You don't often see her openly sweat, but there it is, beads forming on her soft skin despite the cool night air. Judging by the smile on her face, she's enjoying herself... but who wouldn't, surrounded by family like this? How many years have passed by without her seeing anyone? Bong. Has it been a hundred and eight tolls of the bell already? It doesn't feel like it — [pc.toughnessRange 70|you're still plenty energetic as it is|all that activity was far less tiring than you thought it would be]. But neither your foxy wife nor your fluffy daughter are revving up the clapper for another strike, so it must be over. You wipe the sweat from your brow, take a few deep breaths, and contemplate the matter in silence. Sure, it was a lot of hard work, and this isn't part of your own culture... but by being here with Kiyoko and Kinu, there's no doubt it's been worth your while. Kinu squirms up against you and tugs at your [pc.armor]. "Look, [pc.PapaMama], look! We made it just in time for the first sunrise of the new year!" She's not wrong. From where you stand, you can see a dull orange glow cresting the treetops, slowly pushing away the inky darkness of the starry night sky. As you watch, transfixed, Kiyoko comes up to your side and melts against your shoulder, draping herself on you with a smile. "Happy new year, [pc.name]. May it be a successful and prosperous one for you." The same for her — and of course, Kinu as well. You reach down and find the spot on Kinu's brow where she likes to be petted, then plant the heel of your palm squarely on it while chasing her ears with your fingers. |"It's just the last stretch; I have perfect confidence in your ability to finish up all one hundred and eight strikes." Well, instead of you taking over wholesale, why don't the two of you ring the bell together? It'd be more fun that way. "Hmm?" So long as it's not dangerous, why not? It's just the last stretch, isn't it? You came here to spend time with your foxy friend here, after all; this'll be better than just staring at each other taking turns at the clapper, right? Kiyoko makes a show of considering the prospect, planting a finger on her chin as she pretends to think deeply. Then, with a small smile, "I guess it can't hurt." So it comes to pass that the both of you return to the bell once more with you taking the front while Kiyoko backs you up from the rear. Affirming your grip on the heavy wooden clapper, the both of you draw it back on its chains and thrust forward to strike the bell cleanly. Bong... The sound is brilliant, far stronger than either of you could possibly have managed on your own; leaves rustle and the air itself shimmers as it travels outward into the night. Your teeth chatter and bones rattle, but the powerful reverberation soon passes, leaving a sense of clarity in the fore of your mind despite your body's protestations. "Again?" Of course. Again. Bong... With two people instead of one, you're far better able to pace yourselves, wood striking bronze at a steady pace to herald the arrival of the new year. The thump the clapper makes against your shoulder as it hits the bell is powerful yet calming, its sense of power lending a solemn air to the proceedings. Kiyoko sure is putting her back into it, too[kiyoko.pregStage 2|, despite how obviously pregnant she is]. You don't often see her openly sweat, but there it is, beads forming on her soft skin despite the cool night air. Judging by the smile on her face, she's enjoying herself... but of course. How many years have passed by without her seeing anyone? Bong... The last strike rings true with a distinctive note of finality, shaking you to the core. At this point, you can't even feel very much of yourself, let alone feel how tired you ought to be; all you're experiencing right now is a strong sense of self-satisfaction as you finally let go of the clapper and let your foxy friend fall into your embrace. Yes, that was much more fun than just going it alone. "Look, [pc.name]," Kiyoko mumbles in your arms. "We finished just in time for the new year, and not a moment too soon." She's right. Making a half-turn and looking over Kiyoko's shoulder, you spy a dull amber glow coming up upon the horizon, cresting the treetops as warmth begins to pour out over this little pocket dimension. Your foxy friend is warm and fluffy against you, and she's not that different a color as the sunrise... ... Ha. Happy new year. "Happy new year to you too, [pc.name]." ] Yep, it's been only a few minutes into the new year, and things are looking up already. "As much as I'd like you to stay longer, I suppose that's not possible, is it? After all, you still have much to do out there." Is she chasing you off? Because it sounds like she's chasing you off. "No, no. Just reminding you not to get too caught up in the moment. I had fun today, [pc.name]... but there's also a whole world out there which requires your attention. I wouldn't want to monopolize your time, after all, and there're other people you need to spend this day with, aren't there?" Well... "Don't argue now. Off you go." Before you can protest, Kiyoko leans in and smooches you lightly on the lips, just the briefest of pecks. "Come visit again soon, okay?" [kiyoko.numKits 1|"Eeee! Come visit again!" You sigh and pet Kinu's ears again. With such a precocious daughter, how could you not? ]
rows.translation: 嗯，有一个小仪式，我想向你们介绍一下。 清子说道，她的眼中闪烁着光芒。 如果你不介意的话…… 一种仪式，是吧？哦，当你看到她那调皮的神情时，你就知道她肯定在策划什么。看来你也不介意陪她一起玩这个游戏吧？你知道，你这位狡黠的朋友绝对不会对你造成任何真正的伤害。 好的，请跟我来。 [kiyoko.numKits 1||[pc.isChamp|你犹豫了片刻，然后转身看向遮阳桌下那些脏盘子。她总不能就把它们留在这里吧？不过，你也很聪明，不会破坏这种氛围——脏盘子随时都可以处理，但新年前夜可是一年只有一次。清子已经开始忙碌起来了，你得加快速度才能赶上她，否则她就会开始怀疑你到底去哪儿了。 ] ] 你们俩最终来到了森林的边缘，那里距离标志着桃园尽头的围栏还有那么一点距离。你之前从未注意到这个地方——考虑到它隐藏得如此之好，这也并不奇怪——但在文明与荒野的交界处，确实有一个看起来像凉亭的小建筑。 那些布满锈迹的链条上悬挂着一口巨大的铃铛和一块形状与长度都如同树干般的拍板；这口铃铛本身体积庞大、历史悠久，上面刻满了各种图案，还覆盖着一层绿色的铜锈。 这是我来到这里后最早要求‘星界之舟’制作的东西之一，它是我很久以前少女时代居住过的家的一个小部分。当然，我无法确定，但是……我希望这能是一个相当逼真的复制品。 你们俩长得一模一样，你用指关节轻轻敲了敲那个铃铛。确实是纯青铜制成的。那么，你是觉得应该去敲这个铃铛吗？ 清子点了点头，微笑着回答。 确切地说是一百零八次。每次都是针对克罗斯大人所警告的那些会导致不良行为的心理状态。 不健康的行为……这么说吧。一百零八次……这个数字确实相当大了。 [pc.toughnessRange 70|其实你并不会拒绝这个挑战——至少，这会是一个锻炼自己控制节奏的好机会。] 我当然会帮你。没人说过你必须独自完成这件事。 [pc.toughnessRange 70 |虽然你可能觉得不需要别人的帮助，但两个人一起做这件事，效果肯定会比一个人好得多。 |啊，对。两个人一起做的话，肯定会比一个人容易很多。 ] 她以前经常这样做吗？ 在我被囚禁的那段时间里？倒不是这样；当时时间本身就已经变得模糊不清，一天与另一天毫无区别地流逝着，所以并没有理由去庆祝新年。不过在那之前，当我还是那个旧国的小女孩的时候……哈哈，会有三四个小伙伴在母亲的注视下争着去玩那个拍手部游戏。 基约科轻轻抽泣着，用纸巾擦去了脸颊上那颗滑落的泪珠。 能在太阳升起之前完成敲击工作，已经算是小小的奇迹了。 ... 来吧，现在就开始吧。 当然可以。你走到那块巨大的木制拍子旁，把它夹在胳膊下，试了试它的重量。这确实是块质地非常结实的木头，那些链条虽然有些生锈，但看起来依然十分坚固。清子站在一旁，密切观察着你。你深吸一口气，鼓起勇气，然后将拍子用力甩向那面巨大的青铜钟。 砰…… 这个声音在空气中回荡，传遍了整片森林，尽管这口钟已经很古老了，但它发出的声音依然清晰响亮。这种声音在你的骨子里震动，在你的脑海中回荡，最终才会消失，但在此之前，它一定会让你感到一阵紧张——不过奇怪的是，这种紧张感却是令人愉悦的。当最后的回声终于消失时，你会感到从头到脚都在发麻，就好像刚刚被一阵静电击中了一样。 一阵轻微的掌声响起。 不错， [pc.name]那么，还剩下107次了。 呼…… 一开始确实很困难，尤其是每次当那震耳欲聋的铃声响起时，你都需要停下来休息一会儿，但渐渐地，你的肌肉和头部都会适应这种震动，到了敲钟二十次左右的时候，这种感觉就已经不会那么难受了。 [pc.toughnessRange 70 |虽然你并不觉得有什么不妥，但清子坚持要在第42次攻击之后由她来接手这项工作，让你先休息一会儿再继续。她那副表情以及双臂交叉的姿势，清楚地表明她不会接受拒绝。 |到了第四十二次攻击时，你的关节已经开始感到疼痛了。这时，清子主动提出暂时接手攻击，让你休息一会儿。你欣然接受了这个帮助，让她独自继续攻击，而你则活动活动肩膀和腰部，缓解疼痛。 ] 有一侧长满了苔藓，你可以靠在那里很好地观看整个过程。而当你观看清子进行比赛时，也正是靠在这个地方。 尽管你身材娇小、体重轻盈，但你的动作却充满活力与敏捷性 [kiyoko.numKits 1|恋人|朋友]她显然对这种技巧并不陌生；在力量上有所欠缺，她就依靠技巧来弥补，随着鼓槌的自然节奏不断敲击钟铛，她的身体也随之灵活地移动。作为一只狐妖，清子的天生的柔韧性与灵活性在这里发挥了重要作用，她巧妙地利用了自己的体重来增强敲击的力量。 六十三、六十四、六十五。呼，又到你的回合了 [pc.name]." 哦，已经结束了？她看起来在那里玩得非常开心啊。 哦，我确实是这么想的。不过，既然你是今晚的嘉宾，那么让你能够充分体验这些仪式带来的乐趣就显得非常重要了。 哈，既然她说得这么委婉，那你想想，你也没别的选择了…… [kiyoko.numKits 1|就在你准备起身回到原来的位置时，你突然看到一个小小的身影在月光下出现在山顶上。从远处看，你的长女很容易被认出来——当月光照射在她银白色的头发和皮毛上时，它们会闪烁着光芒。绮奴在凉亭前停了下来，轻轻咳嗽了一声，以此来表明自己的存在，然后向清子和你微微鞠了一躬。 那么，她来这里究竟是为了什么呢？ 呃……好吧， [pc.PapaMama]妈妈，我按照你的要求把新年吃剩的寿司剩菜都收好了，然后我就 [kiyoko.numKits 2|让其他人都睡着了|做了晚祷] 好像我本来就应该这样做的。不过，我现在并不觉得困，所以…… ……所以你想和我们一起熬通宵，一起看日出吗？ 纪久努力装出一副可爱又害羞的样子。 还有，我也想帮忙敲响那面大钟。今年我已经够大了！ 你将目光转向那个几乎有树干那么大的钟槌，然后又看向绮奴。她真的确定吗？ 我当然不会这么做。 独自一人, [pc.PapaMama]有妈妈你在身边，这根本不会比使用我的练习用薙刀更危险吧。 清子托着下巴思考着。 嗯，你怎么看，亲爱的？ 嗯，这种活动一年只有一次，所以如果她已经足够成熟，不会在活动中打瞌睡的话，她完全可以一起来参加。距离铃声响起只剩下大约四十次了，你会觉得，如果全家一起参与的话，这个活动一定会更加有趣。 只要你仔细照看绮奴，确保不会发生任何意外，那就应该不会有问题了。 于是，你们三个人就围着那个拍手部器，像一家人一样站好了位置：你站在前面，清子站在后面，而绮奴则被你们两个人夹在中间。 你再次通过链条拉动钟槌，然后用尽全力敲击钟铃。 砰…… 绮奴发出了既充满恐惧又充满兴奋的叫声，但你的九尾狐女儿却用她的小手部紧紧抓住了那个拍手部器。 砰…… 清子确实也在全力以赴呢。[kiyoko.pregStage 纪久在你身边扭来扭去，还不停地拉扯你的衣服 [pc.armor]. 看， [pc.PapaMama]看！我们刚好在新年的第一个日出之前完成了它！ 她并没有错。从你的位置望去，可以看到一道暗橙色的光芒正在树梢上缓缓升起，逐渐驱散星光灿烂的夜空中的黑暗。当你凝神注视着这一幕时，清子走到了你身边，依偎在你的肩头，微笑着靠在你身上。 新年快乐， [pc.name]愿你的生活充满成功与繁荣。
