|尽管与女儿一起生活的日子里有欢乐，也有艰辛，但我一点也不后悔经历过这一切。因为这些经历让我的人生变得更加充实。 ]" 真是太可爱了。你轻拍着清子的头，感受到她身体散发出的温暖，然后叹了口气。快点，趁食物还没凉掉，赶紧吃吧。[kiyoko.numKits 2| 看，连孩子们都已经开始吃饭了。等会儿再聊吧。] 是的，你说得对。谢谢你提供的食物。 哈，多亏了绮奴准备的食物，真的非常美味。不仅仅是食物本身，还能和你那位美丽的狐妖妻子以及你们一起组建的家庭一起分享这些美食，更是让人感到幸福。考虑到绮奴付出了这么多努力，要是自己没有为这个场合准备任何东西，肯定会感到有些内疚的。 当然，如果没有别人告诉你，你根本无从知道今天是哪一天，但即便如此…… 清子吃完了最后一块饭团，然后凑过身来低声说道，嘴角还不禁露出一丝笑意。 我想，如果你真的愿意的话，应该能为我做些什么吧…… 哦？ [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |是的。 她的嘴角上扬，露出了充满童趣的笑容——至少，这样理解最为恰当。 今年也许会很快过去，但明年母亲节还是会到来的，对吧？如果你能向我保证，明年的庆祝活动会比今年更加精彩……那我就会满足了。 |嗯。 清子的笑容变得更加灿烂，带着一丝顽皮的神情，她向后靠在椅子上，将那圆鼓鼓的孕妇肚子尽量往外凸出。 我们的新套装很快就会问世了……不过之后，谁又能保证不能再给我准备一套呢？明年母亲节又会到来……或许我们应该把庆祝活动办得比今年更加盛大一些？这也是一个值得努力的目标啊…… |哦，当然。 她的笑容愈发灿烂，身体不断蹭向你，那姿态简直像只狡黠的狐妖。 你或许可以告诉我，我究竟是怎么陷入这种境地的。如果你愿意的话，就把这当作一份母亲节的礼物吧。当然，现在还不行……不过下次你来的时候，我们总有时间单独聊聊。我希望能再次看到你平坦圆润的腹部；你知道的，明年又会是母亲节。为什么不让这次变得更加特别一些呢？ ] 现在安静一会儿。以后还有时间去满足这些愿望的。 嘿嘿。 你们俩慢慢地吃完了饭。当所有的食物都被吃完后，清子优雅地擦了擦嘴，然后叹了口气，显得非常满足。 真的有那么好吃吗？ 我有时候真希望能每天无所事事，把所有事情都交给我们的女儿来处理……但当然，我们也知道那样最终会带来什么后果。工作本身确实具有价值。不过，能有一天休息时间并得到家人的感激，也确实是一件很愉快的事情。 她理应得到这一切。 嗯…… 这时，绮奴悄悄走到你身边，把空盘子收走了——当她下定决心的时候，确实能够行动得非常安静。当桌子被清理干净后，你的九尾狐女儿清了清嗓子，再次鞠了一躬。 谢谢您，母亲。也谢谢您 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]为了让妈妈开心，我今天还准备了一些其他的舒适享受等着你，所以如果你愿意的话…… 啊，等一下，我得先把你的……发出去。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲] 关闭。 你的狐妖妻子转向了你。 那么，谢谢大家能陪我一起度过这段时光；考虑到我们曾经经历的一切，这对我来说意义非凡。我想，今天剩下的时间我会过得非常愉快。 她是真的希望你能一直留在这里，直到你无法继续留下来的那一天吗？ 我觉得这样就可以了；我宁愿你自愿离开，而不是被强行带走。毕竟我们也不想让这次的事情留下不好的印象，对吧？你已经做得够多了，而且你们以后也还会再见面的，不是吗？ 嗯，如果那是她想要的，那么在这个特别的日子里，你拒绝你亲爱的狐妖妻子也是情有可原的。 清子又凑过来，在你的脸颊上轻啄了一下。[kiyoko.numKits 4|这一举动引来了在场的玩家们一阵阵的笑声。]. 下次再见吧。 [pc.name]."
rows.raw: " Out of the sitting room, down the hallway to the back of the tree. It's just silence, your footsteps echoing down across wood the only sounds as you approach the entrance to the dining [kiyoko.numKits 8|hall|room]. It gets to the point where you wonder if Kinu was playing a prank on you, if there's going to be nothing waiting for you when you arrive — — Such doubts are pushed aside when you push aside the screen door and step in. There, [kiyoko.numKits 2 8 16 32 |Kinu stands at the fore of the table facing the door, bowing deeply as the two of you enter. Her siblings are seated at the table, fidgeting a little but otherwise well-behaved for the occasion. Small as she might be, Kinu has summoned up all the gravitas and solemnity her eight-year-old self can muster, as befits her position as firstborn daughter — a miniature majordomo to her mother. |Kinu stands at the fore of the head table, bowing deeply as the two of you enter. She's positioned all of her numerous siblings at the other tables, already set and waiting your arrival; they follow their eldest sister's lead in greeting the two of you. Being able to wrangle her naturally mischievous siblings like that... sheesh, your little daughter feels a lot more grown-up already, even if she doesn't look it at all. |a small army of foxen floofs stand to greet you, seated at the numerous tables laid out along the walls. Seeing all these kits... did you really impregnate Kiyoko that many times? Sure, you've seen your kits running around here and there, but for them to all be in the same place... Kiyoko certainly deserves to be honored here. Kinu stands at the fore of the head table, bowing deeply as the both of you make your entrance, her petite frame standing out against the multitude of her many siblings. |a veritable horde of kitsune kits await, seated at the numerous tables laid out in the hall. Your breath catches in your throat — sure, you knew you'd sired plenty of children on Kiyoko, but seeing them all in the same place at once is staggering. Fur ranging in color from white to black to gold to red and gray and even more turns the dining hall into a sea of color, and even though they fidget uncomfortably all of the kits are reasonably well-behaved for the occasion. Boys and girls, big and small, rowdy and quiet, every single one of them emerged from Kiyoko's womb at some point, born from your union with her. If anyone deserves to be honored on Mother's Day and given recognition for the work she's done in the name of motherhood, it's your lovely fox-wife. Kinu's standing at the fore of the head table, her many, many siblings behind her. For everything else that she is, your firstborn daughter sure knows how to take charge when her mother's not around. |Kinu awaits at the fore of the table facing the door, your daughter having summoned up all the solemnity and gravitas an eight-year-old can muster. ] She holds a silken bouquet of carnations in her hands, and standing on tiptoe, presents it gracefully and formally to Kiyoko. Her words sound overly stiff and formal, but perhaps that's how it's supposed to be between kitsune. Your firstborn daughter bows again, eyes closed, ears folded forward against her head, a clearly submissive position in front of her mother's authority. "Mother, [kiyoko.numKits 2|we are|I am] thankful for all your kindness. Today is a Mother's Day present from [kiyoko.numKits 2|us|me] to you. [kiyoko.numKits 2|On behalf of us all|With my deepest sincerity], allow me to wish for good health and a long, meaningful life for you. "Please, always be [kiyoko.numKits 2|our|my] beloved mother." Kiyoko stands over her daughter, her expression carefully neutral, her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails gathered about herself. In this moment and at this time, it strikes you how absolutely and incredibly beautiful your fox-wife can be when she chooses to project such airs; even the simplest and smallest of her movements speaks of refinement and elegance. Reaching down, Kiyoko plucks the bouquet of carnations from Kinu's hands, then takes a step back to study the gift. [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |It feels like forever before Kiyoko responds, but she eventually dips her head in her daughter's direction. "You have my thanks." Kinu doesn't have a reply, instead tilting her gaze to the side and away from her mother. There's a sense of awkwardness there, and then your daughter falls back on etiquette and decorum to save the situation, giving her mother another deep bow. "That will do." Pressing the bouquet close to her with her left hand, Kiyoko reaches down with her right and pats Kinu on the head, right in the space between her ears. Kinu squirms uncomfortably, grinding the balls of her feet into the ground, not daring to look her mother in the eye. |After what feels like an eternity, your kitsune wife breaks into a small smile. "Please, don't stand on ceremony." At those words, Kinu leans forward and encompasses her mother in a great big hug. [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |Her little arms press into the sides of Kiyoko's swollen belly as she stands on tiptoe, trying to reach around her mother — and failing quite miserably and comically at it. |There's no way her little arms can hope to reach all the way around to Kiyoko's back, so she contents with nuzzling into her mother's big pregnant belly, pressing her hands against the sides. |She has to stand on tiptoe to reach around Kiyoko's waist, but the effort is definitely worth it. ] Kiyoko returns the gesture, wrapping an arm about Kinu's shoulders while her other hand reaches to scratch between her daughter's ears. "Such an obedient child you are," she whispers, her voice choking up. "You, too... please always be my beloved firstborn.[kiyoko.numKits 2| And you all... my children, too.] The day will eventually come when you will not need me, but I hope I will have dispensed with my responsibilities well enough that you will still want me after that." ] "I will see to the final preparations. Please, Mother, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], take your seats." At that, Kinu withdraws, soft white tails swishing behind her as she makes for the kitchen. [kiyoko.numKits 4 |Two of her siblings detach themselves from their table, ushering Kiyoko and you towards the seats of honor in this little event. |Well, it looks like this is where you come in. Taking your beautiful fox-wife by the hand, you guide her towards the seat of honor in this little event. ] [kiyoko.pregStage 3 |It's a little amusing how her big, pregnant tummy gets in between her and the tabletop, requiring a bit of shifting and squeezing, but this probably isn't the time to be teasing her about it. This is her day, after all. |She slides into her seat, every bit as fine and regal as befits a woman of her station. This is her day, after all... it's very fitting that she looks the part of a fine mother in front of her children. ] Once she's settled in, Kiyoko lets out a little sigh of contentment and sets the bouquet to one side of the table. "Well, this is a pleasant surprise." You lean in and give your fox-wife a quick peck on the cheek. [kiyoko.numKits 2|The children|Kinu] must love her a lot to have gone to all this trouble for her — she's an excellent mother, and this is the day for her to be recognized. Why should it be a surprise in any way? She mulls over that. "I don't suppose you would've had any hand in all this, would you?" You? Oh no, perish the thought. With you having no idea how exactly time flows in the Astral Plane, you certainly wouldn't have any way to effectively plan something of this scale with [kiyoko.numKits 2|the kits|Kinu], right? No, all the credit goes to [kiyoko.numKits 2|them|her] for pulling it off. [kinu.kinuChildPersonality |Kiyoko sighs and contrives to look contemplative. "It's not that I don't like the proceedings, but... I do wish our daughter could be more like this in her daily life. More filial and obedient, if nothing else. Today will be today, and tomorrow she'll be back to her old self, I can tell you as much. Flowers are beautiful and all, but the greatest present she could have given me for today would be fewer gray hairs over the next year." She can't have fewer gray hairs if she doesn't have any to begin with. Your fox-wife rolls her eyes and bats at you with one of her many tails. "Please be serious for a moment. I do worry for our daughter's future if she's going to continue like this — I can already see the trouble I'm going to have finding a suitable husband-consort for her." She's growing away from her mother, becoming independent. The process began the moment she was conceived, and has only picked up in pace ever since. Kiyoko doesn't look happy at all with that answer, but that train of thought is stopped cold by Kinu returning on the scene. |Kiyoko sighs and hugs herself, looking very, very pleased as she makes herself comfortable. "Credit's where credit's due; I'm enjoying every moment of this. Kinu is already such a pleasant child... for her to have the resourcefulness to mastermind such a surprise makes me feel all giggly inside. I wonder which side of the family she gets that from?" You'd like to think it's a combination of both your better halves. "Ah, being diplomatic, are we?" Just calling the facts as you see them. "If you say so. A child like this is a pleasant dream for a parent... I know from experience how much worse Kinu could be. Going on like this, she'll have a bright future ahead of her — if nothing else, I won't have any trouble finding a suitable husband-consort for her." Thinking that far ahead already, huh? "Kits... they grow up fast. Trust me — today she's but at your waist, tomorrow she'll be sneaking out to meet with boys in secret. My sisters used to do that all the time..." You would've said more, but that conversation is stopped cold by Kinu returning on the scene. ] Your firstborn daughter struggles under the burden of a tray piled almost comically high with food, standing on tiptoe to be able to properly present it to Kiyoko. After setting it down on the table, she steps back a respectful distance, awaiting her mother's appraisal of her offerings. Your fox-wife sniffs each of the covered crockeries daintily in turn. "Hmm. Kitsune udon, inarizushi, amazake... your know your mother's preferences well, don't you, girl?" "It wouldn't do to serve you something you disliked on the day meant to honor you, Mother." "Mm. Such a thoughtful child. Why kenchin soup, though? Isn't that your preference?" "It is, Mother. But..." "Yes?" "It's also the first thing I remember you making for me." "Ah." Kiyoko closes her eyes, her bosom heaving as she draws a deep breath and lets it out slowly. "Well then, that only leaves me to wonder how you managed to work in the kitchen without me noticing. If it were any other kit, I would've been concerned about you being too young to do anything involving fire, but..." "Mother has gone to great lengths to teach me well."[kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0| She may say that, but you can hear the strain in Kinu's voice as she forces the words forth...] "Well, then." A quiet click as your fox-wife picks up her chopsticks. "I shall begin. Please, serve your [pc.mf|father|mother][kiyoko.numKits 2| and your siblings, too]. This will be sufficient." Kinu disappears without a sound, and returns shortly after with a similar tray, sliding it onto the table. "For you, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. Please continue to make Mother happy for as long as the two of you live." Ah... of course. "I will take my leave, then.[kiyoko.numKits 2| There are others who need to be served.]" As Kinu departs, Kiyoko gives you a sidelong glance, then sets down her chopsticks and smiles. "I suppose I should thank you too, [pc.name]" Why? This is her day, not yours. "Well, without you, I wouldn't have had the opportunity to be a mother, would I? Without you and your delectable chi to make kits with, I wouldn't be sitting here today with the people I love... [kiyoko.numKits 2 8 16 32 |our kits, and you, of course. This short time has been far better to me than the eternity that I spent alone; how could I not be grateful to you for making all this possible? |our big family. Isn't this just amazing? Now there's always something to do, some errand to be taken care of... but having seen the other side for myself, I couldn't be more satisfied with where I am today. |our kits, each and every one of them. Ehehehe... it kind of makes me a little embarrassed to recall where they came from, but on the other hand... it also makes me want to make some more, even if we have so many already. |so many of them. Even I can't quite believe I've been pregnant so many times at this point... it all feels a little like a dream. But even so, it's not a dream I want to wake from, not when there's so much living to be had. |even if life with our daughter has had its good and bad days alike, I don't regret having gone through any of this. My existence feels so much fuller for it. ]" Now isn't that cute. You pat Kiyoko on the head, feeling the comfortable warmth of her body, then sigh. Come on, it's best to tuck into the food before it gets cold.[kiyoko.numKits 2| See, even the children are eating already. There'll be time for talk later.] "Yes, you're right. Thank you for the food." Hah. Thank Kinu for the food, more like. It really is very good, though. Not just the food in and of itself, but also being able to share it with your beautiful fox-wife and the family you made with her. With all the effort Kinu's put in, you can't help but feel a little guilty at not having prepared anything for the occasion. Sure, you had no way of knowing the day without someone telling you, but even so... Kiyoko finishes off the last of the inarizushi before leaning over and whispering, a little giggle escaping her lips. "I suppose there's something you can do for me if you really want to..." Oh? [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |"Yes." Her smile turns upwards at the corners, becoming downright playful — or at least, it's best interpreted as playful. "This year may come and go, but there's always mother's day next year, isn't there? If you can just promise me that next year's celebrations will surpass this year's... I'll be satisfied." |"Mm-hm." Kiyoko's smile widens and turns mischievous as she leans back in her chair, pushing her huge pregnant belly out as far as it'll go. "Our kit will be born soon... but after that, who's to say you can't give me another? Mother's day will come around again next year... perhaps we should make the celebrations more grandiose than this year's? It's a goal to work towards to..." |"Oh, of course." Her smile widens, turning ever more vulpine as she rubs her side against you. "You could remind me how I ended up in this position to begin with. Call it a mother's day gift, if you will. Not right now, of course... but there's always your next visit, when we can get some time alone. I want to see this flat belly big and round again; mother's day will come around next year too, you know. Why not make it more of an occasion than this year's?" ] Hush now. There'll be time for such desires later. "Ehehe." Bit by bit, the two of you finish your meal. When it's finally all gone, Kiyoko wipes her mouth daintily and sighs, utterly content. Was it that good? "I'm finding myself wishing I could just laze around every day and leave everything to our daughter... but of course, we know where that ends up. There is intrinsic value to work. Still, a day off to be appreciated is lovely." She deserves as much. "Mm..." At this point, Kinu slides in by your side, removing the empty dishes — she sure can move silently when she's got the mind to. With the table cleared, your kitsune daughter clears her throat and bows again. "Thank you, Mother. And thank you, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], for making Mother happy. I've some more comforts prepared for you over the rest of today, so if you would..." "Ah. One moment, I have to send your [pc.mf|father|mother] off." Your fox-wife turns to you. "Well, then. Thank you for being here for me as part of this; it means quite a lot, considering what we've been through. I think I'll have a very enjoyable rest of today." Does she want you here for as long as you're able to stay? "I think this will do; I'd rather have you depart of your own accord instead of being dragged away. Wouldn't want a sour note on this occasion, would we? You've already done more than enough, and it's not like you won't be visiting again, right?" Well, if that's what she wants. Far from you to deny your beloved fox-wife on this day. Kiyoko leans in and pecks you on the cheek again[kiyoko.numKits 4|, earning a number of giggles from the gathered kits]. "I'll see you again next time, [pc.name].""

rows.original: See how your fox-wife and daughter are holding up after their sudden change of environment.
rows.translation: 看看你的狐狸妻子和女儿在环境突然发生变化之后，过得怎么样吧。
rows.raw: "See how your fox-wife and daughter are holding up after their sudden change of environment."

rows.original: Your fox-wife and daughter are still assessing the state of the den after more than two centuries' worth of neglect. Perhaps it would be best to leave them to making their accommodations livable before intruding upon their lives. You might be thinking to help, but frankly with your ignorance of Old Country architecture and decor it's best to just stay out of their way.
rows.translation: 你的狐狸妻子和女儿还在评估这个被忽视了两个多世纪的洞穴目前的状况。或许，在打扰她们之前，让她们自己把这里收拾得适合居住会更好。你可能想帮忙，但说实话，由于你对古老乡村的建筑风格和装饰方式一无所知，最好还是不要插手为妙。
rows.raw: "Your fox-wife and daughter are still assessing the state of the den after more than two centuries' worth of neglect. Perhaps it would be best to leave them to making their accommodations livable before intruding upon their lives. You might be thinking to help, but frankly with your ignorance of Old Country architecture and decor it's best to just stay out of their way."

rows.original: Once, these homes presumably used to house the expeditionary force that Kiyoko had brought with her from across the ocean. More than two centuries later, they now house her [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |kits |many kits |many, many kits |daughter ]. A few of the buildings are but one-storey homes, although most have anywhere between two to four; as part of an expeditionary force, the original kitsune who threw these together clearly decided to live in close quarters, perhaps for ease, perhaps for safety. [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |With the population of the den slowly but steadily increasing, a couple more homes have been cleared and refurbished, no doubt with Komari's help. Old boards torn out, roofs rethatched, support beams replaced and the plant life pruned to appropriate levels. It's been a lot of work, but less work than completely tearing down the homes and rebuilding them would have been. That they're still in salvageable condition after two centuries of neglect in the wild perhaps speaks volumes as to the deftness of kitsune architecture, the effort that went into reclaiming them, or more likely, both. |With plenty of foxes now living in the den, younger and older alike, about half of the old buildings have been turned into a liveable state. Judging by how the buildings themselves, Kiyoko's expeditionary force might have numbered three to four hundred in close quarters; not to disparage your fox-wife, but she'll probably stop before getting to that point, right? Right now, there's still plenty of space for everyone, and each kit is probably taking up a lot more room than the foxes who came with her... Whatever the case, there's definitely plenty of energy about the living quarters, voices and other sounds of daily life rising from sources unseen. And knowing your fox-wife, she'll only want to keep on adding to that number... |At this point, you feel justified in saying that there's a bit of a bustle to the living quarters, to the point where you occasionally catch sight of one of your fox-children on their way to and from their daily tasks. While about half of the buildings still lie in various states of disrepair, that simply means that there'll be space for expansion should it eventually be called for. Kiyoko's womb is certainly capable of producing a village over her lifetime, although you're not entirely sure if that'll come to pass. You'll see. Either way, things are really looking up. Your kits have really been industrious, patching up the walls to the point where they're absolutely pristine; the wooden floors and walls gleam with cleanliness and varnish alike, and the faint smell of green growing things is tame and inviting, speaking of restfulness, relaxation, and sleep after a hard day's work. Small homemade decorations adorn some of the chamber as you peer into them; folded paper figurines, foxes made from straw, simple flower arrangements. |Most of the homes still lie in various states of disrepair; with your fox-wife's brood of kits being not that big yet, there's been no need to put limited hands to less important tasks for the moment. Even dilapidated and abandoned, the overgrown kitsune homes are strangely calming, the plants that once strengthened and supported the structures having gone feral and begun to retake the buildings in earnest. It's a bit of a pity, perhaps, but resources are limited and need to be apportioned to where they're best served. ] Beyond the actual living quarters, there's a dining hall, [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |the faint scent of [dayNight|warm food|cool ash] rising from it |the place bustling with activity around mealtimes |practically required at this point to feed all the kits you've sired on your fox-wife |although it's awfully spacious for the actual number of people who eat there ], as well as several other adjoining chambers that've been spruced up but don't appear to serve any dedicated purpose. Most importantly, though, are Kinu's quarters; a small, two-room building situated at the entrance to the den quarters such that anyone heading in or out has to pass by her doorstep. Being the firstborn daughter and heir apparent to her mother comes with its responsibilities but also its privileges; with her overseeing the reconstruction of her mother's old shrine, your firstborn fox-daughter has taken care to allot herself some measure of comfort. [kiyoko.numKits 6|While her brothers and sisters are packed anywhere between four to six in the den quarters' large rooms|With the entire run of the den quarters to choose from], Kinu has a small place all to herself. Not all of her space is personal. One of the walls is covered with schedules and other arrangements for all sorts of day-to-day duties, both here and over in the Frostwood den. Work, education, delegation... [kiyoko.numKits 6|these days, Kinu doesn't do that much of the shepherding herself, instead choosing to appoint the more responsible and conscientious of her siblings to oversee the younger ones|it's a lot for a future den mother to catch up with, and seeing it all laid out bare makes it hard not to respect your daughter a little more]. Ah... [a] [kinu.kinuWeapon|naginata, blade gleaming|hankyu, unstrung alongside a quiver full of arrows], up on the wall. Embers burning in the firepit. Clothes trunk. Medicine chest. Scrollwork. Schedules. Inventory of the stores. Cupboard. Her mother's instructions. Mementos of your time together when she was but a kit. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0|A large, puffy coat of the purest silvery-white fur, looking very, very warm and snug|Exquisite finery — or at least, as exquisite as she can manage given her situation — fit for a princess]. [var0 |[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Kinu isn't here, of course — girls like her get out of bed at the crack of dawn to work the fields. If you want to find her, that's where she'll be in the mornings. |Kinu should be around here somewhere, she usually is at this time of day. She hasn't noticed you yet, but you could easily get your fox-daughter's attention should you need it. ] |Kinu's not here at the moment; your firstborn daughter is off in the Frostwood making nice with the people there. If you want to find her, she's probably puttering around somewhere on that side of the torii gate. |Kinu's home right now, but your daughter's sleeping and probably doesn't want to be wakened unless it's a true emergency. She needs all her energy for tomorrow... you wouldn't deny her that, would you? ]
rows.translation: 曾经，这些房屋应该是用来容纳那些由清子从大洋彼岸带来的远征军队的。两个多世纪之后，如今它们却成了她的居所。 [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |配件包 |许多套件 |各种各样的套件 |女儿 ]其中一些建筑只是一层楼的住宅，不过大多数都有两到四层；作为一支远征军的一部分，最初建造这些房屋的那些狐妖显然决定挤在一起居住，或许是为了方便，或许是为了安全。 [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |随着洞穴内的人口数量逐渐但稳定地增加，又在几处地方清理并翻修了房屋，这些工作无疑是在小毬的帮助下完成的。旧木板被拆掉，屋顶重新铺上了草席，支撑梁也被更换了，周围的植物也被修剪到了合适的程度。 虽然这确实耗费了大量精力，但相比彻底拆除这些房屋后再重新建造，所付出的努力还是要少一些。在经历了两个世纪的无人照料之后，这些房屋依然能够被修复使用，这一事实或许充分证明了狐族建筑技术的精湛之处，也体现了人们在修复这些房屋时所付出的努力——当然，更有可能的是，这两点因素共同作用才使得这一目标得以实现。 |现在有许多狐狸居住在这个洞穴里，有年轻的，也有年长的。大约有一半的旧建筑已经被改造成了适合居住的地方。从这些建筑的结构来看，清子的远征队伍在紧要关头可能会有三四百人；我并不是要贬低你的狐狸妻子，不过她应该不会发展到那种地步吧？ 目前，还有足够的空间容纳所有人，而且每个装备包所占的空间，恐怕都比她带来的那些狐狸们要大得多…… 无论如何，生活区里确实充满了活力，各种声音——人们的谈话声、日常生活的琐碎声响——都从那些看不见的地方传来。 而你又太了解你的那个狐狸老婆了，她肯定只会想让那个数字继续增加下去…… |此时，你会有理由认为居住区里确实有些热闹的气氛，因为你会偶尔看到自己的那些“狐狸孩子们”在往返于日常任务的路上去来匆匆。虽然大约有一半的建筑物仍处于不同程度的破败状态，但这恰恰意味着，如果将来有需要的话，还是会有空间可以进行扩建的。 清子的子宫确实有潜力在她有生之年内孕育出一个完整的村庄，不过你是否真的能看到这一幕发生，目前还无法确定。等着瞧吧。 无论如何，目前的情况确实正在好转。你们的小伙伴们都非常勤奋，他们把墙壁修补得完好无损；木制地板和墙壁也因为清洁和上过清漆而闪闪发光，而那种淡淡的植物生长气息则给人一种宁静、放松的感觉，让人一想到忙碌一天后能够休息、放松，就会感到十分惬意。 当你仔细观察这些房间时，会发现其中一些地方装饰着小巧的手工制品：折纸人偶、用稻草制成的狐狸模型，以及简单而别致的花束。 |大多数房屋仍然处于不同程度的破败状态；由于你那位狐狸妻子生的幼崽还不多，目前还没有必要把有限的精力投入到那些不太重要的修缮工作上。即便这些破败不堪、被遗弃的狐狸巢穴已经杂草丛生，但它们却给人一种奇怪的宁静感——那些曾经用来加固建筑结构的植物已经野化，开始真正地占据这些房屋。 虽然有点遗憾，但资源毕竟是有限的，必须把它们分配到最能发挥其作用的地方。 ] 在实际的生活区域之外，还有一间餐厅。 [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |那淡淡的香味 [dayNight|热食|酷灰] 从中恢复过来 |在用餐时间，这个地方总是热闹非凡。 |在这个阶段，如果你想让自己与狐妖妻子所生的所有幼崽都能存活下来，这样做几乎是必不可少的。 |尽管对于实际在那里用餐的人数来说，这个空间确实相当宽敞。 ]此外，还有几间经过装饰的相邻房间，但似乎并没有特定的用途。 然而，最重要的是基努的住所——那是一栋小巧的两居室建筑，位于巢穴区域的入口处，因此任何进出该区域的人都必须经过她的住所门前。 作为母亲的长女和法定继承人，她既肩负着责任，也享有相应的特权。在监督母亲旧神殿的重建工作的同时，这位长女也为自己安排了一些舒适的生活条件。 [kiyoko.numKits 6|而她的兄弟姐妹们，则被安置在巢穴区域那些宽敞的房间里，每间房间里住着四到六个人。|玩家可以选择地道内的任何一段路径进行游戏。]基努有一个属于她自己的小空间。 不过，她的这个空间并不全是私人的。其中一面墙上挂满了各种日程安排以及关于这里和弗罗斯特伍德巢穴里日常事务的安排表：工作、学习、任务分配…… [kiyoko.numKits 6|这些天，绮奴不再亲自负责照看那些年幼的兄弟姐妹了，而是选择指派那些责任心更强、更认真负责的同辈来照看他们。|对于一位未来的母亲来说，要掌握这一切确实相当困难。而当这一切都被清晰地呈现在眼前时，人们确实会不由得更加敬重你的女儿。]啊…… [a] [kinu.kinuWeapon|长刀，刀刃闪耀着光芒|半弓未拉，箭袋中还装满了箭矢]墙上挂满了东西：火坑里还有余火在燃烧，有衣物箱、药箱、装饰有卷轴图案的物品、各种日程安排表，还有仓库里的库存清单、橱柜，还有她母亲的嘱咐，以及你们在一起时留下的纪念品——那时她还只是一个刚出生的小婴儿。 [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0|一件由最纯净的银白色毛皮制成的蓬松大衣，看起来既温暖又舒适。|如此精致的服饰——或者说，就她目前的处境而言，已经算是极致的精致了——才配得上一位公主。]. [var0 |[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |当然，绮奴现在不在这里——像她这样的女孩们通常会在天刚破晓时就起床去田里干活。如果你想找到她，早上去田里找肯定能找到她。 |纪久应该就在附近的某个地方，这个时候她通常都在这里。她还没有注意到你，但如果你需要的话，完全可以很容易地吸引你那位狐狸女儿的注意。 ] |基努现在不在这里；你的长女正在冰原森林里，和那里的居民们相处得很好。如果你想找到她，她应该就在那片区域的某个地方闲逛吧。 鸟居 大门。 |现在她正在绮奴家里，不过你的女儿正在睡觉，除非真的发生了紧急情况，否则她肯定不想被吵醒。她需要把所有的精力都留到明天……你不会拒绝她这个请求吧？ ]
rows.raw: " Once, these homes presumably used to house the expeditionary force that Kiyoko had brought with her from across the ocean. More than two centuries later, they now house her [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |kits |many kits |many, many kits |daughter ]. A few of the buildings are but one-storey homes, although most have anywhere between two to four; as part of an expeditionary force, the original kitsune who threw these together clearly decided to live in close quarters, perhaps for ease, perhaps for safety. [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |With the population of the den slowly but steadily increasing, a couple more homes have been cleared and refurbished, no doubt with Komari's help. Old boards torn out, roofs rethatched, support beams replaced and the plant life pruned to appropriate levels. It's been a lot of work, but less work than completely tearing down the homes and rebuilding them would have been. That they're still in salvageable condition after two centuries of neglect in the wild perhaps speaks volumes as to the deftness of kitsune architecture, the effort that went into reclaiming them, or more likely, both. |With plenty of foxes now living in the den, younger and older alike, about half of the old buildings have been turned into a liveable state. Judging by how the buildings themselves, Kiyoko's expeditionary force might have numbered three to four hundred in close quarters; not to disparage your fox-wife, but she'll probably stop before getting to that point, right? Right now, there's still plenty of space for everyone, and each kit is probably taking up a lot more room than the foxes who came with her... Whatever the case, there's definitely plenty of energy about the living quarters, voices and other sounds of daily life rising from sources unseen. And knowing your fox-wife, she'll only want to keep on adding to that number... |At this point, you feel justified in saying that there's a bit of a bustle to the living quarters, to the point where you occasionally catch sight of one of your fox-children on their way to and from their daily tasks. While about half of the buildings still lie in various states of disrepair, that simply means that there'll be space for expansion should it eventually be called for. Kiyoko's womb is certainly capable of producing a village over her lifetime, although you're not entirely sure if that'll come to pass. You'll see. Either way, things are really looking up. Your kits have really been industrious, patching up the walls to the point where they're absolutely pristine; the wooden floors and walls gleam with cleanliness and varnish alike, and the faint smell of green growing things is tame and inviting, speaking of restfulness, relaxation, and sleep after a hard day's work. Small homemade decorations adorn some of the chamber as you peer into them; folded paper figurines, foxes made from straw, simple flower arrangements. |Most of the homes still lie in various states of disrepair; with your fox-wife's brood of kits being not that big yet, there's been no need to put limited hands to less important tasks for the moment. Even dilapidated and abandoned, the overgrown kitsune homes are strangely calming, the plants that once strengthened and supported the structures having gone feral and begun to retake the buildings in earnest. It's a bit of a pity, perhaps, but resources are limited and need to be apportioned to where they're best served. ] Beyond the actual living quarters, there's a dining hall, [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |the faint scent of [dayNight|warm food|cool ash] rising from it |the place bustling with activity around mealtimes |practically required at this point to feed all the kits you've sired on your fox-wife |although it's awfully spacious for the actual number of people who eat there ], as well as several other adjoining chambers that've been spruced up but don't appear to serve any dedicated purpose. Most importantly, though, are Kinu's quarters; a small, two-room building situated at the entrance to the den quarters such that anyone heading in or out has to pass by her doorstep. Being the firstborn daughter and heir apparent to her mother comes with its responsibilities but also its privileges; with her overseeing the reconstruction of her mother's old shrine, your firstborn fox-daughter has taken care to allot herself some measure of comfort. [kiyoko.numKits 6|While her brothers and sisters are packed anywhere between four to six in the den quarters' large rooms|With the entire run of the den quarters to choose from], Kinu has a small place all to herself. Not all of her space is personal. One of the walls is covered with schedules and other arrangements for all sorts of day-to-day duties, both here and over in the Frostwood den. Work, education, delegation... [kiyoko.numKits 6|these days, Kinu doesn't do that much of the shepherding herself, instead choosing to appoint the more responsible and conscientious of her siblings to oversee the younger ones|it's a lot for a future den mother to catch up with, and seeing it all laid out bare makes it hard not to respect your daughter a little more]. Ah... [a] [kinu.kinuWeapon|naginata, blade gleaming|hankyu, unstrung alongside a quiver full of arrows], up on the wall. Embers burning in the firepit. Clothes trunk. Medicine chest. Scrollwork. Schedules. Inventory of the stores. Cupboard. Her mother's instructions. Mementos of your time together when she was but a kit. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0|A large, puffy coat of the purest silvery-white fur, looking very, very warm and snug|Exquisite finery — or at least, as exquisite as she can manage given her situation — fit for a princess]. [var0 |[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Kinu isn't here, of course — girls like her get out of bed at the crack of dawn to work the fields. If you want to find her, that's where she'll be in the mornings. |Kinu should be around here somewhere, she usually is at this time of day. She hasn't noticed you yet, but you could easily get your fox-daughter's attention should you need it. ] |Kinu's not here at the moment; your firstborn daughter is off in the Frostwood making nice with the people there. If you want to find her, she's probably puttering around somewhere on that side of the torii gate. |Kinu's home right now, but your daughter's sleeping and probably doesn't want to be wakened unless it's a true emergency. She needs all her energy for tomorrow... you wouldn't deny her that, would you? ] "

rows.translation: 去迎接你的狐狸女儿吧。
去迎接你的狐狸女儿吧。

rows.original: You step between the gateposts, and the shimmer in the air about you turns into a blur. With a sudden wrenching sensation not unlike being lifted into The Ways Between, the world twists, and then you're in the shaded confines of the sacred gardens in the Frostwood den.
rows.translation: 当你跨过门柱的那一刻，周围空气中那闪烁的光芒瞬间变得模糊不清。紧接着，你感受到一种类似被强行带入“幽冥之路”的剧烈牵扯感，整个世界开始扭曲变形，转眼间，你就置身于霜木巢穴中那些荫蔽神圣的花园之中了。
rows.raw: "\n        You step between the gateposts, and the shimmer in the air about you turns into a blur. With a sudden wrenching sensation not unlike being lifted into The Ways Between, the world twists, and then you're in the shaded confines of the sacred gardens in the Frostwood den.\n        "

rows.original: Travel to the Frostwood kitsune den.
rows.translation: 前往霜林中的狐妖巢穴吧。

rows.original: You could always add any extra stone or wood on you to this stash. It won't be much, but every little bit helps, right?
rows.translation: 你总是可以把多余的石头或木材添加到这个储藏处里。虽然数量不会很多，但积少成多嘛，对吧？
rows.raw: "You could always add any extra stone or wood on you to this stash. It won't be much, but every little bit helps, right?"

rows.original: . How many would you like to donate?
rows.raw: ". How many would you like to donate?"

rows.original: Hefting the materials out of your possessions, you find a nice dry spot in the material shed to set them down in. While your fox-wife and daughter are no doubt well-stocked, every single bit helps when it comes to reconstruction — if nothing else, they won't be impinging on Komari's resources as much. It's a nice thing to be able to provide for your family, even if it's in such a small context.
rows.translation: 把那些物资从你的物品中取出来，你在材料储藏室里找了一个干燥的地方把它们放好。虽然你的狐狸妻子和女儿肯定储备了足够的物资，但任何一点帮助对于重建工作来说都意义重大——至少这样，她们就不会过多地占用科马里的资源了。能够为家人提供帮助，哪怕只是这么一点微不足道的事情，也是一件好事。
rows.raw: "\n        Hefting the materials out of your possessions, you find a nice dry spot in the material shed to set them down in. While your fox-wife and daughter are no doubt well-stocked, every single bit helps when it comes to reconstruction — if nothing else, they won't be impinging on Komari's resources as much. It's a nice thing to be able to provide for your family, even if it's in such a small context.\n        "

rows.original: Invalid input. [var0|You cannot donate more materials than you have on you|You can't donate 0].
rows.translation: 输入无效。 [var0|你不能捐赠超出自己所拥有的物资数量的物品。|你不能捐赠0。].
rows.raw: "\n Invalid input. [var0|You cannot donate more materials than you have on you|You can't donate 0]."

rows.original: Invalid input. Please enter positive whole numbers only.
rows.raw: "\n Invalid input. Please enter positive whole numbers only."

rows.original: Putting some lumber towards reconstruction efforts would be great. Beams, planks, walls — put ten units in the shed.
rows.translation: 为重建工作提供一些木材会非常有帮助。梁木、木板、墙壁材料——往仓库里放上十单位吧。
rows.raw: "Putting some lumber towards reconstruction efforts would be great. Beams, planks, walls — put ten units in the shed."

rows.original: You don't have these materials on hand at the moment.
rows.translation: 你目前手头并没有这些材料。
rows.raw: "You don't have these materials on hand at the moment."

rows.original: Kitsune architecture doesn't use nails, but there're many other useful purposes for iron in tools and implements. If nothing, your fox-wife and daughter can use these to bribe Kohaku into getting them what they need.
rows.translation: 狐族建筑并不使用钉子，但铁在制作工具和器具方面确实有着许多其他实用用途。至少，你的狐妻和女儿可以用这些工具去贿赂琥珀，从而获得她们所需要的东西。
rows.raw: "Kitsune architecture doesn't use nails, but there're many other useful purposes for iron in tools and implements. If nothing, your fox-wife and daughter can use these to bribe Kohaku into getting them what they need."

rows.original: You don't have these materials on hand at the moment.
rows.translation: 你目前手头并没有这些材料。
rows.raw: "You don't have these materials on hand at the moment."

rows.original: Stone isn't as heavily used in Kitsune architecture, which favors light materials as opposed to the Marches style, but it's still useful for paving, foundations and many other purposes.
rows.translation: 在狐族建筑中，石头并不被广泛使用——与边境地区的建筑风格不同，狐族建筑更倾向于使用轻质材料。不过，石头仍然可用于铺路、建造地基以及许多其他用途。
rows.raw: "Stone isn't as heavily used in Kitsune architecture, which favors light materials as opposed to the Marches style, but it's still useful for paving, foundations and many other purposes."

rows.original: You don't have these materials on hand at the moment.
rows.translation: 你目前手头并没有这些材料。
rows.raw: "You don't have these materials on hand at the moment."

rows.original: On the western end of the camp, the palisade parts as thin forest soil gives way to rocky riverbank. Judging by the long stone ramp leading from dry ground to the water's edge, this is where the logs were floated down to Hawkethorne to be cut into timbers and planks, as well as a means of transport for the loggers themselves. Indeed, there's mooring for a number of flat-bottomed barges, but the boats themselves are smashed and riven with many small holes, perhaps the work of the blizzard on that fateful night. Either way, it explains why the loggers haven't escaped downriver to Hawkethorne already. The water itself is clear and fast-flowing, fed by snowmelt off from the Frost Marches. Though there's no actual ice in the water itself, it's almost certain the water's bitterly cold — swimming in the river would freeze anyone foolhardy enough to try. No escape that way, either. [var0 |Out by the riverbank, you spy a lone silhouette wading in the shallows, completely unperturbed by the icy water and swift current. This, you quickly surmise, must be Hethia, the druidess Garret spoke of. There's enough distance between you and her that she hasn't noticed your presence yet, although that could quickly change depending on your next course of action. Just what do you do? |A stack of not-so-freshly felled timber lies by the water's edge in a neat stack, evidently the last job the loggers were working on before the blizzard struck. Now slowly rotting away in place, it looks like these logs will never meet their intended destination, their deaths expiring into meaningless nothingness. ]
rows.translation: 在营地的西端，栅栏逐渐消失，因为稀薄的森林土壤被岩石质河岸所取代。从那条从干燥地面通向水边的长石阶可以看出，这里正是原木被运送到鹰棘镇进行切割成木材和木板的地方，同时也是伐木工人们使用的运输通道。 的确，那里有足够的空间供许多平底驳船停泊，但这些船只本身已经破旧不堪，上面布满了许多小洞，或许这些都是那个灾难性夜晚暴风雪造成的。无论如何，这也解释了为什么那些伐木工人还没有顺流而下前往鹰棘镇。 这条河的水清澈见底，水流湍急，其水源来自于霜冻边境地区的融雪。虽然河水中并没有真正的冰块，但可以肯定的是，这些水冰冷刺骨——任何敢于在河里游泳的人，都一定会被冻伤。 那样也无处可逃。 [var0 |在河岸边，你看到一个孤独的身影正在浅水区涉水而行，那冰冷的水流和湍急的水势似乎完全没有影响到她。你立刻猜到，这个人一定就是加勒特提到的那位德鲁伊希西娅。 你与她的距离足够远，因此她还没有注意到你的存在，不过这种情况很快就会改变，这完全取决于你接下来要采取的行动。 那么，你接下来应该怎么做呢？ 做 你是这么做的？ |一堆刚砍下来的木材整齐地堆放在水边，显然这是伐木工人们在暴风雪来临之前完成的最后一项工作。如今这些木材正在那里慢慢腐烂，看来它们永远也无法到达预定的目的地，它们的“死亡”就这样在无意义的虚无中结束了。 ]
rows.raw: " On the western end of the camp, the palisade parts as thin forest soil gives way to rocky riverbank. Judging by the long stone ramp leading from dry ground to the water's edge, this is where the logs were floated down to Hawkethorne to be cut into timbers and planks, as well as a means of transport for the loggers themselves. Indeed, there's mooring for a number of flat-bottomed barges, but the boats themselves are smashed and riven with many small holes, perhaps the work of the blizzard on that fateful night. Either way, it explains why the loggers haven't escaped downriver to Hawkethorne already. The water itself is clear and fast-flowing, fed by snowmelt off from the Frost Marches. Though there's no actual ice in the water itself, it's almost certain the water's bitterly cold — swimming in the river would freeze anyone foolhardy enough to try. No escape that way, either. [var0 |Out by the riverbank, you spy a lone silhouette wading in the shallows, completely unperturbed by the icy water and swift current. This, you quickly surmise, must be Hethia, the druidess Garret spoke of. There's enough distance between you and her that she hasn't noticed your presence yet, although that could quickly change depending on your next course of action. Just what do you do? |A stack of not-so-freshly felled timber lies by the water's edge in a neat stack, evidently the last job the loggers were working on before the blizzard struck. Now slowly rotting away in place, it looks like these logs will never meet their intended destination, their deaths expiring into meaningless nothingness. ]"

rows.original: You step up to the longhouse doors, and hear rustling and shifting on the other side of the barricade. "You're back? Have you, uh, dealt with the crazy elf yet?" Not just yet. You wanted to check in and see how they were holding up. "A bit hungry, but aren't we all? I mean, hardtack is okay, but you wouldn't want to live on it. At least the water in these parts is the purest you'll find anywhere. Snowmelt, y'know." Right, right. You'll see to dealing with the situation, then.
rows.translation: 你走到长屋的门前，听到屏障另一侧传来了沙沙声和挪动物体的声音。 你回来了？那个疯狂的精灵，你处理好了吗？ 还不行。你本来是想去看看他们的情况如何的。 有点饿，不过我们不都是这样吗？说实话，硬饼干倒也能充饥，但总不能一直靠它活着吧。至少这一带的水是整个地区最纯净的，都是融雪水啊。 好的，好的。那么你就负责处理这个情况吧。

You wanted to check in and see how they were holding up. "A bit hungry, but aren't we all? I mean, hardtack is okay, but you wouldn't want to live on it. At least the water in these parts is the purest you'll find anywhere. Snowmelt, y'know." Right, right. You'll see to dealing with the situation, then."

rows.original: Curious, you walk up to the longhouses and try peering inside. While the windows have been boarded up pretty tight, you think you catch sight of movement within. Wondering if there might be any survivors in the otherwise deserted camp, you stride up to the door and knock firmly. When there's no reply forthcoming, you hammer on it — and discover the entrance has been barricaded quite thoroughly. Ah. You call out, and at last, a tired, frightened voice replies. "Who's there?" You announce yourself, and explain that Garth sent you; you intend to rescue anyone left in the camp. How many of them are there in the longhouse, anyway? "All ten of us. We're a little tired and cold, but still all right. Provisions are a bit low, but we're pretty much unharmed, if rather stressed out. How'd you get in here, anyway? The crazy elf chick put up some kind of magic that prevents us from sneaking out and back to Hawkethorne. Trust me, we've tried." Magic, eh? That would explain your difficult trip here. Silence. And then, "Look, it's not that I don't want to leave — everyone here would like to put plenty of distance between us and that crazy elf chick. Garret's been taking the brunt of her attentions since he showed up, but there're things in the woods and the barges are full of holes. That we at least have a fighting chance against, but whatever spell the elf put on the woods twists the path on itself when we try to leave. You might be skilled enough to slip in and out as you like, but we aren't as good as you are, okay?" So essentially they need you to deal with the situation before sneaking off. "I don't know why she's still hanging around. The elf got what she wanted, right? Is Garret that good of a lay that he's worth staying for? "But yeah. With the elf chick maintaining her witchcraft, we're stuck here. She kinda leaves us alone, so... we're just waiting, I guess. Laying low." It could be worse; at least they're still in one piece. You'll see what you can do about the situation. "If you got past what she did to the trees, maybe you have a chance." A trace of hope creeps into the voice. "We're counting on you."
rows.translation: 出于好奇，你走向那些长屋，试图往里面看。虽然窗户都被牢牢地封住了，但你似乎看到里面有动静。想着这个原本空无一人的营地里是否还有人幸存，你大步走到门前，用力敲了敲门。然而没有得到任何回应，你便开始猛敲——这时你才发现，入口处已经被彻底堵住了。 “啊……”你喊道，终于，一个疲惫而惊恐的声音回应了你。 谁在那里？ 你表明自己的身份，解释说是加斯派你来的，并表示你打算救出营地里还剩下的所有人。那么，一共有多少人呢？ 是 总而言之，就是在那间长屋里吧？ 我们十个人都在这儿。虽然有点累，也觉得有点冷，但总体来说还挺不错的。食物确实有点不足，不过我们并没有受到什么伤害，只是有点紧张而已。你们到底是怎么进来的呢？那个疯狂的精灵女孩用了某种魔法，阻止我们偷偷溜回鹰棘镇。相信我，我们确实试过了。 魔法，是吗？这就解释了你为何要费尽周折来到这里。 沉默。然后， 听着，并不是我不想离开——这里的每个人其实都希望我们能和那个疯狂的精灵女孩保持足够的距离。自从加勒特出现后，他就成了她关注的对象，但森林里还有很多危险，而且那些驳船上也布满了漏洞。 那个 我们至少还有机会与之抗争，但是那个精灵在森林里施加了某种魔法，每当我们试图离开时，道路就会发生扭曲。你或许有足够的本事随心所欲地进出那里，但我们没有你那么厉害，明白吗？ 所以，本质上来说，他们需要你在偷偷离开之前先处理好这个问题。 我不知道她为什么还留在那里。那个精灵已经得到了她想要的东西，对吧？加勒特真的有那么吸引人，值得她留下来吗？ 不过，确实是这样。因为那个精灵女孩一直在使用她的巫术，我们就被困在这里了。她基本上不会来打扰我们，所以……我们也就只能等着吧，尽量不惹麻烦。 情况本可能更糟；至少他们现在还完好无损。你会想出办法来应对这个局面的。 如果你能原谅她对那些树木所做的一切，或许你还有机会。 声音中透出一丝希望。 我们期待你的帮助。

rows.original: The moment you pass through the camp's gates, Sanders is there waiting for you. There's a bit of dirt and sap on his white robes from traveling through the forest and mud has caked the boots he's put on for the occasion, but he's otherwise in good shape. His emerald-tipped staff is clutched tightly in his hands, and he gives you a warm smile as you approach. "[pc.name]. You've arrived." Yes, you have. [pc.isDK|Nice of him to turn up just when you needed him|Hope you didn't keep him waiting long]. "I've just arrived myself; there were a number of preparations I had to make. While I've met a number of different peoples in my day, I've never quite had the chance to speak to one of the pale elves; they're quite elusive and secretive, by all accounts. I had to consult Mistress Ivris for what she knew of them, and even that was not as much as I'd hoped it would be." But he'll still do it, won't he? Sanders winks at you. [pc.cunningRange 70|You can tell he's unsure of this, but the good brother is putting on a brave face, both for you and himself. Which makes sense — there's no sense going into a negotiation doubting oneself. ] "Whoever this druidess Garret spoke of might be, she can at least be spoken to and hopefully reasoned with. Like I said, I bear in part some responsibility for what's happened here, [pc.name]. I promised I'd do something, and I won't back out now." All right, then. "So, where do you think she is?" [dayNight|While Garret said that the druidess would be at the river in the evenings, now's not the right time for that; you may have to bide your time for a while until she shows up. Sanders shakes his head at the news. "Unfortunate, but we don't need to be idle all this while. I'd like to see Garret and the loggers beforehand; perhaps we can do something for them before we parley with the druidess." Sounds like a good idea. Besides, sitting around twiddling your thumbs isn't going to help anyone. Best to start with Garret — taking the lead, you guide Sanders [party.hasCompanions|and your group ]off to the hall where Garret's cage is. On the way, you point out the longhouses where the loggers have barricaded themselves into, and Sanders nods. "We'll go and see them after this, but judging from what you told me, I think Garret needs our attention the most." That you have to agree with; maybe Sanders can break him out of that cage. Stepping up to the entrance, you push open the door with a loud creak of its hinges, and step in to see — — Quite the sight indeed. Garret's cage has been unlocked, the door thrown wide open. That by no means suggests that he's anything but free, though — the fact that he's sprawled on his back with a collar about his neck proves as much. Your gaze follows the collar to the leash it's attached to, then to the person holding it — the amazonian, silver-haired druidess who just so happens to be completely disrobed and straddling poor Garret. She grinds her pussy lips against his engorged red cock, leaving a slick sheen of freezing slime even as he grunts and struggles under her. "Bad doggy!" the druidess coos. "Who's been a bad doggy, then? Isn't getting treats like this so much better than being a bad dog? If you'll just behave, you can get more many more treats!" But Garret isn't listening, his ears flattening against his head as his gaze fixes squarely on you. Then he notices Sanders standing beside you, and goes into a full-on cringe, trying to hide his face for all the good it'll do. Poor puppy. Sanders sighs. "[pc.name], would you please hold my staff?" Right, he doesn't want to be seen holding a weapon when trying to parley with the druidess. You take the emerald-tipped staff from Sanders, then watch as he shoots Garret a warning glance as if to say: don't fuck this up. On her part, the druidess has pushed herself off Garret — although the latter is still seething with defiance and shame, he doesn't do anything stupid. Yet. Her entire demeanor shifts as she turns to face down Sanders, and she eyes him carefully like an animal sizing up a potential rival. In the meantime, her pet warg pads out of the darkness, her armored robes clenched between its jaws. "Who are you? What are your intentions?" |Garret did mention that the druidess would be down by the river in the evenings — to do her communing, whatever that means. Chances are that you should check that out first — you tell Sanders as much, and the priest gives you a curt nod. "Let's head there, then." Yeah, that would be for the best. Taking the lead, you guide Sanders [party.hasCompanions|and your group ]to the riverbank — hopefully the druidess will be there as expected. As it turns out, she is. From the distance, you can see a lone silhouette half-submerged in the icy water, washing her hair — or at least, it looks like she's washing her hair. That has to be it, then. By the bank, another silhouette lounges about, ruddy and bulky — her pet warg. Sanders points questioningly; you give him a nod of affirmation. "Very well," he says. "[pc.name], please hold my staff for a moment. I don't want to start off on the wrong foot by approaching her with a weapon." Ah, that makes sense. Sure. Sanders passes you his emerald-tipped staff, and you watch as he steps towards the riverbank at an even pace, slow enough to let anyone see he's coming, but unflinching and unhesitating as well. The warg is the first to notice him, snarling as it bounds in Sanders' direction, but a sharp whistle from the river stops it in its tracks. It doesn't look too happy about being called off by its mistress, but obeys anyway and slinks away even as the druidess emerges from the water. "Who are you?" she asks, wringing water out of her long silver locks. Tall and pale, the elven druidess is perfectly comfortable being naked in front of Sanders, although the warg does come up to her side with her armored robes in its jaws. "I take it you don't mean ill if you're approaching me openly. What are your intentions?"]
rows.translation: 当你穿过营地的大门时，桑德斯已经在那里等着你了。他的白色长袍上沾满了森林里的灰尘和树液，为这次出行而穿的靴子上也积满了泥巴，但除此之外，他的状态还算不错。他紧紧握着那根顶端镶着翡翠的手部杖，当你走近时，他向你露出了温暖的微笑。 "[pc.name]您已经到达了。 是的，你做到了。 [pc.isDK|他能在你最需要的时候出现，真是太好了。|希望你没有让他等太久。]. 我也是刚刚到这里的；有好多事情需要准备。这些年来，我确实遇到了很多不同种族的人，但却从未有机会与那些苍白精灵交谈过；据大家所说，他们非常隐秘、难以接近。我不得不向伊夫里斯女士请教她所了解的关于他们的信息，不过得到的答案也不如我期望的那么多。 但他还是会这么做的，对吧？ 桑德斯朝你眨了眨眼。 [pc.cunningRange 70|你能看出他对此并不确定，但这个好兄弟为了你，也为了他自己，一直在强装勇敢。这也是情有可原的——在谈判中，如果对自己缺乏信心，那就毫无意义了。 ] 无论加勒特所说的那位女德鲁伊究竟是谁，至少我们可以与她进行交谈，希望能通过理性对话解决问题。正如我所说，对于这里发生的一切，我确实负有一定的责任。 [pc.name]我答应过会去做某件事，现在不会反悔的。 好吧，那就这样吧。 那么，你认为她现在在哪里呢？ [dayNight|加勒特说过，那位女德鲁伊会在晚上去河边，但现在还不是合适的时间；你可能得耐心等待一段时间，等她出现才行。 桑德斯听到这个消息后摇了摇头。 虽然遗憾，但我们不能一直无所事事。我想先去见见加勒特和那些伐木工人们，或许在与女德鲁伊会面之前，我们可以为他们做点什么。 听起来是个好主意。再说，干坐着无所事事对谁都没有帮助。最好从加勒特开始——你带头，引导桑德斯行动起来。 [party.hasCompanions|还有你的团队 ]朝着加勒特的笼子所在的那个大厅走去。在路上，你指出了那些伐木工们把自己关在里面的长屋，桑德斯点了点头。 等这次忙完之后，我们会去看看他们的，但根据你告诉我的情况，我觉得加勒特最需要我们的关注。 你不得不同意这一点；也许桑德斯能够帮助他摆脱那种困境。你走到门口，推开门，门铰链发出响亮的吱嘎声，然后你走了进去，看到了—— — 真是令人印象深刻的一幕啊。 加勒特的笼子已经被打开，门大开着。但这并不意味着他真的获得了自由——事实上，他仍然仰面躺着，脖子上还戴着项圈，这一事实恰恰证明了这一点。你的目光顺着项圈追到了连接它的牵引绳，然后又看到了牵着牵引绳的人——那个银发的女德鲁伊，她竟然一丝不挂地骑在可怜的加勒特身上。 她的阴唇在他那充血发红的阴茎上摩擦着，留下了一层黏稠的液体；而他在她的压迫下不断发出呻吟声，挣扎着。 坏狗狗！ 女德鲁伊轻声低语。 那么，是谁表现得不好呢？得到这样的零食，难道不比表现不好要好得多吗？只要你乖乖听话，就能得到更多的零食哦！ 但是加勒特根本没有在听，他的耳朵贴在脑袋上，目光紧紧地盯着你。然后他注意到桑德斯站在你身边，顿时尴尬得不行，拼命想遮住自己的脸，但显然毫无用处。 可怜的小家伙…… 桑德斯叹了口气。 "[pc.name]请您帮我拿着这根法杖，好吗？ 没错，他肯定不想在试图与那位女德鲁伊谈判时被人看到手部持武器。你从桑德斯那里拿走那根顶端镶有绿宝石的法杖，然后就会看到他向加勒特投去一个警告的眼神，仿佛在说： 别把这件事搞砸了。 这位女德鲁伊将自己从加勒特的怀抱中推了出去——尽管加勒特内心依然充满反抗与羞耻，但他暂时没有做出任何愚蠢的行为。当她转身面对桑德斯时，她的整个态度都发生了变化，她像在审视潜在对手部一样仔细地观察着他。与此同时，她的宠物战兽也从黑暗中走了出来，那身铠甲被它紧紧地咬在嘴里。 你是谁？你的目的何在？ |加勒特确实说过，那位女德鲁伊每到晚上都会去河边——去做她所谓的“交流仪式”，具体是什么意思就不得而知了。你最好先去看看情况如何。你把这件事告诉了桑德斯，那位牧师只是简短地点了点头。 那我们就往那边去吧。 是的，那样做才是最好的。你带头引导桑德斯吧。 [party.hasCompanions|还有你的团队 ]来到河岸边——希望那位德鲁伊女巫会在那里，就像预期的那样。 结果，她果然在那里。从远处望去，可以看到一个孤独的身影半浸在冰冷的水中，正在洗头发——至少，看起来是那样。 看起来 就像她在洗头发一样。那么，肯定就是这个原因了。在河岸边，另一个身影正懒洋洋地躺着，皮肤呈红褐色，体型魁梧——那一定是她的宠物战兽。桑德斯疑惑地指了指那个身影，你向他点了点头表示肯定。 好吧。 他说。 "[pc.name]请稍等一下，让我先把法杖拿好。我可不想一开始就拿着武器去接近她，那样会给人留下不好的印象。 啊，这样想确实有道理。当然。桑德斯将他那柄顶端镶有翡翠的手部杖递给你，然后你看到他以稳定的步伐走向河岸——速度慢到足以让任何人都能看到他的到来，但他的步伐却毫不迟疑、毫不动摇。 rows.original: Her commanding voice might have cowed a lesser man, but Sanders stands firm as he steps into comfortable speaking distance. "I am Brother Riordan Sanders, and I serve Velun, Old Man of the Earth. I intend to parley and plead for those who have been entrapped within this camp, and lead them safely to their homes." "So, you serve the Living Gods." Interesting that that's the first thing she caught from Sanders' words. "Yes." A moment's silence. "You don't seem too pleased about that." The druidess takes her clothes from her warg and begins shrugging them on. "No. It's not your fault, human. Three generations ago — or at least, three pale elf generations ago, the ruling family of the pale elves declared worship of the Seven Living Gods as the new religion of our people. Those who still professed faith in the Old Wyld chose to leave the Winter City, not just in protest, but for fear of reprisals, social or otherwise." "I cannot fault your animosity, then. But you are showing good faith in speaking with me." "Like I said, it's not your fault. That lies squarely with the Winter City and the house of Ridell. My name is Hethia Runasdottir — you intend to plead for the loggers?" Sanders nods. "You clearly don't want to harm them any more than they have been." "Oh? What makes you say that?" Hethia shrugs. "I seem to remember a certain would-be hero of a lupine willingly giving himself up to me so I wouldn't bother the loggers any. Maybe he was just so good a dildo that I didn't need any others?" "When I was approaching the camp, I ran up against a spell of warding; one that utilized the natural forces of the Old Forest to misdirect and turn aside those who would approach the camp. Ordinarily, anyone caught in it would end up walking in circles, lost and unaware... you are responsible for this spell, aren't you?" A huff. "So what if I am?" "You didn't have to do it. Clearly, you're possessed of enough power that leaving Westbank, despite the increased dangers of the Old Forest, would not be a problem for you. Yet you chose to remain and protect the loggers until help arrived. You wouldn't have done that if you were an evil person, Hethia Runasdottir." Slowly, Sanders holds out his hands in a placating fashion before taking a step towards Hethia. "Allow me to take this burden off your hands. Allow me to take them safely home. Westbank is finished as a logging camp for now; you have what you came for. Whatever secrets you are protecting are safe. I think I know where they lie, and when they return, they will not encroach upon what you hold dear." Hethia sighs. "I'm not entirely sure of that, considering the things that I've seen since the blizzard. I must hurry back to the ruins... wait, I'm giving in too easily!" "Is that wrong when it's the right thing to do?" Hethia looks uncomfortable — something that's startling, considering she's at least a full head taller than Sanders and much more imposing. It's just a moment, though — she composes herself in an instant and looks away. "I never meant to hurt them. I just wanted to teach them a lesson." "And that lesson has been taught. You have won." "I won't say I'm not tempted to take such a fine piece of doggy dick home, but I think I've humbled him enough and he'll just slow me down. He'll think twice before trifling with another boer'alvar." Sanders nods. "Since the night of the blizzard, there have been dire things afoot in the world. We can bicker about theology when these trying times are over, but for now we should unite and overcome this common threat. From our conversation, I gather there're more of your kind about, yes?" "My full title is Hethia Runasdottir, servant to the Old Wyld, grower of the first circle. Although, it must be said the title means little in this day and age. Not since we left the Winter City, at least — we had better sense than to remain where we were not wanted. The rest of the Pale Elves were drunk on the powers their new gods had brought them, and forgot about the forces that had sustained them for generations hence." "I'm sorry." "Hm." Hethia stares hard at Sanders. "If it were anyone else, I would accuse them of mouthing empty platitudes. But you, human... I don't know. The Old Wyld does teach that all things will eventually pass, even gods and primal forces. Perhaps it is time for it to fade away into obsolescence, too... but even then, it's still our duty to prevent it from passing because of our inaction. I would speak further with you, human priest." Brother Sanders nods, then turns to you. "[pc.name], I'm afraid I may not be joining you on the trip back. Can I count on you to get everyone safely to Hawkethorne?" 女德鲁伊从她的战争宠物那里取来衣服，开始一件件地穿上去。 不，这不是你的错，人类。三代之前——至少是三代之前 苍白精灵 几代人之前，苍白精灵的统治家族宣布将崇拜七位生神作为我们民族的新宗教。那些仍然信仰古老荒野之神的人们，选择离开冬城——这既是一种抗议，也是出于对报复的恐惧，无论是社会上的报复还是其他形式的惩罚。 那么，我无法指责你的敌意。不过，你愿意与我交谈，这已经体现了你的诚意。 正如我所说，这不是你的错。这完全是冬城和里德尔家族的责任。我叫赫希娅·鲁纳斯多蒂尔——你打算为那些伐木工人们求情吗？ 桑德斯点了点头。 你显然并不想再给他们带来更多的伤害了。 哦？你为什么这么认为？ 赫希娅耸了耸肩。 我似乎记得有个自封为英雄的家伙，主动把自己交给我，这样我就不用去打扰那些伐木工了。也许他实在太‘好用’了，以至于我根本不需要其他的替代品吧？ 当我接近营地时，遇到了一个防护法术——这个法术利用了古旧森林中的自然力量，来迷惑那些试图接近营地的人，使他们迷失方向、无法前进……这个法术应该是你设下的吧？ 哼。 那又怎样，如果我就是这样的呢？ 你本不必这么做的。显然，你拥有足够的力量，因此即便旧森林的危险加剧，离开西岸对你来说也不是什么问题。然而你还是选择留下来，保护那些伐木工人们，直到援助到来。如果你是一个邪恶的人，赫希娅 Runasdottir，你是不会这么做的。 慢慢地，桑德斯伸出双手部，做出安抚的动作，然后朝赫希娅走了过去。 让我来替您卸下这个负担吧。让我把它们安全地带回家。目前，Westbank已经不再是一个伐木营地了；您已经得到了想要的东西。无论您在保护哪些秘密，它们都安然无恙。我想我知道它们在哪里，等它们被取回时，一定不会侵犯到您珍视的东西。 赫希娅叹了口气。 考虑到自那场暴风雪以来我所看到的一切，我其实并不太确定……我必须赶紧回到那些废墟中去……等等，我是不是太轻易就放弃了呢？ 如果这是正确的事情，那么这样做有错吗？ 赫希娅看起来显得很不自在——考虑到她至少比桑德斯高出一个头，体型也更加魁梧，这样的反应实在令人惊讶。不过，这也只是短暂的一瞬间而已，她很快便恢复了镇定，然后将目光移开了。 我从来都不是有意要伤害他们的，我只是想给他们一个教训而已。 这个教训已经得到了传达。你们赢了。 这算不上什么真正的胜利。 桑德斯笑了。 所以，你打算放他们走？包括那个自封的英雄也是吗？ 赫希娅犹豫了一下，但还是点了点头。 我得承认，看到这么漂亮的家伙，我确实很想把它带回家，但我想我已经让他知道我的厉害了，所以他应该会不敢轻举妄动。他再也不敢随便招惹别的‘布尔雄狮’了。 桑德斯点了点头。 自从暴风雪的那个夜晚以来，世界上发生了一些非常糟糕的事情。我必须承认，我们虽然隶属于不同的势力，但彼此之间也存在分歧。然而，我想我们谁都不希望萨瓦拉陷入这样的腐败之中。等这些艰难的时刻过去后，我们可以再讨论那些理论上的分歧，但现在，我们应该团结起来，共同应对这一共同的威胁。从我们的谈话中，我了解到，像你们这样的人还有很多，对吧？ This large expanse of open space is where most of the logging camp's work took place. Directly in front of the gates, it's where branches were hewn off the great trees hauled into the camp and split into uniform lengths before being floated downstream to the sawmill by Hawkethorne. Rotting wood chips and splintered branches lay strewn about in the mud, churned to a soft, brown mess by multitudes of footsteps, testament to the once bustling activity of the loggers.

    To one side stands an open-air shed, filled with tools of all kinds. Saws, axes, planes, a workbench, weights and measures, barrels of nails and other various sundry supplies. To the other, what might have been a smokehouse filled with drying racks, but the blizzard's made short work of that one — the roof's been torn off by the winds, and a gaping hole's been blown in one of the wooden walls. Neither building looks like it holds anything that could be of use to you, so there's no point to investigating further.
    
    Surrounding the entire logging camp is a palisade wall; most of the palings are still upright and firm, despite the blizzard having knocked a few askew. At least the damage isn't so great as to be obvious to anyone watching from a distance, which is probably to your advantage.
    
    What now? The river lies to the west, the longhouses to the north, and the eastern side of camp is dominated by one particularly large building, and to the south, the exit still waits should you wish to beat a retreat.

这片广阔的开放空间正是伐木营地大部分作业的进行地。就在大门的正前方，这里是人们从那些被运进营地的巨树上砍下树枝，将其切成统一长度后，再通过鹰棘镇运往锯木厂的地方。腐烂的木屑和碎裂的树枝散落在泥泞中，被无数人的脚步踩得变得软软的、呈棕色，这一切都在见证着这里曾经一度繁忙的伐木活动。

    一侧有一间露天棚屋，里面堆满了各式各样的工具：锯子、斧头、刨子、工作台、测量工具，还有成桶的钉子以及其他各种杂物。另一侧原本可能是用来熏制肉类的房子，但现在里面堆满了晾晒架，不过暴风雪把那里破坏得一干二净——屋顶被大风掀掉了，其中一面木墙上也出现了一个巨大的洞。这两间房子里似乎都没有什么对你有用的东西，所以继续调查也没有意义了。
    
    整个伐木营地周围都筑有栅栏墙；尽管暴风雪把其中一些栅栏撞得歪歪扭扭，但大部分仍然竖立着，十分坚固。至少这种损坏程度还不足以被远处的人察觉，这对你们来说或许是个有利因素。
    
    现在该怎么办？河流在西方，长屋在北方，营地的东侧有一座特别大的建筑，而南方则是出口，如果你想撤退的话，那里随时可以离开。
rows.raw:
"
    This large expanse of open space is where most of the logging camp's work took place. Directly in front of the gates, it's where branches were hewn off the great trees hauled into the camp and split into uniform lengths before being floated downstream to the sawmill by Hawkethorne. Rotting wood chips and splintered branches lay strewn about in the mud, churned to a soft, brown mess by multitudes of footsteps, testament to the once bustling activity of the loggers.

    To one side stands an open-air shed, filled with tools of all kinds. Saws, axes, planes, a workbench, weights and measures, barrels of nails and other various sundry supplies. To the other, what might have been a smokehouse filled with drying racks, but the blizzard's made short work of that one — the roof's been torn off by the winds, and a gaping hole's been blown in one of the wooden walls. Neither building looks like it holds anything that could be of use to you, so there's no point to investigating further.
    
    Surrounding the entire logging camp is a palisade wall; most of the palings are still upright and firm, despite the blizzard having knocked a few askew. At least the damage isn't so great as to be obvious to anyone watching from a distance, which is probably to your advantage.
    
    What now? The river lies to the west, the longhouses to the north, and the eastern side of camp is dominated by one particularly large building, and to the south, the exit still waits should you wish to beat a retreat."

rows.original: You're standing in what once was the focus of the logging camp's social life. While nowhere as big as the Frost Hound, this hall has been built in a traditional lupine style of the Frost Marches — a high, sloping roof to shake off snow buildup, straight wooden walls smoothed to perfection, several central beams to support the whole shebang. The beams themselves have been carved with various patterns that you [pc.ora lupine|recognize as being out of various lupine legends from your childhood.|are not quite sure of. There's a lot of swirly patterning going on, but there's no clue as to what the carvings might actually mean.] A firepit ringed by rocks sits in the middle of the hall, easily large enough to hang a cauldron over by the nearby spit and hooks. Empty benches and tables line either wall to your left and right, abandoned and mouldering away; there's an old pitcher and empty plate on one of them slowly gathering dust, but little else of note. Lining the walls are several pelts and furs that appear to have been taken from local creatures, wolves included — evidently, lupines have no qualms about hunting and skinning things that look like them. Finally, there's a large, iron-barred cage tucked in a corner by the head of the hall. [var0 |Garret is sitting on the floor of his cage, with as much dignity as the sort of animal his prison was made for — which is to say, very little. To be fair, it's hard to look dignified when one's stuck in a rusting iron cage, naked save for a leather collar about his neck. A tag hangs from it, "Dog" scratched onto the bronzed surface. To say that Garret is rather upset about his predicament would be an understatement of the greatest proportions, but at least he's stopped worrying at the bars of his cage, trusting you to deal with his situation in a swift and efficient manner. You're going to do that, aren't you? |There appears to be someone sitting in it — a rather large someone — but you can't quite make out who or what it is in the dim light of the hall. You'd have to get closer, which can't be that bad of a decision, can it? After all, whoever it is, he or she is stuck in that cage. ]
rows.translation: 你现在站在这个曾经是伐木营地社交活动中心的地方。虽然这个大厅没有“霜猎犬”那么庞大，但它却是按照霜冻边境地区的传统建筑风格建造的——高高的斜屋顶有助于清除积雪，轻型滑的木质墙壁经过精心加工，几根中央横梁共同支撑着整个建筑结构。这些横梁上还雕刻着各种图案 [pc.ora lupine|这些形象在你童年时听过的各种狼人传说中都有出现过。|我不太确定。那些图案看起来非常复杂，但却完全不知道这些雕刻实际上代表着什么。 意思是.] 大厅中央有一个被石头围起来的火坑，其大小足以让一口大锅悬挂在附近的烤架和挂钩上。你的左右两侧各排列着一些空荡荡的长凳和桌子，它们已被遗弃，上面布满了霉菌；其中一张长凳上放着一个旧水壶和一块空盘子，它们正在慢慢积满灰尘，除此之外，这里并没有什么值得注意的东西。 墙壁上挂着几张皮毛，显然这些都是从当地动物身上获取的，其中也包括狼的皮毛——显然，这些狼并没有丝毫犹豫，会捕猎那些与它们外形相似的动物并将其剥皮。 最后，在大厅的尽头的一个角落里，还摆放着一个用铁条围起来的大笼子。 [var0 |加勒特坐在笼子的地板上，尽他这种被关在铁笼里的动物所能表现出的“尊严”——其实这种尊严几乎为零。公平地说，当一个人被关在生锈的铁笼里，身上只戴着一条皮项圈时，确实很难保持什么尊严可言。 上面挂着一个标签，铜质表面上刻着“狗”字。 说加勒特对自己目前的处境感到非常沮丧，那简直还是轻描淡写了；不过至少他不再在笼子的栏杆前忧心忡忡，因为他相信你会迅速而有效地解决他的问题。 你打算这么做，对吧？ |看起来里面有人坐着——一个体型相当庞大的人——但在大厅昏暗的光线中，你无法看清那到底是谁或什么。你得靠近一些看看，这个决定应该不会太糟糕吧？毕竟，不管那个人是谁，他或她现在都被困在那个笼子里了。 ]

rows.original: There's nothing between Shar and the stoop of the old wizard's abode ahead except for an old, moss-covered statue standing in the middle of a fountain that's long since dried up. The statue's endured the test of time about as well as a statue should, its human form withered and cracked, and one arm fallen off entirely. The other holds a huge bladed staff in hand; perhaps this was once an effigy of the wizard Shar's here to visit? Or one of his ancestors, more likely.
rows.translation: 在莎尔与前方那位老巫师住所的门槛之间，除了矗立在早已干涸的喷泉中央的一座被苔藓覆盖的古老雕像外，再没有什么其他东西了。这座雕像在时间的侵蚀下依然保持着应有的形态——它的身体已经干枯开裂，一只手臂也完全脱落了，而另一只手中还紧握着一根巨大的法杖。或许这曾经是用来纪念来到这里的巫师莎尔？或者更有可能的是，它代表着莎尔的某位祖先。
rows.raw: "\n    There's nothing between Shar and the stoop of the old wizard's abode ahead except for an old, moss-covered statue standing in the middle of a fountain that's long since dried up. The statue's endured the test of time about as well as a statue should, its human form withered and cracked, and one arm fallen off entirely. The other holds a huge bladed staff in hand; perhaps this was once an effigy of the wizard Shar's here to visit? Or one of his ancestors, more likely."

rows.original: You're standing in the overgrown and ruined courtyard, just outside the wizard's tower. The remains of the golem still remain, littered around the courtyard. There's no way you're going to be able to harvest or lift the remains of it — or get the fountain working — so it seems like your work here is done.
rows.translation: 你站在那片杂草丛生、一片荒废的院子里，就在巫师塔的外面。那个魔像的残骸仍然散落在院子的各处。你根本不可能把这些残骸收集起来，也不可能让那座喷泉重新运转起来——所以看来，你在这里的任务已经完成了。
rows.raw: "\n    You're standing in the overgrown and ruined courtyard, just outside the wizard's tower. The remains of the golem still remain, littered around the courtyard. There's no way you're going to be able to harvest or lift the remains of it — or get the fountain working — so it seems like your work here is done."

rows.original:
Further on down the passageway, what little light that's filtered in along with you has quickly petered out, as have the moss and vines. There're still multitudes of roots clinging to the walls and hanging from the ceiling, peeking in through chips and cracks in the stonework, and the earthy scent to everything only intensifies along with the humidity as you push on into the darkness.

    Perhaps one day natural forces will fully consume this place, but for now it appears that an equilibrium has been reached. Surprisingly, the air here is far from stale, the draft that greeted you at the entrance still going strong — perhaps even moreso than it was before.
    
    [flags.SHRINE_PUZZLE 2
        |Further on down the passageway, you spy the now-open double doors inviting you further into the belly of the earth. Darkness awaits... 
        |However, the passage comes to an abrupt end. Barring your path is another set of double stone doors which spans the passageway — for some reason, the draft passes through it without a hitch, but a cautious touch confirms that it indeed is very solid and real to you.
    
        Another one of these gem puzzles, eh? One wonders who would build such a thing and why...
    ]
rows.translation:
在通道的更深处，那些与你一同进入这里的微弱轻型线早已消失无踪，苔藓和藤蔓也全都不见了踪迹。仍然有许多根系紧紧附着在墙壁上，或悬挂在天花板上，从石墙的裂缝中探出头来。而随着你继续深入黑暗，那种泥土的气息会因为湿度的增加而变得更加浓烈。

    或许有一天，自然力量会彻底摧毁这个地方，但目前来看，这里似乎已经达到了某种平衡状态。令人惊讶的是，这里的空气一点也不闷热，入口处迎面吹来的微风依然强劲——甚至可能比之前更加猛烈。
    
    [flags.SHRINE_PUZZLE 2
        |在通道的更远处，你看到了那扇已经敞开的双开门，它们正在邀请你继续深入地底。黑暗正在那里等待着你…… 
        |然而，这段通道突然结束了。在你的前方，又有一扇由双层石块构成的大门，横跨着整个通道——出于某种原因，空气可以毫无阻碍地穿过它，但当你小心翼翼地触碰它时，会确认这扇门确实非常坚固、真实存在。

又是一道这样的谜题啊……人们不禁会想知道，究竟是谁建造了这样的东西，又是出于什么目的……
    ]

rows.original: This deep into the hill, you're pretty sure you're beneath ground level. The passageway widens into a room, perhaps in slightly less disrepair than the passageway leading out to the Old Forest, but that's not really saying much. The brick flooring has cracking in a corner forming a depression, and the steady drip-drip-drip of water echoes about you as water collects in it. Fat mushrooms grow from the walls here, each one as large as your clenched fist, clumps of them in a creamy brown-white and speckled with yellow spots on their caps. There really shouldn't be enough light to see anything by — or any light at all, for that matter — but an eerie bluish glow pervades the air here, flickering slightly as it illuminates your surroundings. You're reminded — no, it is the same blue glow which infused the waterfall you passed on your way here. Perhaps its source is close by? Here and there you spy decor — a carved stone lamp here, an archway there, but more importantly the occasional sign of past residence makes itself known — a shard of pottery, a few scraps of mold-eaten leather, the remnants of what once might have been a garment. Other passageways lead off from the main path, but all of them have been blocked off by cave-ins; the rubble looks rugged, ruddy, and very much impassable. Oh well. As you near the end of the passageway, across a small stone bridge that spans an underground river, you spy [flags.SHRINE_PUZZLE 3 |the door to the innermost part of this burrow, open now that you've solved its puzzle. There's nothing barring your way at this point; you could head on right in if you so chose. |yet another one of those stone double doors blocking your way into the burrow. Barrow? Well, burrow is probably a more apt term for this place anyway. Hopefully this silly little puzzle isn't too much harder than the last two were. ]
rows.translation: 在这片山腹深处，你完全可以确定自己已经处于地下层了。通道逐渐变宽，最终形成了一间房间。虽然这个房间的破败程度似乎比通往旧森林的那条通道要轻一些，但这也说明不了太多问题。 砖砌的地板在某个角落出现了裂缝，形成了一个凹陷处，水不断从裂缝中滴落下来，发出持续不断的滴答声。水积聚在那个凹陷里，发出回声。在这里的墙壁上，长出了肥大的蘑菇，每一朵都有一只握紧的拳头那么大，它们成簇生长，菌盖呈现出奶油棕白色的颜色，上面还点缀着黄色的斑点。 这里本不该有足够的轻型线让你看清任何东西——事实上，根本就不应该有任何轻型线——但一种诡异的蓝轻型却弥漫在空气中，微微闪烁着，照亮了你周围的环境。这让你不禁想到……不，其实是 是 那种同样的蓝色轻型芒，正是你在此途中经过的瀑布所散发出来的。或许它的源头就在附近吧？ 在这里或那里，你会看到一些装饰元素——这里有一盏雕刻石制灯笼，那里有一座拱门，但更重要的是，那些能让人联想到过去有人居住过的痕迹也会时不时地出现在你的视线中：一块陶器碎片，几片被霉菌侵蚀过的皮革，或许还有一些曾经是衣物的残余。 其他通道都从主路分岔出来，但它们都被山体坍塌给堵住了；那些碎石看起来杂乱无章、颜色发红，根本无法通行。唉，算了。 当你即将走完这条通道时，穿过一座横跨地下河流的小石桥，你突然看到了 [flags.SHRINE_PUZZLE 3 |现在你已经解开了这个谜题，通往这个洞穴最深处的大门也就敞开了。此时没有任何东西会阻挡你的去路；如果你愿意，可以直接走进去。 |又是一扇石制的双开门，挡住了你进入这个洞穴的路。洞穴？嗯，其实“洞穴”这个词用来形容这个地方倒也挺合适的。希望这个愚蠢的小谜题不会比前两个更难吧。 ]
