rows.original: Huddled together like rats [party.has einin|— or in Einin's case, a literal rat — ]atop the ice raft, you wait for the ship to reach its final destination. Which it does before too long, as the raft shakes and judders as the ship slows to a stop. You hear several orders barked from above, the sound too far away and indistinct for you to make out the words, but what happens next gives context to the whole matter: there's a loud creaking of ancient wood, followed shortly by numerous splashes of heavy things hitting the water. Grimacing, Gweyr leans on the edge of the raft, peering as far as this angle will allow her. The old wolfess' eyes widen, and then she settles back, chewing her lip. "[pc.name]." No longer [pc.mf|kid|girl] any more, eh? "I'm no longer in the mood to tease. Take a look at this." You swap places with Gweyr, and she holds onto you while you take a gander at what's going on. While you can't see the side of the ship from here, you manage to spy the very edge of the platform the opened half of the cargo hold has created. That, and the bundles and packs being tossed into the water with loud splashes. Several demons are treading water in the icy ocean, guiding the jettisoned cargo downwards for a little while before resurfacing. Visibility is still miserable given the thick, icy fog that hangs just over the water's surface, but the voices and silhouettes moving around atop the surface are unmistakable. They're dumping the hold's contents. The barrels you saw on the way in, weighed down by all kinds of bulky material, and wrapped up as best as possible against the cold and wet. Exotic goods, with the more mundane cleverly attached as ballast — all of them sinking down to the ocean floor, into the cold and dark. [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona kiyoko atugia quintillus azyrran einin |"What are they doing?" Cait breathes, her voice hushed. "They packed their hold to the brim with all that stuff just to throw it away here? But why? I know those creeps are crazy, but not like that; what gives?" Your best guess is that they're not throwing away their cargo, but sending it down. There are all kinds of aquatic peoples who'd take this stuff — is this some kind of payment Tollus's cult is handing out to buy their loyalty? |"There's just so much," Brint muses as he takes in the sight over your shoulder. "This really feels like a gigantic waste... but that's not what's happening here, is it?" If he's thinking what you're thinking, no. With all the aquatic peoples about in these parts — not to mention that the demons are impervious to the cold — they're certainly being sent somewhere instead of being thrown away. Maybe this is some kind of payment Tollus's cult is handing out to buy the locals' loyalty? "... Might be," Gweyr replies at last. "I can't speak for the siorcs, but there're a half-dozen herds of selkies in the rift alone and they have their own directions. I know the one I'm dealing with are good, but that just leaves the loyalties of the other herds up in the air, especially if Tollus and his goons can fast-talk them." "That's got to be some work they're doing for the cult if they're being bought off with so much, then." |"There's just so much," Brienne muses as she takes in the sight over your shoulder. "This really feels like a gigantic waste... but that's not what's happening here, is it?" If she's thinking what you're thinking, no. With all the aquatic peoples about in these parts — not to mention that the demons are impervious to the cold — they're certainly being sent somewhere instead of being thrown away. Maybe this is some kind of payment Tollus's cult is handing out to buy the locals' loyalty? "... Might be," Gweyr replies at last. "I can't speak for the siorcs, but there're a half-dozen herds of selkies in the rift alone and they have their own directions. I know the one I'm dealing with are good, but that just leaves the loyalties of the other herds up in the air, especially if Tollus and his goons can fast-talk them." "That's got to be some work they're doing for the cult if they're being bought off with so much, then." |"Shit, what a fucking waste," Arona growls softly as she watches the cargo being jettisoned. "Ships would do that when it was clear they couldn't outrun us... just throw their stuff away so we wouldn't be able to take it from them." You suppose that the Kervus would just throw the captured crew into the water and make them retrieve the goods anyway. "Ha, yeah, that's what we'd do! How'd you know?" Just a hunch. |"Ah. No doubt there will be people beneath the water to receive these goods." You eye your fox-wife. How can she be so sure? "While it is tempting to assume stupidity and irrationality of one's enemies to make oneself feel better, such assumptions are traps. There is clearly a purpose to these demons' actions; since they are not throwing these goods away, it only stands to reason that they are being transported to people who will use them beneath the waves. We already know that such peoples exist, and the demons themselves are not hindered by icy water. It is a distinct possibility." Well, Kiyoko does have a point. Tollus and his senior posse may be evil and deranged, but they're not crazy, or at least not in that sense. Yeah, they wouldn't be throwing away good supplies for the kicks of it, there's got to be more to this. |"They're just throwin' away that stuff?" Tui whispers, peering over your shoulder. "That doesn't make sense at all." No, it doesn't, but then Tollus's cult has been unpredictable, to say the least. "Don't know about that. I don't even think they're really dumpin' all that — they're just sendin' it somewhere, is my guess." |"Huh," Quintillus muses as he observes the scene over your shoulder. "They're sending all that stuff down there? I'd have thought they were just throwing it away... but as dumb as they are, Tollus's goons aren't that dumb." It looks too much like work, true. None of the demons are particularly having fun tossing all the goods out of the open hold and into the water. "Maybe I should rethink a few things, that's all. If Tollus can actually build some sort of camp underwater... how the fuck would that even work, anyway? You wouldn't be able to lay mortar like that. Still, I wouldn't put it past him, especially if he's got that demon queen bitch helping run things and giving him stuff." |"Now that's efficient," Azyrran muses with a hushed chuckle as she watches the demons go at it through the mist. "Busy little bees, aren't they? If we didn't have a higher calling right now, I'd be tempted to raid them." She may just get the chance to do that regardless. "They're just throwing all that stuff away... no, it can't be. It's too regular, too ordered to be anything but work. I'd be just as miserable if I were up to my neck in freezing water — just sitting on this raft is chilling my thighs and bum off." Well, maybe you'll warm he rup later, but for now you do need to keep your focus on the mission at hand. |"Oooh, it burns me up just watching them do that," Einin says as she peeks over your shoulder at the demons. "I know they're not really throwing it all away, but even so...!" She knows they're not throwing all these goods away? What makes her so sure? "It's far too much work to gather all the demons, sail out to this very place, then dump their cargo for no good reason. They could've done that anywhere, but sailing all the way out here? Tollus and his senior posse may be evil and deranged, but they're not crazy, or at least not in that sense. They wouldn't be throwing away good supplies for the kicks of it, there's got to be more to this. Call it a thief's intuition — I'd have been smelling salvage if they were throwing all this away just for fun." Well, her thief's intuition has served you well on this trip so far, so you'll take her word for it. |Hmm... ] Gweyr considers the sight a little longer, scratching her chin. "By the by, I heard you just now. That's not the ocean floor we're talking of here." It isn't? "The selkies and siorcs tell me that this is one of the deepest trenches around. If they're throwing all this crap down there, it's all ending up far, far deeper than just the regular ocean floor about these parts." Hmm... "I don't have all the pieces, but the picture's starting to come together. The jotuns tell me that there's been good fishing of late, that giant squids, octopi and other deep-sea nasties have been spotted coming out of the trenches where they live. They don't usually do that because they're used to the deep dark, but something's spooked them out of their homes." Tollus and his shenanigans. "A safe bet. Either way..." reaching into her gambeson, Gweyr pulls out a small bladder, blows into it to inflate the thing, then sets out bobbing by the side of the raft. "There, a buoy to mark the place." Won't it float away? "It's enchanted — my siorc friends will come get it later and remember exactly where this was for us. This stretch of ocean may look pretty indistinguishable from up top, but under the sea is a different matter altogether." You shake your head. First the ice raft, then the enshrouding mist, and now this. How many favors has she called in just to be able to pull this off, and from how many people? "About a year's worth, give or take a couple months. Who you know and favors owed you are basically the only currency that's worth anything up here, [pc.mf|kid|girl]." You would've said more, but your attention's drawn towards a series of barked orders from the open side of the ship's hold. The voice is nasal yet gravelly — perhaps it was once higher, but damaged in some way. It certainly doesn't sound natural, if nothing else.
rows.translation: 挤作一团，就像一群老鼠一样。 [party.has einin|——或者像艾宁的情况那样，实际上是一只老鼠—— ]在冰筏上，你等待着船只抵达最终目的地。不久之后，船只果然停了下来，冰筏也随之开始摇晃震动。你听到上方传来几声命令，但声音太远了，你无法听清具体在说什么。然而接下来发生的事情为整个情景提供了线索：一阵古老的木头发出的嘎吱声响起，紧接着便是许多重物落入水中的溅水声。 格韦尔面露痛苦之色，倚在筏子的边缘，尽可能地往远处望去。那位老女狼的眼睛瞪得大大的，随后她又放松下来，开始咬着自己的嘴唇。[pc.name]不再 [pc.mf|小孩|女孩] 我再也没有心情开玩笑啦。看看这个吧。” 你和格温尔交换了位置，她紧紧握住你的手，而你则仔细观察着前方发生的一切。虽然从这里看不到飞船的侧面，但你还是设法看到了货物舱被打开后所形成的平台边缘。 还有那些被扔进水中的包裹，它们落入水中时发出了巨大的水花声。有几只恶魔在冰冷的海洋中游动，它们将那些被抛出的货物引导向下，过了一会儿才重新浮出水面。由于水面上笼罩着厚厚的冰雾，能见度仍然很低，但那些在水面上移动的声音和身影，却再也无法被混淆了。 他们正在将船舱里的物品全部倾倒出去。你在进入船舱时看到的那些桶，里面装满了各种笨重的货物，还被仔细地包裹起来，以抵御寒冷和潮湿的环境。这些珍稀的货物，而那些较为普通的物品则被巧妙地用来作为压舱物——所有这些都被扔进了海洋，沉到了冰冷而暗影的海底。 [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona kiyoko atugia quintillus azyrran einin |他们在干什么？”凯特轻声问道，声音低得几乎听不见。“他们把船舱塞得满满当当，就为了把这些东西扔到这里来？但为什么呢？我知道那些人很古怪，但也不至于做到这种地步；这到底是怎么回事？” 最有可能的解释是，他们并不是在丢弃这些货物，而是要把它们送到别的地方去。肯定有各种各样的水生生物会需要这些东西——难道这是托卢斯教派为了换取他们的忠诚而发放的某种报酬吗？ |真的太多了，”布林特边看着你身后的一幕边喃喃道，“这简直就是巨大的浪费……但实际情况并非如此，对吧？” 如果他也在想你正在想的事情，那么答案是否定的。 考虑到这一带有很多水生种族，更不用说那些恶魔根本不受寒冷的影响，他们被送到某个地方而不是被丢弃，肯定是有什么原因的。也许这是托卢斯教派为了换取当地人的忠诚而提供的一种补偿吧？ 她或许无论如何都能得到这个机会。 “他们把那些东西都扔掉了……不，不可能。这一切都太有规律、太有条理了，肯定是在工作。如果我被冻在水里，处境也会一样糟糕—— just坐在这个筏子上，我的大腿和屁股都已经冻得发麻了。嗯，也许之后你会有机会让她暖和起来，但现在你确实需要把注意力集中在手头的任务上。 |哦，光是看着他们那么做就让我觉得心疼不已，”艾宁一边从你肩膀后面偷看那些恶魔，一边说道，“我知道他们其实并不是真的要把那些东西都扔掉，但即便如此……！” 她知道他们并没有把那些货物都扔掉？ 她为什么会这么确定呢？ “把所有的恶魔聚集起来，航行到这个地方，然后毫无理由地把它们的‘货物’扔在这里，这样的麻烦实在太大了。他们完全可以在其他任何地方做这件事，为什么非要特意航行到这里呢？ “我还没有掌握所有的线索，但整个画面已经开始逐渐清晰起来。那些巨兽们告诉我，最近捕鱼的收获相当不错，人们发现巨大的乌贼、章鱼以及其他深海生物纷纷从它们生活的深渊中游了出来。它们通常不会这样做的，因为它们已经习惯了那里的暗影环境，但显然有什么东西把它们吓出了家园。 托卢斯和他的那些恶作剧…… “这肯定是个可靠的办法。不管怎样……”格温尔从自己的护身衣里拿出一个小气囊，吹气使其膨胀，然后把它放在筏子旁边。“这样，就能用这个浮标来标记这个位置了。” 这个浮标不会被水流冲走吧？ 这地方被施了魔法——我的朋友们稍后会来取走它，并且会清楚地记住我们把东西放在了这里。从上面看，这片海域可能看起来和别的地方没什么区别，但到了海底，情况就完全不同了。” 你摇了摇头。先是冰筏，然后是笼罩一切的迷雾，现在又是这个魔法。她究竟请了多少人帮忙，才得以完成这一切呢？ 大概有一年的时间，上下浮动几个月吧。在这里，你认识的人以及他们给你的帮助，基本上才是真正有价值的‘货币’。 rows.raw: " Huddled together like rats [party.has einin|— or in Einin's case, a literal rat — ]atop the ice raft, you wait for the ship to reach its final destination. Which it does before too long, as the raft shakes and judders as the ship slows to a stop. You hear several orders barked from above, the sound too far away and indistinct for you to make out the words, but what happens next gives context to the whole matter: there's a loud creaking of ancient wood, followed shortly by numerous splashes of heavy things hitting the water. Grimacing, Gweyr leans on the edge of the raft, peering as far as this angle will allow her. The old wolfess' eyes widen, and then she settles back, chewing her lip. "[pc.name]." No longer [pc.mf|kid|girl] any more, eh? "I'm no longer in the mood to tease. Take a look at this." You swap places with Gweyr, and she holds onto you while you take a gander at what's going on. While you can't see the side of the ship from here, you manage to spy the very edge of the platform the opened half of the cargo hold has created. That, and the bundles and packs being tossed into the water with loud splashes. Several demons are treading water in the icy ocean, guiding the jettisoned cargo downwards for a little while before resurfacing. Visibility is still miserable given the thick, icy fog that hangs just over the water's surface, but the voices and silhouettes moving around atop the surface are unmistakable. They're dumping the hold's contents. The barrels you saw on the way in, weighed down by all kinds of bulky material, and wrapped up as best as possible against the cold and wet. Exotic goods, with the more mundane cleverly attached as ballast — all of them sinking down to the ocean floor, into the cold and dark. [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona kiyoko atugia quintillus azyrran einin |"What are they doing?" Cait breathes, her voice hushed. "They packed their hold to the brim with all that stuff just to throw it away here? But why? I know those creeps are crazy, but not like that; what gives?" Your best guess is that they're not throwing away their cargo, but sending it down. There are all kinds of aquatic peoples who'd take this stuff — is this some kind of payment Tollus's cult is handing out to buy their loyalty? |"There's just so much," Brint muses as he takes in the sight over your shoulder. "This really feels like a gigantic waste... but that's not what's happening here, is it?" If he's thinking what you're thinking, no. With all the aquatic peoples about in these parts — not to mention that the demons are impervious to the cold — they're certainly being sent somewhere instead of being thrown away. Maybe this is some kind of payment Tollus's cult is handing out to buy the locals' loyalty? "... Might be," Gweyr replies at last. "I can't speak for the siorcs, but there're a half-dozen herds of selkies in the rift alone and they have their own directions. I know the one I'm dealing with are good, but that just leaves the loyalties of the other herds up in the air, especially if Tollus and his goons can fast-talk them." "That's got to be some work they're doing for the cult if they're being bought off with so much, then." |"There's just so much," Brienne muses as she takes in the sight over your shoulder. "This really feels like a gigantic waste... but that's not what's happening here, is it?" If she's thinking what you're thinking, no. With all the aquatic peoples about in these parts — not to mention that the demons are impervious to the cold — they're certainly being sent somewhere instead of being thrown away. Maybe this is some kind of payment Tollus's cult is handing out to buy the locals' loyalty? "... Might be," Gweyr replies at last. "I can't speak for the siorcs, but there're a half-dozen herds of selkies in the rift alone and they have their own directions. I know the one I'm dealing with are good, but that just leaves the loyalties of the other herds up in the air, especially if Tollus and his goons can fast-talk them." "That's got to be some work they're doing for the cult if they're being bought off with so much, then." |"Shit, what a fucking waste," Arona growls softly as she watches the cargo being jettisoned. "Ships would do that when it was clear they couldn't outrun us... just throw their stuff away so we wouldn't be able to take it from them." You suppose that the Kervus would just throw the captured crew into the water and make them retrieve the goods anyway. "Ha, yeah, that's what we'd do! How'd you know?" Just a hunch. |"Ah. No doubt there will be people beneath the water to receive these goods." You eye your fox-wife. How can she be so sure? "While it is tempting to assume stupidity and irrationality of one's enemies to make oneself feel better, such assumptions are traps. There is clearly a purpose to these demons' actions; since they are not throwing these goods away, it only stands to reason that they are being transported to people who will use them beneath the waves. We already know that such peoples exist, and the demons themselves are not hindered by icy water. It is a distinct possibility." Well, Kiyoko does have a point. Tollus and his senior posse may be evil and deranged, but they're not crazy, or at least not in that sense. Yeah, they wouldn't be throwing away good supplies for the kicks of it, there's got to be more to this. |"They're just throwin' away that stuff?" Tui whispers, peering over your shoulder. "That doesn't make sense at all." No, it doesn't, but then Tollus's cult has been unpredictable, to say the least. "Don't know about that. I don't even think they're really dumpin' all that — they're just sendin' it somewhere, is my guess." |"Huh," Quintillus muses as he observes the scene over your shoulder. "They're sending all that stuff down there? I'd have thought they were just throwing it away... but as dumb as they are, Tollus's goons aren't that dumb." It looks too much like work, true. None of the demons are particularly having fun tossing all the goods out of the open hold and into the water. "Maybe I should rethink a few things, that's all. If Tollus can actually build some sort of camp underwater... how the fuck would that even work, anyway? You wouldn't be able to lay mortar like that. Still, I wouldn't put it past him, especially if he's got that demon queen bitch helping run things and giving him stuff." |"Now that's efficient," Azyrran muses with a hushed chuckle as she watches the demons go at it through the mist. "Busy little bees, aren't they? If we didn't have a higher calling right now, I'd be tempted to raid them." She may just get the chance to do that regardless. "They're just throwing all that stuff away... no, it can't be. It's too regular, too ordered to be anything but work. I'd be just as miserable if I were up to my neck in freezing water — just sitting on this raft is chilling my thighs and bum off." Well, maybe you'll warm he rup later, but for now you do need to keep your focus on the mission at hand. |"Oooh, it burns me up just watching them do that," Einin says as she peeks over your shoulder at the demons. "I know they're not really throwing it all away, but even so...!" She knows they're not throwing all these goods away? What makes her so sure? "It's far too much work to gather all the demons, sail out to this very place, then dump their cargo for no good reason. They could've done that anywhere, but sailing all the way out here? Tollus and his senior posse may be evil and deranged, but they're not crazy, or at least not in that sense. They wouldn't be throwing away good supplies for the kicks of it, there's got to be more to this. Call it a thief's intuition — I'd have been smelling salvage if they were throwing all this away just for fun." Well, her thief's intuition has served you well on this trip so far, so you'll take her word for it. |Hmm... ] Gweyr considers the sight a little longer, scratching her chin. "By the by, I heard you just now. That's not the ocean floor we're talking of here." It isn't? "The selkies and siorcs tell me that this is one of the deepest trenches around. If they're throwing all this crap down there, it's all ending up far, far deeper than just the regular ocean floor about these parts." Hmm... "I don't have all the pieces, but the picture's starting to come together. The jotuns tell me that there's been good fishing of late, that giant squids, octopi and other deep-sea nasties have been spotted coming out of the trenches where they live. They don't usually do that because they're used to the deep dark, but something's spooked them out of their homes." Tollus and his shenanigans. "A safe bet. Either way..." reaching into her gambeson, Gweyr pulls out a small bladder, blows into it to inflate the thing, then sets out bobbing by the side of the raft. "There, a buoy to mark the place." Won't it float away? "It's enchanted — my siorc friends will come get it later and remember exactly where this was for us. This stretch of ocean may look pretty indistinguishable from up top, but under the sea is a different matter altogether." You shake your head. First the ice raft, then the enshrouding mist, and now this. How many favors has she called in just to be able to pull this off, and from how many people? "About a year's worth, give or take a couple months. Who you know and favors owed you are basically the only currency that's worth anything up here, [pc.mf|kid|girl]." You would've said more, but your attention's drawn towards a series of barked orders from the open side of the ship's hold. The voice is nasal yet gravelly — perhaps it was once higher, but damaged in some way. It certainly doesn't sound natural, if nothing else. "

rows.original: "All right, you sorry excuses — I'm going down to report to the master. All of you wait here for a few more minutes, and the cargo you requested will be bobbing up to you no problems. My crew will help you load it onto the ship, and then you can head on back without me; the master himself has asked for my personal involvement with a project of his. Do you understand? And secure them better next time — this last batch took some pains to gather on such short notice!" Gweyr perks up at that, her ears visibly shooting up atop her head as she all but bowls you out of the way. Her bulky body teeters on the very edge of the ice raft, throwing it off balance and threatening to capsize you despite the spikes binding you to the ship's stern, her teeth on full display as she listens intently. What in the gods' names — "Sorry, but I've got to hear this. I could've sworn..." And then, just before the water erupts in a splash of salt spray, you catch a glimpse of a blue-scaled salamander tail with its telltale aurora flame... that, and the fingers of a black gauntlet. Oh, dear. "It can't be," Gweyr breathes. "I killed him." You know the demon cult is capable of many things, but bringing the dead back to life is something beyond even Kasyrra's powers, [flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS |given how she reacted to the deaths of her dragon %"daughters" back at the Winter City |or else you suspect she'd have done it already ]. Did she see him die? "I told you. He was on top of the pile of bodies the villagers had gathered. I ran him through, made sure he'd stay down." But did. She. See. Leold. Die? "...No, I didn't check." Well, there she has it. The next time she drops the bastard she should make sure to behead him, burn his body, that kind of thing. That's what all the legends say is effective, at any rate. "Still, that kind of wound should have been mortal." Well, clearly Tollus didn't think it was, or else he wouldn't be walking around and captaining a ship for the bald fucker. And what did she say about him not seeming to have aged at all since that night twenty years ago? Yeah, there're shenanigans about all this, especially when her description of Tollus in her tale matches up exactly with how you remember he looks; like Leold, Tollus has perfectly escaped the ravages of time. That being said, it doesn't look like Leold's gone demon like his crew just yet, though, so that's probably not it? "Appearances can be deceiving. Frostmanders aren't bothered by the cold, but he can't be normal any more if he can hold his breath all the way down to the bottom of the trenches." Gweyr just looks tired at this point. "Still, this more or less confirms our next course of action." Which would be? "We're finding a way to head on down after him, and put an end to all this." You take it, then, that she has an idea for surviving the trip to the bottom. "I do. But for now, I think our job here is done — let's just wait for these guys to tow us back to shore." Moments pass by in silence, with Gweyr looking more glum than ever. She keeps an eye on the choppy open seas, as if expecting her old nemesis to burst out from the waters and clamber onto the raft at any moment, but nothing of the sort happens. After about fifteen minutes of waiting, nets fashioned from corded seaweed break the surface, chock-full of sealed barrels. They aren't the exact same ones that went in — you can see the effects of damp on the wood and metal banding — but there's little doubt they're of the same make. The demons busy themselves with fishing them out of the water and loading them into the hold, a process that takes surprisingly — or perhaps unsurprisingly — little time, throwing the filled barrels around with ease. Once the haul is taken in, there's the creak of wood as the ship's side slams shut, and then the vessel turns around and starts moving back towards the ice. The trip back is uneventful; when the headlands of the rift draw back into view, Gweyr wrests the bone spikes out of the ship's wood and unmoors you from the vessel's wake. There's a vehemence in her movements, a surge of strength that's been sparked in her despite her aging body, and it's in fuming yet contemplative silence that you pick up the paddles and row the rest of the way back through the channels. So, about going into the depths... she said she had an idea? Gweyr gives you a solemn nod as she ties up the raft and rubs her aching arms. "I'll need to speak with the siorcanna some, and so do you. Do you know of one of their number, a shaman named Imora?" [flags.IMORA_MET |Yes, and you're on speaking terms. "Good, good. That makes my job much easier. She'll help us out there, the woman owes me for sharing that kill a little while back. Don't know what she needed that walrus gall for, but she owes me for it, anyway." You're seeing how this is coming together. She wants one of those water-breathing tattoos Imora can put on people, right? "It's not just drowning, it's also the cold and being crushed by the depth we'll need to go down to; I've asked for them every now and then in the past. That being said, she's warned me that her usual tattoos won't hold up in the deep dark depths of the trenches, so that's what I need you to ask her about." |No, unfortunately. "It doesn't matter, meeting new friends is always a good thing." Given how belligerent the local siorcanna have been to you, you're not sure they're friends. "Imora will deal with you if you use my name; she owes me for that walrus gall from my kill, if nothing else. You can find her on the ice on the north-western part of the rift, or at least, that's where she likes to lounge about when she's not actually doing anything important." All right, then. So you presume that this Imora will have some kind of solution for helping you all get underwater? "I know she has tattoos to help people like you and me stay underwater and not drown, freeze, or get crushed. Temporary ones, if it comes to that; I've asked for them every now and then in the past. That being said, she's warned me that her usual tattoos won't hold up in the deep dark depths of the trenches, so that's what I need you to ask her about." ] And what's she going to do while you're consulting with Imora? "I'm going to return the raft to the jotuns, then talk to my siorc friends at Starhome and check up on that buoy we planted back there, make sure they've got the location down straight." Sighing, Gweyr presses a palm to her forehead and rubs her temples. "I was expecting something to go down when we set off on this trip... but seeing that man alive and unaged a single day is just a gut punch." Hey, if it were a gut punch to her, she certainly didn't show it. "Thanks, but... living up here numbs you to a lot. That, and I was never the best person for all of that. My old profession, you see." Of course. "It's been a pretty long trip, [pc.mf|kid|girl]. Make sure to rest up well, okay? Check in with me back at the cave once you've secured Imora's cooperation."
rows.translation: 好吧，你们这些蹩脚的借口……我下去向船长汇报。你们在这里再等几分钟，你们要求的货物就会毫无问题地被送到你们手中。我的船员会帮助你们把货物装上船，之后你们就可以不用等我直接回去了——船长本人要求我亲自参与他手头的一个项目。 明白了吗？下次一定要把它们保护得更好些——这次为了在这么短的时间内收集到这些物品，我们可是费了不小的功夫！ 听到这里，格温尔立刻精神了起来，她的耳朵仿佛一下子竖到了头顶上，然后她迅速从你身边挤了过去。 她那魁梧的身躯在冰筏的边缘摇摇欲坠，使得冰筏失去平衡，有翻覆的危险。尽管那些尖刺将她固定在船尾，但她依然全神贯注地倾听着。 这到底是怎么回事—— “对不起，但我必须得听听这个。我发誓我刚才真的看到了……” 就在海水溅起一片盐雾的瞬间，你瞥见了那条拥有蓝色鳞片、尾巴上还带着那道标志性的极光火焰的蝾螈。……还有那副黑色护手上的手指。 哦，天哪。 “不可能，”格温尔惊呼道，“我亲手杀了他。” 你知道，那些恶魔崇拜者确实有能力做出许多令人震惊的事情，但让死者复生，这种事情甚至连卡希拉的力量也做不到。 [flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS |考虑到她对冬城时期她的那些“龙女儿”死亡所做出的反应…… |否则你就会怀疑她早就这么做了。 ]我早就告诉过你。他就在村民们堆起来的那些尸体上面。我直接从他身上冲了过去，确保他永远动弹不得。” 但是 她看到莱奥德死了吗？ ……不，我没有检查。” 好吧，现在她明白了吧。下次再遇到那个混蛋，她应该确保把他斩首，然后烧掉他的尸体，至少应该这么做。毕竟所有的传说都这么说，这样才会有效果。 “不过，那样的伤势本来应该是致命的啊。 嗯，显然托卢斯并不这么认为，否则他也不会为那个光头家伙效力，四处奔走、指挥船只了。而且她还说过，自从二十年前那个夜晚之后，托卢斯似乎一点都没有变老。对，这一切肯定藏着什么猫腻，尤其是当她讲述托卢斯的外貌时，描述与你记忆中的他一模一样——就像莱奥德一样，托卢斯也完美地逃过了时间的摧残。 话虽如此，不过看起来莱奥德还没有像他的那些同伴那样变成恶魔，所以问题应该不在于这个吧？ 外表往往具有欺骗性。霜冻巨魔并不怕寒冷，但如果你能在战壕的最下装依然屏住呼吸，那就说明他已经不再是一个正常人了。”此时，格韦尔看起来只是显得有些疲惫。“不过，这至少证实了我们接下来应该采取的行动方案。 那会是什么办法呢？ “我们正在想办法追上他，彻底结束这一切。” 那么，你认为是她想出了某种办法来熬过这段艰难的旅程吧？ “是的。但目前来说，我觉得我们的任务已经完成了——就等着这些人把我们拖回岸上吧。 时间在沉默中流逝，格温尔的表情比以往任何时候都要忧郁。她始终注视着波涛汹涌的海洋，仿佛期待着那个宿敌随时会从水中冲出来，爬上救生筏，但这一切都没有发生。 等待了大约十五分钟后，用海藻绳编织而成的网被拉到了水面，里面装满了密封好的桶。这些桶与之前投入水中的那些并不完全一样——你可以看到潮湿环境对木材和金属包装材料造成的影响——但毫无疑问，它们确实是同一种型号的产品。 那些恶魔忙着将它们从水中捞出来，然后装进船舱里，这个过程出人意料地——或者也许也在意料之中——花费了很短的时间，他们轻松地将装满货物的桶子搬来搬去。一旦所有的货物都被搬进船舱，船身就会发出木头相互碰撞发出的嘎吱声，然后这艘船就会掉头，开始朝冰原的方向驶去。 返程的过程十分顺利；当裂隙的两侧地岬重新出现在视野中时，格温尔迅速将那些插在船体木料中的骨刺拔了出来，然后将你从船尾的拖拽中解救出来。她的动作充满力量，尽管身体已经衰老，但她身上依然蕴藏着惊人的活力。在一片愤怒而沉思的沉默中，你拿起了桨，继续划船，穿过了剩下的水道，回到了岸边。 那么，关于深入那些未知的区域……她说她有个主意？ 格温尔认真地点了点头，一边整理着筏子，一边揉着自己酸痛的双臂。“我需要和那些首领们谈谈，你也需要这么做。你知道他们中间有位名叫伊莫拉的萨满吗？ [flags.IMORA_MET |没错，你们已经建立了联系了。” “太好了，这样我的工作就方便多了。她会帮助我们的，那个女人之前因为我帮她完成了那次击杀而欠我人情。虽然不知道她到底需要海象胆汁来做什么，但总之她确实是欠我一个人情。你们可以看到，这一切是如何逐渐形成的。她想要那种Imora能为人们纹上的、能让人在水中呼吸的纹身，对吧？ “不仅仅是溺水的问题，还有寒冷以及我们需要下到的那种深度所带来的压力；过去我也曾多次要求过他们制作这样的纹身。 话虽如此，她还是提醒我，她平时纹的那些纹身在战壕那种极其黑暗的环境中是根本看不清楚的，所以这就是我需要你去问她的事情。 |不，很遗憾。” “没关系，结交新朋友总是件好事。” 不过考虑到那些当地的家伙对你表现得如此敌对，你也不确定他们算不算朋友吧。 “如果你用了我的名字，伊莫拉会来处理你的；至少，她欠我那头海象的胆汁——那可是我亲手捕杀的动物啊。 你可以在裂隙的西北部冰面上找到她，至少在她没有忙于其他重要事情的时候，她总是喜欢在那里闲逛。 好吧，那么你应该是认为这个伊莫拉会想出某种办法来帮助你们所有人潜入水中吧？ 我知道她纹了那些纹身，就是为了帮助像你我这样的潜水员能够在水下存活，避免溺水、受冻或被挤压。如果是必要的话，她也会纹一些临时性的纹身；过去我也偶尔要求她帮我纹这样的纹身。不过，她提醒过我，她平时纹的那些纹身在战壕那种极其黑暗的环境中是撑不住的，所以这就是我需要你去问她的事情。" ] 那么在你与伊莫拉商谈的时候，她打算做什么呢？ “我会把木筏归还给乔顿人，然后去星际之家的朋友们那里聊聊，再检查一下我们之前放置的那个浮标，确保他们已经记清了位置。唉，格温尔用手掌按住自己的额头，揉了揉太阳穴。‘我本来以为这次出行会发生些什么……但看到那个男人依然活着，一点都没有变老，真的让人感到非常沮丧。 嘿，如果这件事真的让她深受打击，她肯定没有表现出来。 “谢谢，但是……生活在这样的环境中，会让人逐渐变得麻木。再加上，我本来就不是适合做那些事情的人。你知道的，我的老职业…… 这段旅程确实相当漫长， [pc.mf|小孩|女孩]一定要好好休息，好吗？等你得到了伊莫拉的合作后，再来洞穴找我汇报情况吧。
rows.raw: " "All right, you sorry excuses — I'm going down to report to the master. All of you wait here for a few more minutes, and the cargo you requested will be bobbing up to you no problems. My crew will help you load it onto the ship, and then you can head on back without me; the master himself has asked for my personal involvement with a project of his. Do you understand? And secure them better next time — this last batch took some pains to gather on such short notice!" Gweyr perks up at that, her ears visibly shooting up atop her head as she all but bowls you out of the way. Her bulky body teeters on the very edge of the ice raft, throwing it off balance and threatening to capsize you despite the spikes binding you to the ship's stern, her teeth on full display as she listens intently. What in the gods' names — "Sorry, but I've got to hear this. I could've sworn..." And then, just before the water erupts in a splash of salt spray, you catch a glimpse of a blue-scaled salamander tail with its telltale aurora flame... that, and the fingers of a black gauntlet. Oh, dear. "It can't be," Gweyr breathes. "I killed him." You know the demon cult is capable of many things, but bringing the dead back to life is something beyond even Kasyrra's powers, [flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS |given how she reacted to the deaths of her dragon %"daughters" back at the Winter City |or else you suspect she'd have done it already ]. Did she see him die? "I told you. He was on top of the pile of bodies the villagers had gathered. I ran him through, made sure he'd stay down." But did. She. See. Leold. Die? "...No, I didn't check." Well, there she has it. The next time she drops the bastard she should make sure to behead him, burn his body, that kind of thing. That's what all the legends say is effective, at any rate. "Still, that kind of wound should have been mortal." Well, clearly Tollus didn't think it was, or else he wouldn't be walking around and captaining a ship for the bald fucker. And what did she say about him not seeming to have aged at all since that night twenty years ago? Yeah, there're shenanigans about all this, especially when her description of Tollus in her tale matches up exactly with how you remember he looks; like Leold, Tollus has perfectly escaped the ravages of time. That being said, it doesn't look like Leold's gone demon like his crew just yet, though, so that's probably not it? "Appearances can be deceiving. Frostmanders aren't bothered by the cold, but he can't be normal any more if he can hold his breath all the way down to the bottom of the trenches." Gweyr just looks tired at this point. "Still, this more or less confirms our next course of action." Which would be? "We're finding a way to head on down after him, and put an end to all this." You take it, then, that she has an idea for surviving the trip to the bottom. "I do. But for now, I think our job here is done — let's just wait for these guys to tow us back to shore." Moments pass by in silence, with Gweyr looking more glum than ever. She keeps an eye on the choppy open seas, as if expecting her old nemesis to burst out from the waters and clamber onto the raft at any moment, but nothing of the sort happens. After about fifteen minutes of waiting, nets fashioned from corded seaweed break the surface, chock-full of sealed barrels. They aren't the exact same ones that went in — you can see the effects of damp on the wood and metal banding — but there's little doubt they're of the same make. The demons busy themselves with fishing them out of the water and loading them into the hold, a process that takes surprisingly — or perhaps unsurprisingly — little time, throwing the filled barrels around with ease. Once the haul is taken in, there's the creak of wood as the ship's side slams shut, and then the vessel turns around and starts moving back towards the ice. The trip back is uneventful; when the headlands of the rift draw back into view, Gweyr wrests the bone spikes out of the ship's wood and unmoors you from the vessel's wake. There's a vehemence in her movements, a surge of strength that's been sparked in her despite her aging body, and it's in fuming yet contemplative silence that you pick up the paddles and row the rest of the way back through the channels. So, about going into the depths... she said she had an idea? Gweyr gives you a solemn nod as she ties up the raft and rubs her aching arms. "I'll need to speak with the siorcanna some, and so do you. Do you know of one of their number, a shaman named Imora?" [flags.IMORA_MET |Yes, and you're on speaking terms. "Good, good. That makes my job much easier. She'll help us out there, the woman owes me for sharing that kill a little while back. Don't know what she needed that walrus gall for, but she owes me for it, anyway." You're seeing how this is coming together. She wants one of those water-breathing tattoos Imora can put on people, right? "It's not just drowning, it's also the cold and being crushed by the depth we'll need to go down to; I've asked for them every now and then in the past. That being said, she's warned me that her usual tattoos won't hold up in the deep dark depths of the trenches, so that's what I need you to ask her about." |No, unfortunately. "It doesn't matter, meeting new friends is always a good thing." Given how belligerent the local siorcanna have been to you, you're not sure they're friends. "Imora will deal with you if you use my name; she owes me for that walrus gall from my kill, if nothing else. You can find her on the ice on the north-western part of the rift, or at least, that's where she likes to lounge about when she's not actually doing anything important." All right, then. So you presume that this Imora will have some kind of solution for helping you all get underwater? "I know she has tattoos to help people like you and me stay underwater and not drown, freeze, or get crushed. Temporary ones, if it comes to that; I've asked for them every now and then in the past. That being said, she's warned me that her usual tattoos won't hold up in the deep dark depths of the trenches, so that's what I need you to ask her about." ] And what's she going to do while you're consulting with Imora? "I'm going to return the raft to the jotuns, then talk to my siorc friends at Starhome and check up on that buoy we planted back there, make sure they've got the location down straight." Sighing, Gweyr presses a palm to her forehead and rubs her temples. "I was expecting something to go down when we set off on this trip... but seeing that man alive and unaged a single day is just a gut punch." Hey, if it were a gut punch to her, she certainly didn't show it. "Thanks, but... living up here numbs you to a lot. That, and I was never the best person for all of that. My old profession, you see." Of course. "It's been a pretty long trip, [pc.mf|kid|girl]. Make sure to rest up well, okay? Check in with me back at the cave once you've secured Imora's cooperation." "

rows.original:
You're facing a cultist patrol!

    This small patrol of cultists is proof enough that the demon cult has a presence on the very mountain trail that you've been sent to explore. Whatever the reason that they're here, they can't be up to very much good.
rows.translation:
你正面对着一支邪教巡逻队！

这支由邪教徒组成的小巡逻队，足以证明恶魔邪教确实存在于你被派去探索的那条山路上。无论他们为何会出现在这里，他们的目的肯定不怀好意。
rows.raw:
"
    You're facing a cultist patrol!

    This small patrol of cultists is proof enough that the demon cult has a presence on the very mountain trail that you've been sent to explore. Whatever the reason that they're here, they can't be up to very much good."

rows.original: The last of the cultists slumps against a nearby boulder, breathing heavily. You whirl around, half-expecting more of their number to be drawn to you by the ruckus you've made fighting, but the coast is clear for now, even if the reprieve isn't likely to last for long. You've got to press ahead before more of them home in on you... [party.comp einin quin |"I have a really bad feeling about this," Einin murmurs as she tugs on your sleeve. "[pc.name], we have to find out more. Let's go." Whether it's because all this is going down so close to home or if it's just because of how disquieting these cultists are, Einin's extra skittish today. On one hand, it's a poor idea to distrust a mousefolk's keenly honed sense of impending danger; on the other hand, running off blindly is bound to get you in trouble. | However, Quin doesn't have the same rush to his step; he sets his hand along the ears of the final cultist and snaps, sparking a bit of his magic through their unconscious mind. "With this, maybe these ones will awaken and see the err of their ways. If not, hopefully we're long gone by the time they get up. Tollus... this bastard really knows no end to this madness." The taeleer's ears flick and help him break his gaze from them. [quin.relationshipRange 0 20|You'll resolve things one way or another.|When the day comes, you made Quin a promise; you'll keep it.] ] Either way, you've got to keep moving. With how narrow the mountain trail is, you're already at serious enough risk of being cornered — no need to take unnecessary chances.
rows.translation: 最后一个邪教徒瘫倒在一块附近的巨石上，喘着粗气。你迅速转身，原本还以为会因为你的战斗声吸引来更多敌人，但此刻周围确实空无一人——不过这种宁静恐怕不会持续太久。你必须尽快继续前进，否则更多的敌人会追上来…… [party.comp einin quin |我对这件事有一种非常不好的预感。 艾宁轻声说着，同时拉了拉你的袖子。 "[pc.name]我们必须了解更多信息。让我们行动起来吧。 开始吧。" 不管是因为这一切发生得实在太近了，还是因为这些狂热信徒给人们带来的不安感，艾宁今天显得格外紧张不安。一方面，怀疑鼠人那种对即将到来的危险极为敏锐的直觉确实是个糟糕的决定；另一方面，盲目逃跑只会导致更多的麻烦。 | 然而，奎因并没有那么急躁；他将手放在最后一名邪教徒的耳畔，轻轻一捏，让一点点魔力通过他们的无意识意识传递了出去。 “这样或许能让这些人醒悟过来，认识到自己的错误。如果还是不行的话，希望等他们醒来的时候，我们早就离开这里了。托卢斯……这个混蛋真的不知何时才会停止这种疯狂的行为。”泰勒耳尖微微一动，让他得以将视线从那些人身上移开。 [quin.relationshipRange 0 20|你总会找到解决办法的。|当那一天来临时，你曾向Quin许下承诺，你必须遵守它。] ] 无论如何，你都必须继续前进。这条山路如此狭窄，你已经处于相当大的危险之中，根本没有必要去冒不必要的风险。

rows.original: As you forge your way forward, the sound of footsteps upon gravelly rock from up ahead draw your attention. Not even bothering to be subtle in the slightest, the handful of black-robed figures march down the narrow mountainside trail in two columns, quashing any hope of slipping by them. More of Tollus's underlings, then. [party.comp cait brint arona einin quin | "You bastards," Cait says through gritted teeth, uncharacteristic fury flashing in her eyes. "Each one of you I beat up is one less obstacle to getting Calla back!" | Brint hefts his [brint.weapon] as he eyes the approaching cultist patrol and chuckles. "Going to be a bit cramped fighting in this pass. Guess I'll have to make us some space, won't I?" | Arona chuckles as she readies her [arona.weapon]. "So, these are supposed to be servants of Argoth's 'great evil', are they? Can't be very great if this is the kind of mooks she's able to gather. Small and scrawny — plus, there's something to be said if this lot can't even outdress orcs to begin with." | Einin appears a little more on edge than she usually is, the mousegirl's eyes darting from one heavy hood to the other as she bites her lip. What's the matter? It's understandable that she might be skittish when facing Tollus's goons, but this is something else altogether. "It's... for a moment, I thought I recognized one or two of them. Even under all those clothes, there was something familiar... no, it's got to be just my imagination. Come on, [pc.name], let's make this quick." | "Cultists," Quintillus fumes. "Sometimes, it's easy to understand why Cait hates them... but right now, all I want to do is get even!" ] There's nothing for it. You'll have to meet them head-on in these confined conditions. Moments later, one of the patrol points straight at [party.combatNames] and raises a warning shout. Ah, this outcome was never really in doubt. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 当你继续前进时，前方碎石路上传来的脚步声吸引了你的注意。那些身穿黑袍的身影毫不掩饰地排成两列，沿着狭窄的山路走来，让你根本无法躲过他们。看来，这些都是托卢斯的手下。 [party.comp cait brint arona einin quin | 你们这些混蛋。 凯特咬紧牙关说道，她眼中闪烁着前所未有的愤怒。 每一个我打败的人，都意味着让卡拉回到我身边这一目标又近了一步！ | 布林特举起了他的 [brint.weapon] 当他看到那支正在接近的邪教巡逻队时，不禁笑了起来。 在这个通道里战斗的话，空间会有点拥挤。看来我得为我们腾出一些空间才行，对吧？ | 阿罗娜轻笑着，开始准备起来。 [arona.weapon]. 所以，这些家伙应该是阿戈斯‘大邪恶’的仆从吧？如果她能召集到这种连兽人都不如的废物，那她的‘大邪恶’恐怕也并不怎么样吧。一个个又小又瘦弱，而且这些家伙连兽人的穿着都比不上，这也说明他们的实力实在有限。 | 艾宁看起来比平时更加紧张不安，这位鼠女的眼睛不停地在那两个重型的兜帽之间移动，同时她还咬着嘴唇。 “出了什么事吗？面对托卢斯的打手们，她感到紧张也是可以理解的，但这次的情况似乎有些不同。 ……有那么一瞬间，我以为自己认出了他们中的几个人。即使他们穿着那么多衣服，还是有一种熟悉的感觉……不，肯定只是我的想象而已。得了吧， [pc.name]我们快点吧。 | "邪教徒昆蒂勒斯气得直冒烟。有时候，确实很容易理解为什么凯特会讨厌他们……但现在，我唯一想做的就是离开那里。 甚至!" ] 没有别的办法了。在这种狭小的环境中，你必须直接面对他们。片刻之后，其中一个巡逻点就出现在了正前方 [party.combatNames] 并发出了警告声。啊，这个结果其实从一开始就没什么悬念。 这是一场激烈的战斗！
rows.raw: " As you forge your way forward, the sound of footsteps upon gravelly rock from up ahead draw your attention. Not even bothering to be subtle in the slightest, the handful of black-robed figures march down the narrow mountainside trail in two columns, quashing any hope of slipping by them. More of Tollus's underlings, then. [party.comp cait brint arona einin quin | "You bastards," Cait says through gritted teeth, uncharacteristic fury flashing in her eyes. "Each one of you I beat up is one less obstacle to getting Calla back!" | Brint hefts his [brint.weapon] as he eyes the approaching cultist patrol and chuckles. "Going to be a bit cramped fighting in this pass. Guess I'll have to make us some space, won't I?" | Arona chuckles as she readies her [arona.weapon]. "So, these are supposed to be servants of Argoth's 'great evil', are they? Can't be very great if this is the kind of mooks she's able to gather. Small and scrawny — plus, there's something to be said if this lot can't even outdress orcs to begin with." | Einin appears a little more on edge than she usually is, the mousegirl's eyes darting from one heavy hood to the other as she bites her lip. What's the matter? It's understandable that she might be skittish when facing Tollus's goons, but this is something else altogether. "It's... for a moment, I thought I recognized one or two of them. Even under all those clothes, there was something familiar... no, it's got to be just my imagination. Come on, [pc.name], let's make this quick." | "Cultists," Quintillus fumes. "Sometimes, it's easy to understand why Cait hates them... but right now, all I want to do is get even!" ] There's nothing for it. You'll have to meet them head-on in these confined conditions. Moments later, one of the patrol points straight at [party.combatNames] and raises a warning shout. Ah, this outcome was never really in doubt. It's a fight!"

rows.original: You take a look at the cliff face just up ahead in closer detail, eyeing its entire length from top to bottom. While it looks like you might have a useful vantage point from up there if you managed to scale the cliff, to say doing so would take some effort would be an understatement. There're some natural handholds in the otherwise smooth stone face, but the climb's going to be a tough one. Still, it might be rewarding to do so, if only to get a better idea of what lies ahead and what preparations Tollus's goons might have made in preparation for anyone brave or foolhardy enough to disturb their operations. [party.has cait |"Looks pretty steep, even if it isn't that tall," Cait muses as she shields her eyes and raises her gaze. "Might want to be careful if you're going to try climbing up there." ] Will you make the climb, and if so, how will you go about doing it?
rows.translation: 你仔细观察前方那面悬崖，从上到下打量它的整个轮廓。虽然看起来如果能够爬上那悬崖，应该能获得一个很有用的观察点，但要说这样做需要付出一定的努力，那简直还是轻描淡写了。 在这块表面光滑的石头上，虽然有一些天然的把手，但攀爬起来仍然会相当困难。 不过，这样做或许也是值得的——至少可以让我们更清楚地了解前方会遇到什么，以及那些胆大包天或鲁莽的人在扰乱他们的行动之前，可能已经做了哪些准备。 [party.has cait |看起来坡度挺陡的，尽管它的高度并不是很高。 凯特遮住眼睛，抬起头，若有所思地凝视着前方。 如果你打算尝试爬上去的话，最好小心一点。 ] 你愿意尝试攀登吗？如果愿意，你打算如何进行呢？

While it looks like you might have a useful vantage point from up there if you managed to scale the cliff, to say doing so would take some effort would be an understatement. There're some natural handholds in the otherwise smooth stone face, but the climb's going to be a tough one. Still, it might be rewarding to do so, if only to get a better idea of what lies ahead and what preparations Tollus's goons might have made in preparation for anyone brave or foolhardy enough to disturb their operations. [party.has cait |"Looks pretty steep, even if it isn't that tall," Cait muses as she shields her eyes and raises her gaze. "Might want to be careful if you're going to try climbing up there." ] Will you make the climb, and if so, how will you go about doing it?"

rows.original: Well, nothing for it. If you're going to make the ascent, you're going to have to scale the cliff. You take another quick look over the stony face to plan your path upwards, then step forward and pull yourself onto a handhold. [party.hasCompanions |"Here," [companion1.name] says, stepping forward and hooking a coil of rope about your shoulder at the last moment. "Won't go you much good while on the ground, but at least you'll be able to tie it to something once you're up top." ] The climb is as arduous as it looks. You take every advantage you can, grabbing onto roots and small plants growing out of the rocky cliff and jamming your feet into cracks where there aren't any good footholds to be had. It's not long before your limbs begin to tire and ache, telling you to be done with tormenting them already.
rows.translation: 好吧，别无选择。如果你想继续向上攀登，就必须翻越那道悬崖。你再次快速扫视了一下那崎岖的岩壁，以便规划好上行的路线，然后向前迈出一步，抓住了一个可供攀爬的把手。 [party.hasCompanions |在这里。 [companion1.name] 说着，他上前一步，在最后一刻将一圈绳子挂在你的肩上。 在地面上的时候，这个东西用处不大，但至少等你爬到上面后，就可以用它把什么东西绑在一起了。 ] 这次攀登确实像看上去那么艰难。你必须利用一切可用的条件——抓住从岩石峭壁上生长出来的树根和小植物，把足部塞进那些没有合适立足点的裂缝中。不久之后，你的四肢就会开始感到疲劳和酸痛，仿佛在抗议你继续折磨它们。
rows.raw: " Well, nothing for it. If you're going to make the ascent, you're going to have to scale the cliff. You take another quick look over the stony face to plan your path upwards, then step forward and pull yourself onto a handhold. [party.hasCompanions |"Here," [companion1.name] says, stepping forward and hooking a coil of rope about your shoulder at the last moment. "Won't go you much good while on the ground, but at least you'll be able to tie it to something once you're up top." ] The climb is as arduous as it looks. You take every advantage you can, grabbing onto roots and small plants growing out of the rocky cliff and jamming your feet into cracks where there aren't any good footholds to be had. It's not long before your limbs begin to tire and ache, telling you to be done with tormenting them already."

rows.original:
By and large, though, you make it. With a final pull of effort, you haul yourself over the edge and onto firm ground, then take a moment to catch your breath and survey your surroundings. [party.hasCompanions
                |Remembering [party.compNames] still at the foot of the cliff, you find a nearby solid-looking protrusion of rock and tie the rope to it, throwing the free end over the edge and watching it unroll on its way down. There, that should make getting up here much easier.
                |Still, now that you've navigated a path up the cliff, at least your next climb will be far simpler and straightforward, and a lot less enervating.
                ]

                Now, time to see what you can make of this situation...
rows.translation:
不过，总的来说，你还是成功了。在最后使出全部力气之后，你终于爬过了边缘，来到了坚实的地面上，然后停下来喘口气，环顾四周。 [party.hasCompanions
                |回忆 [party.compNames] 仍然站在悬崖脚下，你会看到附近有一块看起来很结实的岩石突起，把绳子系在上面，然后将绳子的另一端扔到悬崖边上，观察它如何向下延伸。这样，爬上来就会容易多了。
                |不过，既然你已经成功地沿着悬崖开辟出了一条道路，那么接下来的攀登就会变得简单得多，也会容易许多，不会再那么令人疲惫了。
                ]

                现在，是时候看看你能否利用这种局面来取得成功了……
rows.raw:
"
                By and large, though, you make it. With a final pull of effort, you haul yourself over the edge and onto firm ground, then take a moment to catch your breath and survey your surroundings. [party.hasCompanions
                |Remembering [party.compNames] still at the foot of the cliff, you find a nearby solid-looking protrusion of rock and tie the rope to it, throwing the free end over the edge and watching it unroll on its way down. There, that should make getting up here much easier.
                |Still, now that you've navigated a path up the cliff, at least your next climb will be far simpler and straightforward, and a lot less enervating.
                ]

                Now, time to see what you can make of this situation..."

rows.original: As things would have it, your strength fails you at the worst possible moment. Partway through your climb, you misjudge a grab and your fingers end up closing upon thin air as opposed to the rock spur you were reaching for; panic quickly sets in as your momentum falters and gravity soon begins asserting itself. The weight of your body yanks your grip loose, and then you're plummeting down, down — [party.has cait |[silly | — Straight onto Cait's pillowy rack. There's a loud %"oomph" from the pink kitten, followed by an enveloping warm softness as the sheer expansiveness of Cait's monstrous mammaries cushions your fall. You practically bounce off the springy breastflesh, amazed at the rather astounding properties of Cait's rack. Is there nothing it can't do? "Are you all right? That looked like a pretty bad fall." No, no. Considering that she was kind enough to break your fall, is she all right? Cait winces and gathers her [cait.breasts] in her hands, squeezing them together and rolling them around. "Owww. They'll be sore for a little bit, but better them than you, right?" | — Straight into a clump of scraggly bushes. You're a little torn up, but at least you weren't hurt with the foliage breaking your fall. Cait comes running up, her [cait.breasts] jiggling as she bends over you and helps you to your feet. "That looked like a bad fall. Are you okay?" You're a little dazed, but you're fine. "Really? Nothing broken? Everything working fine?" You wave her off. It's nice to have her be so concerned for you, but you were fortunate enough to suffer little more than a few perfunctory scratches. You'll be okay. ] | — Into a clump of scrubby foliage, some sort of dense matted weed. You're a little dazed, but at least the landing wasn't as hard as it might have been. [party.hasCompanions |[comp1.name] comes running up to you, grabbing you by the arm and helping you to your feet, if a bit shakily. "Are you fine?" Yeah, you'll be okay. The fall wasn't that bad, you're just a bit rattled. [comp1.name] doesn't look all too convinced at your words, but doesn't press the matter further. |It takes a little while for you to regain your full faculties, but at length you manage to push yourself upright and stagger a few steps. You're still a bit rattled, but you should be able to walk it off in a bit. ] ] One way or the other, it doesn't look like you'll be able to make an unassisted climb up the cliff given your physical capabilities. Best to find another way, or if you don't have anyone or anything to assist you, maybe it's just best to cut your losses before you get into more trouble.
rows.translation: 命运似乎总爱捉弄人，在最关键的时刻，你的体力却突然衰竭了。在攀爬的过程中，你错误地判断了抓取的位置，结果手部指却抓到了空气，而不是你原本想要抓住的岩石突起；恐慌立刻涌上心头，你的动作变得迟缓，而重力的作用也开始显现。身体的重量使你的手部松开了抓握，于是你开始急速向下坠落—— [party.has cait |[silly | — 你直接落在了凯特的柔软胸脯上。那只粉红色的小猫发出了一声响亮的“扑通”声，紧接着，凯特那巨大的胸部就像一个柔软的弹簧垫，将你的冲击力完全吸收了。你几乎从她那富有弹性的胸脯上弹了回来，对凯特这惊人的胸部构造感到无比惊讶。难道还有什么它做不到的事情吗？ 你没事吧？看样子你摔得挺严重的。 不，不。考虑到她还特意帮你缓冲了跌落的冲击，这 她 好吧？” 凯特皱了皱眉头，然后收拾好自己的东西。 [cait.breasts] 她把它们握在手部里，仔细地揉搓着、转动着。 哎哟，他们疼一会儿就会好的，不过总比你受伤要好吧？ | — 你直接撞上了一丛杂乱的灌木丛。虽然你的衣服有些撕破了，但至少那些灌木丛缓冲了你的跌落，让你没有受伤。凯特跑过来，她 [cait.breasts] 当她弯下腰来帮助你站起来的时候，你的身体会微微摇晃。 那次摔倒看起来挺严重的。你没事吧？ 你有点晕乎乎的，不过没什么大碍。 真的吗？没有损坏的地方？所有东西都运行正常吗？ 你摆了摆手部，让她别担心了。她这么关心你确实很好，不过你运气不错，只不过受了一些轻微的擦伤而已，不会有事的。你会没事的。 ] | — 你落在一丛灌木丛中，那些灌木看起来像是茂密而缠结的杂草。你有点头晕，但至少这次降落并没有想象中那么糟糕。 [party.hasCompanions |[comp1.name] 它会跑过来，抓住你的手部臂，帮你站起来，尽管你可能会有些摇晃。 你没事吧？ 没关系的，你会好起来的。那次跌倒并没有那么严重，你只是有点受惊而已。 [comp1.name] 他看起来对你的话并不是很信服，但也没有进一步追问下去。 |你需要一段时间才能恢复完全的意识，但最终你还是设法站了起来，踉跄着走了几步。你仍然有些恍惚，不过应该过一会儿就能恢复正常了。 ] ] 不管怎样，以你的身体状况来看，似乎无法独自攀登那座悬崖。最好另寻他法；如果你没有其他人或任何可以帮助你的东西，或许在陷入更大的麻烦之前，及时放弃才是上策。

rows.original: Attempt to scale the cliff yourself without any additional help.
rows.translation: 尝试在没有任何帮助的情况下独自攀登这座悬崖。
rows.raw: "Attempt to scale the cliff yourself without any additional help."

rows.original:
Right. The climb up the cliff might be tricky, but there's no reason to do this unaided. Sorting through your camping supplies, you quickly pick out the rope, twine and stakes that you'd originally have used to pitch the tents with. It's not proper climbing gear by any stretch of the imagination, but it'll do for your purposes. Shouldering a coil of rope, you look at the cliff face again and plan your ascent, gathering the nerve to make a move.

            Well, nothing for it; you reach for the nearest handhold, and pull yourself up. [var0|The climbing is smooth going thanks to your gear — while you think that you might have been able to make it up without additional help, the ability to create additional hand and footholds by jamming the tent stakes into the rock is very, very helpful, let alone the better grip you have. Step by step, pull by pull, you make it up the cliff face without too much trouble, hauling yourself over the edge with a grunt of effort.

            |The climb is as difficult as you suspected it would be — having your makeshift climbing gear here really made the difference between getting the next hand up and falling off the cliff face. You use most of your stakes in creating more hand and footholds to aid your ascent, jamming the hard wooden spikes into cracks and crevices before gingerly testing your weight on them; the worry that they'll come loose is always present in the back of your mind, but they hold and you eventually make it up to the top, hauling yourself over the edge with a grunt of effort.]

            Once atop the cliff, you find a solid-looking rocky protrusion and affix the rope to it, then let the loose end down so [party.hasCompanions
            |[party.compNames] can come up after you
            |you can get up and down the cliff without needing to go through that again
            ]. Now then, to see what can be gained from this vantage point...
rows.translation:
没错。攀爬那座悬崖确实有点棘手，但没有必要独自完成这项任务。你在自己的露营用品中快速找到了原本用来搭建帐篷的绳子、藤条和木桩。 这根本算不上是专业的攀岩装备，但对你来说已经足够用了。你背着一圈绳子，再次审视着悬崖的表面，仔细规划着攀登的路线，然后鼓起勇气开始行动。

            好吧，没什么好犹豫的；你抓住最近的一个把手，开始往上爬去。 [var0|多亏了你的装备，攀爬过程进行得十分顺利——虽然你可能会认为没有这些装备也能成功爬上去，但利用帐篷支架将它们固定在岩石上，从而创造出更多的抓握点和支撑点，确实帮了大忙，更何况这些装备还能让你有更稳定的抓握力。一步一步地攀爬，一次一次地用力拉扯，你终于毫无困难地爬上了悬崖峭壁，最后费了九牛二虎之力才爬到了边缘。

            |这次攀登确实如你预想的那样困难——在这里使用自制的攀登工具，确实成为了你能否继续向上攀爬、或是从悬崖上掉下来的关键。你在攀登过程中用掉了大部分木桩，用来制造更多的支撑点来帮助自己上升，将这些坚硬的木刺插入裂缝和缝隙中，然后小心翼翼地测试它们是否能承受你的重量；虽然你一直担心它们会松动，但它们最终还是稳稳地支撑住了你，让你终于成功到达了顶端，费了九牛二虎之力才爬过了边缘。]

            一旦登上悬崖，你会看到一处看起来非常坚固的岩石突起，把绳子系在上面，然后把绳子的另一端放下来。 [party.hasCompanions
            |[party.compNames] 可以随后再来找你。
            |你可以直接在悬崖上上下移动，而无需再经过那个地方。
            ]那么，让我们看看从这个角度能够获得什么……

Step by step, pull by pull, you make it up the cliff face without too much trouble, hauling yourself over the edge with a grunt of effort.

            |The climb is as difficult as you suspected it would be — having your makeshift climbing gear here really made the difference between getting the next hand up and falling off the cliff face. You use most of your stakes in creating more hand and footholds to aid your ascent, jamming the hard wooden spikes into cracks and crevices before gingerly testing your weight on them; the worry that they'll come loose is always present in the back of your mind, but they hold and you eventually make it up to the top, hauling yourself over the edge with a grunt of effort.]

            Once atop the cliff, you find a solid-looking rocky protrusion and affix the rope to it, then let the loose end down so [party.hasCompanions
            |[party.compNames] can come up after you
            |you can get up and down the cliff without needing to go through that again
            ]. Now then, to see what can be gained from this vantage point..."

rows.original: There's more than one way to use camping supplies, after all. You can see how having some handy tools would help you get up that cliff.
rows.translation: 毕竟，使用露营用品的方法并不只有一种。你可以看到，拥有一些实用的工具确实能帮助你顺利爬上那座悬崖。
rows.raw: "There's more than one way to use camping supplies, after all. You can see how having some handy tools would help you get up that cliff."

rows.original: You don't have the camping supplies this would take.
rows.translation: 你并没有进行这次露营所需的装备。
rows.raw: "You don't have the camping supplies this would take."

rows.original: You look up at the cliff and then [pc.heightRange 74 |down |over ] at Quin, meeting the taeleer's gaze. He returns the gesture with a grin and easy shrug, knowing full well what you want but daring you to pop the question. "Go on then, [pc.name]. Ask away." You sigh at his teasing. He's good at this sort of thing, right? Climbing? "I'm not bad at it, if that's what you're asking..." Better than you, at any rate? He likes talking about his time in the uh, Talia's Talons, or whatever it was called... that thing before he got caught up with the cult. Quin's expression grows somber for a moment, but then his easygoing demeanor returns in the blink of an eye. "Yeah, sure. Sometimes it's easier to go over an obstacle rather than around it, a good runner keeps his options open. Give me some space, and get ready to catch me if I fall, just in case. I don't expect to, but you never know; you might just be so attractive that I can't help myself." You shake your head and chuckle. Now really isn't the time for that, but maybe making light of the situation is Quin's way of keeping his head steady while facing his guilt over having been in Tollus's cult, even if it was in a peripheral position. You get in position as Quin loops a coil of rope about one of his shoulders and steps up to the cliff face. After a brief moment of considering his options, he swings up in an overhead grab, reaching for a handhold. The next grab appears to be for empty air, until you realize that what you took for a smooth surface wasn't so smooth after all — it can't be used as leverage for long, but it just has to last for long enough. There're a few moments when you're certain the nimble bunny-man will fall straight into your arms, but he always manages to find purchase in the most unlikely situations, jamming his feet in cracks and swinging himself from purchase to purchase, never still for more than a few seconds. He clearly has the entire route up the cliff marked out in his mind, and it's simply a matter of going through the motions. It's perhaps anywhere from five to ten minutes before Quin reaches the top of the cliff and ties the rope to a solid-looking outcropping, allowing [party.som | | |the rest of ]you to climb up after him. "There, all done. I hope you're happy." Yeah, he did good; of course you're happy. You move to clap Quin on the shoulder, [var0 |and as you reach out he instead takes your hand in his and kisses its back with a little flourish |and he chuckles before giving you a little dismissive wave, acting completely nonplussed with his achievement ]. Now, perhaps it's time to see what you can discover from up here... "Indeed, let's see what these bastards are up to."
rows.translation: 你抬头望向悬崖，然后 [pc.heightRange 74 |向下 |超过 ] 在奎因那里，与那位泰勒尔对视而立。他微笑着轻松地回应了那个眼神，心里很清楚对方想要什么，但却故意不直接说出来，想看看对方是否会直接提出那个问题。 “那就说吧。 [pc.name]有疑问就尽管问吧。” 你对他这种调侃方式只能叹气。他确实很擅长这类事情，对吧？比如攀爬？ “我并不擅长 糟糕 如果这就是你想要知道的的话，那就这么说吧……” “至少比我讲得好吧？他总喜欢谈论他在‘塔莉亚的利爪’组织里的经历，或者那个组织的名字是什么来着 在……之前 他陷入了那个邪教组织。 奎因的表情瞬间变得阴沉起来，但转眼间，他又恢复了那副随和的样子。“是啊，有时候那样做确实更简单。 超过 与其绕开障碍物，不如直面它——一个优秀的跑者总会保留多种选择。给我一些空间吧，如果我摔倒了，你准备好接住我吧，以防万一。虽然我不指望会摔倒，但谁知道呢？也许你实在太迷人了，让我根本无法控制自己……你摇摇头，轻笑出声。现在确实不是说这种话的时候，但或许，通过淡化这种处境，奎因是在努力让自己在面对因加入托卢斯的邪教而产生的内疚感时保持冷静，哪怕他只是处于一个边缘性的角色罢了。 当你站好位置时，奎因将一圈绳子绕在肩上，然后走向悬崖边缘。在短暂思考了一下后，他开始向上攀爬，试图抓住某个支撑点。接下来的几次尝试似乎都落了空，直到你发现那些看似轻型滑的表面其实并不那么平整——虽然这些地方无法提供长时间的支撑，但至少必须能够支撑他继续攀爬一段时间。 足够了有那么几个瞬间，你会确信那个灵活的兔子人一定会落入你的怀抱，但他总能在一些最意想不到的情况下找到支撑点——把足部塞进裂缝里，然后从一个支撑点荡到另一个支撑点，从来不会静止超过几秒钟。 他显然在脑海中已经将攀登悬崖的整个路线牢记在心，现在所做的只是按照这个路线一步步行动而已。 大概过了五到十分钟，奎因终于到达了悬崖的顶部，他将绳子系在了一块看起来非常坚固的岩石上，然后 [party.som | | |其余部分 ]来，都弄好了。希望你会开心。” “是啊，他做得很好；你当然会开心了。”你走上前去，拍了拍Quin的肩膀。 [var0 |当你伸出手去时，他反而握住了你的手，然后轻轻一吻，动作十分优雅。 |他轻笑了一声，然后随意地挥了挥手，表现得好像对自己的成就完全不以为意似的。 ]现在，也许是时候看看从这里能发现些什么了…… “确实，让我们看看这些混蛋在搞什么名堂。

rows.original: You've got a bouncy bunny on hand. Why not put him to good use?
rows.translation: 你手头有一只活泼可爱的小兔子，为什么不把它派上用场呢？
rows.raw: "You've got a bouncy bunny on hand. Why not put him to good use?"

rows.original: This sheer wall looks like a bunny-boy could scramble up it without too much issue. Too bad you don't have Quin around at the moment.
rows.translation: 这面笔直的墙看起来，一个小兔子应该也能毫不费力地爬上去。可惜你现在身边没有奎因。
rows.raw: "This sheer wall looks like a bunny-boy could scramble up it without too much issue. Too bad you don't have Quin around at the moment."

rows.original:
You take another long, hard look at the cliff and shake your head. Whatever tactical advantage you might gain over Tollus's goons simply isn't worth the risk of falling during the climb and hurting yourself, or even worse, drawing their attention. Besides, it's not like it's going anywhere if you change your mind later on, so it's perfectly fine to leave well enough alone for now.

            Stepping away from the cliff, you [party.hasCompanions|gather up [party.compNames] and ]prepare to be on your way.
rows.translation:
你再次仔细地看了看那悬崖，然后摇了摇头。无论你在对付托卢斯的那些打手时能获得什么战术上的优势，都远远不如在攀爬过程中坠落受伤的风险大，更糟糕的是，还可能引起他们的注意。另外，如果你后来改变主意，那东西也不会消失到哪里去，所以现在暂时不去管它也是完全没问题的。

你从悬崖边走开，然后 [party.hasCompanions|集合起来 [party.compNames] 以及 ]准备出发吧。
rows.raw:
"
            You take another long, hard look at the cliff and shake your head. Whatever tactical advantage you might gain over Tollus's goons simply isn't worth the risk of falling during the climb and hurting yourself, or even worse, drawing their attention. Besides, it's not like it's going anywhere if you change your mind later on, so it's perfectly fine to leave well enough alone for now.

            Stepping away from the cliff, you [party.hasCompanions|gather up [party.compNames] and ]prepare to be on your way."

rows.original: It's not worth the risk. Just walk away.
rows.translation: 不值得冒这个险。还是离开吧。
rows.raw: "It's not worth the risk. Just walk away."

rows.original: Examine the cliff face just ahead.
rows.translation: 仔细观察前方的悬崖面。

rows.original: Standing as close to the edge as you dare, you survey the trail from your vantage point. The view is pretty impressive, allowing you to catch glimpses of several notable happenstances: Firstly, it looks like someone's built a barricade spanning the trail's width at its foot, close enough that you could actually edge along the overhang's base and be almost on top of them. [flags.CLOISTER_QUEST_BARRICADE_HANDLED |With the cultists' barricade shattered and broken and those manning it either out of the fight or fled, there's nothing stopping you from waltzing straight on into their camp. However, since they're certainly alert to your presence and intention to meddle, it would be advisable to not tarry in your actions from here on out. There're bound to be more of Tollus's goons who weren't taken out in your assault on the barricade; you don't want to give them the time to regroup and rally themselves against you. |The barricade itself has been put together from local boulders and what looks like sharpened logs, clearly rolled in from somewhere else. Whatever Tollus's goons are doing here, they've certainly invested a considerable amount of time and effort into it to be so heavily committed to security. Entrenched as they are with their fortifications forcing anyone wanting to climb the trail to be funnelled towards them, the cultists are in an excellent defensive position. Anything you could do to weigh the odds in your favor when you inevitably have to face them would be welcome. You're too high up to jump down on them safely and the ledge doesn't extend THAT far for you to be able to bypass them completely, but perhaps you could toss something down atop their heads? That might work, if you had something appropriate on hand. [party.comp etheryn quin | You turn to Ryn. Any ideas? This would be a good point from which to rain arrows down upon them, you think... Ryn studies the situation below you a little and eventually shakes her head. "That won't work. They'll just hide under the inclined palisades and return fire while they send some of their number up to trap us here. I've only one pair of hands — it would take far too long. It would work if we had a whole squad of bowmen to pin them down while another advanced upon their position, but as a long group we don't really have a chance at utilising that kind of tactic." All right, not arrows, then. Wonder if any other kind of missile might work... pity there aren't any boulders conveniently lying around that you could drop atop the cultists' heads. | "You know," Quin interrupts. "I can use my magic to get them all worked up." You turn and face the taeleer, only for Quin to bring his hands close together; the warm glow of his lustful flames dances across his knuckles, thankfully low enough so that it isn't visible to your unsuspecting victims below. "One nice, big fireball would be all it'd take." Unfortunately for all of you, lobbing a fireball down onto them might be effective but probably cause a huge explosion. You can't risk it. Quintillus grumbles and lets his flames receed. "If you say so." ] Well. If nothing else, at least you have a better idea of their numbers — about ten to twelve at any one point, swapping out with each other in rotating shifts. Seeing as the guard just changed before your eyes, this ought to be the time to strike before the next detail returns and discovers the mess you've made. ] Further up the trail, there's no sign of the altar that Brother Sanders mentioned, but instead a large mound of dirt and rock that sits on the bend of the trail, rubble from the cliffside above crumbling and collapsing. Even from this distance, you can see wooden scaffolding and small figures moving atop the mound — a dig, then. Tollus must want this relic badly enough that he's willing to devote so many underlings and resources to unearth it from under the collapsed cliff. There's nothing you can do about it from this distance, but at least you know what's ahead, for what it's worth. [party.hasCompanions |"Don't think there's anything else to see from up here," [companion1.name] says, shielding [companion1.hisHer] eyes as [companion1.heShe] peers off into the distance at the dig site. "Given the sheer number of thugs milling down there, Sanders had better have something good for us when we get back." | ] Yeah. If you're going to do something, you ought to do it, but otherwise you've got as complete an overview of the situation as you can from up here. Time to act on the information you've gathered, if you can.
rows.translation: 你小心翼翼地站在离边缘尽可能近的地方，从这个有利的位置俯瞰着小路。眼前的景象相当壮观，让你得以瞥见几件值得注意的事情： 首先，看起来有人在小路的起点处搭建了一道横跨整个小路宽度的路障，其位置距离地面如此之近，以至于你甚至可以沿着路障的基部行走，几乎就能到达路障的顶部。 [flags.CLOISTER_QUEST_BARRICADE_HANDLED |随着那些邪教徒设置的路障被彻底摧毁，驻守在那里的人要么已经退出了战斗，要么已经逃跑了，因此你们完全可以直接闯入他们的营地。不过，既然他们肯定已经察觉到了你们的存在以及你们想要干涉他们的意图，那么从现在起行动上最好要迅速一些。在你们攻击路障的过程中，肯定还有更多的托卢斯的打手没有被消灭；你们可不能给他们重新集结起来对付你们的机会。 |这些路障是用当地的巨石以及一些看起来像是被削尖的原木搭建起来的，这些材料显然是从其他地方运过来的。不管托卢斯的那些打手在这里究竟在图谋什么，他们显然投入了大量的时间和精力来确保这些路障能够起到有效的防护作用。 这些邪教徒凭借他们的防御工事占据了极为有利的阵地——任何想要攀登这条小路的人都会被引向他们的防线，因此他们处于绝对的防御优势之中。既然最终你不得不与他们面对，那么任何能够帮助你改变战局的因素都是值得欢迎的。 你站得太高，无法安全地跳下去攻击他们，而且那块岩架也没有延伸到足够远的地方，让你能够完全绕过他们。不过，或许你可以往他们头上扔些什么东西？如果你手边有合适的物品，这个办法应该可行。 [party.comp etheryn quin | 你转向瑞恩，问道：“有什么建议吗？你觉得这里应该是个很好的位置，可以从这里向他们发射箭矢吧……” 瑞恩仔细观察了下你下方的局势，最终摇了摇头。 那样不行。他们只会躲在倾斜的栅栏后面，一边还击，一边派一些人上来把我们困在这里。我只有两只手，这样做的话耗时太长了。如果我们有一整个弓箭手小队，能够牵制住他们，而另一队人则趁机进攻他们的阵地，那样才有可能成功。但以我们目前的规模来说，实在没有机会采用这种战术。 好吧，那就不用箭了。不知道有没有其他类型的导弹可以用……可惜周围没有合适的巨石可以扔到那些邪教徒的头上。 | 你知道的，”奎因插话道，“我 可以 用我的魔法让他们全都兴奋起来吧。” 你转过身面对那个泰勒尔，这时奎因将双手凑到了一起；他那充满欲望的火焰所散发出的温暖光芒在他指节间跳动，幸好光芒强度较低，因此下面的那些毫无防备的受害者根本看不到。 只需要一个大火球就可以了。” 可惜，对你们所有人来说，向他们扔一个大火球虽然可能有效，但很可能会引发巨大的爆炸。你们不能冒这个风险。 昆蒂勒斯嘟囔着，让他的火焰熄灭了。“如果你这么说的话…… ] 嗯，至少你现在对他们的人数有了更清楚的了解——任何时候都有大约十到十二个人在轮流值守。既然守卫刚刚在你眼前更换了，现在就应该立刻行动，在下一个巡逻人员回来发现你造成的混乱之前。 ] 在小路的更远处，并没有桑德斯兄弟提到的那个祭坛的踪迹，取而代之的是一小堆堆的泥土和岩石，这些堆积物位于小路的拐弯处，上方悬崖峭壁上的碎石不断掉落堆积下来。即使从这么远的距离，也能看到那些木制脚手部架以及一些在小堆土石上活动的小身影——看来他们正在那里进行挖掘工作。 托卢斯一定非常渴望得到这件遗物，以至于他愿意投入如此多的手部下和资源，去从那座坍塌的悬崖下挖掘它。从这么远的距离，你无能为力，但至少你知道前方会有什么在等着你，不管这能带来什么帮助。 [party.hasCompanions |从这里往上看，应该没有什么别的东西了。 [companion1.name] 说着，便挡在了前面。 [companion1.hisHer] 眼睛如同 [companion1.heShe] 远处的挖掘现场渐渐消失在视线中。 考虑到那里有那么多的暴徒，等我们回来时，桑德斯最好能给我们带来一些好东西。 | ] 是的。如果你决定要做某件事，那就应该全力以赴地去完成它；否则，从这里你已经能够获得关于整个情况的最为全面的了解了。如果可以的话，是时候根据你收集到的这些信息采取行动了。

If you're going to do something, you ought to do it, but otherwise you've got as complete an overview of the situation as you can from up here. Time to act on the information you've gathered, if you can."

rows.original: You pull out a full flask of naphtha from your pack and roll it in your hand, testing its weight as you eye the cultists milling far below you. Rock won't burn, but their palisades will, and it doesn't look like they have any water — which wouldn't work anyway — or sand readily available. This should make short work of them. [party.comp brint brienne |"Reminds me of some of the tunnel fighting tactics I'd overhear the men talking about when I was still a calf," Brint says as he comes up beside you and peers down. "They'd light fires in underground tunnels, suck out all the air and replace it with smoke. Force someone to abandon an entrenched position. I know that there's a ravine and not a tunnel, but with one that narrow a fire big enough would come pretty close." You weren't thinking of that when you came up with this plan, but forcing the cultists out into the open sounds like a neat bonus. |"Reminds me of some of the tunnel fighting tactics I'd overhear the men talking about when I was still a calf," Brienne says as she comes up beside you and peers down. "They'd light fires in underground tunnels, suck out all the air and replace it with smoke. Force someone to abandon an entrenched position. I know that there's a ravine and not a tunnel, but with one that narrow a fire big enough would come pretty close." You weren't thinking of that when you came up with this plan, but forcing the cultists out into the open sounds like a neat bonus. ] Finding some scraps of rope and old rags amongst your possessions, you wring them into a crude fuse of sorts, dip it into the jellied oil and set it aflame. It ignites with a glorious %"whoomph", dancing with yellow and blue flames, and you don't hesitate before hurling the jug straight down at the barricade below, watching it plummet like a stone. Precious seconds pass before the ring of shattering clay echoes upwards the ravine walls to you, followed by plenty of screaming and the stench of heavy smoke. [party.has arona |"Ah, music to the ears," Arona says, making a show of cupping a hand to an ear and leaning down to listen. "Come on, [pc.name]. Let's head on down and finish off the rest of those idiots while they're still occupied. Can't wait to finally see some real action." ] That's right. You've got to take advantage of this situation before Tollus's goons get things under control, strike while the iron's hot. Making the descent from the clifftop in short order, you [party.hasCompanions|gather [party.compNames] and ]prepare to head on out again.
rows.translation: 你从背包中取出一整瓶石脑油，在手中揉搓着，感受它的重量，同时注视着下方那些正在活动的邪教徒。石头是不会燃烧的，但他们的栅栏却会；而且看起来他们既没有水——用水也没用——也没有现成的沙子。这样的话，应该能很快解决他们的问题。 [party.comp brint brienne |这让我想起了一些我在小时候还听那些士兵们讨论过的隧道作战战术。 布林特走到你身边，低头看着你说道。 他们会在地下隧道里生火，把里面的空气全部抽走，然后代替之以烟雾。这样就能迫使对方放弃坚守的阵地。我知道那里其实是一条峡谷，而不是隧道，但只要峡谷足够狭窄，那么一场足够大的火灾所产生的烟雾效果也会非常显著。 当你制定这个计划的时候，应该没有考虑到这一点，但把那些邪教徒逼到露天地带，似乎也是一个不错的附带效果。 |这让我想起了一些我在小时候还听那些士兵们讨论过的隧道战斗战术。 布蕾妮走到你身边，低头看着你说道。 他们会在地下隧道里生火，把里面的空气全部抽走，然后替换成烟雾。这样就能迫使对方放弃坚守的阵地。我知道那里其实是一条峡谷，而不是隧道，但只要峡谷足够狭窄，那么一场足够大的火灾所产生的烟雾效果也会非常显著。 当你制定这个计划的时候，应该没有考虑到这一点，但把那些邪教徒逼到露天地带，似乎也是一个不错的附带效果。 ] 你在自己的物品中找到了一些绳子残段和旧破布，将它们揉成了一种简易的导火索，然后将其浸入那黏稠的油中，点燃它。火焰“呼”的一声燃了起来，黄蓝相间的火轻型跳动着，你毫不犹豫地将那个装满导火索的容器朝下方的路障扔了下去，看着它像石头一样坠落下去。几秒钟后，陶罐碎裂的声音在峡谷的墙壁间回荡过来，紧接着便是人们的尖叫声以及浓烟弥漫的气息。 [party.has arona |啊，真是耳目一新的音乐。 阿罗娜做出用手捂住耳朵、然后弯下身子仔细倾听的动作。 来吧， [pc.name]我们赶紧下去，趁那些蠢货还在忙别的时候把他们解决掉。真等不及了，终于可以看看结果了 真实的 行动吧。 ] 没错。你必须在托卢斯的打手们控制局面之前抓住这个机会，趁热打铁。迅速从悬崖顶端下来，你 [party.hasCompanions|收集 [party.compNames] 以及 ]准备再次出发吧。

rows.original: While magical fire would dissipate quickly, the jellied oil is made to stick, burn, and be nigh-impossible to extinguish. It'd make short work of the cultists' wooden palisades.
rows.translation: 虽然魔法火焰会迅速消散，但这种胶状油却会粘附在物体表面，持续燃烧，而且几乎无法被扑灭。它一定能轻易摧毁那些邪教徒搭建的木栅栏。
rows.raw: "While magical fire would dissipate quickly, the jellied oil is made to stick, burn, and be nigh-impossible to extinguish. It'd make short work of the cultists' wooden palisades."

rows.original: You don't have this item on you to use.
rows.translation: 你当前并没有携带这个物品来使用它。
rows.raw: "You don't have this item on you to use."

rows.original: You pull out the glass vial of wyvern venom, testing its weight in your hand. As a liquid, there's not much of the viscous pink substance to be had, but you know it'll quickly exude all kinds of lusty fumes once exposed to air. That's got to be enough — hopefully. With how Tollus's underlings are low-key horny all the time, it probably won't take a very large dose of wyvern venom to render them too aroused to do anything useful. Well, nothing for it, then. Pausing a split second to take aim, you toss the glass vial down onto the barricade the demon cultists have set up. Nothing happens for a moment or two, then the tinkle of shattering glass, faint but sharp, echoes up the ravine walls to you. This is followed by several surprised shouts and many lusty moans in quick succession, letting you know of your plan's at least partial success. [party.has arona |"Can't decide which's giving me more of a chub, the thought of fighting these bastards or fucking them later," Arona chuckles as she cocks an ear towards the salacious sounds coming from the ravine below. "Come on, let's get our own piece while they're still warm, eh?" ] That's right. You've got to take advantage of this situation before Tollus's goons get things under control, strike while the iron's hot. Making the descent from the clifftop in short order, you [party.hasCompanions|gather [party.compNames] and ]prepare to head on out again
rows.translation: 你取出了那个装着双足飞龙毒液的玻璃小瓶，在手中掂了掂它的重量。这种呈液态的、粘稠的粉红色物质体积并不大，但你知道，一旦接触到空气，它很快就会散发出各种刺鼻的气味。 希望这样已经足够了。考虑到托卢斯的那些手下总是蠢蠢欲动、欲火中烧，恐怕只需要一点点 翼龙 的毒液，就能让他们兴奋到无法做出任何有用的行动。 好吧，那也没办法了。 你暂停了片刻来瞄准目标，然后将那个玻璃小瓶扔向恶魔教徒设置的路障上。有那么一两秒钟，什么动静都没有，随后，玻璃破碎的清脆声响在峡谷的墙壁间回荡开来——那声音很微弱，但却十分清晰。 紧接着，一连串惊讶的呼喊声和许多充满欲望的呻吟声接踵而至，这足以说明你的计划至少取得了部分成功。 [party.has arona |真不知道到底是想着和这些混蛋打架更让我兴奋，还是想着之后把他们干掉更让我兴奋…… 阿罗娜轻笑着，侧耳倾听着从下方峡谷中传来的那些令人遐想的声音。 快点，趁它们还热乎，咱们也拿一份吧，怎么样？ ] 没错。你必须在托卢斯的打手们控制局面之前抓住这个机会，趁热打铁。迅速从悬崖顶端下来，你 [party.hasCompanions|收集 [party.compNames] 以及 ]准备再次出发吧。
