rows.original: While the cultists are clearly expecting a physical assault, they probably aren't expecting an aphrodisiac one.
rows.translation: 虽然那些狂热信徒显然预料到会遭到身体攻击，但他们恐怕没有想到会遇到一种能激发性欲的攻击方式。
rows.raw: "While the cultists are clearly expecting a physical assault, they probably aren't expecting an aphrodisiac one."

rows.original: You don't have this item on you to use.
rows.translation: 你当前并没有携带这个物品来使用它。
rows.raw: "You don't have this item on you to use."

rows.original: [flags.CLOISTER_QUEST_CLIMB_HANDLED 3 |You give Einin a meaningful look. Hey, you're pretty sure she keeps those aphrodisiac canisters on her all the time, right? The things she uses in combat? Think the cultists in the ravine would appreciate a handful of them landing at their feet? The little mousefolk crosses her arms and rolls her eyes. "Do I have to do everything myself?" [pc.isDK|Oh, of course. She's such a useful help; you wouldn't keep her around otherwise, right?|Wouldn't be asking if she wasn't good at making herself useful to you.] "Eh." That, and these people are edging in on her home turf. She wouldn't want Tollus's goons getting even more of a foothold in Harvest Valley, would she? Might get a little too close to home for comfort. Einin sags her shoulders. "[pc.isDK|Oh, fine. Since you can't clear out these goons by yourself I guess I'll just have to earn my keep and take care of them for you.|You're right, sorry. I hate the sight of them, and being here makes me nervous. I'll take care of it.]" If she would, please. |In the middle of devising a plan of attack, you give Einin a meaningful look. The mouse-thief is never seen without the tools of her illicit trade, and the ones catching your eye are the aphrodisiac bombs fit to her belt. You've seen her use them plenty of times. Smilingly, you wonder aloud if the cultists down there would appreciate a few of those landing at their feet. Einin blinks and rolls her eyes. "I already thought of that." Absolutely; she must have been waiting with bated breath to get one up on the people [pc.isDK|abducting and raping her friends and family|closing in on her home]. Her brow sets and her ears fold forward. "Just say the word,", she whispers.] The mousefolk [pc.isDK|mumbles under her breath and reaches for her belt pouch,] drawing out a handful of thin glass rods. At first, you think the liquid within them is wyvern venom, but no — it's too thin, for one, and the color's not quite the same. Still, Einin counts out three of them and drops the rest back into the pouch, heading for the cliff edge. With a solemn air of finality, she releases her hold on them and watches the alchemical concoction plummet straight down towards the cultists' barricade. "They all deserve worse." Nothing happens for a moment or two, then the tinkle of shattering glass, faint but sharp, echoes up the ravine walls to you. This is followed by several surprised shouts and many lusty moans in quick succession, letting you know of your plan's at least partial success. Well, looks like it worked. Like you said, this sort of thing is why you keep her around. "Of course it worked," Einin replies, dusting off her hands. Try as she might, she can't help but look a bit smug. "Won't last too long, so we should take them out while they're busy, right?" That's right. You've got to take advantage of this situation before Tollus's goons get things under control, strike while the iron's hot. Making the descent from the clifftop in short order, gather [party.compNames] and prepare to head on out again.
rows.translation: [flags.CLOISTER_QUEST_CLIMB_HANDLED 3 |你意味深长地看了艾宁一眼。嘿，你应该很确定她一直随身带着那些催情罐吧？就是她在战斗中使用的那些东西……想想看，如果那些邪教徒落在他们脚下，他们肯定会非常高兴的吧？ 那只小老鼠族女孩双臂交叉，翻了个白眼。 我应该……吗？ 拥有 难道所有事情都要我自己来做吗？ [pc.isDK|哦，当然。她是个非常实用的帮手；否则你也不会留她在你身边，对吧？|如果她不能帮你解决问题、发挥自己的作用，我也不会来问你这些了。] 呃。 而且，这些人正在逐渐侵入她的地盘。她肯定不希望Tollus的手部下在丰收谷获得更多的立足之地，对吧？那样的话，对他们来说未免太危险了。 Einin耸了耸肩。 "[pc.isDK|哦，好吧。既然你一个人无法对付这些混蛋，那我想我就只好帮你们把他们解决掉吧。|你说得对，对不起。我实在无法忍受看到它们的样子，而且待在这里让我感到很紧张。我会处理这个问题的。]" 如果她愿意的话，那就太好了。 |在制定攻击计划的过程中，你意味深长地看了埃宁一眼。这个老鼠贼出门时总是带着她用于非法交易的工具，而最吸引你注意的，就是她腰间别着的那些催情炸弹。你早就见过她多次使用这些东西了。你不禁笑着自问：那些邪教徒要是收到几颗落在他们足部边的炸弹，会不会感到高兴呢？ 埃宁眨了眨眼，然后翻了个白眼。 我已经考虑过那个办法了。 当然；她肯定是一直屏息等待着，就为了能比别人先得到它。 [pc.isDK|绑架并强奸她的朋友和家人|逐渐逼近她的住所]她的眉头紧锁，耳朵也向前耷了下来。 只要你说出一个词就行了。 她轻声说道。] 鼠人族 [pc.isDK|她小声嘟囔着，然后伸手去拿腰带上的小袋子。] 她取出了几根细长的玻璃棒。起初，你可能会以为里面的液体是双足飞龙毒液，但事实并非如此——首先，这种液体的浓度太低了，颜色也不完全对。不过，艾宁还是取出了其中三根，把剩下的重新放回袋子里，然后朝着悬崖边缘走去。她带着一种决绝的神情，松开了手部，看着那些炼金药剂直直地坠向那些邪教徒设置的障碍物。 他们全都活该受到更严厉的惩罚。 有那么一两刻，什么动静都没有，然后，玻璃碎裂的清脆声响在峡谷的岩壁上回荡开来——那声音很微弱，但却十分清晰。紧接着，一连串惊讶的叫声和许多兴奋的呻吟声接踵而至，这一切都说明你的计划至少取得了一定的成功。 嗯，看来是奏效了。就像你说的，正是因为有这样的时刻，你才愿意让她留在身边。 当然，它成功了。 艾宁一边回答，一边拍掉手部上的灰尘。尽管她努力想要表现得低调一些，但还是忍不住露出了一丝得意的神情。 不会持续太久，所以我们应该在他们忙的时候把它们处理掉，对吧？ 没错。你必须在托卢斯的打手部们控制局面之前抓住这个机会，趁热打铁。尽快从悬崖顶端下来，然后集合起来。 [party.compNames] 然后准备再次出发吧。

rows.original: You're pretty sure the little mousefolk has a steady supply of aphrodisiacs on her. Why use your own resources when you could have her do the work for you?
rows.translation: 你很确定那个小老鼠族女孩身边总是有各种催情剂吧？既然她可以帮你完成这个任务，为什么还要自己耗费资源呢？
rows.raw: "You're pretty sure the little mousefolk has a steady supply of aphrodisiacs on her. Why use your own resources when you could have her do the work for you?"

rows.original: [quin.relationshipRange 0 15|Although you aren't too close, you know better than anyone after seeing it firsthand that Quin's magic can be potent; its uses alone can meddle with the mind. You turn and ask him squarely:|After spending so much time together, Quintillus and his magic are plainly obvious candidates for bursting up their little defense force. Yet when you turn, you find him already putting his hands together. You smile, stepping close and grabbing his shoulder;] can he take care of them from here? "Well," he sighs, albeit sounding far from authentic. "I suppose I can spare a few cultists with my... talents." The taeleer rolls his shoulders and steps closer to the edge, peering down at the barricade. Both of his ears straighten up, his fur slowly morphing into its fiery pink hue; the bun's eyes glow brighter, raising his right hand and pointing his finger at the centermost cultist. "After this, you owe me a drink. No... two." The taeleer snaps his other hand and a jolt of lightning arcs off and down below; its color and hue do nothing to illuminate the area, crashing down out of sight. Quintillus steps back from the edge and crosses his arms, letting the pale flames slowly slip back into his furry coat. Although you had expected a lot more, the silence in the air has you doubting just how effective it was. That is until Quin raises his hand and presses his fingers together. "Three, two, aaaaand... one." A soft snap no louder than the one moments ago passes between you, yet immediately the chasm roars with cries and screams of ecstasy. Even if he's on your side, the level of accuracy to his mental magic's effectiveness leaves you a bit slackjawed.[party.has cait| Cait grabs your sleeve, leaning in close and pouting. "If he's that good, [cait.fucked|we may need to try that out to make things even wilder at night|I think I know why I keep orgasming back at the Frost Hound]."] As awe-inspiring as it may be, though, you've got to take advantage of this situation before Tollus's goons get things under control. Making the descent from the clifftop in short order, you [party.hasCompanions|gather [party.compNames] and ]prepare to head on out again.
rows.translation: [quin.relationshipRange 0 15|虽然你与他并不十分亲近，但亲眼见到之后，你比任何人都更清楚——奎因的魔法确实非常强大，它的某些用途甚至能够影响人的精神状态。于是你转过身，直截了当地问他：|在共同度过了这么多的时光之后，昆蒂勒斯和他的魔法显然已经成为威胁他们这个小防御队伍的潜在因素。然而当你转过身去时，你会发现他已经在双手合十祈祷了。你微笑着走上前，抓住他的肩膀说：] 他从这里开始能照顾好他们吗？ “嗯，”他叹了口气，不过听起来并不太真诚。“我想我应该可以吧。 可以 用我的……能力，饶几名邪教徒一命吧。” 泰勒耸了耸肩，走到边缘附近，向下俯视着那道路障。他的两只耳朵都竖了起来，身上的毛色也逐渐变成了火红色的光芒；他的眼睛也变得更加明亮了。他抬起右手部，用手部指着最中间的那个邪教徒。 之后，你得请我喝一杯。不……两杯。” 泰勒猛地甩了甩另一只手部，一道闪电从天而降，但它那刺目的光芒并没有照亮周围的环境，只是瞬间划过视线，消失在了黑暗中。 昆蒂勒斯从边缘退后几步，双臂交叉抱在胸前，任那些淡色的火焰缓缓重新融入他那毛茸茸的外套之中。虽然你原本期待着会有更惊人的效果，但空气中的这份寂静却让你开始怀疑这种做法究竟有多有效。 直到奎因举起手部，将手部指捏在一起。 “三、二、一…… 一个啪”的一声，声音并不比刚才那声更大，但这一瞬间，整个空间仿佛被狂喜的呼喊与尖叫所充斥。即使他站在你这一边，这种精神魔法的高精准度依然让你惊叹不已。[party.has cait| 凯特抓住你的袖子，凑近身体，撅着嘴说道：“如果他真的有那么厉害的话 [cait.fucked|我们或许需要试试这个方法，让夜晚的气氛变得更加热闹非凡。|我想我现在明白为什么每次在“霜猎犬”那里都会达到高潮了……]."] 然而，尽管这一情景令人敬畏，你还是必须尽快利用这个机会，因为在Tollus的手部下控制局面之前。你得尽快从悬崖顶端下来。 [party.hasCompanions|收集 [party.compNames] 以及 ]准备再次出发吧。
rows.raw: ' [quin.relationshipRange 0 15|Although you aren't too close, you know better than anyone after seeing it firsthand that Quin's magic can be potent; its uses alone can meddle with the mind. You turn and ask him squarely:|After spending so much time together, Quintillus and his magic are plainly obvious candidates for bursting up their little defense force. Yet when you turn, you find him already putting his hands together. You smile, stepping close and grabbing his shoulder;] can he take care of them from here? "Well," he sighs, albeit sounding far from authentic. "I suppose I can spare a few cultists with my... talents." The taeleer rolls his shoulders and steps closer to the edge, peering down at the barricade. Both of his ears straighten up, his fur slowly morphing into its fiery pink hue; the bun's eyes glow brighter, raising his right hand and pointing his finger at the centermost cultist. "After this, you owe me a drink. No... two." The taeleer snaps his other hand and a jolt of lightning arcs off and down below; its color and hue do nothing to illuminate the area, crashing down out of sight. Quintillus steps back from the edge and crosses his arms, letting the pale flames slowly slip back into his furry coat. Although you had expected a lot more, the silence in the air has you doubting just how effective it was. That is until Quin raises his hand and presses his fingers together. "Three, two, aaaaand... one." A soft snap no louder than the one moments ago passes between you, yet immediately the chasm roars with cries and screams of ecstasy. Even if he's on your side, the level of accuracy to his mental magic's effectiveness leaves you a bit slackjawed.[party.has cait| Cait grabs your sleeve, leaning in close and pouting. "If he's that good, [cait.fucked|we may need to try that out to make things even wilder at night|I think I know why I keep orgasming back at the Frost Hound]."] As awe-inspiring as it may be, though, you've got to take advantage of this situation before Tollus's goons get things under control. Making the descent from the clifftop in short order, you [party.hasCompanions|gather [party.compNames] and ]prepare to head on out again. '

rows.original: Tossing a magical fireball down there might be a bit too risky, but Quin has another talent you can think of that might help deal with this: his lust magic.
rows.translation: 向下扔一个魔法火球或许有点太危险了，但奎因还有另一项能力，或许可以用来解决这个问题：他的欲望魔法。
rows.raw: "Tossing a magical fireball down there might be a bit too risky, but Quin has another talent you can think of that might help deal with this: his lust magic."

rows.original:
You consider your options once more, and coming up short, shrug and decide to leave. The chance to scout ahead has in and of itself already been enough of a boon to you; managing to do something concrete to the cultists holed up in the ravine under you would have been the cherry on the cake. At least you're mentally prepared to storm the barricade, since it looks like it's going to come down to that.

                With that in mind, you carefully climb down the cliff and make your way back to the trail. Better be prepared for what's ahead.
rows.translation:
你再次考虑了自己的选择，发现没有其他办法，便耸了耸肩，决定离开。能够先探路本身就已经对你来说是一大帮助了；要是还能对那些躲在下方峡谷里的邪教徒采取一些实际行动，那就更是锦上添花了。 至少你在心理上已经做好了冲破障碍物的准备，因为看起来最终确实会走到那一步。

                有了这样的想法，你小心翼翼地爬下悬崖，重新回到了小路上。最好做好迎接前方挑战的准备。
rows.raw:
"
                You consider your options once more, and coming up short, shrug and decide to leave. The chance to scout ahead has in and of itself already been enough of a boon to you; managing to do something concrete to the cultists holed up in the ravine under you would have been the cherry on the cake. At least you're mentally prepared to storm the barricade, since it looks like it's going to come down to that.

                With that in mind, you carefully climb down the cliff and make your way back to the trail. Better be prepared for what's ahead."

rows.original: There's nothing you can do about the situation now with the resources you have on hand. Forewarned is forearmed; just leave.
rows.translation: 以你目前手头的资源，对于这种局面你无能为力。未雨绸缪总比事后补救好；干脆离开吧。
rows.raw: "There's nothing you can do about the situation now with the resources you have on hand. Forewarned is forearmed; just leave."

rows.original: Examine what lies ahead on the trail.
rows.translation: 仔细观察小路上前方有什么。
rows.raw: "Examine what lies ahead on the trail."

rows.original: Rounding the next bend on the trail, you're greeted by quite the sight: a palisade formed from boulders, upturned wagons and logs. The former aside, none of these are common in this neck of the mountains, and must've been lugged all the way here. There's even a warning beacon in the form of a bonfire, although it's been long since used up and the cultists haven't had the time or resources to replace the charred remains with fresh wood. All the better for you, else they alert their fellows further along the trail. The barricade itself overlooks a good stretch of open trail leading up to it, with little cover for anyone heading down the only approach and clearly intended to take anyone heading up the trail by surprise while preventing an easy retreat into cover. Whoever ordered this chokepoint reinforced certainly knew what they were doing. [flags.CLOISTER_QUEST_BARRICADE_HANDLED 1 2 |Indeed, this would have been quite the impressive roadblock were it not wholly ablaze and the fire spreading by the moment; the fruits of your insidious attack having time to take root in between you climbing down from the cliff and arriving on the trail. Bluish flames so particular of naphtha leap from the puddle of viscous, burning liquid, turning to a more conventional yellow as the dry timbers in the barricade easily catch alight. The smooth ravine yields little in the way of sand, and the cultists' attempts to douse the fire with what little water they have on hand only causes the oil fire to spread even further. With its defenders busy and their minds on more pressing matters, it's easy for [party.combatNames] to creep up on their position, ready for action. Not that your immediate fears are realized — Tollus's goons are losing the battle against the raging flames, and they know it. At length, their efforts flag, and one of the stouter timbers comes crashing down on part of the barricade, crushing cart bodies underneath with its bulk and sending smouldering splinters flying into the air. This is the final straw. Utterly demoralised, the remaining cultists abandon their position and flee northwards, their footsteps echoed by the angry bellows of someone... although to be frank, it sounds more like something. What that is quickly reveals itself, silhouetted against the blazing timbers. As ropes fray and snap, sending more of the barricade crashing in upon itself, a towering, imposing figure kicks a wagon wheel aside and storms towards you. He — or at least, you think that's what it is by the general cut of the body under the plated robes — wields a heavy mace in one hand and a diamond-shaped shield of purple crystal in the other, and you dodge aside as its spiked head sails through the air where you were seconds ago. Despite the oddly-shaped helmet he's wearing having neither visor nor slits, being a blank facade of bronze, the cultist leader turns his head towards you as if sizing you up. "The Master said you might interfere." The voice is somewhat muffled by the faceless helmet as he raises his mace for another blow. "I suppose you were more clever than I took you for, but I don't need to turn you into a pincushion to put you down myself." |In fact, it would've been more impressive and perhaps even functional if there were actually people atop the palisade to discourage trespassers from approaching. As things stand, though, no one's there to dissuade your approach; the reason why soon becomes evident as you draw close. Moaning reaches your ears when you're within a stone's throw of the palisade, accompanied by the sounds of raunchy sex. Seems like your gamble paid off — keeping his underlings at least a little horny at all times might get them in the proper frame of mind for being in a demonic sex cult and all, but surely Master Tollus would've accounted for the fact that doing so would have rendered them vulnerable to this sort of attack, right? Their robes lying discarded on the rocky ground and naked, tattooed skin glistening, the cultists who ought to have been manning the barricade are too busy having all kinds of perverse fun with each other to notice [party.combatNames] as you stroll by them, kicking away their bows and blades. Things look they're going to be a walk in the park until your path is blocked by a towering, imposing figure, kicking aside one of his underlings as he makes straight for you. He — or at least, you think that's what it is by the general cut of the body under the plated robes — wields a heavy mace in one hand and a diamond-shaped shield of purple crystal in the other, and you dodge aside as its spiked head sails through the air where you were seconds ago. Despite the oddly-shaped helmet he's wearing having neither visor nor slits, being a blank facade of bronze, the cultist leader turns his head towards you as if sizing you up. Despite his heavy breathing and obvious arousal, he's managed to withstand the effects of the aphrodisiac you doused the barricade with, be it through his sheer size diluting the dosage he received, or through dint of sheer willpower. "Clever. Very clever. The Master..." he gasps for air, clenching his armaments so hard his knuckles are white. "...Said you might interfere. Whatever, I don't need these worthless curs to take you down!"[party.has quin | "Oh?" Quintillus steps out, forcing the man to flinch. It seems the two may very well know one another. The reaver spits, glaring at the taeleer whilst audibly squeezing his mace's handle. "Quintillus, how are you still alive?" You look over and spot the bunny's normal cheery and flirtatious demeanor slip, instead glaring down the titanic male with a snarl. "Don't worry about it; if you live to the end of this day, I'll get real acquainted with you all over again. Now then, [pc.name]... shall we enact some justice on this musclehead?" |[pc.isDK | A brave front in the face of a considerable setback and bad situation, you see. Oh well, still, it wouldn't do to underestimate this one. ] ] |And judging by the sheer number of arrows nocked and aimed straight for you, the barricade's very certainly manned. Caught between a rock and a hard place, you've barely enough time to drop to the ground while the first salvo of arrows flies into the air, arcing before raining down on your general position. This... is unorthodox. Even at this distance, the dark robes and hoods of Tollus's demon cult are clearly visible, but they aren't taunting you, declaring the power of their dark lady or behaving in a manner that would be more stereotypical of the wild-eyed fanatics. No, it's draw, nock, loose — draw, nock, and loose again in disciplined silence. Well, fuck. [party.has arona |Arona snaps into action, the burly orcess pulling her shield out and holding the massive thing up at an angle. You vaguely wonder where she might've faced such an assault before to instinctively know what to do in the face of danger, but your thoughts are cut short as she grabs you by the scruff of your neck and pulls you into the cover of her pavise. "Stop fucking around and get in here!" [party.manyCompanions |Once you're safely pressed against her, she reaches for [companion2.name] and helps [companion2.himHer] into the cover her shield affords |Once she's satisfied you're safe, she braces herself for the next salvo of arrows that's coming down the ravine at you ]. "Gonna be a bit of a squeeze, but better than nothing." As if proving her point, an arrow whistles down and lands smack in Arona's shield, quivering as the barbed head sticks into hide and wood. She snarls and roars a curse [pc.ora orc |that would have made your mother blush |in suitably ferocious orcish ], then breaks into a brisk jog straight for the barricade. Seeing this development, the cultists focus their fire on her, more and more arrows slamming into her shield as she leans this way and that to intercept the missiles aimed for her legs; [party.manyCompanions |you and [companion2.name] |you ] have to hurry to keep up with Arona and the cover she's affording you. A last desperate salvo of arrows manages to graze Arona's arms and legs, painting her green skin with blood. That only enrages her more as she bowls straight into the barricade and the nearest cultist bowman, sending shards and splinters flying in all directions as she hurls him into his fellows, bowling the lot of them over into some nearby scrub. "Face me up close, you craven cunts!" Looks like Arona's got her blood up. Bringing up the rear, [party.manyCompanions |you and [comp2.name] |you ] move to back up the orcess as the cultists drop their bows and draw blades and daggers alike. |[pc.hasShield |You don't have time to waste. While the cultists are preparing to loose another volley, you take a defensive half-crouch and raise your [pc.offhand] at an angle to meet the impending attack. Barely have you steadied yourself before an arrow lands smack into your [pc.offhand], making your forearm jerk from the sharp impact as the barbed head digs into the shield's surface. Yeowch, that looks like it'd have been nasty had it actually managed to find its mark. [party.hasCompanions |Looking around, you shout for [party.compNames] to get in under the cover of your shield. Once you're sure everyone's as safe as can be given the circumstances |There's nothing for it. Breaking into a brisk, braced walk ], you press ahead resolutely with defenses raised. You've got to close the distance before those bastards can loose more arrows at you! Not that the defenders are slacking any. Seeing you come at them, Tollus's goons loose another salvo, and another — some fall wide, others slam into your shield, and one or two nick your skin, stinging as the barbed heads manage to draw blood. Whatever, better a scrape or two than being turned into a pincushion[pc.isDK | — but you'll be sure to make them pay dearly for annoying you ]. You soon close the distance[party.hasCompanions |, [party.compNames] hot in your wake ], and the cultists drop their bows and pull out blades and daggers to meet you in melee. |[var0 |Scrambling to your hands and knees, you search your mind for the appropriate incantation and gestures to deploy the shield of light that you oh-so-painstakingly learned to conjure. [pc.cl blackmage whitemage |While you've been trained to wield spells under pressure, the sight of a little over a half-dozen arrows nocked and ready to be loosed at you is enough to almost cause you to stumble over the incantation |Despite your magical aptitude not being at its peak right this moment, you scour your mind and eventually come up with the proper incantation from memory ]. Still, the shield of shimmering light materializes into existence just in time for the next salvo of arrows to break across its surface, faint sparks of light erupting into existence with each impact. Whew. You're safe for now, but also aware that the spell won't last very long under the cultists' continual assault. [party.hasCompanions |Looking around, you shout for [party.compNames] to get in under the cover of your magical shield. With everyone under the protection of your spell |Trusting in your magic ], you break into a run, barreling straight for the barricade. You've got to close the distance before those bastards can loose more arrows at you! Seeing you come at them headlong, Tollus's goons loose a final salvo of arrows at you, then drop their bows and draw wicked-looking blades and daggers, clustering about the barricade's entrance to greet you. The last of the missiles shatters your shield, splinters of the magical barrier falling away before dissolving into nothingness. That's fine, because you've already got your [pc.weapon] out and at the ready, closing in on the nearest of the cultists. |[pc.agilityRange 70 |You turn the drop into a roll, scrambling to your feet in short order. [party.som |Determined not to be taken any further by surprise, you |[party.compNames] is still lying in the dirt, and you rush over to lend a hand before Tollus's goons can ready another salvo. Together, the two of you |[party.compNames] are still lying in the dirt, and you rush over to lend a hand before Tollus's goons can ready another salvo. Together, the three of you ] make a mad dash for the barricade, zigzagging as erratically as you can while still making expedient progress towards your goal.[party.hasCompanions | Fortunately for [party.compNames], the cultists have figured that you're the biggest threat here and are focusing their fire on you in an attempt to bring you down. Flattering, perhaps, and you definitely don't need to worry that much about anyone besides yourself, but on the other hand there's a lot of pressure on you to stay standing. ] The experience is harrowing, to say the least. More than once, an arrow comes within inches of burying its cruel, barbed head into your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], but you're light enough on your feet and blessed with quick enough reflexes to catch yourself in the nick of time and hurl yourself the other way. Several others come really close, searing your flesh as the barbed heads catch and draw blood, but at least you don't suffer wounds any more serious than a couple of stinging grazes. It looks like the cultists were depending too much on quantity instead of quality in their attempt to bring you down, and are paying the price for it. Eventually, you're finally within arm's reach of the barricade, but the fight's not over yet. Drawing your [pc.weapon] [party.hasCompanions |and with [party.compNames] hot on your heels, ]you vault over an upturned wagon and bound atop a set of palings with your superior agility. Time slows as you plant your feet squarely on one of the bowmen's chests, sending him sprawling off his post and to the rocky ground with an %"oomph." Unperturbed by one of their number going down, the remaining cultists drop their bows and draw wicked-looking blades and daggers, closing in to engage you in melee. |There's no time to waste. Scrambling to your feet, you sweep the ravine with your eyes for any kind of cover, but Tollus's goons have done their job well and long since removed anything that might shield an approach to the barricade. Cursing, you [party.hasCompanions |shout for [party.compNames] to get behind you and run. Hopefully you can draw enough fire from the defenders on the barricade that they won't focus so much on your allies. |start off towards the barricade at a dash, knowing full well that this is quite possibly what the defenders want but having little choice in the matter. ] With retreat being out of the question, it's either move in or wait to be turned into a pincushion, and you're not giving these bastards the satisfaction of the latter. Though you move in as erratic a fashion as possible and zigzag as much as you can, you've simply nowhere near the impressive speed and reflexes someone would need in order to evade the hail of arrows aimed at you simply by dodging. Halfway to the barricade, you become aware of a searing pain in your shoulder as a cruelly barbed arrowhead tears into your shoulder; another one nicks your thigh, leaving your [pc.armor] stained with bright red. It could've been worse — the arrowheads could've lodged in you like the barbs were intended to encourage — but there's a noticeable limp in your step as you force yourself forward and vault over an upturned wagon and onto the palisade[party.hasCompanions |, [party.compNames] hot on your heels ]. The cultists are prepared for this move, and drop their bows to brandish serrated blades and daggers, moving in to meet you in melee. What you can see of their faces under their heavy hoods is grim and neutral, their mouths set in thin lines, and you wonder if Tollus has been recruiting a more... practical bent of underling for his more important projects. Either way... ] ] ] ] ] It's a fight!
rows.translation: 在小路上拐过下一个弯道，你眼前出现了一幅颇为壮观的景象：一排由巨石、翻倒的马车和原木堆砌而成的防御工事。除了那些巨石之外，这些材料在这片山区都是极为罕见的，它们肯定是被专门运送到这里的。 甚至还有以篝火形式出现的警示信号，只不过这些篝火早已被烧尽，那些邪教徒也一直没有时间或资源去用新鲜的木材重新点燃它们。这对你们来说反而是件好事——否则他们早就向沿途的其他同伙发出警报了。 这道路障本身正好能够俯瞰通往它那一段开阔的小路。对于那些从唯一可行的通道前进的人来说，几乎没有任何掩护；而这种设置显然就是为了让那些试图从这条小路上爬上来的人措手部不及，同时也能阻止他们轻易地找到掩护撤退。 凡是下令加强这个关键据点的人，肯定清楚自己在做什么。 [flags.CLOISTER_QUEST_BARRICADE_HANDLED 1 2 |事实上，如果这处障碍物没有处于燃烧状态，火势也没有在不断蔓延的话，那确实会是一道相当令人难以逾越的障碍。在你从悬崖上下来并到达小路上之前，你那阴险的攻击所造成的后果已经有时间逐渐显现并产生影响了。 那种特有的蓝绿色火焰从那滩黏稠的燃烧液体中喷涌而出，而当路障中的干木头被点燃后，火焰又变成了更为常见的黄色。这片平坦的沟壑中几乎没有沙子，那些狂信者们试图用他们手头为数不多的水来扑灭大火，结果却只是让油火蔓延得更加迅速。 在防御者们忙于处理更为紧迫的事情时，这种情况就很容易发生了。 [party.combatNames] 他们悄悄接近自己的阵地，随时准备行动。不过，你的担忧并没有成为现实——托卢斯的打手部们正在与熊熊烈火进行殊死搏斗，而且他们自己也意识到了这一点。最终，他们的抵抗力量逐渐减弱，有一根较为结实的木头倒下了，砸坏了部分路障，巨大的重量压坏了下面的马车，同时还将燃烧的木屑抛向了空中。 这真是压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草。彻底陷入绝望的那些邪教徒们放弃了他们的阵地，向北方逃去，他们的足部步声在某人的愤怒怒吼声中回荡……不过说实话，那声音听起来更像东西那东西的真实形态很快就暴露了出来——在熊熊燃烧的木柴映照下，它的轮廓清晰可见。随着绳索逐渐断裂，更多的路障开始倒塌，而一个高大威猛的身影则将一个车轮踢到一边，朝你的方向冲了过来。 rows.raw: " Rounding the next bend on the trail, you're greeted by quite the sight: a palisade formed from boulders, upturned wagons and logs. The former aside, none of these are common in this neck of the mountains, and must've been lugged all the way here. There's even a warning beacon in the form of a bonfire, although it's been long since used up and the cultists haven't had the time or resources to replace the charred remains with fresh wood. All the better for you, else they alert their fellows further along the trail. The barricade itself overlooks a good stretch of open trail leading up to it, with little cover for anyone heading down the only approach and clearly intended to take anyone heading up the trail by surprise while preventing an easy retreat into cover. Whoever ordered this chokepoint reinforced certainly knew what they were doing. [flags.CLOISTER_QUEST_BARRICADE_HANDLED 1 2 |Indeed, this would have been quite the impressive roadblock were it not wholly ablaze and the fire spreading by the moment; the fruits of your insidious attack having time to take root in between you climbing down from the cliff and arriving on the trail. Bluish flames so particular of naphtha leap from the puddle of viscous, burning liquid, turning to a more conventional yellow as the dry timbers in the barricade easily catch alight. The smooth ravine yields little in the way of sand, and the cultists' attempts to douse the fire with what little water they have on hand only causes the oil fire to spread even further. With its defenders busy and their minds on more pressing matters, it's easy for [party.combatNames] to creep up on their position, ready for action. Not that your immediate fears are realized — Tollus's goons are losing the battle against the raging flames, and they know it. At length, their efforts flag, and one of the stouter timbers comes crashing down on part of the barricade, crushing cart bodies underneath with its bulk and sending smouldering splinters flying into the air. This is the final straw. Utterly demoralised, the remaining cultists abandon their position and flee northwards, their footsteps echoed by the angry bellows of someone... although to be frank, it sounds more like something. What that is quickly reveals itself, silhouetted against the blazing timbers. As ropes fray and snap, sending more of the barricade crashing in upon itself, a towering, imposing figure kicks a wagon wheel aside and storms towards you. He — or at least, you think that's what it is by the general cut of the body under the plated robes — wields a heavy mace in one hand and a diamond-shaped shield of purple crystal in the other, and you dodge aside as its spiked head sails through the air where you were seconds ago. Despite the oddly-shaped helmet he's wearing having neither visor nor slits, being a blank facade of bronze, the cultist leader turns his head towards you as if sizing you up. "The Master said you might interfere." The voice is somewhat muffled by the faceless helmet as he raises his mace for another blow. "I suppose you were more clever than I took you for, but I don't need to turn you into a pincushion to put you down myself." |In fact, it would've been more impressive and perhaps even functional if there were actually people atop the palisade to discourage trespassers from approaching. As things stand, though, no one's there to dissuade your approach; the reason why soon becomes evident as you draw close. Moaning reaches your ears when you're within a stone's throw of the palisade, accompanied by the sounds of raunchy sex. Seems like your gamble paid off — keeping his underlings at least a little horny at all times might get them in the proper frame of mind for being in a demonic sex cult and all, but surely Master Tollus would've accounted for the fact that doing so would have rendered them vulnerable to this sort of attack, right? Their robes lying discarded on the rocky ground and naked, tattooed skin glistening, the cultists who ought to have been manning the barricade are too busy having all kinds of perverse fun with each other to notice [party.combatNames] as you stroll by them, kicking away their bows and blades. Things look they're going to be a walk in the park until your path is blocked by a towering, imposing figure, kicking aside one of his underlings as he makes straight for you. He — or at least, you think that's what it is by the general cut of the body under the plated robes — wields a heavy mace in one hand and a diamond-shaped shield of purple crystal in the other, and you dodge aside as its spiked head sails through the air where you were seconds ago. Despite the oddly-shaped helmet he's wearing having neither visor nor slits, being a blank facade of bronze, the cultist leader turns his head towards you as if sizing you up. Despite his heavy breathing and obvious arousal, he's managed to withstand the effects of the aphrodisiac you doused the barricade with, be it through his sheer size diluting the dosage he received, or through dint of sheer willpower. "Clever. Very clever. The Master..." he gasps for air, clenching his armaments so hard his knuckles are white. "...Said you might interfere. Whatever, I don't need these worthless curs to take you down!"[party.has quin | "Oh?" Quintillus steps out, forcing the man to flinch. It seems the two may very well know one another. The reaver spits, glaring at the taeleer whilst audibly squeezing his mace's handle. "Quintillus, how are you still alive?" You look over and spot the bunny's normal cheery and flirtatious demeanor slip, instead glaring down the titanic male with a snarl. rows.original: The reaver staggers, dropping his shield and reaching out for something, anything, with which to steady himself, but his grasping fingers close on empty air. [party.has arona |Grinning, Arona steps forward and gives the reaver a good slam on his armored chest with her [arona.weapon], sending him crashing into a nearby boulder. There's a loud metallic ding as the back of the reaver's helmet connects with solid stone, and then he slumps to the ground, blood trickling out from under the featureless, full-face helmet. "You're not half-bad yourself," Arona says with a nasty grin as she steps forward and kicks away the reaver's mace. "Almost got me a few times there. If this is what this so-called great evil is looking to put on the field, I'm going to have a great time." |[party.has brint |While the reaver's still off-kilter, Brint surges forward in a surprising burst of speed and plants the hilt of his [brint.weapon] straight into the reaver's chest with a metallic clang. The cultist stumbles backward and crashes back-first into a nearby boulder, a loud metallic ding sounding in the air as the back of his helmet connect with solid rock. Mace and shield falling from his hands, the reaver slumps to the ground and doesn't get back up. "He didn't work for his strength," Brint muses as he steps forward and kicks away the reaver's armaments. "You can tell. He wasn't used to his body, and that's one of the reasons we won. An advantage." |[party.has cait |He drops his mace and lashes out again, thick sausage fingers closing in on Cait's shoulder. Your pink kitten squeals and lashes out reflexively with her [cait.weapon], hitting the reaver square in the chest. Whether it's because he was already weakened from the battle, or because Cait didn't want a creepy tattooed guy laying his hands all over her, he stumbles back in shock. Her lips a thin, straight line, Cait follows this up with another straight to the head. The reaver falls back with a grunt, a dull clang sounding out as his helmet strikes a boulder and slumps to the hard, stony earth. "What a creep," Cait spits as she hurriedly dusts off her shoulder. "That hand of his was just so sweaty and clammy, it was revolting." You'd be surprised if anyone who would willingly join Master Tollus's little Kasyrra-worshipping troupe wasn't revolting on some level. "Pff." |You step forward and smack him with the business end of your [pc.weapon], straight on the chest for good measure. There's a dull clang as your attack bounces off one of the armored plates on his robes, but the impact is enough to send him staggering backwards and lose balance. The reaver falls onto a large boulder behind him, a loud clang ringing out as his helmeted head strikes smooth rock; he slumps to the stony earth and doesn't get up again. ] ] ] [party.comp einin |Observing from a safe distance, Einin whistles. rows.translation: 那个掠夺者摇摇晃晃地站着，丢掉了盾牌，伸手部去抓什么东西——任何能够让他站稳的东西，但他的手部指却只抓到了空气。 [party.has arona |阿罗娜咧嘴一笑，走上前，用她的拳头狠狠地击中了那个穿着盔甲的掠夺者的胸膛。 [arona.weapon]这一撞击使他重重撞上附近的一块巨石。当掠夺者的头盔后部与坚硬的石头相撞时，发出了剧烈的金属碰撞声，随后他瘫倒在地，鲜血从那顶毫无装饰、完全覆盖整个头部的头盔下渗了出来。 你自己也挺不错的嘛。 阿罗娜露出阴险的笑容，上前一脚将那把掠夺者的钉头锤踢开了。 有几次差点就骗到我了。如果这就是所谓的‘大恶’想要在战场上使用的手部段，那我可要好好享受这场战斗了。 |[party.has brint |虽然那个掠夺者仍然处于失衡状态，但布林特突然以惊人的速度冲了上去，将他的武器柄狠狠地插入 [brint.weapon] 金属碰撞声响起，长矛直接刺中了那个邪教徒的胸膛。他踉跄着向后倒去，后脑重重地撞在附近的巨石上，头盔的后部与坚硬的岩石相撞，又发出一声刺耳的金属声响。长矛和盾牌从他手部中掉落，那个邪教徒瘫倒在地，再也没能站起来。 他并不是靠自己的力量来工作的。 布林特一边思索着，一边上前将那夺命者的武器踢开。 看得出来，他还不太适应自己的身体，而这正是我们获胜的原因之一——一个优势。 |[party.has cait |他扔掉手中的钉头锤，再次冲了上来，那粗壮的手指紧紧抓住了凯特的肩膀。你的粉色小猫发出尖叫声，条件反射般地也挥动起了自己的爪子。 [cait.weapon]这一拳正中那名掠夺者的胸膛。或许是因为他在战斗中已经体力不支，又或许是因为凯特不愿让一个身上布满纹身的怪人触碰她，他震惊地踉跄后退。凯特的嘴唇紧抿成一条细直线，紧接着又是一记直拳击中他的头部。掠夺者发出一声闷哼，头盔撞在巨石上发出沉闷的声响，随后重重地倒在坚硬的石地上。 真是个变态。 凯特急忙拍掉肩上的灰尘，同时吐了口唾沫。 他的那只手部简直湿漉漉的，黏糊糊的，让人感到非常恶心。 如果你遇到有人愿意自愿加入托卢斯大师那个崇拜卡希拉的小团体，那你一定会感到惊讶——因为这样的人在内心深处，肯定也在某种程度上感到反感或不满。 哼。 |你上前一步，用工具的末端猛击了他一下。 [pc.weapon]为了确保效果，你直接朝他的胸膛猛击。你的攻击击中了他袍子上的护甲板，发出沉闷的金属碰撞声，但这股冲击力足以让他踉跄后退，失去平衡。那个袭击者摔倒在他身后的一块巨石上，他的头盔狠狠地撞在光滑的岩石上，又发出一声巨响，随后他瘫软在地，再也没能站起来。 ] ] ] [party.comp einin |从安全的距离观察着，艾宁吹了一声口哨。 嗯，看来是尺寸的问题吧 做 毕竟，这些东西都是有重量的。它们越大，就越容易成为目标——而且掉下来的时候也会越猛烈！ ] 你转过身来，心想在自己忙于对付那些恶魔教徒的首领时，是否还有其他人来到了现场，但此刻周围确实空无一人。你的目光再次落在那个被击败的敌人身上——虽然他现在静止不动，但你还是不敢靠近去确认他是否真的已经死了。他戴的那顶头盔，很可能确实有某种原因，用来遮住他的整个面部。 [party.comp einin |他说了些什么关于推迟我们行动的事情。 艾宁突然开口说道： [einin.weapon] 消失了。 我们得走了。 ] 好吧，是时候离开这里了。如果那个袭击者是在故意拖延你，而路上其他的人正在完成他们要做的任务，那么最好的办法就是立刻离开，就像一棵树一样迅速消失。

rows.original: You step aside and look to Quin, waving him toward the unconscious reaver. Your taeleer ally hesitates, shockingly staring at you. "You mean it? I... I can take my revenge?" [pc.isDK|The fucker deserves it after helping Tollus, doesn't he?|It isn't your ideal situation but the two clearly have bad blood.] One less enemy is better for both of you, isn't it? "Yes," Quintillus replies. "Yes... it is." The bunny steps forward, looking down on the reaver; his fur rages into flames, flickering hotter than normal whilst Quintillus reaches to his journal. Both of his eyes glow brighter, focused solely on the unconscious cultist yet flipping it open. One by one, he cycles through drawings and notes until he finds [flags.QUINTILLUS_STATUES|the rune for his stasis spell.|a strange glyph in the back. A circular pattern with various runes and magical symbols similar to the ones you'd seen on his journal's cover.] "Saving you would be too easy," Quin sighs. "Enjoy your prison, dumbass." The charming bunny raises one hand and the flames around his wrist surge forth, both of his eyes erupting with fiery auras. In an instant, the unconscious cultist is engulfed in the surging heat. It licks and shrinks him, completely covering every bit of him. As it burns down and leaves ashes, the only thing left where he had been is a statue: a perfect, down-scaled copy of the reaver. Your companion picks the miniature up, pocketing into one of his pouches. You make your way over Quin cautiously, grabbing his shoulder and watching the taeleer's ears droop. Moments ago he had been so proud and confident... but now, he was pale and tired. Is he okay? "Yes, I am now at the very least. It isn't like I killed him but using this compression-stasis magic isn't... easy." Although you don't mean to be rude, now isn't the time to discuss this. You need to get moving before the cultists find and surround you.
rows.translation: 你退到一边，看向奎因，示意他走向那个已经失去意识的掠夺者。你的泰勒尔盟友却犹豫了，震惊地盯着你。 “你是认真的吗？我……我终于可以报仇了？ [pc.isDK|那个混蛋在帮助了托卢斯之后，活该受到这样的报应，不是吗？|这虽然不是你理想中的情况，但很明显，他们两人之间的关系非常糟糕。] 对你们来说，少一个敌人不是更好吗？ “是的，”昆蒂勒斯回答道，“确实如此……” 那只兔子向前迈了一步，居高临下地盯着那个掠夺者；它的毛发仿佛燃烧起来，火焰比平常更加炽烈。与此同时，昆蒂勒斯伸手去拿他的笔记本。他的双眼亮得更加明亮，目光紧紧地盯着那个失去意识的邪教徒，然后打开了笔记本。他一页一页地翻阅着其中的图画和笔记，直到找到了他想要的东西。 [flags.QUINTILLUS_STATUES|用于施展静止术的符文。|背面有一个奇怪的符号——一个由各种符文和魔法符号组成的圆形图案，这些符号与你在他日记封面上看到的那些非常相似。] 救你未免太容易了，”奎因叹道。 “好好享受你的牢狱生活吧，笨蛋。” 这只迷人的兔子举起一只手，手腕周围的火焰猛地燃烧起来，他的双眼也迸发出炽烈的光芒。 刹那间，那个失去意识的狂热信徒被滚滚热浪吞噬了。那股热浪不断侵蚀他的身体，使他不断缩小，最终将他彻底覆盖。当火焰熄灭，只剩下灰烬时，在他原本所在的地方，只剩下一座雕像——那是一座完美缩小版的“掠夺者”雕像。 你的同伴捡起了那个小模型，把它放进了自己的一个袋子里。你小心翼翼地走到奎因身边，抓住他的肩膀，观察到那个泰勒尔的耳朵耷拉了下来——刚才他还充满了骄傲和自信呢。…但现在，他的脸色苍白，看起来很疲惫。他没事吧？ “嗯，至少现在我没事。我又没有真的杀死他，只是使用了这种压缩停滞魔法而已…… 简单虽然你并无冒犯之意，但现在并不是讨论这个问题的时候。在那些狂热信徒找到你并将你包围之前，你必须立刻行动。

rows.original: The last of the cultists staggers back, too winded to continue the fight. The black-robed bastard looks about, as if half-deciding whether to make a break for it or not, but the decision's made for him as he's thrown back by a thick, muscled arm and lands in the remains of a broken, upturned cart. "Useless. All of you, useless. But that's not your fault — it's my fault as a leader for failing you." Splinters fly into the air as you narrowly dodge the business end of a mace, the spiked bronze ball sinking into a beam by your shoulder. You don't know how the towering, imposing figure that now looms before you managed to hide so well, but he's here now, raising his mace for another swing at you. He — or at least, you think that's what it is by the general cut of the body under the plated robes — wields a diamond-shaped shield of purple crystal in his off-hand, and raises it to ward off your [pc.weapon] as you counter his blow. Despite the oddly-shaped helmet he's wearing having neither visor nor slits, being a blank facade of bronze, the cultist leader turns his head towards you as if sizing you up. "The Master said you might come and interfere, and you're certainly more than I expected," he rumbles. "But even if I am defeated here, all I have to do is delay you long enough." Long enough for what? "The less I know, the less I can tell," comes the curt reply as the mace smashes into a barrel. Looks like the time for talk is over with this one. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 最后一个邪教徒踉跄着后退，已经气喘得无法继续战斗了。那个穿着黑袍的混蛋环顾四周，似乎还在犹豫是否应该逃跑，但他的决定早已被别人替他做出了——一只粗壮有力的手臂将他推了回去，使他跌落在一辆被撞坏、翻倒的马车的残骸中。 毫无用处。你们所有人，都毫无用处。但这不是你们的错——而是 我的 作为领导者，如果他让你失望了，那他就是有缺点的。 当你侥幸躲过了那柄长矛的致命一击时，碎片纷纷飞向空中，那颗带刺的青铜球则击中了你肩膀旁的一根横梁。你实在不明白，这个此刻矗立在你面前的高大威猛的身影，究竟是如何成功地隐藏自己的踪迹的。但他现在又出现了，正举起长矛准备再次攻击你。他——或者至少，从他那身铠甲下露出的身形来看，你认为是他——在另一只手中握着一块紫色水晶制成的菱形盾牌，正举起来试图挡开你的攻击。 [pc.weapon] 就在你准备反击他的攻击时，那个邪教头目竟然转过头来看着你，仿佛在打量你一样。尽管他戴着的头盔形状怪异，既没有面甲也没有视线孔，只是一块光秃秃的青铜板，但他的动作却显得十分自然。 大师说过你可能会来干涉，而你确实比我想象中的还要厉害。 它发出隆隆声。 但即使我在这里被击败，我所要做的就是尽可能长时间地拖住你们。 足够做些什么呢？ 我知道得越少，就能说的越少。 当铁锤砸中桶子时，只传来简短的回应。看来，和这个人交谈已经没有意义了。 这是一场激烈的战斗！
rows.raw: " The last of the cultists staggers back, too winded to continue the fight. The black-robed bastard looks about, as if half-deciding whether to make a break for it or not, but the decision's made for him as he's thrown back by a thick, muscled arm and lands in the remains of a broken, upturned cart. "Useless. All of you, useless. But that's not your fault — it's my fault as a leader for failing you." Splinters fly into the air as you narrowly dodge the business end of a mace, the spiked bronze ball sinking into a beam by your shoulder. You don't know how the towering, imposing figure that now looms before you managed to hide so well, but he's here now, raising his mace for another swing at you. He — or at least, you think that's what it is by the general cut of the body under the plated robes — wields a diamond-shaped shield of purple crystal in his off-hand, and raises it to ward off your [pc.weapon] as you counter his blow. Despite the oddly-shaped helmet he's wearing having neither visor nor slits, being a blank facade of bronze, the cultist leader turns his head towards you as if sizing you up. "The Master said you might come and interfere, and you're certainly more than I expected," he rumbles. "But even if I am defeated here, all I have to do is delay you long enough." Long enough for what? "The less I know, the less I can tell," comes the curt reply as the mace smashes into a barrel. Looks like the time for talk is over with this one. It's a fight!"

rows.original: Deciding that Tollus's goons aren't going to be needing the stuff they brought with them any more, you conduct a quick search of the bundled supplies. Most of the goods wrapped up here are sundry and not worth carrying — nails, scraps of tough salted jerky, a hammer and chisel, some short lengths of rope. Looks like most of what they carried here was either used in building the barricade or carried further up the trail. However, buried beneath all the empty sackcloth wrapping is a small box, curiously nailed down to the cart bed on which it sits. A brief examination reveals a set of ornate carvings, and a very curious locking mechanism. [party.has einin |You glance at Einin and ask the little mousegirl if she knows anything about this kind of lock. Can she do anything about it? Einin takes all of three seconds to study the box before shaking her head. "Lockpicks won't work on this one — it's a wordlock chest. If we rip it off the cart bed and could find a fence willing to take it no questions asked, it might be worth more than what's in it. It's an antique in and of itself, and the mechanism isn't something even the Khor'minoans can make any more." Would she? She shakes her head. "Me? I wouldn't do it. It's too valuable to randomly fence... and my bosses would probably think I was embuzz... embezzleeng or something — er, not that that matters anymore. But if you want to open it... there should be a riddle on it somewhere. Solve it, and it opens... that's what I know." Hmm. [pc.bg scholar noblescion acolyte |Based on your own studies, you know that servants of Belharan nobility were not educated and could not read. Considering Einin's inexpert linguism, she'd probably never get these open either. |Riddles, eh? Shouldn't be too hard to figure out, if ancient Belharan security was testing someone's ability to read. [pc.isDK |Einin may be the only thief in existence who gets stumped by a reading test, too. She may not look it, but you can tell she's saving face right now. Cute. |How... convenient that this is the one box your informally educated mouse-thief would probably be unable to open on her own. ] ] |[party.has cait |"Father used to tell Calla and I about these," Cait pipes up as she studies the chest. "They're wordlock chests, a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly|players|servants]. Each combination lock was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was a riddle was often posed on the chest itself." So if you solved this thing, the lock would just pop open and you could just help yourself to anything inside. "Yep!" |[pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |You've come across these before in your past — wordlock chests, a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly|players|servants]. Each of these combination locks was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was, a riddle was often posed on the chest itself. If you could solve it and thereby rotate the tumblers into the right position, the chest would unlock and allow you to claim its contents. |Hmm, what can this all mean? It certainly seems like a thoroughly roundabout way to secure a container, but at least it isn't likely to be trapped in the bargain. You test the mechanism a few times, turn the tumblers, but nothing happens. ] ] ] You consider the box again. It's a strange way to go about securing valuables, to be sure, but also a fairly effective one given the circumstances; too bad for the demon cultists that you came along, eh? Would you like to have a go at opening it?
rows.translation: 你认为托卢斯的那些打手们已经不再需要他们带来的那些东西了，于是你迅速检查了一下这些捆绑好的物资。这里装着的大多数物品都是一些琐碎的小东西，根本不值得携带——钉子、一些咸肉碎块、一把锤子和凿子，还有几段短绳子。 看起来他们带在这里的大部分物品，要么被用来搭建路障，要么被带到了更远的地方。然而，在所有那些空麻袋的包裹之下，还有一个小盒子，它被奇怪地钉在了放置它的车架上。 经过简单的检查，人们发现了一组精美的雕刻，以及一种非常奇特的锁闭装置。 [party.has einin |你瞥了眼艾宁，询问这位小老鼠女孩是否了解这种锁的原理，以及她是否能够解决这个问题。 艾宁花了整整三秒钟来观察那个盒子，最终还是摇了摇头。 这個锁箱不能用开锁工具打开，它是密码锁箱。如果我们把它从马车上拆下来，再找到一个愿意无偿接收它的买家，它的价值可能会远远超过里面的物品。它本身就是一件古董，而这种锁具的制造技术，就连科尔米诺人现在也再无法复制了。 她会吗？ 她摇了摇头。 我？我可不会那么做。这个东西太有价值了，不能随便卖掉……而且我的上司们可能会觉得我在贪污什么的——呃，不过现在这已经不重要了。不过如果你想打开它的话……应该 somewhere 有個谜题。解开谜题，它就能打开……我是这么知道的。 嗯。 [pc.bg scholar noblescion acolyte |根据你自己的研究，你应该知道贝尔哈兰贵族的仆从们是没有受过教育的，也不识字。考虑到艾宁在语言能力方面的不足，她很可能也永远无法打开这些东西。 |谜语，嗯？如果古代贝尔哈兰的安全系统是用来测试某人的阅读能力的话，这些谜语应该不会太难解吧。 [pc.isDK |艾宁或许是这个世界上唯一一个会被阅读测试难住的小偷了。她看起来可能并不像，但你能看出她现在正在努力维护自己的面子呢。真是可爱。 |真是太方便了……这个盒子正是那种没有受过正规教育的老鼠小偷很可能自己根本打不开的东西。 ] ] |[party.has cait |父亲过去常常给我们讲这些故事。 凯特在研究那个箱子时开口说道。 这些是密码锁箱，是古老的贝尔哈兰贵族们非常喜爱的物品，它们的作用就是保护贵重物品免受那些不识字的人的侵害。 [silly|玩家们|仆从们]每个密码锁都需要输入正确的密码才能打开，而为了帮助主人记住密码，人们通常会在箱子本身上设置一个谜语来帮助记忆。 所以，如果你解决了这个问题，锁就会自动打开，然后你就可以取走里面的任何东西了。 没错！ |[pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |你在过去曾经见过这类东西——字锁箱。这种箱子曾是贝尔哈兰老贵族们的最爱，他们的目的就是用它来保护贵重物品，防止那些不识字的人偷走它们。 [silly|玩家们|仆从们]这些组合锁每一把都需要输入密码才能打开，为了帮助主人记住密码，人们通常会在箱子上设置谜语。只要你能解开这个谜语，将锁芯旋转到正确的位置，箱子就会打开，让你取走里面的物品。 |嗯，这一切到底意味着什么呢？这种方式看起来确实挺迂回的，但至少不会让人陷入什么麻烦之中。你试了几次这个装置，转动了那些旋钮，但什么反应也没有。 ] ] ] 你再次看了看那个盒子。用这种方式来保护贵重物品，确实有些奇怪，但考虑到当时的情况，这种方法也还算相当有效吧？那些恶魔教徒可就倒霉了，因为你出现了，对吧？你想试试打开它吗？

rows.original: You rub your temples and sigh. The riddle's right there in front of you, but its words might as well have been unscalable walls. Whatever's in the chest is going to have to stay inside until you figure this out.
rows.translation: 你揉了揉太阳穴，叹了口气。这个谜题就摆在你的眼前，但它的内容简直就像一堵高不可攀的墙。除非你解开这个谜题，否则箱子里的东西永远也取不出来。
rows.raw: "\n            You rub your temples and sigh. The riddle's right there in front of you, but its words might as well have been unscalable walls. Whatever's in the chest is going to have to stay inside until you figure this out."

rows.original: With flashing sword and booming cry With darkness staining land and sky Soldiers fall in glistening dress As battles are joined without egress
rows.translation: 伴随着闪烁的剑光与震天的呐喊 当黑暗笼罩大地与天空…… 身着闪亮战装的士兵们倒下了 当战斗开始后，便再无退路可言。
rows.raw: " With flashing sword and booming cry With darkness staining land and sky Soldiers fall in glistening dress As battles are joined without egress"

rows.original: Something within the chest clicks, followed by a loud thump as the mechanisms within disengage. Instinctively, you step back, fearing a trap, but your fears are soon allayed as the spring-loaded lid pops open, revealing the chest's contents. You quickly realize why the cultists were so particular about security here — in addition to a small amount of money, no doubt what remains of the funds for this expedition, there're several small items that look like they've been recently excavated. Finds that the cultists have dug out, then. [party.has einin |"Oh, early payday!" Einin chimes, the little mouse-girl whistling appreciatively as she picks up one of the electrum coins and bites it. "Yeah, these are good. Finders keepers, losers weepers. It's not stealing when you do it from bad guys, right?" She sure is picking up on this adventuring stuff really quickly. "Hey, it's kind of like what I used to do, if only a little bit more socially acceptable. A little bit." ] Without further ado, you pocket the small stash of coins and turn your attention to the cultists' finds. Though they're still smeared with dirt, [party.has cait |Cait is all over the marble fragments, picking them out of the box's velveted insides and raising them up to the light. "Hmm." Figure anything out? "I know enough of my theology to get that there's indeed Sorran symbology on some of these. That aside... there's not much inherent value of any of these, I'm afraid. At least, we know we're on the right track. That's got to count for something, right? Wait — oh, look at this!" Hmm? Your attention's drawn to the pair of light plated boots Cait's waving about. Someone's obviously tried to clean off the dirt and remove the patina that's accumulated on it in places, and it looks to be in pretty good condition despite how old it must be. If you replaced the rotted inner padding, it could still be serviceable even without needing to get it touched up at a forge. "I don't think it's what we were sent here to find, but it's nevertheless ours now. I'm not about to let those creeps get their hands on anything if I can help it!" That's a sentiment you can agree with. |you sift through the marble fragments, trying to figure if any of them hold any significance to you. [pc.bg acolyte scholar arcanist |Happily, thanks to your time as [a] [pc.background], you're able to at least recognize some of the symbology etched upon the marble fragments as clearly Sorran — flowing lines, jagged thunderbolts, wings. As much as what might be expected from cursory learning; someone who'd studied the field more in-depth might have been able to decipher more, but you know enough to be sure that Sanders didn't send you on a wild goose chase. |You pick up a couple of the marble fragments, trying to make head or tail of the symbology and considering what it might be about them that would have made the cultists deem them valuable. It looks vaguely religious, which means that Sanders didn't send you on a wild goose chase and that Tollus's goons are indeed after the same thing that you are, but any meaning beyond that simple inference is lost on you. ] Your attention, though, is drawn to the last item lying in the box — a pair of light sabatons fashioned from some kind of gray metal, much lighter than it ought to be. Someone's obviously tried to clean off the dirt and remove the patina that's accumulated on it in places, and it looks to be in pretty good condition despite how old they must be. If you replaced the rotted inner padding, they could still be serviceable even without needing to get them touched up at a forge. This probably isn't the relic Sanders sent you here to find, but it's not something you'd want to leave in the cultists' hands, either. You'll be able to make better use of it than they would. ] With that dealt with, you slam the chest shut and prepare to be on your way. Acquired 300 EC. Acquired 1x Winged Sabatons.
rows.translation: 箱子里的某个部件突然发出咔嗒声，随后随着内部机械装置的松动，传来一声沉重的撞击声。你本能地后退了一步，担心这是个陷阱，但很快你的担忧就消散了——弹簧装置驱动的盖子猛地弹开，露出了箱子里的物品。 你很快便明白了为什么这些狂热信徒对这里的安全如此重视——除了少量的钱之外，毫无疑问，这里还存放着这次探险剩下的资金，还有一些看起来像是刚刚被挖掘出来的小物件。 看来那些狂热信徒已经把东西挖出来了。 [party.has einin |哦，今天发工资了！ 艾宁宁轻声哼着小曲，那只小老鼠女孩满怀欣赏地捡起一枚琥珀金币，轻轻咬了一口。 没错，这些东西确实不错。谁找到了就归谁所有，谁没找到就只能哭鼻子了。从坏人手里拿走这些东西，根本不算偷窃，对吧？ 她确实学得非常快，对这类冒险类的事情掌握得也相当迅速。 嘿，这有点像我以前常做的事情，只不过现在这种方式在社会上更容易被接受了而已。只是稍微容易接受一点而已。 ] 不再多说，你把那小堆硬币收进口袋，然后把注意力转向那些邪教徒留下的物品。虽然它们仍然沾满了泥土 [party.has cait |凯特把那些大理石碎片都捡了出来，把它们从盒子里那柔软的天鹅绒衬里中取出来，然后把它们举到光线下仔细观察。 嗯。 弄清楚什么了吗？ 我对神学有所了解，因此知道这些物品中确实蕴含着索兰族的象征符号。不过……恐怕这些物品本身并没有什么太大的价值。至少，我们知道我们目前走在正确的道路上，这一点总归是值得肯定的，对吧？等等——哦，看这个！ 嗯？你的注意力肯定被凯特挥舞着的那双镀了金属的光亮靴子吸引住了。显然有人努力清理过上面的污垢，也去掉了那些积聚在某些地方的锈迹，所以尽管这些靴子已经很老了，但看起来仍然状况不错。如果把里面腐烂的衬垫换掉，即使不需要去铁匠铺修理，它们也应该还能继续使用。 我觉得这并不是我们被派到这里来寻找的东西，但它现在已经是我们的了。只要有可能，我绝对不会让那些家伙得到任何东西！ 这种观点确实值得认同。 |你仔细地筛选着那些大理石碎片，试图判断其中是否有任何一块对你来说具有特殊的意义。 [pc.bg acolyte scholar arcanist |幸运的是，多亏了你之前的付出与努力。 [a] [pc.background]至少，你能够辨认出那些刻在大理石碎片上的符号——流畅的线条、锯齿状的闪电图案、还有翅膀的形状。这对于那些只是粗略学习过这些符号的人来说，已经算是相当不错的成绩了；如果有人对这些符号进行了更深入的研究，或许还能解读出更多信息。但你知道，这些信息已经足够让你确信：桑德斯并没有让你白白浪费时间。 |你捡起了几块大理石碎片，试图弄清楚这些符号的含义，也在思考究竟是什么让那些狂热信徒认为它们如此珍贵。这些符号看起来带有某种宗教意味，这说明桑德斯并没有让你白白浪费时间，而托卢斯的那些手部下确实也在寻找与你一样的东西。不过，除了这个简单的推论之外，你完全无法理解这些符号背后的真正含义。 ] 不过，您的注意力可能会被盒子里的最后一件物品吸引——那是一双由某种灰色金属制成的轻型剑护足，其重量显然比应有的要轻得多。显然有人试图清除上面的污垢以及那些积聚在某些地方的锈迹，因此尽管这些护足已经非常陈旧了，但它们的状况还算不错。 如果你更换了那些已经腐烂的内衬材料，这些物品即便不需要送到铁匠铺进行修理，仍然可以继续使用。 虽然这可能不是桑德斯让你来这里寻找的那些遗物，但你也绝对不会想把它们留在那些邪教徒的手部里。 你能够比他们更充分地利用它。 ] 处理好这一切后，你便关上胸膛，准备踏上新的旅程。 获得了300点EC。 获得了1个带翼战靴。
rows.raw: " Something within the chest clicks, followed by a loud thump as the mechanisms within disengage. Instinctively, you step back, fearing a trap, but your fears are soon allayed as the spring-loaded lid pops open, revealing the chest's contents. You quickly realize why the cultists were so particular about security here — in addition to a small amount of money, no doubt what remains of the funds for this expedition, there're several small items that look like they've been recently excavated. Finds that the cultists have dug out, then. [party.has einin |"Oh, early payday!" Einin chimes, the little mouse-girl whistling appreciatively as she picks up one of the electrum coins and bites it. "Yeah, these are good. Finders keepers, losers weepers. It's not stealing when you do it from bad guys, right?" She sure is picking up on this adventuring stuff really quickly. "Hey, it's kind of like what I used to do, if only a little bit more socially acceptable. A little bit." ] Without further ado, you pocket the small stash of coins and turn your attention to the cultists' finds. Though they're still smeared with dirt, [party.has cait |Cait is all over the marble fragments, picking them out of the box's velveted insides and raising them up to the light. "Hmm." Figure anything out? "I know enough of my theology to get that there's indeed Sorran symbology on some of these. That aside... there's not much inherent value of any of these, I'm afraid. At least, we know we're on the right track. That's got to count for something, right? Wait — oh, look at this!" Hmm? Your attention's drawn to the pair of light plated boots Cait's waving about. Someone's obviously tried to clean off the dirt and remove the patina that's accumulated on it in places, and it looks to be in pretty good condition despite how old it must be. If you replaced the rotted inner padding, it could still be serviceable even without needing to get it touched up at a forge. "I don't think it's what we were sent here to find, but it's nevertheless ours now. I'm not about to let those creeps get their hands on anything if I can help it!" That's a sentiment you can agree with. |you sift through the marble fragments, trying to figure if any of them hold any significance to you. [pc.bg acolyte scholar arcanist |Happily, thanks to your time as [a] [pc.background], you're able to at least recognize some of the symbology etched upon the marble fragments as clearly Sorran — flowing lines, jagged thunderbolts, wings. As much as what might be expected from cursory learning; someone who'd studied the field more in-depth might have been able to decipher more, but you know enough to be sure that Sanders didn't send you on a wild goose chase. |You pick up a couple of the marble fragments, trying to make head or tail of the symbology and considering what it might be about them that would have made the cultists deem them valuable. It looks vaguely religious, which means that Sanders didn't send you on a wild goose chase and that Tollus's goons are indeed after the same thing that you are, but any meaning beyond that simple inference is lost on you. ] Your attention, though, is drawn to the last item lying in the box — a pair of light sabatons fashioned from some kind of gray metal, much lighter than it ought to be. Someone's obviously tried to clean off the dirt and remove the patina that's accumulated on it in places, and it looks to be in pretty good condition despite how old they must be. If you replaced the rotted inner padding, they could still be serviceable even without needing to get them touched up at a forge. This probably isn't the relic Sanders sent you here to find, but it's not something you'd want to leave in the cultists' hands, either. You'll be able to make better use of it than they would. ] With that dealt with, you slam the chest shut and prepare to be on your way. Acquired 300 EC. Acquired 1x Winged Sabatons."

rows.original: Open it up! What's in the box?
rows.translation: 把它打开吧！盒子里有什么？
rows.raw: "Open it up! What's in the box?"

rows.original: This isn't worth the trouble. Just let it be.
rows.translation: 这不值得费这个劲。就让它保持原样吧。
rows.raw: "This isn't worth the trouble. Just let it be."

rows.original: See if there's anything of use amongst the cultists' supplies.
rows.translation: 看看那些邪教徒的物资里有没有什么有用的东西。
rows.raw: "See if there's anything of use amongst the cultists' supplies."

rows.original:
You step off to the side and examine the fountain leaning against what remains of the walled cavern. Cut from white and pink marble, it's shaped in the form of a winged woman holding a basin, overflowing from a spout and disappearing into a culvert at her feet. The water still flows steadily after all these years, and the basin is surprisingly clean.

        Placed at roughly chest height for the average human, it's clear this is a drinking fountain and the water appears pretty sweet and clear. Snowmelt is as pure as it gets, and running through sand, gravel and stone all but guarantees its potable nature.

        Chance a sip, perhaps?
rows.translation:
你走到一旁，仔细观察那座倚靠在残余洞壁上的喷泉。这座由白色和粉色大理石制成的喷泉，被雕刻成一位手持水盆、有翅膀的女人的形象——水盆中的水从喷口流出，然后消失在她足部下的涵洞中。 这么多年过去了，这股水依然源源不断地流淌着，而这个水池也出奇地干净。

对于平均身高的人来说，这个饮水装置大概位于胸部的位置，很明显，这是用来饮水的，里面的水看起来既清澈又甘甜。 融雪是极其纯净的，当它流经沙子、碎石和石头时，几乎可以确保它仍然适合饮用。不妨尝上一口吧？

The water still flows steadily after all these years, and the basin is surprisingly clean.

        Placed at roughly chest height for the average human, it's clear this is a drinking fountain and the water appears pretty sweet and clear. Snowmelt is as pure as it gets, and running through sand, gravel and stone all but guarantees its potable nature.

        Chance a sip, perhaps?"

rows.original:
It's water, it's meant for drinking, and there's nothing about the fountain that suggests it was reserved for rituals, the altar's caretakers, or anything of the sort. Cupping your hands, you rinse them before gathering a bit of the water and taking a sip.

            Aah, now that's much better![party.hasCompanions
            | Seeing no ill effects surface on your countenance, [party.compNames] wait[party.oneCompanion|s] for you to be done, then take a turn at the water, too.
            ] You feel very much refreshed, and quietly thank whoever built this place for conveniently placing this sacred fountain right by the altar just where you need it.

            Time to face what's ahead, then...
rows.translation:
这是水，本来就是用来饮用的。这座喷泉没有任何迹象表明它是为仪式、祭坛的看守者之类的用途而设计的。你把双手部捧起来，先冲洗一下，然后取一些水喝了一口。

            啊，这样就好多了！[party.hasCompanions
            | 看到你的脸色没有任何异常变化， [party.compNames] 等等。[party.oneCompanion|s] 等你忙完了，也去玩玩水吧。
            ] 你感到精神为之一振，默默地感谢那些建造了这个地方的人——他们将这处神圣的喷泉安置在祭坛旁边，正好放在你需要的地方，真是太方便了。

那么，是时候面对前方的挑战了……
