rows.original: Maybe you could open that chest?
rows.translation: 也许你可以打开那个箱子？

rows.original: You squat down next to the old chest and peer at its etched riddle...
rows.translation: 你蹲在那个旧箱子旁边，仔细端详上面刻着的谜语……
rows.raw: "\n    You squat down next to the old chest and peer at its etched riddle..."

rows.original:
The lock clicks softly. Livrea pumps her fist into the air behind you. "You did it! Good job!"
        
        You give her a slight smirk over your shoulder and then pop the chest open. Inside, you find a breastplate sitting on a blue velvet cushion, accompanied by a white leather vest stitched with moonstones. The armor has blue crescent moons etched upon its gilded surface, still as vibrant and shiny as the day it was last polished. It practically glitters in the arcane light. 
        
        "Wow," Livrea says, looking over your shoulder. "It's beautiful." 
        
        [party.has cait
            |Cait bounces. "Wow's right. That must've belonged to somebody important. Maybe even a general, or a high lord. You said this camp had the Imperial household's colors, right? Could it have been a royal's?"
            
            Livrea shrugs. "I don't know that anyone from the royal house came this far north during the war, but our history from those days is... spotty, at best. Anything's possible."
        ]
        
        You gently lift the cuirass from its resting place. It's heavy, but a cursory rap against the chiseled abs on its belly indicates that the armor's as solid as any soldier's should be. It might be worth more to you in these dark and dangerous days than to a collector somewhere.
        
        "If you wear it, wear it with pride," Liv says. "You'll cut quite the heroic figure!"
rows.translation:
锁轻轻一声打开了。莉芙蕾娅在你身后兴奋地挥舞着拳头：“你做到了！干得好！”

你回头朝她微微一笑，然后打开胸腔。里面，你看到一块胸甲放在蓝色的天鹅绒垫子上，旁边还有一件缝着月轻型石的白色皮制背心。 这副铠甲的镀金表面上刻着蓝色的新月图案，那些图案至今依然鲜艳夺目，仿佛是刚刚被打磨过一样。在那种神秘的轻型芒下，它们简直闪闪发轻型。

“哇，”莉芙蕾娅从你身后说道。 真是太美了。 
        
        [party.has cait
            |凯特跳了起来：“哇，没错。那肯定属于某个重要人物，也许是一位将军，或者是一位高阶贵族。你说过这个营地使用了皇室的标志，对吧？难道那会是某位王室成员的东西吗？”

莉芙蕾娅耸了耸肩：“我不知道在战争期间是否有王室成员来到这么北边的地方，不过那段时期的历史记录……充其量也只能说有些零散不全。所以，一切都有可能。
        ]
        
        你轻轻地将这件胸甲从它放置的地方取下来。它很重，但当你用它轻轻敲击自己腹部那结实的肌肉时，你会感觉到这件盔甲确实像任何士兵应该拥有的那样坚固。在这样暗影而危险的时代，它对你来说，可能比对某个收藏家来说更有价值。

“如果你要穿上它，那就带着自豪感去穿吧，”莉芙说道，“你会显得非常英勇的！

rows.original: Our dance lasts forever 'cross the dark ocean's light; though our meetings are rarer, we turn day into night. Who am I?
rows.translation: 我们的舞蹈永恒不息，穿越暗影海洋的轻型芒； 虽然相聚的机会越来越少，但我们依然将白昼变为黑夜。 我是谁？
rows.raw: "Our dance lasts forever 'cross the dark ocean's light;\nthough our meetings are rarer, we turn day into night.\nWho am I?"

rows.original:
The snarling sounds you heard in the branch cavern are back, and more intense than ever. It's downright deafening, leaving you only able to talk between whatever beast is lurking in the cave's breaths. 
    
    "It sounds huge," Liv says, trying to whisper over the sound as you walk north. "Are you sure we should-" she's forced to pause by a snarl, "-go this way?"
    
    You are most definitely not, but at least you can see that there's an end to the path ahead. It's an overhang of solid stone, looking out over a cavern below. You get low and creep up to the edge, hoping you might get a good look at whatever monster lies beneath you now.
    
    When you finally peer over the edge, you almost wish you hadn't.
    
    "Oh, gods!" Liv gasps, covering her mouth. 
    
    You're looking at a beast the size of a warhorse, laying on a bed of precious gems and sparkling stones. It's curled up into a ball with its great draconic wings spread to cover itself, and its scaly tail draped over its long, crocodile-like snout. One of its canine fangs is much longer than the other, poking out of its jaw like a wicked scythe. You can see why Livrea would call it a dragon! The thing's almost the picture of one, save for its square jaw and comparatively diminutive wings. You doubt the creature could fly on its own, but perhaps it could glide down from the hilltops and catch its prey by surprise. Its claws are certainly big enough to crush most animals living in the region, even a bear or elk, and its body is covered in iridescent seafoam-colored scales that look as thick as any soldier's armor.
    
    Your bardic companion points to the beast and mouths 'Sea Wyrm!'
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |Of course. Kin to dragons, but with none of the majesty or intelligence. Just big, fire-breathing animals condemned to crawl on the ground rather than soar.
        |[pc.bg hunter
            |You're familiar enough with their kind: kin to dragons, but with none of the majesty or intelligence. Just big, fire-breathing animals condemned to crawl on the ground rather than soar.
            |You shrug. First time you've seen one.
        ]
    ] 
    
    The acoustics of the cave are amplifying its snores, making every slumbering breath sound like a true dragon's snarl. 
    
    Thankfully, the monster hasn't detected you yet. It's probably just as hard of hearing as you two are down there, surrounded by the echoes of its own snoring. 
    
    You glance around its lair from your vantage while you can. There's two entrances to the cave following the underground river, a pile of bones pushed off to one side, precious gems and even some coins scattered around — presumably offerings from the kobolds. They do love their dragons, and a wyrm is as close as it gets these days. But nothing stands out that could give you an edge...
    
    ... Until you [pc.isCanine
        |overcome your canine instincts and 
    ]look up. 
    
    The walls and floor of this cave have been worn smooth by the passing of water over the eons, but the ceiling is another matter. Thick, jagged stalactites hang down from overhead, and one of them happens to be perilously positioned right over the wyrm's nest. If only there was some way to knock it free...
rows.translation:
你在支脉洞穴里听到的那些咆哮声又出现了，而且比以往任何时候都要激烈。那些声音简直震耳欲聋，让你几乎无法在那些潜伏在洞穴中的野兽发出的吼声之外进行交谈。

“听起来那家伙体型很大啊，”莉芙边说边试图压低声音，你们正朝着北方走去。“你确定我们应该……”她的话被又一次咆哮声打断了，“……选择这条路吗？
    
    你绝对不是那样，但至少你可以看到前方的道路是有尽头的。那是一块坚固的岩石形成的悬岩，下方是一个洞穴。你弯下腰，小心翼翼地爬到边缘，希望能清楚地看到下面究竟有什么怪物。
    
    当你终于俯身看向下方时，你几乎会希望自己当初没有这么做。

“哦，天啊！”莉芙惊呼着，捂住了嘴。

你看到的是一只体型与战马相当的巨兽，它正躺在一堆珍贵的宝石和闪闪发光的石头上。 它蜷缩成一团，那巨大的龙翼展开覆盖着自己的身体，鳞片状的尾巴搭在它那长长的、类似鳄鱼的吻部上。它的其中一颗犬齿比另一颗长得多，从颌骨中伸出，就像一把邪恶的镰刀。 你就能明白为什么莉芙蕾娅会称它为“龙”了！这种生物简直就是龙的形象化身，只不过它的下颌呈方形，翅膀也相对较小。你可能会怀疑这种生物是否能够独自飞行，但也许它可以从山顶滑翔下来，然后出其不意地捕捉猎物。 它的爪子绝对足够大，能够碾碎该地区生活的大多数动物，甚至包括熊或麋鹿。它的身体覆盖着闪闪发光的、呈海泡沫色的鳞片，这些鳞片厚实程度不亚于任何士兵所穿的盔甲。
    
    你的吟游诗人同伴指着那头野兽，高声喊道：“海龙！
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |当然。它们与龙有亲缘关系，但却缺乏龙那种威严与智慧。只不过是些体型庞大、会喷火的动物，注定只能在地上爬行，而无法翱翔于天空之中。
        |[pc.bg hunter
            |你对这类生物应该很熟悉：它们与龙有亲缘关系，但却不具备龙的威严或智慧。只不过是些体型庞大、会喷火的动物，注定只能在地上爬行，而无法翱翔于天空之中。
            |你耸了耸肩，说道：“这是我第一次见到这样的东西。
        ]
    ] 
    
    洞穴的声学效果使它的鼾声被放大了，因此每一个呼出的气息听起来都像真正的龙吼一般。

幸运的是，那个怪物还没有发现你。它很可能和你一样，也被自己鼾声的回声所干扰，根本听不到周围的声音。 
    
    你趁现在还有机会，从有利的位置环顾了一下它的巢穴。沿着地下河流，洞穴有两个入口，有一堆骨头被挤到了一边，还有一些珍贵的宝石甚至硬币散落在地上——这些大概都是狗头人们献上的祭品。 他们确实非常喜爱自己的龙，而如今，巨龙已经是最接近他们想象中的“龙”了。但是，没有任何东西能真正让他们占据优势……

……直到你出现。 [pc.isCanine
        |克服你的犬类本能吧…… 
    ]向上看。

这个洞穴的墙壁和地面在亿万年的水流冲刷下已经被磨得光滑平整，但天花板却另当别论。厚厚的、参差不齐的钟乳石从上方垂下来，其中有一根恰好危险地悬在那条巨龙的巢穴正上方。要是有办法把它敲掉该多好……

        |Of course. Kin to dragons, but with none of the majesty or intelligence. Just big, fire-breathing animals condemned to crawl on the ground rather than soar.
        |[pc.bg hunter
            |You're familiar enough with their kind: kin to dragons, but with none of the majesty or intelligence. Just big, fire-breathing animals condemned to crawl on the ground rather than soar.
            |You shrug. First time you've seen one.
        ]
    ] 
    
    The acoustics of the cave are amplifying its snores, making every slumbering breath sound like a true dragon's snarl. 
    
    Thankfully, the monster hasn't detected you yet. It's probably just as hard of hearing as you two are down there, surrounded by the echoes of its own snoring. 
    
    You glance around its lair from your vantage while you can. There's two entrances to the cave following the underground river, a pile of bones pushed off to one side, precious gems and even some coins scattered around — presumably offerings from the kobolds. They do love their dragons, and a wyrm is as close as it gets these days. But nothing stands out that could give you an edge...
    
    ... Until you [pc.isCanine
        |overcome your canine instincts and 
    ]look up. 
    
    The walls and floor of this cave have been worn smooth by the passing of water over the eons, but the ceiling is another matter. Thick, jagged stalactites hang down from overhead, and one of them happens to be perilously positioned right over the wyrm's nest. If only there was some way to knock it free...
    "

rows.original: Despite the dangers, you've chosen to continue along the underground river, ready to face down whatever beast lurks in the inky darkness of the deep. It's a fairly long, curving tunnel between you and it, plenty of time to build up apprehension about your choices before you finally round the last of the bend, and come face to face [flags.LQ1_BEAST2 |with the sea wyrm. |with- "A dragon!" Livrea gasps, covering her mouth. "Wait. No." In front of you is a beast the size of a warhorse, laying on a bed of precious gems and sparkling stones. It's curled up into a ball with its great draconic wings spread to cover itself, and its scaly tail draped over its long, crocodile-like snout. One of its canine fangs is much longer than the other, poking out of its jaw like a wicked scythe. You can see why Livrea would call it a dragon! The thing's almost the picture of one, save for its square jaw and comparatively diminutive wings. You doubt the creature could fly on its own, but perhaps it could glide down from the hilltops and catch its prey by surprise. Its claws are certainly big enough to crush most animals living in the region, even a bear or elk, and its body is covered in iridescent seafoam-colored scales that look as thick as any soldier's armor. "Those scales," your bardic companion whispers. "It must be a sea wyrm." [pc.isCunning |Of course. Kin to dragons, but with none of the majesty or intelligence. Just big, fire-breathing animals condemned to crawl on the ground rather than soar. |[pc.bg hunter |You're familiar enough with their kind: kin to dragons, but with none of the majesty or intelligence. Just big, fire-breathing animals condemned to crawl on the ground rather than soar. |You shrug. First time you've seen one. ] ] ] The acoustics of the cave are amplifying its snores, making every slumbering breath sound like a true dragon's snarl. And those snores are quickening, getting fitful. Even deafened by its own breathing in this [silly |thunder dome |cavern ], the predator senses prey nearby. One of its eyes rolls open, gold and flecked with black. Its vertical slit narrows. "Shit shit shit," Liv gasps, taking a step back. One of her hooves crunches down on an animal bone, and the wyrm lunges to its feet in an instant, letting loose a roar that shakes you to your core. "This was supposed to be the safer way home!" So much for that!
rows.translation: 尽管存在种种危险，你还是选择了继续沿着这条地下河流前进，准备面对那些潜藏在漆黑深处的未知生物。从你当前的位置到目标地点，有一段相当长且蜿蜒曲折的隧道要穿越，在最终绕过最后一个弯道、与那些生物正面交锋之前，你有足够的时间来为自己的选择感到担忧和不安。 [flags.LQ1_BEAST2 |与海怪一同。 |一条龙！”莉芙蕾娅惊呼道，连忙捂住嘴巴。“等等，不……” 你眼前出现的是一只体型与战马相当的巨兽，它躺在一片由珍贵宝石和闪闪发光的石头铺成的床上。它蜷缩成一团，巨大的龙翼展开覆盖着自己的身体，鳞片状的尾巴则垂落在它那长长的、类似鳄鱼的鼻子上。 它的其中一颗犬齿比另一颗长得多，从下颌中突出出来，看起来就像一把邪恶的镰刀。现在你应该明白为什么莉芙蕾娅会称它为“龙”了吧！除了方形的下颌和相对较小的翅膀外，这家伙简直就是龙的化身。 你怀疑这种生物是否能够独自飞行，但也许它可以从山顶滑翔下来，然后出其不意地捕捉猎物。它的爪子确实大到足以碾碎该地区大多数动物，甚至包括熊或麋鹿；而它的身体覆盖着闪闪发光的、呈海泡沫色的鳞片，这些鳞片厚实程度不亚于任何士兵所穿的盔甲。 那些鳞片……”你的吟游诗人同伴低声说道，“那肯定是一条海龙。 [pc.isCunning |当然。它们与龙有亲缘关系，但却不具备龙的威严与智慧。只不过是些体型庞大、会喷火的动物，注定只能在地上爬行，而无法翱翔于天际。 |[pc.bg hunter |你对这类生物应该很熟悉：它们与龙有亲缘关系，但却缺乏龙那样的威严与智慧。只不过是些体型庞大、会喷火的动物，注定只能在地上爬行，而无法翱翔于天际罢了。 |你耸了耸肩，说道：“这是我第一次见到这种东西。 ] ] ] 洞穴的声学效果使它的鼾声被放大了，以至于每一个呼噜声都听起来像真正的龙在咆哮。 而这些鼾声正在变得越来越急促，也越来越不规律。甚至在这种环境中，它自己的呼吸声都几乎要把它震聋了 [silly |雷霆穹顶 |洞穴 ]捕食者察觉到附近有猎物。它的一只眼睛缓缓睁开，那金色的眼珠上点缀着黑色的斑点，它的垂直瞳孔也逐渐收缩起来。 “糟了糟了糟了，”莉芙惊呼着，连忙后退了一步。她的蹄子踩到了一块动物骨头，那只巨蛇立刻猛地站了起来，发出一声震得人魂不附体的咆哮。“这里本来应该是 更安全 快回家吧！” 就这样吧！

rows.original: The cavern's acoustics are amplifying storms to dangerous levels!
rows.translation: 这个洞穴的声学特性使得风暴的声音被放大到极其危险的程度！

rows.original:
With a final, desperate roar, the wyrm charges straight at you with its head down, trying to gore you with its horns. The damn thing's nearly blind with pain, though, and you're able to dodge to the side at the last moment. Snarling and vomiting flames from its maw, the wyrm careens past you and bashes its head into the stone hard enough to break that snaggle-tooth right off. It howls and staggers back, reeling from the impact... before flopping on its side with a defeated snort. 

    Liv lets out a heavy breath and grabs her knees, barely holding onto her sword. "Holy Seven! What a monster."
    
    You nod breathlessly.
    
    "And to think this was just a little one," Livrea says, finally managing to sheathe her sword. "Give it another couple decades and it could be the size of my house. Or even mom's tower!" 
    
    And it's living right next to town? The next time it gets mad, it might just raze Hawkethorne. You glance at the disoriented beast lying on its side, breathing hard and caked in blood and dirt...
rows.translation:
随着一声最后的绝望嘶吼，那条巨龙低着头直接向你冲来，试图用它的角刺伤你。然而，那该死的家伙已经被疼痛折磨得几乎失明了，你在最后一刻及时躲到了旁边。 这条巨龙从口中喷出火焰，咆哮着从你身边飞驰而过，用头猛烈撞击石头，以至于那颗参差不齐的牙齿都被撞掉了。它发出凄厉的嚎叫，踉跄着后退，显然被这一击震得晕头转向……最终它倒在地上，发出一声沮丧的鼻息。 

    莉芙重重地叹了口气，双手抱住膝盖，几乎无法握住手中的剑。“天啊！这简直是个怪物。”

你也气喘吁吁地点了点头。

“而且想想看，这只不过是其中比较小的一个而已，”莉芙蕾亚终于把剑收了进去，说道。 再过几十年，它的体型可能会赶上我的房子，甚至比妈妈的塔还要大！”

而且它就住在小镇旁边？下次它发怒的时候，说不定会把鹰棘镇整个摧毁呢。你看着那只倒在地上、呼吸急促、浑身沾满鲜血和泥土、显得十分迷惘的巨兽。..

rows.original:
You stagger over to the defeated wyrm and plunge a knife into its throat. Its end is quick, at least. 

        "Grim," Livrea says. "But fair. Plenty of stories about even beasts wanting revenge. Or just growing too big for the towns near their lair." 
        
        "Yeah," you say, starting to turn towards the cow-bard. 
        
        Something rumbles deep in the cave floor. Stones begin to fall from the ceiling, pitter-pattering onto the dead drake's lair. Livrea grimaces, looking between you and the tunnel leading downriver, towards home. "I, uh, I should get going. I am going to sing so many songs about you when I get home, [pc.name] — the wyrmslayer! Come find me in the city sometime!"
        
        You wave as Livrea starts jogging, and then outright sprinting down the riverside. More stones begin to fall around you, and the cave shakes violently. 
        
        [party.has cait
            |"We gotta go!" Cait says, grabbing as many gemstones as she can stuff in her pouches.
        ]
        
        [party.has brint
            |Brint looks for a moment between you and the tunnel home... before shaking his head and clapping your shoulder. "Time to get outta here!"
        ]
        
        [party.has brienne
            |Brienne barely spares a glance to the tunnel home before turning and grabbing your shoulder. "Time for us to go, [pc.name]!"
        ]
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |Your foxy sorceress creates a shield of magic around your heads, and looks urgently towards the way back.
        ]
        
        You quickly scoop up a bunch of gemstones, as many as you dare spend the time to, before turning and booking it back the way you came — back out of the cave entirely, whereupon you hear the thunder of collapsing stone in your wake.
        
        Only when you pause to collect yourself do you realize the wyrm's broken tooth is among the hurriedly-gathered stones too.
rows.translation:
你摇摇晃晃地走到那只被击败的巨龙面前，将一把刀刺进了它的喉咙。至少，它的死亡来得很快。

“残酷，”莉芙蕾娅说道，“但也是公平的。有很多故事都讲述了这样的怪物会想要复仇，或者是因为它们长得太大了，以至于附近的城镇再也无法安全地存在了。是的，”你说道，开始朝那个吟游诗人走去。

洞穴的地面深处传来一阵隆隆声，石头开始从洞顶掉落，纷纷砸在那只死去的巨龙巢穴里。莉芙蕾娅皱起了眉头，目光在你和通往下游、通往家的隧道之间来回移动。 我，呃，我该走了。回家后，我会唱很多关于你的歌的。 [pc.name] ——那个杀龙者！有空到城里来找我吧！”

你向莉芙蕾娅挥了挥手，然后看着她开始沿着河岸慢跑，接着迅速冲了出去。周围的石头开始纷纷掉落，洞穴也剧烈地摇晃起来。 
        
        [party.has cait
            |我们得走了！”凯特说着，尽可能多地把宝石装进她的袋子里。
        ]
        
        [party.has brint
            |布林特在你和通往家的隧道之间犹豫了片刻……最终摇了摇头，拍了拍你的肩膀：“是时候离开这里了！
        ]
        
        [party.has brienne
            |布蕾妮几乎没有多看一眼通往家的隧道，就转身抓住了你的肩膀：“我们该走了。 [pc.name]!"
        ]
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |你那位狡黠的女巫在你们头顶上制造出一道魔法护盾，同时急切地朝来路的方向望去。
        ]
        
        你迅速捡起了尽可能多的宝石，只要你有时间去捡的话，然后转身沿着来时的路返回——彻底离开那个洞穴。就在这时，你听到身后有石头坍塌的声响。

直到你停下来稍作休息时，你才意识到，那条巨龙的断牙也在你匆忙捡起的那些宝石之中。

rows.original: There's no need to kill this thing. Perhaps it will remember your mercy someday.
rows.translation: 没有必要杀死这个生物。也许有一天，它会记住你的仁慈。
rows.raw: "There's no need to kill this thing. Perhaps it will remember your mercy someday."

rows.original:
The wyrm's onslaught proves overwhelming, battering you down with tooth and claw until you're slammed into the ground, pinned between two clawed toes. The sea wyrm roars into your face, its breath swelteringly hot — so hot that you could swear you see the interior of its throat glowing.

    Oh, so it is. The heat... like a furnace washing over you...
    
    Your last thought is wondering whether or not it likes its [pc.raceCute] well done.
rows.translation:
这条海怪的攻击力实在强大得令人难以抵挡，它用牙齿和爪子猛烈地攻击你，直到将你压倒在地面，让你的身体被它的爪子紧紧夹住。这条海怪对着你的脸咆哮，它呼出的气息热得令人窒息——热得让你仿佛能看到它喉咙内部的火焰在燃烧。

哦，原来如此……这种高温……就像是一股熔炉里喷出的烈火，直接扑面而来……

你最后的念头，只是在想：这条海怪，到底会不会喜欢这样的攻击方式呢？ [pc.raceCute] 干得好。

    Oh, so it is. The heat... like a furnace washing over you...
    
    Your last thought is wondering whether or not it likes its [pc.raceCute] well done."

rows.original:
You can only hope Livrea made it home after that. There's no way of telling now, until you find your own way into Khor'minos someday... which will probably not be today, considering the wringer you[party.som
        |'ve
        | and your companion have
        | three have
    ] been through. Not to mention the tunnel collapsing behind you. [flags.LQ1_WYRM 2
        |You have to wonder if the wyrm managed to slither out while you were running for it. You didn't see it leave, at least...
    ]
    
    [party.has brint
        |"Rough day, huh?" Brint laughs, clapping your back. "Shame about the way home being blocked off, but I'm sure we'll get there eventually. Just hope the cute cow made it to the other side!"
    ]
    
    [party.has cait
        |Cait sighs, plucking a loose rock out of her cleavage. "So we [flags.LQ1_WYRM 1 2|killed|beat up] a sea wyrm. That's the stuff of heroes, alright!" She flashes you a pretty smile and nuzzles into your shoulder. "So what're we doing for an encore?[cait.fucked
            | Or should I say, whom?
        ]"
    ]
    
    Right now, you need to get back to town and get a bath. 
    
    You set your sights on home and start walking. Without Livrea's songs to keep your spirits up, it proves more of a slog than you remember.
    
    [pc.isDK
        |You shake that thought off. No getting soft now. Not when you've come so far.
        |With a sigh, you admit you'll miss her cheery company. More reason to find your way to her city under the mountain someday, you suppose.
    ] For now, you concentrate on getting home and getting some rest.

rows.original: A new dungeon has been added that you have progressed beyond. Livrea, a bard from Khor'minos, arrives in Hawkethorne shortly after you awake from your Kasyrra-induced coma and tells you that her homeland may be in peril, but the Foothills are dangerous and the King's Gate is sealed. She suggests a safe route might be through the old waterheads outside of Hawkethorne that feed into the Undermountain. Would you like to help her get home, and experience this sidestory?
rows.translation: 游戏中新增了一处你已经成功通关的地下城。在从卡希拉引起的昏迷中苏醒后不久，来自科尔米诺斯的吟游诗人莉芙蕾娅来到了鹰棘镇，她告诉你她的故乡可能正处于危险之中，但山脚地带十分危险，国王之门也已被封闭。她建议，或许可以通过鹰棘镇外那些通往地下山脉的古老水道来寻找一条安全的路线。你愿意帮助她回到家乡，并体验这个支线故事吗？
rows.raw: "\n    A new dungeon has been added that you have progressed beyond. Livrea, a bard from Khor'minos, arrives in Hawkethorne shortly after you awake from your Kasyrra-induced coma and tells you that her homeland may be in peril, but the Foothills are dangerous and the King's Gate is sealed. She suggests a safe route might be through the old waterheads outside of Hawkethorne that feed into the Undermountain. Would you like to help her get home, and experience this sidestory?"

rows.original: Open it up! What's in the box?
rows.translation: 把它打开吧！盒子里有什么？
rows.raw: "Open it up! What's in the box?"

rows.original: The storeroom is as unassuming and threadbare as you'd have expected it to be — but there is one thing that stands out. Its metal bandings glistening in the dim light of the brazier, the sight of a bronze-bound box draws into view as you continue your search, complete with the most unorthodox locking mechanism. [party.has quin |You glance at Quin and ask the bunny-man if he knows anything about this kind of lock. Can he do anything about it? Quin takes all of three seconds to study the box before shaking his head. "Lockpicks won't work on this one, it's a wordlock chest; Tollus fancies himself a heir of old Belhar and is pretty crazy about collecting anything even remotely related to it. If we rip it off the cart bed and find a fence willing to take it no questions asked, it might be worth more than what's in it. It's an antique in and of itself, and the mechanism isn't something just anyone can make any more." Would he? "Damn right I'd do it even if it were worthless, just to deny him it. There're people in the Tael Alliance who'd pay much for one of these... but we don't have the time for that right now. Still, you want to know how these things work, right? There's a password, and you make the tumblers spell it out, simple as that. People also had a riddle inscribed on the chest just in case they forgot their password; solve that, and it opens." Hmm. [pc.bg scholar noblescion acolyte |Based on your own studies, you know Quin's not talking out of his ass; servants of Belharan nobility were not educated and could not read. |Riddles, eh? Shouldn't be too hard to figure out, if ancient Belharan security was testing someone's ability to read. ] |[party.has cait |"Father used to tell Calla and I about these," Cait pipes up as she studies the chest. "They're wordlock chests, a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly |players |servants ]. Each combination lock was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was a riddle was often posed on the chest itself." So if you solved this thing, the lock would just pop open and you could just help yourself to anything inside. "Yep!" |[pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |You've come across these before in your past — wordlock chests, a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly |players |servants ]. Each of these combination locks was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was, a riddle was often posed on the chest itself. If you could solve it and thereby rotate the tumblers into the right position, the chest would unlock and allow you to claim its contents. |Hmm, what can this all mean? It certainly seems like a thoroughly roundabout way to secure a container, but at least it isn't likely to be trapped in the bargain. You test the mechanism a few times, turn the tumblers, but nothing happens. ] ] ] You glance at Nihara. Is she okay with this? Nihara shrugs. "Given the lack of any other clergy around, I'm certainly authorized to let you have anything inside as due payment for services rendered. Since it doesn't belong to the dead, you're welcome to the contents — within reason, of course." Well, that settles that. Is there something you can do about this?
rows.translation: 储藏室确实如你所预料的那样朴素而破旧——但里面 是 有一样东西特别引人注目：在火盆昏暗的轻型线下，那些金属带闪烁着轻型芒；当你继续搜寻时，一个用青铜包裹的盒子逐渐进入你的视线，而它的锁具机制更是显得非常不寻常。 [party.has quin |你瞥了瞥奎因，然后问那个兔人是否了解这种锁的原理，以及是否能够解决这个问题。 奎因花了整整三秒钟来观察那个箱子，最终摇了摇头说道：“开锁工具对这种锁根本不起作用，这是种密码锁。托卢斯自认为是古老贝哈尔的继承人，因此他对任何与贝哈尔有关的物品都极为热衷，甚至到了疯狂的程度。 如果我们把它从货车上拆下来，找到一个愿意无条件接收它的买家，那么它的价值可能会远远超过里面的物品。它本身就是一件古董，而这种机械结构也已经不是任何人都能制造出来了。他会那么做吗？” “我当然会。即使那东西毫无价值，我也一定会这么做，就为了不让他得到它。在泰尔联盟里，有些人愿意花大价钱购买这样的东西……但现在我们没有时间去管这些了。 不过，你肯定想知道这些东西到底是怎么运作的吧？只需要一个密码，然后让那些转盘按照正确的顺序拼出这个密码，就这么简单。如果人们忘记了密码，胸腔上还刻有一条谜语；解开这条谜语，胸腔就能被打开。嗯。 [pc.bg scholar noblescion acolyte |根据你自己的研究，你应该知道昆的话并非无稽之谈；贝尔哈兰贵族的仆从们根本没有受过教育，也不识字。 |谜语，嗯？如果古代贝拉兰的安全系统是用来测试某人的阅读能力的话，这些谜语应该不会太难解吧。 ] |[party.has cait |父亲过去常常给我们讲这些故事。 凯特在研究那个箱子时开口说道。 这些是密码锁箱，是古老的贝尔哈兰贵族们非常喜爱的物品，它们的作用就是保护贵重物品免受不识字之人的窃取。 [silly |玩家们 |仆从们 ]每个密码锁都需要输入密码才能打开，为了帮助主人记住密码，人们通常会在箱子本身上设置一个谜语来帮助主人回忆密码。 所以，如果你解决了这个问题，锁就会自动打开，然后你就可以取走里面的任何东西了。 没错！ |[pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |你在过去曾经见过这类东西——字锁箱。这种箱子曾是贝尔哈兰老贵族们的最爱，他们用它来保护贵重物品，防止那些不识字的人偷走它们。 [silly |玩家们 |仆从们 ]这些组合锁每一把都需要输入密码才能打开，为了帮助主人记住密码，人们通常会在箱子本身上设置一个谜语。如果你能够解开这个谜语，将锁芯旋转到正确的位置，箱子就会打开，让你取走里面的物品。 |嗯，这一切到底意味着什么呢？这种方式看起来确实有些迂回，但至少不会让人陷入不必要的麻烦。你试了几次这个装置，转动了那些旋钮，然而什么反应也没有发生。 ] ] ] 你瞥了眼尼哈拉，心想：她真的同意这样吗？ 尼哈拉耸了耸肩：“既然周围没有其他神职人员，我当然有权允许你拿走里面的东西，作为对你所提供的服务的报酬。既然这些东西并不属于死者，你当然可以拿走——当然，也要在合理的范围内。” 好吧，这个问题就这么解决了。那你能不能想点办法来解决这个麻烦呢？

rows.original: There's nothing for it. Whatever Nihara's looking for, it's got to be in that pile of junk.
rows.translation: 没什么别的地方了。尼哈拉要找的东西，肯定就在那堆垃圾里。
rows.raw: "There's nothing for it. Whatever Nihara's looking for, it's got to be in that pile of junk."

rows.original: They feel no pain No sorrow no greed They have no anger No hatred nor need
rows.translation: 他们没有痛苦， 没有悲伤，也没有贪婪， 他们没有愤怒， 没有仇恨，也没有任何需求。
rows.raw: "They feel no pain No sorrow no greed They have no anger No hatred nor need"

rows.original:
Something within the chest clicks, followed by a loud thump as the mechanisms within disengage. Instinctively, you step back, fearing a trap, but your fears are soon allayed as the spring-loaded lid pops open, revealing the chest's contents. Lying within is a folded black outfit with gold trimmings, the colors of Tira not too different from what Nihara wears, if considerably less revealing. It's a little odd for a wordlock to be used as a wardrobe, but these don't look to be any ordinary vestments, more ceremonial than practical.
        
        Still, leaving them here isn't going to do anyone any good, and given the cloth's already a little musty it's not going to be long before it starts the long and inexorable slide towards decay. Stowing it away requires making a little space amongst your possessions, but you manage to make it fit comfortably.
        
        Right, now on to other matters...
rows.translation:
箱子里的某个装置发出了咔嗒声，随后随着内部机械装置的松开，传来一声沉重的撞击声。你本能地后退了一步，担心这是个陷阱，但很快你的担忧就消散了——弹簧装置驱动的盖子猛地弹开，露出了箱子里的物品。 里面是一件带有金色装饰的黑色折叠式服装，其颜色与尼哈拉所穿的衣物颇为相似，只不过这件服装的暴露程度要低得多。用一件“词锁”来作为服装使用，确实有点奇怪，但这些衣物显然并非普通的日常服饰，而更具有仪式性意义，而非实用性考虑。
        
        不过，把它们留在这里对任何人都没有好处。而且，由于这块布料已经有点发霉了，它很快就会开始慢慢腐烂。要把它们收起来，你需要在自己的物品中腾出一些空间，不过你还是设法把它们妥善地存放了起来。
        
        好的，现在我们来说说其他事情吧……

rows.original: You rub your temples and sigh. The riddle's right there in front of you, but its words might as well have been unscalable walls. Whatever's in the chest is going to have to stay inside until you figure this out.
rows.translation: 你揉了揉太阳穴，叹了口气。这个谜题就摆在你的眼前，但它的答案仿佛就是一道无法逾越的墙。直到你解开这个谜题，箱子里的东西才会被取出。
rows.raw: "\n        You rub your temples and sigh. The riddle's right there in front of you, but its words might as well have been unscalable walls. Whatever's in the chest is going to have to stay inside until you figure this out.\n        "

rows.original: Nihara wrinkles her nose in distaste as she looks at the mess piled up against the wall. "Gods, what happened with this mess? Everything was supposed to be put neatly away!" It's not supposed to all be in one big messy pile? "Gods forbid! The vicar wouldn't have stood for it. No, the last time I was in this room, everything was packed away in trunks. Come to think of it, where are they? It's as if all the trunks just vanished and spilled out their contents on the ground. Looters wouldn't have —" Nihara's words are cut short as she reaches for the junk heap to dig through it, and then squeals and hops back when it begins to move. With much crashing and rattling as bronze and silver knick-knacks clatter off the pile and fall to the ground, you realize where all the organic mass in the room went — straight into the dark, translucent latex slime that jiggles to life as Nihara awakens it from its slumber. It wasn't just hidden in the pile, it was the pile — weapons, goblets, statuettes and other objects buried within it aside, you spot something near the goo's center that shines faintly with a wan, silvery light. "That's it!" Nihara shouts, grabbing her staff as she recovers. "That's the ward I need, in that casket!" The goo starts to undulate and flow, but surprisingly, it's not towards you to attack, but rather away. Weighed down as it is by the sheer amount of metal junk attached to and inside of its body, the grayish mass of latex is incredibly sluggish, but nevertheless is determined to make away with its bulk towards the nearest hole in the wall. Can it actually fit, given all the things it's laden with inside of its body? It's certainly willing to try. "Stop it! We can't let it squeeze away with what we've come all the way here to get!" While the big gray slime isn't actually interested in attacking you and its weight is preventing it from simply oozing away in the blink of an eye, you've nevertheless got to beat it before it flees with your prizes. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 尼原看着靠在墙边那一堆乱七八糟的东西，不悦地皱起了鼻子。“天啊，这都是怎么回事？所有东西本来都应该被整齐地收好才对啊！” 难道不应该把它们都分开放，而不是堆成一团乱七八糟的东西吗？ 但愿不会这样！牧师绝对不会允许这种事情发生的。不，我上次来这个房间的时候，所有的东西都已经被装进箱子里了。仔细想想，那些箱子现在在哪里呢？就好像它们全都消失了一样，里面的东西也都散落在地上。 抢夺者们肯定不会……” 尼哈拉的话还没说完，她就伸手去翻找那堆杂物，结果那些东西突然动了起来，她吓得尖叫着跳了回去。随着青铜和银制的小饰品从堆里掉落到地上，发出一阵嘈杂的声音，你终于明白了——房间里那些“有机物质”全都掉进了那团暗影中、半透明的乳胶状黏液中去了。当尼哈拉唤醒它时，那黏液开始蠕动起来。 它并不只是被藏在那一堆东西里，而是 是 除了那些埋在其中的武器、高脚杯、小雕像等其他物品外，你在那团黏稠物靠近中心的位置发现了一个东西，它正散发着微弱而银色的轻型芒。 “就是那个！”尼哈拉一边喊着，一边抓起她的法杖站了起来，“就在那个棺材里，我需要的就是那个护身符！” 那团黏稠物开始波动、流动，但令人惊讶的是，它并没有朝你的方向袭来，而是 离开由于身上和内部附着了大量的金属碎片，这个灰色的橡胶团块行动起来极其迟缓，但依然顽强地试图朝着墙上最近的洞洞移动。它真的能成功吗？ 适合考虑到它体内所含的那些东西，它当然愿意尝试一下。 “住手！我们不能让它带着我们费尽周折才得到的东西逃掉！” 虽然那只巨大的灰色黏液生物其实并没有攻击你的意图，而且它的重量也使得它无法在瞬间溜走， 你无论如何都必须在它带着你的奖品逃走之前打败它。 这就是一场战斗！
rows.raw: " Nihara wrinkles her nose in distaste as she looks at the mess piled up against the wall. "Gods, what happened with this mess? Everything was supposed to be put neatly away!" It's not supposed to all be in one big messy pile? "Gods forbid! The vicar wouldn't have stood for it. No, the last time I was in this room, everything was packed away in trunks. Come to think of it, where are they? It's as if all the trunks just vanished and spilled out their contents on the ground. Looters wouldn't have —" Nihara's words are cut short as she reaches for the junk heap to dig through it, and then squeals and hops back when it begins to move. With much crashing and rattling as bronze and silver knick-knacks clatter off the pile and fall to the ground, you realize where all the organic mass in the room went — straight into the dark, translucent latex slime that jiggles to life as Nihara awakens it from its slumber. It wasn't just hidden in the pile, it was the pile — weapons, goblets, statuettes and other objects buried within it aside, you spot something near the goo's center that shines faintly with a wan, silvery light. "That's it!" Nihara shouts, grabbing her staff as she recovers. "That's the ward I need, in that casket!" The goo starts to undulate and flow, but surprisingly, it's not towards you to attack, but rather away. Weighed down as it is by the sheer amount of metal junk attached to and inside of its body, the grayish mass of latex is incredibly sluggish, but nevertheless is determined to make away with its bulk towards the nearest hole in the wall. Can it actually fit, given all the things it's laden with inside of its body? It's certainly willing to try. "Stop it! We can't let it squeeze away with what we've come all the way here to get!" While the big gray slime isn't actually interested in attacking you and its weight is preventing it from simply oozing away in the blink of an eye, you've nevertheless got to beat it before it flees with your prizes. It's a fight! "

rows.original: [var0 |Despite having no real way to communicate what it's feeling, you can tell that the jelly isn't having a good time — or maybe it's just having too good a time that it just can't keep itself together. Even though it's half-oozed its way into the ventilation opening with its ill-gotten gains, your last display is the final straw that breaks the proverbial donkey's back — it shudders, quavers, and then with a muted 'phut' pops like a particularly noisome bubble. What consistency it had vanishes in the blink of an eye as the latex turns runny and starts seeping into the cracks in the flooring, leaving behind all the junk it was carrying. It's probably not dead... but given that it can't reconstitute itself for the time being it may as well be. Wasting no time, Nihara steps forward over the defeated slime, picking up the glowing casket and leaving you to pick through all the other junk the corrupted slime was attempting to abscond with. Most of it is trash, but another bronze casket it had inside of it catches your eye, one with the symbol of... something engraved on its lid. rows.original:
Right, a shield, that's what it is under all the grime and gunk. You wipe off the lid, undo the catch, and to your surprise find that it lifts easily; there's a little pop of an airtight seal and then inside is a gleaming cuirass of silvered bronze that looks like it might've belonged to a Tiran paladin or something. It doesn't look like it'll be missed... and it'll probably do more good in your hands than floating around inside an overgrown pile of latex.
        
        Meanwhile, Nihara's had her back to you, scrabbling at the remains of the defeated jelly to pick up the faintly glowing casket it had in its core. Holding it close to her breast, the goocat heaves a huge sigh of relief and tightens her grip on her staff.
        
        "Well, I wasn't expecting this, but it seems to have turned out all right. Come on, let's get out of here before worse happens. Thanks, [pc.name]."
        
        It was a pleasure.
rows.translation:
没错，就是一个盾牌——在那些污垢和积灰之下，它其实就是这么一个盾牌。你擦掉盖子，解开卡扣，然后会惊讶地发现它竟然很容易就被取出来了；会听到一声轻微的“啪”声，表明密封装置已经打开，而里面则是一面闪闪发光的银青铜盾牌，看起来简直就像是某个提兰圣骑士才会拥有的东西。 看起来没人会想念它……而且放在你手部里，它可能会发挥出比被扔在那一堆堆积如山的乳胶材料中更大的作用。

与此同时，尼哈拉已经转过身来，正在翻找那些被击败的凝胶残骸，试图找到它核心部位那个微微发光的棺材。 将那只小猫紧紧抱在胸前，她长舒了一口气，同时更加紧地握住了手部中的手部杖。

“唉，我本来没预料到会这样，不过看来结果还算不错。好了，我们赶紧离开这里，免得发生更糟糕的事情。 谢谢。 [pc.name]真是太愉快了。

rows.original: As slow as the big gray jelly is, the blob can sure take a lot of punishment; the sheer amount of metal junk it's collected in and on its body doesn't help either, armoring its amorphous form as it oozes away. Several bronze pieces wind up dislodged, falling to the ground as the jelly makes its escape through the gunked-up vent, but none of them are your prize. "Come on, [pc.name]! We can't let it get away!" Nihara yells, lancing a ray of frost at the big gray jelly. "Who knows where it'll end up once it's out of our sight!" Faced with the jaws of defeat — defeat by a creature that hasn't taken a single hostile action towards any of you in this entire encounter, nonetheless — you take another swipe at the big latex jelly, hoping to at least catch one of the gewgaws caught in its body and slow it down that way. It's not much, but it's enough of an opening for Nihara to spear another ray of frost towards the creature, freezing one of is extremities solid. That certainly hurts the horrid thing — its gleaming surface ripples and undulates, its translucent insides roiling about in what passes for pain in such an amorphous monster. Dragging about its iced-over portion in a manner eerily reminiscent of a person with a broken limb, it continues its retreat, but is forced to disgorge a number of items it's got caught inside of its form — including the faintly glowing casket that Nihara's been after. Seeing her prize fall away from the big gray jelly, Nihara loses all interest in the monster and scrabbles at the goo-slick flagstones, making her way across with all expediency without falling over. It might be a trap... but that's where you come in, and frankly you're not sure if the latex jelly is smart enough to lay one to begin with. Scooping up the casket and holding it close to her breast, the goocat heaves a huge sigh of relief and tightens her grip on her staff; relieved of its burdens and your attentions, the big gray jelly slurps away into the wall and out of sight, bringing its ill-gotten gains with it. "Well, I wasn't expecting this," Nihara mutters as she stops to catch her breath. "The latex ranches aren't that far away from the lake, but I've never heard them giving in to greed before. Or having much of an intelligence to begin with, to be honest." There's a first time for everything, and at least she got what she came here for, even if the big gray jelly managed to get away with a lot of the other things that were kept here. "Yes. I couldn't have done it without you, [pc.name]. So... thanks. As for the other things that were kept here... well, only a few belonged to the temple proper, with the rest the property of the dead. If it'll make the restless ghosts go after the slimes, I'm not going to begrudge it. "Come on, [pc.name]. Let's get out of here before something worse has the chance to happen."
rows.translation: 尽管那团灰色的黏液移动得极其缓慢，但它确实能够承受巨大的冲击；它身上堆积的那些金属碎片也起到了加固作用，使得它那无定形的身体在不断移动的过程中依然能够保持坚固。当黏液通过那些被杂物堵塞的通风口逃走时，有几块青铜碎片脱落掉了，掉到了地上，但这些碎片都不是你想要的东西。 “快点吧 [pc.name]我们不能让它逃掉！”尼哈拉大喊着，向那团灰色的胶状物射出一道冰霜光束。“谁知道它一旦离开我们的视线，会跑到哪里去呢！” 面对这场看似必败的局面——尽管在整个遭遇过程中，那个生物从未对你们中的任何一个人采取过任何敌对行动——你们还是再次试图攻击那团乳胶状的胶状物，希望能抓住它体内那些奇怪的附生物，从而延缓它的移动速度。 虽然不算太多，但这个机会已经足够让尼原再次向那只生物发射出一道寒光，将其的一条肢体彻底冻结。 那确实让那个可怕的怪物受到了伤害——它那闪闪发光的表面出现了涟漪和波动，其半透明的内部也在不断地翻腾着，仿佛在承受着某种痛苦。它那被冰覆盖的部分移动的方式，让人联想到一个肢体受伤的人，它继续后退着，但却不得不吐出那些被它身体包裹住的物品——其中包括尼哈拉一直在寻找的、那盏发出微弱光芒的棺材。 看到自己的奖品从那块灰色的黏稠物中脱落，尼原立刻对这只怪物失去了兴趣，开始在那些黏糊糊的石板上拼命爬行，只想尽快穿过那里而不摔倒。 这可能是个陷阱……但这就是你需要发挥作用的地方了。说实话，你甚至不确定那种乳胶状物质是否有足够的智慧来设下这个陷阱。那只猫把棺材捧在胸前，长舒了一口气，然后紧紧握住了手中的法杖。摆脱了负担和你的关注，那只灰色的胶状物质缓缓滑进了墙壁，消失在了视线之外，同时也带走了它那些不义之财。 嗯，我本来没预料到会这样。 这个尼原边喘息边低声说道，‘那些生产乳胶的农场离湖边并不远，但我从来没听说过它们会为了贪婪而做出这种事。说实话，它们本来也就没什么智慧可言。’” 凡事都有第一次，至少她还是得到了自己来这里想要的东西，尽管那些被保存在这里的其他东西，大多还是被那个灰色的巨大生物给带走了。 “没错。如果没有你，我根本不可能完成这件事。 [pc.name]那么……谢谢。至于那些被留在这里的物品……嗯，只有少数是属于寺庙本身的，其余的都是死者的财产。如果这些物品能让那些不安的鬼魂去追捕那些黏液生物，我也不会介意的。” “来吧， [pc.name]我们赶紧离开这里，免得发生更糟糕的事情。

There's a first time for everything, and at least she got what she came here for, even if the big gray jelly managed to get away with a lot of the other things that were kept here. "Yes. I couldn't have done it without you, [pc.name]. So... thanks. As for the other things that were kept here... well, only a few belonged to the temple proper, with the rest the property of the dead. If it'll make the restless ghosts go after the slimes, I'm not going to begrudge it. "Come on, [pc.name]. Let's get out of here before something worse has the chance to happen." "

rows.original:
With Nihara's staff lighting your way, you hurry back through the city of the dead — perhaps having been mollified for now at the big gray jelly [silly
        |having left the building
        |no longer being there
    ], no more minotaur specters bother you during your egress. Once you reach the heavy granite doors, Nihara presses her hand against the hourglass-and-moon symbol, and with a low grinding sound whatever mechanism that drives the doors rumbles into action, sealing them shut. Not that it stopped the slimes from getting in to begin with, but hey... 
    
    "Phew, and that's that. Let's get this lot back home and take a well-deserved rest. Maybe even a bath."
    
    Your trip back through the tunnels is uneventful, with Nihara clutching the glimmering casket to her breast every step of the way. It's not until after you make it through her fungal gardens and in through her door that she heaves a sigh of relief and sets the bronze casket down on the table with a clank.
    
    While this has been very exciting and interesting, she wouldn't begrudge you a look at this ward she took you all the way to the temple to retrieve, would she?
    
    "N-no. No, of course not. It's the least I can do for you after you sticking out your neck for me, [pc.name]. Here, help me get this open."
    
    The hinges are a little tight, but the casket's in great shape considering all the time it's spent floating about in the middle of a latex slime. Nihara cracks it open with a strand of goo-hair, and within is an ankh fashioned of some form of white stone — marble? Jade? — that glows silvery like the moon as it lies atop a cushion of decaying velvet.
    
    "Not a very powerful charm, I'll admit. Didn't help too much against the slimes, or to keep the dead in their resting places..."
    
    Well, there's the distinct possibility that the situation might have gotten even worse had it not been around.
    
    Nihara raises a hand to her cheek and sighs. "Maybe. It looks pretty, but appearances can be deceiving. Hopefully it'll help keep away the imps from the lakeside, nasty little things that they are... but more importantly, it'll give the people remaining about these parts hope, and that's in painfully short supply these days."
    
    You don't know about that. Nihara staying about these parts and continuing to minister to the people in their villas instead of holing up herself at the bottom of the lake or something and trying to wait it all out brings out more hope in people than some flashy carved rock, really.
    
    [nihara.isCorrupted
        |"Well, I never," Nihara purrs, curling a dark, inky tail about your leg and stroking you lightly. "I'm flattered, I truly am."
        |"Oh? Really?" Nihara tries to hide her smile and blush, and fails horribly at it; even if she did, the twitching of her tails would've given her away. "Well..." 
    ]
    
    No, seriously. She could've just sunk to the bottom of the lake and tried to wait it out, or barricaded herself in her home like all the patricians in the villas, but she chose to risk herself to look out for other people.
    
    "Oh, oh, if you keep on flattering me like that something untoward might happen, [pc.name]. Come on, let's get this somewhere it might be useful."
    
    With that, Nihara opens the gates in the back of her home, those that lead out from the bathing pools into the lake proper; you watch her as she wades, then eventually swims out a little way to a pole in the middle of the water. Once, it might've been used to guide boats to a nearby jetty, but with the waters empty the lantern's long since gone dead with no one to refuel it. This is where Nihara sets down the little stone ankh, propping it up in the lantern's oil reservoir; you see her flatten her palm and press it against the lantern's metal frame, and then the silvery glimmer from the ankh intensifies into a pale glow reminiscent of the light of the full moon. Quite fitting, given the stars above... and the light makes a lovely sheen off Nihara's watery goo-bits as she swims back to you in a lazy paddle, every bit in her element.
    
    "There, we're done. And now as to your reward, [pc.name]..."
    
    With a soft sigh, Nihara steps up from the bathing pool, her already revealing Tiran priestess' garments clinging to the curves of her body, water running from her hair and down her limbs as she steps up and [pc.heightRange 72 84
        |draws close
        |stands on tiptoe
        |bends her knees down
    ] to give you a lovely wet smooch. Supple and turgid, like the water that's pouring away and puddling on the ground... but surely that's not all, is it?
    
    Breaking the kiss with a hearty sigh, Nihara drags herself out of the pool with some reluctance and crosses over to a cupboard on the opposite end of the room, her footsteps perfectly dry. "Ah. I suppose not. Here, one of my patients paid me with this the other day. It's drink all right, but too rich for my veins. And money, since you'll be in a better position to spend it than me."
    
    "Now then, why don't you let me make sure you're in good shape before you go? Just another way of saying thanks for the help."
rows.translation:
在尼哈拉的手杖照亮前行的道路后，你匆匆穿过了这座死城——或许，那巨大的灰色 jelly 已经让你暂时安心了。 [silly
        |已经离开了那栋建筑
        |已经不在那里了
    ]在您离开时，再也没有弥诺陶洛斯的幽灵来打扰您了。当您走到那扇重型的花岗岩门前，尼哈拉将她的手放在那个沙漏与月亮的符号上，随着一声轻微的摩擦声，驱动门扉的机械装置开始运转，将门牢牢地关上了。 虽然这并没有阻止那些黏液生物进入进来，不过……  

“呼，总算搞定了。我们把这些东西带回家，好好休息一下吧。或许还可以洗个澡。”  

你们穿过隧道返回途中没有发生任何意外，尼哈拉一路上都把那个闪闪发轻型的棺材紧紧抱在怀里。 直到你穿过了她那些布满真菌的花园，走进了她的家门，她才松了一口气，然后把那个青铜棺材重重地放在桌子上。

虽然这一切都充满了刺激和趣味，但她应该不会介意让你看看这个她特意带你去寺庙取来的东西吧？
    
    不、不，当然不是这样的。在你为我挺身而出之后，这至少是我能为你做的。 [pc.name]在这里，帮我把这个打开吧。”

铰链有点紧，但考虑到这个棺材在胶状黏液中漂浮了这么久，它的状况还算不错。尼哈拉用一根沾满黏液的头发把棺盖撬开了，里面是一个用白色石头制成的安克符号——是大理石吗？ 翡翠？——当它躺在那层腐烂的天鹅绒上时，会发出如同月轻型般的银色轻型芒。

“我得承认，这并不是什么强大的法器。在对抗那些黏液生物时，它并没有起到太大的作用；也无法让死者安息在应有的地方。嗯，如果没有它的存在，情况很可能还会变得更糟。”

尼原用手捂住脸颊，叹了口气：“也许吧。它看起来很漂亮，但外表往往具有欺骗性。 希望这能帮助把那些讨厌的小东西赶离湖边……但更重要的是，这能为这些地区剩下的居民带来希望，而如今，希望实在是太稀缺了。你并不了解这些。尼原留在这些地区，继续为村民们提供服务，而不是躲在湖底什么的地方等待事情结束，这样反而能让人们看到更多的希望，比起那些华丽的雕刻石像来说，确实如此。
    
    [nihara.isCorrupted
        |嗯，我从来没有过这种感觉，”尼哈拉轻声说道，它那条漆黑的尾巴缠在你的腿上，轻轻抚摸着你。“我真的很荣幸，真的。
        |哦？真的吗？”尼原试图隐藏自己的笑容和脸红，但失败得一塌糊涂；即使她真的做到了，她尾巴的抽动也会暴露她的情绪。“嗯…… 
    ]
    
    不，说真的。她本可以沉到湖底等待事情平息，或者像那些别墅里的贵族们一样把自己关在家里，但她却选择了冒险去帮助别人。

“哦，哦，如果你继续这样讨好我，可能会发生一些不好的事情 [pc.name]来吧，让我们把这件事弄到某个可能会有用的地方去。”

说完，尼原打开了她家后方的门——那扇通往游泳池、最终通向湖面的门。你看着她一步步走进水中，最终游到湖中央的一根柱子旁。 曾经，这盏灯或许被用来引导船只驶向附近的码头，但随着水域变得干涸，这盏灯早已失去了作用，再也没有人去为它补充燃料。在这里，尼哈拉将那枚小石制的安卡放在灯的油槽中固定好；你可以看到她将手掌平放在灯的金属框架上，随后那枚安卡发出的银色轻型芒便变得愈发明亮，仿佛满月的轻型芒一般。 好了，已经完成了。那么，关于你的奖励 [pc.name]尼哈拉轻叹一声，从浴池中走出来。她那已经暴露出身材曲线的提兰女祭司服饰紧贴着她的身体，水从她的头发上流下来，顺着她的四肢滑落 [pc.heightRange 72 84
        |逐渐接近
        |踮起脚来
        |双膝弯曲
    ] 为了给你一个充满湿意的甜蜜吻……柔软而饱满，就像那些倾泻而下、在地面上汇聚成水洼的水一样……但当然，这肯定还不止这些，对吧？

尼哈拉深深地叹了口气，结束了这个吻，有些不情愿地从泳池中爬出来，然后走向房间另一端的橱柜，她的脚步声听起来干干净净的，没有一丝水分。 啊，我想也不是吧。前几天，有位病人用这个付给我的钱。这种饮料倒不错，但对我来说，它的浓度实在太高了，对我的血管不太好。至于钱嘛，反正你比我更有能力去花它。”

“那么，你为什么不让我先确保你身体状况良好，再让你离开呢？ 这只是另一种表达“感谢你的帮助”的方式而已。

rows.original: Oh, why not. It's been a long day, and you could use a bit of a break after that outing. What better way to do it than get a lovely dip with a goocat? [nihara.isCorrupted |Purring, Nihara slowly descends into the pool once more, sashaying her way past you and cooly disrobing you as if it were nothing at all. She's certainly acting really familiar around you, although given what you've just gone through together it's not completely unwarranted... In the blink of an eye, Nihara's got her Tiran nun's habit off, tossing the soggy garment to land on the pool's steps with a wet smack. Maybe it's a trick of the light, especially with the faint glow of the ankh burning in the distance, but here and now, standing knee-deep in the bathing pool with the ends of her inky water-hair trailing below the surface, she looks ever more voluptuous than you remember her being... "Come on in." Smiling beatifically, the goocat spreads her arms towards you in just the right way to accentuate her breasts, each one larger than her head. "The water's perfect." |Giggling, Nihara slowly descends into the bathing pool, sashaying her way past you and letting her goo-tails trail ripples in the water while you work on disrobing yourself. She's certainly acting a little flighty and much more familiar about you than you remember, but given what you've just gone through together it's not completely unwarranted... With a soft purr and glance over her shoulder to make sure that you're watching, Nihara's got her Tiran nun's habit off, tossing the soggy garment to land on the pool's steps with a wet smack. "Come on in." Giddy with excitement, Nihara beckons you over with a wave. "The water's perfect." ]

rows.original:
You're fine, you promise. At this point, an adventure like this is all in a day's work for you — slimes and ghosts aren't the worst of what you've faced.
        
        Nihara raises a finger to her lips, looking thoughtful. "Well... if you're determined to go, then I can't stop you. Just take care of yourself while you're in the tunnels, all right? And truly, once more, thanks for today again, [pc.name].
        
        "Don't be a stranger, now."
rows.translation:
你没问题的，我向你保证。对你说来说，这样的冒险根本不算什么—— slime和鬼魂都算不上你遇到过的最可怕的东西。

尼原把手指放在嘴唇上，若有所思地说：“嗯……如果你非要去的话，我也阻止不了你。不过在隧道里的时候一定要小心哦，好吗？真的，再次感谢你今天的帮助。 [pc.name]现在，别再表现得像个陌生人了。

rows.original: As you make your way forward, your hackles suddenly rise, and the back of your neck crawls with cold dread as your senses scream alarm at some unseen threat. Something horribly warm and empty caresses your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], like heat rising from an anguishing, starved fire, and then the spectres take form. They step out from the walls, they rise from piles of yellowed, cracked bones, they materialize into existence from thin air. Tattered rags cling to their ghostly bodies, the remains of everything from patrician finery to plebian tunics, but the specters' forms are anything but withered; tall, broad-shouldered and bulging with muscle, the burning ghosts are every bit as imposing in death as they were in the primes of their lives. Despite the blank looks in their eyes, the singular emotion the corrupted spirits are dominated by is evident in their tumescent, turgid horsecocks, each pillar of fuckmeat every bit as corporeal and palpable as they were in life. [party.has arona |[var0 |"All right, you sons of bitches," Arona growls, smacking the business end of her [arona.weapon] against her palm as she waits for the minotaur ghosts to draw close. "I'm ready for you this time around — you're not getting me with your bullshit this time. Come at me!" |"Oh shit, oh fuck, oh shit, oh fuck," Arona growls, hefting her [arona.weapon] for all the good it'll do against the apparitions. She's trying to hide it, but it's plain as day that her inability to do very much against these foes is irking her much more deeply than she'd like. rows.original:
Right, a shield, that's what it is under all the grime and gunk. You wipe off the lid, undo the catch, and to your surprise find that it lifts easily; there's a little pop of an airtight seal and then inside is a gleaming cuirass of silvered bronze that looks like it might've belonged to a Tiran paladin or something. It doesn't look like it'll be missed... and it'll probably do more good in your hands than floating around inside an overgrown pile of latex.
        
        Meanwhile, Nihara's had her back to you, scrabbling at the remains of the defeated jelly to pick up the faintly glowing casket it had in its core. Holding it close to her breast, the goocat heaves a huge sigh of relief and tightens her grip on her staff.
        
        "Well, I wasn't expecting this, but it seems to have turned out all right. Come on, let's get out of here before worse happens. Thanks, [pc.name]."
        
        It was a pleasure.

“唉，我本来没预料到会这样，不过看来结果还算不错。好了，我们赶紧离开这里，免得发生更糟糕的事情。 谢谢。 [pc.name]真是太愉快了。

Though I do hear the baths are nice... probably better than the ones I've been to."
                
                "It's like a community centre," you say.
                
                She nods. "Bathing culture's real big here. Lots of people try to get to the baths once a day, both to stay clean and to just relax. That should be where you pay and head inside."
                
                She points out a raised marble section with several attendants standing behind it, most of them engaged in conversation with some minotaur men and a few cowgirls alongside them.
            ][party.has brint
                |
                
                "Nice place," Brint says, turning his head. "Baths are like a pillar of the Minoan community." He taps an actual pillar supporting an archway with his knuckles. "Sometimes you don't even come here to bathe, just to hang out. The bathing is nice, though, from what I've heard. Prolly better than the baths I've been to here, anyway."
                
                "It's like a community centre," you say.
                
                He nods. "Bathing culture's real big here. Lots of people try to get to the baths once a day, both to stay clean and to just relax. That should be where you pay and head inside."
                
                He points out a raised marble section with several attendants standing behind it, most of them engaged in conversation with some minotaur men and a few cowgirls alongside them.
            ][party.has brint brienne
                |
                |There's a raised marble section with several attendants standing behind it, most of them engaged in conversation with some minotaur men and a few cowgirls alongside them.
            ] You walk over and give one of the attendants a nod, catching his attention. He flashes you a smile and leans over the desk.
            
            "Hey there, welcome to the community baths. Entry's free, courtesy of Khel'salak," he says.
            
            "Who?" you say.
            
            "Ha ha! Khel'salak's a senator, one who really wants you to know who he is," the attendant chuckles. "The crazy kenat's paid for the next few months of entry leading up to senate elections for everyone who comes in." He shakes his head. "Can't even imagine how much electrum he must be raking in from those vineyards of his — no other senator'd pull this kind of stunt."
            
            "Guess I'm not gonna complain," you say. "I don't think I can vote, anyway."
            
            "Yeah, don't worry about it," he says. "Anyway, you can head inside if you like. It's mixed bathing, [party.solo
                |just so ya know." He winks. "Don't get surprised, now."
                |so you and any friends can go in together."
            ]
            
            You notice there are several exits out of this room, though only one seems to lead to the baths. There's art all over the walls depicting battles in the colosseum and advertisements for the same. Interesting.
        ]
    ]
    '

rows.original: There's a bunch of other doors up here besides the exit to the baths. Maybe there's something interesting behind one of them?
rows.translation: 除了通往浴室的出口之外，这里还有很多其他的门。也许其中某扇门后面藏着什么有趣的东西呢？
rows.raw: "There's a bunch of other doors up here besides the exit to the baths. Maybe there's something interesting behind one of them?"

rows.original: Head down into the hot rooms. The really hot rooms.
rows.translation: 前往那些高温房间吧。 真的 热室。
rows.raw: "Head down into the hot rooms. The really hot rooms."

rows.original: Time to [silly|blow this popsicle stand|bring this investigation to a close].
rows.translation: 是时候了 [silly|把这个冰棍棒架弄坏吧|结束这项调查].
rows.raw: "Time to [silly|blow this popsicle stand|bring this investigation to a close]."

rows.original: [var3 |You enter the teyarium and immediately note the temperature difference, the warm air caressing your bare body. The room itself is beautiful, adorned in marble with huge murals upon its walls. There are several benches with cowgirl attendants standing nearby, and you can see a few people getting an oil massage. [flags.KM_BATHS_TEYARIUM |Smells as good as ever. |So that's why people leaving this place smell so good! The scent wafts over to you — sweet, but not overbearing. ] ] There are quite a few people here, some talking in groups and some alone, unwinding after their time in the hotter rooms or getting ready to enter them. The mood here is a lot more relaxed than the atrium — there's even a servant playing some kind of stringed instrument near the massage benches. This is quite nice. [var1 |You could go to the heated pools now that you're cooled off or spend some time here — or head back to the cooler pools in the dinarium, maybe. |You could head over to the heated pools in the saldarium, relax here, or go swimming in the cooler pools in the dinarium. ] [var2 |You tip the cooled water over your head and re-enter the teyarium, sighing in relief. Wow, it's nice to be back in here. You can really understand why people like to relax here after their time in the pools... the atmosphere is perfect for a rest after the heat of the baths. The music the servant is creating drifts over to you, inspiring you to listen. You could go back to the heated pools or spend some time here — or head over to the cooler pools in the dinarium for some contrast, maybe. ]

rows.original: [flags.ARILLE_MET|Arille's swimming here, and the rest of the cowfolk are giving her a wide berth as usual.|Who's that girl everyone's giving such a wide berth to?]
rows.translation: [flags.ARILLE_MET|阿里尔在这里游泳，而其他的牛人像往常一样，都与她保持了一定的距离。|那个大家都避而远之的女孩到底是谁啊？]

rows.original: Step back out into the Laconicum.
rows.translation: 退回到拉科尼库姆区域吧。

rows.original: A fancy private library has got to have some rare gems.
rows.translation: 一个高档的私人图书馆里，肯定会有一些珍贵的藏书。
rows.raw: "A fancy private library has got to have some rare gems."

rows.original: Check out that rune-warded door to the south...
rows.translation: 看看那扇位于南方的、被符文守护的门吧……
rows.raw: "Check out that rune-warded door to the south..."

rows.original: You have two ancient vaults of eldritch knowledge and a specially prepared ritual chamber. Let's make some magic happen.
rows.translation: 你拥有两座蕴藏着古老神秘知识的地下宝库，还有一个专门准备好的仪式厅。让我们一起创造一些神奇的事情吧。
rows.raw: "You have two ancient vaults of eldritch knowledge and a specially prepared ritual chamber. Let's make some magic happen."

rows.original: "Let's check the shelves," you say, starting to peruse them yourself. "Could be something useful." "Maybe if you're five hundred years old," Livrea grumbles. "None of this is in Minothan. Or Belharan. Or even Alvarin or Jassiran." "Something has to be," you say. "[pc.isBimbo |Reading's already hard, nobody'd want to read this on its own! |I don't think some old engineer is going to be reading ancient dialects either. ]" A moment passes before Livrea lifts up one of the tablets. "Hold on. This mark, I recognize it." You and Varena come to look over her shoulders. It's an old fired-clay tablet, cracked from the hard passage of years, but seam lines of glue have meticulously bound it back together. There's a circular symbol on the top-right corner of the tablet, in the middle of which are a pair of crossed crook-staves. [pc.bg scholar arcanist |Your eyes widen. "Estelore!" "The old Belharan mage academy." Varena says. "Gods, how old was that place?" "Old enough," you say, gingerly taking the tablet from Livrea. "This is... earth-shaping magic, I think? It's so old even I can barely make anything out..." "Me neither," Varena says. "What would they need earth-shaping for out in the Sailgraves? That's where Estelore was, right?" |"This is the symbol of Estelore," Livrea says, tapping the circle. "The ancient Belharan magic school out in the Sailgraves. I had no idea it was this old though..." "What is it?" Varena asks, eyes scanning the runes. "I can't make heads or tails of it, beyond it being old magic." You and Livrea shrug. No amount of magical know-how today is going to make up for just how old this stuff is. ] "I wonder where he could have gotten this?" Livrea murmurs. "It must have cost a fortune. Estelorean relics that haven't been nabbed by [pc.isAstrida |you blackscales |the Order Astrida ] are so, so rare nowadays..." "Maybe we should take it with us?" you suggest. "Be my guest," Liv says. "If it's alright with you, princess?" Varena nods. "I don't want anything to do with their magic, thanks; in fact I'd rather not have it in the kingdom at all. Take it with my blessing." You gingerly stuff it into your pack.

rows.original: "Iavari really doesn't want anybody going in there," you say, nodding towards the door. There's a shimmer around it, a spectral shield of force emanating from the runes etched into the wood that rebukes your touch before you can get within an inch of the door's handle. Varena sucks in a low breath. "I don't think I'm skilled enough to abjure something like that." [var0 |Well, you are, if you're so inclined... |[pc.isAstrida |Something like this should be easy for you to breach as an Astrida. ] ] "There's gotta be a way to disable it," Liv says. "A runestone or something!"
rows.translation: 亚瓦里 真的吗 没人能进去那里，”你边说边朝那扇门点了点头。门周围笼罩着一层微光，那是刻在木门上的符文释放出的能量屏障——只要你试图靠近门把手，这股力量就会立刻将你击退。 瓦蕾娜轻吸了一口气，说道：“我觉得我的能力还不够强，无法驱散那样的力量。 [var0 |嗯，如果你真的愿意的话，当然可以…… |[pc.isAstrida |作为阿斯特里达，这样的障碍对你来说应该很容易就能突破。 ] ] 肯定有办法把它关掉，”莉芙说，“比如说用一块符文石之类的东西！

rows.translation: 使用那块被损坏的领主符文石来突破防护结界。
rows.raw: "Use the corrupted lord's runestone to breach the ward."

rows.original: You don't have a runestone for this ward.
rows.translation: 你没有适合这个守卫的符文石。
rows.raw: "You don't have a runestone for this ward."

rows.translation: 你运用阿斯特里达的能力所取得的成就

rows.original: You don't have the ability to cast a spell powerful enough to do this. If only you had a member of the Order Astrida here...
rows.translation: 你没有足够强大的法力来施展这样的咒语。要是这里有阿斯特里达教团的成员该多好……
rows.raw: "You don't have the ability to cast a spell powerful enough to do this. If only you had a member of the Order Astrida here..."

rows.original:
You hold up the veiny rune-etched stone to the wards on the door and push forward against the field of resistance engraved into the wood. There's a moment of tension, but it snaps like a twig once you start putting your weight into it, and then the pressure gives way so suddenly you have to take a step forward to steady yourself. 
    
    "That did it!" Liv says, pumping her fist.
    
    "Just be careful," Varena says. "If he went to so much trouble to protect whatever's in there, it could still be dangerous."
    
    Duly noted.
rows.translation:
你将那块刻有符文、布满脉络的石头靠近门上的守卫装置，然后用力推挤那些刻在木门上的阻力装置。有那么一刻，你感到一阵紧张，但当你开始施加真正的力量时，那些阻力装置就像细枝一样轻易被折断了，压力瞬间消失，你甚至不得不向前迈一步才能保持平衡。 
    
    就这样吧！”莉芙激动地挥舞着拳头说道。

“不过还是要小心点，”瓦蕾娜提醒道，“如果他费了那么大劲子来保护里面的东西，那么那些东西可能仍然很危险。”

明白了。

rows.original: [var0 |You take a deep breath and then step forward, feeling out the aura of magic in front of you with your divinely-enhanced senses. It's powerful, thick cords of binding magic woven on top of each other like a net to surround the door three inches out. "Someone put a lot of effort into this," you mention, cracking your knuckles. "But not enough." You thrust a hand forward and then rip it back again, tearing apart the seams of magic. You can taste the power in it, the ancient arts latticed together to protect whatever dark work lurks beyond, and it makes you salivate. This is your purpose made manifest, your holy bargain paying off, giving you the strength to overcome even the most archaic and occult of magics. You step back, and feel the strands of magic tearing away. The runes on the door burst into azure flame, seething as they're rendered impotent. It's over in a heartbeat. There's a rush of power in your veins as you absorb the magic spilling into the air, breathing deep of the smoke until the flames burn out to embers. "Wow," Varena murmurs. "So that's the power of an Astrida." [livrea.fucked |"Hot, huh?" Liv says, squishing her thighs together. [varena.fucked |"Y-yeah." Varena blushes. "Very." |Varena rolls her eyes. ] |"Way more impressive in person than in the stories," Livrea says. [varena.fucked |"A sexy kind of power," Varena says, giving you a wink. |"Mmhm," Varena nods. ] ] "Alright, girls. Come on," you say. "Whatever's in there is going to be even worse." "R-right," Varena says, clutching her staff. "We'll follow your lead." |You motion for the girls to stand back while you plant your feet and begin to move your hands, incanting the words of power to draw the power directly out of these wardings, leaving them nothing but a hollow husk of wasted effort. The wards struggle against your magical unbinding, energies writhing in a desperate, if futile attempt to resist. But your spell is too potent to be turned aside, and with a final wrench of magical force, you shatter the protections on the doors. The runes carved into burst into plumes of azure smoke, their power burned out and discharged, fleeing rapidly. "W-wow. That's amazing," Varena murmurs. While most of the crowd is coming to and from the baths down south, every so often a couple of weary-looking cowgirls or a sweat-drenched bull will come up from the archway on the right, wearing nothing but towels around their hips. The one on the left seems to be pretty much ignored. "Something exhausting," you suggest. Another bull surfaces, bringing with him a plume of steamy air. "And hot." "And over that way?" Varena pokes her head through the curtain on the left wall. "Oh. Just cleaning supplies." Liv giggles. "It does say 'Janitorium' over the arch, Rena." The princess pouts. "You never know." The really hot rooms, right near the furnace." "And all the pipes," Varena says, rubbing her chin. If you were an evil engineer...

当你在楼梯上转过一个拐角时，一股浓重的湿气迎面扑来，随后你便来到了一间宽敞的房间。这里的墙壁和柱子全都由橙色的石头建造而成，上面用色彩鲜艳的瓷砖装饰着古老神话中英雄与怪兽的形象。 你可以看到房间里弥漫着一层明显的热气，尤其是在角落和房间中央那些用石头堵塞的通风口周围。

沿着南墙，有五扇门通向私人桑拿室，每扇门都是由青铜加固的木头制成的。 对于这样一个地方来说，这里的设施显得异常坚固耐用。

东墙上有另一扇门，有两名男子站在那里把守。“熔炉就在下面，”莉芙指着门上的一块指示牌说道。 
        
        大约有二十几名女牛仔和米诺陶洛斯们穿着毛巾站在那里，大汗淋漓，一边聊天一边互相逗趣。房间里没有一件遮盖胸部的衣物，除了你们带来的那些……她们的胸部完全暴露在外，而那些米诺陶洛斯男人们也毫不羞于在她们赤裸的身体上动手动脚。
        
        你可以听到几间门紧闭的私人房间里传来的微弱呻吟声。
        |你朝那扇挂着帘子的门走去。刚走了几步，就感觉到有一股浓重的湿热气息从那里散发出来。

“想下楼吗？唉，这样我的头发肯定要毁了。”瓦蕾娜抱怨道。

“现在回头还来得及的，公主。”莉芙轻推了她一下，说道。 
        
        瓦蕾娜摇了摇头，然后跟在你身后下了楼。

        房间里弥漫着明显的热气，尤其是在角落和中央那些用石头堵塞的通风口附近。

沿着南墙，有五扇通往私人桑拿房的门，每扇门都是由青铜加固的木头制成的。对于这样的地方来说，这些门的材质显得格外厚重。从几扇关着的私人房间里，可以听到微弱的呻吟声。
        
        你在东墙上看到了另一扇门，有两名男子站在那里站岗守卫。“熔炉就在下面，”莉芙指着门上的一块指示牌说，“上面也写着‘危险’二字。”

大约有二十名女牛仔和牛头人穿着毛巾站在那里，他们满头大汗，一边聊天一边等待着下一步行动。 房间里除了你们带来的那些之外，没有其他带盖的箱子——那些裸露的胸部随处可见，而那些米诺人对于在它们裸露的时候动手动脚也毫不羞耻。在房间后面，有几头公牛站在那里，它们的前部被刻意遮挡起来，而那个胸脯裸露的牛仔姑娘身高正好使得她的胸部与人们的裆部处于同一水平线上。 
        
        莉芙蕾娅朝那三人点了点头，说道：“现在的这些人真是毫无廉耻之心，不是吗？”

尤其是在这一带，以你的经验来看，更是如此。

It's all orange stone down here, walls and columns adorned with images of heroes and monsters from myths of old set in colorful tile. "I'm a little insulted I wasn't asked to do some painting down here," Varena mutters, pulling her hair back into a ponytail. "Then again... I don't want to think about what could've happened if I'd accepted."
        
        There's a visible haze of heat in the room, especially around stone-packed vents near the corners and in the center. 
        
        Along the south wall are a quintet of doors to private sauna chambers, each made of bronze-reinforced wood. Unusually heavy-duty for a place like this. You can hear faint moaning from a couple of the private rooms that have their doors closed.
        
        You see another door on the east wall, which has a pair of men standing guard over it. "The furnace is down there," Liv says, pointing to a sign over the door. "It says its dangerous, too."
        
        Around two dozen cowgirls and minotaurs are standing around in towels, sweating up a storm while they chat amongst themselves. There's not a covered chest in the room except for those you've come with — tits are hanging out aplenty, and mino men aren't shy about getting handsy with them while they're bare. A couple of bulls standing near the back are standing with their fronts suspiciously out of view, with a bare-breasted cowgirl that's just tall enough for her chest to be crotch-high. 
        
        Livrea nods at the trio. "People really are shameless these days, huh?"
        
        Especially around here, from your experience.
    ]

rows.original:
It's hard to believe people are getting up to mischief in this heat, but as you head over to the reinforced doors of the private saunas, you can hear faint moaning and wet, flesh-slapping sounds coming from the first two. The middle two are slightly ajar, unoccupied at the moment. And the last door is closed up tight, but you can't hear anything from inside. There's also no steam coming from inside it. 
    
    You glance back at the girls and then knock on the last door. 
    
    A gruff male voice answers from inside, "What do you want?"

rows.original: You glance at Varena and give the princess a little nudge. These are her people, after all. She steps past you and gives the guards a disarming smile. "You know who I am, right?" The men look between themselves. "Uhh..." "I'm Varena. Pleased to meet you." She takes a step forward. "Varena Moratia." The guards' eyes go wide. "You might not know this, but I love engineering. It's fascinating, seeing how things really work. I just want to take a peek inside and see what kind of furnace and pipes can power a place as impressive as this bath house. I'm sure Senator Khaius would be happy to know if I approved of the work..." "It's a little dangerous in there," one of the bulls says. "It's hot, your highness.You could get hurt." "We'll be careful," she assures him. "So if you'll excuse us..." They can hardly ignore a direct order from the princess, and so the two bulls begrudgingly step aside. Varena flashes you a grin and strides past. You follow on her heels, into the furnace chamber.

rows.translation: 凯特，我找到了 [pc.isDK |一名受害者 |一份工作 ] 是给你准备的。” “嗯？”你的小猫娘发出呼噜声，蹦蹦跳跳地跑到你身边，从你肩膀后面探出头来。“嘿，宝贝，你怎么喝得这么醉啊？” 狼女叹了口气：“生活太艰难了，天气也太冷了……不过，你知道什么才是柔软而温暖的吗？胸部？”凯特提议道。 “对，”狼说道，“胸部。过来让我暖和一下，我就告诉你一个秘密。” 凯特向你眨了眨眼，然后悄悄走进更衣室，拉上了帘子。 一秒钟后，你看到她的内裤掉在了地上，紧接着她的双足部也完全从视线中消失了。 真是个乖女孩。 你退后了几步，给他们一些私密空间，不过仅仅用一道帘子，是根本无法阻挡里面传来的那些微弱而潮湿的声音的。 你周围的几个乡下人用困惑的眼神看着你们的团队，但更多的人只是觉得这很有趣。有几个人甚至 好色的你会想，是否只有凯特第一个接受了她的提议呢？ “那么……玛拉基特人，对吧？”瓦雷娜说道。 “嘿，”莉芙撅了撅嘴，“我们并不是所有人都那么……热衷于这个提议。当然，这并没有什么不对的地方！ 我真的很钦佩她对这一事业的奉献精神。” “没错，”瓦雷娜说道。 幸运的是，那只狼没过多久就开始用爪子抓地板了，这时你也听到了凯特在抱怨些什么，好像是在说一定要管住自己的情绪。 在内部发生了一阵短暂的挣扎，随后凯特的双足部再次触地，那位充满激情的女祭司也从更衣间走了出来。 “学到了什么吗？”你问道。 凯特笑了笑道：“嗯！她告诉我要‘播种’ 玫瑰 在蒸汽中……”我不知道那是什么意思，但对她来说，这似乎很重要。 “也许吧 [flags.V_BATHS_LACONICUM|这是一个密码短语吗？|她就是喜欢园艺而已吗？]Liv建议道：‘你轻轻揉揉那只粉色小猫的耳朵，然后转身离开吧。我们会弄清楚的。
rows.raw: ' "Cait, I've got [pc.isDK |a victim |a job ] for you." "Hmm?" your kitty-slut purrs, prancing over to peek over your shoulder. "Hey there, cutie. What's got you drinkin' so hard?" The wolf-girl groans. "Life's hard. Stone's cold. You know what's soft and warm, though?" "Titty?" Cait offers. "Yeah," the wolf says. "Titty. Come warm me up and I'll tell ya a secret." Cait gives you a wink and slips past into the changing stall, drawing the curtain closed behind her. You see her panties hit the floor a second later, and then her feet disappear from view entirely. Good girl. You step back to give the two some measure of privacy, though there's hardly any keeping the faint, wet noises from inside from leaking out through just a curtain. A few cow-folk around you give your group disconcerted looks, but even more just look amused. A couple look horny. You wonder if Cait's the first one to take the she-stud up on her offer. "So... Mallachites, huh?" Varena says. "Hey," Liv pouts. "We're not all quite that, uh, eager. Not that there's anything wrong with it! I admire her dedication to the cause." "Right," Varena says. Luckily the wolf doesn't take very long before she's scraping her toe-claws on the floor, and you hear Cait groaning something about keeping a knot to herself. There's a faint tussling inside, before Cait's feet hit the floor again, and the passion priestess slips out from the changing stall. "Learn anything?" you ask. Cait grins. "Mmhm! She said to 'plant roses in the steam.' Dunno what that means, but it seemed important to her." "Maybe [flags.V_BATHS_LACONICUM|it's a passphrase?|she just likes gardening?]" Liv suggests. You rub the pink kitten's ears and turn to go. "We'll find out." '

rows.original: You and your companions enter the blistering-hot furnace chamber at the heart of the bath house, descending a long but narrow set of stairs. Vents of geothermal heat have been opened up in the floor of the place, blasting directly into vast cauldrons to warm water being fed in and then drawn away again by fired pipes. A few slave-collared catfolk are down here managing the pipes, making sure water goes where it's needed, and draining water that's cooled from the higher rooms directly onto themselves. "I thought there'd be a fire," Livrea says, glancing at the floor. "I guess we are pretty far down now." "Oh, yeah, this whole part of town is over an earthflame. Vranny says it stretches from here to the bogs in the boreal forest. I can't believe they're channeling it up into the city like this, though. Gods above, it's boiling in here." She's not kidding. It felt like a sauna in the Laconicum; in here, you feel like you're being physically assaulted by the heat. Sweat pours down your brow, and every breath scorches your lungs. The slaves manning the pipes give you wary looks and shirk away as your group comes down and starts looking around, searching for... well, you aren't sure what exactly, but anything out of place. It's just so damn hard to concentrate with the oppressive heat hammering you... It's almost enough to make you miss one of the catfolk trying to sneak past you.
rows.translation: 你和你的同伴走进浴室中央那个炽热如熔炉的房间，沿着一条又长又窄的楼梯向下走去。地面上的地热通风口被打开，热气直接喷入那些巨大的锅状容器中，将流入的水加热，然后又通过燃烧过的管道将热水排出。 这里有几名被奴役的猫族正在管理这些管道，确保水能够流向需要的地方，同时将上层房间冷却后的水直接引到他们自己的身上。 “我还以为会发生火灾呢，”莉芙蕾娅边说边瞥了瞥地面。 我想我们现在已经走得相当远了。” “哦，对，这一整片区域都被地火覆盖了。Vranny说，这片地火从这里一直延伸到北方森林的沼泽地带。不过，我真不敢相信他们竟然能将这种能量引入城市里。 天啊，这里简直热得要命。” 她可不是在开玩笑。这个浴室里简直就像桑拿房一样；在这里，热浪仿佛在实实在在地攻击你的身体。汗水从你的额头不断流淌下来，每一次呼吸都让你的肺部感到灼烧般的疼痛。 那些负责操作管道的奴隶们看到你们一行人下来后，都露出了警惕的神情，然后纷纷躲开了。你们开始四处寻找……嗯，其实你们自己也并不确定在寻找什么。 什么 确实如此，但只要有一点不对劲，就根本无法集中注意力——当那种令人窒息的热浪不断袭来时，真的太难让人保持清醒了…… 这种环境几乎会让你忽略那些试图悄悄从你身边经过的猫族。

rows.original:
You grab the passing catgirl, a chocolate-skinned waif with short crimson hair and big reddish-brown eyes. The grab is sudden enough to make her squeal, kicking her legs and flailing her skinny arms at you. "Lemme go! Lemme go, you dick!" 
    
    She's squirming so much that her cat ears fall right off, clattering to the floor along with the headband they're attached to. And then goes the towel wrapped around her middle...
rows.translation:
你抓住了那个路过的猫耳少女——一个皮肤呈巧克力色、留着短短的深红色头发、拥有一双大而呈红棕色的眼睛的女孩。你的动作太突然了，让她尖叫起来，她用双腿踢打，瘦小的手臂也朝你挥舞着：“放开我！放开我，你这个混蛋！”

她扭动得太过厉害，结果她的猫耳直接掉了下来，连同绑在耳朵上的发带一起掉在了地上。然后，她身上缠着的毛巾也脱落了……

rows.original: "Isadora!" The human auxilia flails at you until you finally drop her. Several of the surrounding catfolk gasp in shock seeing one of their own revealed as an impostor.[pc.isFeline | Even you give her a cross look for pretending to be your kin. That's not on in public! ] "[pc.name], what's the big idea! What're you even doing here, and with — oh my god oh shit oh fuck." Isadora takes one look at your royal companion and trips over herself in her hurry to kneel. There goes her towel again. You notice the tail is still right where it was, though, hanging from her backside. "Your highness!" Varena sighs as the confused catfolk behind her scramble to follow suit. "It's- no it's fine, please get up." "What are you doing here?" you ask her, [pc.isDK |watching her turn red as she realizes she's disrobed in front of Varena |quickly putting her towel back around her ]. "Let's just... c-can we talk in private?" she says, glancing over a shoulder. Varena makes a shooing gesture at everyone else in the room and then casts her muffling spell, drowning out the sound of talking from above, and roaring heat from below. Only the three of you are able to be heard. "So, it's Isadora, is it? Friend of [pc.name]'s?" "[isadora.fucked |You could say that," Izzy says bashfully. |Something like that!" Isadora says. ] "We met through Lady Calise, your highness. I'm here on her behalf." "Calise's?" Varena says, eyes narrowing subtly. Isadora doesn't pick up on the suspicion in the princess's voice. "Yes, highness! I'm part of her personal cadre — she gave me a chance to fight on the front, when the Legions never did! Though right now I'm helping her with stuff around the city. Errands and such, mostly, but..." "But?" you ask. "But now she asked me to look into this place. She thinks..." Isadora glances around conspiratorially, as though she hadn't just been outed as a spy in front of all the furnace workers already. "She suspects there's enemy influence here. And I'm starting to agree." The suspicion on Varena's face softens. "What have you found, soldier?" Isadora wipes the sweat off her brow. "Well, the people here, you've seen how, um..." She pauses, blushing, until Varena gives her a soft and encouraging smile. "Well, how horny they are? And that's just the tip of the spear. I've seen folk coming into this place and never coming out, like they're just vanishing down here! I've seen people go into the sauna rooms and just never, ever come out. Way past the time when somebody'd pass out from the heat. And then somebody else comes along, goes right in that same room, and repeats. I've watched so long that a guard came up and cuffed me for falling asleep on the job; I swear I didn't miss a thing!" "I believe you," Varena says. "We're investigating the place too. Have you seen anyone important coming or going lately?" Isadora taps her chin. "Yeah. Senator Khaius stopped by today. He went through one of the saunas, too. Gods, I hope he doesn't vanish too! A missing senator would be awful!" [var0 |"Yeah," you muse. "Awful. So what exactly happened?" |"What exactly happened?" you ask. ] "The Senator came down in a rage! He was furious about... something about the water. There wasn't enough of it coming in, because the pipes from all but one of the waterheads have been closed up since the siege started. The baths were struggling to stay full. He grabbed a couple of the massage girls and then went pounding on the last sauna door, shouting 'to hell with your damn roses, open up' before taking them in with him. That's the last I saw of him, almost a day ago!" You and Varena exchange a glance. "You should probably get out of here," you say to Isadora. "I think your cover's blown." "Yeah..." she sighs. "I've got to report back to Lady Calise! Your highness, it's been an honor!" Varena inclines her head. "Khor Aterna, soldier." Isadora scampers, and Varena drops her spell. "Back to work, everybody. Don't mind us!"
rows.translation: 伊莎多拉！” 这个人类辅助角色不断地扑向你，直到你最终将她扔到地上。周围的几只猫族看到他们中的一员原来是个冒名顶替者，都震惊得倒抽了一口气。[pc.isFeline | 就连你也会因为她假装是你的亲人而瞪她一眼吧？在公共场合这样做可不太合适啊！ ] "[pc.name]搞什么鬼！你到底在这里干什么，而且还是和……哦我的天啊，真是见鬼了。”伊莎多拉看了一眼你的王室同伴，慌忙中差点绊倒，赶紧跪了下去。她的毛巾又掉在地上了。你注意到了这一幕 尾巴 它仍然挂在她的屁股后面，一点都没动。“殿下！” 瓦蕾娜叹了口气，身后那些困惑的猫族族也急忙跟着模仿起来。“没……没关系的，请您起来吧。” “你们到底在搞什么 进行中 这里吗？”你问她。 [pc.isDK |看着她意识到自己在瓦蕾娜面前脱光了衣服，顿时涨红了脸。 |她迅速地把毛巾重新围在身上。 ]我们能不能……单独谈谈？”她边说边侧头瞥了一眼周围的人。 瓦蕾娜朝房间里的其他人做了个“走开”的手势，然后施展了隔音咒语，让上方的谈话声以及下方的热浪声都消失了，只有他们三个人的谈话声能够被听到。“所以，是伊莎多拉吧？她的朋友 [pc.name]s?[isadora.fucked |也可以这么说吧，”伊兹害羞地说道。 |差不多就是这个意思！”伊莎多拉说道。 ] 我们是通过卡莉丝女士相识的，殿下。我是受她委托前来拜访的。” “卡莉丝的？”瓦蕾娜微微眯起眼睛，语气中带着一丝怀疑。 伊莎多拉没有察觉到公主话语中的疑虑，继续说道：“是的，殿下！我是她私人团队的成员——当军团们从未给予我这样的机会时，她却让我能够上前线作战！ 虽然现在我主要是在帮她处理一些在城市里的事情，就是一些跑腿之类的活儿，不过……” “不过什么呢？”你问道。 “不过现在她让我去调查这个地方。她觉得……”伊莎多拉鬼鬼祟祟地环顾四周，仿佛自己刚才还没有在所有炉工面前被揭穿是间谍一样。 她怀疑其中藏着什么。 敌人 在这里确实会产生影响。我开始同意这一点了。” 瓦雷娜脸上的疑虑渐渐消散。“你发现了什么，士兵？” 伊莎多拉擦了擦额头上的汗水。“嗯，这里的居民们，你们也看到了，他们……”她停顿了一下，脸上泛起了红晕，直到瓦雷娜给了她一个鼓励的微笑，她才继续说道：“嗯，他们 好色的 他们是这样吗？而这仅仅只是冰山一角而已。我见过有些人来到这个地方，就再也没出来过，就好像他们彻底被困在了这里一样 消失 就在这里！我见过有人走进桑拿房，然后就再也没出来过。那些人待在里面的时间早就超过了正常人会因为高温而昏倒的时间限制。后来又有人进去，同样的事情再次发生。我盯着看得太久了，以至于一个保安过来，因为我上班时睡着了而给我戴上了手铐；但我发誓，我一点都没错过任何事情！我相信你，”瓦蕾娜说道，“我们也在调查那个地方。最近有没有看到什么重要人物来来去去？” 伊莎多拉托了托下巴：“有啊。凯乌斯参议员今天来过，他还用了其中一间桑拿房。 天啊，我希望他也不会消失吧！如果有一位参议员失踪了，那可就太糟糕了！ [var0 |是啊，”你自言自语道，“太糟糕了。那又怎样呢？ 正是如此 这是怎么发生的？ |什么？ 正是如此 这是怎么发生的？”你问道。 ] 那位参议员气冲冲地下了台！他对于水的问题感到非常愤怒……因为自从围城开始以来，除了一个水源之外，其他所有水源的管道都被关闭了，导致水供应量远远不足。因此，那些浴场都很难保持有足够的水量。 他抓了几个按摩女，然后冲向最后一扇桑拿房的门，大喊着“去你们的玫瑰吧，快开门”，随后把那些女孩带了进去。那是我最后一次见到他，差不多是昨天的事了！ 你和瓦蕾娜对视了一眼。 “你或许应该离开这里了，”你对伊莎多拉说，“我觉得你的伪装已经暴露了。” “是啊……”她叹了口气，“我必须向卡莉丝女士汇报！殿下，能与您共事真是我的荣幸！瓦雷娜低下了头：“科尔·阿特纳，一名士兵。” 伊莎多拉飞快地跑开了，瓦雷娜也停止了施法：“大家继续工作吧，别管我们！
