rows.translation:
这座水头要塞环绕在你的四周，即便如今，它的城墙依然高耸入云，令人敬畏。

在你北边有一座已经毁坏的塔楼，而在南边则是要塞的主堡。西边矗立着一座曾经威武庄严的米诺斯女性士兵雕像，她高举着斧头，但如今这座雕像已经被破坏了：成百上千个用过的避孕套被堆放在士兵的足部边，挂在她的盔甲上，系在她的角上，甚至被塞进了她的胸腔里，导致避孕套内的液体渗了出来，浸湿了她那大理石般光滑的肌肤。 在那片区域，河流从东边流来，然后向南蜿蜒，紧贴着山体流淌。

那些恶魔惊慌失措地四处乱飞，它们要么忙着战斗，要么忙着逃跑，根本无暇注意到你的存在。有许多原本驻扎在远离重要目标地的恶魔，正趁这个机会抛弃那个邪教组织，飞越城墙，逃往下面的山谷中去了。
rows.raw:
"
	The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now. 

	One of the ruined towers is north of you, and to the south is the fort's keep. To the west is a once-proud statue of a female Minoan soldier, axe held high, though it's been defaced: hundreds upon hundreds of used condoms are piled up around the soldier's feet, draped off her armor, tied around her horns, and piled into her cleavage so that their contents leak across her marble flesh. Between her legs, the river flows from the east and curves around into the keep itself in the south, pressed against the mountainside.
	
	Demons flap about in a panic, too busy fighting or fleeing to really notice you. Plenty of them that were stationed this far from anything important are taking the opportunity to bail on the cult, taking wing over the walls and into the mountain valleys below. 
	"

rows.original:
The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now. 

	You're tucked into the furthest corner of the courtyard now, where most of the rubbish from the old garrison has been stacked up out of the way: overturned wagons, tattered tarps, old banners, whatever was left behind in the soldiers' hurry to leave. 
	
	Demons flap about in a panic, too busy fighting or fleeing to really notice you. Plenty of them that were stationed this far from anything important are taking the opportunity to bail on the cult, taking wing over the walls and into the mountain valleys below. 
	
	North from here you can see a pair of towers, the closer of which lies in utter ruin. To the west is the fort's keep, solidly built into the mountainside.
rows.translation:
那座水头堡垒环绕在你的四周，即便如今，它的城墙依然高耸入云，令人望而生畏。

你现在站在庭院的最角落里，那里堆放着从那座旧驻军营地遗留下来的大部分垃圾：翻倒的马车、破旧的防水布、陈旧的旗帜——所有这些都是在士兵们匆忙撤离时被遗弃的东西。 
	
	恶魔惊慌失措地四处飞窜，它们要么忙着战斗，要么忙着逃跑，根本无暇注意到你的存在。许多那些驻扎在远离重要目标地区的恶魔，都趁这个机会抛弃了那个邪教组织，飞越城墙，逃往下方的山谷之中。 
	
	从这里向北望去，可以看到两座塔楼，其中较近的那座已经完全毁坏了。而在西边，则是堡垒的主楼，它坚固地建在山坡上。
rows.raw:
"
	The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now. 

	You're tucked into the furthest corner of the courtyard now, where most of the rubbish from the old garrison has been stacked up out of the way: overturned wagons, tattered tarps, old banners, whatever was left behind in the soldiers' hurry to leave. 
	
	Demons flap about in a panic, too busy fighting or fleeing to really notice you. Plenty of them that were stationed this far from anything important are taking the opportunity to bail on the cult, taking wing over the walls and into the mountain valleys below. 
	
	North from here you can see a pair of towers, the closer of which lies in utter ruin. To the west is the fort's keep, solidly built into the mountainside."

rows.original: You've clambered down the ladder from the shattered ground floor of the ruined tower and into the dugout undercroft below. This might've started as a small storage area, but the walls were never smoothed out to anything but jagged rock, and now somebody's gone through the effort of tunneling into the mountain to your east.
rows.translation: 你从那座废墟塔楼破碎的底层爬下，进入了下方挖掘出来的地洞。这里最初可能只是个小型储藏空间，但墙壁始终没有被修整得平整，依旧是参差不齐的岩石表面。而现在，有人竟然费心地在你东边的山体中开凿出了隧道。
rows.raw: "\n\tYou've clambered down the ladder from the shattered ground floor of the ruined tower and into the dugout undercroft below. This might've started as a small storage area, but the walls were never smoothed out to anything but jagged rock, and now somebody's gone through the effort of tunneling into the mountain to your east.\n\t"

rows.original:
The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now. 

	The two towers of the fortress are to your northeast and northwest. To the south is a once-proud statue of a female Minoan soldier, axe held high, though it's been defaced: hundreds upon hundreds of used condoms are piled up around the soldier's feet, draped off her armor, tied around her horns, and piled into her cleavage so that their contents leak across her marble flesh. Between her legs, the river flows from the east and curves around into the keep itself in the south, pressed against the mountainside.
	
	Demons flap about in a panic, fighting [party.has calise|your troops|the frost wyvern pack] in a desperate bid to keep the fort from being overrun. The bulk of them are no threat to you now, too busy in a battle of their own to look down at you.
rows.translation:
这座水头要塞环绕在你的四周，即便如今，它的城墙依然高耸入云，令人望而生畏。

要塞的两座塔楼分别位于你的东北方和西北方。而在南方，有一座曾经威武庄严的米诺斯女性士兵雕像——她高举着斧头，但如今这座雕像已经被破坏了：成百上千个用过的避孕套被堆放在士兵的足部边，挂在她的盔甲上，系在她的角上，甚至被塞进了她的胸脯里，导致避孕套内的液体渗到了她的大理石雕像上。 在那片区域，河流从东边流淌过来，然后向南蜿蜒，紧贴着山体延伸。

恶魔惊慌失措地四处飞扑，互相厮杀着。 [party.has calise|你的军队|霜冻飞龙包] 为了阻止敌人占领据点，他们做出了最后的努力。现在，他们中的大多数人已经没有能力威胁到你，因为他们都在忙于自己的战斗，无暇顾及你。
rows.raw:
"
    The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now. 

	The two towers of the fortress are to your northeast and northwest. To the south is a once-proud statue of a female Minoan soldier, axe held high, though it's been defaced: hundreds upon hundreds of used condoms are piled up around the soldier's feet, draped off her armor, tied around her horns, and piled into her cleavage so that their contents leak across her marble flesh. Between her legs, the river flows from the east and curves around into the keep itself in the south, pressed against the mountainside.
	
	Demons flap about in a panic, fighting [party.has calise|your troops|the frost wyvern pack] in a desperate bid to keep the fort from being overrun. The bulk of them are no threat to you now, too busy in a battle of their own to look down at you.
    "

rows.original:
The stone is wet with water from the river rushing through the fort, and you're surrounded by a musty, earthy smell emanating from deeper within. A handful of improvised pickaxes and shovels are scattered around. For how crude they are, they seem well cared for; the copper blades practically glisten with polish.

	The man-made tunnel curves here, from west to the tower and then south underneath the fortress.
rows.translation:
这些石头被从堡垒中流过的河水浸湿了，而周围弥漫着一种发霉的、泥土的气息，这种气味似乎来自更深处。地上散落着几把自制的镐和铲子。尽管这些工具非常简陋，但它们似乎被保养得很好，铜制的刀刃甚至闪烁着光泽。

这条人工挖掘的隧道在这里转向，从西侧延伸到塔楼，然后向南穿过堡垒的下方。
rows.raw:
"
	The stone is wet with water from the river rushing through the fort, and you're surrounded by a musty, earthy smell emanating from deeper within. A handful of improvised pickaxes and shovels are scattered around. For how crude they are, they seem well cared for; the copper blades practically glisten with polish.

	The man-made tunnel curves here, from west to the tower and then south underneath the fortress.
	"

rows.original:
This tunnel is long enough to make you wonder if the demons are trying to mine something down here. Somebody's come along and reinforced the excavation's path with wooden support beams, and even hung up torch sconces — though with no ventilation to speak of, they've been forced to make due with embers that barely give enough light to make your way by.

	The tunnel stretches north, back to the tower, or deeper in to the south.
rows.translation:
这条隧道长得让人不禁怀疑，那些恶魔是不是在试图在这里挖掘什么。有人曾经来过，用木制支撑梁加固了挖掘的道路，甚至还挂上了火把——不过由于完全没有通风设施，他们只能使用那些几乎只能发出微弱轻型亮的火把来照明。

这条隧道向北延伸，通向那座塔，或者继续向南延伸，通往更远的地方。
rows.raw:
"
	This tunnel is long enough to make you wonder if the demons are trying to mine something down here. Somebody's come along and reinforced the excavation's path with wooden support beams, and even hung up torch sconces — though with no ventilation to speak of, they've been forced to make due with embers that barely give enough light to make your way by.

	The tunnel stretches north, back to the tower, or deeper in to the south.
	"

rows.original: You're standing in a 3-way branch of the tunnel: north of course leads back towards the tower, and to the west you can see a long, curving tunnel. Somebody's brought actual carpets down there, and you can see the flicker of lantern-light. To the east,
rows.translation: 你现在站在隧道的三岔路口：向北走会回到塔楼那里，而向西则会看到一条长长的、蜿蜒的隧道。显然，是有人把这些东西带过来的 地毯 在远处，你可以看到灯笼轻型闪烁的身影。 在东方，
rows.raw: " You're standing in a 3-way branch of the tunnel: north of course leads back towards the tower, and to the west you can see a long, curving tunnel. Somebody's brought actual carpets down there, and you can see the flicker of lantern-light. To the east, "

rows.translation: 那就是那个被击败的恶魔地法师。

rows.original: you can hear the sounds of metal crashing against stone — somebody's down there, mining away.
rows.translation: 你可以听到金属撞击石头的声音——有人在下面进行采矿作业。
rows.raw: "you can hear the sounds of metal crashing against stone — somebody's down there, mining away."

rows.original: You're in a bend in the tunnel here, connecting the mine chamber back east to a softly-lit, surprisingly well-furnished office to the south. A set of curtains made from an old Minoan war-banner separate the carpeted chamber in front of you from the dark, damp tunnels you've traveled through to get here.
rows.translation: 你现在正处于这条隧道的一个转弯处，这条隧道将东侧的矿井与南侧那间灯光柔和、装饰颇为精致的办公室连接起来。一扇由古老的米诺斯战旗制成的窗帘，将你眼前的这个铺着地毯的房间与你之前穿行过的那些阴暗潮湿的隧道分隔开来。
rows.raw: "\n\tYou're in a bend in the tunnel here, connecting the mine chamber back east to a softly-lit, surprisingly well-furnished office to the south. A set of curtains made from an old Minoan war-banner separate the carpeted chamber in front of you from the dark, damp tunnels you've traveled through to get here.\n\t"

rows.original: At the end of the mine tunnel is a small office, separated by curtains made from banners from the rest of the dig site. A thick, if time-worn, carpet is laid out over the smoothed-out floor, and somebody's actually dragged a desk — admittedly a cheap, thin one — down here. There's a lantern on it, and all manner of writing implements litter the desk, but most of the space is dedicated to rocks. All manner of different kinds, carefully catalogued in labeled vials, alphabetized and neatly arranged. Somebody's making a collection.
rows.translation: 在矿井隧道的尽头，有一间小办公室，它与其他挖掘区域是用横幅制成的帘子隔开的。平整的地板上铺着一块厚厚的、虽然已经有些磨损的地毯，而且还有人把一张桌子拖到了这里——虽然那是一张便宜又单薄的桌子。 桌上放着一盏灯笼，各种书写工具散落一地，但大部分空间都被用来摆放岩石了。这些岩石种类繁多，都被仔细地分类收纳在贴有标签的试管里，按照字母顺序整齐地排列着。 有人在收集这些东西。
rows.raw: "\n\tAt the end of the mine tunnel is a small office, separated by curtains made from banners from the rest of the dig site. A thick, if time-worn, carpet is laid out over the smoothed-out floor, and somebody's actually dragged a desk — admittedly a cheap, thin one — down here. There's a lantern on it, and all manner of writing implements litter the desk, but most of the space is dedicated to rocks. All manner of different kinds, carefully catalogued in labeled vials, alphabetized and neatly arranged. Somebody's making a collection.\n\t"

rows.original: Take the mining tool with you. Never know when you might need to excavate something.
rows.translation: 带上这个挖掘工具吧，谁知道什么时候会需要用到它来挖掘些什么呢。
rows.raw: "Take the mining tool with you. Never know when you might need to excavate something."

rows.original:
You're walking through what seems like more recent excavation — there's still shattered bits of stone scattered all over the ground, yet to be cleaned up and out, and the floor's uneven enough in places to nearly trip you. The walls, though, are what really catch your eye: even in the dimness of the torchlight you can see flecks of tin glittering. This must be what the demons were after down here.

	Back west is the main tunnel; east is deeper into the dig site.
rows.translation:
你正走在一片似乎是最近才挖掘出来的区域——地上仍然散落着破碎的石块，这些碎片尚未被清理干净，地面的起伏也大到足以让你差点绊倒。不过，真正吸引你注意力的是那些墙壁：即使在火把微弱的光芒下，你也能看到那些闪烁的锡粒。想必这些就是恶魔在这里想要夺取的东西。

向西走就是主通道；而向东则会进入挖掘区域的更深处。
rows.raw:
"
	You're walking through what seems like more recent excavation — there's still shattered bits of stone scattered all over the ground, yet to be cleaned up and out, and the floor's uneven enough in places to nearly trip you. The walls, though, are what really catch your eye: even in the dimness of the torchlight you can see flecks of tin glittering. This must be what the demons were after down here.

	Back west is the main tunnel; east is deeper into the dig site.
	
	"

rows.original: You can hear the ring of stone and metal up ahead to the east. Somebody's definitely down here, working away...
rows.translation: 在东边前方，你可以听到石头与金属碰撞发出的声响。肯定有人在这里辛勤工作着……
rows.raw: "You can hear the ring of stone and metal up ahead to the east. Somebody's definitely down here, working away..."

rows.original: The end of the tunnel is clearly a work in progress, mined out by the labor of imps and golems under the demon catboy's direction. Amongst the shattered stone at the mine's end, you can see veins of tin in the process of being dug up — an essential part of forging bronze, and the more expensive of the two primary components. No wonder the demons were digging so enthusiastically down here in the dark!
rows.translation: 隧道的尽头显然还处于施工阶段，那些小妖精和傀儡在恶魔猫男孩的指挥下正在那里挖掘。在矿井尽头的碎石堆中，你可以看到那些正在被挖掘出来的锡矿脉——这是锻造青铜所必需的材料，也是两种主要成分中价格更昂贵的一种。难怪那些恶魔会如此热衷于在暗影中在这里挖掘啊！
rows.raw: "\n\tThe end of the tunnel is clearly a work in progress, mined out by the labor of imps and golems under the demon catboy's direction. Amongst the shattered stone at the mine's end, you can see veins of tin in the process of being dug up — an essential part of forging bronze, and the more expensive of the two primary components. No wonder the demons were digging so enthusiastically down here in the dark!\n\t"

rows.original: You've made it into the great tower that looms above the waterway fortress, what you assume to be the demons' command post. There's a small entrance foyer here, leading north into the central spire. Circular stairs ring the inner tower, spiraling up and up out of sight.
rows.translation: 你已经进入了那座耸立在水路要塞上方的巨塔，你认为这里就是恶魔的指挥中心。这里有一个小小的入口大厅，通往北方的中央尖塔。圆形的楼梯环绕着内塔，一路向上延伸，最终消失在视线之外。
rows.raw: "\n\tYou've made it into the great tower that looms above the waterway fortress, what you assume to be the demons' command post. There's a small entrance foyer here, leading north into the central spire. Circular stairs ring the inner tower, spiraling up and up out of sight.\n\t"

" [var0 |The bottom floor of the tower... just looking up gives you a bit of vertigo. There's no floor between where you stand now and the very top, just a spiraling staircase clinging to the outer walls, around and around and around for what looks like two hundred feet from down here! There's a small entrance foyer back south. To the east is a sturdy wooden door, underneath a sign that says "LIBRARY" in Belharan — presumably the Minoan characters above it represent the same. A note's been pinned to the door in a neat, harshly-angled script: "Took the key with me since imps can't stop stealing my shit. Find me in the dig site if you need it. -Auren." [party.has viv |As she reads Auren's note, Viv just lets out a sigh. ] |[party.has calise |Calise puts a hand on your shoulder. "I'm eager to put the enemy leaders down too, but that's a hell of a climb. The battle will be over before we're done, I fear — we should see to the demon pits first. I have a fire in my heart, and only cleansing that evil from the world will quench it!" ] [party.has varena |Varena glances up the tower. "There's no way the demons' breeding grounds are up there. We should finish them off before we go after whoever's up there. It's a LONG climb!" ] [party.has azzy |Azyrran shakes her head and frowns. "Unless all of us could blast up there by wing, I think we're better off dealing with that foul demon-pit first... or this climb could get very ugly." ] ] "

rows.original:
You're at the foot of the spiral stairs leading up, and up, and up... Gods, [pc.hasWings|you're so happy you have wings!|this is going to be agony on your poor legs tomorrow.]
	
	[party.has calise|Calise whistles, looking upwards. "You'd best be sure you're ready for this, [pc.name]. By the time we finish this climb, the battle will be over!"]
	
	[party.has varena|Varena glances up and grimaces. "Damn it, leg day was yesterday... by the time we get up to the top the wyverns might well be done with their work, so... so be sure you're done down in the courtyard. I don't want to come back down and see an army waiting for us!"]
	
	[party.has arona|"Wish I could dry assfuck whoever invented stairs," Arona says, shaking out her legs. "This sucks."]
	
	[party.has ryn|Ryn looks up, flattens her ears, and then makes a plaintive [silly|uppies|grasping] motion at you. 
	
	You just shake your head. Not in the middle of a battle.]
	
	[party.has atugia|Atugia glances up the stairs. "Shit. Up we go."]
rows.translation:
你站在那螺旋楼梯的脚下，楼梯一直向上延伸，越来越高……天啊， [pc.hasWings|你高兴得简直像是长了翅膀一样！|明天你的双腿肯定会因此而感到剧痛。]
	
	[party.has calise|卡莉丝吹着口哨，抬头说道：“你最好确定自己已经做好了准备。 [pc.name]等我们爬到山顶的时候，战斗早就结束了！]
	
	[party.has varena|瓦蕾娜抬头看了看，然后皱起了眉头。“该死，昨天才是训练腿力的日子……等我们爬到山顶的时候，那些双足飞龙可能已经完成它们的任务了。所以……一定要在院子里把事情处理完毕。我可不想下去后看到有一支军队在等着我们！]
	
	[party.has arona|真希望我能把发明楼梯的那个人干得屁滚尿流，”阿罗娜一边说，一边活动着双腿。“这太糟糕了。]
	
	[party.has ryn|瑞恩抬起头，耳朵贴得紧紧的，然后发出了一声哀怨的叫声。 [silly|小狗们|理解] 有动作朝你袭来。

你只是摇了摇头。毕竟现在不是在战斗中。]
	
	[party.has atugia|阿图吉娅抬头望了望楼梯，说道：“该死，我们得上去了。]
rows.raw:
'
	You're at the foot of the spiral stairs leading up, and up, and up... Gods, [pc.hasWings|you're so happy you have wings!|this is going to be agony on your poor legs tomorrow.]
	
	[party.has calise|Calise whistles, looking upwards. "You'd best be sure you're ready for this, [pc.name]. By the time we finish this climb, the battle will be over!"]
	
	[party.has varena|Varena glances up and grimaces. "Damn it, leg day was yesterday... by the time we get up to the top the wyverns might well be done with their work, so... so be sure you're done down in the courtyard. I don't want to come back down and see an army waiting for us!"]
	
	[party.has arona|"Wish I could dry assfuck whoever invented stairs," Arona says, shaking out her legs. "This sucks."]
	
	[party.has ryn|Ryn looks up, flattens her ears, and then makes a plaintive [silly|uppies|grasping] motion at you. 
	
	You just shake your head. Not in the middle of a battle.]
	
	[party.has atugia|Atugia glances up the stairs. "Shit. Up we go."]
	'

rows.original: You're just beginning your long, winding journey up the stairs. [party.has azzy|You're more than a little envious of Azzy taking wing and just hovering along in your wake.]
rows.translation: 你才刚刚开始这段漫长而曲折的上楼梯之旅。 [party.has azzy|你对于Azzy能够振翅飞翔、紧随在你身后翱翔，实在感到非常羡慕。]
rows.raw: "\n\tYou're just beginning your long, winding journey up the stairs. [party.has azzy|You're more than a little envious of Azzy taking wing and just hovering along in your wake.]\n\t"

rows.original:
You're maybe a story up from the ground floor now. Plenty more to go after this. [party.has brint brienne|[brint.name] glances upwards.

	"Good thing I lived in a mountain," [brint.heShe] sighs.]
rows.translation: 你现在或许已经取得了初步的成功，但前方还有许多路要走。 [party.has brint brienne|[brint.name] 还好我住在山上。 [brint.heShe] 叹息。]
rows.raw:
'
	You're maybe a story up from the ground floor now. Plenty more to go after this. [party.has brint brienne|[brint.name] glances upwards.

	"Good thing I lived in a mountain," [brint.heShe] sighs.]
	'

rows.original: You're getting higher with every step...
rows.translation: 你每迈出一步，都在不断上升……

rows.original: Higher and higher, around and around... you're head's a little fuzzy from the ascent now.
rows.translation: 越来越高，一圈又一圈……随着不断上升，你的头脑都有点昏昏沉沉了。
rows.raw: "\n\tHigher and higher, around and around... you're head's a little fuzzy from the ascent now.\n\t"

rows.original: Gods you're really high up now...[party.has azzy| Even Azyrran's looking winded now, and settles down to walk behind you.]
rows.translation: 天啊，你们现在真是地位高不可攀了……[party.has azzy| 就连阿兹兰现在看起来也有些气喘吁吁，于是便跟在你身后走了起来。]
rows.raw: "\n\tGods you're really high up now...[party.has azzy| Even Azyrran's looking winded now, and settles down to walk behind you.]\n\t"

rows.original:
The floor's far enough below you now that you're keenly aware that [pc.hasWings|if you couldn't fly ]one good tumble would at the very least put you in the healer's tent for a spell. And somehow there's still another floor to go.

	[party.has atugia|Despite the distance, Tui's still looking like she's climbed no more than two stories...]
rows.translation:
现在，当你清楚地意识到地板已经离你如此之远时 [pc.hasWings|如果你不能飞翔 ]哪怕只是重重摔一次，至少也会让你被送到治疗者的帐篷里接受治疗。然而，奇怪的是，似乎还有另一层楼层需要去挑战。

	[party.has atugia|尽管距离那么远，但崔看起来就像只是爬了两层楼而已……]
rows.raw:
"
	The floor's far enough below you now that you're keenly aware that [pc.hasWings|if you couldn't fly ]one good tumble would at the very least put you in the healer's tent for a spell. And somehow there's still another floor to go.

	[party.has atugia|Despite the distance, Tui's still looking like she's climbed no more than two stories...]
	"

rows.original: You're nearly there! There's a door up ahead another rotation around the tower. Just a few more steps...
rows.translation: 你快要成功了！在前方有一扇门，只需再绕塔旋转一圈，再走几步就能到了……
rows.raw: "\n\tYou're nearly there! There's a door up ahead another rotation around the tower. Just a few more steps...\n\t"

rows.original:
A small library sits at the bottom of the tower, surprisingly cozy for where it is. There's a fireplace on the far side from the door, and a pair of semi-circular bookshelves line the walls between. A pair of big, plush reading chairs face the fire with a drink table between them.[flags.WHFORT_WINE|| There's still a bottle of ice wine sitting there.]
	
	[flags.WHFORT_BOOKS||Several of the books sitting out appear to be recently-scribed spell tomes, and a quick glance through their content reveals the same sharp hand as wrote the note outside. Auren's work.
	
	[party.has viv|You can see Viv restraining herself from [viv.isDemon|quietly ]nabbing them for her own studies.]]
rows.translation:
在塔楼的下装，有一个小小的图书馆，考虑到它所处的位置，这里显得格外舒适。门的另一侧有一座壁炉，而在壁炉两侧的墙上则排列着一对半圆形的书架。两把柔软舒适的阅读椅面对着壁炉而摆放，它们中间还有一张摆放饮品的桌子。[flags.WHFORT_WINE|| 还有一瓶冰酒放在那里呢。]
	
	[flags.WHFORT_BOOKS||那些放在外面的几本书似乎都是最近编写的法术典籍，匆匆翻阅一下内容，就能发现它们的书写风格与外面那张纸条如出一辙——显然是奥伦的手笔。
	
	[party.has viv|你可以看到薇薇在努力克制自己。 [viv.isDemon|安静地 ]将这些资料收集起来用于自己的研究。]]
rows.raw:
"
	A small library sits at the bottom of the tower, surprisingly cozy for where it is. There's a fireplace on the far side from the door, and a pair of semi-circular bookshelves line the walls between. A pair of big, plush reading chairs face the fire with a drink table between them.[flags.WHFORT_WINE|| There's still a bottle of ice wine sitting there.]
	
	[flags.WHFORT_BOOKS||Several of the books sitting out appear to be recently-scribed spell tomes, and a quick glance through their content reveals the same sharp hand as wrote the note outside. Auren's work.
	
	[party.has viv|You can see Viv restraining herself from [viv.isDemon|quietly ]nabbing them for her own studies.]]
	"

rows.original: Help yourself to the spellbooks that've been left here unguarded.
rows.translation: 把这些被遗忘在这里、无人看管的法术书拿去吧。
rows.raw: "Help yourself to the spellbooks that've been left here unguarded."

rows.original: This looks like the safest place in the keep, and you can even lock the door.
rows.translation: 这个地方看起来是整个堡垒中最安全的地方了，而且你甚至可以把门锁上。
rows.raw: "This looks like the safest place in the keep, and you can even lock the door."

rows.original:
You pick up the bottle of wine and look it over. 
    
    [party.has ryn
        |"Ice wine!" Ryn gasps. "How did it get all the way here..."
        |You remember seeing bottles just like it in the Palace of Ice, just before you kicked Alissa out of Njorhaalt.
    ]
    
    Seems to be in good condition, regardless of the path it might have taken to get here.
rows.translation:
你拿起那瓶葡萄酒仔细端详起来。 
    
    [party.has ryn
        |冰酒！”瑞恩惊呼道，“它是怎么传到这里的……
        |你记得在冰之宫殿里看到过一模一样的瓶子，就在你把艾丽莎赶出尼约哈尔特之前。
    ]
    
    无论它是通过怎样的途径来到这里的，它的状况似乎都还不错。

    You pick up the bottle of wine and look it over.

"
    You heft up one of the lengthy tomes and give it a glance through. The handwriting is the same neat, geometric script used on the note outside[var0| — and now that you've seen a bigger sample, you're entirely sure it really is the same as in the surveyor's journal you found for Katya. Auren's identity is beyond a doubt now]. The book's contents are a ramble of geomancy symbols, runic phrases, and diagrams of hand gestures — spellbooks, in other words.
    
	[party.has viv
        |Viv peers around your shoulder as you flip through the grimoire. "Hmm. This man's downright obsessive in his work. This sort of detail is every bit the equal of what you'd expect from an archmagister's work... though the end product is just... moving rock. [viv.isDemon
            |A shameful waste of talent, really.
            |I'll be the first to admit that that's not my area of expertise, but it seems like it'd be useful when you live under a mountain or want to build anything of particular size.
        ]"
        	
		[party.has cait
            |Cait shrugs. "At least he clearly loves what he does. Or did."
        ]
    ]
    	
	[party.has varena
        |"I don't see anything corrupted in this work at least," Varena says. "It should be safe to use, if you're of a mind to. Though good luck making sense of this scrawl.."
    ]
    "

rows.original:
"Let's take a breather," you say, slumping down into one of the chairs. 
    	
	[party.has calise
        |"In the middle of a battle?" Calise scoffs, slinging herself into the other chair. Her axe comes to rest beside her, and she lifts her helm from her head. "Ballsy. I like it. Show them contempt."
    ]
    	
	[party.has varena
        |Varena cuts her eyes between you and the door, and sighs. "Honestly I'm going to need my strength before we climb that tower. Goddess preserve me." She sits down next to you, rolling her head back and breathing hard. "Though I can't promise I'll get up again as it is..."
    ]
    	
	[party.has azzy
        |Azzy sits down on a chair and tucks her legs, letting her fuzzy abdomen rest over one of the arms. "Light protect us, to be so high up and yet still so far from warmth and sky. Good luck, everyone."
    ]
    	
	You put your hands out to the fire, enjoying the fleeting warmth against the cold of the mountaintops. Your breathing slows, and the chill begins to recede from your extremities. Gods, that's nice...
    	
	A few minutes of that and you've caught your breath again, good to go. 
    	
	[party.has varena
        |The princess, though, groans as she pushes herself to her feet, and you're pretty sure you hear her knees pop. "Uuugh, Tira! No, I'm fine, really... ready to go."
    ]
rows.translation:
我们休息一下吧，”你说着，瘫坐在其中一把椅子上。 
    	
	[party.has calise
        |在战斗进行中？”卡莉丝嗤笑道，一屁股坐到另一把椅子上。她的斧头放在身旁，她摘下了头上的头盔。“真有胆量。我喜欢。就这样，让他们看看你的蔑视。
    ]
    	
	[party.has varena
        |瓦蕾娜将目光在你们和门之间来回移动，然后叹了口气。“说实话，在爬那座塔之前，我真需要恢复一下体力。愿女神保佑我。”她坐在你旁边，仰着头，喘着粗气。“不过……我现在也不敢保证自己还能再站起来呢……
    ]
    	
	[party.has azzy
        |阿齐坐在椅子上，把双腿盘起来，让毛茸茸的腹部搭在椅子的扶手上。“愿光明保护我们，让我们身处如此高的地方，却依然远离温暖与蓝天。祝大家好运。
    ]
    	
	你将双手部伸向火焰，享受着那短暂的热量，驱散山顶的寒冷。你的呼吸逐渐变得平稳，四肢的刺痛感也渐渐消失了。天啊，真是太舒服了……

就这样休息几分钟，你就能重新恢复体力，继续前进了。 
    	
	[party.has varena
        |然而，公主在试图站起来的时候发出了呻吟声，你几乎可以听到她的膝盖发出了“咔嚓”的声响。“呃，蒂拉！不，我真的没事……已经准备好出发了。
    ]

rows.original:
[party.has varena
        |Varena's huffing and puffing already, wiping the sweat from her brow as her hooves pound the stone stairs. Every step makes that enormous bust of hers [var0|quake under her golden armor|almost jiggle out of her corset].
        |Calise's rushing the stairs in front of you now, axe raised and ready to strike the next fiend that shows itself before her.
    ] Your calves are burning now, an unpleasant contrast to the frigid mountain air. The sounds of fighting are starting to die down outside — at least until a magical blast sends the tower shaking around you.
    
    [party.has varena
        |Varena squeals in alarm, clutching your arm. "Oh, gods! They're getting desperate out there."
        |"Fuck!" Calise growls, rocking on her feet. "Didn't they see us go in here?"
    ]
    
    You've got no time to worry about that, though. While your companion's distracted, your eyes are on the stairs above, and the towering shape thundering down towards you. Another centaur woman, corrupted into a fecund breeder overflowing with fertile hips and breasts barely contained in her tight leather barding. Atop her is an imp, more broadly built than the scrawny wastrels you've been fighting all through the fort, with a drawn blade that crackles with unholy energy in one hand, and a flapping banner displaying a pair of crossed equine cocks held aloft in the other. 
    
    "Charge!" it screeches, digging its heels into the tainted mare. She tucks her head down and barrels down the stairs like a living battering ram, laughing like a madwoman all the while.
rows.translation:
[party.has varena
        |瓦蕾娜一边喘着粗气，一边擦着额头上的汗水，她的蹄子重重地踩在石阶上。每走一步，她那巨大的胸脯都会随着步伐的节奏而起伏。 [var0|在她那金色的铠甲下，大地都在颤抖。|几乎要从束腰中跳出来似的].
        |现在，卡莉丝正冲在你前面跑上楼梯，她举着斧头，随时准备攻击任何出现在她面前的敌人。
    ] 现在你的小腿正在剧烈燃烧，这与山间寒冷的空气形成了鲜明的对比。外面的战斗声渐渐减弱了——至少在某次魔法爆炸使你周围的塔楼开始剧烈震动之前是这样。
    
    [party.has varena
        |瓦蕾娜惊恐地尖叫着，紧紧抓住你的手臂：“哦，天啊！他们简直已经走投无路了。
        |该死！”卡莉丝愤怒地吼道，摇摇晃晃地站了起来，“他们难道没看到我们进来了吗？
    ]
    
    不过，你现在没有时间去担心那些事情。当你的同伴分心之际，你的目光已经盯在了上方的楼梯上——那个高大的身影正轰鸣着朝你冲下来。又是一个半人马女性，她已经被腐蚀成了一个生育能力极强的生物，那丰满的臀部与胸部几乎要撑破她那紧身的皮制盔甲了。 她头顶上站着一个小妖精，这个家伙的体格比你在堡垒里一路上遇到的那些瘦骨嶙峋的家伙要魁梧得多。他一只手握着一把散发着邪恶能量的拔出的刀，另一只手则高举着一面旗帜，旗帜上画着两只交叉的公马图案。 
    
    冲啊！”它尖叫着，用后腿猛地蹬着那匹被污染的马。她低下头，像一头活生生的攻城槌一样冲下楼梯，一路上还在疯狂地大笑。

rows.original:
The centaur warioress totters on her hooves before slumping onto her side — thankfully the one facing the tower wall. Her imp rider, though, goes tumbling off his saddle, straight down to the tower floor.
    
    [party.has varena
        |Varena grimaces. "Did he forget he had wings..."
        |Calise scoffs. "So much for him."
    ]
    
    "Come on," you say, grabbing her attention back. "We aren't done yet!"
    
    [party.has varena
        |Varena groans in pure despair. Still, t
        |T
    ]he cult's command staff — Master Tollus included, gods willing — is within reach!
rows.translation:
那位半人马女战士在蹄子上摇晃了几下，最终侧倒在地——幸好她是面朝塔墙倒下的。然而，她骑在身上的小妖精却从马鞍上摔了下来，直接坠到了塔底。
    
    [party.has varena
        |瓦蕾娜做了个鬼脸：“他该不会忘了自己有翅膀吧……
        |卡莉丝嗤笑道：“他就这样罢了。
    ]
    
    快点吧，”你说道，重新吸引了她的注意力，“我们还没结束呢！
    
    [party.has varena
        |瓦拉娜在绝望中发出了呻吟。然而，她依然……
        |T
    ]如果诸神愿意的话，那个邪教的指挥团队——包括托卢斯大师在内——已经就在我们的掌控范围之内了！

rows.original:
The centauress's whole body weight barrels into you at full force. The wind's knocked out of your lungs before you can scream, and then you're hit by a rush of horrific vertigo as you're thrown clear of the stairs.
    
	The stone rushes up to greet you with bone-crushing force[pc.hasWings
        | before you can even spread your wings
    ].
rows.translation:
半人马女的全部体重以全力向你冲来。在你还能发出尖叫之前，空气就已经被挤出了你的肺部，紧接着，一阵剧烈的眩晕感袭来，你被猛地抛出了楼梯之外。

那块石头也以足以粉碎骨骼的巨力朝你袭来。[pc.hasWings
        | 还没等你展翅高飞呢
    ].
rows.raw:
"
    The centauress's whole body weight barrels into you at full force. The wind's knocked out of your lungs before you can scream, and then you're hit by a rush of horrific vertigo as you're thrown clear of the stairs.
    
	The stone rushes up to greet you with bone-crushing force[pc.hasWings
        | before you can even spread your wings
    ].
    "

rows.original:
You hear the beating of wings and nasal cackling — the now all too familiar sign of imps approaching from behind. You twist around in time to see a flock of four coming into view, dicks out and wicked snarls on their misshapen faces. 


	[party.has calise|Calise snarls, whirling her axe to bear. "No mercy!"]
	
	[party.has varena|Varena brings her staff up, taking a step back as the winged demons descend. "Get away!"]
rows.translation:
你听到了翅膀拍打的声音，还有那种刺耳的咯咯笑声——这些声音早已成为了小妖精从背后接近的标志。你迅速转身，只见有一群四只的小妖精出现在视野中，它们的阴茎都勃起了，那些畸形的脸上挂着凶狠的表情。 


	[party.has calise|卡莉丝怒吼着，挥动她的斧头冲了上去。“绝不留情！]
	
	[party.has varena|瓦蕾娜举起法杖，向后退了一步，与此同时，那些长着翅膀的恶魔们开始俯冲下来。“快逃！]

rows.original:
[party.has calise|The [calise.hdk|paladin|fallen knight|demon queen] at your side drops the blade of her axe four times in quick succession. You suppose she wasn't kidding about showing no mercy. 

	"Filth," she snarls. "Come. More where they came from, [flags.WHFORT_PITS_DESTROYED|even now|and in limitless numbers until we clear the breeding puts]!"]
	
	[party.has varena|Varena swats one of the barely-conscious fields away from her hooves with a disgusted grunt. "Let's move on before more show up."]
rows.translation:
[party.has calise|那个 [calise.hdk|圣骑士|堕落骑士|恶魔女王] 她站在你身旁，连续四次快速挥下了她的斧头。你不得不承认，她所说的“绝不留情”绝对不是在开玩笑。

“肮脏的东西，”她厉声说道，“过来。还有更多的，就在它们来的地方 [flags.WHFORT_PITS_DESTROYED|即便在现在也是如此。|而且数量是无限的，直到我们清除所有的繁殖点为止。]!"]
	
	[party.has varena|瓦蕾娜厌恶地哼了一声，用蹄子把那个几乎失去意识的生物踢到了一边。“再有更多这样的东西出现之前，我们还是赶紧离开吧。]

rows.original: The imp assault proves to be the stone that broke the centaur's back, and you crumple to your knees under a wave of beats and cock-slaps. The pathetic creatures cackle all around you, pushing you down on the ground and tearing at your [pc.armor]. rows.translation: 叮当！ 在这段隧道里，金属撞击石头的声音震耳欲聋。这种回声就像战鼓的敲击声一样，持续而有力。 哐当！ 在你前方，是一条长长的、由粗糙的石壁构成的通道，通道上挂满了用匆忙搭建的支撑梁固定的菌类灯笼，为道路提供了照明。在隧道的尽头，有两座巨大的、笨重的机器正在移动，它们那形状怪异的机械臂不断地将粗糙的金属工具敲打在坚硬的石壁上。 在他们之间站着一个小恶魔，身材矮小而瘦弱，穿着的衣服看起来更适合在茂密的森林里穿，而不是在山腹深处。他甚至背着一把弓，一条长长的猫尾巴从他的腰带下方垂下来，当他的傀儡们挖掘时，那条尾巴会兴奋地摆动着。 哐当！ 叮当！ 那个小恶魔男孩的猫耳微微一动，他便脚跟一转，转身面对着你。一根上面镶嵌着各种矿物石头的畸形铜钥匙，挂在他的脖子上，与那个巨大的猫铃挂在同一条项圈上。“我早就告诉过你，要找到下一处可开采的矿脉，至少需要几天的时间！他大喊着，朝你挥舞着拳头，”我不在乎你多么需要那些武器，但你不能急功近利。你——你又不是将军！ “指望别人来帮忙吗？” 那只猫妖露出得意的笑容，露出了獠牙。 是啊，但你肯定能做到的。有人告诉我，根据你的描述，肯定会有一个人带着某样珍贵的东西出现，而如果我能拿到它的话，这一切就都属于我！” 你眨了眨眼。这并不是你预想中的回答。 他从背后拔出弓，打了个响指，立刻吸引了身边那些魔像的注意。 他们停止了敲击隧道墙壁的动作，慢吞吞地走过来面对你。“我是奥伦，”那个恶魔说道，“那位地理法师，这个领域最顶尖的人物！而你现在必须把那些石头交给我！
rows.raw: " Clang! The sound of metal striking stone is deafening down here in the tunnels. The sound echoes like a war drum's beat, steady and powerful. Clang! Ahead of you, there's a long stretch of rough-hewn passage illuminated by fungal lanterns hung from hastily-erected support beams. A pair of huge, hulking shapes move at the end of the tunnel, their misshapen arms heaving rough metal picks into the hard stone. There's a demon standing between them, small and effete, wearing garb that would look more at home in the deep forests than the depths of the mountain. He's even got a bow across his back, and a long feline tail sprawls from just beneath his belt, swishing excitedly as his golems dig. Clang! Clang! The little demon-boy's cat-ears flick, and he whirls around on a heel to face you. A misshapen copper key studded with mineral stones hangs around his neck from the same collar as an oversized cat-bell. "It's going to take days to get to the next usable vein, I told you!" he yells, shaking his fist at you. "I don't care how much you need those weapons, you can't rush geomancy. You— you're not the general!" "Expecting somebody else?" The kitty-demon bares his fangs with a smug smirk. "Yeah, but you'll do. I was told somebody by your description would be coming down with something precious in tow, and that it was all mine if I could take it!" You blink. Not the answer you expected. He draws the bow off his back and snaps his fingers, drawing the attention of the golems at his side. They stop hammering the tunnel walls, lumbering around to face you. "I'm Auren," the demon says. "The Geomancer. Best in the business! And you're going to give me those stones!" "

rows.original: With a pained mewl, the cat-demon's strength gives out. His stone elementals — or at least, what remains of them — try to cushion his fall, but without him able to maintain their bindings all they manage is to collapse with him into a heap of [silly |coarse kitty litter |rubble and corrupted kitty ]. You snatch the key from around his neck as he falls. You have to appreciate the ludicrousness of the situation: [party.has calise |trained warriors |beastly wyvern-men ], demented cultists and ferocious demons rage all around you in a life-and-death struggle for the soul of Khor'minos, and here you have a rather pathetic kitten pinned down by the remains of his own summoned elementals. It'd be laughable in any other situation, but now... This little guy doesn't need to be here. He doesn't even want to be here. Demon or not, a rock nerd like this is fairly harmless; he's only here because the other demons promised him interesting geological oddities, which you know don't exist anywhere on the battlefield the mountain's turned into. [pc.isBimbo |What this cat-demon needs to be is far away from here, with a shiny rock collection, maybe some fish, and a large bowl of chilled milk. [pc.isDK |Yes, he's that pathetic. ]Probably why Tollus' demons needed to trick him onto the battlefield in the first place. ] As things stand, you could leave the cat-demon; he'll be mostly harmless until the battle's over, and then the Minoans can pick him up afterwards[katya.met| or maybe send him back to Katya or something, she'll sort him out]. On the other hand, this might be about the most pathetic demon you've ever run into, and you're including imps in that list. Not that much else can be expected of a scholar dedicated to his craft stuck on a battlefield, but you get the feeling that even prior to demonification this cat placed his rocks above even sex — a prime victim just waiting for [silly |a prime unit |someone ] to barge in and turn his existence upside-down. Everyone nearby[party.hasCompanions |, even [party.compNames], ] seems to be preoccupied with the battle at the moment...

rows.original:
"Kiyoko," you say. "Give him Keros's justice."
    
    The kitsune nods solemnly and approaches the fallen demon.
    
    He scrambles backwards. "Keros the trickster? What's justice to him, huh? A handjob and a pat on the head, right? Come on, I didn't do anything!"
    
    "Your work has been responsible for arming an invasion," Kiyoko says evenly. "And you never stopped to consider how much harm you were doing by proxy, did you? That would have been... inconvenient."
    
    "C-come on, somebody else woulda! I'm so close to a discovery that it's gotta be worth it, ri-"
    
    Kiyoko interrupts him with a flick of her wrist, and his body convulses as foxfire spreads inside and out. It's quick, at least, if gruesome.
    
    [party.has calise
        |Calise grimaces. "Was that really necessary?"
        |Varena sighs. "I don't feel good about that..."
    ]
    
    [party.has cait
        |"Oh, poor guy..." Cait laments. "I feel terrible."
    ]
    
    Kiyoko says a prayer in her native tongue over the body, at least, before folding her hands back into her robes. "Let us go, please."
rows.translation:
清子，”你说，“为他讨回克罗斯应得的正义。”

那只狐妖严肃地点了点头，然后走向倒地的恶魔。

那个恶魔慌忙向后退去：“那个诡计多端的克罗斯？对他来说，什么才算正义啊？不就是手部淫一下再拍拍头而已，对吧？ 拜托，我什么都没做啊！”

“正是你的工作导致了这次入侵的发生，”清子平静地说道，“而你从未停下来思考过，自己其实是在间接地造成多大的伤害，对吧？你本应该考虑到的。太不方便了……”

“拜托，换作别人也会这样吧！我距离发现真相已经这么近了，这肯定值得的，我……”

然而，清子只是轻轻一甩手部腕，他就突然全身抽搐起来，仿佛有狐火在他的体内肆意燃烧。 速度很快，至少是这样；不过过程可能相当残酷。

rows.original:
It takes you putting your back into it, and Varena's, but you're able to push the keep's doors open and peek your heads out into the cold mountain air. The wind howls from the peaks, blowing mist and snow down across the old stones. 
    
    Before you sprawls an ancient fort of piled stone, not too unlike the castle that looms over Hawkethorne — if a bit smaller — and in no better repair. Three walls lurch out from the mountainside, crumbling at their tops, and one of the two towers opposite the keep has collapsed in on itself completely. The other, though, is abuzz with demonic activity: you can see a thick cloud of imps whirling around the top, conjoining with a handful of true succubi and incubi in the air. 
    
    There's countless demons in the yard, too, fucking or squabbling for domination. A few play at soldier, clunking around in ramshackle armor and keeping the pretense of watch, while they watch the roil of bodies around them. Thankfully none of them have cottoned onto your presence yet. There's too many demons here for them to treat their own inner door opening as suspicious. 
    
    "If their leaders aren't in the keep here," you say, pointing upwards, "I'd bet they're at the top of that tower."
    
    "Yeah. Riding high over all their corrupted subjects," Varena says. 
    
    The princess bounces the runestone out of her cleavage and passes it to you. "Let's make sure they're nice and occupied for a while!" 
    
    You nod and curl your fingers around the stone, careful not to apply any pressure. If this doesn't work, you're giving up the element of surprise entirely. But then again, the moment you lose that without some kind of cover, the whole fort's coming down on your like a sack of bricks... and [var0|you know Livrea's a smart cookie with a hell of an archmage for a mom. This should work.|if Juno's half as clever as her daughter, this should work...]
    
    Taking a deep breath, you hurl the runestone into the midst of the demons writhing about in the courtyard, aiming for the pedestal of an old statue standing tall in the heart of their cavorting.
rows.translation:
你需要付出极大的努力，无论是你自己还是瓦雷娜，只有这样，你才能推开堡垒的大门，将头探出那寒冷的山间空气之中。风从山峰上呼啸而下，将雾气和积雪吹落在那些古老的石墙上。 
    
    在这座由堆叠的石块建造而成的古老堡垒面前，你不禁会联想到鹰棘镇山上那座巍峨的城堡——只不过规模要小一些，而且维护状况也差得多。三面城墙从山体上延伸而出，顶部已经开始崩塌；而位于主堡对面的两座塔楼中，有一座已经完全倒塌了。 然而，另一个地方却充满了恶魔的活动：你可以看到一大群小恶魔在顶部盘旋飞舞，还有一些真正的女妖和男妖也在空中聚集在一起。 
    
    院子里也有数不清的恶魔，它们要么在交配，要么在为争夺统治权而争斗。有些恶魔装作士兵的样子，穿着破旧的盔甲四处走动，假装在巡逻，其实只是在观察周围那些混乱的场景。幸运的是，它们还没有注意到你的存在。这里的恶魔实在太多了，它们根本不会把自家大门的突然打开当成可疑的事情。 
    
    如果他们的领导者不在这个堡垒里，”你指着上方说道，“我敢打赌他们一定在那座塔的顶端。”

“没错。高高坐在那些被腐蚀的子民之上，”瓦蕾娜说道。

公主把那块符文石从胸前弹出来，递给了你：“让我们确保他们有足够的时间忙个不停吧！ 
    
    你点了点头，用手指轻轻握住那块石头，小心翼翼地避免施加任何压力。如果这种方法不起作用，那就意味着你完全失去了出其不意的效果。不过话说回来，一旦你失去了这种优势，而又没有任何掩护，整个堡垒就会像一袋砖头一样压在你身上…… [var0|你知道，莉芙蕾娅可是个聪明的女孩，她的妈妈还是位了不起的大法师呢。这件事应该会成功的。|如果朱诺只有她女儿一半的聪明才智，这个办法应该就能奏效……]
    
    你深吸一口气，将那块符文石扔向院子里那些正在扭动挣扎的恶魔，目标正是他们聚集地中央那座古老雕像的基座。

rows.original: For a heartpounding moment, the world around you goes silent; your gaze raptly follows the arc of the stone through the air, until it finally impacts the chest of the bovine statue. And in that moment of collision, the chorus of moans and pleasure-cries from the demonic orgy before you is completely and utterly drowned out by the shrill screech of Livrea's mating call, so loud that it dislodges piles of snow all around the inner keep. The demons one and all pause in their debauchery, shocked out of their frenzy by the deafening racket. The canniest among them start searching for the source, shouting orders that can barely be heard. You take the opportunity to close the door, pulling it shut before anybody has the presence of mind to look for who might have cause the disturbance. Though in the end, you needn't have bothered. A few scant moments after the cries of a wyvern queen in heat start echoing through the mountainside, you begin hearing the much more bestial roars of males... a lot of males. You pick out dozens of voices responding to the call, beginning a furious descent to seek out the needy female you've conjured to their ears. The demons might've been in a rut themselves, but even they realize what's about to happen, and panicked screaming starts filling the air outside. [party.has cait |"I almost feel bad," Cait laughs. There's a dark edge to her voice, and you can see her fangs glinting in the light. "But these demons have it coming." ] [party.has arona |Arona hefts her weapon. "Damn sneaking shit, I want to wade in there! Think of the glory!" Even she's smart enough not to actually act on the impulse. ] [party.has atugia |Even demonic magic can't stand up to so many beasts like that..." Tui says with a quiet whistle. ] "Let's not waste this chance," Varena says. "C'mon. We've got to put a stop to those... that breeding program we heard inside." You nod. "Let's go."

    以你的能力，面对他们庞大的数量，你根本没有任何胜算，你的团队也会在瞬间被那些蠕动着的恶魔肉体所吞噬。
rows.raw:
"
    It takes you putting your back into it, and Varena's, but you're able to push the keep's doors open and peek your heads out into the cold mountain air. The wind howls from the peaks, blowing mist and snow down across the old stones. 
    
    Before you sprawls an ancient fort of piled stone, not too unlike the castle that looms over Hawkethorne — if a bit smaller — and in no better repair. Three walls lurch out from the mountainside, crumbling at their tops, and one of the two towers opposite the keep has collapsed in on itself completely. The other, though, is abuzz with demonic activity: you can see a thick cloud of imps whirling around the top, conjoining with a handful of true succubi and incubi in the air. 
    
    There's countless demons in the yard, too, and they're all looking right at you. Hundreds of true succubi and incubi, standing and staring. 
    
    "We forgot the mating call thing..." Varena says.
    
    "We forgot the mating call thing," you affirm, moments before countless corrupted bodies descend upon you. 
    
    Skilled as you are, you don't stand a chance against their sheer numbers all at once, and your party is buried under writhing demonic flesh in a matter of moments.
    "

rows.original: You tumble to the ground, equal parts literally and not-quite-literally petrified, wondering if either the cat-demon's earth elementals are going to finish the job, or if you're going to spend the rest of your existence as a museum display. What happens next is completely out of the blue: instead of moving to finish you off, he reaches down, grabs you by your [pc.armor] and starts rifling through your pockets. "Where're the rocks?" You blink. Rocks? "You have rocks! I know you have rocks, they told me so! Where are they? Don't tell me you made me go through the trouble of beating you up, and you don't have them?" Confused by this sudden turn of events, your mind reels until you remember who this is supposed to be. A geologist whose lifelong passion whose passion was everything to do with rocks, especially chilly ones — after being turned into a cat-demon, that hasn't changed in the slightest. For once, a demon's monomania may have saved you from an untimely end as a conversation piece: the cat-demon obviously rates rocks above sex, violence, or any number of unsavory things he could do to you. It was also clearly the only way Tollus' cultists could wrangle him into being somewhat useful, which is its own double-edged sword. [var0 |And as it so happens, you share his enthusiasm for rocks enough to have brought some with you into the battle for the city. Or maybe they're just good-luck charms, or perhaps you just forgot to replace them with actually useful items. Whatever the case, you gesture with stiff, heavy arms to where you keep your loose items. The cat-demon wastes no time pouncing upon your things and ransacking his way through them, eyes lighting up and ears perking as his fingers close on the rocks. "Oh, you have a good eye for oddities! Would you just look at this! A fine metamorphic specimen, formed within the mountain and later weathered on the cold slopes! Such porphyry! The size of the inner crystals set in fine-grained body —" As far as you can tell, it's just a semi-precious stone, but if it distracts the cat-demon enough for him to leave you alone, you're fine with that. The juxtaposition of his enthusiasm like a kitten with a new toy against the life-and-death struggle of the battle for the very soul of Khor'minos in the background isn't lost on you: at least from a distance the entire scene probably looks like yet another demon accosting a defeated foe, which is likely why no one from either side of the battle has given either of you a second glance. Better the rocks than you — the cat-demon wastes no time in pur[silly |r- ]loining any others you may have, still utterly entranced by his find. Gleefully, he picks up a rock and bites down like someone testing the purity of a gold coin — and looks pretty shocked himself when the rock shatters between his teeth like a dry biscuit. Still, that doesn't dampen his good mood any as he spits out the fragments and gushes over the rest of his find. "All that surveying! All that work! And it was in someone's pockets all along! Well, now that I have you, you're not leaving me until... until... you're not leaving me, that's for sure!" While the cat-demon's been distracted, [party.som |you've been slowly dragging yourself away |[party.compNames] has seized the opportunity to recover and slowly drag you away |[party.compNames] have seized the opportunity to recover and slowly drag you away ] — there isn't anywhere safe while the battle's going on, but a nearby alley provides a moment's respite while the cat-demon's curses wear off. With all his attention focused on the semi-precious stones, the cat-demon doesn't care in the slightest that you're removing yourself from the picture, and appears to have lost all inclination to give battle. That suits you just fine... |Unfortunately, you don't have any on you right now. Who in their right mind would lug around rocks in the midst of a raging battle when one could be carrying something more pertinent to a maelstrom of chaos? This doesn't dampen the cat-demon's single-mindedness in the slightest: if anything, it burns all the brighter as he outright strips you down in the vain hope of finding [silly |his precious |whatever he's looking for ]. From a distance, the entire scene probably looks like yet another demon accosting a defeated foe, which is likely why no one from either side of the battle has given either of you a second glance. For a moment, you wonder if he's going to take out his frustrations at not being able to find whatever it is he's looking for on you, but that doesn't happen: instead, the cat-demon balls his fists and caterwauls, his voice lost amidst the chaos of the raging battle. "You lied! You liars! The [pc.race] doesn't have the rocks!" And then a lot more grumpily, "screw all of you, I've had enough of this place. I'm going home, going fishing, maybe find a few good water-smoothed pebbles by the river. I'm done with this survey, you can take your contract and —" As improbable as it sounds, the cat-demon's monomania for his love is so compelling that it might just have spared you. Tail swishing as he mumbles to himself, he kicks a loose brick and wanders off through the battle, dreaming of fish, milk and chilly geological formations as his elementals trundle along in his wake. With the cat-demon out of the picture, [party.som |there's nothing stopping you from slowly dragging yourself away |[party.compNames] has seized the opportunity to recover and slowly drag you away |[party.compNames] have seized the opportunity to recover and slowly drag you away ] — there isn't anywhere safe while the battle's going on, but a nearby alley provides a moment's respite while his curses wear off. You should probably sit down and catch your breath before trying to press on... ]
rows.translation: 你重重摔在地上，无论是从字面上还是比喻意义上来说，都吓得魂不附体，心里都在想：是那只猫妖操控的地元素会把你彻底消灭，还是你会从此变成博物馆里的展品，度过余生。 接下来发生的事情完全出乎意料：它并没有继续攻击你，而是伸出手来，抓住了你的 [pc.armor] 然后开始翻你的口袋。 “石头在哪里？” 你眨了眨眼。石头？ “你肯定有石头的！我 知道 他们跟我说你很有实力！那些实力在哪里呢？别告诉我，让我费了那么大劲打败你，结果你 不要 让他们来吗？” 面对这种突如其来的变故，你一时有些茫然，直到你想起这个人究竟是谁——一个毕生热爱岩石的地质学家，尤其是那些冰冷坚硬的岩石；即使变成了猫妖，这种热爱也丝毫没有改变。 这一次，某个恶魔的固执性格反而让你免于过早遭遇不测——因为对于这个猫妖来说，石头显然比性、暴力，或是他可能对你做出的任何恶劣行为都更重要。显然，这也是托卢斯的信徒们能够让他暂时发挥一些作用的唯一办法，不过这也是一把双刃剑。 [var0 |巧的是，你也和他一样对那些石头充满热情，甚至带着它们参加了这场争夺城市的战斗。或者，也许这些石头只是用来祈求好运的吉祥物，又或者你只是忘记把它们换成真正有用的物品罢了。 无论如何，你都用僵硬而沉重的手臂指向自己存放零碎物品的地方。那只猫妖毫不迟疑地扑向你的东西，开始翻找起来，它的眼睛亮了起来，耳朵也竖了起来，手指紧紧地抓着那些石头。 哦，你真有发现奇特事物的眼光！快看这个吧！这是一块非常珍贵的变质岩标本，它是在山体内部形成的，后来又在寒冷的山坡上经历了风化作用！看看这些斑岩吧！内部晶体如此巨大，而整个岩石结构却非常细腻…… 从表面上看，它只不过是一块半宝石而已，但只要它能让那只猫妖分心，让它不再打扰你，那你也就没意见了。你肯定注意到了这样一个对比：它那像小猫得到新玩具一样兴奋的样子，与背景中为争夺科尔米诺斯灵魂而进行的生死搏斗形成了鲜明的反差——至少从远处看，这一幕很可能只是另一只恶魔在攻击一个被击败的敌人罢了，正因如此，战斗双方的任何人都没有多看你们一眼。 连石头都比你强——这只猫妖可不会浪费时间去喵喵叫。[silly |r- ]他抛开了手中可能持有的其他东西，依然完全被自己的发现所吸引。他高兴地捡起一块石头，像是在检测金币的纯度一样咬了下去——然而当石头在他牙齿间像干饼干一样碎裂开来时，他自己也显得十分震惊。 不过，这丝毫没有影响他的好心情。他一边把那些碎片捡起来，一边兴奋地谈论着自己找到的其他东西。 “花了那么多的时间进行调查！付出了那么多的努力！结果这些东西一直都在某个人的口袋里！好了，现在你终于在我手里了，你不会再离开我了吧。……直到你再也不离开我，这一点我绝对不会改变！” 趁着这只猫妖分心的时候， [party.som |你一直在慢慢地拖垮自己。 |[party.compNames] 抓住了机会进行恢复，然后慢慢地将你拉走。 |[party.compNames] 抓住了机会进行恢复，然后慢慢地将你拉走。 ] — 没有任何地方可以去了 安全 就在战斗正在进行的时候，附近的一条小巷却为你提供了片刻的喘息机会，让那些猫妖的诅咒暂时失效。由于那只猫妖的全部注意力都集中在那些半宝石上，它根本没有注意到你已经离开了战斗现场，而且看起来它也完全失去了继续战斗的兴趣。 这对你来说再合适不过了…… |不幸的是，你现在身上一个石头都没有。在一场激烈的战斗中，谁会傻乎乎地带着石头到处跑，而不是携带一些对这场混乱局势更有用的东西呢？ 然而，这丝毫没有减弱这只猫妖的执着：相反，它的决心反而更加坚定了。它直接把你脱得精光，就为了徒劳地寻找 [silly |他的珍爱之物 |无论他在寻找什么 ]从远处看，整个场景看起来就像是一只恶魔正在攻击一个已经被击败的敌人，因此战斗双方的任何人都没有多看你们一眼。 有那么一瞬间，你怀疑他是否会把找不到自己想要的东西而产生的愤怒发泄在你身上，但事实并没有发生：相反，那只猫妖只是握紧了拳头，发出尖锐的叫声，它的声音在激烈的战斗声中彻底消失了。 “你 撒了谎。你们这些骗子！真是的 [pc.race] 不 去你们的吧！”然后他又更加恼怒地补充道：“去你们的所有人，我受够了这个地方。我要回家去钓鱼，或许还能在河边找到一些光滑的鹅卵石。这次调查我彻底玩腻了，你们可以把那份合同拿走—— 虽然听起来有些不可思议，但那只猫妖对爱情的执着确实如此强烈，以至于它或许真的救了你一命。它摇着尾巴，自言自语地走着，踢着一块松动的砖块，穿过战场继续前行。它梦想着鱼、牛奶以及那些寒冷的地质构造，而它的元素生物则跟在它的身后缓缓移动。 既然那个猫妖已经被解决了， [party.som |没有什么能阻止你慢慢离开。 |[party.compNames] 抓住了机会进行恢复，然后慢慢地将你拉走。 |[party.compNames] 抓住了机会进行恢复，然后慢慢地将你拉走。 ] — 没有任何地方可以去了 安全 就在战斗正在进行的时候，附近的一条小巷却提供了一个暂时的休息场所，让他的咒骂声暂时停止。在你继续前进之前，最好先坐下来喘口气…… ]

rows.original: Your advance into the tower is interrupted by a swirl of darkness from above, dropping down from the tower's heights — and a rain of arrows precedes her, lighting the air with a hail of green flames upon their enchanted tips. You [pc.hasShield |get your shield up, covering yourself and [party.has calise |Calise |Varena ] from the barrage |dodge back, dragging [party.has calise |Calise |Varena ] with you before she's riddled with arrows. ] The shadow lands, coalescing into the form of [var0 |the Faceless Blade |a black-haired kitsune woman, tall and leanly muscled, wearing a skin-tight bodysuit reinforced with leather ]. She rises to her feet, surrounded by a blazing circle of burning arrows. "My lord has dictated that this tower is sacrosanct. None may pass beyond this point.[party.has calise | Even you, Dark Lady. ]" [party.has calise |"You again!" Calise snarls. "Bitch! I won't let you get away this time." "I invite you to try," the kitsune says evenly. "Come, then." ] [party.has varena |"Who the hell are you!?" Varena gasps. "You're not a demon." The kitsune snorts derisively. "Rare for a barbarian to say as much. Still, I cannot let you pass. And my master wishes for [pc.name] to be neutralized. You, however, should return to Lord Iavari." "Iavari!? He's in prison. I will be nobody's pawn." "You should have killed him when you had the chance." ] [party.has kiyoko|"Enough wasted words," Kiyoko says, fingers crackling with power. "She is faceless. Honor demands she meet her death here."] The assassin draws her bow.
rows.translation: 当你即将进入那座塔时，上方的暗影突然旋涡般向下袭来，从塔的高处坠落下来——紧接着，一阵箭雨迎面扑来，那些箭的箭头被施了魔法，箭尖上燃烧着绿色的火焰，划过空气，照亮了整个空间。你 [pc.hasShield |举起你的护盾，保护好自己。 [party.has calise |卡莉丝 |瓦雷纳 ] 在连续不断的攻击中 |向后闪避，同时拖着身体移动 [party.has calise |卡莉丝 |瓦雷纳 ] 在她被箭矢射中之前，我会陪在她身边。 ] 那些阴影之地，逐渐凝聚成了某种形态 [var0 |无面之刃 |一位黑发狐妖女子，身材高挑，肌肉线条分明，穿着一件用皮革加固的贴身连体衣。 ]她站了起来，周围环绕着一圈燃烧的箭矢。 “我的主人下令，这座塔是神圣不可侵犯的。任何人都不准越过这个界限。[party.has calise | 就连你也不例外，黑暗女士。 ]" [party.has calise |又是你！”卡莉丝怒吼道，“贱人！这次我绝不会让你逃掉。” “我倒想看看你能不能做到，”那只狐妖平静地说道，“那就来试试吧。 ] [party.has varena |你到底是谁！？”瓦蕾娜惊呼道，“你根本不是恶魔。” 那只狐妖冷笑道：“一个野蛮人也能说出这种话，真是难得。不过，我还是不能让你通过。而且我的主人也这么希望 [pc.name] 必须将其消灭。不过，你应该回到贾瓦里大人身边。” “贾瓦里！？他现在被关在监狱里。我 没有人你的棋子。” “你当时有机会的话，就应该杀掉他。 ] [party.has kiyoko|够了，不要再浪费口水了，”清子说道，她的手指因聚集的力量而发出噼啪声，“她毫无面目可言。荣誉要求她在这里死去。] 刺客拔出了她的弓。

rows.original:
[party.has calise
        |Calise knocks the kitsune's bow aside with a mighty swing of her axe, and then pivots on a heel, bringing the two-handed weapon around in a reaping arc that slams down into the assassin's collarbone, just missing her neck by an inch — but it's still a mortally deep stoke that brings the fox-woman to her knees. 
        
        "Yield," Calise says sharply. "Your life can still be saved, if [pc.name] is feeling merciful."
        |Varena throws up an arcane shield to deflect a final, desperate arrow from the assassin while you come in from the other side and grab her, wrestling her arms apart. "That's enough shooting from you!"
        
        The moment her guard's down, Varena steps in and cracks her staff over the kitsune's head, hard enough that it should well have been lights out. 
    ]
    
    [party.has kiyoko
        |Kiyoko takes a menacing step forward, eyes dark. "Enough with this false mercy. Accept your judgement, faceless."
    ]
    
    A ragged laugh escapes the raven-haired vixen's lips, accompanied by a drop of blood. "You... fools... you know not what... you do..." 
    
    Something slips from her hand. 
    
    You have just enough good sense to recoil and cover your eyes before you're deafened by a thunderous boom, and a flash of brilliant pink so bright you can see it like the sun through your own eyelids. rows.original:
An arrow strikes you squarely in the chest, barreling you backwards against the door. Another shot follows it up, pinning you bodily to the wood. Pain thunders through your body like a war drum, blasting apart cogent though and leaving you breathless and hollow.
    
    [party.has calise
        |"[pc.name]!" Calise screams, moving to cover you — only to take an arrow in the chest herself. She collapses onto a knee, barely keeping herself upright on her axe. "You bitch. I'll fucking kill you. I'll rip your fucking-"
        
        She's silenced by another arrow in the head.
    ]
    
    [party.has varena
        |Varena hoarsely cries "No!" while trying to throw up a magic shield around you. The spell barely has time to start on her lips before the Faceless Blade kicks her roundly in the stomach, knocking the wind out of her. 
    ]
    
    The assassin's attention turns to you. "At last. My master's vision will have no one left to oppose it. Goodbye, Champion. Tell your gods we are coming for them."
    
    She draws her bow again, and when her fingers loose the arrow, your world goes black forever.

rows.original: The chamber in front of you is dominated by a strategy table bearing a map of Khor'minos and the Undermountain, and dozens of small crystal figurines representing the movements of legions and demonic hordes. More chunks of pink crystal lie haphazardly across the surface, each one a discarded soul, glimmering with a faded inner light and yet used as nothing but paperweights. The towering purple warrior you saw at the underground docks is leaning over it while other succubi run around like headless chickens, abjectly terrified by the battle — to say nothing of your sudden appearance. A few of them leap from the windows, spreading their wings and tucking their tails rather than face you now, but not the purple behemoth. "So you're the one in charge here?" you say, advancing closer. The black-armored beast pushes up on her fists, staring at you with dark, hateful eyes. "And you're the one responsible for this chaos. So few of you, for all this damage. Color me impressed." "Name yourself, demon, and surrender!" Varena says, making a real effort not to sound as winded as she is. The tip of her staff crackles with lightning. The demon sneers. "You should be well familiar with my name, princess. I understand I have been made a hero in your kingdom." "[pc.dcb |The hell is that supposed to mean? |Explain yourself! |I... don't get it... ]" you say. "I am Calise of the Tilamac," the demon knight says, taking hold of the massive two-handed axe beside her and rising to her full, towering height. She is a mountain of muscle barely contained by her flame-blackened, battle-scarred armor. Varena's eyes go wide, and even for all her courage, she takes a step back in the shadow of the demonic general. "Champion of Velun! The wrath of nature made manifest!" The succubus takes a step towards you around the table. "Or I was, until my name was stolen by that bitch-queen, along with my soul." [var0 |"So you're the real one!" Varena gasps. "I'm so sorry." "I don't need your pity, northern whore," the demon spits. "You both are the ones who've been played by that vile creature from the start." |Varena sucks in a sharp breath, clutching her staff hard. "Bitch queen... our Calise's not just any demon, is she? Gods, right under our noses this whole time!" "Oh, yes," the charred warrior sneers. "She's been playing both sides from the start." |"You... you're..." Varena gasps, looking between you and the demon. "Oh, gods. I knew we couldn't trust that bitch!" [calise.hdk |Your thoughts swirl. No, that can't be right... whether or not you trusted Calise, that she's not just a demon but the demon queen? Gods protect you[calise.fucked |, you had sex with her! |. ] |You knew Calise was a demon in disguise, but that demon, Kasyrra? Gods protect you[calise.fucked |, you had sex with her! |. ] |This is... not how you would have wanted Varena to find out about that, and so you try your best to look surprised too. ] The demonic warrior sneers at you both. "Oh, yes. She's been playing both sides from the start." ] Varena's knuckles whiten around her staff. "You're awfully loose-lipped for a general. This would be a lot easier for everyone if you surrendered, and told the court what you've just told us. If there's anything left of the Champion you were-" "No," the demon says. "You're a unique opportunity for me. A chance to meet my end gloriously." [flags.WHFORT_FBLADE |From the shadows, the raven-haired kitsune slips into view, drawing a glitteringly-silvered curved blade from her hip. The tip of the blade crackles with lightning, while the general hefts her axe up in both hands. "Enough talk," the bladeswoman says softly. "Victory or death." "To the death," the general snarls. |"It doesn't have to be this way," Varena says. "Please, you were a paladin. It's not too late." "It is far too late, princess. Now... to the death!" ]

More chunks of pink crystal lie haphazardly across the surface, each one a discarded soul, glimmering with a faded inner light and yet used as nothing but paperweights. The towering purple warrior you saw at the underground docks is leaning over it while other succubi run around like headless chickens, abjectly terrified by the battle — to say nothing of your sudden appearance. A few of them leap from the windows, spreading their wings and tucking their tails rather than face you now, but not the purple behemoth. "So you're the one in charge here?" you say, advancing closer. The black-armored beast pushes up on her fists, staring at you with dark, hateful eyes. "And you're the one responsible for this chaos. So few of you, for all this damage. Color me impressed." "Name yourself, demon, and surrender!" Varena says, making a real effort not to sound as winded as she is. The tip of her staff crackles with lightning. The demon sneers. "You should be well familiar with my name, princess. I understand I have been made a hero in your kingdom." "[pc.dcb |The hell is that supposed to mean? |Explain yourself! |I... don't get it... ]" you say. "I am Calise of the Tilamac," the demon knight says, taking hold of the massive two-handed axe beside her and rising to her full, towering height. She is a mountain of muscle barely contained by her flame-blackened, battle-scarred armor. Varena's eyes go wide, and even for all her courage, she takes a step back in the shadow of the demonic general. "Champion of Velun! The wrath of nature made manifest!" The succubus takes a step towards you around the table. "Or I was, until my name was stolen by that bitch-queen, along with my soul." [var0 |"So you're the real one!" Varena gasps. "I'm so sorry." "I don't need your pity, northern whore," the demon spits. "You both are the ones who've been played by that vile creature from the start." |Varena sucks in a sharp breath, clutching her staff hard. "Bitch queen... our Calise's not just any demon, is she? Gods, right under our noses this whole time!" "Oh, yes," the charred warrior sneers. "She's been playing both sides from the start." |"You... you're..." Varena gasps, looking between you and the demon. "Oh, gods. I knew we couldn't trust that bitch!" [calise.hdk |Your thoughts swirl. No, that can't be right... whether or not you trusted Calise, that she's not just a demon but the demon queen? Gods protect you[calise.fucked |, you had sex with her! |. ] |You knew Calise was a demon in disguise, but that demon, Kasyrra? Gods protect you[calise.fucked |, you had sex with her! |. ] |This is... not how you would have wanted Varena to find out about that, and so you try your best to look surprised too. ] The demonic warrior sneers at you both. "Oh, yes. She's been playing both sides from the start." ] Varena's knuckles whiten around her staff. "You're awfully loose-lipped for a general. This would be a lot easier for everyone if you surrendered, and told the court what you've just told us. If there's anything left of the Champion you were-" "No," the demon says. "You're a unique opportunity for me. A chance to meet my end gloriously." [flags.WHFORT_FBLADE |From the shadows, the raven-haired kitsune slips into view, drawing a glitteringly-silvered curved blade from her hip. The tip of the blade crackles with lightning, while the general hefts her axe up in both hands. "Enough talk," the bladeswoman says softly. "Victory or death." "To the death," the general snarls. |"It doesn't have to be this way," Varena says. "Please, you were a paladin. It's not too late." "It is far too late, princess. Now... to the death!" ] '

rows.original: The Blood Knight roars with rage, barely able to keep herself from falling on her face with both hands braced on the strategy table. "Why!? Demonhood is supposed to bring power, but I have never been weaker! Curse that red fucking bitch!" She pounds the table, hard enough to crack it straight down the middle. Your attention shifts to the Faceless Blade, now on her knees by the table's side. Pink soul-stones fall around her. Her sword hangs limply in her hand, and her breath is coming so heavy that it further rips her tattered bodysuit. "Drop it," you command, stepping closer. Your weapon slaps hers, but the fox's grip tightens rather than yielding, and she wards you off with the tip of the blade. [party.has kiyoko |"Allow me the honor, beloved," Kiyoko says, her voice uncharacteristically hard-edged. "She's no demon," Varena says, putting a hand on Kiyoko's arm — which is quickly brushed aside. "I don't know what she did to you, miss, but she's no demon. She deserves a trial for what she's done." | "Will you both please yield?" Varena pleads. "It's not too late to help us save Khor'minos from the traitor Calise." ] "I chose... dishonor before death... once before," the Faceless Blade pants, pulling down her facemask. "Never again. Even if it costs me my soul. I will be a false god's pawn no longer!" She grabs a handful of the glittering soulstones and crams them into her mouth.
rows.translation: 血骑士愤怒地咆哮着，双手部撑在战略桌上，几乎无法控制自己不摔倒在地。“为什么！？成为恶魔应该是为了获得 力量但我从来没有这么虚弱过！去他妈的那个该死的红衣女人！” 她用力敲打桌子，力度之大以至于桌子直接被敲裂成了两半。 此时，你的注意力被那把“无面之刃”吸引了——它此刻正放在她的膝盖上，就在桌子的旁边。 粉红色的灵魂之石在她周围纷纷坠落。她的剑无力地悬挂在手部中，呼吸变得如此急促，以至于进一步撕裂了她那破烂的身体套装。 “放下它，”你命令道，同时向前迈了一步。你的武器与她的剑相撞，但那只狐狸紧握着剑刃，丝毫没有松手部的意思，她用剑尖挡开了你的攻击。 [party.has kiyoko |请允许我这个荣幸，亲爱的，”清子说道，她的声音异常地严厉。 “她不是恶魔，”瓦蕾娜说着，伸手想要触碰清子的手臂，但清子迅速将她的手拨开了。“我不知道她对你做了什么，小姐，但她确实不是恶魔。她应该为自己所做的事情接受审判。 | 你们俩能不能让一下？”瓦蕾娜恳求道，“现在还来得及，我们一起帮助科尔米诺斯摆脱叛徒卡莉丝的掌控。 ] 我曾经选择过……死不屈辱……”无面之刃低声说道，同时拉下了自己的面罩。“再也不会了。即使这意味着我要付出灵魂的代价。我不会再成为某个虚假之神的棋子了！” 她抓起一把闪闪发光的灵魂石，将它们全部塞进了嘴里。

rows.original: You lunge for the Blade's neck to try and stop her, but a wind-swift slice from her sword drives you away while she swallows. The pain of it's clear in her bloodshot eyes, but that is a mere prelude before every muscle in her body strains uncontrollably, sending her into spasms. Roseate strands of lightning arc across her skin, from her eyes to the tips of her tails. The scream she makes could curdle milk and shatter glass. You recoil, covering your ears as whatever supernal power the Blade's infused herself with consumes her inch by inch in soulfire. Her hair and fur burns the same pink as the stones, standing on end; whatever power has been unleashed drags the kitsune to her feet, too, so quickly that the sword in her hand shatters against the table — but its constituent parts are dragged back together by the magic, reforged in a roiling storm of iron and energy. "What... what did she do..." Varena gasps. "Is she a demon after all?" "No," you say. "Something [pc.dcb|new... Let's see what she does.|else, now. Stay back!|weird and freaky and new. Be careful!]" The Blade takes a staggering step forward, tongue lolling from her mouth. It unfurls almost a foot down her chest, as pink as her fur, framed by long, dagger-sharp incisors. "More..." Her voice is a rasp, wheezing through the pain. "I need... more." Finally, she looks you dead in the eyes. "More souls." She lunges for you like a wild animal, a feral scream in her throat.
rows.translation: 你冲向那把刀的刀柄，试图阻止她，但她用剑猛地一挥，将你击退，同时将那东西吞了下去。她那布满血丝的眼睛中明显流露出痛苦，但这一切，仅仅只是一个开始罢了 每个 她体内的肌肉不受控制地抽搐着，导致她全身陷入痉挛。玫瑰色的闪电从她的眼睛一直延伸到尾巴的尖端，在她皮肤上划出一道道光芒。 她发出的尖叫声足以让牛奶凝固、玻璃碎裂。你吓得连连后退，捂住耳朵——因为那把剑所蕴含的超自然力量正在一点一点地将她的灵魂吞噬殆尽。 她的头发和毛发都燃烧成了与那些石头相同的粉红色，全都竖了起来；无论是什么力量被释放了出来，它也立刻将那只狐妖拽到了地面，速度快得让她手中的剑狠狠地撞在桌子上——但剑的各个部件又被魔法重新凝聚在一起，在一阵翻腾的铁与能量的风暴中重新锻造成了剑。 她……她做了什么……”瓦蕾娜惊呼道，“她难道真的是个恶魔吗？” “不，”你回答道，“只是有些事情而已。 [pc.dcb|新……让我们看看她会做出什么来。|否则，现在就行动吧。退后！|奇怪、诡异又新颖。小心点！]那把利刃向前迈出了惊人的一步，她的舌头从口中垂了出来。那把利刃几乎延伸了一英尺，它的颜色与她的毛皮一样粉红，边缘镶嵌着长长的、锋利如匕首的獠牙。 “再给我……”她的声音嘶哑而喘息，显然是在忍受着巨大的痛苦。“我需要……更多。” 最终，她直视着你的眼睛说道：“更多的灵魂。” 她像一只野兽一样向你扑来，喉咙里发出凄厉的尖叫。

rows.original:
The duo's assault proves overpowering, and you're thrown back against the strategy table like so much detritus. A huge, strong hand grabs [pc.hasHair|your hair|the back of your head] and yanks you backwards, baring your neck. 

	The kitsune assassin slinks into view, her blade raised. "You have been a thorn in my master's side too long, Champion. It is time his plans were set back on the path to victory. Die, so that his new future may blossom."
	
	You never have a chance to wonder what that future might be.
rows.translation:
这两人联手的攻击力实在强大，你就像一堆残渣一样被猛地推倒在战略棋盘前。一只巨大而有力的手抓住了你 [pc.hasHair|你的头发|后脑勺] 然后猛地将你向后拉，迫使你暴露脖子。

那只狐妖刺客悄然现身，手中的刀刃已经高高举起。“冠军，你太长时间以来一直是我主人的眼中钉了。是时候让他的计划再次偏离胜利的道路了。去死吧，这样他新的未来才能得以实现。”

你根本没有任何机会去想象那个未来会是什么样子。

The pain of it's clear in her bloodshot eyes, but that is a mere prelude before every muscle in her body strains uncontrollably, sending her into spasms. Roseate strands of lightning arc across her skin, from her eyes to the tips of her tails. The scream she makes could curdle milk and shatter glass. You recoil, covering your ears as whatever supernal power the Blade's infused herself with consumes her inch by inch in soulfire. Her hair and fur burns the same pink as the stones, standing on end; whatever power has been unleashed drags the kitsune to her feet, too, so quickly that the sword in her hand shatters against the table — but its constituent parts are dragged back together by the magic, reforged in a roiling storm of iron and energy. "What... what did she do..." Varena gasps. "Is she a demon after all?" "No," you say. "Something [pc.dcb |new... Let's see what she does. |else, now. Stay back! |weird and freaky and new. Be careful! ]" The Blade takes a staggering step forward, tongue lolling from her mouth. It unfurls almost a foot down her chest, as pink as her fur, framed by long, dagger-sharp incisors. "More..." Her voice is a rasp, wheezing through the pain. "I need... more." Finally, she looks you dead in the eyes. "More souls." She lunges for you like a wild animal, a feral scream in her throat. '

rows.original: The corrupted kitsune barrels into you like a wolverine, snarling and gnashing her teeth. Her fangs rip into you, barreling you to the ground with her unholy strength. You scream and struggle, but only for a few seconds before the last of your own strength leaves your body, and you're left watching through dimming eyes as the creature overtop you tries to get at your soul with tooth and claw.
rows.translation: 那只被腐蚀的狐妖像狼獾一样扑向你，发出凶狠的咆哮，牙齿狠狠地咬住你。它的獠牙刺入你的身体，用它那邪恶的力量将你重重摔在地上。你尖叫着挣扎，但仅仅几秒钟后，你所有的力气就都被耗尽了。在视线逐渐模糊之中，你只能眼睁睁地看着这个怪物压在你身上，用牙齿和爪子试图吞噬你的灵魂。

        |You outlast the kitsune-turned-monster, refusing to yield in the face of her beastly onslaught until the magic propping her up finally loses its hold on her body. She crumples like a puppet with its strings cut, blood rushing from eyes and mouth. Her hand finally legs go of her crackling blade, and you're quick to kick it away from her. 
        
        "Marae's tits," Kasyrra says, only slowly relaxing her grip on her poleaxe. "She made herself into a real monster, didn't she?"
        
        "Well she's down now," you say, watching the last resistance bleed out from the kitsune at your feet. She's still breathing. But the mutations aren't going away, still ravaging her body — you can see her muscles writhe beneath her skin, and saliva drools from her enlarged fangs. 
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |"First a Faceless," Kiyoko says, "and now a monster outside as well as in. You have escaped justice long enough, traitor. May your soul find salvation, for there is none left in this life for you."
            
            Your vixen clenches her fist as she incants a spell. The fire blazing inside the Faceless Blade flares into a momentary, all-consuming inferno, blazing so brightly that it hurts the eyes. Even when you close yours, there's a pink haze that dances in your vision for several seconds.
            
            When you open them again, there's naught but ashes and the scent of charred fur.
            
            Kiyoko smooths her robe and relaxes her hands. She glances towards Kasyrra, curling her nose up at the demoness's shocked expression. "Do not pretend you care about her life. The law of our people demanded her death. She was a murderer who used her god-given gifts for evil. Do not mourn her."
            
            "Didn't plan to," Kasyrra says. "Though I see justice is a bit more brutal in this world than I expected..."
            
            "Justice is protecting the world from her depredations," Kiyoko says, regarding the two demons left in the room with cold eyes. "She would only escape to kill again. [pc.name] might have been next."
            
            "Okaaaaay. You're of a kin with her, fox. What happened to her?"
            
            "A reaction between the Oversoul and the soul-stones she consumed, perhaps. We kitsune are touched to our very being by Keros; to desecrate that divine connection with demonic corruption did not sever her soulbinding like she expected, but supercharged it, and overwhelmed her body with power. At least, that would be my suspicion."
            
            [pc.isGodsworn
                |Kasyrra looks between you and the pile of ashes with growing alarm. "Oh. Oh no..."
                
                Her fists tighten, and her breath quickens. "You bloody fool, [pc.name]. You damned, bloody fool. Is this what you've done to yourself? I never thought... I never imagined it was this bad. That you could be such a monster on the inside."
                
                Big words coming from a demon! The irony is clearly lost on her in her rising rage. The Demon Queen whirls around to face you, her disguise melting away into crimson flesh and sweeping horns. Her hair turns black, and her four wings spread from behind her, shredding the back of her tunic. 
                
                [party.has cait
                    |"Oh... shit," Cait whimpers.
                ]
                
                You take a step back, lifting your weapon defensively.

                "To keep it away from you, for one thing," you say.

                Her fist tightens hard enough to shatter the haft of her poleaxe. The pieces fall away to either side of her as she turns towards the window. "Fuck you, and fuck this city. To hell with all you accursed mortals!" She leaps into the air, spreading her wings. "If I see you again, [pc.name], I'll crush you. Stay out of my way!"
                
                From below, you hear the shouts of your soldiers; cheers of victory turn to confusion and panic as the Demon Queen herself swoops across the field — but she does not engage them, only flies past them and over the eastern mountaintops. Once she's certifiably giving your army her tail, another round of cheers rise up from the men below you. 
                
                "They think you defeated her," Kiyoko muses, peering over the edge of the tower. "They are not wrong, either. You have foiled her plans to their core, it seems, beloved. I am sure Keros is most pleased to see her [silly

rows.translation:
[party.has calise
        |你成功战胜了那头由狐妖变成的怪物，在它发起的疯狂攻击面前始终没有屈服，直到支撑它的魔法力量最终彻底失去了控制。她就像一根线被剪断的木偶一样瘫软下来，鲜血从她的眼睛和口中喷涌而出。 她的手终于松开了那把发出咔嚓声的刀刃，而你迅速将刀踢开了。

“玛拉埃真是太厉害了，”卡希拉说道，同时慢慢放开了对那把长柄斧的握力，“她把自己变成了一个真正的怪物，不是吗？好吧，她现在已经倒下了，”你边说边看着脚边的那只狐狸体内最后的抵抗力量逐渐消失。它还在呼吸，但那些突变并没有停止，仍在摧残它的身体——你可以看到它的肌肉在皮肤下不停地抽搐，唾液也从它那变长的獠牙中滴下来。 
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |先是‘无面者’，现在又是外面有怪物，里面也有怪物。叛徒，你逃过正义的制裁已经太久了。但愿你的灵魂能得到救赎——因为在这个世界上，你已经没有任何机会了。”

那个恶毒的女人握紧拳头，开始念咒语。 无面之刃内部燃烧的火焰瞬间化作了一场吞噬一切的烈焰，光芒如此耀眼，以至于会刺痛双眼。即使你闭上眼睛，那种粉红色的光晕也会在你的视野中持续闪烁数秒。
            
            当你再次打开它们时，里面只剩下灰烬以及烧焦的毛发的气味。

清子整理好自己的长袍，放松双手，然后瞥了瞥卡希拉——看到这位女恶魔那震惊的表情，她不禁皱起了鼻子。 别装作你在乎她的性命。我们族人的法律要求她死。她是个杀人犯，利用上天赋予她的能力去做坏事。不要为她哀悼。”

“我本来也没打算哀悼她，”卡希拉说道，“不过看来这个世界的正义比我想象中要残酷得多。正义正在保护世界，让它免受那些恶魔的侵害，”清子冷冷地注视着房间里剩下的那两个恶魔说道，“如果让她逃脱，她只会再去杀人。 [pc.name] 下一个可能就是你了。”

“好吧……你和她有某种关联，狐妖。她发生了什么事？”

“可能是她的‘灵魂之石’与她的‘超灵魂’发生了某种反应吧。我们狐族与‘凯罗斯’有着紧密的联系；当这种神圣的联系被恶魔的力量破坏时，她的灵魂束缚并没有像她预想的那样被切断，反而被强化了，大量的力量冲破了她的身体……至少，我是这么怀疑的。
            
            [pc.isGodsworn
                |卡希拉焦急地望着你，又看向那堆灰烬，脸上逐渐露出惊恐的神情。“哦……不……”

她的拳头紧握起来，呼吸也变得急促起来。“你这个该死的傻瓜 [pc.name]你这个该死的蠢货！这就是你对自己造成的伤害吗？我从来没想过……我完全无法想象情况会这么糟糕。原来你内心竟藏着这样的恶魔。”

这些话出自一个恶魔之口，真是具有讽刺意味。在她的愤怒中，这种讽刺显然已经被完全忽略了。恶魔女王转过身来面对你，她的伪装瞬间消失，露出了猩红色的肌肤和尖锐的角。她的头发变成了黑色，四只翅膀从背后展开，撕裂了她的外袍。 
                
                [party.has cait
                    |哦……糟了，”凯特哀叹道。
                ]
                
                你后退一步，举起了武器以防御姿态应对。

“你毁掉了我所有的计划，不是吗？还毁掉了你的灵魂，但这一切都是为了什么呢？”

“至少，是为了让它远离你，”你说道。

卡希拉发出了愤怒的咆哮。 [kasyrra.romantic
                    |我信任你！你难道没有明白我真正需要你做什么，为什么需要你的‘灵魂’吗？我向你倾诉了自己的心事，结果……结果却更加愚蠢地让自己陷入了困境。 
                    |"
                ]你现在也和我一样，是个没有灵魂的怪物，对吧？”

她的拳头握得如此用力，以至于连那根战斧的柄都快被捏碎了。碎片散落在她的身两侧，她转身走向窗户，怒吼道：“去你的，还有这个该死的城市！所有这些该受诅咒的凡人，都该下地狱！”她纵身跃向空中，展开了双翼。“如果我再见到你 [pc.name]我会把你碾得粉碎的！别挡我的路！”

从下方，你可以听到士兵们的呐喊声；原本洋溢着胜利喜悦的欢呼声，却在恶魔女王亲自飞掠战场的瞬间变成了混乱与恐慌——但她并没有与他们交战，只是从他们身边飞过，然后越过了东边的群山。 当她明显地开始逃窜、不再抗性你的军队时，下方的士兵们再次爆发出欢呼声。

“他们以为你打败她了，”清子边说边从塔顶往下望去，“他们也没有错。 亲爱的，看来你已经彻底破坏了她的计划。我敢肯定，凯罗斯看到这一幕一定会非常高兴的。 [silly

她的拳头握得如此用力，以至于连手部中的战斧柄都几乎被捏碎了。碎片散落在她的身两侧，而她则转身朝着窗户走去。“去你的，还有这个该死的城市。所有这些该受诅咒的凡人，都该下地狱！”她纵身跃向空中，展开了双翼。“如果我再见到你 [pc.name]我会把你碾得粉碎的！别挡我的路！”

从下方，你可以听到士兵们的呐喊声；原本充满胜利喜悦的欢呼声，却在恶魔女王亲自飞掠战场时变成了混乱与恐慌——但她并没有与他们交战，只是从他们身边飞过，然后飞向了东边的山脉。 当她明显开始拼命讨好你的军队时，下方的士兵们再次爆发出一阵欢呼声。

而在你身后，真正的卡莉丝——那位血骑士——发出了呻吟声：“是啊，去他的吧。现在赶紧杀了我吧，好吗？ 我非得往维伦的眼睛里吐口水不可。
                |是啊，去他们的吧，”卡莉丝呻吟道，“快点杀了我吧，行不行？我得往维伦的眼睛里吐口水。
            ]
            
            卡莉丝靠在墙上坐了起来，从某个地方拿出一支冬日烟卷，深深地吸了一口。她的目光缓缓地移到你身上，那充满恨意的目光已经消退了。你无法想象在看到“利刃”的表现后，她正在想些什么，但现在她似乎已经接受了自己的命运，只是静静地抽着烟，似乎对此感到满足。
