Now keep that chin up, we've got to get out of here, and I feel like we've got a long road ahead of us." |When you return to Viviane, she's dusting off her hat [viviane.isDemon |and idly cleaning off her nails with each other. "Oh. Are you finally done? That took way longer than it ought to have, not that it's a surprise with how weepy that bimbo's gotten." Yes. You're getting the impression that she's less than impressed with what's happened. "Oh, of course. What a terrible and absolute waste that was, even if I understand that ingratiating ourselves to the elves who want to eventually resettle the locale is more important. But it'd have been a great opportunity to find out if fey creatures like that have souls, or if they're just big blobs of magic. There's painfully little established literature on the matter of dryads, you understand — I'm sure a good fucking or two would've been all that was needed for that poor thing to cum out any soul that she might've had. "But choices are rarely good in all aspects, and you really just have to pick what aligns the most with your interests, aren't I right?" ...Right. | and looking tight-lipped. "Did everything go well?" As well as it might've been. "It looked fairly painless." She sighs, and plops back her hat on her head. "You probably ought to see to your elven friends later. They appear pretty shaken up by the whole thing. I know that you did what you thought was best given the circumstances, but this is the kind of thing which shakes morale pretty badly. I know you'll handle it well, though." It's nice to have someone who has such confidence in you. "Hey, I wouldn't have followed you on this expedition if you weren't worthy of it, right?" ] |"It never gets old," Agni says with a sigh, wiping her brow. "Even after having died myself over and over again, it never feels good making that kind of deliberate choice to end someone." And it shouldn't. You're glad she feels that way even if she weren't the one to make the decision, or the one to carry it out. The stereotype in stories about ancient people like her is that they're all jaded out the ears, but having Agni like this and willing to say it makes a whole lot of difference. She says nothing at first, but glances over at Elthara, who's comforting Ryn, then back to you. "Yeah. Sure, we both know that it was the best course of action knowing that she was likely unsavable... but the fact that you didn't do it unthinkingly is what's important. Thanks, [pc.name]." No, you're the one who ought to thank her for this vote of confidence in you. "They're getting ahead — I think we should catch up, lest the party winds up split." ] With the grim deed done, the air's a little more breathable, and there's no risk that the corrupted dryad grove will pose any further threat to you while you're busy elsewhere. Time to move on...
rows.translation: 你艰难地咽了口唾沫，带着瑞恩离开小树林，在桥边等待，然后招手部让埃尔萨拉也过来，一起前往兰尼尔的树下。自从你第一次遇见瑞恩以来，她已经成长了许多，但这些决定她并不需要亲自去面对。 还没有。 女祭司向你投来一个意味深长的眼神，两人静静地注视着兰尼埃——那个无助的干尸，在你们注视的目光下不断扭动身体。仅仅因为你们距离如此之近，这种压力就已经足以让她全身因无法满足的渴望而颤抖起来。随着一声轻柔的呻吟，那干尸突然向上跃起，将一大股带有麝香气味的液体喷洒在泥土上。 你以为这样就能证明你的观点是正确的吗？埃尔萨拉应该还记得被钉在祭坛上的那种感觉吧？如果你的计算没有出错的话，这位树精已经处于这种状态超过两个世纪了。 “她已经无药可救了，对吧？ 埃尔萨拉提出这个问题的方式其实暗示着她已经知道了答案，尽管这个答案可能令人难以接受。虽然你不能完全排除某种奇迹发生的可能性，但你现在既没有时间也没有资源去判断哪种奇迹才适合在这种情况下发生，更何况她的情况或许还没有那么糟糕。埃尔萨拉刚打算把手部放在那名过度性欲旺盛的精灵的额头上，却突然看到那家伙的阴囊中又喷出了大量香气扑鼻的精液，每一滴都足有甜瓜那么大。 那么……我们该怎么做呢？ [var0 |根据你在旅途中遇到的其他树精们的说法，它们其实就是其所栖息树木的精灵。只要将那些树木毁掉，它们就应该就会消失。 |嗯，既然那棵树似乎是干尸的来源，那么摧毁它应该就能解决问题，对吧？ ] 那看来就只能由我来做了。” 你留在这里，确保兰尼尔的离世过程尽可能没有痛苦。你回头确认瑞恩仍然背对着即将发生的那一幕，然后向埃尔萨拉点了点头，示意她继续行动。 女祭司闭上了眼睛，握紧了拳头，然后朝着那棵树走去。 “如果……如果我也变成了这样的一个人，我不确定自己是否还会继续坚持下去。” 不……幸运的是，事实并非如此。 用贝尔哈兰人的说法来说，埃尔萨拉是莱恩身边一位非常值得信赖的助手部。然而，她内心也有着属于自己的渴望——当心情好的时候，她也很乐意享受马拉赫与卢米娅带来的祝福。要不是她的女神及时出手部，让她在危难时刻得到了救援，她恐怕早就…… 埃尔萨拉没有说任何话，只是抬头望着那棵正在颤抖的真菌树，伸出双手部向它喷射出白色的火焰。它的巨口无声地张开，喷出了几阵闪闪发光的蓝色孢子，但由于它的许多根茎和树枝已经被切断或严重受损，因此它已经无法再有效地进行抗性了。 拼命地尝试着去做某件事， 任何东西那棵被腐蚀的干树发出嘶嘶声，伴随着刺鼻的真菌气味，不断爆裂。 如果你身边的干树精灵因为她的树被毁而感到任何痛苦，她其实并没有感觉到——或者也许，她的腐蚀已经侵蚀了她的一切，使得她再也无法感受到其他任何感觉了。 当你轻抚她的额头，低声安慰她时，她轻轻地呜咽着、呻吟着；而埃尔萨拉则面无表情地继续着她的工作。 就在最后那一刻，兰尼尔的腐化开始随着她的身体一同消退，那干尸般的身躯重新恢复了正常的比例，她皮肤上那种病态的甜腻光泽也消失了。 在最后的那些时刻，出现在你面前的，是一位身形苗条、没有阴茎的树精。她的眼神中充满感激，用你听不懂但依然能理解的博尔阿尔瓦林语低声说了几句话。 就这样，她消失了，化作了一阵蓝色的火花消散在了空气中。 埃尔萨拉望着那棵树剩下的焦黑树桩，又看了看那些枯萎的干尸树丛，然后低下了头。 “我们走吧。 [pc.name]她的声音有些颤抖，显然她在极力忍住泪水不让自己哭出来。 [etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政王夫人 ] 正在等待我们。 [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran kiyoko atugia quintillus viviane agnimitra |那真是……”凯特把耳朵贴在身体两侧，然后从口袋里掏出一块手帕。 [cait.armor] 她抽着鼻子，把鼻涕弄得一团糟。“真希望我们能帮她更多。虽然我们只认识了她短短几分钟，但发生的事情实在太令人难过了。” 在这种情况下，你已经尽力了；你还是必须活着离开这个地方。 “我知道。即便如此……”凯特最后回头看了一眼那具正在燃烧的肉质真菌混合体残骸，“你们都看到了她遭遇了什么。我想她现在应该已经安息了吧。我们能做的，也只有这样期待了。 |哦，”布林特低声说道，“我……” 他在哭吗？ 他朝你微微一笑：“只是有些孢子进入了我的眼睛，而已。虽然它们没能对我产生什么影响，但还是让人觉得特别痒。是的，你懂我的意思。 “有时候你会在论坛上听到这样的故事：一些退伍军人退役后无事可做，就只能坐在论坛里讲这些故事。 我想我现在对他们有了更深的理解了。 |哦，”布蕾妮轻声说道，“我……” 她在哭，对吧？ 当布蕾妮除了抽泣之外没有其他回应时，你就上前紧紧地抱住她。这类举动并不总是那么美好，但它们能让你时刻记住自己正在为什么而奋斗。 “我不太确定。我在为……而奋斗。 你, [pc.name]如果你认为这很重要，那么它确实很重要。” 好姑娘。 |阿罗娜在桥上等着你，双臂交叉，同时也在注视着莱恩。“终于来了，你花了太长时间了。” 你确实需要确保一切都做得恰到好处，不过，没错，那棵树以及那片树林已经不复存在了。 “好吧，那我们走吧。没必要为此感到难过。 她似乎对事情的发展结果并不满意。 “那简直是一种可悲的死亡，”阿罗娜愤恨地说道，“那种死亡发生在一个人病得太重或年纪太大，已经无力做任何事情，只能躺在草床上呻吟，因为身体已经不再听使唤的时候。那绝对是世界上最糟糕的死亡方式——那种需要别人来结束你的生命，因为你自己已经没有力气去结束它。而我，绝对不会等到那种地步才去赴死。 在我年轻的时候，有一个邻近部落的酋长，他的部落就在几座岛屿之外。他是个还算不错的战士，但有一次他的头部被锤子击中，虽然没有丧命。后来阿戈斯带着我和其他几个人去袭击那个部落，结果我们看到的只是一个满口流口水、甚至都无法站直的废人。那里没有什么值得悲伤的，就像这里一样。看到一个人沦落到那种地步，只会让人感到厌恶，或许还会有一丝怜悯。 在Sailgraves，生活或许就是这样的，但在这里，事情并非如此运作。 |阿兹兰一路上都保持着沉默，僵硬地挺直身体，双肩紧绷。这件事对她造成的打击，肯定比她愿意承认的要严重得多——因为如果当时你没有及时出现，她的母亲和姐妹们可能也会遭遇同样的命运。 你说的没错，”她终于说道，“但如果事情真的发展到了那一步，做出那种事的人也不会是我。我实在无法下决心对母亲动手部。” 不过，事情终究没有发展到那一步。 要不是因为你，事情本来会是这样的。与我的姐妹们战斗？光是想到这个念头就让人害怕。与我的母亲战斗？绝对不可能。即使母亲变得不再是我们认识的那个人，而只是变成了某个 看起来 像她那样……不，那不可能。” 心中虽然存有这样的疑虑，但你也知道，维瑟兰人以及其他昆虫种族在思维方式上确实存在差异，尤其是那些具有集体意识的种族。既然她现在已经来到了这里，或许阿齐也可以像你为她所做的那样，为德鲁伊们尽一些力，将这份善意传递下去。只有这样，这个世界才会变得更好。 |我们在这里的任务完成了吗？ [kiyoko.married |你的狐狸精妻子 |清子 ] 一个充满同理心的点头。当艾尔塔拉照顾莱恩的时候，你们两人共享了这样一个时刻——彼此绕着对方转圈，只是为了移动而移动，却始终无法到达任何地方。 那个树精…… “你后悔吗？ [var1 |丈夫 |亲爱的 ]不，但是——” “很好，你不必再为此烦恼了。那种情况本来就无法避免，而你已经充分利用了现有的条件和知识，做出了最合适的选择。既然没有任何教训需要从中吸取，再为此懊恼也没有意义了。” …… “我的教育并没有达到应有的水平，但我毕竟是被培养来从事治理工作的。 [var1 |丈夫 |亲爱的 ]而且人们很快就会意识到这样一个事实：即使尝试了所有的选择，也几乎没有哪一种选择是绝对的好或绝对坏的。那么，现在就不要再纠结下去了，因为前面还有许多事情需要去做。 |当埃尔萨拉把瑞恩拉到一边时，图伊走过来，跟着你缓缓地离开了小树林，走向那座桥。你们俩沉默地走了一会儿，直到她终于开口说道： “埃尔萨拉看起来对这一切并不太高兴。没有人应该这样，尤其是她——毕竟真正实施焚烧行动的人就是她。他们俩都需要一些空间。 “你看起来也不太好啊。 她能看出来吗？ “卡门有时候也会这样，所以这对我来说并不陌生。”阿图吉娅拍了拍你的背，“就是那种无论你做什么，结果似乎总是会变糟的感觉，对吧？ 嗯，不算吧。 正是如此你在那些摆在面前的选择中，做了你认为最好的决定。只是……这让人感到有些难过，尽管你其实没有理由感到后悔。这种经历，也是构成人类生活的一部分，对吧？ “哦，是的，我明白。现在我就跟你说 [pc.name] — 别太往心里去，好吗？我相信你会仔细考虑的。 |嗯，那真是一幅令人难过的景象，”奎因走过来对你说，“我几乎是强忍着看下去的。那位精灵女士现在怎么样了？” 你瞥了一眼埃尔萨拉，她正慢慢地带着瑞恩朝桥的方向走去，而奎因也在带你朝那个方向前进。 你将目光重新转向那个兔人，耸了耸肩。毕竟是埃尔萨拉在树上做了那些燃烧的动作，所以…… “你能感受到这些情绪，真是太好了，”奎因一边说，一边拍了拍你的背。“疼痛才是证明你还活着的证据。 如果你对这一切毫无感触，对看到那位鹿女离世毫无反应，我才会更担心。不过现在，再后悔也已经来不及了。 “话虽如此，但考虑到我们迄今为止所看到的一切……呼，难怪托卢斯对贝尔哈兰和戈德斯沃那些事情如此感兴趣。想象一下，如果他拥有这样的力量，他甚至可能不再把目标局限于那些偏远的小边境村庄了。就算没有其他意义，至少你能理解这个笑话的幽默之处。 “看看那个笑容，你戴上它看起来真是好多了。 [pc.name]现在，一定要振作起来，我们必须离开这里，而且我觉得前路还很长。 |当你回到薇薇安身边时，她正在擦拭她的帽子。 [viviane.isDemon |她们一边闲聊，一边互相清理指甲。“哦，你终于弄完了吗？花的时间比预期要长多了，不过考虑到那个傻妞哭得那么厉害，这也难怪吧。” 是的，从她的语气来看，她对发生的事情似乎并不满意。 哦，当然。那真是太糟糕、太浪费资源了……虽然我也明白，讨好那些最终打算在这个地区定居的精灵们确实更为重要。但那样的机会本来可以让我们弄清楚：像这样的精灵生物是否拥有灵魂，还是说它们只不过是一团团魔法而已。 关于干尸精灵这个话题，现有的相关文献少得可怜，你懂我的意思吧——我敢肯定，只要再多写上一两篇高质量的论文，那个可怜的家伙说不定就能吐露出她内心深处可能隐藏的任何秘密了。 但是，任何选择几乎都不可能在所有方面都是完美的，你真正需要做的，就是选择那些最符合你自身利益的选择，对吧？” ……没错。 | 她紧闭着嘴唇，问道：“一切进行得顺利吗？” “应该说是挺顺利的。” “看起来过程也没那么痛苦。”她叹了口气，然后把帽子重新戴在了头上。 你或许应该去看看你的精灵朋友们。他们看起来对发生的一切都感到非常震惊。我知道你在那种情况下已经做了你认为最好的选择，但这种事情确实会严重打击大家的士气。 不过，我相信你一定能把这件事处理得很好。” 有人如此信任你，确实是一件令人欣慰的事情。 “嘿，如果你不够值得，我也不会陪你参加这次探险的，对吧？" ] |这种感觉永远不会过时，”阿格尼叹息着说道，一边擦着额头。“即使我自己一次又一次地经历了死亡，但每次做出那种故意结束某人生命的决定时，心里依然感觉不好。” 事实上，也确实不应该有这种感觉。 即使她并不是做出那个决定的人，也不是执行那个决定的人，你依然为她有这样的感受而感到高兴。在关于像她这样的古代人物的故事中，人们通常会认为他们都已经变得麻木不仁、听惯了各种事情，但像阿格尼这样愿意直言不讳的人，确实为故事带来了截然不同的氛围。 她起初什么也没说，只是瞥了眼正在安慰瑞恩的埃尔萨拉，然后又把目光转回到你身上。“嗯，当然。我们都知道，既然知道她很可能已经无可救药，那么那样做确实是最好的选择……但重要的是，你并不是在冲动之下才做出那个决定的。 谢谢。 [pc.name]不，应该是你感谢她对你所给予的这种信任。 “他们正在取得进展——我觉得我们应该加紧行动，否则党派最终可能会分裂。 ] 既然这件棘手部的事情已经解决了，空气也变得清新了许多，而且那个被污染的干神树林也不会在你忙于其他事情的时候再对你构成任何威胁了。是时候继续前进了……
rows.raw: " You swallow hard and lead Ryn away from the grove to wait at the bridge, then beckon for Elthara to come up with you to Lanniere's tree. Ryn's come some way since you first met her, but she doesn't need to face these decisions. Not yet. The priestess gives you one of her meaningful looks as the both of you quietly gaze down upon Lanniere, the helpless dryad squirming under the heat of your eyes. Just the pressure of the both of you being so close is enough to make her body shudder with unsatiated need, and with a soft moan the dryad thrusts into the air and releases a large plume of musky spunk out onto the dirt. You think that serves to make your case for you. Elthara should remember what it was like to be pinned down on the altar, right? The dryad's been like this for more than two centuries now, if your counting isn't off. "She can't be saved, can she?" The way Elthara's asking the question belies the fact that she already knows the answer, as unpalatable as it may be. While you're not going to rule out some kind of miracle, you don't have the time or resources to figure out which miracle would be appropriate right now, on the slim chance that she isn't too far gone. Elthara moves to lay her hand on the dryad's brow, and thinks better of it when another gigantic gush of musky cum erupts from the oversexed fey's churning balls, each one easily the size of a melon. "So... how do we do this?" [var0 |From what other dryads you've met in your travels have told you, they're the spirits of the trees they inhabit. Simply destroying the tree should do it. |Well, given that the dryad's source appears to be her infested tree, destroying it should do the trick, shouldn't it? ] "I guess it falls to me, then." You'll stay here and make sure that Lanniere's passing is as painless as possible. You look over your shoulder to make sure that Ryn's back is still turned to the grim spectacle that's about to happen, then nod to Elthara to continue. The priestess closes her eyes, clenches her fists and steps towards the tree. "If... if I'd become something like this, I'm not sure I'd have wanted to continue, myself." No... but happily, that's not the case. Elthara's a valuable seneschal to Ryn, to use the Belharan term to describe it, and yet she has enough desire in her to enjoy Mallach's and Lumia's blessings when the mood takes her. Here but for the grace of her goddess in having you rescue her in the nick of time, goes her. Elthara doesn't say anything, but looks up at the twitching fungal tree and bathes it with gouts of whitefire from outstretched palms. Its maw gapes in a silent scream, coughing out several bursts of glittering blue spores, but too many of its roots and branches have been severed or reduced to put up an effective resistance. Flailing wildly in a bid to do something, anything, the corrupted dryad tree hisses and pops with a stink of searing fungus. If the dryad at your side feels any pain at having her tree destroyed, she doesn't feel it — or maybe her corruption fills her to such an extent that she doesn't possess the capability for other sensations anymore. She whimpers and moans softly as you stroke her brow and whisper calming nothings, as Elthara grimly continues her work. And then, in one final moment of clarity, Lanniere's corruption begins to fade along with her, the dryad's body returning to more reasonable proportions as the sheen of sickly sweet sap vanishes from her skin, too. rows.original: Coughing from all the spores in the air, you look around you, expecting another revenant to emerge from the corrupted bonepile and throw itself at you, but none emerge. The infested spectres have melted into dissolving ectoplasm and spore clouds, and the fungal carpet that possessed their earthly remains and forced them into wakefulness lies trampled all about you in clods of disgusting filth and bits of old bones. There's no telling what might come at you next, but for now it looks like it's over. Ryn gasps, unable to tear her eyes from the remains. Though she's silent, it's not too hard to guess that she's contemplating her own mortality, something that all so often is too distant to the young... until circumstances contrive to bring those thoughts to the fore. That, and what might happen to her, to all of you should she succumb in this place... Ryn bites her lip and looks to you, then very pointedly directs her gaze ahead of her, squares her shoulders, and begins marching forward without even looking back. "Don't wander too far ahead, [etheryn.crowned |my queen |lady regent ]." Ryn doesn't look back, but pointedly pauses to examine a nearby crumbling archway in excruciating detail. She didn't act like this down in the crypt... Elthara keeps her gaze trained on the back of Ryn's neck. "With all respect, champion, the revenants beneath the palace were still recognizable as boer'alvar, while the druids we've encountered so far are undoubtedly... changed. The spirits in the crypt were driven by melancholy and sorrow, these have nothing but fury and blame for the var Ridell lineage. The atmosphere is different." This is hard on her, but Ryn needs a lot of toughening up if she's going to be an effective ruler in the years to come. A nod. "In the short space of time since your arrival, champion, the [etheryn.crowned |queen |lady regent ] has had to experience so much in but the blink of an eye. A lesser person would have been broken, but she has her parents' and grandmother's spirit in her. And of course, once again, as before, you serve as the catalyst for that necessary change, [pc.name]. Think about it." Maybe later. For now, Ryn's getting ahead of the party — you've got to keep everyone together.

rows.original:
An idea comes to you. As filthy as the stream is, it probably wouldn't react well to... well, does such a thing as anti-filth exist? You're willing to give it a go, if for no other reason than making a blind run for it across the bridge isn't a prospect you fancy taking if you can help it. Gathering the bag of greasy curative in hand, you untie the string about its neck and test its weight in your hand, inching towards the bridge.
        
        Every step you take is tense, just waiting for the elemental to reappear — and when you draw level with the marble posts, it does, tendrils of dark water exploding from the sluggish flow. Bits of rotting matter fall down as they whip towards you, but you're ready for them — taking aim at the spot in the water where you estimate all the tentacles are joined, you draw back your arm and toss the remedy.
        
        The bag sails through the air, and you watch as the tentacles of fluid change course mid-swing, now aiming not for you but for the new threat. A perfect catch with the kind of uncanny alacrity only a fluid can have — and the flimsy paper explodes, scattering its contents into the elemental's body. There's a moment as each of the long, whipping appendages trembles and curls as if being burned up from within, and then breaks apart in a shower of foul-smelling water.
        
        "Hurry!" Elthara yells, shoving Ryn, [comp2.name] and you forward as the droplets scattered about the riverbank start oozing back into the water. "We don't have long!"
        
        Yeah, it was too much of a stretch to imagine that a simple folk remedy would take it out of commission for good. Still, an opening's an opening — taking Elthara's advice, you hustle and double-time it across the bridge. By the time you make it to the other side, the elemental's already reformed enough to grasp for your heels, but thankfully you're all out of reach by this point.
        
        Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...

你突然想到了一个主意。尽管这条小溪非常肮脏，但它很可能不会对……嗯，难道真的存在某种能够对抗污垢的东西吗？你愿意试一试，至少因为如果你可以避免的话，实在不想冒险穿过那座桥去尝试这件事。 你手中拿着那袋油腻腻的药材，解开系在袋子颈部的绳子，用手感受它的重量，然后一步步地向桥边走去。

每走一步，你都紧张不已，生怕那些元素力量会再次出现——而当你走到那些大理石柱子所在的位置时，它们果然出现了：黑色的水花从那缓慢流动的水流中迸发出来。 那些腐烂的物质在向你飞来的过程中会掉落下来，但你早已做好了准备——你瞄准水中那些你认为所有触手连接在一起的地方，收回手臂，然后将药剂抛了出去。
        
        那个袋子在空中飞舞，你看到那些“触手”在飞行途中改变了方向，现在它们的目标不再是你了，而是那个新的威胁。这种捕捉动作快得惊人，只有流体才具备这样的灵活性——于是那张薄薄的纸瞬间被撕碎，其内容物散落在那个生物的身体里。 有那么一刻，那些长长的、像鞭子一样的附肢开始颤抖、卷曲，仿佛内部正在被烧灼一般，随后便在一阵散发着恶臭的水花中碎裂开来。

“快！”艾尔塔拉喊道，一边推着瑞恩。 [comp2.name] 当那些散落在河岸边的水滴开始重新渗回水中时，你也继续前进着。“我们没有多少时间了！”

是啊，要想相信一种简单的民间疗法就能彻底让它失效，未免有些牵强。 不过，机会就是机会——听从埃尔萨拉的建议，你加快脚步，飞快地跑过了那座桥。当你到达对岸时，那个元素生物已经恢复到了足以抓住你脚后跟的状态，但幸运的是，此时你已经远远地离开了它的攻击范围。
        
        现在，让我们来看看你究竟陷入了什么困境，以及你是否只是从火坑跳进了另一个更危险的火坑……
rows.raw:
"
        An idea comes to you. As filthy as the stream is, it probably wouldn't react well to... well, does such a thing as anti-filth exist? You're willing to give it a go, if for no other reason than making a blind run for it across the bridge isn't a prospect you fancy taking if you can help it. Gathering the bag of greasy curative in hand, you untie the string about its neck and test its weight in your hand, inching towards the bridge.
        
        Every step you take is tense, just waiting for the elemental to reappear — and when you draw level with the marble posts, it does, tendrils of dark water exploding from the sluggish flow. Bits of rotting matter fall down as they whip towards you, but you're ready for them — taking aim at the spot in the water where you estimate all the tentacles are joined, you draw back your arm and toss the remedy.
        
        The bag sails through the air, and you watch as the tentacles of fluid change course mid-swing, now aiming not for you but for the new threat. A perfect catch with the kind of uncanny alacrity only a fluid can have — and the flimsy paper explodes, scattering its contents into the elemental's body. There's a moment as each of the long, whipping appendages trembles and curls as if being burned up from within, and then breaks apart in a shower of foul-smelling water.
        
        "Hurry!" Elthara yells, shoving Ryn, [comp2.name] and you forward as the droplets scattered about the riverbank start oozing back into the water. "We don't have long!"
        
        Yeah, it was too much of a stretch to imagine that a simple folk remedy would take it out of commission for good. Still, an opening's an opening — taking Elthara's advice, you hustle and double-time it across the bridge. By the time you make it to the other side, the elemental's already reformed enough to grasp for your heels, but thankfully you're all out of reach by this point.
        
        Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...
        "

rows.original:
Right, how did the saying go again? %"If there's a problem, use explosions. And if that doesn't solve the problem, use more explosions"? You can't quite remember where you heard it, but that doesn't stop it from being any less true in these circumstances. You're willing to give it a go, if for no other reason than making a blind run for it across the bridge isn't a prospect you fancy taking if you can help it.
        
        Palming the leananstone, you inch towards the bridge, just waiting for the elemental to reappear. Sure enough, the dark stream's surface churns and froths as you draw near to the bridge posts, and tendrils of dark water explode from the sluggish flow once more to meet you. Bits of rotting matter splatter to the ground as the elemental lashes out for you, but you were expecting this; taking aim at the spot just beneath the water's surface where you estimate all the liquid tentacles are joined, you prime the leananstone and toss it forward in an underhand throw.
        
        The elemental reacts, moving to bat the projectile away, but you've pitched it with enough force that the leananstone drives straight through its membranous surface and into its body. Nothing happens for a second, and then the liquid tentacles flail about in obvious pain as arcs of lightning crawl along its fouled surface, the stone discharging its payload with brutal efficiency. The roar of light and sound that would normally have dissipated in the air ends up completely focused from within the elemental, and it's with a wet, disgusting noise that the long, whipping appendages tremble and curl, then explode outward in a shower of foul water.
        
        "Hurry!" Elthara yells, shoving Ryn, [comp2.name] and you forward as the droplets scattered about the riverbank start oozing back into the stream. "We don't have long!"
        
        Right. An opening's an opening — taking Elthara's advice, you hustle and double-time it across the bridge. By the time you make it to the other side, the elemental's already reformed enough to grasp for your heels, but thankfully you're all out of reach by this point.
        
        Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...
rows.translation:
对了，那句话是怎么说的来着？“如果有问题，就用爆炸来解决；如果爆炸还是无法解决问题，那就再使用更多的爆炸。”你可能不太记得是在哪里听到的这句话，但在这种情况下，这句话依然非常适用。你愿意试一试，至少因为如果你可以避免的话，你肯定不愿意冒险穿过那座桥去尝试。
        
        你双手紧握着那块倾斜的石头，缓缓地向桥边靠近，只等着那些元素力量再次出现。果然，当你逐渐接近桥墩时，那条暗影的溪流表面开始翻腾起泡沫，那些暗色的水花又一次从那缓慢流动的水流中迸发出来，向你袭来。 当那股元素力量朝你袭来时，一些腐烂的物质溅到了地上，但你早有预料；你瞄准了水面下你认为所有液态触手连接在一起的那个位置，握紧了那把利安石剑，然后以一种低手的动作将它抛了出去。
        
        这种生物产生了反应，试图将投掷物击开，但你的力量实在太大，那块倾斜石直接穿透了它的膜状表面，刺入了它的体内。有那么一瞬间什么动静都没有，随后那些液态触手开始剧烈扭动，显然它正在承受巨大的痛苦——电弧沿着被污染的表面闪烁着，而那块石头则以极其高效的方式释放出了它的“载荷”。 那些原本应该消散在空气中的轻型与声的轰鸣，最终在元素内部被完全聚集起来。伴随着一阵潮湿而令人作呕的声音，那些长长的、像鞭子一样的附属物开始颤抖、卷曲，然后向外猛烈喷射出一阵污秽的水花。
        
        快！”艾尔塔拉喊道，同时推了推瑞恩。 [comp2.name] 当那些散落在河岸边的水滴开始重新渗回溪流中时，你也加快了脚步。 “我们没有多少时间了！”

没错，机会就是机会——听从埃尔萨拉的建议，你拼命加快脚步，飞快地穿过了那座桥。 当你终于到达另一边时，那些元素生物已经恢复到了足以抓住你脚后跟的程度，但幸运的是，此时你已经远远地离开了它们的攻击范围。

现在，让我们来看看你究竟陷入了什么境地，以及你是否只是从火坑跳进了另一个更危险的火坑之中。..

rows.original: Right, how did the saying go again? %"If there's a problem, use explosions. And if that doesn't solve the problem, use more explosions"? You can't quite remember where you heard it, but that doesn't stop it from being any less true in these circumstances. You're willing to give it a go, if for no other reason than making a blind run for it across the bridge isn't a prospect you fancy taking if you can help it. The ley-crystal in your hand tingles against your palm as you inch forward, begging to be used already. A little longer, just a little longer... while you guess that the grenade's more than capable of blowing out the entire stream, you want to make it count. Sure enough, the dark stream's surface churns and froths as you draw near to the bridge posts, and tendrils of dark water explode from the sluggish flow once more to meet you. Bits of rotting matter splatter to the ground as the elemental lashes out for you, but you were expecting this; taking aim at the spot just beneath the water's surface where you estimate all the liquid tentacles are joined, you prime the ley-crystal grenade and toss it forward in an underhand throw. To your surprise, the elemental doesn't attempt to dodge or deflect the grenade, instead shrinking back a bit — can such a being feel fear, or perhaps it's acceptance of a sort? Such thoughts are scattered as the ley crystal detonates beneath the water's surface, throwing up an enormous plume of stinking water and rotting mulch in a deafening roar. The long, whipping appendages tremble and curl, then explode outward in a shower of foul water along with the rest of its body. "Hurry!" Elthara yells, shoving Ryn, [comp2.name] and you forward as the droplets scattered about the riverbank start oozing back into the stream, the elemental reforming by degrees. "We don't know how much time we have!" Right. While you'd have liked to savor the spectacle you've caused just a little longer, you heed Elthara's advice and double-time it across the bridge. By the time you make it to the other side, the elemental's already reformed enough to grasp for your heels, but thankfully you're all out of reach by this point. Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...

rows.original: An idea strikes you. [var0 |Say, that winter knight's armor that Brint's wearing... just how cold can he make things, if Ryn were to help? "Pretty chilly, I dare say. One of us? Pretty cool. Both of us? I'd say I like my chances. Are you getting at what I think you're getting at?" You don't think the two of them will be able to freeze the entire stream, but just enough of it that the elemental won't be able to get at you easily. "Yeah, I don't think you're wrong. All right, let's do this — you ready there, Ryn?" |Say, did Brint bring along his winter knight armor on this little trip? "Got it right here," he replies, patting his belongings. "I think I know what you're getting at." Indeed. Just how cold can he make things, if Ryn were to help? "Pretty chilly, I dare say. One of us? Pretty cool. Both of us? I'd say I like my chances. Are you getting at what I think you're getting at?" You don't think the two of them will be able to freeze the entire stream, but just enough of it that the elemental won't be able to get at you easily. "Yeah, I don't think you're wrong. Give me a moment to get out of these clothes and put on my stuff." Brint's gotten really used to the armor he claimed up in the rift — he's gotten changed in the blink of an eye, and gives Etheryn a nod. "You ready, Ryn?" ] "[etheryn.lowConfidence |Y- ]Yes. What exactly do you need us to do, [pc.name]?" You quickly lay out your plan — Brint's to freeze as much of the stream about the bridge as he can, while Ryn fends off the elemental's attacks with her freezing arrows. Once enough of the water is iced over — sure, it's moving water, but it barely qualifies as such given the sluggish flow — you'll make a run for it. You'll step back and spot attacks for her, [var1 |help her with your own ice magics |let her focus on keeping the tendrils at bay ]. It's as good a plan as any, and once everyone's in place, you start for the bridge. Sure enough, the dark stream's surface churns and froths as you draw near to the bridge posts, and tendrils of dark water explode from the sluggish flow once more to meet you. Bits of rotting matter splatter to the ground as the elemental lashes out for Brint and Ryn, but the latter already has an icy arrow nocked and ready to loose for a counterattack. The moment the arrows pierce each tendril, it freezes, falls to the ground and shatters — the liquid doesn't stay frozen for long, slowly creeping to the riverbank to rejoin the elemental's main body. Nevertheless, it's enough an opening for Brint to start icing over the water with several wintery bellows, while you direct Ryn in staving off the attacks[var1 | and add in some of your own as well ]. It works. As more and more of the water is iced over, the corrupted elemental's reach becomes more and more tenuous, until it can no longer strike at the bridge crossing from the still free-flowing portion of the stream. It's then that you give the call to hurry over the bridge while the creature's still occupied with cracking up the ice, one that Elthara quickly picks up on. "You heard [pc.himHer]!" the priestess yells, leading the charge with a sprint and gathering up both Brint and Ryn on her way. You follow hot on her heels, and the lot of you have scarcely made it across when the thick sheets of ice Brint's laid out over the water give and splinter into chunks under the elemental's furious thrashing. Thankfully you're all out of reach by this point, but gods, is it mad. Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...
rows.translation: 你突然想到了一个主意。 [var0 |说起来，布林特穿的那一身冬季骑士铠甲……要是莱恩也能帮忙的话，那场面该有多冷啊？ “我觉得会冷得很厉害吧。如果只有我们其中一个人穿上，应该还行吧。但要是我们两个人都穿上……那我敢说，我们的处境就有点麻烦了。 你是不是想表达我所说的那个意思？” 你认为他们两个人不可能完全冻结整个水流，但至少能够冻结足够的部分，使得那些元素生物无法轻易攻击到你。 是啊，我觉得你没有错。好吧，我们就这么办吧——Ryn，你准备好了吗？ |说起来，布林特这次出门是不是也带上了他的冬季骑士铠甲？” “就在这儿呢，”他一边回答，一边拍着自己的行李，“我想我明白你的意思了。” 确实如此。 如果瑞恩帮忙的话，他到底能把事情弄得多冷酷呢？ “可以说，相当冷酷吧。如果只有我们其中一个人参与的话，应该还算不错。但如果是我们两个人一起行动的话？我觉得自己的胜算还挺大的。你是不是也在想我在想的事情呢？你认为他们两个人能够冻结整个水流吗？其实只需要冻结足够的部分，就能让那些元素生物无法轻易攻击到你。” “嗯，我觉得你说得对。 给我一点时间，我先脱掉这些衣服，然后换上我的装备。” 布林特已经非常习惯在裂隙中获得的那些盔甲了——他转眼间就换好了装备，然后向艾瑟琳点了点头。 准备好了吗，瑞恩？ ] "[etheryn.lowConfidence |Y- ]是的。什么？ 正是如此 你需要我们来做这件事吗？ [pc.name]你迅速制定了计划：布林负责尽可能冻结桥周围的流水，而瑞恩则用她那些能冻结目标的箭矢来抵挡那些元素的攻击。一旦有足够多的水被冻结住——虽然这些水仍在流动，但考虑到它那极其缓慢的流速，其实已经几乎不能算作流动的水了——你们就会立刻冲过去。你会退到安全的地方，为她留意周围的攻击情况。 [var1 |用你自己的冰系魔法来帮助她吧。 |让她专心对付那些触手吧。 ]这个计划和其他计划一样不错，等所有人都到齐后，你们就可以开始向桥的方向前进了。 果然，当你们接近桥墩时，那条暗影的河流表面开始翻腾起泡沫，那些暗色的水花再次从缓慢流动的河水中冲了出来，迎向你们。 随着那股元素力量向布林特和瑞恩袭来，一些腐烂的物质溅到了地上，但瑞恩早已将一支冰箭搭在弓上，准备进行反击。当箭矢射中那些触手的一瞬间，它们立刻冻结了，坠落到地面并碎裂开来——这种液态物质无法长时间保持冻结状态，会慢慢流回河岸，重新融入那股元素力量的主体之中。 尽管如此，这已经为布林提供了足够的时机来使用那些冬季用的武器开始发动攻击，而你的任务则是指挥莱恩抵挡这些进攻。[var1 | 也可以加入一些你自己的内容。 ]这招确实有效。随着越来越多的水面被冰覆盖，那个被腐蚀的元素生物的攻击范围也越来越有限，最终它再也无法攻击那些仍然处于流动状态的河水区域，也就是那些能够通往桥面的地方。就在这个时候，你们应该立刻催促大家尽快过桥，因为那个生物此时正忙于破坏冰层，而埃尔萨拉也立刻意识到了这一点。 “你们听到了吧 [pc.himHer]快跑！”女祭司大喊着，冲了上去，一路上还把布林特和瑞恩也拉了上来。你紧随其后，就在你们刚刚越过冰面时，布林特在水面上铺开的厚厚冰层在那个元素生物的猛烈冲击下开始破裂，一块块冰块纷纷掉落。 幸好在这个时候你们都已经不在我的攻击范围之内了，但天啊，这一切真是太疯狂了。 现在，就让我们看看你们究竟陷入了什么困境，以及你们是不是刚刚从火坑跳进了另一个更危险的火坑……
rows.raw: " An idea strikes you. [var0 |Say, that winter knight's armor that Brint's wearing... just how cold can he make things, if Ryn were to help? "Pretty chilly, I dare say. One of us? Pretty cool. Both of us? I'd say I like my chances. Are you getting at what I think you're getting at?" You don't think the two of them will be able to freeze the entire stream, but just enough of it that the elemental won't be able to get at you easily. "Yeah, I don't think you're wrong. All right, let's do this — you ready there, Ryn?" |Say, did Brint bring along his winter knight armor on this little trip? "Got it right here," he replies, patting his belongings. "I think I know what you're getting at." Indeed. Just how cold can he make things, if Ryn were to help? "Pretty chilly, I dare say. One of us? Pretty cool. Both of us? I'd say I like my chances. Are you getting at what I think you're getting at?" You don't think the two of them will be able to freeze the entire stream, but just enough of it that the elemental won't be able to get at you easily. "Yeah, I don't think you're wrong. Give me a moment to get out of these clothes and put on my stuff." Brint's gotten really used to the armor he claimed up in the rift — he's gotten changed in the blink of an eye, and gives Etheryn a nod. "You ready, Ryn?" ] "[etheryn.lowConfidence |Y- ]Yes. What exactly do you need us to do, [pc.name]?" You quickly lay out your plan — Brint's to freeze as much of the stream about the bridge as he can, while Ryn fends off the elemental's attacks with her freezing arrows. Once enough of the water is iced over — sure, it's moving water, but it barely qualifies as such given the sluggish flow — you'll make a run for it. You'll step back and spot attacks for her, [var1 |help her with your own ice magics |let her focus on keeping the tendrils at bay ]. It's as good a plan as any, and once everyone's in place, you start for the bridge. Sure enough, the dark stream's surface churns and froths as you draw near to the bridge posts, and tendrils of dark water explode from the sluggish flow once more to meet you. Bits of rotting matter splatter to the ground as the elemental lashes out for Brint and Ryn, but the latter already has an icy arrow nocked and ready to loose for a counterattack. The moment the arrows pierce each tendril, it freezes, falls to the ground and shatters — the liquid doesn't stay frozen for long, slowly creeping to the riverbank to rejoin the elemental's main body. Nevertheless, it's enough an opening for Brint to start icing over the water with several wintery bellows, while you direct Ryn in staving off the attacks[var1 | and add in some of your own as well ]. It works. As more and more of the water is iced over, the corrupted elemental's reach becomes more and more tenuous, until it can no longer strike at the bridge crossing from the still free-flowing portion of the stream. It's then that you give the call to hurry over the bridge while the creature's still occupied with cracking up the ice, one that Elthara quickly picks up on. "You heard [pc.himHer]!" the priestess yells, leading the charge with a sprint and gathering up both Brint and Ryn on her way. You follow hot on her heels, and the lot of you have scarcely made it across when the thick sheets of ice Brint's laid out over the water give and splinter into chunks under the elemental's furious thrashing. Thankfully you're all out of reach by this point, but gods, is it mad. Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire... "

rows.original: An idea strikes you. Viv? "Let me guess. You want me to do something with the elemental, because enchanting's my field of expertise, isn't it?" Actually, no. While enchanting is her greatest love, you know that she can cast a mean chill when she needs to. If Ryn were to help her, does she think she'd be able to freeze over the stream? Viv raises an eyebrow. "The entire stream? That's a tall order, even if —" No, not all of it. Just icing over the patch about the bridge so that the elemental can't get at you while you cross — that'll do just fine. "Hm. I suppose I don't mind your pet elf helping. It's a better option than trying to fend it off while crossing, at any rate. Very well, I'm for this plan. What about you, girl?" "[etheryn.lowConfidence |I- ]I am. It's then that you give the call to hurry over the bridge while the creature's still occupied with cracking up the ice, one that Elthara quickly picks up on. rows.translation: 薇芙现在并不在你身边。
rows.raw: "Viv's not with you at the moment."

rows.original:
A smile crosses your face as you realize the unique opportunity this situation presents — and here you have just the tool to overcome it. Corrupted as the elemental might be, there's no reason this shouldn't work.
        
        It's with this confidence that you stride back up to the bridge, steps sounding on the ancient path as you don't bother hiding your approach. The elemental senses you drawing near and sure enough, the dark stream's surface churns and froths as you draw near to the bridge posts. The stench is overpowering as tendrils of dark water explode from the sluggish flow once more to meet you, bits of rotting matter splattering to the ground as the elemental lashes out with an attack.
        
        This time, you're ready for it. Before the elemental can so much as touch you, you've already undone the tethers that keep it here in this existence, and step back to watch the results. In the blink of an eye, the tendrils of stinking river water lose consistency, momentum carrying what mass there is forward to splash harmlessly on the ground. Everything stinks, but at least the matter's deal with.
        
        "Well," Elthara says. "That's one way to solve the problem."
        
        Mm-hm. Nothing else accosts you as [party.compNames] stride across the bridge, easily making it to the other side. Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...
rows.translation:
当你意识到这种处境所带来的独特机会时，脸上会浮现出一丝微笑——而你手中正好拥有克服这一困难所需的工具。尽管这个工具可能有些“残缺不全”，但并没有理由认为它无法发挥作用。
        
        正是带着这样的自信，你大步走回了桥边，脚步声在古老的道路上清晰地回荡，你甚至没有刻意隐藏自己的接近。那些感知到你靠近的元素生物，果然在你靠近桥墩时，使那条暗影的溪流表面开始翻腾起泡沫。 这种恶臭简直令人难以忍受——当那些黑色的水花再次从那缓慢流动的水中迸发出来迎向你的时候，一些腐烂的物质也会随之溅落到地上，而那些蕴含着自然力量的力量正在猛烈地攻击着你。

这一次，你已经做好了准备。 在那些元素力量还来不及触及你的时候，你就已经解开了将它们束缚在这个存在中的纽带，然后退后一步，观察着结果的发生。转瞬间，那些散发着恶臭的河水就失去了原有的凝聚力，其携带的那一点点质量也失去了前进的动力，最终只是无害地溅落在地面上而已。 一切都糟透了，但至少这个问题已经得到了解决。

“嗯，”埃尔萨拉说道，“这也是解决这个问题的一个办法。”

嗯，没有其他事情再困扰你了。 [party.compNames] 跨过桥梁，轻松地到达了另一边。现在，就让我们看看自己究竟遇到了什么，以及是否只是从火坑跳进了另一个更大的火坑……

rows.original: This is an elemental creature — you could simply return it to whence it came. Regardless of how good an idea it'd be, it won't be in your way any more. This will consume your ultimate power.
rows.translation: 这是一种由元素构成的生物——你完全可以把它送回它来的地方。无论这个想法有多好，它都不会再妨碍你了。 这将消耗你的终极力量。
rows.raw: "This is an elemental creature — you could simply return it to whence it came. Regardless of how good an idea it'd be, it won't be in your way any more.\n\n This will consume your ultimate power."

rows.original: You must have a power capable of banishing elementals equipped and available to use this option.
rows.translation: 你必须拥有能够驱散那些被召唤出来并可供使用的元素生物的力量，才能选择这个选项。
rows.raw: "You must have a power capable of banishing elementals equipped and available to use this option."

rows.original:
There doesn't seem to be anything you can do about the situation. If you want to get across, making a run for it while fending off the elemental's tentacles as best as you can is your only option here.
        
        "I could perhaps freeze some of the water when it gets close," Ryn volunteers hopefully. "Given what we saw, I probably wouldn't be able to get them all while running, but it'd be better than nothing."
        
        That would be appreciated.
        
        Well, nothing for it. Tensing the muscles in your legs, you take a deep breath and break into a sprint, making for the bridge; [party.manyCompanions
            |[comp2.name], 
        ]Ryn and Elthara follow in your wake, spreading out along the bridge's span to divide the elemental's attention as much as possible.
        
        No sooner have you drawn close to the bridge posts that the stream's surface churns and froths, tendrils of dark water exploding from the scum-choked surface to meet you. Ready as you are, the first liquid tentacle grazes your [pc.hair] as you duck just in time to avoid it, followed by a couple more aimed at Ryn and Elthara. Bits of rotting matter splatter to the ground, but Ryn uses the opening you've created to nock an icy arrow and looses a counterattack. The next tendril that comes for you winds up frozen solid, filthy ice falling to the ground and shattering — not that the liquid doesn't stay frozen for long, slowly creeping to the riverbank to rejoin the elemental's main body.
        
        [pc.agilityRange 65
            |You have a close call, though. While you've been busy watching the spectacle above your head and focusing on keeping your legs moving, you fail to notice a liquid tendril coming low; however, a shadow catches the corner of your eye and you pull your foot out of the way just in time to avoid being snagged. The elemental isn't about to give up, though — now that the game is up, several more stinking coils emerge from the stream, clearly intent on dragging you down into the water.
            
            "[pc.Name]!" Ryn puts a freezing arrow into the nearest tendril of water going for you, giving you the opening you need to disengage and make a full-on run for it. You narrowly dodge several more close calls, duck under a last-ditch grab, and roll onto the other bank winded but untouched throughout the entire ordeal. [party.manyCompanions
                |[comp2.name], 
            ]Ryn and Elthara follow shortly after — it looks like the elemental had been focusing its attention mostly on you, leaving them mostly untouched. It's nice to know that you're so popular...
            
            Is everyone okay?
            
            Elthara gives the back of her hand a tentative sniff and makes a face. "I could smell worse, I suppose."
            
            Well, if the stink's the worst of everyone's problems, then you got off lightly, especially with the elemental thrashing about in the back. Looks like you're not going to be retreating over the bridge that easily — time to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...
            |It's not enough, though. While you've been busy watching the spectacle above your head and focusing on keeping your legs moving, you fail to notice a liquid tendril coming low; by the time you've realized something's caught you by the ankle, you're already on your way down to the ground. The elemental is quick to press its advantage — several more stinking coils emerge from the stream, clearly intent on dragging you down into the water.
            
            "[pc.Name]!" As you scramble to right yourself, Elthara grabs you by under the arms, braces herself against the bridge's railings, and pulls. The elemental isn't about to let you go, either — not until Ryn puts several freezing arrows into the tendrils clinging onto your ankles, at the very least.
            
            It's a rough effort, and given that the elemental's assailing all of you while this is going on, more than a little of the foul, stinking liquid splashes all over the bridge and the three of you. Yet frustration, anger and fear all lend you strength on the condition of being repaid with interest later on, and you manage to scramble back upright to close that last bit of distance and make it out of the elemental's grasping reach.
            
            Phew.
            
            "Are you all right?" Ryn asks as you try to dry yourself without much success.
            
            Yeah, you'll be fine. This stuff is vile, though, and the stench is distracting and dizzying all at once. You're sure that it'll pass by the time it dries off, but who knows how long it'll be in this muggy atmosphere?
            
            "Goddess' mercy, you look frightful. But even if I'd a cloth or something, it wouldn't be enough to clean you up," Elthara adds, patting you on the shoulder. "You're sure you'll be all right?"
            
            You groan and pick off the worst bits of rotting sludge from your [pc.armor]. As well as can be when stinking so horribly it's enough to make someone light-headed, you suppose. Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...
        ]
rows.translation:
对于这种情况，似乎你无能为力。如果你想成功逃脱，那么在尽可能抵挡那些元素生物的触手的同时拼命逃跑，就是你唯一的选择了。

“或许当那些水靠近的时候，我可以试着把其中的一部分冻结起来，”瑞恩满怀希望地提议道。 根据我们所看到的情况，我在奔跑的过程中可能无法把它们全部拿到手，但总比什么都没有要好。”

如果能做到这一点，我会非常感激的。

好吧，没什么好说的。你绷紧腿部肌肉，深吸一口气，然后开始冲刺，朝着那座桥跑去吧。 [party.manyCompanions
            |[comp2.name], 
        ]林恩和艾尔塔拉跟在你的身后，沿着桥面分散开来，尽可能地分散那些元素生物的注意力。

你刚靠近桥柱，河水的表面立刻开始翻腾起泡沫，一缕缕黑色的水触从满是污垢的河面上延伸出来，向你袭来。你早已做好了准备，第一根液态触手就轻轻擦过了你的身体 [pc.hair] 就在你及时躲开的同时，又有几道攻击瞄准了瑞恩和艾尔塔拉。一些腐烂的物质溅到了地上，但瑞恩利用你创造的这个机会，射出一支冰箭，发动了反击。下一条朝你袭来的触手立刻被冻住了，那些肮脏的冰块掉落到地上并碎裂开来——不过这些冰块并没有持续太久，它们会慢慢移动到河岸边，重新融入那个元素生物的主体之中。
        
        [pc.agilityRange 65
            |不过，你真的算是侥幸逃过一劫。当你全神贯注地观察头顶上的景象，同时努力让自己的双腿不停地移动时，你并没有注意到有一根液态的触须正在缓缓逼近；然而，你的眼角突然瞥见了什么，于是你及时抽回了脚，才得以避开被缠住的危险。不过，这个元素生物并没有放弃——既然已经开始了这场“游戏”，又有几圈恶臭的触须从水流中伸了出来，它们显然决心要把你拖进水中去。[pc.Name]砰！”瑞恩将一支冰冷的箭射中那条正朝你袭来的水藤，为你赢得了逃脱的机会，让你得以全力奔逃。你又侥幸躲过了几次险境，从最后一次试图抓住你的攻击下钻了过去，最终滚到了对岸——尽管经历了这一切，你却毫发无伤。 [party.manyCompanions
                |[comp2.name], 
            ]莱恩和艾尔塔拉也很快就跟了上来——看来那个元素生物主要把注意力放在了你身上，所以他们基本上没受到什么影响。知道你这么受欢迎，真是太好了……

大家都没事吧？
            
            埃尔萨拉试探性地闻了闻自己手背的味道，然后做了个鬼脸：“我想，我的味道应该还没这么难闻吧。”

嗯，如果这种臭味真的是大家面临的最严重的问题，那么你还算运气好的，尤其是考虑到后面还有那些元素力量在肆意乱动的话。 看来你不会那么轻易地从那座桥上退下来了——是时候看看你究竟陷入了什么困境，以及你是否只是从火坑跳进了另一个更危险的火坑……
            |但这还不够。当你忙于注视头顶上的景象，同时努力让自己的双腿继续移动时，你根本没有注意到有一根液态的触须正在悄悄接近你；等到你意识到有什么东西抓住了你的脚踝时，你已经开始向下坠向地面了。这种元素生物很快就利用了这一优势——更多的恶臭触须从水流中伸了出来，显然它们是想把你拖进水中。[pc.Name]就在你努力站稳身体的时候，埃尔萨拉抓住你的手臂，将自己抵在桥的栏杆上，然后开始拉你。那个元素生物也绝对不会放开你——至少在瑞恩用几支冰箭射中那些缠住你脚踝的触手之前，它是不会放手的。
            
            这确实是一次艰难的尝试。由于在这段时间里，那个元素生物一直在攻击你们，因此许多又脏又臭的液体溅得到了桥上，也溅到了你们三个人身上。然而，沮丧、愤怒与恐惧反而给了你们力量——只要以后能得到相应的回报就行。你们终于设法爬回了站立姿势，赶在那个元素生物能够再次抓住你们的之前，成功逃出了它的攻击范围。
            
            呼……

“你没事吧？”当你试图擦干身体却收效甚微时，Ryn问道。

“应该没问题的。不过这种东西实在太恶心了，那股气味既让人分心，又会让人头晕目眩。等它干掉后，气味应该就会消失吧……不过在这种闷热的空气中，谁知道要过多久才能干掉呢？
            
            天哪，你看起来太糟糕了。不过就算我有布之类的东西，也远远不够用来把你清理干净，”埃尔萨拉一边说，一边轻拍着你的肩膀。“你确定你不会有事吗？”

你呻吟着，把身上最严重的腐烂污物清理掉。 [pc.armor]当然，当那种气味浓烈到足以让人头晕目眩的时候，也确实会让人产生这样的感觉。现在，让我们来看看你究竟遇到了什么，以及你是否只是从火坑跳进了另一个更危险的火坑……
        ]

rows.original: You don't have any means of making the situation better, or simply aren't willing to use it. Make a run for it across the bridge and hope that your agility is up to snuff.
rows.translation: 你没有任何办法来改善这种局面，或者干脆就是不愿意采取任何行动。那就赶紧穿过那座桥吧，希望你的敏捷性足够好，能够顺利通过。
rows.raw: "You don't have any means of making the situation better, or simply aren't willing to use it. Make a run for it across the bridge and hope that your agility is up to snuff."

rows.original: You take a look down at the dark waters beneath the bridge, slow and sluggish, and shake your head. With how narrow the canal is, you might be able to make it across with some mighty feat of acrobatics, but you're still not inclined to take your chances. Maybe you'll find a way around, maybe you'll discover a better way to deal with this river lurker, or maybe whatever's on the other side just isn't worth the risk of making the crossing. Whatever your reason, you decide to fall back and leave the bridge be for now.
rows.translation: 你低头看着桥下那漆黑的水面，水流显得缓慢而滞涩，于是你摇了摇头。考虑到这条运河如此狭窄，或许通过一些高难度的杂技动作才能成功穿过，但你还是觉得冒这个险并不值得。也许你可以找到其他的绕行路线，或许能想出更好的办法来应对这条河中的“潜伏者”，又或许对岸的东西根本不值得你冒险去穿越。无论出于什么原因，你最终决定暂时放弃这个想法，先不过桥了。
rows.raw: "\n        You take a look down at the dark waters beneath the bridge, slow and sluggish, and shake your head. With how narrow the canal is, you might be able to make it across with some mighty feat of acrobatics, but you're still not inclined to take your chances. Maybe you'll find a way around, maybe you'll discover a better way to deal with this river lurker, or maybe whatever's on the other side just isn't worth the risk of making the crossing. Whatever your reason, you decide to fall back and leave the bridge be for now.\n        "

rows.original: Fall back for now; maybe you'll find a better way to deal with this river lurker later.
rows.translation: 暂时先退一步吧，也许以后你会找到更好的方法来应对这个隐藏在河流中的敌人。
rows.raw: "Fall back for now; maybe you'll find a better way to deal with this river lurker later."

rows.original: If she doesn't mind... Ryn steps up and studies what inscriptions that haven't been obscured by mold and sap, then gives you a nod. "The runes are a bit archaic from what we use today, but I can indeed translate for you." "Don't worry," Elthara chuckles. "I'll be sure to correct the [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess-regent ] if she makes a mistake." Well, if she would begin, that'd be great. Ryn turns to the writing on the nearest wall and traces her finger — or would have, before remembering the mold and shrinking back. Slowly, she begins reading aloud... Henceforth Let It Be Claimed: Blessed of the Wyld be the daughters of Flendel Theruviel; so named Thea, Andrea, Gena, Sara, Kira, and Larissa; who in good mercy have been rightworthy and true to the calling, having repeatedly provided much-needed leather goods, grain, and care for the convalescent and woefully poor in their hour of need. From this day in the fifth of the reign of the winter queen Atheldred var Ridell, forever shall your issue be watched over by the fortunes of the Wyld. "There're more names here," Ryn continues. "A list of faithful almsgivers stretching back three millennia — not that the alms were needed by the druids themselves, and so most of what was given was passed onto the needy, as the passage implies. Given that this is one of the oldest druidic temples, I'm not surprised that so many peoples' names have been recorded." It certainly is one way to be immortalized, at least in some small fashion. But seeing the common folk honored warms the heart, and you think the Lumians continued the tradition, didn't they? "Recognizing the generosity of almsgivers is simply common courtesy," Elthara replies. "We'd be terribly remiss if we didn't give these people recognition, especially from those who are giving a bigger proportion of what they have." You see. What about this other tablet, then? This one looks a lot more hastily carved and newer, inasmuch as anything can be new in this moldering pit. For those who may see this after we have passed: Know that in our dying moments we have tried our best in our duty and fought valiantly to the very end, even if we did not succeed. First the monsters from the void between the spheres, then our own queen who turned against us, and finally this malaise has arrived from one or the other to wipe us from the face of the world. As this corrupted fungus turns our magics on us and feeds on our own connection to the Old Wyld to spread along the stones and walls, infesting this place, please remember our names. "A list of names, presumably the initiates who lived in this dormitory," Ryn says. "You're not wrong, [pc.name], looks like it was done very hastily. Did the fungus spread that quickly? No, that was a silly question. Of course it did." That's all the writing that's here? "That's all." [pc.isChamp |Maybe after you make it out of here, you can return later and have these retrieved. Surely at least a couple of names on these lists ought to have surviving relatives or descendants hanging around... it would be nice to know and reflect well on Ryn's reign, if nothing else, give her a bit of a boost in popularity. Gods know that she'll need it as [etheryn.crowned |queen |regent ]. ]
rows.translation: 如果她不介意的话…… 瑞恩走上前，仔细观察那些没有被霉菌或树液覆盖的铭文，然后点了点头：“这些符文与我们现在使用的有些不同，但我确实可以帮你翻译。” “别担心，”埃尔萨拉笑着说，“我会确保把翻译内容修改正确的。 [etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政公主 ] 如果她犯了错误的话……” “嗯，如果她能开始尝试的话，那就太好了。” 莱恩转向最近那面墙上的文字，用手指沿着字迹划过——本来是打算这么做的，但想起墙上的霉菌后，她立刻缩了回去。慢慢地，她开始大声朗读起来…… 从此以后，人们应当这样宣称： 弗伦德尔·特鲁维埃尔的女儿们——名叫西娅、安德莉亚、吉娜、萨拉、基拉和拉里萨的这些女性——因她们的善良与忠诚而受到荒野之神的庇佑。在人们最需要的时候，她们始终慷慨解囊，提供了人们急需的皮革制品、粮食，并为那些生病康复或生活贫困的人提供了帮助。从今天起，在冬之女王阿瑟尔德雷德·瓦·里德尔统治的第五个年头开始，你们的后代将永远受到荒野之神的庇护与眷顾。 这里还有更多的名字，”瑞恩继续说道，“这是一份名单，列出了那些在三千年间一直慷慨解囊、乐于助人的人们的名字——其实德鲁伊们本身并不需要这些帮助，所以大部分捐赠的钱和物资都被用来帮助那些需要帮助的人了，正如这段文字所暗示的那样。 既然这是最古老的德鲁伊神庙之一，那么有这么多人的名字被记录在这里，我并不感到意外。 这确实是一种让名字永垂不朽的方式，尽管只是以一种微小的形式。但看到普通民众能够获得这样的荣誉，确实让人感到温暖。而且你认为卢米安人也是延续了这一传统的，对吧？ 认识到施舍者的慷慨是一种基本的礼貌，”埃尔萨拉回答道，“如果我们不向这些人表示感谢，尤其是那些捐赠了他们大部分财产的人，那我们就太失礼了。你看，那另一块石板怎么样？这块看起来像是匆匆雕刻出来的，而且看起来更新一些——毕竟在这个破败的地方，什么东西都可能算是‘新的’吧。 对于那些在我们离开后才会看到这些文字的人： 请知道，在我们生命的最后时刻，我们已经尽了自己最大的努力去履行职责，也英勇地战斗到了最后一刻，尽管我们最终并没有取得成功。首先是来自各个领域之间的虚空的怪物，然后是我们自己的女王背叛了我们，最后，这种灾祸从某个地方降临，将我们从这个世界上抹去。 当这种腐烂的真菌反过来利用我们的魔法，侵蚀我们与古老荒野之间的联系，通过石头和墙壁蔓延开来，逐渐侵袭这个地方时，请记住我们的名字。 这是一份名单，上面列着那些住在这间宿舍里的新成员的名字，”瑞恩说道。“你说得没错 [pc.name]看起来这是非常仓促地完成的。真菌真的会蔓延得那么快吗？不，这个问题太愚蠢了——当然会了。 这里就只有这些文字吗？ “就这些。 [pc.isChamp |也许等你离开这里之后，还可以再回来取这些东西。这些名单上至少应该有一些人的亲属或后代还活着吧……知道这些信息会对评价莱恩的统治有所帮助，至少也能提升她的一些人气。天知道，她确实需要这样的支持。 [etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政者 ]. ]
rows.raw: ' If she doesn't mind... Ryn steps up and studies what inscriptions that haven't been obscured by mold and sap, then gives you a nod. "The runes are a bit archaic from what we use today, but I can indeed translate for you." "Don't worry," Elthara chuckles. "I'll be sure to correct the [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess-regent ] if she makes a mistake." Well, if she would begin, that'd be great. Ryn turns to the writing on the nearest wall and traces her finger — or would have, before remembering the mold and shrinking back. Slowly, she begins reading aloud... Henceforth Let It Be Claimed: Blessed of the Wyld be the daughters of Flendel Theruviel; so named Thea, Andrea, Gena, Sara, Kira, and Larissa; who in good mercy have been rightworthy and true to the calling, having repeatedly provided much-needed leather goods, grain, and care for the convalescent and woefully poor in their hour of need. From this day in the fifth of the reign of the winter queen Atheldred var Ridell, forever shall your issue be watched over by the fortunes of the Wyld. "There're more names here," Ryn continues. "A list of faithful almsgivers stretching back three millennia — not that the alms were needed by the druids themselves, and so most of what was given was passed onto the needy, as the passage implies. Given that this is one of the oldest druidic temples, I'm not surprised that so many peoples' names have been recorded." It certainly is one way to be immortalized, at least in some small fashion. But seeing the common folk honored warms the heart, and you think the Lumians continued the tradition, didn't they? "Recognizing the generosity of almsgivers is simply common courtesy," Elthara replies. "We'd be terribly remiss if we didn't give these people recognition, especially from those who are giving a bigger proportion of what they have." You see. What about this other tablet, then? This one looks a lot more hastily carved and newer, inasmuch as anything can be new in this moldering pit. For those who may see this after we have passed: Know that in our dying moments we have tried our best in our duty and fought valiantly to the very end, even if we did not succeed. First the monsters from the void between the spheres, then our own queen who turned against us, and finally this malaise has arrived from one or the other to wipe us from the face of the world. As this corrupted fungus turns our magics on us and feeds on our own connection to the Old Wyld to spread along the stones and walls, infesting this place, please remember our names. "A list of names, presumably the initiates who lived in this dormitory," Ryn says. "You're not wrong, [pc.name], looks like it was done very hastily. Did the fungus spread that quickly? No, that was a silly question. Of course it did." That's all the writing that's here? "That's all." [pc.isChamp |Maybe after you make it out of here, you can return later and have these retrieved. Surely at least a couple of names on these lists ought to have surviving relatives or descendants hanging around... it would be nice to know and reflect well on Ryn's reign, if nothing else, give her a bit of a boost in popularity. Gods know that she'll need it as [etheryn.crowned |queen |regent ]. ] '

rows.original: These are written in the old boer'alvarin. Why don't you ask one of the pale elf ladies to translate for you?
rows.translation: 这些是用古老的布尔阿尔瓦林文字写成的。你为什么不请一位淡色精灵女士来帮你翻译呢？
rows.raw: "These are written in the old boer'alvarin. Why don't you ask one of the pale elf ladies to translate for you?"

rows.original:
As you make to leave the dormitories through the northern hallway, a sudden chill crawls up the back of your neck. This feeling... yes, you encountered in the ruined plaza just outside the temple, not too long ago. While nothing's happened for now, you're certain that should you press ahead, you'll be confronted by more of the restless dead.

    Knowing that, will you proceed?
rows.translation:
当你沿着北侧的走廊离开宿舍时，一股突如其来的寒意从后颈蔓延开来。这种感觉……没错，你不久前在寺庙外的废墟广场上也曾经历过。虽然目前还没有发生什么，但你确信，如果继续前进，必定会遇到更多那些不安宁的死者。

既然知道了这一点，你还会继续前进吗？
rows.raw:
"
    As you make to leave the dormitories through the northern hallway, a sudden chill crawls up the back of your neck. This feeling... yes, you encountered in the ruined plaza just outside the temple, not too long ago. While nothing's happened for now, you're certain that should you press ahead, you'll be confronted by more of the restless dead.

    Knowing that, will you proceed?
    "

rows.original: Malevolence in the air or not, you've got to get through here. The sensation of being watched only intensifies with the next few steps you take, until it all happens at once: translucent specters rise from the fungal remains and lurch out through the walls, their gazes filled with equal parts desire and rage as they scream and lunge for your party. Hermaphroditic bodies, sores scabbed over with fungal growth, the spirits of the druidic initiates are twisted into overgrown, cancerous mockeries of the life and vitality they once revered. No words are needed — if the fungal infestation isn't outright puppeteering their bodies, then it's driven them well beyond the point of reason. Gripping your [pc.weapon] tightly, you prepare to set yourself against these corrupted spirits. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 无论空气中是否弥漫着恶意，你都必须穿过这里。每走几步，那种被监视的感觉就会愈发强烈，直到一切都同时发生：半透明的幽灵从那些真菌残骸中浮现出来，穿过墙壁冲了出来，它们那充满欲望与愤怒的目光紧盯着你的队伍，同时发出尖叫并扑向你们。 这些拥有两性特征的躯体上，那些被真菌侵蚀而结痂的伤口，仿佛在宣告德鲁伊学徒们曾经崇敬的生命与活力，如今已变成了畸形的、充满恶意的嘲弄。 无需任何言语——如果说这种真菌感染没有直接控制他们的身体，那么它至少也已经将他们逼到了理智的边缘之外。 紧紧抓住 [pc.weapon] 你严阵以待，准备与这些堕落的灵魂展开对抗。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

rows.original: You're ready to fight whatever comes at you.
rows.translation: 你已经做好了迎接任何挑战的准备。
rows.raw: "You're ready to fight whatever comes at you."

rows.original: No, not just yet. Either you need a moment to be better prepared, or perhaps you don't want to fight if you can help it and would rather try finding another way around. Thinking back, there was that fork in the hallway just behind you... maybe a more palatable alternative will present itself. You take a step back, and the tiny mushrooms, creeping mold and amber ooze all look positively alive as you do so. Maybe it's just a trick of the light... but probably not, not with the way it undulates and squirms under your gaze. It knows it's being watched... You retreat to the dormitories, and consider your next move.
rows.translation: 不，还不是现在。要么你需要一些时间来做好更充分的准备，要么也许你并不想战斗，如果可以避免的话，你更愿意尝试寻找其他的解决办法。回想一下，就在你身后那条走廊里，有那个岔路口……也许会有一个更可行的替代方案出现。 你后退了一步，那些小小的蘑菇、爬行的霉菌以及琥珀色的黏液，看起来全都 活着 当你这样做的时候，或许只是轻型线的错觉……但很可能不是，因为那些东西在你的注视下确实在蠕动、在晃动。它们知道有人在看着它们…… 你回到了宿舍，开始思考下一步该怎么做。

You retreat to the dormitories, and consider your next move. "

rows.original:
It's over. The last of the infested spirits dissolves into discolored ectoplasm with a wail and you whirl around, expecting more, but none emerge from the walls to assail you. From the number of personal quarters branching off from the dormitories, you'd have expected more than just that handful, but maybe it's a small mercy that the remaining victims avoided being trapped in undeath by the fungal infestation, then.
    
    Still, you pause a moment to check the air, and it's when you're sure that the crawling sensation is no longer pressed against your skin that you proceed confidently into the northern hallway. There's still a lot more of this temple to cover...
rows.translation:
一切都结束了。最后那些被真菌侵扰的灵魂在哀嚎声中化作变色的 ectoplasm 消散了，你转过身，本以为还会有更多东西出现，但墙壁里再也没有任何东西冲出来攻击你。从宿舍里分出的那些私人房间数量来看，你本以为会有更多的受害者，但或许，剩下的那些人没有因为这种真菌感染而陷入不死的状态，这也算是一种小小的幸运吧。
    
    不过，你还是停了一下，仔细观察周围的空气。直到确定那种爬行般的触感不再紧贴着你的皮肤时，你才放心地走进了北侧的走廊。这座寺庙还有许多地方需要探索呢。..

    It's over. The last of the infested spirits dissolves into discolored ectoplasm with a wail and you whirl around, expecting more, but none emerge from the walls to assail you. rows.original: Out of the frying pan and into the fire, indeed. No sooner have you crested the top of the stairs and set foot on the upper landing that a small army of druidic specters burst forth from the walls and fungus-overgrown remains alike, moaning and panting in a disturbingly sexual manner as they reach for you with outstretched ghostly arms. You must be close, then, for whatever intelligence that holds this temple enthralled to muster all its forces at once and throw them against you in a last-ditch attempt to stop you in your tracks. With how many of them there are, this has to be the remainder of the congregation. "It's nearly over," Ryn says to herself through gritted teeth, nocking an arrow and taking aim at the nearest ghost clad in green, white and gold. "It's nearly over." [party.randComp arona quintillus |Arona, though, is in much higher spirits than Ryn is — she would be when faced with overwhelming odds, wouldn't she? Letting out a roar to deafen the spirits', she hurls herself straight into battle, swinging wildly with her [arona.weapon]. Finally, in all of this, she's truly in her element, allowing her battle-fury to push all fear of her foes from her mind. |On his part, Quin gives you a weak grin and shrugs. "And here I thought joining a sex cult was the craziest time of my life. If I'm to be perfectly honest, [pc.name]... coming along with you on these adventures has been the best and worst time of my life all at once, and I wouldn't have it any other way." You too. ] Even if the stairs weren't filled with disgusting sap, bits of plant matter and the very obstacle which you overcame to get here in the first place, you wouldn't be able to retreat quickly enough to avoid the incoming horde of revenants. There's nothing left for it, then, but to get your backs to the nearest wall and hold out against them. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 真是从火坑跳进了另一个火坑。你刚爬上楼梯的顶端，踏上上层平台，一大群德鲁伊幽灵就从墙壁和长满真菌的残骸中冲了出来，它们发出令人不安的、带有性暗示的呻吟声，用伸出的幽灵之手向你扑来。 那么，你们一定离那个地方非常近了。因为正是某种神秘的力量让这座寺庙如此令人着迷，才会迫使它集结所有力量，发起最后的攻击，试图阻止你们的前进。考虑到它们的数量之多，这些肯定就是剩下的那些生物了。 差不多要结束了，”瑞恩咬紧牙关自言自语道，她搭上一支箭，瞄准了那个穿着绿白金三色服装的鬼魂。“差不多要结束了。 [party.randComp arona quintillus |然而，阿罗娜的精神状态要比瑞恩好得多——面对如此巨大的困难，她肯定也会这么做的，不是吗？她发出一声震耳欲聋的吼叫，然后猛地冲向战场，挥舞着她的武器疯狂地战斗起来 [arona.weapon]最终，在这一切之中，她真正找到了属于自己的舞台，让战斗中的狂热彻底驱走了对敌人的恐惧。 |奎因只是淡淡地笑了笑，然后耸了耸肩：“我还以为加入这个性崇拜组织才是我一生中最疯狂的经历呢。说实话 [pc.name]能够与你一起经历这些冒险，对我来说既是人生中最美好的时光，也是最艰难的阶段。但我毫不后悔这样的经历。” 你也是吧。 ] 即使楼梯上没有那些令人作呕的树液、植物残渣，以及你当初为到达这里而必须克服的那些障碍，你也不可能迅速撤退以避免那些即将袭来的亡灵大军。那么，你唯一能做的就是背靠最近的墙壁，顽强抵抗它们。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

You too. ] Even if the stairs weren't filled with disgusting sap, bits of plant matter and the very obstacle which you overcame to get here in the first place, you wouldn't be able to retreat quickly enough to avoid the incoming horde of revenants. rows.original: The horde seems inexhaustible, but you fell one specter after the other, forcing them to lose coherence and dissolve into stinking, sap-stained ectoplasm. Even in that state, the lustful rage that animates them is palpable, and the sheer intensity of the emotion which the Wraith's weapon inflicted upon them is overpowering, to say the least. But just when you've cut down a druidic spirit and swing your [pc.weapon] around to intercept the next one, a sudden change comes over the upper landing: a pulse of cold serenity sweeps over the once luxurious chamber, reminiscent of a clear morning in the Winter City, mixed with the smell you get after rain. A breath of fresh air in this choking corruption, made all the sweeter by its contrast. "What — " Elthara begins, leaving little doubt that you're not the only one to sense this. If anything, the boreal elves are keener to the change in atmosphere than you are, thrown off-kilter enough to lower their guard in the midst of battle. It's a good thing, then, that the remaining specters start losing consistency and dissolving, while the roots jutting out of the walls pull back — not all the way, but enough to cause chunks of marble to fall from the ceiling. It isn't trying to drop the room in on you, is it? Thankfully, neither the floor falls away, nor does the roof cave in on you. All you're left with in the aftermath of the battle is a sudden quietness so loud that you can hear it, and an ankle-thick coating of foulness on the floor. Despite the serenity that pervades the air, you don't like it one bit — it feels all too distinctly like the calm in the eye of a storm... But whatever the reason the seemingly inexhaustible horde withdrew, you have a moment's peace.
rows.translation: 那股怪物群似乎无穷无尽，但你一个接一个地消灭了它们，迫使它们失去组织性，最终化作那些散发着恶臭、沾满树液的幽灵物质。即便处于那种状态，驱动它们行动的狂怒依然显而易见，而那些幽灵所使用的武器所激发的那种强烈情感，至少可以说，是极其可怕的。但是，就在你刚刚消灭了一个德鲁伊灵魂，正准备继续攻击的时候 [pc.weapon] 就在即将拦截下一个目标的时候，上层的降落舱突然发生了变化：一股寒冷而宁静的气息弥漫在了这个曾经奢华的房间里，这种气息让人联想到冬城某个晴朗的早晨，同时还带着雨后空气中的那种清新味道。 在这令人窒息的腐败环境中，这一股清新的空气显得格外珍贵，其带来的对比效果使得这种改变显得更加甜美。 “什么——”埃尔萨拉开口说道，这无疑表明，不止你一个人感受到了这种变化。事实上，极北精灵们对这种氛围的变化更为敏感，他们的反应甚至让你感到惊讶——在战斗进行的过程中，这种变化竟然让他们放松了警惕。 幸好，剩下的那些幽灵开始变得不再稳定，逐渐消失不见了，而那些从墙壁中伸出来的根也开始缩回——虽然没有完全收回，但已经足以导致天花板上的大理石块一块块掉落下来。 它并不是想突然把整个房间压在你身上，对吧？ 幸运的是，地面没有塌下来，屋顶也没有坍塌。战斗结束后，留下的只有那种如此刺耳的寂静 听到 地上到处都是这种东西，还覆盖着一层厚厚的污秽。尽管空气中弥漫着宁静的气氛，但你却一点也不喜欢这种感觉——这简直就像暴风雨前的宁静…… 不过，不管是什么原因让这支看似无穷无尽的队伍撤走了，你总算得到了片刻的安宁。

rows.original:
As you start on the stairs reading up to the next level of the temple, a sense of unease settles deep into the pit of your stomach. Something about this climb is off — you note that the vines lining the walls rustle at your passing despite the air being still, and there's a sensation of static in the air, much like that of a gathering dry thunderstorm. Nothing's coming at you just yet, but the sense of impending danger is unmistakable. If you're intent on passing through, you're going to have to face what's lurking in this stairwell.
    
    Knowing this, will you proceed anyway?
rows.translation:
当你开始登上楼梯，朝着寺庙的上一层前进时，一种不安的感觉逐渐在你的胃里蔓延开来。这次攀登似乎有些不对劲——你注意到，尽管空气静止不动，但墙壁上攀爬的藤蔓却在你经过时沙沙作响，空气中还弥漫着一种静电般的氛围，就像一场即将来临的干雷暴前的预兆。 目前还没有什么东西向你袭来，但那种迫在眉睫的危险感却是显而易见的。如果你决心要继续前进，那么你就必须面对这个楼梯间里潜藏的威胁。

知道了这些，你还是会继续前进吗？

"
    As you start on the stairs reading up to the next level of the temple, a sense of unease settles deep into the pit of your stomach. rows.original: Given that you've prepared as best as you can, there's no point in putting it off any longer. After the first dozen steps, the sensation of static suddenly surges — pink-tinged energies surge off the tips of the vine-like fungal tendrils, gathering into a ball of crackling light. This is rapidly followed by the vines themselves, pulling and knitting themselves about the elemental's core until you're facing a writhing mass of fleshy, tentacular tendrils. Corded appendages possessed of inhuman strength and volatile energies alike waver in all directions akin to a perverse tumbleweed; all of them as thick as your arm and capped with oozing, phallus-like tips or orifices that distinctly resemble swollen, blooming pussies. There's little rhyme or reason to the mass of vegetation — only a theme of rampant, overgrown sexuality encouraged to an obscene degree by the corrupted druidic magics within. [var0 |You finally recognize the sensation crawling on your skin: it's akin, but not identical to the one which the unstable elementals gave off when you made the site of Cait's temple safe for restoration. Whether that knowledge will be of any use... well, you'll find out soon enough. [party.has cait |Cait turns her eyes to you questioningly, and it's clear that she's felt it, too. You give her a nod of acknowledgement, and together you ready yourselves to face this foe. ] ] It's a fight!
rows.translation: 既然你已经尽了最大努力去准备，再拖延下去也没有意义了。当迈出最初的十几步之后，一种静电般的感应突然涌现出来——那些呈粉红色的能量从那些类似藤蔓的真菌触须的末端释放出来，汇聚成一团闪烁着轻型芒的球体。 紧接着，这些藤蔓本身也会开始蠕动，它们会缠绕在那个元素核心周围，最终形成一团由肉质触手构成的扭曲怪物。 这些带有非人类般力量与不稳定能量的绳状附肢会向四面八方摆动，就像一颗扭曲的风滚草；它们的粗细与人的手臂相当，末端则长着不断渗出液体的、类似阳具的突起，或者是一些看起来像肿胀、绽放的阴户般的开口。 这种茂密的植被分布毫无规律可言，唯一能解释这种现象的，就是那些被腐蚀的德鲁伊魔法在极大程度上激发了人们那种肆无忌惮、过度膨胀的性欲。 [var0 |你终于意识到了那种在皮肤上爬动的感觉：它与你在保护凯特神庙的遗址以便进行修复时，那些不稳定的元素所散发出的感觉有些相似，但又不完全相同。至于这种认知是否会有什么用处……嗯，你很快就会知道答案的。 [party.has cait |凯特疑惑地看向你，显然她也感觉到了同样的事情。你向她点了点头表示认同，然后你们一起准备好了面对这个敌人。 ] ] 这是一场激烈的战斗！
rows.raw: " Given that you've prepared as best as you can, there's no point in putting it off any longer. After the first dozen steps, the sensation of static suddenly surges — pink-tinged energies surge off the tips of the vine-like fungal tendrils, gathering into a ball of crackling light. This is rapidly followed by the vines themselves, pulling and knitting themselves about the elemental's core until you're facing a writhing mass of fleshy, tentacular tendrils. Corded appendages possessed of inhuman strength and volatile energies alike waver in all directions akin to a perverse tumbleweed; all of them as thick as your arm and capped with oozing, phallus-like tips or orifices that distinctly resemble swollen, blooming pussies. There's little rhyme or reason to the mass of vegetation — only a theme of rampant, overgrown sexuality encouraged to an obscene degree by the corrupted druidic magics within. [var0 |You finally recognize the sensation crawling on your skin: it's akin, but not identical to the one which the unstable elementals gave off when you made the site of Cait's temple safe for restoration. Whether that knowledge will be of any use... well, you'll find out soon enough. [party.has cait |Cait turns her eyes to you questioningly, and it's clear that she's felt it, too. You give her a nod of acknowledgement, and together you ready yourselves to face this foe. ] ] It's a fight! "

rows.original: You're as ready as you'll ever be.
rows.translation: 你已经做好了充分的准备。
rows.raw: "You're as ready as you'll ever be."

rows.original: Hesitating, you back away from the stairs, and the sensation of crackling energy on your skin fades. Breathing a sigh of relief that whatever danger there is isn't pursuing out out of its domain, you turn your mind to the problem at hand. It looks like given what you felt, it may be prudent to have some storm resistance on tap, if nothing else. There doesn't seem to be any other avenue to progress through the ruined, infested temple, so sally forth once you've steeled yourself.
rows.translation: 你犹豫了一下，然后退开了楼梯，那种能量在皮肤上产生的刺痛感也逐渐消失了。你松了一口气，心想不管有什么危险，它应该没有超出自己的活动范围来追击你。接下来，你开始思考当前面临的问题。根据你刚才感受到的那些现象，看来采取一些措施或许是明智的。 抗风暴能力 至少，还有这个选择。 在这个被破坏、充满危险的神庙里，似乎没有其他办法可以继续前进了，所以当你下定决心后，就立刻行动吧。
