Breathing a sigh of relief that whatever danger there is isn't pursuing out out of its domain, you turn your mind to the problem at hand. It looks like given what you felt, it may be prudent to have some storm resistance on tap, if nothing else. There doesn't seem to be any other avenue to progress through the ruined, infested temple, so sally forth once you've steeled yourself. "

rows.original: You need a moment to prepare.
rows.translation: 你需要一点时间来准备。

rows.original: [var0 |No point in dragging this out when you have to tools to end it quickly. Reaching out with your magic, you slip beneath the writhing mass of dripping tentacles and sever the link which keeps the corrupted elemental together — merely banishing it would simply move the problem elsewhere, and you want to get rid of it. Nothing happens for a second or two, and then slowly but surely, light begins to seep out from between the rents in the fleshy husk of vines, growing more and more intense by the moment. The elemental stops trying to attack you, grasping at itself in pain — and then it explodes with a wet splortch and burst of volatile energies. Stinking sap sprays down the stairs as scorched tentacles are thrown in all directions, twitching with the last remnants of life before going still. That's one way to banish an elemental, you suppose. |The corrupt elemental's core was already unstable to begin with, and [lastStanding.HPDefeated |you've dealt enough damage to start a runaway reaction in its core. As the incandescent husk succumbs to its own volatile energies |overloading it with lustful energies has proven a surprisingly effective strategy. As it becomes unable to contain itself ], the pulsing pink light in its exposed core flares up to a blinding brilliance... Images of the druids' many perverse acts in their final moments flash through your mind in that split second — the corruption overtaking them as the fungal weapon tailor-made to destroy them twisted their bodies and magics into an incomprehensible, lustful amalgamation of fuck-hunger, a sick mockery of the ideals they worshipped. And then the elemental explodes, its exposed core ripping itself apart with a wet splortch and burst of volatile energies. Stinking sap oozes from its tentacles as they're thrown all over the stairwell, twitching and grasping futilely at the air, and finally the last of the pink-hued light fades into nothingness. ] With the stairs now clear, the upper reaches of the druidic temple are open to you, inasmuch as a buried structure has upper reaches. You pace them two at a time, warily watching the walls for any new threats that might emerge like the incandescent husk did. [party.oneComp cait brint brienne |"You felt that, didn't you?" Cait whispers as she bounds up the stairs at your side. [var1 |"It was the same kind of energy that flowed from the temple when we took Dad up to stabilize it! That, and also when that creep Tollus threw Calla through the portal!" That stands to reason. The old temple that now has been repurposed to Mallach's service must've once been a druidic one — the pale elves and lupines were the only people in the Marches before the Belharans came. They drew power from the ley-lines that ran across the Marches, didn't they? Maybe this temple's even sitting on the same one that Cait's is on. "H-hey!" Of course, you have no way to prove that. Cait pouts. "Try to be serious, [pc.name]. I'm bringing this up because of what Dad said, remember? Without Tollus or some other creep using up all the power every so often, the temple was going to blow or something in a handful of years if someone didn't do something about it. So my question is: why hasn't this one crumbled already?" You don't know. Maybe it has, and that's why most of it is buried? "That... I didn't think of that." |"It was the same thing at the old temple when the portal opened and that creep Tollus threw Calla through!" That stands to reason. Given the similarities in architecture, your guess is that the old temple under Castle Hawkstone was a druidic one — didn't they have surrounding villages as support, too? Maybe Hawkethorne once belonged to the pale elves before humans and wood elves came up from Belhar — the boer'alvar and lupines were the only people in the Marches before the Belharans came. Hethia said they drew power from the ley-lines which ran across the Marches — maybe these two are connected by the same line? Cait thinks about that, and makes a face. "Eww. But it'd explain a lot." ] That being said, you seriously doubt that the elves have a portal here — something like that wouldn't have stayed buried for long, be it by people wanting to use it or prevent others from using it. The sinking feeling in your gut tells you there's still a whole lot of temple to explore, so perhaps you should save the discussion for when you're safely out of here. |"You know, [pc.name], I just realized something while we were fighting that... that plant back there," Brint says as he keeps pace with you up the stairs. What would that be? "How are we still breathing?" What? Because of the spores? "No — they aren't helping, but that's not what I mean. It's because this place has been buried for the gods know how long." Brint replies, waggling his fingers at the walls. "Every minotaur calf or heifer knows what happens when a tunnel gets sealed off for too long — the air goes stale at first, then bad, then outright poisonous to breathe. When you open up an old collapse that hasn't had any air circulation for years, you need to let out all the bad air first, or else you'll choke and collapse, maybe even die if there's no one around to help. "But we've been running, shouting, fighting — breathing hard, and only all the spores in the air have given us any problems. The air here is still and the temple's been buried for centuries according to that druid lady, so why haven't we all collapsed already?" That's... interesting. You didn't consider that, had too much on your mind. Brint claps you on the shoulder. "Don't feel bad, I'm the one who should know and we haven't had a breather to think, not with all kinds of crazy things throwing themselves at us. But I don't like it one bit, and I'm getting the feeling that we're not going to like the answer if we do stumble across it, either." |"You know, [pc.name], I just realized something while we were fighting that... that plant back there," Brienne says as she keeps pace with you up the stairs. What would that be? "How are we still breathing?" What? Because of the spores? "No — they aren't helping, but that's not what I mean. It's because this place has been buried for the gods know how long." Brienne replies, waggling her fingers at the walls. "Every minotaur calf or heifer knows what happens when a tunnel gets sealed off for too long — the air goes stale at first, then bad, then outright poisonous to breathe. When you open up an old collapse that hasn't had any air circulation for years, you need to let out all the bad air first, or else you'll choke and collapse, maybe even die if there's no one around to help. "But we've been running, shouting, fighting — breathing hard, and only all the spores in the air have given us any problems. The air here is still and the temple's been buried for centuries according to that druid lady, so why haven't we all collapsed already?" That's... interesting. You didn't consider that, had too much on your mind. Brienne smiles and turns up her palms. "Don't feel bad, I'm the one who should know and we haven't had a breather to think, not with all kinds of crazy things throwing themselves at us. But I don't like it one bit, and I'm getting the feeling that we're not going to like the answer if we do stumble across it, either." |Ryn keeps pace with you, tailing slightly behind as she watches the walls like a hawk. "[pc.name], I've been thinking..." Yes? "How big is this place, anyway? We have the palace chapel, and there're some cathedrals to Lumia in the city, but this is something else altogether." Well, from everything that you've seen so far, the way Hethia's people lived feels like it used to be a complete lifestyle. It's not surprising, considering monastic traditions across the world, so you'd expect it to be pretty big? The temple isn't just a place of worship, it's one of work and life — if it were more in the Belharan monastic tradition, it wouldn't be one building, but many buildings. This was supposed to be the biggest and brightest of them all, too, so... maybe as large as the Palace of Ice, if you'd to guess? "That... that makes sense, I guess. I've read some histories on the way druidic temples were, but few people bothered to actually note down their scale. I guess it was because that was something that everyone at the time was expected to know." Or other details like them being situated on ley lines which have the tendency to create nasty elementals if left untended. "Hmm..." ] The last of the stairs passes beneath your feet, and you arrive at a sprawling landing, passageways stretching in all directions. More of the same, more of the same...
rows.translation: [var0 |既然你有工具可以迅速解决这个问题，那就没有必要再拖延下去了。你运用自己的法力，穿梭在那团蠕动着、不断伸出触手的怪物之下，切断了将那些被腐蚀的元素力量凝聚在一起的纽带——仅仅将它们驱散的话，问题只会转移到其他地方去，而你的目标是要彻底消灭它们。 一瞬间什么都没有发生，但随后，光线开始从那些藤蔓柔软的外皮上的裂口中慢慢渗出，而且这种光芒越来越强烈。那个元素生物不再试图攻击你，而是痛苦地抓着自己的身体——然后，它突然爆炸了，迸发出一阵湿漉漉的光芒 噗通一声 伴随着一阵剧烈的能量爆发，那些散发着恶臭的汁液顺着楼梯喷溅而下，而那些被烧焦的触手则向四面八方甩去，在最后一点生命力的驱使下还在抽搐着，随后便彻底静止不动了。 我想，这应该是一种驱逐元素生物的方法吧。 |这个被腐蚀的元素核心本身就已经很不稳定了，更何况 [lastStanding.HPDefeated |你造成的伤害已经足以引发其核心处的连锁反应。当这颗炽热的外壳在自身剧烈的能量作用下逐渐消亡时…… |用充满欲望的能量去“充斥”它，这种做法被证明是出奇有效的。因为这样一来，它就无法再控制自己了。 ]它裸露的核心中闪烁的粉红色轻型芒骤然迸发出刺目的强轻型…… 在那一瞬间，德鲁伊们在最后时刻所犯下的种种邪恶行径瞬间浮现在你的脑海中——当那种专门用来毁灭他们的真菌武器扭曲了他们的身体与魔法，将他们的本质变成了一种充满欲望的、令人无法理解的混合体时，腐败已经彻底侵蚀了他们，而这种转变，正是对他们所信奉的理想的一种病态的嘲弄。 然后，那颗元素核心发生了爆炸，它暴露在外的核心部分在剧烈的冲击下开始自我撕裂 噗通一声 伴随着一阵剧烈的能量爆发，那些触手被抛向楼梯间，不断地抽搐着，徒劳地试图抓住空气中的什么东西。最终，那最后一丝粉红色的轻型芒也消失得无影无踪。 ] 现在楼梯已经清理完毕，德鲁伊神庙的上层区域终于向你敞开了大门——当然，对于一个被埋藏起来的建筑来说，所谓“上层区域”也只是相对而言罢了。你小心翼翼地一步步向上走去，时刻警惕着墙壁上是否会出现像那团炽热的残壳那样的新威胁。 [party.oneComp cait brint brienne |你也是这么觉得的，对吧？”凯特轻声说道，一边说着一边和你一起快步走上楼梯。 [var1 |就是那种能量，当我们带着爸爸去稳定那座寺庙时，也正是那种能量在流动！还有，当那个叫托卢斯的怪物把卡拉扔进传送门的时候，也是同样的能量！” 这确实很有道理。现在被改造成用于服务马拉克的那座古老寺庙，肯定曾经是一座德鲁伊的神殿——在贝拉兰人到来之前，荒野地带只有苍白精灵和狼人居住。 他们是从贯穿那些边境地区的能量脉络中获取力量的，对吧？也许这座寺庙就坐落在与凯特所在的那个能量脉络相同的地点上。 “嘿！” 当然，你根本无法证明这一点。 凯特撅起了嘴：“认真点吧。 [pc.name]我之所以提到这件事，是因为爸爸说过的话，还记得吗？如果没有人采取行动，没有托卢斯或者其他什么怪物时不时地消耗掉所有的能量，那么这座寺庙在几年内就会坍塌或者发生别的什么事情。所以我的问题是：为什么这座寺庙还没有倒塌呢？ 你不知道的。也许它 拥有所以大部分内容都被埋藏起来了？ “那个……我之前确实没有考虑到这一点。 |在古老的寺庙里，当传送门打开时，那个叫托卢斯的怪物也是把卡拉扔了进去的！” 这确实很有道理。考虑到建筑风格的相似性，你推测霍克斯通城堡下的那座古老寺庙应该是德鲁伊教的祭祀场所吧——而且它们不也是需要周围村庄作为支撑的吗？ 也许在人类和森林精灵从贝尔哈尔来到这里之前，鹰棘镇曾经属于那些苍白精灵——在贝尔哈尔人到来之前，布尔阿尔瓦尔人和狼族曾是这片边境地区唯一的居民。赫希娅说过，他们从贯穿整个边境地区的能量脉络中获取力量……也许这两者之间存在着某种联系？ 凯特想了想，然后做了个鬼脸：“呃，不过这确实能解释很多事情。 ] 话虽如此，你还是很难相信精灵们在这里真的设下了传送门——这样的东西不可能长期被埋藏起来，要么会有人想要使用它，要么会有人试图阻止他人使用它。你内心那种不安的感觉在告诉你，这座神庙里还有许多地方有待探索，所以或许你应该把这个话题留到安全离开这里之后再讨论。 |你知道， [pc.name]在我们战斗的时候，我突然意识到了一件事……就是那边那株植物，”布林特一边说，一边跟着你一起上楼。 那会是什么事情呢？ “我们怎么还能继续呼吸呢？” 什么？是因为那些孢子吗？ 不，并不是他们在帮忙，但我的意思并不是这个。而是因为这个地方已经被埋藏了，天知道有多久了。”布林特一边说，一边用手指指着墙壁。“每一个弥诺陶洛斯幼崽都知道，如果隧道被封闭太久，会发生什么——起初空气会变得浑浊，然后变质，最终甚至会变得有毒，无法呼吸。 当你打开一个已经多年没有空气流通的旧废墟时，首先必须把里面的污浊空气全部排出去，否则你会窒息而倒下，如果周围没有人帮忙，甚至可能会丧命。 但我们一直在奔跑、呼喊、战斗——呼吸变得十分困难，而真正给我们带来麻烦的，只有空气中的那些孢子。这里的空气很平静，而且根据那位德鲁伊女士的说法，这座寺庙已经被埋藏了几个世纪，那么我们为什么还没有全部倒下呢？ 那……还挺有意思的。你之前确实没考虑到这一点，当时你脑子里有太多事情要处理了。 布林特拍了拍你的肩膀：“别难过，这本该是我该注意到的。我们根本没时间仔细思考，各种疯狂的事情不断涌向我们。但我一点也不喜欢这样，而且我有种预感，就算我们最终找到了答案，我们也不会喜欢那个答案的。 |你知道， [pc.name]在我们战斗的时候，我突然意识到了一件事……就是那边那株植物，”布蕾妮一边说，一边跟着你一起上楼梯。 那会是什么事情呢？ “我们怎么还能呼吸呢？” 什么？是因为那些孢子吗？ 不，并不是他们在帮忙，但我并不是这个意思。而是因为这个地方已经被埋藏了，天知道有多久了。”布蕾妮一边说，一边用手指指着那些墙壁。“每一个弥诺陶洛斯幼崽都知道，如果隧道被封闭太久，会发生什么——起初空气会变得浑浊，然后变得有害，最后甚至会变得有毒，无法呼吸。 当你打开一个已经多年没有空气流通的旧废墟时，首先必须把里面的污浊空气全部排出，否则你会窒息而倒下，如果周围没有人帮忙，甚至可能会丧命。 但我们一直在奔跑、呼喊、战斗——呼吸变得十分困难，而真正给我们带来麻烦的，只有空气中的那些孢子。这里的空气很平静，而且根据那位德鲁伊女士的说法，这座寺庙已经被埋藏了几个世纪，那么我们为什么还没有全部倒下呢？ 那……还挺有意思的。你之前确实没考虑到这点，当时你肯定有很多事情要处理。 布蕾妮微笑着，摊开了手掌：“别难过，这本该是我该明白的事情。而且我们根本没机会仔细思考，各种疯狂的事情不断涌向我们。但我真的很不喜欢这样，而且我有种预感，就算我们最终找到了答案，我们也不会喜欢那个答案的。 |瑞恩跟在你身后，略微落后一些，她像鹰一样注视着周围的墙壁。[pc.name]我一直在思考……” “嗯？” “这个东西到底会有多大呢？ 是 rows.original: Stepping up to the portcullis set into the northern end of the refectory, you give it a look-over. Some kind of mechanism, it would seem... hopefully, the mechanisms haven't gotten all gunked up with things growing in between the moving bits or something. "I'm not surprised," Elthara says. "From what we know of these temples, they were built to be defensible — when need be, people from the surrounding village would be expected to take shelter in it. A chokepoint, then, to seal off the inner temple from the outer should the main entrance be breached. The mechanism that operates the lift to the glacial rift isn't so different; it's only scaled up enough that it has to be driven by goats." You point down the bronze wheel by the gate's side. This ought to be able to be turned by hand, you guess. "Certainly looks like it." Well, do either Ryn or Elthara know how to raise the portcullis over the gate, then? "If it's like any of the others that were built around Njorhaalt back in the day..." Elthara taps her chin, thinking. "How you lift the gate is through this wheel over here: you can turn it left, right, or just hold it in place for a bit. You've got to do this five times, and it's got to be in the correct sequence; for each action in the sequence that you perform correctly, the mechanism will click." Why does it have to be so complicated? "It's like a password — you wouldn't want just anyone being able to raise the portcullis, would you? That'd make sense, if it was intended to cut off potential attackers. At the same time, you wouldn't want to cut yourself off by making it raisable only from one side." So if you got three out of five correct, there'd be three clicks? "That's right. What we want to hear is five clicks from the portcullis mechanism." And... well, of course Elthara wouldn't know the exact sequence in which to turn the wheel. That was silly — what reason would she have to know that? Guess it's up to you to figure this out; it's not as if you're pressed for time or anything.
rows.translation: 走到餐厅北端的那个活板门前，你仔细观察了一下。看起来这是某种机械装置……希望这些机械部件之间没有因为植物生长之类的原因而变得堵塞吧。 我并不感到意外，”埃尔萨拉说道，“根据我们对这些寺庙的了解，它们当初建造的时候就是为了便于防御——在需要时，周围村庄的居民也可以在里面避难。因此，如果主入口被攻破，这些寺庙就可以作为屏障，将内殿与外界隔离开来。 驱动电梯前往冰川裂谷的机制其实并没有太大不同，只是规模被扩大了，因此需要用山羊来拉动它。 你指向大门旁边那个青铜轮子，心想这个应该可以手动转动吧。 确实看起来是这样。” 那么，Ryn或者埃尔萨拉当中有谁知道如何打开大门上的吊门呢？ “如果它和当年在Njorhaalt周围建造的那些吊门一样的话……”埃尔萨拉托着下巴思考着。 要打开大门，就需要使用这里的这个轮子：你可以 向左转、向右转，或者直接保持当前方向不变。 暂时先这样吧。你必须得这么做。 必须按照正确的顺序完成五次操作；只要你按照顺序正确地完成每一次操作，这个机制就会启动。为什么非得这么复杂呢？” “这就像密码一样——你肯定不希望随便什么人都能打开那扇门，对吧？如果这样做的目的是为了阻止潜在的攻击者，那么这种设计当然是合理的。但同时，你也不希望自己把自己困在里面，所以才不会设计成只能从某一侧打开吧。” 那么，如果答对了五道题中的三道，就需要点击三次吗？ “没错。我们希望听到的就是这样的答案。 距离栅门机关只有五次点击的距离。嗯……当然，艾尔塔拉不可能知道应该按什么顺序转动那个轮子。这太愚蠢了——她有什么理由需要知道这个呢？我想这个任务就交给你来解决了；反正你也没有时间压力之类的吧。

rows.original: [var0 |You finish your sequence of turns, and let go of the wheel to see what happens with the portcullis. Nope, nothing, not even a single click. "Well, it's not a complete loss," Ryn says with a small smile. "At least you learned what most certainly doesn't work." There is that, you suppose. Given that there're only so many combinations of wheel turns to be had, having a complete dud ought to teach you something about what the correct sequence ought to be... "There's no need to get frustrated," Elthara says, patting you on the shoulder. "Take your time. Of course, if you'd rather just give up, there's the other passageway we passed on the way here. We might be able to work our way around, although I'm sure that way has its own challenges, too." |You finish your sequence of turns, and let go of the wheel to see what happens with the portcullis. Nothing happens for a torturously long time... and then a single click rises from the portcullis mechanism. Better than nothing... or perhaps maybe worse, given that you've no way of telling exactly which turn of the wheel was the right one. "Keep on trying," Ryn offers by way of encouragement. "Or if you'd rather not, there's always the other hallway — we might be able to find a way around. Of course, I wager that path'll have its own problems to put in our way." When she puts it like this... a known yet frustrating obstacle against a mystery obstacle that could be easier or worse to deal with. What a choice. "There's no need to get frustrated," Elthara says, patting you on the shoulder. "Take your time." |You finish the sequence of turns and wait for the gate's response. Before too long, two clicks sound from within the mechanism, the portcullis itself still remaining firmly down. Even if you're still some ways off, you're getting closer to the goal. "We're getting warmer," Ryn quips helpfully. "That's a good sign — I'm glad you're here to figure things out for us." Well then, if she were the one trying to figure it out, what would she do? "I'd turn the wheel all the way to one side once, then to the other, then hold it. Figure out how many of each are in the correct sequence," Ryn replies. "That'd help narrow down the potential number of sequences quite a bit, wouldn't it? You'd still have to figure out what goes where, but the kinds of turns that you have to do with the wheel wouldn't be a mystery any more." Well... that's some insight, actually. Not that it's necessarily the only way to figure this out, but it'd certainly make things easier. |You finish the sequence of turns and wait to see if anything happens; sure enough, after a few seconds, you hear three clicks from the gate's internal mechanisms, even if the portcullis doesn't budge. More than halfway there, then — that's got to be good, right? [pc.isDK |It's more than a little embarrassing and infuriating, having an audience right here to watch your failures. Well, at least it's people you know and not a whole gaggle of ghost druids mocking you or something, so you'll take small mercies where they show themselves. |Keeping everyone standing around while they wait for you to get it right is kind of embarrassing, though, so it's probably best that you get this solved quickly... ] "There's no need to get frustrated," Elthara says. "Just turning the wheel randomly and hoping to strike upon the sequence by chance isn't going to get you anywhere — you need to have a strategy to figure it out." Would she mind sharing such a strategy, then? "What works for me might not work for you. Besides, you're at three out of five. Might as well keep on doing what you're doing, right?" |You finish the sequence of turns and wait for the gate's response, which comes almost immediately: a series of four loud clicks and several grinding noises from the portcullis mechanism, strong enough for flecks of aged mold to fall off the brick. Alas, though, the gate still doesn't rise — it'd have been too much to hope you could've gotten a freebie. "Almost there," Elthara says, patting you on the shoulder. "Just got one of them wrong. Question is: which one?" Could be any one of them. Still, you're not too far off. Just have to figure it out, right? "We've always had perfect confidence on you, our Champion of Frost." The way she says it, you could believe it. Just that bit more, then... |No sooner have you finished with the wheel that five clicks sound from within the portcullis mechanisms — something grinds deep within the ancient marble walls, and then sheets of fungi slough off ancient bronze as the gate rises. It's agonzingly slow and at times you fear that the machinery might jam or stall, choked with overgrowth as it is, but eventually it rises into the ceiling and latches with a click. So, who wants to be the first to pass under it? "I'll do it," Ryn volunteers. "A [etheryn.crowned | |future ]queen should lead by example, shouldn't she?" Without further ado, Ryn strides forward [etheryn.highConfidence |boldly |with a deep breath ], passing under the now-raised portcullis and to the other side. When it fails to come crashing down on her either by means of trap or ancient mechanisms failing, you follow suit with Elthara [party.som | |and [comp2.name] ]tailing along behind. There, that wasn't so bad, was it? "We've still got a long way ahead of us, I fear," Elthara says. "But yes, you did well, [pc.name]. Shall we see what's ahead of us? ]

"[ryn.lowConfidence |T-t |T ]here might not be a cure, yet, but [ryn.lowConfidence |t-t |t ]hat doesn't mean we aren't trying! We came here to cleanse the [ryn.lowConfidence |t- ]temple, so maybe once that's done more research on a cure can be done!" Ryn says, looking between you and Elthara. "Ech. Here to cleanse the temple, but none of you are infected, or showing any signs of it. Something inside me can feel it, sense it. It wants to try and make you. I'm holding it back, And for now I'm quite distracted enough to do so," Leanore replies. It's hard to even come close to looking presentable, naked and stiff with arousal as she is, but she straightens to her full height. "You lot must be Lumians, then? Come to cleanse the infection and us along with it?" "No! We had no idea the [ryn.lowConfidence |t-t |t ]rouble ran this deep! You've been down here for a long time! I'm[ryn.lowConfidence |, um, ] not sure how long, but we're cleansing the temple as a peace offering. There has been too much suffering amongst our people, and it's [ryn.lowConfidence |t-t |t ]ime for that to end," Ryn explains. The mushroom-clad druidess' countenance softens momentarily. "Such idealistic goals. Who are you to make such promises, young one?" she asks, cocking her head to the side. Ryn blushes with slight shame. "[ryn.lowConfidence |S-sorry! I forgot to introduce myself. |My apologies for not introducing myself. ] My name is Etheryn var Ridell, granddaughter of Synneva and Atheldred, and I'm [ryn.crowned |the current queen of the Winter City. |queen regent of the Winter City. ] My high priestess, Elthara,[party.manyCompanions| my friend [companion2.name],] and my [ryn.isLover |beloved champion |dear friend ], [pc.name] have come with me to aid in this effort." "Hmm. Maybe your promises aren't so empty, but still," Lea says, her blind attention shifting to Elthara. "You've been quite silent, priestess. Is there any truth to the other claim being made? Is it possible for... this... to be undone?" She gestures to herself and her friends stuck in the fungal mass. Elthara remains silent for a further moment before speaking up. "I don't know. I'm not going to promise you it would be swift or possible. You seem lucid enough that I would think you're still you, but your minds appear to be intermixed in such a way that I couldn't begin to fathom how separating you would work. What I do know for sure is that I can ensure you pass on peacefully here and now, with no pain, and ensure that your spirits do not remain in this tortured state." Both parties are debating this outcome with some difficulty, but you might be able to sway the decision in either direction. You don't know if they can really be saved, but in the meantime you're sure you can make them feel at home in the Wayfort. They'd fit right in with the kinds of people who end up there, and it'd be a safe place for them to stay until someone finds a way to safely separate them. If not, however, they seem poised to accept Elthara's offer of a peaceful passing. "

rows.original: "Wait! There's no reason for that! I have a place you can stay while you're still stuck this way, and I'm sure we can find a way to safely get you there!" you offer, trying to steer the mood away from the omnipresent pall of death over this place. Leanore turns to you with a skeptical frown, at least until Anisette flips her head back to look up at her. "[pc.HeShe]'s right, Lea! I'm like, so not ready to pass on! Neither is Missy! You can hear her, right?" she says, and you see Emrisse's hands clench into fists as her toes wiggle. "You saved both of us! So what if it's, like, turned out a little weird. I think we should listen to [pc.himHer]." Leanore continues to look conflicted for a few moments as Anisette affectionately bonks her head against her hip and Emrisse happily kicks her feet up and down. Under the weight of such bubbly counterpoints, she can't hope to remain stoic, and sighs deeply before smiling at you. "I suppose I lost sight of what I was truly trying to do. Keep us alive. But what is this 'place' you speak of? Won't it be a hassle having a... monster like us hanging around it? Just thinking about it too hard scares me away," Lea asks, putting a hand to her shroom-covered brow and shaking her head. "I'm sure it wouldn't! I've met and seen things just as weird out there in the Marches. I'm sure you'd all fit right in! [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED |I'm sure you won't be the only one I bring to my wayfort, either! |There's even an awakened plantfolk who I'm sure would love to meet you! ] Even if I don't find physically similar beings, I'm sure I'll find some [silly |degenerate monsterfuckers who wouldn't mind a beauteous abomination such as yourselfs |people who think you three are just as pretty as I think you are ]!" you say, full of excitement at the prospect. "Tee hee. [pc.heShe] called me [silly |booty-us |pretty ], Lea. I wanna go live there!" Nissy offers with another head bump. "I guess that settles it, then. Do finish what you started here, and we'll be waiting here," Leanore says, relenting with a sigh as she gives Anisette a pat on the cheek and Emrisse a pat on the butt.

rows.original:
You say nothing, content to let them decide for themselves.
        
        "Very well. You're right. I can feel that these two's minds are much more muddled than mine. Snippets of sanity get through, but I have no way of knowing how long those will last, nor how long my own will last before the next lapse. If you think yourself capable, I would have you send me off," Leanore says, nodding to Elthara.
        
        The priestess crosses the room, and begins chanting a prayer while reaching out to place one hand on Leanore's forehead and another on Anisette's. As she finishes her prayer, both women sigh, and you see their spirits rise from the growth like wispy ghost-forms. Emrisse is there as well, looking like a normal half-sexed rather than a stockaded ass. She smiles and waves, and then all three hug as they disperse like smoke in the wind. By the time you look back down, their bodies look about the same as any other in the temple.
        
        "It's a shame we never found a way to cure them, but Wraith power isn't really something you can easily study without inviting exactly this kind of problem," Elthara says, shaking her head.
        
        It's best not to dwell on it too much. You can still make this place safe for the current generation of druids.
        
        "You're right. Shall we continue?" 
        
        The sooner you can get this place fully cleansed of fungus, the better.

rows.original: Despite your best efforts, the triple-bodied monster overwhelms your defenses and you collapse to the ground. The fungal mass slithers closer and closer, while Leanore shakes her head to clear her thoughts. "Don't worry, none of you have been infected yet. My stasis spell is perfect, and I'll be sure to keep you all alive till the archdruid finds a way to cleanse the temple," she says. Her words don't make any sense, but you can't gather enough strength to tell her that cleansing the temple is what you're here for. Instead you can do nothing but let your consciousness fade as the soft light of her magic lulls you into deep hibernation. Perhaps you'll be rescued some day when the Lumian elves can afford to mount a rescue, but there's no telling what state you'll be in by the time they arrive. For now, though, your adventure is over. BAD END
rows.translation: 尽管你竭尽全力，但那个三体结构的怪物还是突破了你的防御，你最终倒在了地上。那团真菌不断向你逼近，而莉诺尔则不停地摇头，试图让自己清醒过来。 “别担心，你们所有人目前都还没有被感染。 我的静止法术非常有效，一定能让你们所有人都活下来，直到大德鲁伊找到净化神庙的方法。”她说。她的话根本没有任何意义，但你也没有足够的力气去告诉她，你们来这里的目的其实就是净化神庙。 相反，你只能任由自己的意识逐渐消散，因为她那柔和的魔力将你带入深深的沉睡之中。 或许有一天，当卢米安精灵们有能力组织救援行动时，你会被救出来，但谁也无法预料到他们到达时，你会处于什么样的状态。 不过，目前来说，你的冒险已经结束了。 坏结局
rows.raw: " Despite your best efforts, the triple-bodied monster overwhelms your defenses and you collapse to the ground. The fungal mass slithers closer and closer, while Leanore shakes her head to clear her thoughts. "Don't worry, none of you have been infected yet. My stasis spell is perfect, and I'll be sure to keep you all alive till the archdruid finds a way to cleanse the temple," she says. Her words don't make any sense, but you can't gather enough strength to tell her that cleansing the temple is what you're here for. Instead you can do nothing but let your consciousness fade as the soft light of her magic lulls you into deep hibernation. Perhaps you'll be rescued some day when the Lumian elves can afford to mount a rescue, but there's no telling what state you'll be in by the time they arrive. For now, though, your adventure is over. BAD END "

rows.original:
You decide to investigate the hospital a little closer, perhaps hoping to find some clue that would shed more light on what happened in the temple. After a little searching, your attention returns to the stationed desk by the door with its shelves. Several of the shattered jars still bear legible inscriptions which Ryn gingerly nudges and inspects, scrutinizing the writing in her native tongue.
        
        "Medicines for common ailments. Also, several ancient coins in the box. A dispensary and a hospital, then."
        
        "When the schism happened, many such hospitals in Njorhaalt and beyond were abandoned, the druids taking what they could carry with them," Elthara adds. "It was up to Atheldred and the first valkyries to staff them, a task which arguably taxed them more than battle did — the followers of the Old Wyld had traditionally cared for the health of the boer'alvar people, and even with the goddess' healing powers that loss was greater and more sudden than could have been imagined, especially in the middle of a war.
        
        "To make things worse, many of the common people were afraid or unsure of the new restorative magics — they wanted the traditional remedies and curatives. Thank the gods that the doubt, while understandable, vanished after enough people made full recoveries."
        
        Thanks for the history lesson, but — the skeletons chained to the beds catch your eye again, and you shake your head. Hethia said that the infestation drove its hosts to uncontrollable lusts, didn't it?
        
        Ryn nods. "She did. That would explain why some of them had to be tied down... although it looks like they quickly ran out of chain as the infection spread like wildfire and the sane were soon overrun. How did the saying go, again? 'Physician, heal thyself?' Well, looks like they didn't."
        
        You search the hospital a little longer, but everything that might've been of use has long since decayed. Still, you walk away with a little more understanding of how the druids tried — and failed — to control the incipient fungal infection. To be sure, it was a doomed effort from the start given that anything they threw at it only made it stronger, but they didn't give up hope until the end. Either that, or their anger at the elvenqueen only made them all the more determined to survive...
rows.translation:
你决定更仔细地调查这家医院，或许希望能找到一些线索，从而弄清楚在寺庙里发生了什么。经过一番搜寻，你的注意力被门边那个带有架子的服务台吸引住了。有几个被打碎的罐子上仍然留有清晰的铭文，瑞恩小心翼翼地拨开那些碎片，用她的母语仔细阅读上面的文字。
        
        这些都是治疗常见疾病的药物，盒子里还有几枚古代硬币。另外，这里还有一间药房和一家医院。”

“当分裂事件发生时，尼约哈尔特地区以及其他地方的许多这样的医院都被废弃了，德鲁伊们只带走了他们能携带的东西，”埃尔萨拉补充道。 是否由阿瑟德雷德和最初的那些女武神来负责这些工作，其实是一个相当艰巨的任务——与参与战斗相比，这个任务对她们来说或许更加沉重。因为传统上，‘古老荒野’的追随者们一直负责照顾‘博尔阿尔瓦人’的健康。即便拥有女神的治疗力量，这样的损失依然超出了人们的想象，尤其是在战争期间。
        
        更糟糕的是，许多普通民众对这种新的恢复性魔法既感到恐惧，又缺乏信心——他们仍然更倾向于使用传统的疗法和药物。所幸，当有足够多的人通过这种新魔法成功康复后，人们的疑虑也就自然而然地消散了。真是多亏了诸神。
        
        多谢你讲的这段历史，不过——那些被锁在床上的骷髅又吸引了你的注意，你摇了摇头。赫希娅说过，这种感染会让人陷入无法控制的欲望之中，对吧？”

瑞恩点了点头：“没错。这就解释了为什么有些人必须被绑起来……不过看起来，随着感染像野火一样迅速蔓延，理智的人很快就被夺走了控制力，链子也很快就不够用了。那句古话是怎么说的来着？‘医者，先治己病。’嗯，看来他们并没有做到这一点。
        
        你在医院里继续搜寻了一阵，但所有可能有用的事物早已腐烂殆尽。不过，这次搜寻还是让你对德鲁伊们如何尝试——以及最终如何失败——去控制那种初期出现的真菌感染有了更多的了解。事实上，从一开始，他们的努力就注定是徒劳的，因为他们采取的任何措施反而让这种感染变得更加严重。但直到最后，他们都没有放弃希望。或者说，正是对精灵女王的愤怒让他们更加坚定了生存的决心……

rows.original: The apothecary's workstation is in complete ruin, but perhaps the bound box by its side might have preserved something of value, tightly-bound as it is. Its bronze bandings glint dully in the sickly amber light, and you're faced with an unorthodox locking mechanism. [party.oneComp viviane cait |"Well, isn't this cute, a wordlock chest," Viviane says. "You hardly see these things nowadays. Unsurprising, for how old they must be. At least they're far more effective in this day and age — if literacy was bad back then, imagine what it must be like now." Well, can she do anything about the lock? Viv huffs a little. "I'm an enchantress, not a tinker, dear — this thing is completely mundane. Sure, I'd be able to figure out the mechanism given enough time, but that's something we don't have an excess of." You meant the riddle, not taking apart the lock. "Oh. That should be simple enough for you to figure out on your own." |"Father used to tell Calla and I about these," Cait pipes up as she studies the chest. "They're wordlock chests, a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly |players |servants ]. Each combination lock was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was a riddle was often posed on the chest itself." |"Oh, that's a nice one," Elthara says from over your shoulder. "We have a few wordlock chests in the palace storerooms, dating from before the Godswar — I think they were gifted by the old empire. Not that they ever saw any practical use, but those were more decadent days, so the tales tell." ] Right. [pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |You've come across wordlock chests in your past — they were a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly |players |servants ]. Each of these combination locks was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was, a riddle was often posed on the chest itself. If you could solve it and thereby rotate the tumblers into the right position, the chest would unlock and allow you to claim its contents. That the druids would have such a thing makes complete sense; they would have had the goods and means to trade across the River Ridell prior to the imperial collapse. And who better to reap the benefits of Belharan trade than the producers of trade goods? |Hmm, what can this all mean? It certainly seems like a thoroughly roundabout way to secure a container, but at least it isn't likely to be trapped in the bargain. You test the mechanism a few times, turn the tumblers, but nothing happens. ] You give the chest a thump, and it looks tightly sealed enough that its contents may have been isolated from the spreading rot that's consumed the druidic temple. Will you have a go at opening it?
rows.translation: 药剂师的工作台已经毁坏得不成样子，但放在它旁边的那个封好的箱子或许还保存着一些有价值的东西，因为箱子被紧紧地封住了。它的青铜绑带在那种昏暗的琥珀色轻型线中黯淡地闪烁着，而你面对的，是一种非常不寻常的锁闭装置。 [party.oneComp viviane cait |哇，这个单词锁箱子真是太可爱了，”薇薇安说道，“现在这种东西已经很少见了。也难怪，毕竟它们已经存在很久了。不过在现在这个时代，它们还是非常实用的——如果过去的识字率就已经很低的话，那现在的情况该有多糟糕啊。那么，她能对这把锁做些什么吗？ 薇芙轻轻哼了一声：“我可是女巫，又不是修理工，亲爱的——这个锁完全就是普通的普通物品。当然，如果给我足够的时间，我肯定能弄明白它的构造，但问题是，我们并没有那么多时间。你是说那个谜语，而不是要拆开锁吧。 “哦，原来如此。 那个 应该足够简单，让你自己就能弄明白。 |父亲以前经常给我们讲这些，”凯特一边研究着那个箱子一边说道，“这些是密码锁箱子，是老贝拉兰贵族们最喜欢的物品，用来保护贵重物品免受不识字之人的侵害。 [silly |玩家们 |仆从们 ]每个密码锁都需要输入正确的密码才能打开，而为了帮助主人记住密码，人们通常会在箱子本身上设置一个谜语来帮助主人回忆密码。 |哦，这个真不错，”埃尔萨拉从你身后说道，“我们在宫殿的储藏室里还有几个字锁箱，那些都是神战之前的遗物——我想它们是老帝国赠送的。虽然那些箱子从来都没有被真正使用过，但在那个时代，人们确实更注重这些繁琐的仪式和装饰，所以才会有这样的传说。 ] 好的。 [pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |你之前肯定遇到过这种“字锁箱”——它们曾是贝尔哈兰老贵族们的最爱，用来保护贵重物品，防止那些不识字的人偷走它们。 [silly |玩家们 |仆从们 ]这些组合锁每一把都需要输入密码才能打开，为了帮助主人记住密码，人们通常会在箱子上设置谜语。如果你能够解开这个谜语，将锁芯旋转到正确的位置，箱子就会打开，让你取走里面的物品。 德鲁伊们拥有这样的能力是完全合理的；在帝国崩溃之前，他们就已经具备了在里德尔河两岸进行贸易的能力和条件。而谁最有可能从贝尔哈兰的贸易中获益呢？当然是那些从事贸易商品生产的人士啊。 |嗯，这一切到底意味着什么呢？这种方式看起来确实挺迂回的，但至少不会让人陷入什么麻烦之中。你试了几次这个装置，转动了那些旋钮，但什么反应也没有发生。 ] 你敲了敲那个箱子，发现它的密封程度似乎相当高，里面的东西应该被牢牢地保护着。 可以 它们已经被隔离起来，没有受到那股正在侵蚀德鲁伊神庙的腐朽力量的影响。你愿意尝试打开它吗？

rows.original: Offered by many Taken by few Yet can be invaluable
rows.translation: 许多人提供，却只有少数人选择接受；然而，它的价值却可能无比巨大。
rows.raw: "Offered by many\nTaken by few\nYet can be invaluable"

rows.original: This isn't worth the trouble. Just let it be.
rows.translation: 这不值得费这个劲。就让它保持原样吧。
rows.raw: "This isn't worth the trouble. Just let it be."

rows.original: Something within the chest clicks, followed by a loud thump as the mechanisms within disengage. Instinctively, you step back, fearing a trap, but your fears are soon allayed as the spring-loaded lid pops open, throwing up a small puff of dust and spores as it reveals the chest's contents. "Wyldsap. Of course," Elthara muses, reaching down to palm the vials. "Unsurprising that something so precious would be sealed away this securely — you would seal away the blood of the being you worshipped quite well, wouldn't you?" Is it you, or does the priestess sound a little melancholy? "It's me," she replies with a small, sad smile. "I'm just thinking of the sacrifices the goddess has made for our sake over the two centuries of patronage for our people, that's all. I have the feeling that we might have need of it before we're done here." Hm. You take the vials from Elthara and turn them over in your hands — the sealing wax still holds, and the contents still look pure enough. There's a resemblance to the stinking amber that oozes continually from the walls, to be sure, but there's also a sense of wholesomeness to the roiling liquid isolated in glass that isn't present in the corrupted vileness that exudes from the mortar. Gained 2x wyldsap. [party.has viviane |"Well, if you don't mind, I think I'll take this as well," Viv says with a smile as she scoops up the small chest. "The one thing in this wreck that looks clean enough to take home as a souvenir. I'm sure taking apart the mechanism will be a suitable diversion from my usual studies on long nights." ] That seems to be that, then. Stowing away the vials amongst your possessions, you make to be on your way.
rows.translation: 箱子里的某个部件突然发出咔嗒声，随后随着内部机械装置的松动，传来一声沉重的撞击声。你本能地后退了一步，担心这是个陷阱，但很快你的担忧就消散了——弹簧装置驱动的盖子猛地弹开，顿时扬起了一阵灰尘和孢子，露出了箱子里的物品。 Wildsap。当然，”埃尔萨拉沉思道，伸手部取过了那些小瓶子。“这种珍贵的东西被如此严密地保管起来，也并不奇怪——对于你所崇拜的生物的血液，你肯定会采取最妥善的保管方式，对吧？是你在说话，还是那位女祭司的声音听起来有点忧郁呢？” “是我，”她带着一丝悲伤的微笑回答道，“我只是在想，在这两百年来，女神为了我们的族群所做出的牺牲罢了。 我有种感觉，我们在完成这里的工作之前，可能会需要用到它。 嗯。你拿起从艾尔塔拉那里得到的那些小瓶子，在手部中仔细观察——封蜡依然完好无损，里面的物质看起来也依然足够纯净。 确实，它与那种不断从墙壁中渗出的恶臭琥珀有着几分相似之处，但那种被封闭在玻璃容器中的翻滚液体所散发出的那种纯粹感，却是从那些从砂浆中渗出的腐朽邪恶之中所感受不到的。 获得了双倍的野生汁液。 [party.has viviane |嗯，如果你们不介意的话，我想我也把这个拿走吧。”薇薇微笑着说道，同时拿起了那个小箱子。“在这个破旧的东西里，只有这个看起来足够干净，可以带回家当纪念品。我相信拆开它的机械结构，一定会让我在漫长的夜晚里暂时忘掉平时的学习任务。 ] 那就这样吧。你把那些小瓶子藏在随身携带的物品中，然后出发吧。

rows.original: You rub your temples and sigh. The riddle's right there in front of you, but its words might as well have been unscalable walls. Whatever's in the chest is going to have to stay inside until you figure this out.
rows.translation: 你揉了揉太阳穴，叹了口气。这个谜题就摆在你的眼前，但它的内容简直就像一堵高不可攀的墙。直到你解开这个谜题，箱子里的东西才会被取出。
rows.raw: "\n    You rub your temples and sigh. The riddle's right there in front of you, but its words might as well have been unscalable walls. Whatever's in the chest is going to have to stay inside until you figure this out.\n    "

rows.original: [flags.XADARON_NODULES |When you return to the foot of the stairs, the pustulent roots are still there — of course they are. What, if anything, are you going to do about them? |As you draw close to the stairwell, a sudden change comes over the exposed roots as they sense your approach: tiles crack off the staircase as the amber nodules on the roots bulge dangerously, reminding you of boils or blisters ready to burst at the slightest provocation. At least the roots haven't become completely ambulatory and started reaching for you, but at the same time, that stuff in the thin root nodules looks absolutely vile and nasty — there's no doubt that you don't want any of that stuff on you. [party.randComp azyrran quintillus brint brienne |"So much in here reminds me of my own hive's corruption," Azyrran says with a sigh, massaging her brow. "If anything, it's more disgusting, and your people were no less robbed of their sensibilities than mine were. My commiserations, Ryn, Elthara — seeing this must be hard on you." |Quin whistles at the sight and shakes his head. "Oh my. Now that's a field of traps that even I wouldn't want to mess with unless I had to. Sure, I could probably do it, but the risk's great enough that there's no point in chancing it." Those are some words, coming from him. The bunny-man snickers and elbows you. "Well then, what's your plan for getting us across? rows.original:
You test the weight of the jug of naphtha in your hands. Plants burn, don't they? Well, it's worth a go — you stuff a bit of tinder into the neck, set it alight, and hurl the naphtha at the nearest undulating root.
        
        The result is underwhelming, to say the least. The jug indeed shatters and the spreading mineral oil bursts into flame, but the nearest two pustules pop with wet squelches and shower the nascent fire with sticky pus-like sap, dousing the flames before it has any chance to get started. Naphtha might be hard to douse with water, but whatever's in this sap quickly retards any inherent flammability in the wood. At least it's not a complete waste — you now know that trying to burn these isn't going to do you much good.
        
        That being said, you're still out a jug of concentrated mineral oil. What are you doing to do next?
rows.translation:
你将那罐煤油的重量握在手部中。植物都是会燃烧的，对吧？那么，不妨试一试——在罐子的颈部塞入一些引火物，点燃它，然后将整罐煤油扔向最近的那株弯曲生长的植物。
        
        至少可以说，结果并不令人满意。那个罐子确实碎了，流淌出来的矿物油也燃烧了起来，但最靠近火源的两个“脓包”破裂了，渗出的黏稠脓液将刚刚燃起的火焰扑灭了，使得火焰根本没有机会继续蔓延。 虽然用水很难扑灭石脑油的火焰，但这种汁液中的成分能够迅速抑制木材本身的易燃性。至少这些材料并没有完全被浪费——你现在应该知道，试图燃烧它们是根本不会有什么效果的。
        
        话虽如此，你还是缺少一罐浓缩矿物油啊。接下来你打算怎么做呢？

rows.original:
The leananstone tingles in your hand as you palm it — given how unstable the pustulent root nodules look, fit to burst at the slightest provocation, you might be able to set them off all at once harmlessly with some bait, the make a run for it while they're still regenerating. No way to know for sure without giving it a go, you guess...
        
        You prime the charged stone, feeling the dormant storm energies stored within the enchantment awaken, then then toss it into the seething mass of amber pustules. Moments pass by as you and your party take cover behind a chunk of fallen debris, waiting for the inevitable...
        
        ...Which comes soon enough. A flash of lightning and roar of thunder light up the ruined hallway with blinding light for the blink of an eye, then gobs of stinking sap come flying over your head in a splattering shower. The rubble shields you from the worst of the mess, but it's still far from a pleasant experience.
        
        When the commotion's died down, you chance peeking out from behind your shelter — the explosion's set off the vile growths on the roots, popping them like blisters and sending their contents oozing down the staircase in a disgusting waterfall. 
        
        There's no time to lose — even now, the pustiles are starting to refill, new sections of the roots bulging and filling with uncontrolled growth. You grab your companions and double-time it up the stairs, Elthara bringing up the rear; it's a battle between making it through while your opening lasts and not slipping on the slick, pus-like sap cascading down the ruined stairs. You make it, if barely — Elthara stumbles once or twice, unused to this kind of hustle, but you catch her in time and shepherd everyone to the upper landing before the roots have time to regrow.
        
        ...What awaits you on the upper landing, one wonders?
rows.translation:
当你握住那块瘦石时，它能让你感到一阵刺痛——考虑到那些脓包状的根瘤看起来如此不稳定，稍有外力就可能使它们破裂，或许你可以用一些诱饵让它们同时破裂，这样在它们还在恢复的时候就赶紧逃跑。不过，不试一试的话，当然也无法确定到底会不会成功……
        
        你将那块充满能量的石头握在手中，感受到其中蕴藏的沉睡风暴能量正在苏醒，随后将其抛进了那团翻腾着琥珀色脓疱的混乱之中。片刻之后，你和你的队友躲在一块倒下的残骸后面，等待着那不可避免的时刻……
        
        ……而这确实发生得很快。一道闪电划过，雷声轰鸣，刹那间，废墟中的走廊被刺目的轻型芒照亮；紧接着，一大股恶臭的树液从头顶飞溅而下。虽然碎石能够遮挡部分伤害，但这种体验仍然远称不上愉快。
        
        当喧闹声渐渐平息后，你冒险从掩体后面探出头来——那场爆炸引发了那些生长在植物根部的邪恶生物，它们像水泡一样爆裂开来，里面的物质顺着楼梯流淌下来，形成一股令人作呕的“瀑布”。 
        
        没有时间可以浪费了——即便现在，那些脓疱已经开始重新形成，根部的新部分也在不受控制地生长、膨胀。你迅速拉上同伴，加快脚步跑上楼梯，而艾尔塔拉则走在最后；此刻，你们必须在机会还在的时候尽快到达目的地，同时还要小心那些从破损的楼梯上流淌下来的黏稠脓液，以免滑倒。 你勉强成功了——埃尔萨拉因为不习惯这种匆忙的行动，踉跄了一两次，但你还及时扶住了她，带着所有人赶在那些根系重新生长之前到达了上层平台。
        
        …人们不禁会想知道，在那层楼上等待着你的会是什么……

rows.original: You consider the ley-crystal grenade in your possessions. Given its power, it's certain to not just set off the pustulent nodules, but also blast apart the roots and perhaps the entire staircase as well, given how torn up the latter already is. Not that it's necessarily a bad thing given the current situation, though... Well, nothing for it. You prime the little ball of raw magical power, feeling it vibrate in your hands as it grows steadily more unstable, then toss it into the seething mass of amber pustules. Moments pass by as you and your party take cover behind a chunk of fallen debris, waiting for the inevitable... ...Which comes soon enough. A deafening roar reverberates down the hallway as the air shudders, and gobs of stinking sap come flying over your head in a splattering shower. The rubble shields you from the worst of the mess, but it's still far from a pleasant experience. When the commotion's died down enough, you chance peeking out from behind your shelter — not just the nodules have been destroyed, but the roots themselves have been reduced to charred ash by the force of the blase, a smoking crater in the staircase marking the spot your grenade landed. While the roots themselves are growing back, they're doing so at a slow enough pace that you can comfortably gather your companions and make it to the top of the stairs without a hitch. ...What awaits you on the upper landing, one wonders?
rows.translation: 你看着自己手部中的那颗能量水晶手部雷。考虑到它的威力，它不仅肯定能引爆那些脓包状的肿块，甚至可能会把那些已经严重损坏的楼梯彻底炸毁。当然，也不一定非得 糟糕 考虑到当前的情况，虽然如此…… 好吧，没什么别的办法了。你将那颗蕴含原始魔力的小球凝聚起来，感受它在手部中不断振动，同时逐渐变得不稳定，然后将其扔进那团翻腾着、布满琥珀色脓疱的混乱之中。 时间一分一秒地流逝，你和你的队友们躲在一块倒下的残骸后面，等待着那不可避免的事情发生…… 而那件事很快就到来了。一阵震耳欲聋的巨响在走廊中回荡，空气都在震动，大量散发着恶臭的树液从你们头顶上飞溅下来。 这些碎石虽然能保护你免受最严重的破坏，但这种体验仍然远称不上愉快。 当周围的喧闹声逐渐平息后，你冒险从掩体后面探出头来——不仅那些结节已经被摧毁，就连树根也被那股巨大的能量烧成了焦灰，楼梯上那个冒着烟的坑洞，正是你的手部榴弹落下的地方。 虽然这些植物的根系正在重新生长，但它们的生长速度相当缓慢，因此你完全有足够的时间召集你的同伴，顺利地到达楼梯的顶端。 ……那么，在楼梯的上层平台，等待着你的是什么呢？人们不禁会这样想。

rows.original:
An idea strikes you. If these roots intend to stop you by spraying sticky, vile sap all over the stairs, why not just freeze it solid? You've got Brint[var0
            |, you've got Ryn, and most of all, you've got yourself. T
            | and Ryn with you, t
        ]his should be a breeze. Well, at the very least these roots can't spew their stinking, corrupted sap all over you if it's all frozen solid, right?
        
        [var1
            |How convenient it is, then, that Brint's currently in his winter knight armor. You gather both him and Ryn over to explain your plan, and he nods appreciatively.
            |Brint's still got his winter knight armor with him, right?
            
            "Got it right here," he replies, patting his belongings. "You've got a plan, right? You're good at these things."
            
            Indeed. If he wouldn't mind getting into his gear? Once he's ready, you'll explain what you have in mind to both him and Ryn.
            
            "Sure thing. Give me a moment to change my clothes, and I'll be with you."
            
            Brint's gotten really used to the armor he claimed up in the rift — despite it being heavy armor, he's donned it with surprising speed, and explain your plan to both him and Ryn while he's fastening his straps.
        ]
        
        "Makes sense," Brint says after hearing you out. "The roots can't regrow if we freeze the blisters solid, right?"
        
        If nothing else, them bursting will be a lot less messy if the liquid isn't able to flow. And what about Ryn? Does she know what she needs to do?
        
        "I just fill in spots which Brint misses, right?"
        
        Yes. You'll focus on the actual wood, clearing a path up the stairs inasmuch as that's possible[var0
            |; your main job here will be to flash-freeze any sap that makes it past either of them and is heading your way
        ]. Now then, is everyone ready?
        
        Brint and Ryn don't say anything, but the former stomps up to the nearest bloated pustule, watching it pulse and undulate on the woody root it's attached to. Taking a deep breath, he lets it all out in a wintery bellow that quickly layers a coat of frost on his target. The root nodule pops, but the flow is oozing and sluggish, and none of the revolting sap manages to get onto Brint before being frozen solid and tinkling onto the ruined marble floor.
        
        "It's working!" Ryn shouts as she nocks an icy arrow and looses it at a straining pustule before it manages to pop. "The sap, it isn't able to flow to refill the roots!"
        
        Now's your chance! Leading the charge[var0
            | with frost streaming from your fingers, you zap the disgusting overgrown roots left and right judiciously, icing them over while still conserving as much of your magic as you can
            |, you duck and weave left and right, using the openings created by Brint and Ryn to lead your party through the overgrown tangle
        ]. As if realizing your intent, several pustules near the top of the stairs pop before you're in range, sending a cascade of oozing sap down the stairs, but that gets frozen solid before it can reach your party. Without the ability to regenerate, the frozen roots aren't ambulatory enough to seriously hinder your advance, clearly having gone all-in on this strategy... which you've just surmounted.
        
        Feels good, doesn't it?
        
        Elthara's the last to make it up to the top landing, the priestess bringing up the rear. The first of the oozing roots are already starting to thaw, but you're in the clear. Now, time to see what you've just landed yourself into...

            |你在这里的主要任务就是阻止任何试图绕过它们并朝你这边移动的汁液通过。
        ]那么，大家都准备好了吗？

            | 当寒霜从你的指尖流淌下来时，你小心翼翼地砍掉那些令人作呕的、过度生长的根茎，同时尽量节省自己的魔力。
            |你左右闪避，利用布林特和莱恩制造的空隙，引导你的队伍穿过那些茂密的灌木丛。
        ]仿佛意识到了你的意图，在你靠近之前，楼梯顶部的几颗脓包突然破裂，渗出的汁液顺着楼梯流了下来，但在那些汁液到达你的队伍之前，就已经凝固成了固体。由于这些被冻住的根系无法再生，它们根本无法阻碍你的前进，显然，对方是倾尽全力采取了这种策略的。…而这些你刚刚都成功克服了。

rows.original:
You've weighed all your options and this looks like the best way forward. Not that it's a high bar to clear, but given the circumstances you've got to work with the tools at hand. Quickly, you gather your companions and sketch out a brief plan: Ryn has her iceburst arrow, [var0
            |and you've frost spells of your own equipped
            |and that packs a decent punch when it comes to being chilly
        ]. There're far too many sap-filled nodules along your path up the stairs for you to be able to suppress them all, but at least one can stem the worst of the flow, right?
        
        No one looks happy about the prospect of being showered in thick, foul-smelling fluid, but neither does anyone have a better suggestion. That, and you're all going to need a long bath after you're out of here, anyway...
        
        Best way to lead is by example. Heading off the charge with [var0
            |frost streaming from your fingers, you zap the disgusting overgrown roots left and right judiciously, icing them over while still conserving as much of your magic as you can
            |[pc.weapon] raised as if to shield you from the worst the corrupted roots can do, you duck and weave left and right, hacking away at the thick, spongy wood as you lead your party through the overgrown tangle
        ]. No sooner have you entered their range do the nearest sap-bloated nodules pop like particularly vile boils, spewing their contents forth in a shower of viscous amber liquid. You're ready for it, though, and dodge aside while Ryn nocks and looses an icy arrow at the source. It doesn't quite manage to freeze all of the sap, but at least the explosion isn't as violent as it ought to have been, and the pustule is slower to regenerate than you previously saw.
        
        No time to waste. Clambering over roots and trying not to slip on the slick steps, you forge your way upward, continuing to open the way for your companions. As if realizing your intent, several pustules near the top of the stairs pop before you're in range, sending a cascade of oozing sap down the stairs; that forces you to slow down enough for the roots to regenerate for a second shower.
        
        No, the corrupted sap can't hurt you directly or infest you like the druids would up being, but struggling through this thick muck of sap and spores is draining, to put it lightly. Just having it on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] makes your skin crawl, and this turbulent state of mind is far from conducive to keeping the exhaustion from your mind. If the roots had been ambulatory enough to actively oppose your climb in the bargain, you might not have been able to keep your balance on the stairs...
        
        But you make it, even if you can smell and taste nothing but rotting sap, and feel sticky from head to toe. Elthara brings up the rear, and you help the struggling priestess with the last stretch before taking stock of everyone. All present and accounted for, if no less miserable than you are — a small mercy, then.
        
        Now, time to see what you've just landed yourself into...
rows.translation:
你已经仔细考虑了所有可行的选择，而这个方案看起来确实是前进的最佳途径。虽然要实现这个目标并非易事，但考虑到当前的情况，你只能利用手头现有的资源来努力。你迅速召集了同伴，简要制定了一个计划：瑞恩可以使用她的冰爆箭 [var0
            |而且你自己也掌握了冰冻系法术。
            |而在寒冷的天气里，这种效果确实相当显著。
        ]在你们上楼梯的过程中，沿途会有太多充满汁液的结节，你们根本不可能全部抑制住它们，但至少有一个结节能够阻止最严重的液体流动，对吧？

没有人会喜欢被大量浓稠且散发着恶臭的液体泼洒在身上，但也没有人能提出更好的解决办法。而且，无论如何，等你们离开这里后，都得好好洗个澡……

最好的领导方式就是以身作则。率先行动起来吧 [var0
            |你的手指上结着冰霜，你小心翼翼地砍掉那些令人作呕的、过度生长的根茎，同时尽量节省自己的魔力。
            |[pc.weapon] 这些枝条仿佛被特意伸出来，用来保护你们免受那些腐烂的树根可能造成的伤害。你们左右闪避，不断砍伐那些粗壮而松软的树枝，带领着队伍穿过这片茂密的灌木丛。
        ]你刚一进入它们的攻击范围，那些靠近你的、充满汁液的肿块就像极其恶心的脓包一样突然破裂，将黏稠的琥珀色液体喷溅出来。不过你早已做好了准备，迅速躲开了，而瑞恩也立刻射出一支冰冷的箭，直击那些肿块的源头。 这种爆炸虽然没能完全冻结所有的树液，但至少其破坏力并没有达到预期的程度；而且那些脓包再生的速度也比之前慢了很多。

没有时间可以浪费。你爬过那些树根，努力避免在湿滑的台阶上滑倒，继续向上攀登，同时为你的同伴开辟前进的道路。 仿佛意识到了你的意图，在你还未靠近之前，楼梯顶部的几颗脓包突然破裂，渗出的汁液顺着楼梯流了下来；这迫使你不得不放慢速度，让那些根系有时间重新生长，以便再次释放这些汁液。
        
        不，这种腐烂的树液并不会直接伤害你，也不会像德鲁伊们所说的那样让你受到感染，但要想在这种由树液和孢子构成的浓稠粘液中艰难前行，说实话，确实非常耗费体力。只要这些东西沾在你的身上 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] 这种感觉会让人浑身不自在，而这种烦躁不安的心态显然无助于缓解疲劳。如果那些植物根系足够活跃，能够主动阻碍你的攀爬，那你可能就无法在楼梯上保持平衡了。但是你还是成功了，即使你闻到和尝到的只有腐烂的汁液，全身也黏糊糊的。埃尔萨拉落在最后，你在帮助那位处境艰难的女祭司度过最后一段艰难路程后，才检查了一下大家的状况。 在场的所有人都到齐了，而且他们的处境应该都不比你更糟——这样还算有点安慰吧。

那么，现在该看看你把自己卷入了什么样的麻烦中了……
rows.raw:
"
        You've weighed all your options and this looks like the best way forward. Not that it's a high bar to clear, but given the circumstances you've got to work with the tools at hand. Quickly, you gather your companions and sketch out a brief plan: Ryn has her iceburst arrow, [var0
            |and you've frost spells of your own equipped
            |and that packs a decent punch when it comes to being chilly
        ]. There're far too many sap-filled nodules along your path up the stairs for you to be able to suppress them all, but at least one can stem the worst of the flow, right?
        
        No one looks happy about the prospect of being showered in thick, foul-smelling fluid, but neither does anyone have a better suggestion. That, and you're all going to need a long bath after you're out of here, anyway...
        
        Best way to lead is by example. Heading off the charge with [var0
            |frost streaming from your fingers, you zap the disgusting overgrown roots left and right judiciously, icing them over while still conserving as much of your magic as you can
            |[pc.weapon] raised as if to shield you from the worst the corrupted roots can do, you duck and weave left and right, hacking away at the thick, spongy wood as you lead your party through the overgrown tangle
        ]. No sooner have you entered their range do the nearest sap-bloated nodules pop like particularly vile boils, spewing their contents forth in a shower of viscous amber liquid. You're ready for it, though, and dodge aside while Ryn nocks and looses an icy arrow at the source. It doesn't quite manage to freeze all of the sap, but at least the explosion isn't as violent as it ought to have been, and the pustule is slower to regenerate than you previously saw.
        
        No time to waste. Clambering over roots and trying not to slip on the slick steps, you forge your way upward, continuing to open the way for your companions. As if realizing your intent, several pustules near the top of the stairs pop before you're in range, sending a cascade of oozing sap down the stairs; that forces you to slow down enough for the roots to regenerate for a second shower.
        
        No, the corrupted sap can't hurt you directly or infest you like the druids would up being, but struggling through this thick muck of sap and spores is draining, to put it lightly. Just having it on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] makes your skin crawl, and this turbulent state of mind is far from conducive to keeping the exhaustion from your mind. If the roots had been ambulatory enough to actively oppose your climb in the bargain, you might not have been able to keep your balance on the stairs...
        
        But you make it, even if you can smell and taste nothing but rotting sap, and feel sticky from head to toe. Elthara brings up the rear, and you help the struggling priestess with the last stretch before taking stock of everyone. All present and accounted for, if no less miserable than you are — a small mercy, then.
        
        Now, time to see what you've just landed yourself into...
        "

rows.original: Force your way past the pustule-laden roots. You don't think they'll be able to stop you, but they will certainly make your day miserable.
rows.translation: 强行穿过那些长满脓包的根部吧……你觉得它们应该挡不住你吧？ 停止 你，但他们肯定会让你的一天变得糟透了。
rows.raw: "Force your way past the pustule-laden roots. You don't think they'll be able to stop you, but they will certainly make your day miserable."

rows.original: You're not sure you want to commit yourself to this particular avenue of ingress — or egress — just yet. You remember seeing another way around back at the junction; maybe approaching the problem from another direction will present you with more palatable options. Of course, depending on who and what you have on you at the moment, said options could be worse, but that just means you can just return here, right? The stairs aren't going anywhere...
rows.translation: 你还不确定是否真的想选择这条路来进入或离开。你记得在那个岔路口看到过另一条路；或许从另一个方向来解决这个问题，会给你带来更多可行的选择。当然，这也取决于你现在身边有谁、有什么，这些选择可能会变得更糟，但那也只是意味着你可以随时回到这里，对吧？这些楼梯总不会通向别的地方……
rows.raw: "\n        You're not sure you want to commit yourself to this particular avenue of ingress — or egress — just yet. You remember seeing another way around back at the junction; maybe approaching the problem from another direction will present you with more palatable options. Of course, depending on who and what you have on you at the moment, said options could be worse, but that just means you can just return here, right? The stairs aren't going anywhere...\n        "

rows.original: Fall back and reconsider your options.
rows.translation: 退一步，重新考虑你的选择吧。

rows.original: [flags.XADARON_TENTACLES |You stop at the foot of the stairs once more, the limp fungal tentacles rousing themselves to readiness as they sense your approach. How do you plan to get past them without being harassed? |No sooner have you approached the staircase up that the long threads of fungus that sprout from the walls and floor come to life, waving agitatedly in your direction. Each individual fungal thread is thin and fragile, but they twine together to form thick braids with the consistency of corded rope. While you're out of reach of the fungal tentacles for now, there's no way for you to climb the staircase without entering their territory — and the barbs on the fungal threads' lengths make it clear that they mean business. [party.randComp cait kiyoko atugia |Cait takes one look at the fields of waving fungal tentacles and sighs. "I don't know why, [pc.name], but looking at these reminds me of some of the more lurid fantasies that the temple-goers would ask for the sacred harlots to act out." Something to do with long, thin, flexible and thoroughly alien appendages? Another sigh. "Yes.I'm sorry for being a downer, [pc.name], but this place is doing things to all of us even if we aren't turning into big mushrooms or something. You get it, right? I just want to go home and have a long bath at this point. Not home as in the Frost Hound or anywhere, you get it, but home home." ...Those are strong words coming from a girl who's crossed oceans and mountains to see the world. "I know!" Cait slaps the side of her head. "It's taken me this long to realize it, but we can't stay in here too long. We're all becoming sad!" She is, at any rate. But chin up — you must be almost out if the temple itself is trying to stop you in so direct a fashion. |"Hmm." [kiyoko.married |Your fox-wife |Kiyoko ] peers at the golden threads of fungus from a distance. "Back home, we have mushrooms not too unlike these. Much smaller and tamer, of course, and delicious when stir-fried or put into a hot pot... why do I feel a sudden sense of nostalgic melancholy coming over me?" It is strange that she would start having such thoughts given the current situation. [kiyoko.married |Your fox-wife |Kiyoko ] half-closes her eyes. "Is that not the case? The sense of melancholy only intensifies, beloved; it should be clear to anyone trained to be cognizant of one's mental state. Well, there is that — if the living force behind this ruin is resorting to such measures to dissuade us from moving forward, then it must be running out of options." You're not so sure about the running out of options bit, but you agree that things are likely to be coming to a head soon. You can feel it. Something in the atmosphere here is meddling with your emotions, trying to make you sad, for lack of a better term — and in all likelihood, you don't appreciate the act. |While you're busy looking over the fields of undulating fungal tentacles and wondering if there's a clear path through them that nevertheless remains out of their reach, your attention's drawn to a heavy sigh. Atugia's found a chunk of marble to sit on and laid down her [atugia.weapon] by her side, looking a little glum. "Hey, [pc.name]. You feeling sad all of a sudden?" You concentrate a moment, but don't think so — or if you are, you're not aware of it. "Think this place's doing something to us, even if you can't feel it. Me, I'm getting that sense... don't know if there's a word for it, but that sense that it's going to be a shut-in day, right? Like when Carmen used to do on some days when she'd just draw the drapes on all the windows and me, Severine and her would get around the fire and have tea with biscuits. Well, Severine didn't eat, but still liked the fire. Like it was one of these sad days, which makes no sense 'cause we're stuck underground with our lives in danger. Ain't no sense that I should be feeling this way, and just look at Ryn. She's fit to cry any moment now." ...All right, take a deep breath, and focus. You don't feel sad like Atugia says she is, but there's the sense that that things are likely to be coming to a head soon; you can feel it. Something in the atmosphere here is meddling with your emotions, and you don't appreciate it. ] Before everything else, though, you have to get up these stairs without being overly harassed by these very unfriendly fungal threads and their barbs. Any ideas? ]
rows.translation: [flags.XADARON_TENTACLES |你再次停在楼梯脚下，那些软弱无力的真菌触手在感知到你的接近后，立刻开始活动起来，准备迎接你的到来。你打算如何避开它们，而不受到它们的骚扰呢？ |你刚走到那段楼梯前，那些从墙壁和地板上生长出来的长菌丝就立刻活了过来，它们剧烈地摇摆着，朝着你的方向伸展。每一根菌丝都细长而脆弱，但它们相互缠绕在一起，形成了质地如同绳索般的粗壮菌丛。 虽然你现在还躲过了那些真菌触手的攻击范围，但如果你想爬上楼梯，就必须进入它们的领地——而那些真菌触丝上的倒钩清楚地表明，它们是来认真履行“职责”的。 [party.randComp cait kiyoko atugia |凯特看了一眼那些摇摆着菌类触手的田野，叹了口气：“我不知道为什么 [pc.name]但这些让我想起那些去寺庙的人会要求那些神圣的妓女表演的一些极其荒诞的幻想…… 是不是和那些细长、柔软、完全属于外星生物的附肢有关呢？ 又叹了口气：“是啊，抱歉让你们感到沮丧 [pc.name]不过，这个地方正在对我们所有人产生影响，即使我们并没有变成什么巨大的蘑菇之类的东西。你明白我的意思吧？我现在真的只想回家，好好泡个澡。不是指回到霜猎犬号上，也不是别的什么地方，你懂我的意思的。 家 家。” ……这些话出自一个跨越了海洋与山脉去见识世界的女孩之口，实在令人印象深刻。 “我知道！”凯特拍了拍自己的脑袋，“虽然我花了这么长时间才意识到这一点，但我们不能在这里待太久。我们都会变得越来越伤心的！ 她 无论如何都是这样。但是，振作起来吧——如果连你的太阳穴都在以如此直接的方式阻止你，那你肯定已经差不多成功了。 |嗯。 [kiyoko.married |你的狐狸妻子 |清子 ] 她远远地注视着那些金黄色的菌丝。“在家里，我们也有和这些差不多的蘑菇。当然，它们要小得多，也温顺一些，但炒了或者用来煲汤的话，味道还是很美味的……为什么我突然会感到一阵怀旧的忧郁呢？” 在这种情况下，她为什么会产生这样的想法，实在有些奇怪。 [kiyoko.married |你的狐狸妻子 |清子 ] 她半闭着眼睛说道：“难道不是这样吗？这种忧郁感只会越来越强烈，亲爱的；对于任何善于观察自己心理状态的人来说，这一点都应该很清楚。嗯，有一点是可以肯定的——如果造成这一切的势力正在采取这样的手段来阻止我们继续前进，那么它肯定已经没有其他选择了。” 你其实并不太确定它是否真的已经没有其他选择了，但你也同意，事情很可能会在不久的将来达到一个临界点。你能够 感受到 这里的气氛中有些东西在影响你的情绪，试图让你 难过用一个不太恰当的词来形容的话——而且很可能，你并不会欣赏这种行为。 |当你正忙于观察那些起伏不平、仿佛由真菌触手构成的地带，思考是否有什么路径能够穿过它们，却又发现那些触手根本无法触及时，突然，一声重型的叹息吸引了你的注意。阿图吉娅找到了一块大理石坐下来，然后 [atugia.weapon] 站在她身边，看起来有些闷闷不乐。 “嘿， [pc.name]你突然感到难过吗？” 你仔细思考了一下，但并不这么认为——或者说，即使你这么认为，你自己也没有意识到这一点。 “想想看，这个地方可能在对我们产生某种影响，即使你感觉不到。 我也有这种感觉……不知道有没有专门的词来形容这种感觉，就是觉得今天会是一个待在室内的日子，对吧？就像卡门有时候会做的那样——她会把所有窗户的窗帘都拉上，然后我和塞维琳就会围在火堆旁，一边喝茶一边吃饼干。 嗯，塞弗琳虽然什么都没吃，但还是喜欢这篝火。在这样的悲伤日子里，这种感觉实在让人难以理解——毕竟我们被困在地下，生命都处于危险之中。我为什么会感到这样的情绪呢？再看看瑞恩吧…… 她现在随时都可能哭出来。” ……好吧，深呼吸，集中注意力。你并没有那种感觉。 难过 就像阿图吉娅所说的那样，但有一种感觉，事情很快就会达到高潮；你可以 感受 这里的气氛中有些东西在影响你的情绪，而你并没有察觉到这一点。 ] 不过，在做其他任何事情之前，你首先必须爬上这些楼梯，同时尽量避免被那些极其不友好的真菌丝状物及其倒钩所困扰。有什么办法吗？ ]

rows.original: You test the weight of the jug of naphtha in your hands. Mushrooms burn, don't they? Well, it's worth a go — you stuff a bit of tinder into the neck, set it alight, and hurl the naphtha at the nearest wavering bunch of fungal filaments. The jug shatters, and the corded fungal threads writhe in disquieting agony — their thread-like nature makes them surprisingly akin to tinder, and soon enough the fire's spreading as if it were razing a dry grassland. Gods, you'd hoped that it would be effective, but you didn't think that it would be this effective. Nevertheless, as complete as it is, your victory is short-lived. Spongy threads are already sprouting from the wet ashes, creeping forth from an underlying bed of filaments beneath the masonry; your window of opportunity is small, and you waste no time in gathering your companions and clearing the remaining stairs. The tentacles are kept sufficiently at bay for you to make it up comfortably, but retreat isn't going to be an option in the immediate aftermath... ...What awaits you on the upper landing, one wonders?
rows.translation: 你将那罐煤油的重量握在手部中。蘑菇是会燃烧的，对吧？嗯，值得一试——你在罐子的颈部塞入一些引火物，点燃它，然后将整罐煤油扔向最近那丛正在摇曳的菌丝。 水壶摔碎了，那些缠着绳子的真菌丝状物在痛苦中扭动着——它们这种丝状的特性让它们与“ tinder”这种社交应用有着惊人的相似之处。很快，火焰就像在焚烧一片干草丛一样迅速蔓延开来。 天啊，你们本来希望这方法能奏效，但没想到效果会这么好。 这个 然而，尽管你的胜利看起来已经圆满完成，但它其实只是短暂的。潮湿的灰烬中已经开始滋生出柔软的丝状物，这些丝状物从砖石结构下的隐蔽层中逐渐蔓延出来；你的机会窗口非常狭窄，因此你没有浪费任何时间，立刻召集同伴，开始清理剩下的楼梯。 那些触手部被有效地控制在了安全距离之外，因此你可以安心地前进，但在接下来的短时间内，退缩已经不再是可行的选择了…… ……人们不禁会想知道，在那层较高的平台上，究竟有什么在等待着你……

rows.original: A traditional staple. See if you can't burn away the fungus.
rows.translation: 一种传统的主食。看看能不能把上面的霉菌烧掉。

rows.original:
The leananstone tingles in your hand as you palm it — maybe the powerful shock from the leananstone will blow apart the fungal threads, or shock them into uselessness for long enough. It's worth a try — there's no way to know for sure without giving it a go, you guess.
        
        You prime the charged stone, feeling the dormant storm energies stored within the enchantment awaken, then then toss it into the writhing mass of fibrous appendages. Moments pass by as you and your party take cover behind a chunk of fallen debris, waiting for the inevitable...
        
        ...Which comes soon enough. A flash of lightning and roar of thunder light up the ruined hallway with blinding light for the blink of an eye, followed by the stench of burning mushroom. The rubble shields you from the worst of the mess, but it's still far from a pleasant experience.
        
        When the commotion's died down, you chance peeking out from behind your shelter — while several of the fungal cords are singed and burnt from the storm discharge, the overwhelming majority of them have simply bent like reeds and weathered the blast with their sheer flexibility. To make things worse, new fungal tentacles are already sprouting from the spongy mass beneath the masonry to replace those which were singed, popping up like... well, like mushrooms, really. 
        
        [silly
            |Well, that's on you. Everyone knows that electric-type attacks are not very effective against plant-types, and you just got a practical demonstration of that typing disadvantage
            |Guess that didn't work as well as you'd hoped, but at least you now know what's likely to be ineffective
        ]. Perhaps trying another approach would yield better results?
rows.translation:
当你将那块瘦石握在手中时，会感到一阵刺痛——或许这块瘦石释放出的强大力量能够摧毁那些真菌丝，或者至少让它们在一段时间内失去作用。值得一试吧……不尝试的话，永远无法确定结果，不是吗？
        
        你将那块充满能量的石头握在手中，感受到其中蕴藏的沉睡风暴能量正在苏醒，随后将其抛向那团蠕动着的纤维状附肢之中。片刻之后，你和你的队友躲在一块倒下的残骸后面，等待着那不可避免的时刻的到来。……果然，不久之后就发生了。一道闪电划过，雷声轰鸣，废墟中的走廊在瞬间被刺目的轻型芒照亮，紧接着便是烧焦蘑菇散发出的恶臭。虽然碎石堆可以遮挡一些污秽物，但这种体验仍然远称不上愉快。
        
        当喧闹声渐渐平息后，你冒险从掩体后面探出头来——虽然有几根真菌触须在风暴的冲击下被烧焦了，但绝大多数触须都只是像芦苇一样弯曲了而已，凭借它们极高的柔韧性，成功抵御了那场冲击。 更糟糕的是，新的真菌触手已经开始从砖石结构下方的海绵状物质中生长出来，取代那些被烧毁的触手，它们生长出来的样子……嗯，真的就像蘑菇一样。 
        
        [silly
            |嗯，这可就怪你啦。大家都知道，电属性攻击对草属性宝可梦来说效果并不好，而你刚刚就亲眼看到了这种属性劣势带来的后果。
            |看来这个方法并没有达到你预期的效果，但至少现在你知道哪些方法可能是无效的了。
        ]或许尝试另一种方法会取得更好的效果？

rows.original: You consider the ley-crystal grenade in your possessions. Using this will probably get rid of the tentacles... and much of the walls. And the staircase too, come to think of it. But hey, it's worth it, right? Well, nothing for it. You prime the little ball of raw magical power, feeling it vibrate in your hands as it grows steadily more unstable, then toss it amidst the writhing fungal tentacles. Moments pass by as you and your party take cover behind a chunk of fallen debris, waiting for the inevitable... ...Which comes soon enough. A deafening roar reverberates down the hallway as the air shudders, and bits of burnt fungal filament come flying over your head in a splatter of wet ashes. The rubble shields you from the worst of the blast, but you still feel it all the way in your skull and your ears just won't stop ringing. When the shockwave's passed you over, you chance peeking out from behind your shelter — indeed, several chunks of marble have been ripped out of the walls and floor by the blast, revealing the spongy, seething mass of orange beneath the stonework from which the tentacles sprout. Entire fields of fungal tentacles lie charred and torn or outright reduced to ashes; they tried to bend and simply go with the flow of the blast to avoid being uprooted, but nothing can stand up to the sheer destructive power of ley-crystal used in this manner. Gods, you'd hoped that it would be effective, but you didn't think that it would be this effective. Nevertheless, as complete as it is, your victory is short-lived. Spongy threads are already sprouting from the wet ashes, creeping forth from the pulsating mass in the floor and walls; your window of opportunity is small, and you waste no time in gathering your companions and clearing the remaining stairs. The tentacles are kept sufficiently at bay for you to make it up comfortably, but retreat isn't going to be an option in the immediate aftermath... ...What awaits you on the upper landing, one wonders?
rows.translation: 你看着自己手部中的能量水晶手部雷。使用这个手部雷，很可能就能消灭那些触手部……还有大部分墙壁。仔细想想，连楼梯也应该也能被摧毁。不过，嘿，这样的代价还是值得的，对吧？ 嗯，没什么可说的。 你将那颗蕴含原始魔力的小球捏在手部中，感受它在你的指间振动，同时逐渐变得不稳定起来，然后将其抛向那些蠕动着的真菌触手部之中。片刻之后，你和你的队友躲在一块倒下的残骸后面，等待着那不可避免的事情发生。.. ……这一刻很快就到来了。震耳欲聋的轰鸣声在走廊中回荡，空气都在震动，一些烧焦的真菌纤维碎片带着湿灰烬从你头顶飞过。碎石虽然保护了你免受爆炸最猛烈的冲击，但震动依然传到了你的颅骨里，你的耳朵也一直嗡嗡作响，停不下来。 当冲击波过去后，你冒险从掩体后面探出头来——果然，爆炸的力量已经将墙壁和地面上的几块大理石震裂开来，露出了那些呈橙色的、充满活力的物质，而这些物质正是那些触手部从其中生长出来的基础。 整片被真菌触手部覆盖的区域都变成了焦炭，有的被撕裂，有的干脆化为了灰烬；这些触手部试图弯曲身体，顺应爆炸的冲击力以避免被连根拔起，但以这种方式释放出的能量，根本没有任何东西能够抵挡。 天啊，你们本来希望这方法能奏效，但没想到效果会这么好。 这个 然而，尽管你们的胜利看起来已经圆满完成，但它其实只是短暂的。湿灰中已经开始滋生出柔软的丝状物，它们从地板和墙壁中不断蔓延出来；你们的机会窗口非常狭窄，因此你们没有浪费任何时间，立即召集同伴，开始清理剩下的楼梯。 那些触手部被有效地控制在了安全距离之外，因此你可以安心地前进，但在接下来的短时间内，退缩已经不再是可行的选择了…… ……人们不禁会想知道，在那层较高的平台上，究竟有什么在等待着你呢？

rows.original: When in doubt, use explosions. And if that doesn't work, use more explosions.
rows.translation: 如果有疑问，就用爆炸来解决。如果那还是不行，那就多用些爆炸吧。
rows.raw: "When in doubt, use explosions. And if that doesn't work, use more explosions."

rows.original: You glance over in Brienne's direction, and a smile crosses your face. [var0 |Given that Brienne's already in her pyromancer's outfit, the only surprise is that the idea took this long to present itself |She's got her pyromancer's outfit with her, right? Brienne thumps her things. "Got it right here with me. I'd have put it on sooner, but a whole lot of the mushrooms here are too moist to burn well. Are you thinking what I'm thinking, [pc.name]?" Almost certainly ]. You've got her, and you've got Elthara — two busty amazons capable of slinging lots of radiant fire about willy-nilly. With you leading the charge and directing them to deploy their flames where it's needed most, you're sure you can make it up the stairs without too much trouble. Sure, most of the fungus you've encountered so far has been squishy and moist, but the long, thing bundles of fungal filaments that form the tentacles look particularly flammable. "I'm in." Brienne looks over at Elthara and gives her a wink, then turns back to you. "Give me a moment to [var0 |limber up |change into something more fitting ] and I'll be with you, okay?" She's good to her word. Scarcely have the few minutes passed before you've got one solid spell-slinger to either side of you, with Ryn bringing up the rear. All right now, the plan's simple — sweep the flames in swathes to either side, focus on anything you call out, and Ryn mops up any threats that either of them miss. Simple enough, right? "Simple enough." Nothing for it, then. No sooner have you drawn near to the lower landing that the nearest fungal tentacles reach for Brienne, only to be repulsed by a gout of searing flame. All of you break into a sprint as the corded fungal threads writhe in disquieting agony, sticking in a tight group as you call out more and more tentacles reaching for either of your fiery ladies. Your guess wasn't wrong — the tentacles' thread-like nature makes them surprisingly akin to tinder, and soon enough the fire's spreading over their shuddering forms as if it were razing a dry grassland. Gods, you'd hoped that it would be effective, but you didn't think that it would be this effective. Nevertheless, as complete as it is, your victory is short-lived. Spongy threads are already sprouting from the wet ashes, creeping forth from an underlying bed of filaments beneath the masonry; the remaining tentacles beat out their fellows as they writhe in disquieting pain. A single thread or tentacle might not have any intelligence, but you get the distinct feeling that the entire network is just a part of some larger entity here... No time to think too deeply on it, though. Your window of opportunity is small, and you waste no time in gathering your companions and clearing the remaining stairs. The tentacles are kept sufficiently at bay for you to make it up comfortably, but retreat isn't going to be an option in the immediate aftermath. ...What awaits you on the upper landing, one wonders?
rows.translation: 你朝布蕾妮的方向瞥了一眼，脸上立刻浮现出一丝微笑。 [var0 |既然布蕾妮已经穿上了火术师的服装，那么唯一让人感到意外的是，这个想法竟然过了这么久才被提出来。 |她应该带着她的火术师服装吧？ 布蕾妮把她的东西重重地放在地上。“我这儿带着呢。本来想早点穿的，但这里的很多蘑菇都太潮湿了，根本没法用来生火。你是不是也在想同样的事情 [pc.name]几乎可以肯定 ]你拥有她，也拥有艾尔塔拉——这两位身材丰满的亚马逊女战士能够随意释放大量的炽热火焰。在你带头指挥，引导她们将火焰投向最需要的地方，你们肯定能够顺利登上楼梯，不会遇到太多麻烦。 当然，你迄今为止遇到的大多数真菌都是柔软潮湿的，但那些由长长的真菌丝构成的触手状结构，看起来特别容易燃烧。 “我进去了。”布蕾妮瞥了埃尔萨拉一眼，朝她眨了眨眼，然后又转过头对你说道。 给我一点时间 [var0 |活动活动筋骨吧。 |换成更合适的东西 ] 我会和你在一起的，好吗？” 她确实说到做到了。短短几分钟过后，你的两侧就各站了一名强大的法术师，而Ryn则负责在后方支援。现在，计划很简单——向两侧迅速扫清敌人，集中攻击你们指定的目标，而Ryn则会处理那些被你们遗漏的威胁。 很简单，对吧？ “确实很简单。” 那么，就没有什么困难了。你刚一靠近下方的平台，最近的那些真菌触手就立刻伸向布蕾妮，但它们立刻被一股灼热的火焰击退了。 当那些缠结的真菌丝状物以令人不安的方式扭动、痛苦地缠绕在你们身上时，你们全都开始狂奔起来。那些触手越来越多地伸向你们中的任何一个人，你们不断呼喊着。你们的猜测没有错——这些触手丝状的特性使它们与“探探”这类交友应用有着惊人的相似之处。很快，火焰就开始蔓延到它们那颤抖的身体上，仿佛正在烧毁一片干枯的草原。 天啊，你们本来希望这方法能奏效，但没想到效果会这么好。 这个 尽管如此，你的胜利虽然看似彻底，但实际上却是短暂的。那些柔软的丝状物已经开始从湿润的灰烬中生长出来，从砖石结构下的隐蔽层中慢慢蔓延开来；那些剩余的触手也在不断地伸展，它们在令人不安的疼痛中不断蠕动着。 单根触须或线状结构可能毫无智能，但你会明显感觉到，整个网络其实只是某个更庞大整体的一部分…… 不过，现在并没有时间去深入思考这个问题。 你的机会窗口很短，因此你没有浪费任何时间，立刻召集同伴一起清理剩余的楼梯。那些触手被有效地控制在了安全距离之外，让你能够顺利通过，但在接下来的短时间内，撤退已经不再是可行的选择。 …人们不禁会想知道，在那层楼上等待着你的会是什么……
