rows.original: "[kinu.isInari |...And then I died. The end |...And then I unfortunately perished, bringing this tale to its conclusion ]." Wait a moment there. If she died there, how are you talking to her right now? You're pretty sure you're not talking to a vengeful spirit at the moment; you'd probably notice something like that. "[kinu.isInari |Ah. Smart of you to point that out, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." Kinu sticks her tongue out at you, but nevertheless looks sheepish as her expression turns serious. "I must've made a mistake in the telling of the tale somewhere. My head goes all fuzzy when I try to remember some of the details, you see..." Like not dying at any point in the experience. "Yeah. I did get a bit carried away in the telling, too..." What she needs to do is sort out her thoughts and recollections, and then get them all in line before trying again at telling the tale. You have no doubt that the harrowing experience rattled her somewhat. "Hey, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]! I wasn't that afraid, I just got confused for a bit back there. Why don't you ask me tomorrow; I should have my head sorted out by then." You laugh and clap Kinu on the back. You'll see her tomorrow, then. "Yeah. There's still work to be done, and it's not doing itself. Catch me tomorrow, okay?" With that, your daughter swings herself off the wall and starts pacing down the path back to the fields, her tails swaying behind her. Wonder if she's really as unperturbed by the whole experience as she's trying to present herself as being... but she wouldn't be Kinu if she didn't put on a strong front. All right, you'll ask again tomorrow. |But have you ever seen an angry kitsune spirit before, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]? The result of one neither having one's name on the clan records or family altar, nor dying without having the rites performed? How would you know I am not one if you have not experienced one for yourself?" Well... you know your beloved daughter, and if she were to become a restless spirit she'd be very, very different from how she's acting now. "I suppose there is that. It would be an unfortunate day if I felt the need to haunt you after my untimely death, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]." Kinu gives you a sad little smile, then her expression grows serious. "But yes, I must have made a mistake somewhere in that chain of events. That is most improper of me, who needs good and accurate recall as a matter of course." What she needs to do is sort out her thoughts and recollections, and then get them all in line before trying again at telling the tale. You have no doubt that the harrowing experience rattled her somewhat. "Still, it is not an excuse. But I shall take your advice and sort out my thoughts and recollections before endeavoring to present them in a coherent and concise fashion." You'll see her tomorrow, then. "Indeed. What has happened to me does not divest me of my duties, and I must depart now. The day is not getting any longer — if you will excuse me, please." With that, your daughter rises from her seat and excuses herself, departing from the room. You're left to finish the cooling tea, and shake your head at the enigma that Kinu has become as a young woman — well, you'll be back tomorrow, then... ]
rows.translation: "[kinu.isInari |……然后我就死了。结局。 |……然后，不幸的是，我死了，这个故事也因此画上了句号。 ]." 等一下。如果她当时真的死了，那你现在怎么还能和她说话呢？你应该很确定，现在和你说话的并不是什么复仇的幽灵吧；否则你应该能感觉到一些不对劲的地方才对。 "[kinu.isInari |啊，你能指出这一点，真是太聪明了。 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]." 纪奈朝你吐了吐舌头，但随后她的表情变得严肃起来，看起来还是有些害羞。 我在讲述这个故事的过程中肯定哪里出错了。每当试图回忆一些细节时，我的脑子就会变得一片混乱，你懂的…… 比如说，在整个游戏过程中绝对不能死亡。 是啊，我在讲述的时候确实有点太投入了…… 她需要做的是整理好自己的思绪和回忆，把它们理顺之后，再尝试重新讲述这个故事。毫无疑问，那段痛苦的经历对她造成了不小的影响。 嘿， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]! 我并没有那样做。 那个 其实我刚才有点糊涂，不太明白你的意思。你明天再问我吧，到那时我想应该能想清楚了。 你笑着拍了拍绮奴的背，然后说道：“那明天见吧。 是的，还有很多工作需要完成，而这些工作不会自动完成。明天见吧，好吗？ 说完，你的女儿从墙上跳下来，开始沿着小路朝田野方向走去，她的尾巴在身后摇摆着。不知道她是否真的像自己表现出来的那样，对这一切毫不在意……但如果她不装出一副若无其事的样子，她也就不是绮奴了。好吧，明天你再问她吧。 |但是，你有没有见过愤怒的狐灵呢？ [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]那种既没有自己的名字记载在氏族名录中，也没有在家族祭坛前接受过祭祀仪式，更是在没有举行任何葬礼仪式的情况下就死去的人，他们的结局会是怎样的呢？如果你自己没有经历过这种事情，又怎么知道我不是这样的一个人呢？ 嗯……你很了解你亲爱的女儿，如果她真的变成了一个“游荡的灵魂”，她的行为肯定会与现在大相径庭。 我想，确实是这样的。如果我在过早离世之后还觉得有必要缠着你不放，那肯定是个不幸的日子。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]." 纪久给了你一个悲伤的微笑，然后她的表情变得严肃起来。 不过，确实，我在那一系列事件中肯定哪里出了错。我这样的一个人，本应该具备准确、清晰的记忆力的，这种失误实在是不应该发生的。 她需要做的是整理好自己的思绪和回忆，把它们理顺之后，再尝试重新讲述这个故事。毫无疑问，那段痛苦的经历对她造成了不小的影响。 不过，这也不能成为借口。我会听从你的建议，先整理好自己的思路和回忆，然后再努力以条理清晰、简洁明了的方式把它们表达出来。 那么，你明天就能见到她了。 确实如此。我所遭遇的一切并不会让我免除自己的责任，我现在必须离开。时间已经不多了——如果你们能原谅我的话，请允许我现在就走。 说完这话，你的女儿便从座位上站起来，找了个借口离开了房间。你只好继续喝着那杯已经凉下来的茶，同时不禁摇头思考：金子这个年轻女孩，如今已经变得如此难以捉摸了……不过，明天你还会再见到她的，对吧…… ]
rows.raw: ' "[kinu.isInari |...And then I died. The end |...And then I unfortunately perished, bringing this tale to its conclusion ]." Wait a moment there. If she died there, how are you talking to her right now? You're pretty sure you're not talking to a vengeful spirit at the moment; you'd probably notice something like that. "[kinu.isInari |Ah. Smart of you to point that out, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." Kinu sticks her tongue out at you, but nevertheless looks sheepish as her expression turns serious. "I must've made a mistake in the telling of the tale somewhere. My head goes all fuzzy when I try to remember some of the details, you see..." Like not dying at any point in the experience. "Yeah. I did get a bit carried away in the telling, too..." What she needs to do is sort out her thoughts and recollections, and then get them all in line before trying again at telling the tale. You have no doubt that the harrowing experience rattled her somewhat. "Hey, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]! I wasn't that afraid, I just got confused for a bit back there. Why don't you ask me tomorrow; I should have my head sorted out by then." You laugh and clap Kinu on the back. You'll see her tomorrow, then. "Yeah. There's still work to be done, and it's not doing itself. Catch me tomorrow, okay?" With that, your daughter swings herself off the wall and starts pacing down the path back to the fields, her tails swaying behind her. Wonder if she's really as unperturbed by the whole experience as she's trying to present herself as being... but she wouldn't be Kinu if she didn't put on a strong front. All right, you'll ask again tomorrow. |But have you ever seen an angry kitsune spirit before, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]? The result of one neither having one's name on the clan records or family altar, nor dying without having the rites performed? How would you know I am not one if you have not experienced one for yourself?" Well... you know your beloved daughter, and if she were to become a restless spirit she'd be very, very different from how she's acting now. "I suppose there is that. It would be an unfortunate day if I felt the need to haunt you after my untimely death, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]." Kinu gives you a sad little smile, then her expression grows serious. "But yes, I must have made a mistake somewhere in that chain of events. That is most improper of me, who needs good and accurate recall as a matter of course." What she needs to do is sort out her thoughts and recollections, and then get them all in line before trying again at telling the tale. You have no doubt that the harrowing experience rattled her somewhat. "Still, it is not an excuse. But I shall take your advice and sort out my thoughts and recollections before endeavoring to present them in a coherent and concise fashion." You'll see her tomorrow, then. "Indeed. What has happened to me does not divest me of my duties, and I must depart now. The day is not getting any longer — if you will excuse me, please." With that, your daughter rises from her seat and excuses herself, departing from the room. You're left to finish the cooling tea, and shake your head at the enigma that Kinu has become as a young woman — well, you'll be back tomorrow, then... ] '

rows.original: Your sleep is troubled. For more than a week now, you've been unable to rest well at night. Fears, worries and anger fill your mind when you lay yourself down to rest, making peaceful repose impossible. It's foolish, you know, but there are things beyond your ability to control, despite how ashamed you may feel at yourself for such weakness. Is it paranoia? Are your instincts trying to tell you something? As you lie down in your futon, hugging two of your tails about yourself, your memories keep on drifting back to that night — the memory of the mere possibility of having the sanctity of your home fouled is one that [kinu.isInari |continues to gnaw at you relentlessly, filling you with seething anger, no matter how impotent and ultimately fruitless it is |continues to gnaw at you relentlessly, filling you with worried concern, regardless of how irrational it all is ]. This won't do; you'll be tired tomorrow, and your work will suffer. This can't go on. Mother is [party.has kiyoko |away with [pc.mf|Father|Mother] on the road |out for the night with [kinu.isInari |Granny Komari |Matron Kurokawa ] ]; when she's away, you're in charge and thus responsible for everyone and everything in the den. Shouldering such a burden while being increasingly fatigued by the day is not good for anyone, yet you [kinu.isInari |need to be able to do this by yourself without getting help from anyone |don't want to complain and thus be a burden on anyone ]. You turn again in bed, and then one of your ears flicks, bothered by a noise. It's the creaking of wood as weight's placed upon it, eerily similar to that night which you remember. Soft, faint, and yet it drives a [kinu.isInari |red-hot spike straight into your heart, igniting the blood in your veins |spike of ice straight into your heart, the blood in your veins running cold ]. Tensing up under the covers, every muscle in your body pulled taut, you quiet and listen for the soft ringing of metal you remember from last time... There it is! It's coming from outside again... The crickets aren't chirping tonight, even though the weather isn't that cold yet; the air is still tonight. And then you smell it: Smoke and ashes. Still in your sleepwear, you spring out from beneath the covers, racing for your [kinu.kinuWeapon |naginata |hankyu and quiver ] on the wall. [kinu.isInari |The feeling of having a weapon, a means of action, in your hands only inflames your blood further, and your confidence surges. Finally, finally, you can put this to rest, whatever it is. Anything that threatens your home, your family, your fields, must die. |Though your hands still tremble a little, you force down the fear and clutch your weapon tightly. It is the duty of every kitsune noblewoman to defend home and hearth; you have been taught this since you were a kit, and even so... nothing could have prepared you for this reality. It is one thing to learn about such histories; it is another to participate in them being made, dressed as you are in your sleepwear and with [kinu.kinuWeapon |naginata |hankyu ] in hand. What you want is irrelevant. Your family is depending on you. ] The creaking of wood just outside of your door has intensified into a soft scratching, louder now but still not quite enough to wake you were you asleep. There, then. [kinu.isInari |Gritting your teeth, you throw open the screen door, [kinu.weapon] at the ready[kinu.kinuWeapon | | with an arrow nocked and ready to loose ]. |No sense in not garnering every advantage you can, then — you don't trust the back entrance, either, so it behooves you to slip out the window after opening it from the inside and circle around to the front. It's a bit of a tight fit, but you make it through soundlessly, [kinu.weapon] at the ready[kinu.kinuWeapon | | with an arrow nocked and ready to loose ]. ] You see them, crouched by your door. Lithe and vulpine, easily mistaken for one of your own in the dim moonlight. But there the similarity ends. Clothing and light armor in the style of the natives, the sort which you've seen in the cat-woman's shop in the native settlement to the south. One tail, where even a newborn kitsune has two. And where human faces ought to be, muzzles, and above that black-and-white masks that obscured the remainder of their features, like something out of a theater. They're not anemic by any means, but there's a certain thinness to them that transcends the mere material. The scent of heavy mineral oil, common to these lands, meets your nose. Behind them, a heavy wooden bar, clearly meant to wedge the screen door shut. A faint flicker of yellow sparks, the scratching of flint against steel. All this floods your mind in the silence between two breaths. [kinu.isInari |And then, rage. How dare they? How dare they? They drop the metal canister of oil, ducking out of the way [kinu.kinuWeapon |as you bring your naginata down upon them in a mighty cleave, the blade of your glaive flashing in the moonlight |as you loose the arrow you've had at the ready, point and fletching whistling through the air ]. As one, the invaders draw slender, sharply pointed blades of bronze, weapons in the style of — wait, these are not weapons the local natives use — and advance upon you. They had meant to burn you alive in your bedroom, bar the exits and prevent you from escape, and now that that's no longer an option there's only one option left. You grip your [kinu.weapon] with white knuckles; fire burns in your heart and lungs as you realize, indeed, that the stakes here are life and death. It's a fight! |You must act now. You are afraid, you are terribly afraid and aware of that fact, but you have no choice. So much of your life has already been decided for you, and you can only play out the steps to their end. They drop the metal canister of oil, ducking out of the way [kinu.kinuWeapon |as you bring your naginata down upon them in a mighty cleave, the blade of your glaive flashing in the moonlight |as you loose the arrow you've had at the ready, point and fletching whistling through the air ]. As one, the invaders draw slender, sharply pointed blades of bronze, weapons in the style of — wait, these are not weapons the local natives use — and advance upon you. They had meant to burn you alive in your bedroom, bar the exits and prevent you from escape, and now that that's no longer an option there's only one option left. You grip your [kinu.weapon] with white knuckles; a horrible acrid pit yawns open in your stomach as you realize, indeed, that the stakes here are life and death. Battle is joined... ]
rows.translation: 你的睡眠受到了干扰。 一个多星期以来，你每晚都无法安心入睡。每当躺下休息时，恐惧、忧虑和愤怒就会充斥你的脑海，使得你无法获得片刻的宁静。你知道，这种感觉很愚蠢，但有些事情确实超出了你的控制范围，无论你因为自己的软弱而感到多么羞愧。 这是妄想症吗？还是你的直觉在试图告诉你什么？当你躺在蒲团上，用两条尾巴紧紧抱住自己时，那些记忆不断浮现在脑海中——一想到自己的家可能会被玷污，这种想法就让人感到无比难受 [kinu.isInari |这种情绪会不断地折磨着你，让你充满愤怒，尽管这种愤怒毫无意义，也根本无法解决问题。 |这种担忧会不断地折磨着你，让你充满焦虑，而无论这些担忧有多么不合理。 ]这样不行，明天你会累坏的，工作也会受到影响。这种状况不能再继续下去了。妈妈是 [party.has kiyoko |把……拿走 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲] 在途中 |出去过夜了 [kinu.isInari |蚊子奶奶 |黑川院长 ] ]当她不在的时候，你就负责整个窝里的一切，也就是要对所有人和所有事情负责。在日渐疲惫的情况下承担这样的负担，对任何人来说都不好，然而你却不得不这么做。 [kinu.isInari |必须能够独自完成这件事，而不需要任何人的帮助。 |不想抱怨，也不想成为任何人的负担。 ]你在床上翻了个身，突然有一只耳朵被某种声音扰动了——那是木头在承受重压时发出的吱嘎声，这种声音与你记忆中的那个夜晚发生的情景惊人地相似。声音很轻，很微弱，但却让人无法忽视 [kinu.isInari |一股炽热的力量直刺你的心脏，点燃了你血管中流淌的血液…… |仿佛有一根冰刺直刺你的心脏，让你体内的血液瞬间变得冰冷。 ]你在被子里紧张地蜷缩着，全身的肌肉都绷得紧紧的，你静静地聆听着那种你上次记得的、轻微的金属碰撞声…… 来了！ 它又从外面传来了…… 今晚没有蟋蟀在鸣叫，尽管天气其实并不算太冷；空气依然很清新。然后，你闻到了那个味道： 烟味和灰烬的气息。 你还穿着睡衣，立刻从被子里爬了出来，冲了出去 [kinu.kinuWeapon |长刀 |半京与箭袋 ] 悬而未决。 [kinu.isInari |拥有武器，拥有某种手段，这种感觉真是太棒了。 动作只有掌握在你手中，才能真正激起你的斗志，让你的信心更加高涨。最终， 终于你可以放心了，无论那是什么。任何威胁到你的家园、家人或田地的东西，都必须被消除。 死亡. |虽然你的双手仍在微微颤抖，但你强压下恐惧，紧紧握住武器。守护家园是每一位狐族贵族女性的责任；从你还是幼崽的时候起，就被教导过这一点。然而……即便是这样，也没有任何东西能让你真正准备好面对这样的现实。了解这些历史是一回事；而亲身参与创造这些历史，却完全是另一回事——尤其是当你还穿着睡衣的时候 [kinu.kinuWeapon |长刀 |汉京 ] 事情已经到了这个地步。 你想要什么已经无关紧要了。你的家人正在依赖你。 ] 你门外的木头吱嘎声已经变成了轻微的刮擦声，声音变大了，但仍然不足以把你从睡梦中唤醒。就这样吧。 [kinu.isInari |你咬紧牙关，猛地推开了纱门。 [kinu.weapon] 随时准备行动[kinu.kinuWeapon | | 箭已上弦，随时准备射出。 ]. |如果不利用一切可用的机会，那就太浪费了——你也不信任后门，所以最好从里面把窗户打开，然后从窗户溜出去，再绕到前面去。虽然空间有点狭窄，但你可以悄无声息地穿过。 [kinu.weapon] 随时准备行动[kinu.kinuWeapon | | 箭已上弦，随时准备射出。 ]. ] 你看到它们了，蹲在你的门口。身形敏捷，如同狐妖一般，在昏暗的月轻型下，很容易被误认为是你自己人中的一员。 但相似之处也就到此为止了。它们穿着当地人风格的服装和轻便盔甲，就是你在南方那座当地人聚居地里的猫女商店里见过的那种。 只有一条尾巴，而即使是新生的狐妖也应该有两条。本该是人类面部的地方，却长着犬鼻，而在犬鼻之上，还戴着那些黑白相间的面具，这些面具遮住了它们面部的其他部分，看起来就像是从剧院里走出来的角色。它们绝对不算体弱多病，但确实有一种 薄度 对于那些超越了物质层面的事物而言…… 空气中弥漫着这种地区常见的浓重矿物油气味。在他们身后，有一根粗重的木棍，显然是用来将纱门固定住的。偶尔会有一丝黄色的火花闪现，那是燧石与钢铁相互摩擦时产生的。 在两次呼吸之间的寂静之中，所有这些景象都涌入你的脑海之中。 [kinu.isInari |然后，就是愤怒——他们怎么敢这样？ 敢 他们？ 他们扔下了那个装满油的金属罐，然后迅速躲开了。 [kinu.kinuWeapon |当你将长刀猛力向下劈砍，刀刃在月光下闪烁着光芒…… |当你射出的箭离开手中、箭尾与箭杆在空气中呼啸而过时…… ]这些入侵者统一使用着细长而尖锐的青铜武器，这种武器风格……等等，这些其实就是 不是 当地原住民使用的武器——他们正带着这些武器向你们发起进攻。他们原本打算在你们卧室里将你们活活烧死，堵住所有出口，让你们无法逃脱；而现在，既然这个办法已经不可行了，那就只剩下一个选择了。 你们紧紧握住手部中的武器 [kinu.weapon] 你紧张得手部指都发白了；当你真正意识到这场游戏的输赢关乎生死时，你的内心和肺部仿佛都被火焰灼烧着。 这是一场激烈的战斗！ |你必须采取行动。 现在你很害怕，害怕得要命，而且你也清楚这一点，但你别无选择。你生命中的许多事情早已被他人决定了，你只能按照那些安排一步步走下去。 他们扔下了那个装满油的金属罐，然后迅速躲开了。 [kinu.kinuWeapon |当你将长刀猛力向下劈砍，刀刃在月光下闪烁着光芒…… |当你射出的箭离开手中、箭头与箭羽在空气中呼啸飞驰时…… ]这些入侵者都手部持细长而尖锐的青铜武器，这种武器的样式——等等，这些其实就是 不是 当地原住民使用的武器——他们正带着这些武器向你们发起进攻。他们原本打算在你们卧室里将你们活活烧死，堵住所有出口，让你们无法逃脱；而现在，既然这个计划已经无法实现，那就只剩下一个选择了。 你们紧紧握住手部中的武器 [kinu.weapon] 你紧张得手部指都发白了；当你真正意识到这场游戏的输赢关乎生死时，你的胃里会涌起一种难以形容的痛苦感。 战斗开始了…… ]

There, then. [kinu.isInari |Gritting your teeth, you throw open the screen door, [kinu.weapon] at the ready[kinu.kinuWeapon | | with an arrow nocked and ready to loose ]. |No sense in not garnering every advantage you can, then — you don't trust the back entrance, either, so it behooves you to slip out the window after opening it from the inside and circle around to the front. It's a bit of a tight fit, but you make it through soundlessly, [kinu.weapon] at the ready[kinu.kinuWeapon | | with an arrow nocked and ready to loose ]. ] You see them, crouched by your door. Lithe and vulpine, easily mistaken for one of your own in the dim moonlight. But there the similarity ends. Clothing and light armor in the style of the natives, the sort which you've seen in the cat-woman's shop in the native settlement to the south. One tail, where even a newborn kitsune has two. And where human faces ought to be, muzzles, and above that black-and-white masks that obscured the remainder of their features, like something out of a theater. They're not anemic by any means, but there's a certain thinness to them that transcends the mere material. The scent of heavy mineral oil, common to these lands, meets your nose. Behind them, a heavy wooden bar, clearly meant to wedge the screen door shut. A faint flicker of yellow sparks, the scratching of flint against steel. All this floods your mind in the silence between two breaths. [kinu.isInari |And then, rage. How dare they? How dare they? They drop the metal canister of oil, ducking out of the way [kinu.kinuWeapon |as you bring your naginata down upon them in a mighty cleave, the blade of your glaive flashing in the moonlight |as you loose the arrow you've had at the ready, point and fletching whistling through the air ]. As one, the invaders draw slender, sharply pointed blades of bronze, weapons in the style of — wait, these are not weapons the local natives use — and advance upon you. They had meant to burn you alive in your bedroom, bar the exits and prevent you from escape, and now that that's no longer an option there's only one option left. You grip your [kinu.weapon] with white knuckles; fire burns in your heart and lungs as you realize, indeed, that the stakes here are life and death. It's a fight! |You must act now. You are afraid, you are terribly afraid and aware of that fact, but you have no choice. So much of your life has already been decided for you, and you can only play out the steps to their end. They drop the metal canister of oil, ducking out of the way [kinu.kinuWeapon |as you bring your naginata down upon them in a mighty cleave, the blade of your glaive flashing in the moonlight |as you loose the arrow you've had at the ready, point and fletching whistling through the air ]. As one, the invaders draw slender, sharply pointed blades of bronze, weapons in the style of — wait, these are not weapons the local natives use — and advance upon you. They had meant to burn you alive in your bedroom, bar the exits and prevent you from escape, and now that that's no longer an option there's only one option left. You grip your [kinu.weapon] with white knuckles; a horrible acrid pit yawns open in your stomach as you realize, indeed, that the stakes here are life and death. Battle is joined... ] "

rows.original: Tired and breathless, bleeding from scratches from the swords' sharp points, you loom over your defeated foes. Somewhere in the fight, your nightgown has torn in a couple places, but [kinu.isInari |you couldn't care less |there isn't time to deal with that now ]; you have priorities. One of these lithe humanoid creatures has fallen in battle, but the other, wounded, is trying to half-limp, half-crawl away, having disengaged from the fight and left its companion to your tender mercies. You know what you must do; there's no doubt in your mind as to your next course of action. A few strides is all it takes to catch up with the miscreant and grab it by the scruff of its neck, hoisting it up to eye level with you. Eyes gaze at you from behind the mask as fingers scrabble at your arm and reach for you throat; there's no doubt that this is someone, not something, behind that mask. [kinu.isInari |Not that it matters in the end. The vulpine-faced creature babbles something in the Belharan; you know the words, but as far as you're concerned they're meaningless and not worth your time. It's not as if you've never gutted fish, disposed of a field mouse or killed a weed before. They're all the same to you, and this pest is no different. |"I yield," the vulpine-faced creature half-gurgles, half-gasps. "Mercy, please!" "If you had just tried to kill me, I might have considered it," comes your reply. "But you threatened my family and home, and that is not something I can forgive." ] The creature snaps and struggles in the face of its fate, but you've beaten the strength out of it; it doesn't have the wherewithal to resist you as you grab it by under the jaw and with every last iota of strength you've left, [kinu.kinuWeapon |take hold of your naginata just below the guard and shove the blade right into its chest |take hold of one of your arrow and shove point and shaft right into its throat ]. The sound that follows is horrific. Hot blood splashes out onto your hands and sleeves, bringing with it the smell of iron — deep, heavy and metallic; [kinu.isInari |Mother is going to be furious at you having ruined your nightgown like this. The masked creature snaps and claws at your neck in furious desperation, lashing out in one last act before bleeding out itself; you scream a scream that should not belong in a noblewoman's mouth and do your damndest to throttle the creature. The more effort it puts into trying to tear out your neck, the faster it'll bleed itself dry. Exactly how long you hold out for, you don't know, but the strength finally ebbs from your foe's body and it goes limp in your hands, slumping to the side with a yip. No, you are not very ladylike right now, but that doesn't matter |it drips down your trembling hands, and your breath comes up short as your head spins. What you've just done is something any noblewoman would be expected to do if the need arose, and yet... How did things come to this point? No, it's their fault, you wouldn't have had to do this if they hadn't tried to kill you in the first place. You wouldn't have just laid down and quietly accepted your fate, would you? A bout of light-headedness washes over you as the rush of battle fades. How much of this blood is yours? You're aware that you've suffered several cuts and scrapes, but exactly how much of the blood on your nightgown is yours? Your injuries will have to wait ]. Your home is burning, smoke and ashes interjecting themselves amidst the blood; an orange glow rises into the night sky as the rooftops burn. Despite the death, blood and fire, a strange sense of peace and purpose comes over you as you toss the limp body to the bloodied ground and pick up your [kinu.weapon] once more. [kiyoko.numKits 2 |You need to make sure the rest of your family is safe, that's what responsibility is |Since your parents are out, the duty of the den's defense falls to you ], and you will not run. The night beckons...
rows.translation: 你疲惫不堪，气喘吁吁，身上布满了剑锋划出的伤口，正俯视着那些被你击败的敌人。在战斗中，你的睡衣有几处被划破了，但 [kinu.isInari |你根本毫不在意。 |现在没有时间去处理那件事了。 ]你也有自己的优先事项。这些灵活的人形生物中有一个在战斗中阵亡了，而另一个虽然受了伤，却仍在试图一瘸一拐地爬开，它已经脱离了战斗，将它的同伴交给了你的处置。 你知道自己该做什么；对于下一步该采取什么行动，你心中没有任何疑问。只需迈出几步，你就能追上那个坏蛋，抓住它的脖子，把它举到与你自己视线平行的高度。 面具后的双眼正注视着你，而那些手部指则在你的手部臂上摸索着，试图触及你的喉咙……毫无疑问，这一定是一种一个，而不是别的什么东西隐藏在那个面具背后。 [kinu.isInari |其实这也无关紧要。那个长着狐狸脸的生物用贝尔哈兰语说着些什么；你虽然知道那些词的意思，但对你来说，它们毫无意义，也不值得你浪费时间。你又不是从来没有剖过鱼、处理过田鼠，或者消灭过杂草……对你说来，它们都是一样的，而这个害虫也不例外。 |我认输。 那个面容如狐狸般的生物一边发出咕噜声，一边喘着气。 求求你，发发慈悲吧！ 如果你当时真的试图杀我，我或许还会考虑一下的。 期待您的回复。 但你威胁到了我的家人和家园，这是我绝对无法原谅的。 ] 这种生物在面对命运的安排时不断挣扎反抗，但你已经耗尽了它的力量；当你用尽最后一点力气抓住它的下颌时，它已经再也没有能力抗性你了。 [kinu.kinuWeapon |握住武士刀的护手部分，然后将刀刃直接刺入它的胸膛。 |拿出一支箭，将箭头和箭杆一起插入它的喉咙里。 ]随之而来的声音令人毛骨悚然。炽热的血液溅到你的手部上和袖子上，同时带有一种浓烈、重型、带有金属气息的味道 [kinu.isInari |妈妈看到你的睡裙被弄成这样，肯定会气炸的。那个戴着面具的怪物在绝望中猛地咬住你的脖子，用最后的力气攻击你，然后便倒下了；你发出了一个根本不应该出自贵族女性之口的尖叫声，用尽全力试图扼死那个怪物。 它越是拼命想要咬断你的脖子，就越快会把自己耗尽力量。你能够坚持多久，谁也说不准，但最终，你的敌人会失去力量，在你手中软弱无力地倒下，同时发出一声哀鸣。 不，你现在确实不太符合淑女的形象，但那也没关系。 |汗水从你颤抖的双手中滴落下来，当你头晕目眩时，呼吸也变得急促起来。你所做的一切，正是任何一位高贵的女士在需要时都应该会做的事情……然而…… 事情究竟是如何发展到这一步的？ 不，这是他们的错。如果他们一开始没有试图杀死你，你就不会陷入这种境地。你也不会就这样默默地接受自己的命运，对吧？随着战斗的激烈场面逐渐平息，一阵头晕感袭上了你。 这些血液中有多少是你的？你知道自己身上有几处伤口和擦伤，但睡衣上的这些血液，到底有多少是你的呢？ 你的伤势暂时还得等一等才能处理了。 ]你的家园正在燃烧，烟雾与灰烬混杂在鲜血之中；当屋顶被烧毁时，一道橙色的轻型芒升上了夜空。 尽管到处都是死亡、鲜血与火焰，但当你将那具无力的身体扔到满是血迹的地面上，然后拾起你的武器时，一种奇怪的平静与使命感涌上心头。 [kinu.weapon] 再一次。 [kiyoko.numKits 2 |你必须确保你的家人都平安无事，这才是责任的意义所在。 |既然你的父母都不在家，保护这个巢穴的责任就落在了你身上。 ]，你就能做到。 不是 奔跑吧。 夜晚正在召唤……

rows.original: As the firstborn and heir apparent, you've the privilege of private quarters all to yourself, but even so the den living spaces are but a stone's throw away across the path from the quarters where [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |your sister and the hired help have |your siblings and the hired help have |the hired help has ] taken up residence. The ground feels warm underfoot and cinders sting your soles as you sprint between buildings, burning tiles and other debris falling about you in the flickering firelight. Somewhere off into the distance, you hear one of the older derelict buildings on the outskirts collapse in on itself with a roar and crash; even from here, you can see the plume of ash and ciders that the destruction's thrown up. You swallow hard, and will your feet to carry you forward just that bit more swiftly. Through the entrance, and into the courtyard; the building is large, and the only thing you can think of is that there's a lot of fuel to go around. More than half of it is already on fire, the warm orange flames spreading fast and the stench of mineral oil redolent in the air. "Hey!" No reply save for the roar of flames. You curse, then cup your hands to your mouth and yell again. "Hey!" This time, you get some kind of response — a pounding on the side of the building; you double-time it to the source to find the door jammed shut by a metal-reinforced bar. "Is someone there? Help, please! It's getting hard to breathe!" The fire isn't too strong on that side of the living quarters, as opposed to the other half that's a complete conflagration by now, but even so sweat's soaking your nightgown even before you've even started to try and lift the wooden bar jamming the entrance shut. Whoever placed it here clearly didn't intend for it to be removed ever again. You grit your teeth. It's so heavy. The pounding starts up again, just on the other side, and you redouble your efforts, feeling tendons and joints cry out in protest at the strain. If you fail, the blood, guilt and shame will be on your hands for the rest of your days. The mere thought of that... [kinu.isInari |finally, the robustness of your body is paying off, and fueled by the thought of your these innocent people burning alive, you will your body into action |you were never the sort suited for manual labor, but the mere thought of repaying these peoples' help with failure is enough for you to will your body into action ]. Your muscles burn — fury and terror lend you strength, which they will demand repayment with great interest later on — but you lean your weight backwards, and with a terrible grinding noise manage to drag the heavy beam out of position and unjam the door. Instantly, the sliding door bursts open, letting out the field hands into the courtyard. The half-dozen of them waste no time in clearing the building and making for the courtyard, gasping and wheezing for breath as they gather their wits. As one, the field hands recover enough to manage a perfunctory half-stumble, half-bow as the support beams collapse in on themselves behind you. Another moment, and it'd have been too late... "[kinu.isInari |Lady Otomo |Princess ]... you have our eternal gratitude. W-what is going on?" "Someone is attacking the den." Blank looks all around. "Why? How?" "[kinu.isInari |I don't know, but it's my job to find out. Is anyone hurt? |I am unsure, but the task falls to me to discover the perpetrators. Are there any casualties?" ] "We're fine, a few minor burns, but nothing serious; we're all able-bodied." You heave a sigh of relief. Keros' tails, the small mercies fortune is willing to afford you. You'll take them anyway. "[kinu.isInari |[kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |My sister isn't with you, is she?" "She left at dusk for your lady mother's residence." Right, that makes sense. You'd scheduled Aya to do the house-sitting today. On one hand, that means that she wasn't trapped in this burning building... on the other, it means you'll have to go look for her. |My brother and sister aren't with you, are they?" "They left at dusk for your lady mother's residence." Right, that makes sense. You'd scheduled Aya and Tatsumi to do the house-sitting today. On one hand, that means that they weren't trapped in this burning building... on the other, it means you'll have to go look for them. |It's good that all of you are fine. If any of you had been seriously injured, I wouldn't have been able to help. The people who did this — they must still be around." ] |[kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |My sister, would she not be amongst your number?" "She left at dusk for your lady mother's residence." Right, that makes sense. You'd scheduled Aya to do the house-sitting today. On one hand, that means that she wasn't trapped in this burning building... on the other, it means you'll have to go look for her. |My siblings, would they not be amongst your number?" "Your brother and sister left at dusk for your lady mother's residence, young lady Otomo." Right, that makes sense. You'd scheduled Aya and Tatsumi to do the house-sitting today. On one hand, that means that they weren't trapped in this burning building... on the other, it means you'll have to go look for them. |It is good that all of you are unharmed and able-bodied, at least. The people who did this... they are still around, I know it. We are not out of danger." ] ] You sweep your gaze over the assembled farmhands, uncertainty and fear written all over their faces. [kinu.isInari |You've never been very good at speaking to people, but you have worked alongside these people for some time now and actions have more weight than words, don't they? Even if you can't inspire them with speech alone, they know who you are, and that's what's important |This is what you were born to, this is why you exist. When the common people falter, they look for the divine for guidance, and you must inspire them to more than what they think themselves capable of ]. Taking a deep breath and squaring your shoulders, you step up to the most capable-looking one and address him in a quick whisper. "This is the plan. [kinu.isInari |I want you to take everyone and head through the den's outskirts, cut through the orchard and head for the entrance; the torii gate is almost certainly being watched or inoperational. Unless you're absolutely sure the coast is clear, do not make a break for it — whoever did this is likely to have posted a guard nearby in case we try to escape. If you're still around when I return, I'll come and get you. You get me? |I want you to lead everyone along the den's outskirts and through the orchard — they have yet to set that ablaze. Do not try to make for the torii gate — whoever our enemies are, they have some knowledge of us and are sure to be watching the portal. Unless you are absolutely confident, do not attempt an escape just yet, either — whoever did this is likely to have posted a guard nearby for just that eventuality. Wait and hide by the entrance — should you still be around when I return, I will effect our retreat. Do you understand? ]" A nod. [kinu.isInari |"[kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |I'll go get Aya |I'll go get Tatsumi and Aya |I'll go make a sweep of the den, deal with these marauders ], and we'll escape together. I'm counting on you to keep everyone safe until then, you hear me?" |"[kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |I will retrieve my sister |I will retrieve my siblings |I will dispense with my duty as a noblewoman, and defend my home. Wait for my return ], and once I am done we will make our egress. You are responsible for keeping your people safe, do you understand me?" ] "W-what do we do if we encounter... them, Lady Otomo?" "Hide. Preserve your lives. But if you must..." The final words are left unspoken, and better that way. The handful of farmhands turn to leave, but there's a brief spate of discussion and they turn to you again. "Lady Otomo, if you will have us, we want to fight at your side." Your answer's simple and direct. "[kinu.isInari |Don't be dumb. You have no weapons, aren't trained in their use, and are frightened and exhausted. You'll just be a hindrance, and risk your lives for nothing. Don't make all my efforts in saving you go to waste. |Your loyalty and bravery are appreciated, but you have neither weapons nor the training required to make effective use of them against these foes. None will fault you for cowardice if I order you to leave, and this is a direct order: go, and do not put my efforts in saving you to naught. ]" They look almost relieved at these words, bow as one, and then are gone into the night. You watch the farmhands disappear into the darkness between the flickering flames, then steady your [kinu.weapon] and break into a run. There's still much to be done, and time is running short. You need to head to Mother's abode and check what's become [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |of your sister |of your other siblings |of it ]...and fast.
rows.translation: 作为长子及法定继承人，你拥有属于自己的私人居所，但即便如此，那些用于聚集和活动的空间也仅仅位于你住所所在道路的对面而已。 [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |你妹妹和那些雇来的帮手们…… |你的兄弟姐妹以及那些受雇来帮忙的人也都…… |那些被雇佣来帮忙的人…… ] 你已在此安家落户。足部下的地面温暖而柔软，当你在建筑物间奔跑时，焦炭会刺痛你的足部底；在闪烁的火光中，烧焦的瓷砖和其他碎片四处飞溅。远处，你听到郊外某座破旧的建筑物轰然倒塌，连从这里都能看到那场破坏所引发的灰烬与烟尘。 你艰难地咽了口唾沫，然后用力蹬动双足部，希望能让自己走得更快一些。 穿过入口，走进庭院；这座建筑规模很大，你唯一能想到的就是，这里肯定储存了大量的燃料。 其中有一半以上的区域已经着火了，温暖的橙色火焰迅速蔓延，空气中弥漫着矿物油的刺鼻气味。 嘿！ 除了火焰的咆哮声，没有任何回应。你咒骂着，然后用手部捂住嘴，再次大声呼喊。 嘿！ 这一次，你收到了某种反应——建筑物的一侧传来了剧烈的敲击声。你立刻赶往声源处，发现门被一根加固了金属的棍子堵住了。 有人在吗？救命啊！我呼吸困难了！ 与居住区的另一半已经陷入熊熊烈火相比，这一侧的火势还不算太猛烈，但即便如此，你还没来得及试图移开堵住入口的木棍，汗水就已经浸透了你的睡衣。显然，把那根木棍放在那里的人根本就不打算让人把它拿走。 你咬紧牙关。 太重了。 那种剧烈的震动又开始了，只不过这次是在另一侧。你加倍努力，却能感觉到自己的肌腱和关节都在因过度负重而发出抗议的信号。 如果你失败了，余生你都将背负着鲜血、内疚与羞耻。光是想到这一点…… [kinu.isInari |终于，你强健的体魄开始发挥作用了。而一想到那些无辜的人们正在活活烧死，这种愤怒就驱使你使出全部力量去行动。 |你从来就不适合做体力劳动，但一想到如果失败就无法回报这些人的帮助，你就不得不强迫自己行动起来。 rows.raw: " As the firstborn and heir apparent, you've the privilege of private quarters all to yourself, but even so the den living spaces are but a stone's throw away across the path from the quarters where [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |your sister and the hired help have |your siblings and the hired help have |the hired help has ] taken up residence. The ground feels warm underfoot and cinders sting your soles as you sprint between buildings, burning tiles and other debris falling about you in the flickering firelight. Somewhere off into the distance, you hear one of the older derelict buildings on the outskirts collapse in on itself with a roar and crash; even from here, you can see the plume of ash and ciders that the destruction's thrown up. You swallow hard, and will your feet to carry you forward just that bit more swiftly. Through the entrance, and into the courtyard; the building is large, and the only thing you can think of is that there's a lot of fuel to go around. More than half of it is already on fire, the warm orange flames spreading fast and the stench of mineral oil redolent in the air. "Hey!" No reply save for the roar of flames. You curse, then cup your hands to your mouth and yell again. "Hey!" This time, you get some kind of response — a pounding on the side of the building; you double-time it to the source to find the door jammed shut by a metal-reinforced bar. "Is someone there? Help, please! It's getting hard to breathe!" The fire isn't too strong on that side of the living quarters, as opposed to the other half that's a complete conflagration by now, but even so sweat's soaking your nightgown even before you've even started to try and lift the wooden bar jamming the entrance shut. Whoever placed it here clearly didn't intend for it to be removed ever again. You grit your teeth. It's so heavy. The pounding starts up again, just on the other side, and you redouble your efforts, feeling tendons and joints cry out in protest at the strain. If you fail, the blood, guilt and shame will be on your hands for the rest of your days. The mere thought of that... [kinu.isInari |finally, the robustness of your body is paying off, and fueled by the thought of your these innocent people burning alive, you will your body into action |you were never the sort suited for manual labor, but the mere thought of repaying these peoples' help with failure is enough for you to will your body into action ]. Your muscles burn — fury and terror lend you strength, which they will demand repayment with great interest later on — but you lean your weight backwards, and with a terrible grinding noise manage to drag the heavy beam out of position and unjam the door. Instantly, the sliding door bursts open, letting out the field hands into the courtyard. The half-dozen of them waste no time in clearing the building and making for the courtyard, gasping and wheezing for breath as they gather their wits. As one, the field hands recover enough to manage a perfunctory half-stumble, half-bow as the support beams collapse in on themselves behind you. Another moment, and it'd have been too late... "[kinu.isInari |Lady Otomo |Princess ]... you have our eternal gratitude. W-what is going on?" "Someone is attacking the den." Blank looks all around. "Why? How?" "[kinu.isInari |I don't know, but it's my job to find out. Is anyone hurt? |I am unsure, but the task falls to me to discover the perpetrators. Are there any casualties?" ] "We're fine, a few minor burns, but nothing serious; we're all able-bodied." You heave a sigh of relief. Keros' tails, the small mercies fortune is willing to afford you. You'll take them anyway. "[kinu.isInari |[kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |My sister isn't with you, is she?" "She left at dusk for your lady mother's residence." Right, that makes sense. You'd scheduled Aya to do the house-sitting today. On one hand, that means that she wasn't trapped in this burning building... on the other, it means you'll have to go look for her. |My brother and sister aren't with you, are they?" "They left at dusk for your lady mother's residence." Right, that makes sense. You'd scheduled Aya and Tatsumi to do the house-sitting today. On one hand, that means that they weren't trapped in this burning building... on the other, it means you'll have to go look for them. |It's good that all of you are fine. If any of you had been seriously injured, I wouldn't have been able to help. The people who did this — they must still be around." ] |[kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |My sister, would she not be amongst your number?" "She left at dusk for your lady mother's residence." Right, that makes sense. You'd scheduled Aya to do the house-sitting today. On one hand, that means that she wasn't trapped in this burning building... on the other, it means you'll have to go look for her. |My siblings, would they not be amongst your number?" "Your brother and sister left at dusk for your lady mother's residence, young lady Otomo." Right, that makes sense. You'd scheduled Aya and Tatsumi to do the house-sitting today. On one hand, that means that they weren't trapped in this burning building... on the other, it means you'll have to go look for them. |It is good that all of you are unharmed and able-bodied, at least. The people who did this... they are still around, I know it. We are not out of danger." ] ] You sweep your gaze over the assembled farmhands, uncertainty and fear written all over their faces. [kinu.isInari |You've never been very good at speaking to people, but you have worked alongside these people for some time now and actions have more weight than words, don't they? Even if you can't inspire them with speech alone, they know who you are, and that's what's important |This is what you were born to, this is why you exist. When the common people falter, they look for the divine for guidance, and you must inspire them to more than what they think themselves capable of ]. Taking a deep breath and squaring your shoulders, you step up to the most capable-looking one and address him in a quick whisper. "This is the plan. [kinu.isInari |I want you to take everyone and head through the den's outskirts, cut through the orchard and head for the entrance; the torii gate is almost certainly being watched or inoperational. Unless you're absolutely sure the coast is clear, do not make a break for it — whoever did this is likely to have posted a guard nearby in case we try to escape. If you're still around when I return, I'll come and get you. You get me? |I want you to lead everyone along the den's outskirts and through the orchard — they have yet to set that ablaze. Do not try to make for the torii gate — whoever our enemies are, they have some knowledge of us and are sure to be watching the portal. Unless you are absolutely confident, do not attempt an escape just yet, either — whoever did this is likely to have posted a guard nearby for just that eventuality. Wait and hide by the entrance — should you still be around when I return, I will effect our retreat. Do you understand? ]" A nod. [kinu.isInari |"[kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |I'll go get Aya |I'll go get Tatsumi and Aya |I'll go make a sweep of the den, deal with these marauders ], and we'll escape together. I'm counting on you to keep everyone safe until then, you hear me?" |"[kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |I will retrieve my sister |I will retrieve my siblings |I will dispense with my duty as a noblewoman, and defend my home. Wait for my return ], and once I am done we will make our egress. You are responsible for keeping your people safe, do you understand me?" ] "W-what do we do if we encounter... them, Lady Otomo?" "Hide. Preserve your lives. But if you must..." The final words are left unspoken, and better that way. The handful of farmhands turn to leave, but there's a brief spate of discussion and they turn to you again. "Lady Otomo, if you will have us, we want to fight at your side." Your answer's simple and direct. "[kinu.isInari |Don't be dumb. You have no weapons, aren't trained in their use, and are frightened and exhausted. You'll just be a hindrance, and risk your lives for nothing. Don't make all my efforts in saving you go to waste. |Your loyalty and bravery are appreciated, but you have neither weapons nor the training required to make effective use of them against these foes. None will fault you for cowardice if I order you to leave, and this is a direct order: go, and do not put my efforts in saving you to naught. ]" They look almost relieved at these words, bow as one, and then are gone into the night. You watch the farmhands disappear into the darkness between the flickering flames, then steady your [kinu.weapon] and break into a run. There's still much to be done, and time is running short. You need to head to Mother's abode and check what's become [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |of your sister |of your other siblings |of it ]...and fast. "

rows.original: As the firstborn and heir apparent, you've the privilege of private quarters all to yourself, but even so the den living spaces are but a stone's throw away across the path from the quarters where your siblings have taken up residence. The ground feels warm underfoot and cinders sting your soles as you sprint between buildings, burning tiles and other debris falling about you in the flickering light. Somewhere off into the distance, you hear one of the older derelict buildings on the outskirts collapse in on itself with a roar and crash; even from here, you can see the plume of ash and ciders that the destruction's thrown up. You swallow hard, and will your feet to carry you forward just that bit more swiftly. Through the entrance, and into the courtyard; the building is large, and the only thing you can think of is that there's a lot of fuel to go around. More than half of it is already on fire, the warm orange flames spreading fast and the stench of mineral oil redolent in the air. "Asagiri!" No reply save for the roar of flames. You curse, then cup your hands to your mouth and yell again. "A-sa-gi-ri!" This time, you get some kind of response — a quiet, terrified mewling, barely audible even as you swivel your ears to try and get some kind of bearing of where it might be coming from. This is followed shortly by a pounding on the side of the building; you double-time it to the source to find the door jammed shut by a metal-reinforced bar. The fire isn't too strong on that side of the living quarters, as opposed to the other half that's a complete conflagration by now, but even so sweat's soaking your nightgown even before you've even started to try and lift the wooden bar jamming the entrance shut. Whoever placed it here clearly didn't intend for it to be removed ever again. You grit your teeth. It's so heavy. The pounding starts up again, just on the other side, and your little sister's whimpering openly turns to terrified screams[kiyoko.numKits 5 16 |; this is quickly joined by more voices behind her |; this is quickly joined by many, many more voices behind her ]. If you fail, the blood, guilt and shame will be on your hands for the rest of your days. The mere thought of that... [kinu.isInari |finally, the robustness of your body is paying off, and fueled by the thought of your [kiyoko.numKits 4 5 |little sister |family ] burning alive, you will your body into action |you were never the sort suited for manual labor, but the mere thought of your little sister as an angry spirit haunting you for the rest of your days is enough for you to will your body into action ]. Your muscles burn — fury and terror lend you strength, which they will demand repayment with great interest later on — but you lean your weight backwards, and with a terrible grinding noise manage to drag the heavy beam out of position and unjam the door. Instantly, the sliding door bursts open and your little sister tumbles out[kiyoko.numKits 5 12 |, the rest of your siblings in her wake |, the rest of your many siblings in her wake ]. She's got a long-bladed tanto in an overhand grip, her fingers shaking violently as she rushes forward at you, her green eyes wide and absolutely terrified.
rows.translation: 作为长子及法定继承人，你拥有属于自己的私人居所，但即便如此，你的活动空间也与兄弟姐妹们居住的地方仅相隔一条小路而已。 当你在建筑物间飞奔时，地面仿佛温暖而柔软，但焦渣会刺痛你的足部底；在闪烁的轻型芒中，燃烧的瓷砖和其他碎片四处飞溅。远处，你听到郊区某座废弃的旧建筑轰然倒塌，伴随着巨大的声响；即使从这里，你也能看到那场破坏所引发的灰烬与烟尘。 你艰难地咽了口唾沫，然后用力蹬动双足部，希望能让自己走得更快一些。 穿过入口，走进院子；这座建筑规模很大，你唯一能想到的就是，这里肯定储存了大量的燃料。 其中有一半以上的区域已经着火了，温暖的橙色火焰迅速蔓延，空气中弥漫着矿物油的刺鼻气味。 朝雾！ 除了火焰的咆哮声，没有任何回应。你咒骂着，然后用手部捂住嘴，再次大声呼喊。 阿萨吉里！ 这一次，你听到了某种回应——那是一种微弱而充满恐惧的呜咽声，几乎听不见。你拼命转动耳朵，试图判断声音是从哪里传来的。不久之后，你听到建筑物的一侧传来剧烈的敲击声。你立刻赶往声源处，发现门被一根加固了金属的棍子堵住了。 与居住区的另一半已经陷入全面燃烧相比，这一侧的火势还不算太猛烈。但即便如此，你还没来得及试图搬开堵住入口的木棍，汗水就已经浸透了你的睡衣。 不管是谁把它放在这里的，显然根本不打算让它被移走。 你咬紧牙关。 太重了。 那种剧烈的震动又开始了，只不过这次发生在另一侧。你妹妹原本只是轻轻啜泣，现在却变成了惊恐的尖叫。[kiyoko.numKits 5 16 |很快，她身后就有更多的声音加入了她的行列。 |很快，就有越来越多的人加入了她的行列。 ]如果你失败了，余生你都将背负着鲜血、愧疚与耻辱。轻型是想到这一点…… [kinu.isInari |终于，你强健的体魄开始发挥作用了，而这种动力也来自于你对……的思考。 [kiyoko.numKits 4 5 |小妹妹 |家人 ] 被活活烧死，你的身体将会彻底燃烧殆尽。 |你本来就不是适合做体力劳动的人，但一想到你的妹妹会变成一个怨灵，在你余生中一直缠着你，你就不得不强迫自己动起来。 ]你的肌肉在燃烧——愤怒与恐惧为你提供了力量，但后来这些力量会让你付出重型的代价；然而你还是用力向后仰，伴随着一声刺耳的摩擦声，终于把那根重型的横梁拖到了合适的位置，解开了门卡的障碍。瞬间，滑动门被猛地推开，你的妹妹也从里面冲了出来。[kiyoko.numKits 5 12 |你的其他兄弟姐妹也跟着她走了。 |以及她身后跟随的你的其他众多兄弟姐妹们 ]她的那把刀刃很长。 tanto 她用一只手部紧紧抓住你，手部指剧烈地颤抖着，同时朝你冲了过来，她那双绿色的眼睛睁得大大的，满脸都是恐惧。

You curse, then cup your hands to your mouth and yell again. "A-sa-gi-ri!" This time, you get some kind of response — a quiet, terrified mewling, barely audible even as you swivel your ears to try and get some kind of bearing of where it might be coming from. This is followed shortly by a pounding on the side of the building; you double-time it to the source to find the door jammed shut by a metal-reinforced bar. The fire isn't too strong on that side of the living quarters, as opposed to the other half that's a complete conflagration by now, but even so sweat's soaking your nightgown even before you've even started to try and lift the wooden bar jamming the entrance shut. Whoever placed it here clearly didn't intend for it to be removed ever again. You grit your teeth. It's so heavy. The pounding starts up again, just on the other side, and your little sister's whimpering openly turns to terrified screams[kiyoko.numKits 5 16 |; this is quickly joined by more voices behind her |; this is quickly joined by many, many more voices behind her ]. If you fail, the blood, guilt and shame will be on your hands for the rest of your days. The mere thought of that... [kinu.isInari |finally, the robustness of your body is paying off, and fueled by the thought of your [kiyoko.numKits 4 5 |little sister |family ] burning alive, you will your body into action |you were never the sort suited for manual labor, but the mere thought of your little sister as an angry spirit haunting you for the rest of your days is enough for you to will your body into action ]. Your muscles burn — fury and terror lend you strength, which they will demand repayment with great interest later on — but you lean your weight backwards, and with a terrible grinding noise manage to drag the heavy beam out of position and unjam the door. Instantly, the sliding door bursts open and your little sister tumbles out[kiyoko.numKits 5 12 |, the rest of your siblings in her wake |, the rest of your many siblings in her wake ]. She's got a long-bladed tanto in an overhand grip, her fingers shaking violently as she rushes forward at you, her green eyes wide and absolutely terrified. "

rows.original: It's a small matter for you to drop your [kinu.weapon] and catch Asagiri by the forearm and shoulder. "Asagiri! It's me! Calm yourself!" Your little sister looks dumbfounded for a second or two, then her fingers loosen and the long-bladed dagger drops to the floorboards with a clatter. Asagiri's entire body slackens, and then she leans into you with a big hug and begins to cry in earnest. You move the tanto out of the way with your foot, then gently return your little sister's embrace and pet her on the head. "[silly |Onee-sama |Big sis ]!" "There, there." You examine Asagiri as you lead her [kiyoko.numKits 5 |and your other siblings ]away from the burning building — your little sister's white hair and fur are but singed, so no true loss there. However, her nightgown is charred in several places, blackened holes in the fabric from having been set on fire; she's been burned a little, but it's not too bad. Asagiri yips and shrinks back as you examine the worst of the burns, instinctively flinching before holding out her arm for your inspection. "It hurts, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]... all the doors were sealed..." [kinu.isInari |If you were angry before, the cold fury that grips your heart threatens to rend it in two. Each and every one of those monsters just signed their own death warrants on this spot. "..." "What's the matter?" Your little sister looks away, not daring to meet your gaze. "[silly |Onee-sama |Big sis ], your eyes. They're scary..." "..." Are they? Good. If you didn't feel this way about those who would burn children alive, you would never be able to forgive yourself. If harm had actually come to your little sister... |Poor Asagiri was never very brave, forever Mother's pet... to have her hurt like this, even if it wasn't very much... it's enough to move one to tears. "Don't cry, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]. It hurts, but I'm fine." "..." She's not, neither of you are fine, but you aren't about to press the issue now. To kill children in this most horrific manner, by burning them alive... even if you'd saved her in time, this is unforgivable. ] "You have blood on your clothes and fur, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]... are you okay?" "[kinu.isInari |I'm not, but it doesn't matter |That is not the case, but I have no choice ]." Bending down, you [kiyoko.numKits 5 |give your other siblings a quick look-over one at a time, but no one seems too much worse for the wear — cuts, scrapes and light burns, but thankfully nothing more. Only Asagiri suffered such horrific burns... she needs medical attention, but you have none to give and all of your lives are still in danger. Those who did this, they must still be around. "[silly |Nee-san |Sis ] saved us," one of your brothers pipes up. "She ran into the fire to drag us out..." You look at Asagiri again, and she lowers her eyes. |check over Asagiri's burns again. Your little sister is holding up fine, but all of your lives are still in danger. Those who did this, they must still be around. ] "[silly |Nee-sama |Big sis ]..." You pull Asagiri into a low hug, and pick up the tanto and force it into her hand. Her grip is trembling, insecure, but she takes the long-bladed dagger in her fingers anyway. "Asagiri, I'm proud of you." "..." "Aya and Tatsumi, they aren't here?" Your little sister shakes her head. "They were house-sitting Mother's abode tonight." "Then I have more to do. Listen very carefully: does it still hurt?" "It does, but... you're worse off than I am, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]." You wince. You'd almost forgotten the pain; but Asagiri's words just bring it all back to the fore. "We have to be strong. I want you to [kiyoko.numKits 5 |take everyone and ]head through the outskirts and orchard to just by the den's entrance. Not at it — whoever did this is likely to have posted a guard nearby in case we try to escape, but near it is enough. Hide until I come — you're good at hiding, right?" A nod. "I'll bring back Tatsumi and Aya, and we'll escape together. I'm counting on you to keep [kiyoko.numKits 5 |everyone |yourself ] safe until then, you hear me?" "W-what do I do if I see... them?" "Hide. But if you must..." Your eyes are drawn back to the tanto in Asagiri's hands, and her fingers tighten about the handle. Your little sister looks absolutely terrified at the prospect, but nods. She might have a pretty face, but at least she can follow instructions even when distressed. "Now go. Hurry." Without another word, Asagiri scampers off, [kiyoko.numKits 5 |leading the other kits behind her |disappearing like the morning fog ]. You take a moment to catch your breath, clear some of the smoke from your nose, but there's little time for anything else. You need to head to mother's abode and check what's become of your other siblings... and fast.

|姐姐大人 |大姐 ]!" 好了，好了。 在你引领着浅雾的同时，你仔细观察着她。 [kiyoko.numKits 5 |还有你的其他兄弟姐妹 ]当你检查那些最严重的烧伤部位时，朝雾吓得尖叫着缩了回去，但很快又主动伸出手部臂让你检查。她的妹妹的白色头发和毛皮只是被烧焦了一点，所以并没有造成真正的伤害。不过，她的睡衣有几处被烧焦了，布料上留下了黑色的洞洞——显然是被火烫到的；她也有点被烧伤了，但情况还不算太糟。 好疼啊 [silly |nee-sama |大姐 ]……所有的门都被关上了…… [kinu.isInari |如果你之前就已经愤怒不已，那么此刻那股冰冷而强烈的怒火简直要将你的心脏撕成两半。那些怪物，每一个，都在这一刻亲手签下了自己的死亡判决书。 "..." 怎么了？ 你的妹妹移开了视线，不敢与你的目光对视。 "[silly |姐姐大人 |大姐 ]你的眼睛……它们看起来很可怕…… "..." 他们是这样吗？很好。如果你对那些会活活烧死孩子的人没有这种感受，你就永远无法原谅自己。如果你的妹妹真的受到了伤害…… |可怜的浅雾从来都不是什么勇敢的人，一直都是母亲的宠儿……看到她受到这样的伤害，即使伤势并不严重……也足以让人落泪。 别哭， [silly |nee-sama |大姐 ]虽然很疼，但我没事。 "..." 她并没有，你们俩也都没事，但现在还不是追究这件事的时候。以这种极其残忍的方式杀害孩子，将他们活活烧死……即使你们当时及时救了她，这种行为也是不可原谅的。 ] 你的衣服和毛发上都有血迹 [silly |nee-sama |大姐 ]……你没事吧？ "[kinu.isInari |我不是，但这也无所谓。 |事实并非如此，但我也没有其他选择。 ]." 弯下腰，你 [kiyoko.numKits 5 |你逐一快速检查了其他兄弟姐妹的情况，发现似乎没有人受到太严重的伤害——只是有一些割伤、擦伤和轻微的烧伤，不过幸运的是并没有更严重的情况。只有浅雾受了那么严重的烧伤……她需要医疗救助，但你现在没有能力提供帮助，而且你们的生命仍然处于危险之中。那些犯下这种罪行的人，肯定还在这附近。 "[silly |妮酱 |姐姐 ] 拯救了我们。 你的某个兄弟开口说话了。 她冲进火海中，把我们救了出来…… 你再次看向朝雾，她则低下了眼睛。 |再检查一下朝雾的烧伤情况吧。你的妹妹目前情况还算稳定，但你们的性命仍然处于危险之中。那些犯下这种罪行的人，肯定还躲在附近。 ] "[silly |妮大人 |大姐 ]..." 你将浅雾拉进一个温暖的拥抱中，然后拿起了 tanto 然后强行将那把匕首塞到她的手部中。她的手部指在颤抖，显得很不稳，但终究还是把那把长刃匕首握在了手部里。 朝雾，我为你感到骄傲。 "..." 绫和龙美，他们不在这里吗？ 你的妹妹摇了摇头。 今晚他们帮忙照看妈妈的住处。 那我还有其他事情要处理。请仔细听：现在还疼吗？ 确实是这样，但是……你的处境比我更糟糕。 [silly |nee-sama |大姐 ]." 你不禁皱起了眉头。你几乎已经忘记了那种疼痛；但浅雾的话语却让这一切再次浮现在你的脑海中。 我们必须坚强。我希望你们能够 [kiyoko.numKits 5 |带上所有人 ]穿过郊外和果园，就能到达那个巢穴的入口附近。没错。 在……时候 肯定是有人在我们附近安排了守卫，以防我们试图逃跑，不过只要在附近躲起来就行。等我过来再出来——你很擅长躲藏，对吧？ 点了点头。 我会把龙美和绫带回来，然后我们一起逃走。我指望你能守在原地等着我。 [kiyoko.numKits 5 |每个人 |你自己 ] 在那之前，一切都安全无恙，明白吗？ 如果我看到了……我该怎么办？ 他们?" 躲起来。但如果你非得…… 你的目轻型再次被吸引过去 tanto 在浅雾的手部中，她的手部指紧紧地握住了把手部。你的妹妹看起来对这个想法感到非常害怕，但还是点了点头。虽然她长得漂亮，但至少在遇到困难时，她还是能够听从指示的。 现在就走，快点。 阿萨吉里一言不发，便飞快地跑开了。 [kiyoko.numKits 5 |带领着其他小队成员走在她身后 |像晨雾一样消失无踪 ]你花了一点时间来喘口气，清理鼻子里的烟雾，但已经没有太多时间可以浪费了。 你得去母亲的家，看看你的其他兄弟姐妹们现在怎么样了…… 而且速度很快。

rows.original: Entering the well crossroads from the den quarters, you're stopped by the sight of three flickering lights in the distance. Voices, carried on the wind, although they're speaking too quickly for you to be able to discern what's being said. The crossroads is an open space by design, but you duck behind the well, huddling up with your [kinu.weapon] in your lap, pressed against your bloodstained nightgown even as your curl your tails about yourself. They're getting closer, lithe figures much like the duo lurking outside of your door; your heart hammers in your ears as you force your breath to still, lest they hear you. The light cast from their torches brings with it the heavy scent of mineral oil, a smell you've grown to hate very, very recently. "...That's how you get demons. Wait for the parents to be out, then seal up the nests and burn out the younglings. Works on imps, makes sense it'd work on these, too." They're speaking Belharan, you figure as much. "...I don't like this..." "Best to get them while they're young. You'd rather have an infestation of full-grown soul-suckers in a few years?" They've passed by the old well, the shadows stretching outward having hidden you well. You could just leave them and slip by... but that was never an option, was it? [kinu.isInari |Just staying hidden until now has tried your patience to its limit, the pointed vengeance of the blooded stayed but momentarily in wait of the perfect time to strike.[kiyoko.numKits 4 | The sight of Asagiri's burns is still fresh in your mind, and every muscle in your body screams and tightens. ] And through it all, at its very heart, an empty, cold clarity. |That would merely leave these three to wreak more havoc upon your home, and you would have failed in your duty and position. Even if you know the truth of the matter, Matron Komari's reputation is forever ruined for allegedly valuing her life above that of her responsibilities... ...They still tell tales of her as a cautionary example to children back in the Old Country, you've heard... Enough excuses for your fear. These monsters have attacked your home. This is unforgivable.[kiyoko.numKits 4 | The sight of Asagiri's burns is still fresh in your mind, and you feel your heart harden. ] ] Unforgivable. "Demon!" [kinu.kinuWeapon |The edge of your naginata flashes as you dart out from behind the well, the glaive's blade |The arrowhead gleams as you draw back the bowstring, the point ] nearly taking off one of the trio's vulpine tails. They whirl around, drawing more of those slender, double-edged blades and spreading out in practiced combat formation. Multiple enemies usually just tended to get in each others' way, but these appear practiced at fighting as a unit. Three to one. Good, it wouldn't be fair otherwise. Despite their numerical advantage over you, they're clearly cautious, advancing closely in a front and clearly intending to surround you when the opportunity presents itself. "What are those idiots doing? One of them got out!" "Don't let the demon touch you, or there won't be anything left but a husk!" [kinu.isInari |"Demon. Is that it? Is that what I am?" Hate and hunger twine about each other, a white-hot needle piercing pain and fatigue alike. All your life you've been holding back the hunger, but if now is not the time to embrace it when life and death hang in the balance, then when? "Then I'll show you how demonic I can be!" It's a fight! |For a moment you can almost pity the faces behind those masks, feel their fear of you, what they think must be a monster. Then you recall their earlier conversation, and your sympathy evaporates. They had their doubts, and made a choice — and so have you, here and now. Miko always teases you for being too soft-hearted and making excuses for yourself and others... Battle is joined... ]
rows.translation: 从洞穴住所出发，走进这个十字路口时，你远远地看到了三处闪烁的灯轻型。风中传来了人们的声音，但他们说话的速度太快，你根本听不清他们在说什么。这个十字路口本来就是一片开阔地带，但你还是躲到了井边，蜷缩在那里 [kinu.weapon] 它们就蜷缩在你膝边，紧贴着你那沾满血迹的睡衣，而你的尾巴也紧紧地缠在身上。 它们正在慢慢靠近，那些灵活的身影与躲在你门外的那两个人一模一样；你的心脏在耳边剧烈跳动，你拼命地屏住呼吸，生怕它们听到你的声音。它们手中的火把散发出的轻型芒中，弥漫着一股浓重的矿物油气味——这种味道，你是最近才开始极其厌恶的。 ……这就是招来恶魔的方法。等父母离开后，把巢穴封起来，然后烧死里面的幼崽。这种方法对小恶魔有效，那么对这些家伙也应该同样有效吧。 他们正在说贝尔哈兰语，这还用想吗？ ……我不太喜欢这个…… 最好在它们还小的时候就把它们处理掉。不然几年后，你的地方就会到处都是这些成熟的、会吸取灵魂的生物吧？ 他们已经经过了那口老井，那些延伸出去的阴影将你很好地隐藏了起来。你本可以让他们继续走，然后悄悄溜过去……但那从来都不是一个可行的选择，对吧？ [kinu.isInari |一直躲藏到现在，已经把你的耐心耗到了极限。那些嗜血之人的复仇之心虽然已经燃起，但仍在等待着最佳的时机来发动攻击。[kiyoko.numKits 4 | 阿萨吉里的烧伤景象依然清晰地烙印在你的脑海中，你身上的每一块肌肉都在剧烈地收缩、紧张起来。 ] 而在这一切的背后，其核心之处，存在着一种空洞而冷漠的清晰感。 |那样只会让这三个怪物继续在你的家中肆意破坏，而你也会因此失职、辜负自己的职责。即使你知道事情的真相，但科马里夫人的名声也会因此受到永久性的损害——毕竟她被指责将个人安危置于职责之上…… ……在旧国，人们至今仍在用她的故事来警示孩子们…… 你的恐惧已经有了太多借口。但这些怪物已经袭击了你的家园，这种行为是不可原谅的。[kiyoko.numKits 4 | 阿萨吉里的烧伤痕迹依然清晰地印在你的脑海中，看着那一幕，你感到自己的心变得坚硬起来。 ] ] 不可原谅。 恶魔！ [kinu.kinuWeapon |当你从井后迅速冲出来时，你的长刀刀刃闪烁着光芒…… |当你拉紧弓弦时，箭头在阳光下闪闪发光，其锋利之处格外显眼。 ] 他们几乎同时甩出了那三只怪物那条条细长的尾巴。它们迅速旋转起来，又抽出了更多那些细长而带双刃的尾巴，然后以熟练的战斗阵型散开。通常情况下，多个敌人只会互相干扰、妨碍对方的行动，但这些怪物显然已经习惯了协同作战。 三对一。很好，否则就太不公平了。尽管他们在数量上占优势，但他们显然非常谨慎，紧密地排列在前面前进，显然打算在时机成熟时将你们包围起来。 那些白痴在干什么？他们中有一个人已经逃出来了！ 千万不要让那个恶魔碰到你，否则你只会变成一个空壳，什么也不会剩下！ [kinu.isInari |恶魔……就是这样的吗？我其实就是这样的存在吗？ 仇恨与饥饿彼此交织，如同一根灼热的针，同时刺痛着身体与心灵。你一生都在压抑着这种饥饿感，但既然此刻生死存亡悬而未决，如果现在不是拥抱它的时候，那还有什么时候呢？ 那我就让你看看我到底有多邪恶吧！ 这是一场激烈的战斗！ |有那么一瞬间，你甚至会为那些戴着面具的人感到同情，感受到他们内心的恐惧 你他们一定认为那是个怪物。但当你回想起他们之前的谈话，你的同情心立刻消失了。他们曾经有过疑虑，但也做出了选择——而你现在，也同样做出了选择。 美子总是取笑你心太软，总是为自己和别人找借口…… 战斗开始了…… ]
rows.raw: " Entering the well crossroads from the den quarters, you're stopped by the sight of three flickering lights in the distance. Voices, carried on the wind, although they're speaking too quickly for you to be able to discern what's being said. The crossroads is an open space by design, but you duck behind the well, huddling up with your [kinu.weapon] in your lap, pressed against your bloodstained nightgown even as your curl your tails about yourself. They're getting closer, lithe figures much like the duo lurking outside of your door; your heart hammers in your ears as you force your breath to still, lest they hear you. The light cast from their torches brings with it the heavy scent of mineral oil, a smell you've grown to hate very, very recently. "...That's how you get demons. Wait for the parents to be out, then seal up the nests and burn out the younglings. Works on imps, makes sense it'd work on these, too." They're speaking Belharan, you figure as much. "...I don't like this..." "Best to get them while they're young. You'd rather have an infestation of full-grown soul-suckers in a few years?" They've passed by the old well, the shadows stretching outward having hidden you well. You could just leave them and slip by... but that was never an option, was it? [kinu.isInari |Just staying hidden until now has tried your patience to its limit, the pointed vengeance of the blooded stayed but momentarily in wait of the perfect time to strike.[kiyoko.numKits 4 | The sight of Asagiri's burns is still fresh in your mind, and every muscle in your body screams and tightens. ] And through it all, at its very heart, an empty, cold clarity. |That would merely leave these three to wreak more havoc upon your home, and you would have failed in your duty and position. Even if you know the truth of the matter, Matron Komari's reputation is forever ruined for allegedly valuing her life above that of her responsibilities... ...They still tell tales of her as a cautionary example to children back in the Old Country, you've heard... Enough excuses for your fear. These monsters have attacked your home. This is unforgivable.[kiyoko.numKits 4 | The sight of Asagiri's burns is still fresh in your mind, and you feel your heart harden. ] ] Unforgivable. "Demon!" [kinu.kinuWeapon |The edge of your naginata flashes as you dart out from behind the well, the glaive's blade |The arrowhead gleams as you draw back the bowstring, the point ] nearly taking off one of the trio's vulpine tails. They whirl around, drawing more of those slender, double-edged blades and spreading out in practiced combat formation. Multiple enemies usually just tended to get in each others' way, but these appear practiced at fighting as a unit. Three to one. Good, it wouldn't be fair otherwise. Despite their numerical advantage over you, they're clearly cautious, advancing closely in a front and clearly intending to surround you when the opportunity presents itself. "What are those idiots doing? One of them got out!" "Don't let the demon touch you, or there won't be anything left but a husk!" [kinu.isInari |"Demon. Is that it? Is that what I am?" Hate and hunger twine about each other, a white-hot needle piercing pain and fatigue alike. All your life you've been holding back the hunger, but if now is not the time to embrace it when life and death hang in the balance, then when? "Then I'll show you how demonic I can be!" It's a fight! |For a moment you can almost pity the faces behind those masks, feel their fear of you, what they think must be a monster. Then you recall their earlier conversation, and your sympathy evaporates. They had their doubts, and made a choice — and so have you, here and now. Miko always teases you for being too soft-hearted and making excuses for yourself and others... Battle is joined... ] "

rows.original: [kinu.isInari |You gasp, sweat pouring down your face and heat rising off your body. Whirling around, tails flowing in your wake, you half-expect the fight to have brought more of these invaders bearing down on you, but whether it's from how short and ferocious the battle was or the chaos in the den, the altercation has gone unnoticed for now. Not that you expect such luck to hold for long... A brief bout of dizziness overtakes you as the surge of adrenaline passes. You're starting to lose blood despite the makeshift bindings about your wounds, you know that — the frailties of the flesh are starting to creep up on your strength of will, and you lean against the well for a moment or two, disgusted with your own weakness. But amidst all that... there's a sense of pride in that most of the rust-red stains adorning your nightgown didn't originate with you. Still, it doesn't hurt to tear a couple more stips of cloth from the fallen invaders' clothes, change your dressings; it's only a moment, after all, and you need all your strength. You take a few deep breaths and steady yourself. A drink of water would be nice, but you don't have the time or strength to draw one from the well |You gasp, coming up short of breath; this is far more physical exertion than what you're used to in your daily routine. Yes, it's true that you still [kinu.kinuWeapon |go through the naginata forms every day, especially when Mother is at home |practice your archery every day with [silly |the warden |Ishida-san ] ], but this is still unprecedented. While you half-expected the fight to have brought more of these invaders bearing down on you, the altercation has gone unnoticed for now. Good fortune, or good fate... A brief bout of dizziness overtakes you as the surge of adrenaline passes, leaving you weak in the stomach; you force down the urge to vomit and take several deep breaths until the nausea passes. Even so, the stench of blood lingers in your nose; it feels like it will never leave you. There is no one that can help you here; you are the highest authority, and indeed, it is others who are going to look to you for guidance... What do you do now? No, that is a stupid question. Just do as Mother and Matron Komari would have done... and what would they do? ]. Mother's abode is just across the other side of the den's heart, and as far as you can tell it's not on fire yet. There's still time. You... you must press on; [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |as much of a brat Aya can be at times, she's still your sister. |Aya and Tatsumi need you. |the most valuable things in the den are with Mother. The thought of these monsters laying their hands on them, committing sacrilege — it's enough to [kinu.isInari |make your blood boil |give one pause ]. ] [kinu.kinuWeapon |Fresh blood adorns the edge of your naginata's blade, and you pause to wipe it off on the grass before allowing yourself to relax |Arrows stick out of the fallen bodies, and you take the time to retrieve as many as you can. No sense in wasting them. ]. Duty beckons. Pausing just long enough to [kinu.isInari |spit on the broken corpses and kick them aside |offer a small prayer to the August Master At The Center Of Heaven ], you heft your [kinu.weapon] and double-time it down the path.
rows.translation: [kinu.isInari |你喘着粗气，汗水从脸上哗哗而下，全身散发着热气。你转身环顾四周，尾巴在身后摆动，心里暗自期待这场争斗会引来更多入侵者向你袭来。然而，不知是因为这场战斗太过短暂且激烈，还是因为洞穴里一片混乱，目前看来这场冲突还没有引起任何人的注意。 不过，你也知道这样的好运不会持续太久…… 当肾上腺素的冲击逐渐消退，一阵短暂的头晕感袭来。尽管你的伤口已经被临时包扎好，但血液仍在不断流失——肉体的脆弱正在逐渐侵蚀你的意志力。你靠在井边休息了一两分钟，对自己这样的软弱感到无比厌恶。 但在这一切之中……你还是会感到一丝自豪：因为你睡衣上那些铁锈红色的污渍，大多并非来自你自己。不过，从那些倒下的入侵者的衣服上再撕下几块布来更换绷带，也没什么坏处吧？毕竟只需要短短的几分钟而已，而你此时确实需要用上所有的力气。 你深吸了几口气，努力让自己保持稳定。喝口水会很好，但你没有时间也没有力气去井边打水。 |你喘着粗气，几乎无法呼吸——这种体力消耗远远超出了你日常习惯所能承受的范围。没错，事实确实如此 [kinu.kinuWeapon |每天都要练习长刀的各种招式，尤其是当母亲在家的时候。 |每天练习射箭吧。 [silly |监狱长 |石田先生 ] ]但这仍然是前所未有的。虽然你原本预计这场争斗会引来更多这样的入侵者向你袭来，但这次冲突目前还没有引起任何人的注意。是幸运吗？还是命运的安排…… 当肾上腺素的冲击逐渐消退后，一阵短暂的头晕感袭来，让你感到胃部不适；你强压住想要呕吐的冲动，深呼吸了几次，直到这种恶心感消失。 即便如此，血腥的气味依然萦绕在你的鼻尖，仿佛永远也不会消失。 在这里，没有人能够帮助你；你才是最高的权威，事实上，正是其他人会寻求你的帮助。 你 作为参考…… 你现在该怎么做呢？不，这个问题太愚蠢了。就按照母亲和科马里嬷嬷会做的那样去做吧……她们会怎么做呢？ ]母亲的居所就在巢穴心脏的另一侧，从目前来看，那里还没有着火。还有时间。你……你必须继续前进。 [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |尽管艾雅有时会表现得像个任性的孩子，但她毕竟还是你的妹妹。 |绫与龙司需要你。 |洞穴里最珍贵的东西都在母亲那里。一想到这些怪物会触碰它们、犯下亵渎罪，就……简直让人无法忍受。 [kinu.isInari |让人怒火中烧 |会让人停下来思考一下。 ]. ] [kinu.kinuWeapon |你手中的长刀刀刃上沾满了新鲜血液，你停下来，在草地上擦了擦，然后才放松下来。 |倒下的尸体上插着箭，你花时间尽可能多地捡起这些箭。浪费它们实在没有意义。 ]职责在召唤。我仅稍作停顿，然后 [kinu.isInari |往那些破碎的尸体上吐口水，然后把它们踢到一边去。 |向位于天中心的八月之主献上简短的祈祷吧。 ]你抬起了它 [kinu.weapon] 然后加快速度，继续沿着这条路前进。

rows.original: You see them coming from the side of the den crossroads, approaching from the east even as you head in from the north. A group of four, keeping tightly together, definitely more cautious than the others you've encountered so far; they're actually keeping silent as they move, as opposed to engaging in idle chatter. Did they find the bodies you've left in your wake? What a silly question — of course they did. The bodies of the last group you slew are gone, and nothing else could produce that sense of trepidation and fear that's practically sloughing off them. [kinu.isInari |At last. It's time for them to be afraid for once, instead of you. The feelings of your foes quaking in terror, even as they try to appear brave... they weren't expecting this, were they? Of course not, they were expecting to kill only defenseless children and get away with it |All the frustration at your impotence, your incompetence, your inability to rise beyond the call and save everything you've ever loved from being broken or outright destroyed — all of that tightens about your heart and drives you to push yourself just that bit much further ]. And now... You don't even bother with an ambush, [kinu.isInari |allowing your rage to propel you forward, all subtlety be damned |moving swiftly as the wind, your tails flowing behind you from the sheer rapidity of your advance ]. Foxfire pours off your body, lighting up the path with a ghastly blue glow as you [kinu.kinuWeapon |vault into your foes' midst, feeling the memory of the forms you practiced with Mother all those years ago surge through your muscles |circle around them, loosing your first volley ]. They're quick to respond, falling into formation and drawing long, thin bronze blades to meet your advance; you can't help but feel a twinge of pride at finally being taken as a serious threat. A wordless cry rings out into the night as you meet each other; the time for any kind of words has long since passed, if it ever existed to begin with. [kinu.isInari |It's a fight! |Battle is joined... ]
rows.translation: 你看到他们从巢穴十字路口的那侧走来，虽然你是从北方方向前往的，但他们却是从东方接近的。这是一群四个人，他们紧紧地靠在一起行动，显然比你迄今为止遇到的其他那些人要谨慎得多；他们在移动的过程中保持着沉默，没有闲聊或交谈。 他们找到你留下的那些尸体了吗？这个问题也太愚蠢了——他们当然找到了。你刚刚杀掉的那些人的尸体已经不见了，而除了这些尸体，没有什么其他东西能够让他们感到那种令人不寒而栗的恐惧。 [kinu.isInari |终于，轮到他们害怕了——而不是你。你的敌人虽然试图表现出勇敢，但内心却充满了恐惧……他们根本没预料到会遇到这种局面，对吧？当然没有，他们原本以为只需要杀死那些无助的孩子，然后就能逍遥法外罢了。 |所有那些因自己的无能为力、不胜任，以及无法挺身而出拯救自己珍视的一切、防止它们被毁掉而感到的沮丧，全都紧紧地压迫着你的内心，驱使你不得不再努力一点、再向前迈出一步。 ]现在…… 你甚至都不屑于设下埋伏， [kinu.isInari |让愤怒驱使自己前进，管他什么委婉与谨慎呢。 |你如风般迅捷移动，由于前进速度实在太快，你的尾巴在身后不断摆动。 ]当你移动时，狐火从你的身体中喷射而出，发出令人毛骨悚然的蓝光，照亮了前方的道路。 [kinu.kinuWeapon |猛地冲入敌人的包围之中，那些多年前与母亲一起练习过的动作记忆瞬间涌上你的四肢，令你充满力量。 |绕着他们转圈，然后发起第一波攻击。 ]他们反应迅速，迅速摆好战斗阵型，抽出那些细长而沉重的青铜武器来迎击你的进攻；当你意识到自己终于被他们视为一个真正的威胁时，不禁会感到一丝自豪。 当你们双方在夜色中相遇时，没有任何言语被发出；早在很久以前，任何言语就已经变得多余了——如果从来真有过需要言语表达的时刻的话。 [kinu.isInari |这是一场激烈的战斗！ |战斗开始了…… ]

rows.original: [kinu.kinuWeapon |The last invader standing lunges at you with a thrust aimed at your gut; you narrowly sidestep the blow and catch the bronze blade with the guard of your naginata. With a quick flick using your palm as leverage, you pull upwards; he? she? it? doesn't have enough stamina to withstand the sudden application of force and the weapon goes careening away into the air |The last invader standing lunges at you with a thrust aimed at your gut; you narrowly sidestep the blow and pull away, gaining enough distance to effectively draw your half-bow while he recovers from the attack. This time, you don't aim for him, but the weapon; you loose the arrow and it strikes the long, thin blade near the hilt. Weakened from the fight, your foe doesn't have the wherewithal to keep his? her? its? grip and the weapon clatters to the ground ]. In a flash, you close the remaining distance between the two of you, getting right up into the invader's personal space. The spindly vulpine thing looks around, eyes darting behind that black-and-white mask, perhaps not quite believing the sight of its fallen comrades-in-arms or the fact that they've managed to lose despite outnumbering you four to one. "You don't belong in this land, demon. Go home!" "...I was born here. This is my home. [kinu.isInari |I have known no other |Everyone I am responsible for lives here ]." It backs away, stepping over fallen bodies in its haste to get away from you. "That doesn't change anything! You still don't belong, and never have!" "...Maybe." [kinu.isInari |For all of the umbrage thrown at you, no mere words can shake your resolve, your conviction, your sure-footed knowledge that these creatures had tried to murder you and yours in your sleep in the most cowardly way possible |Those words, they have the ring of honesty, but not truth. Truth, then, as this poor soul believes it; in this moment, you can almost pity your enemy, redirect your hate and frustration not upon the pawn itself, but reserve it for the hand that drives the game forward ]. Ah, it all changes nothing. [kinu.kinuWeapon |A quick jab with the naginata |A well-placed arrow ], and it's all over. [kinu.isInari |It's certainly not ladylike, but it feels so good to be able to strike back, do something, no matter how small. A surge of strength and perhaps even jubilation at defending you and yours from those who would harm them. |More deaths, more blood on your hands; you don't feel proud or a sense of achievement for having slain enemies in defense of your home and furtherance of your responsibilities. All you feel is empty inside. ] But... Curiosity gets the better of you, and you reach down and take hold of the half-mask, the thin porcelain — or at least, what feels like it — smooth under your touch. You hesitate as your fingers find purchase, then pull and the string holding it in place snaps. What did you expect? You're not sure yourself, but what meets your eyes is a full fox-face, not too different from the wolf-people natives of these lands, slender and androgynous. Very much like yours would be if you gave in to the hunger enough to revert to that state... and perhaps that's what's so uncanny and disquieting about it. You're nothing alike, but it does bear what you could become... ...No, that's not right. You're nothing alike; who you are and what you become are more than your appearance. And though the dead, ashen face beneath you is plain, you know better than to misjudge someone that way; monsters don't have to be ugly, after all. You straighten and shake your head, letting the mask fall and smash to pieces on the path. Sating your curiosity has produced no answers, and only more questions, questions that you're not likely to resolve anytime soon, if ever. Time to move on...
rows.translation: [kinu.kinuWeapon |最后一名入侵者猛地朝你冲来，用剑刺向你的腹部；你巧妙地侧身躲过了这一击，然后用长刀的护手接住了那把青铜剑。你迅速用手掌作为杠杆，向上一拉——对方根本没有足够的体力来承受这种突然施加的力量，于是那把武器被抛到了空中。 |最后一个入侵者猛地朝你冲来，用刺击瞄准你的腹部；你巧妙地侧身躲过了这一击，然后迅速后退，拉开足够的距离，抽出了你的半弓。这一次，你并没有瞄准敌人，而是瞄准了他的武器——你射出的箭击中了那把长而细的刀刃，正好在刀柄附近。经过激烈的战斗，你的敌人已经体力不支，根本无法握住那把武器，于是它重重地掉在了地上。 ]转眼间，你便缩短了与入侵者之间的距离，直接进入了它的个人空间。那个瘦高如狐的生物四处张望，它那双眼睛在黑白相间的面具后快速移动，或许还不太相信自己那些战友已经倒下，也不相信他们竟然会在人数上以四比一的优势仍处于劣势却还是失败了。 你不属于这片土地，恶魔。滚回去吧！ ……我在这里出生，这里就是我的家。 [kinu.isInari |我从未认识过其他人。 |我负责照顾的所有人都住在这里。 ]." 它慌忙后退，踩着倒下的尸体，只想尽快逃离你的身边。 那根本改变不了什么！你仍然不属于这里，从来都不属于！ ……也许吧。 [kinu.isInari |尽管有人对你们提出了种种指责，但没有任何言语能够动摇你们的决心、你们的信念，更无法动摇你们那坚定的信念——这些生物确实试图在你们睡觉时，以最卑鄙的方式杀害你们和你们所珍视的人。 |那些话听起来确实诚恳，但却并不真实。而真相，正如这个可怜的人所相信的那样……在这一刻，你甚至会为你的敌人感到同情，你应该将你的仇恨与沮丧转向那些真正推动这场游戏发展的人，而不是那个被当作棋子使用的角色本身。 ]啊，这一切其实都没有什么改变。 [kinu.kinuWeapon |用长刀快速地刺出一击 |一支射得恰到好处的箭 ]就这样，一切都结束了。 [kinu.isInari |虽然这确实不符合淑女的行为规范，但感觉却挺不错的。 不错 这样才能予以反击，对吧。 某个东西无论这种力量多么微小，当人们保护你和你所珍视的人免受伤害者的侵害时，他们内心都会涌起一股力量，甚至会感到欣喜若狂。 |更多的死亡，更多的鲜血沾上你的双手；你并不会因为为了保卫家园、履行自己的责任而杀死敌人而感到自豪或成就感。你只觉得内心一片空虚。 ] 但是…… 好奇心最终战胜了你的犹豫，你伸手部拿起了那半面面具——那薄薄的瓷质材料，至少在你触摸的时候，感觉确实是瓷质。当你的手部指抓住它的时候，你犹豫了一下，然后一拉，固定它的绳子就断了。 你还能期待什么呢？你自己也不确定，但眼前呈现的，确实是一张典型的狐面——与这些地区土生土长的狼人族群几乎没有区别，同样身形修长，兼具男性和女性的特征。如果你真的忍不住饥饿，身体也会退化成那种形态，你的脸也会变成这样的。……也许正是这一点，才让它显得如此不可思议、如此令人不安。你们之间没有任何相似之处，但它确实蕴含着你们未来可能成为的样子…… ……不，这样说不对。你们之间确实没有任何相似之处；你们的本质以及你们未来会变成什么样，远远超出了外表所能体现的。 尽管你脚下那张苍白、毫无生气的脸看起来十分可怕，但你心里很清楚，不能因此就对这个人产生错误的判断——毕竟，怪物并不一定非得长得丑陋才算怪物。 你挺直身子，摇了摇头，让那面面具从脸上掉落，然后摔得粉碎，散落在小路上。 满足你的好奇心并没有带来任何答案，反而引发了更多的疑问——而这些疑问，很可能在短期内无法得到解答，甚至永远无法解决。 是时候继续前进了……
