rows.original: By the time you get to Mother's abode, it's too late. The door hasn't merely been forced open — it lies on the ground, completely torn off its hinges and slashed in several places, the marks clearly belonging to that of an axe. You swallow hard and pick up your jog into a sprint; there's still hope. Unlike you and [kiyoko.numKits 4 |Asagiri |the field hands ], the invaders chose not to seal the exits and burn everything down; the reason for such soon becomes apparent. Mother was always such a stickler for tidiness ever since you were a kit, and the state of her home would have her shedding all over the place from the sheer disarray it's in. Every single trunk upended, their contents spilled onto the floorboards. Every set of drawers and wardrobe pulled out and ransacked. Even the scroll calligraphy and paintings have been torn down, perhaps to check for anything hidden behind them. And of course, everything that's remotely of value, pilfered. Are there foes still in here, or is everything gone by now? Mother's abode isn't very big, unlike the old cabin you used to live in during your childhood, but it still has to be the best the colonies can offer for someone of her lineage. Your breath catches with each room you peer into, half-expecting to find [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |your sister, dead or alive |your siblings, dead or alive |pillagers about the dirty deed ], but all is peaceful, too peaceful for the mess that's been made. [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |"Aya!" No reply. Dread gnaws at your heart, and you head on to the back. |"Aya! Tatsumi!" No reply. Dread gnaws at your heart, and you head on to the back. |Onwards and forwards, then... ]
rows.translation: 当你赶到母亲的家时，已经为时已晚。门不仅被强行撞开，更是彻底从铰链上被扯了下来，上面还有多处被斧头砍过的痕迹。你艰难地咽了口唾沫，加快脚步开始奔跑——还有希望的。毕竟，和你不同 [kiyoko.numKits 4 |朝雾 |那些在田里劳作的农民们 ]入侵者并没有选择封堵出口、将一切都烧毁；原因很快便显而易见了。自从你还是个小孩子的时候，母亲就一直非常注重整洁，而她家的现状简直乱得让她无法忍受。 每一个箱子都被翻了个个底朝天，里面的东西全都散落在地板上。每一组抽屉和衣柜都被拉出来彻底搜查。就连那些卷轴、书法作品和绘画也被拆下来，或许是为了检查它们后面是否藏着什么秘密。 当然，所有有点价值的东西都被偷走了。 这里还剩下敌人吗，还是都已经被清空了？母亲的住所并不大，不像你童年时住的那个老小屋，但对于她这样的身份来说，这里应该已经是殖民地能提供的最好的住所了吧。 每当你窥视进入一个房间时，都会不由得屏住呼吸，几乎期待着会在那里看到些什么 [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |你的妹妹，无论她是活着还是死了…… |你的兄弟姐妹，无论他们是生是死 |那些干着卑鄙勾当的掠夺者 ]然而，一切却显得如此宁静——对于之前发生的那些混乱而言，这种宁静未免太过不可思议了。 [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |阿雅！ 没有回应。恐惧开始侵蚀你的心，于是你朝着后方走去。 |绫！龙美！ 没有回应。恐惧开始侵蚀你的心，于是你朝着后方走去。 |那么，继续前进吧…… ]

rows.original: And then you hear it when you enter the landing: vulpine yipping, followed by the sound of wood splintering as furniture cracks. [kinu.isInari |A surge of fire rushes through your limbs |You swallow hard ] as you rush down the corridor past strewn cushions and upended plant pots, throwing open the screen door and charging in with [kinu.kinuWeapon |naginata ready to swing |fingers on your bowstring, ready to draw ]. The duo of masked invaders harassing your sister turn at your entrance, just in time for one of them to get [kinu.kinuWeapon |a gash in her side |an arrow in her side ] from you. And that's all the opening Aya needs. Without a weapon in hand, your sister has allowed the hunger to partially consume her, so that she may fight for her life; orange fur sprouts from her arms from the shoulder down, her fingers twisted into animalistic, clawed protrusions wreathed in foxfire. The snapping vulpine fangs that fill her jaws are clearly giving the invaders some pause; as each moment passes and the hunger dominates her more and more, her form wavers and shifts, becoming less and less human in appearance. Caught between the two of you, the one remaining demeanour changes as his companion falls, and then Aya gets in from behind, locks her teeth about his throat, and rips it out. Brutal, yet painfully efficient — [kinu.isInari |it feels inefficient to follow up on your sister's attack by finishing off the bastard, but you've got to be sure |no matter how necessary you know this to be, you still shudder at the sight and the mess it's creating on the tatami flooring ]. The deed done, your sister turns her gaze to you and snarls, ears folded back. "Aya! Get ahold of yourself!" Something shifts behind your sister's eyes; for a moment she looks as if she's going to pounce on you, then relents. The amber-orange fur encasing her limbs retracts back into her body, and her fingers revert to something more human in appearance. Even her teeth come back under control; where there was but moments ago a monstrous creature ready to tear out hearts and eat livers, all there is now is a fox-eared girl kneeling on the floor amidst the strewn cushions and broken furniture, sniffling softly. Tired and breathless, bleeding from scratches and cuts, your little sister whimpers as you gather her in your arms and drag her away from the cooling corpses on the ground. "[silly |Onee-sama |Big sis ]!" "Are you fine?" Aya looks down at her own torn sleepwear and bedraggled hair and fur, then at you, and her eyes widen. You can only imagine what you look like right now, what she sees in you, but [kinu.isInari |there's nothing to be ashamed of here, hard to swallow as it may be |there are no good options in a situation like this. You don't blame her; you'd be afraid of yourself, too ]. "I... it's just a [silly |flesh wound |scratch ], that's all," your sister insists. "It's nothing. I... I can still walk. Run, even." Her wounds are more than physical, but Aya is a resilient soul; she'll get over it with enough time. You hope. "It's all right, Aya. They can't hurt you any more, they're dead. We put them down together." Your sister looks abashed for a moment, then she freezes in your embrace, muscles tensing. "[silly |Nee-sama |Big sis ]! Look out!" Aya pushes you out of the way; you don't resist her and tumble to the floor as a dagger flashes in the darkness, aimed between your shoulderblades. You turn the tumble into a roll, and the pointed edge whistles through thin air; the invader whom you first brought down has crawled all the way over despite her mortal wound, determined for some last-minute revenge. [kinu.isInari |Cursing yourself for your sloppiness, you [kinu.kinuWeapon |heft your naginata and drive the blade between the miscreant's ribs |grab an arrow from your quiver and plunge it into the miscreant's throat ] |You hug your sister close as the two of you watch the miscreant bleed out, having failed in her final purpose ]; the thin, twisted figure shudders, and is still.
rows.translation: 当你走进降落区时，你会听到那些声音：狐狸的尖叫声，紧接着是家具断裂时木头碎裂的声音。 [kinu.isInari |一股灼热的力量在你的四肢中奔涌流淌。 |你艰难地咽了口唾沫。 ] 当你冲过走廊，穿过散落在地上的靠垫和翻倒的花盆，推开门冲了进去的时候 [kinu.kinuWeapon |长刀已准备挥动 |手指紧握在弓弦上，随时准备拉弓。 ]那两个戴着面具的入侵者正在骚扰你的妹妹，就在他们其中一个即将得逞的瞬间，他们转向了你所在的方向 [kinu.kinuWeapon |她侧身被划出了一道伤口。 |心有余而力不足 ] 这一切，都是艾雅开始战斗所需要的。手中没有武器，你的妹妹只能让饥饿感逐渐侵蚀她的身体，这样才能让她有力量为生存而战；从肩膀开始，她的手臂上长出了橙色的毛皮，手指也变成了带有爪子的动物形态，那些爪子上还缠绕着狐火。 她颌部中那些锋利如钩的獠牙显然让入侵者们有些犹豫；然而随着时间的流逝，饥饿感逐渐占据她的意识，她的形态也开始发生变化，外观越来越不再像人类了。 被你们两个人逼迫在中间，那个剩下的家伙在同伴倒下的瞬间彻底改变了态度。接着，Aya从背后扑上来，紧紧咬住他的喉咙，然后将其生生扯了下来。这一幕既残忍，又高效得令人不寒而栗 [kinu.isInari |虽然直接干掉那个混蛋来报复你妹妹的遭遇似乎有些浪费精力，但你必须确保这么做才是正确的选择。 |无论你多么认为这件事是必要的，每当看到这一幕，以及它给榻榻米地板带来的破坏时，你依然会感到不寒而栗。 ]动作完成后，你的妹妹转过头来，瞪着你，耳朵都向后贴住了。 阿雅！冷静一点！ 你妹妹的眼中仿佛发生了某种变化；有那么一瞬间，她看起来就像是要扑向你一样，但最终又放弃了这个念头。覆盖在她四肢上的琥珀色毛发重新缩回了她的身体里，她的手指也恢复成了更接近人类的形态。 就连她的牙齿也重新恢复了控制；就在刚才，那个仿佛随时都会撕出心脏、吃掉肝脏的恐怖生物，如今却变成了一个有着狐狸耳朵的女孩，她跪在地板上，周围散落着垫子和破碎的家具，正轻声抽泣着。 你妹妹又累又气喘，身上还有许多擦伤和伤口在流血。当你把她抱在怀里，把她从地上那些已经冷却的尸体旁边拖走时，她发出了呜咽声。 "[silly |姐姐大人 |大姐 ]!" 你没事吧？ 阿雅低头看着自己破烂的睡衣、凌乱的头发和毛发，然后看向你，她的眼睛突然睁得大大的。你只能想象自己现在看起来是什么样子，以及她在你身上看到了什么 [kinu.isInari |这里没有什么可羞愧的，尽管这可能让人难以接受。 |在这种情况下，根本没有好的选择。你不能责怪她；换作是你，也会害怕的。 ]. 我……只是觉得这有点 [silly |皮肉之伤 |刮擦 ]就这些了。 你姐姐坚持要这样。 没什么。我……我还能走路，甚至还能跑。 她的伤不仅仅是身体上的，但艾雅是一个坚韧的人；只要有足够的时间，她一定能挺过去。至少你是这么希望的。 没事的，阿雅。他们再也不能伤害你了，他们已经死了。是我们一起把他们解决的。 你的妹妹先是显得有些尴尬，随后在你的怀抱中僵硬起来，全身肌肉都绷得紧紧的。 "[silly |妮大人 |大姐 ]小心！ 亚雅将你推到一边，你没有反抗，便跌倒在地。此时，一把匕首在黑暗中闪现，其刀尖正对准你的肩胛骨。你迅速翻滚躲过这一击，那锋利的刀刃只从你身旁呼啸而过。那个你之前击倒的入侵者，尽管受了致命伤，却依然爬了过来，决心在最后关头进行报复。 [kinu.isInari |你因为自己的粗心大意而自责不已。 [kinu.kinuWeapon |握紧你的长刀，将刀刃刺入那个恶人的肋骨之间。 |从你的箭袋中取出一支箭，将其插入那个恶人的喉咙中。 ] |你们紧紧地拥抱在一起，看着那个坏女人慢慢失去生命，她的最终目的终究没有得逞。 ]那个瘦弱而扭曲的身影颤抖着，最终静止了下来。
rows.raw: " And then you hear it when you enter the landing: vulpine yipping, followed by the sound of wood splintering as furniture cracks. [kinu.isInari |A surge of fire rushes through your limbs |You swallow hard ] as you rush down the corridor past strewn cushions and upended plant pots, throwing open the screen door and charging in with [kinu.kinuWeapon |naginata ready to swing |fingers on your bowstring, ready to draw ]. The duo of masked invaders harassing your sister turn at your entrance, just in time for one of them to get [kinu.kinuWeapon |a gash in her side |an arrow in her side ] from you. And that's all the opening Aya needs. Without a weapon in hand, your sister has allowed the hunger to partially consume her, so that she may fight for her life; orange fur sprouts from her arms from the shoulder down, her fingers twisted into animalistic, clawed protrusions wreathed in foxfire. The snapping vulpine fangs that fill her jaws are clearly giving the invaders some pause; as each moment passes and the hunger dominates her more and more, her form wavers and shifts, becoming less and less human in appearance. Caught between the two of you, the one remaining demeanour changes as his companion falls, and then Aya gets in from behind, locks her teeth about his throat, and rips it out. Brutal, yet painfully efficient — [kinu.isInari |it feels inefficient to follow up on your sister's attack by finishing off the bastard, but you've got to be sure |no matter how necessary you know this to be, you still shudder at the sight and the mess it's creating on the tatami flooring ]. The deed done, your sister turns her gaze to you and snarls, ears folded back. "Aya! Get ahold of yourself!" Something shifts behind your sister's eyes; for a moment she looks as if she's going to pounce on you, then relents. The amber-orange fur encasing her limbs retracts back into her body, and her fingers revert to something more human in appearance. Even her teeth come back under control; where there was but moments ago a monstrous creature ready to tear out hearts and eat livers, all there is now is a fox-eared girl kneeling on the floor amidst the strewn cushions and broken furniture, sniffling softly. Tired and breathless, bleeding from scratches and cuts, your little sister whimpers as you gather her in your arms and drag her away from the cooling corpses on the ground. "[silly |Onee-sama |Big sis ]!" "Are you fine?" Aya looks down at her own torn sleepwear and bedraggled hair and fur, then at you, and her eyes widen. You can only imagine what you look like right now, what she sees in you, but [kinu.isInari |there's nothing to be ashamed of here, hard to swallow as it may be |there are no good options in a situation like this. You don't blame her; you'd be afraid of yourself, too ]. "I... it's just a [silly |flesh wound |scratch ], that's all," your sister insists. "It's nothing. I... I can still walk. Run, even." Her wounds are more than physical, but Aya is a resilient soul; she'll get over it with enough time. You hope. "It's all right, Aya. They can't hurt you any more, they're dead. We put them down together." Your sister looks abashed for a moment, then she freezes in your embrace, muscles tensing. "[silly |Nee-sama |Big sis ]! Look out!" Aya pushes you out of the way; you don't resist her and tumble to the floor as a dagger flashes in the darkness, aimed between your shoulderblades. You turn the tumble into a roll, and the pointed edge whistles through thin air; the invader whom you first brought down has crawled all the way over despite her mortal wound, determined for some last-minute revenge. [kinu.isInari |Cursing yourself for your sloppiness, you [kinu.kinuWeapon |heft your naginata and drive the blade between the miscreant's ribs |grab an arrow from your quiver and plunge it into the miscreant's throat ] |You hug your sister close as the two of you watch the miscreant bleed out, having failed in her final purpose ]; the thin, twisted figure shudders, and is still. "

rows.original: "That was close," Aya mewls. You have to agree. "What happened here, Aya?[kiyoko.numKits 3 | Where's Tatsumi?" ] "They... they woke me up by breaking down the door," your little sister admits, hanging her head and folding her ears forward. "Then they came in, eight to ten of them... started ransacking the palace, taking everything that wasn't too heavy to carry and trashing the rest. I... I was so scared, I went into the study to hide because the place is warded..." You nod. "Go on. Calm yourself, I need to know what's out there. You said there were eight to ten of them — I count only two here." "Most of them took Mother's things away in the trunks that held them, anything exotic or valuable. These two came up to the study and found me hiding under the table, and —" "And by the looks of things, they haven't looted this place yet, because of you. Good work protecting Mother's most prized treasures. Two of them are here and dead... so that leaves at least six to eight more of these things out there[kinu.isInari | for me to put down ]." [kinu.isInari |Your sister looks up at you, mouth slightly agape as she shivers. "Y-you're going to kill them?" "Of course. Aya, they were going to burn [kiyoko.numKits 4 5 |Asagiri |Asagiri and the rest of our family |the field hands from Granny Komari's ] alive. They were going to burn me in my bedchambers, bar me inside until either the smoke or the flames killed me. As far as I'm concerned, I will make each and every one of their deaths as excruciatingly painful as practically possible. No one hurts my family and gets away with it, and you are of my blood, too." "..." "Sometimes, Aya, being responsible means bearing sins and shame upon yourself so others don't have to." "[silly |Nee-sama |Big sis ]... please don't die." "I don't intend to bleed out in a ditch, if that's what you mean." "You..." your little sister searches for the right words. "You feel like someone else right now, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]..." You allow yourself a dry chuckle and pat your little sister's head with a bloodstained hand. "And you weren't back there, fighting for your life?" "..." |Your sister winces. "There's more of them than that, I'm sure..." "So many just to kill children." Aya gives you a weak grin. "Isn't that a compliment, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]? Needing such numbers just for us?" "The den is large with many derelict buildings, and I suppose they wanted to be thorough. It is what I would have done, were I in their position. I just need to make sure the most important places are safe... or at least, overlooked." "[silly |Nee-sama |Big sis ]... please don't die." There are several things you could have said to that, but you aren't willing to say anything that's disheartening or an outright lie. Instead, you settle for patting your little sister on the head and leaving it at that. ] [kiyoko.numKits 3 |"Right. It's just you here. Where's Tatsumi?" "He said he was going to work late in the field shed getting all the new things organized, and that I should go to bed first without waiting for him..." Ah, of course. That makes perfect sense. "I'll have to go and get him, then." |"Is everyone safe? Are we going to get out of here now?" "I don't know. There are some places I still have to scour, like the fields and the shed, make sure I didn't miss anyone working late, for example.[kinu.isInari | That, and not going to fall back until I absolutely must — I haven't had my fill of these monsters' blood yet. ]" ] Aya nods. "Okay, listen up. You know where Mother's treasures are in this room, the most valuable ones. Go and get everything that you can easily carry, and head off to the den's entrance. I've told [kiyoko.numKits 4 |Asagiri |the field hands ] to wait for me there while I clear out our home; go and join them. Keep as much as you can from being pilfered by these thieves, but at the same time don't throw your life away doing it. Do you understand me?" "Y-yes, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]." "Good. I'll see you at the entrance." You hug Aya one last time, then leave her to it, breaking into a brisk jog as you head downstairs and out the door. Your task tonight is still far from done...
rows.translation: 真是好险啊。 阿雅发出了呜咽声。 你不得不承认，这一点确实如此。 这里发生了什么，阿雅？[kiyoko.numKits 3 | 龙美在哪里？ ] 他们……他们撞开了门，把我吵醒了。 你的妹妹低着头，把耳朵耷拉下来，承认了自己的错误。 然后他们进来了，有八到十个人……开始洗劫宫殿，把所有不重得搬不动的东西都拿走了，其余的则被毁得一片狼藉。我……我害怕极了，就躲进了书房，因为那个地方有防护措施…… 你点了点头。 继续说。冷静下来，我需要知道外面到底有多少人。你说有八到十个人——但我在这里只看到了两个人。 他们中的大多数人把母亲的所有物品都装进了那些用来携带它们的箱子里，把所有那些稀有的或珍贵的东西都拿走了。而这两个人来到书房，发现我躲在桌子下面，然后—— 看样子，因为你的缘故，他们还没有洗劫这个地方。保护母亲最珍贵的财宝，干得不错。其中有两个已经在这里被毁掉了……那么，应该还剩下至少六到八件这样的财宝在别的地方。[kinu.isInari | 让我放弃吧 ]." [kinu.isInari |你的妹妹抬头看着你，嘴巴微微张开，身体还在发抖。 你、你要杀了他们？ 当然。阿雅，他们本来打算把它们烧掉的。 [kiyoko.numKits 4 5 |朝雾 |朝雾以及我们家的其他成员 |来自小毬奶奶家的那些农场工人 ] 还活着。他们本来是要被烧死的。 我 在我的卧室里，他们把我关在里面，直到烟雾或火焰把我烧死。在我看来，我会让他们每个人的死亡都变得极其痛苦。谁要是伤害我的家人，谁就别想轻易逃脱惩罚——而你，也是我的亲人。 "..." 有时候，阿雅，承担责任意味着要自己背负罪恶与羞耻，这样别人就不用承受了。 "[silly |奈様 |大姐 ]……请千万不要死。 我可不想在沟里流血而死，如果你是这个意思的话。 你…… 你的妹妹正在努力寻找合适的词语来表达自己的意思。 现在你感觉自己仿佛变成了另一个人 [silly |nee-sama |大姐 ]..." 你暗自笑了笑，然后用沾满血迹的手部轻轻拍了拍妹妹的脑袋。 那你当时并不在那里，为生存而战斗吗？ "..." |你的妹妹皱起了眉头。 我敢肯定，他们的数量远不止那些…… 竟然有这么多人只是为了杀害儿童。 阿雅勉强挤出了一个微笑。 那难道不是一种赞美吗？ [silly |nee-sama |大姐 ]难道真的只为我们才需要这样的数字吗？ 那个藏身处很大，里面有许多废弃的建筑，我想他们应该是想把一切都处理得彻底一些。如果我处在他们的位置，也会这么做。我只需要确保最重要的地方是安全的……或者至少，不会被注意到罢了。 "[silly |妮大人 |大姐 ]……请千万不要死。 对于那种情况，你本可以说很多话，但你却不愿意说任何会让人沮丧的话，也不愿意说彻头彻尾的谎言。于是，你只能选择轻轻拍拍妹妹的头，然后就此作罢。 ] [kiyoko.numKits 3 |对了，这里只有你一个人。龙美去哪里了？ 他说他要在田间的小屋里工作到很晚，把所有新到的东西整理好，让我先去睡觉，不用等他…… 啊，当然。这完全合情合理。 那我就得去把他找回来才行。 |大家都安全吗？我们现在能离开这里了吗？ 我不知道。还有一些地方我还需要仔细检查，比如田野和棚屋，要确保没有遗漏任何加班工作的人。[kinu.isInari | 就是这个原则，而且在绝对必要时之前，我绝不会退缩——我还没喝够这些怪物的鲜血呢。 ]" ] 绫点了点头。 好了，听好了。你们知道这个房间里母亲珍藏的最贵重的物品放在哪里吧。去把所有能轻松携带的东西都拿过来，然后朝着巢穴的入口方向前进。我已经告诉过你们该怎么做了。 [kiyoko.numKits 4 |朝雾 |那些在田里劳作的农民们 ] 你就在那里等我，等我把我们的家清理干净后再过来找你。去和他们一起吧。尽量防止那些小偷把你的东西偷走，但同时也不要为了保护这些东西而冒生命危险。明白我的意思吗？ 是……是的。 [silly |nee-sama |大姐 ]." 好的，我们在入口处见。 你最后一次拥抱了艾雅，然后离开她，快步下楼，走出了大门。今晚你的任务还远未完成……

rows.original: The second floor of Mother's abode is in much the same condition as the first: ransacked and looted. Without anyone around to stop them, the invaders were able to conduct a thorough search of the place; you yourself know where Mother keeps her valuables in the study, and they're all gone. Not that there were very many places to hide things in this much smaller home, but even so all of the hiding spots in the study have been rooted out and pilfered. Yes, it's true that nothing stored here is irreplaceable — anything that precious would be on Mother's person at all times — but even so, the thought of your things, kitsune things, in the hands of these people who will certainly have no appreciation or understanding of their value only makes you [kinu.isInari |all the more upset |sad ]. It does reveal the fact, though, that whoever conducted this search had to have some measure of competency in these matters in order to be able to defeat Mother's little glamours and tricks... There's nothing left for you here now, and lingering in Mother's study only makes the hollow emptiness in your ribs and pit of your stomach weigh all the more heavily[kinu.isHime |, reminding you of your failure ]. If nothing else, the invaders haven't torched the building yet, small consolation as that is; [kinu.isInari |you'll just have to hunt them down elsewhere |you have to move on before they decide to return and finish the deed ]. You still haven't checked the fields and the adjoining storage sheds; that feels like a good place to try next... Time to get moving, then.
rows.translation: 母亲的住所二楼和一楼的情况差不多：被洗劫一空。由于没有人阻止他们，入侵者得以彻底搜查这个地方；你自己也知道母亲把贵重物品放在书房的哪个地方，而那些东西都已经不见了。 虽然在这个面积小得多的家里，能藏东西的地方本来就不多，但即便如此，书房里所有的藏匿处还是都被翻了个底朝天，里面的东西都被偷走了。 没错，这里存放的东西确实没有哪一样是不可替代的——任何珍贵的东西母亲都会随身携带——但即便如此，一想到你的东西被偷走了，我还是感到很难过。 狐妖 把这些东西交给那些根本不会懂得它们价值的人手部中，只会让事情变得更糟。 [kinu.isInari |更加心烦意乱 |难过 ]不过，这一事实确实说明：凡是进行这次搜索的人，必定在这些领域具备一定的能力，才能够识破母亲那些小小的迷惑手部段和诡计…… 现在这里已经没有你该留下来的理由了，继续滞留在母亲的书房里，只会让你胸中的空虚感和胃里的难受感变得更加沉重。[kinu.isHime |这是在提醒你，你的失败已然成为事实。 ]至少，入侵者还没有烧毁这栋建筑，也算是一个小小的安慰吧。 [kinu.isInari |你只能去其他地方寻找它们了。 |在他们决定回来完成这件事之前，你必须继续前进。 ]你还没有检查那些田地以及旁边的储藏棚吧；那些地方似乎很适合下一步的搜寻…… 那么，是时候行动了。
rows.raw: " The second floor of Mother's abode is in much the same condition as the first: ransacked and looted. Without anyone around to stop them, the invaders were able to conduct a thorough search of the place; you yourself know where Mother keeps her valuables in the study, and they're all gone. Not that there were very many places to hide things in this much smaller home, but even so all of the hiding spots in the study have been rooted out and pilfered. Yes, it's true that nothing stored here is irreplaceable — anything that precious would be on Mother's person at all times — but even so, the thought of your things, kitsune things, in the hands of these people who will certainly have no appreciation or understanding of their value only makes you [kinu.isInari |all the more upset |sad ]. It does reveal the fact, though, that whoever conducted this search had to have some measure of competency in these matters in order to be able to defeat Mother's little glamours and tricks... There's nothing left for you here now, and lingering in Mother's study only makes the hollow emptiness in your ribs and pit of your stomach weigh all the more heavily[kinu.isHime |, reminding you of your failure ]. If nothing else, the invaders haven't torched the building yet, small consolation as that is; [kinu.isInari |you'll just have to hunt them down elsewhere |you have to move on before they decide to return and finish the deed ]. You still haven't checked the fields and the adjoining storage sheds; that feels like a good place to try next... Time to get moving, then. "

rows.original: The ground is warm beneath your feet, heavy smoke rises from the burning fields as you pace through them, [kinu.isInari |not knowing or caring if they see you now. The sight of scorched stalks and trampled leaves — even the fury in you is gone as you double-time it through the ashes of the harvest, replaced by a numb vacuousness that presses against your eyes from the inside of your head. Everything feels like a dream, unreal; despite the roar and flicker of the flames that linger, everything is quiet and muted. You have never walked through a battlefield before, but given the histories you've read, perhaps this is what it might be like. It is a struggle to not give in and break down crying completely and utterly, but you will not give these barbaric monsters the satisfaction of that. |hot air rushing through your lungs as you pant and sweat. Maybe you should have stopped for a drink of water at the well, but it's too late to regret past decisions now. The harvest is going up in smoke; the rice, the beans, even the root crops. Pettiness; what they could not easily steal or glean, they destroyed. Even if you can understand the reasoning and motivation behind such actions, it's all such a terrible waste... ] The paths through the fields are winding on purpose to accommodate the irrigation ditches; the shortest route to the storage sheds is through them. Dangerous to cross the fields right now like this, even if the flames are burning themselves out; still, it's less [kinu.isInari |time-consuming than the alternative. You need to be fast on your feet, and... well, there is the desire to be with your children in the last moments of their lives, agonising as they may be... |dangerous than running into more of those invaders on the road. ] And then your heart sinks as the other edge of the fields draws into view. Whether it's because you got here last or they were first to arrive, these being on the edges of the den, the destruction is complete; only burnt-out husks remain of the sheds, blackened support beams sitting amidst a sea of ashes. Half of the makeshift granary has collapsed in on itself, popping and crackling sounds coming from within as the contents continue to smoulder; the ground here has been churned into dirt, what looks like dozens of feet having come and gone without care for stealth or subtlety. There is nothing left here; that which has not been stolen has been destroyed. [var0 |That, though, is only one of the things that you're here for. Though the loss of the stores hurts, they can be replaced; your baby brother can't. You're about to call for him, and then the clash of metal on metal draws your attention. By the charred shell of what used to be where you kept the seeds, two silhouettes clash with each other, two more bodies on the ground. Tatsumi has grabbed one of the invading monsters' weapons and is fighting the last standing one of their number. You dart forward, [kinu.weapon] at the ready, but your baby brother doesn't need your help and is handily dealing with his foe. By the time you're within [kinu.kinuWeapon |striking ]range, he's pressed his attack and rammed the long, slender bronze sword through the invader's guts. With a sharp yank, Tatsumi extracts the still-dripping blade, and his shoulders and tails relax as his foe slumps to the hard earth. Huh. You knew he'd been taking lessons from [kinu.isInari |the military provost |Nakano ], and yet you had no idea he could just pick up a completely foreign weapon of a different material than what he's used to, with different grip and balance, and at least do passably with it. But his face... As far back as you can remember, [kiyoko.numKits 4 |ever since Asagiri was born, ]your little brother has always been, or at least done his best to keep smiling. As far as you can remember, there hasn't been a single memory of yours that doesn't have Tatsumi hopefully optimistic at the very least. But even so, knowing that he is no longer a child, seeing him cut down your enemies with their own weapons, seeing the sickle and trowel wet with blood, discarded upon the dry earth... you can never look at your baby brother in the same light again. His tattered old scarf, the one you knitted for him when he was but a kit, flutters in the breeze, lit by the dancing lights of the burning fields and granary. Very poetic. "Tatsumi!" He half-turns, and you see his fingers tighten about the slender foreign blade, clearly deliberating whether to let it fall to the ground or not. Eventually, he opts to keep it in hand, and your eyes meet. Your baby brother smiles, but the boyish charm that it once held is gone, and you wonder if it will ever return with time, even if you already know the answer to that. He's scrutinising your face as hard as you are his, and you can only wonder if he sees something similarly changed in you. Not necessarily broken, but incontrovertibly changed forever. At last, the moment passes, and Tatsumi sinks back, leaning the slender foreign sword against a blackened tree stump. "Are you all right?" "I've had worse accidents with the hoe and sickle." Your baby brother grimaces momentarily, unwraps his scarf from around his neck, and with a sharp rip tears it in two. Completely numb or otherwise incognizant of the pain, he ties one about his arm and his thigh; no sooner has the old woollen cloth come into contact with flesh that the bloodstains start spreading into its weave. You want to laugh and cry at the same time. He's not all right, he's clearly not all right, and yet you would have done the exact same thing in his place.[kiyoko.numKits 4 | For if he were to get upset, little sensitive Asagiri would pick up on it too and start fretting... ... Gods, you mustn't tell him what happened to her, and yet you can't put it off forever. Later. Later. He'll find out on his own eventually, anyway... ] When Tatsumi is done binding his wounds with his scarf, he retrieves the blade and swallows hard, the small smile on his face trembling and forced. He's fooling no one with that facade... "[silly |Nee-sama |Big sis ]. I'm sorry to make you see this." He kicks the twitching bodies and makes to drive the point of the sword downwards upon them. "Please turn away." [kinu.isInari |You pout. "You don't need to feel responsible for me; [kiyoko.numKits 4 |I'm not Asagiri who needs |I don't need ] to be coddled. In fact, I'm supposed to be responsible for you. A little blood is nothing." Your baby brother looks like he's about to argue, then bows his head and gets to the grisly work of granting mercy to the fallen |You nod and turn, but even so you've seen enough tonight to imagine what Tatsumi is doing as he gets to the grisly work of granting mercy to the fallen. Only when the noises have ceased do you turn around again, doing your best not to look down ]. "Are you going to keep that thing on you?" "This?" Your baby brother looks distracted for a moment, then realizes what he's doing and lowers the point of the bloodied blade. "At least until we're out of danger. What are you doing here, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]?" "Looking for you! Aya told me you were working late!" "I was about to do the same." He gives you a rueful, sad smile. "But I got held up." "So you did. You did well." A sigh. "You didn't need me, I guess." "I got lucky and managed to ambush them. Really, it was but a one-on-one fight." You shake your head. "What happened here?" "Those... people came while I was sharpening the tools, arriving from the north. They must have climbed over the crater wall... or used the gate somehow." "Don't be ridiculous. Miko and Mai have control over the torii gate from the other side, there's no way to change who it activates for or where it goes from here. Even Mother doesn't have that kind of power." Tatsumi shrugs. "I don't know very much about that. What I do know is that they came from that direction, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ], twenty of them at least. They started going through the sheds and taking all our things, and what they couldn't easily move, they piled up by the granary and burned everything with that foul-smelling oil." You nod. Your baby brother continues speaking, his voice gone strangely flat as he recounts the events. "I went and hid by the trees, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]; I couldn't move because they were all around. But when they went so far as to set fire to the fields, I couldn't take it any more. I wouldn't be able to live with myself if I just stood by and did nothing. So I waited for those people to thin out, and when there was a small group left over after the last of them had finished taking our stuff, I..." He motions down to the bloodied trowel and sickle on the ground with his free hand, and you nod. [kinu.isInari |"You don't need to feel sorry for or regretful of what you've done. I'm proud of you." "Really?" "People who would stoop this low need to die. If anything, you were too merciful." |"I see. I don't relish it, either, but..." Tatsumi glances at the [kinu.kinuWeapon |bloodied blade of your naginata |bloodied tips of the arrows in your quiver ]. "...Responsibility flows upwards." You smile. "It does." ] "What now, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]?" "I've been picking them off for a while now, and so have you; it won't be long before they notice some of their number is missing, if they haven't already. It won't be easy to get isolated groups we can manage like these any more; they'll stick together. I want you to make for the den entrance and join Aya and [kiyoko.numKits 4 |Asagiri |the field hands ]; [kinu.isInari |as much as I want to stay and drive off all these sick sons of bitches, you all being safe comes first. Once I return and send you off, go through the woods, get help from Granny Komari and her people. Do you understand me?" Your baby brother doesn't meet your eyes. "You don't intend to come with us, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]." "Someone has to make these monsters pay for [kiyoko.numKits 4 |trying to burn us all alive |what they've done ]." "Don't do this, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]. You'll die." Tatsumi's voice is empty and flat as he forces the truth from his lips. "I got lucky to ambush a group of three, making them but one, and come away with only flesh wounds. You may be good, but more than twenty at once... please don't throw your life away." "Once I know you're all safe, I won't have any reason to hold back any more." "No. I know it hurts, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ], but please don't. Please." How can he understand? How can your precious baby brother ever understand? No, you don't need Tatsumi to understand; you just need him to obey. Despite your pains and aches, despite your scratches and gashes, you plant your feet firmly on the ground and stare him down despite being more than a head shorter than your baby brother. Not even able to maintain a rueful smile at this point, Tatsumi lowers his eyes and folds his ears, then dashes off into the night. He will remember this, and maybe he will hate you for it, but he will obey. That is all you need... |once I've finished making sure that as much of the den is as secure as I can, we'll all make our escape together. If we just try to go it alone, we'll be alone and separated, easy pickings like our enemies were." Tatsumi looks askance at the cooling bodies lying in slowly spreading pools of their own blood. "They got overconfident." "They expected to only have to murder children and loot the place while our parents were out. Who would not be?" That brings a ghost of a smile back to your baby brother's face. "But we're not children, are we?" "If we were, I daresay we are not any more. Once Mother started leaving us more and more to our own devices, it was only a matter of time. Those days are over." "Those days are over." Your little brother twitches his ears. "Everyone else is safe, aren't they? What will you do now, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]?" "Not me. Us. You are the last one — you circle around the edges while I draw their attention. We will reconvene at the entrance, and then go and get help. I had thought to try and sweep the den clear myself... but even I cannot take twenty or thirty on my own. We need assistance; anything else would be throwing our lives away for nothing. There is no shame in understanding you need help and asking for it." Tatsumi nods. "I understand. I'll meet up with everyone back at the entrance, then." Your baby brother lowers his eyes and folds his ears, then dashes off into the night like a fleeting shadow, leaving you to finish your sweep of the fields. ] ...It's time for you to go, too. |[kinu.isInari |Damn it, damn it all. Never before in your life have you felt more impotent and incompetent than you have right now — even if you did manage to save the field hands[kiyoko.numKits 2 | and retrieve your sister ], failure stretches out in front of your eyes as far as the eye can see. Everything looted or burned... it feels like wherever you go, no matter how quickly you hurry, you just weren't fast enough, capable enough, to stop whatever was happening from happening anyway. It's true, your failure isn't complete, but partway isn't, has never been good enough. You've arrived too late, there's nothing you can do here. |You slump against one of the charred beams, not caring that you're smearing soot all over yourself at this point. Exhaustion and dizziness threaten to overwhelm you — never before in your life have you felt more impotent and incompetent than you have right now. Even if you did manage to save the field hands[kiyoko.numKits 2 | and retrieve your sister ], failure stretches out in front of your eyes as far as the eye can see. Did you do things correctly? Had you chosen to handle the situation in a different order, would things have turned out better for you? Now more than ever, you're made keenly aware of the painful irony of your own inexperience, yet the only way to gain experience is to start off by being inexperienced. Without the benefit of guidance, how would you have known how to best go about this sweep? Or did you truly do everything you could, and this is the best outcome possible, as sour as it is? ] The light of the burning fields stretches a good distance, perhaps more than it has any right to; movement in the distant shadows catches your eye, irregular shapes near the horizon. You creep a little closer, using the burnt-out storage sheds for what cover they afford, then slink into the irrigation ditches.[kinu.isHime | To say having so much dirt pressed so close to you is awkward in the least, but at this point with your clothes bloodstained and torn and sweat and soot all over your skin, the distinction is meaningless, isn't it? ] More of the invaders, eagerly carrying everything you and [kiyoko.numKits 2 |your sister |the field hands ] have worked so hard to create. And you were so close to being self-sufficient at this point, too... you do a quick tally, and come up with no less than twenty, no more than thirty of them still in the distance, packing away their ill-gotten gains. And how many are there still wandering the den? Yet another tight knot forms in your guts, joining the half-dozen that've already taken up residence within. The realization that you've been lucky, very, very lucky strikes home, and his divine lordship does really tire after carrying a single person on his shoulders for too long. And yet... [kinu.isInari |you can't let them go. They may ridiculously outnumber you, but you just. Can't. Let. It. Go. If you just ran, you'd never be able to live it down; you'd feel eternally ashamed of yourself for letting these bastards get away with it. All your anger, all your determined promises of vengeance for razing your home and fields, would all be empty and impotent if you didn't even try to make them pay for it. Circumstances may have changed since you made those promises to yourself, but it won't change the fact that your own words will ring all the more hollow if you flee in the face of... of this. |how much of what little success you've had tonight is yours, then? And for all that, haven't they accomplished so much of what they meant to do? It is true that you're but one and they have so many on their side, but you're supposed to be more than just another pair of hands. Escaping with your lives isn't even the bare minimum of what your station demands of you; after all, you are expected to defend your home with your life if it comes to that. ] You swallow hard. You'll... you'll decide what to do later on, when you've evacuated [kiyoko.numKits 2 |Aya and ]the field hands from this place. Time is of the essence, and it's time for you to go, too. ]
rows.translation: 你的足部下是温暖的地面，当你穿梭在燃烧的田野中时，浓烟正从那里升起。 [kinu.isInari |他们现在是否看到了你，你既不知道也不在乎。那些被烧焦的茎秆和被踩得乱七八糟的树叶……就连你内心的愤怒也消失了。当你快步穿过这些收割后的废墟时，取而代之的，是一种从内心深处涌出的麻木与空虚感，这种感觉仿佛压在你的双眼上，让你无法看清前方的道路。 一切仿佛都像梦境一样，不真实；尽管火焰仍在咆哮、闪烁，但周围却一片寂静。你以前从未走过战场，但根据你读过的那些历史记载，或许这里就是战场的样子吧。 克制自己、不要彻底崩溃、不要放声大哭，这确实很困难，但你一定能够做到的。 不是 让这些野蛮的怪物得到他们想要的满足吧。 |你喘着粗气，汗水从脸上流淌，热空气在肺部肆意穿梭。或许你当初应该在井边停下来喝口水，但现在后悔也为时已晚。 所有的收成都在熊熊燃烧中化为灰烬——稻谷、豆类，甚至连根茎类作物也不例外。这些人真是太小气了；那些他们不容易偷走或捡到的东西，他们竟然全都毁掉了。即使你能理解他们这样做的原因和动机，这种行为依然是一种极其可怕的浪费…… ] 田野中的小路被刻意设计成蜿蜒曲折的形态，这样就能为灌溉沟渠留出足够的空间；通往储藏棚的最短路径正是经过这些小路。现在这样穿过田野是非常危险的，即使火焰已经快要熄灭了，但风险依然存在 [kinu.isInari |这比其他方法要耗时得多。你必须反应迅速，而且……嗯，你肯定也希望能够陪伴在孩子的最后时刻，看着他们经历那些痛苦…… |这比在路上遇到更多的那些入侵者还要危险。 ] 然而，当田野的另一端逐渐进入视线时，你的心情顿时沉了下来。无论是因为你是最后一个到达的，还是他们先到了这里——由于这些地方位于巢穴的边缘，破坏已经彻底完成：那些棚屋只剩下烧焦的残骸，黑色的支撑梁架在一片灰烬之中。 这个临时搭建的粮仓有一半已经坍塌了，里面不断传来噼啪声，说明里面的东西仍在闷烧；这里的地面已经被踩得一片狼藉，看起来有几十个人来来去去，完全不讲究隐蔽或谨慎。 这里什么也没有了；那些没有被偷走的东西，都已经被毁掉了。 [var0 |不过，这仅仅是你来到这里的原因之一。虽然那些商店的损失令人痛心，但它们可以重新建立；而你的弟弟却无法替代。你正准备去叫他，这时金属碰撞的声音吸引了你的注意。在曾经用来存放种子的那个地方，只剩下焦黑的残骸，两个身影正在激烈交战，又有两个人倒在了地上。龙司抓起了其中一个入侵怪物的武器，正在与它们中最后一个幸存者搏斗。你立刻冲了上去 [kinu.weapon] 你已经准备好了，但你的小弟弟并不需要你的帮助，他完全能够独自应对他的对手部。等到你赶到那里的时候 [kinu.kinuWeapon |引人注目的 ]只见他猛地挥动手部中那把修长而重型的青铜剑，将剑刃刺入了入侵者的腹部。随着一声猛拉，龙司将还带着血迹的剑拔了出来，此时他的肩膀和尾巴也放松了下来，因为他的敌人已经瘫软在地。 哈，你早就知道他一直在接受训练吧 [kinu.isInari |军事检察官 |中野 ]然而，你却完全不知道，他竟然能够使用一种完全陌生的武器——这种武器的材质与他以往使用过的武器不同，握把和平衡性也都有所不同，但他却至少能够勉强使用它。不过，他的表情…… 从你记事起，就一直是这样。 [kiyoko.numKits 4 |自从朝雾出生以来， ]你的弟弟一直都保持着微笑，或者至少一直在努力保持微笑。就你的记忆所及，没有哪一段回忆里，塔茨米不是至少带着乐观的情绪的。 但即便如此，当你知道他已经不再是小孩子了，当你看到他用敌人的武器亲手部消灭他们的敌人，当你看到那些沾满鲜血的镰刀和铁锹被丢弃在干涸的地上……你就再也无法用以前的眼轻型来看待你的弟弟了。 他那条破旧的老围巾——就是你在他还只是个幼崽的时候为他织的那条——在微风中飘动，被燃烧的田野和谷仓中跳动的火轻型照亮。 真是充满诗意啊。 龙美！ 他微微转过身来，你可以看到他的手部指紧紧握着那把细长的外国制刀，显然正在犹豫是否应该让它掉到地上。最终，他决定继续握在手部里，你们的目轻型相遇了。你的弟弟露出了微笑，但那种曾经属于他的少年特有的魅力已经消失了，你不禁想知道，随着时间的流逝，这种魅力是否还会重新出现——尽管你早已知道答案。 他正像你一样仔细地端详着你的脸，你不禁会想，他是否也察觉到了你身上发生的那些变化。这些变化未必是负面的，但无疑已经永远地改变了你。终于，这一刻过去了，龙司重新坐了下来，将那把细长的外国剑靠在了一根被烧黑的树桩上。 你没事吧？ 我用锄头和镰刀干活时，遇到过更糟糕的情况。 你的小弟弟皱了皱眉头，然后把围在脖子上的围巾解开，猛地一拉，把它撕成了两半。他的身体似乎完全失去了感觉，或者说他对疼痛毫无察觉，于是他把其中一条围巾缠在手部臂上，另一条则缠在大腿上。可那条旧羊毛围巾一接触到皮肤，血迹立刻开始渗进织料里。 你真的既想笑又想哭——他真是太……了。 不是 好吧，很明显他现在的情况并不妙，但如果你处在他的位置，你也会做出完全一样的选择。[kiyoko.numKits 4 The sight of scorched stalks and trampled leaves — even the fury in you is gone as you double-time it through the ashes of the harvest, replaced by a numb vacuousness that presses against your eyes from the inside of your head. Everything feels like a dream, unreal; despite the roar and flicker of the flames that linger, everything is quiet and muted. You have never walked through a battlefield before, but given the histories you've read, perhaps this is what it might be like. It is a struggle to not give in and break down crying completely and utterly, but you will not give these barbaric monsters the satisfaction of that. |hot air rushing through your lungs as you pant and sweat. Even if you can understand the reasoning and motivation behind such actions, it's all such a terrible waste... ] The paths through the fields are winding on purpose to accommodate the irrigation ditches; the shortest route to the storage sheds is through them. Dangerous to cross the fields right now like this, even if the flames are burning themselves out; still, it's less [kinu.isInari |time-consuming than the alternative. Whether it's because you got here last or they were first to arrive, these being on the edges of the den, the destruction is complete; only burnt-out husks remain of the sheds, blackened support beams sitting amidst a sea of ashes. Half of the makeshift granary has collapsed in on itself, popping and crackling sounds coming from within as the contents continue to smoulder; the ground here has been churned into dirt, what looks like dozens of feet having come and gone without care for stealth or subtlety. There is nothing left here; that which has not been stolen has been destroyed. [var0 |That, though, is only one of the things that you're here for. Though the loss of the stores hurts, they can be replaced; your baby brother can't. You're about to call for him, and then the clash of metal on metal draws your attention. By the charred shell of what used to be where you kept the seeds, two silhouettes clash with each other, two more bodies on the ground. Tatsumi has grabbed one of the invading monsters' weapons and is fighting the last standing one of their number. You dart forward, [kinu.weapon] at the ready, but your baby brother doesn't need your help and is handily dealing with his foe. By the time you're within [kinu.kinuWeapon |striking ]range, he's pressed his attack and rammed the long, slender bronze sword through the invader's guts. With a sharp yank, Tatsumi extracts the still-dripping blade, and his shoulders and tails relax as his foe slumps to the hard earth. Huh. You knew he'd been taking lessons from [kinu.isInari |the military provost |Nakano ], and yet you had no idea he could just pick up a completely foreign weapon of a different material than what he's used to, with different grip and balance, and at least do passably with it. But his face... As far back as you can remember, [kiyoko.numKits 4 |ever since Asagiri was born, ]your little brother has always been, or at least done his best to keep smiling. As far as you can remember, there hasn't been a single memory of yours that doesn't have Tatsumi hopefully optimistic at the very least. But even so, knowing that he is no longer a child, seeing him cut down your enemies with their own weapons, seeing the sickle and trowel wet with blood, discarded upon the dry earth... you can never look at your baby brother in the same light again. His tattered old scarf, the one you knitted for him when he was but a kit, flutters in the breeze, lit by the dancing lights of the burning fields and granary. Very poetic. "Tatsumi!" He half-turns, and you see his fingers tighten about the slender foreign blade, clearly deliberating whether to let it fall to the ground or not. Eventually, he opts to keep it in hand, and your eyes meet. Your baby brother smiles, but the boyish charm that it once held is gone, and you wonder if it will ever return with time, even if you already know the answer to that. He's scrutinising your face as hard as you are his, and you can only wonder if he sees something similarly changed in you. Not necessarily broken, but incontrovertibly changed forever. At last, the moment passes, and Tatsumi sinks back, leaning the slender foreign sword against a blackened tree stump. "Are you all right?" "I've had worse accidents with the hoe and sickle." Your baby brother grimaces momentarily, unwraps his scarf from around his neck, and with a sharp rip tears it in two. Completely numb or otherwise incognizant of the pain, he ties one about his arm and his thigh; no sooner has the old woollen cloth come into contact with flesh that the bloodstains start spreading into its weave. You want to laugh and cry at the same time. "Don't do this, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]. You'll die." Tatsumi's voice is empty and flat as he forces the truth from his lips. "I got lucky to ambush a group of three, making them but one, and come away with only flesh wounds. You may be good, but more than twenty at once... please don't throw your life away." "Once I know you're all safe, I won't have any reason to hold back any more." "No. I know it hurts, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ], but please don't. Please." How can he understand? How can your precious baby brother ever understand? No, you don't need Tatsumi to understand; you just need him to obey. Despite your pains and aches, despite your scratches and gashes, you plant your feet firmly on the ground and stare him down despite being more than a head shorter than your baby brother. Not even able to maintain a rueful smile at this point, Tatsumi lowers his eyes and folds his ears, then dashes off into the night. He will remember this, and maybe he will hate you for it, but he will obey. That is all you need... |once I've finished making sure that as much of the den is as secure as I can, we'll all make our escape together. If we just try to go it alone, we'll be alone and separated, easy pickings like our enemies were." Tatsumi looks askance at the cooling bodies lying in slowly spreading pools of their own blood. "They got overconfident." "They expected to only have to murder children and loot the place while our parents were out. Who would not be?" That brings a ghost of a smile back to your baby brother's face. "But we're not children, are we?" "If we were, I daresay we are not any more. Once Mother started leaving us more and more to our own devices, it was only a matter of time. Those days are over." "Those days are over." Your little brother twitches his ears. "Everyone else is safe, aren't they? What will you do now, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]?" "Not me. Us. You are the last one — you circle around the edges while I draw their attention. We will reconvene at the entrance, and then go and get help. I had thought to try and sweep the den clear myself... but even I cannot take twenty or thirty on my own. We need assistance; anything else would be throwing our lives away for nothing. There is no shame in understanding you need help and asking for it." Tatsumi nods. "I understand. I'll meet up with everyone back at the entrance, then." Your baby brother lowers his eyes and folds his ears, then dashes off into the night like a fleeting shadow, leaving you to finish your sweep of the fields. ] ...It's time for you to go, too. |[kinu.isInari |Damn it, damn it all. Never before in your life have you felt more impotent and incompetent than you have right now — even if you did manage to save the field hands[kiyoko.numKits 2 | and retrieve your sister ], failure stretches out in front of your eyes as far as the eye can see. Everything looted or burned... it feels like wherever you go, no matter how quickly you hurry, you just weren't fast enough, capable enough, to stop whatever was happening from happening anyway. It's true, your failure isn't complete, but partway isn't, has never been good enough. You've arrived too late, there's nothing you can do here. |You slump against one of the charred beams, not caring that you're smearing soot all over yourself at this point. Exhaustion and dizziness threaten to overwhelm you — never before in your life have you felt more impotent and incompetent than you have right now. Even if you did manage to save the field hands[kiyoko.numKits 2 | and retrieve your sister ], failure stretches out in front of your eyes as far as the eye can see. Did you do things correctly? Had you chosen to handle the situation in a different order, would things have turned out better for you? Now more than ever, you're made keenly aware of the painful irony of your own inexperience, yet the only way to gain experience is to start off by being inexperienced. Without the benefit of guidance, how would you have known how to best go about this sweep? Or did you truly do everything you could, and this is the best outcome possible, as sour as it is? ] The light of the burning fields stretches a good distance, perhaps more than it has any right to; movement in the distant shadows catches your eye, irregular shapes near the horizon. You creep a little closer, using the burnt-out storage sheds for what cover they afford, then slink into the irrigation ditches.[kinu.isHime | To say having so much dirt pressed so close to you is awkward in the least, but at this point with your clothes bloodstained and torn and sweat and soot all over your skin, the distinction is meaningless, isn't it? ] More of the invaders, eagerly carrying everything you and [kiyoko.numKits 2 |your sister |the field hands ] have worked so hard to create. And you were so close to being self-sufficient at this point, too... you do a quick tally, and come up with no less than twenty, no more than thirty of them still in the distance, packing away their ill-gotten gains. And how many are there still wandering the den? Yet another tight knot forms in your guts, joining the half-dozen that've already taken up residence within. The realization that you've been lucky, very, very lucky strikes home, and his divine lordship does really tire after carrying a single person on his shoulders for too long. And yet... [kinu.isInari |you can't let them go. They may ridiculously outnumber you, but you just. Can't. Let. It. Go. If you just ran, you'd never be able to live it down; you'd feel eternally ashamed of yourself for letting these bastards get away with it. All your anger, all your determined promises of vengeance for razing your home and fields, would all be empty and impotent if you didn't even try to make them pay for it. Circumstances may have changed since you made those promises to yourself, but it won't change the fact that your own words will ring all the more hollow if you flee in the face of... of this. |how much of what little success you've had tonight is yours, then? And for all that, haven't they accomplished so much of what they meant to do? It is true that you're but one and they have so many on their side, but you're supposed to be more than just another pair of hands. Escaping with your lives isn't even the bare minimum of what your station demands of you; after all, you are expected to defend your home with your life if it comes to that. ] You swallow hard. You'll... you'll decide what to do later on, when you've evacuated [kiyoko.numKits 2 |Aya and ]the field hands from this place. Time is of the essence, and it's time for you to go, too. ] "

rows.original: Finally, here you are. You have to search the persimmon grove a little bit, but it doesn't take too long for you to find [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 4 5 |Aya and the field hands hiding off by the side in the shadow of the trees, within view of the waterfall grotto. Your sister comes rushing up to you as she sees you approach, wrapping her arms about your waist and burying her face in you. "I'm so relieved, [silly |onee-sama |big sis ]! I thought you'd never come!" "I'm sorry to have kept you waiting," you reply, then turn to the field hands. All six of them seem to have made it in one piece, although the unspoken word goes that everyone's quite harrowed by the experience. Well, with any luck they'll be safe soon and the night will be over... for them, that is. "[kinu.isInari |Are you all ready to go |Is everyone prepared to depart ]?" Aya turns her ears down and to the side. "Let's get out of here, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]." |your siblings and the field hands hiding off by the side in the shadow of the trees, within view of the waterfall grotto. Your sister comes rushing up to you as she sees you approach, wrapping her arms about your waist and burying her face in you. "I'm so relieved, [silly |onee-sama |big sis ]! I thought you'd never come!" "She was sniffling and crying for you the whole time," Tatsumi adds, coming up beside you. "[kinu.isInari |Don't blame her, Tatsumi; she had to lose herself to the hunger to fight for her life |She is not at fault, Tatsumi. Anyone would be similarly unstable and prone to being distraught after having come so close to the brink of the hunger to fight for their life ]." Sighing, you pet Aya on the head, murmuring sweet nothings to try and calm your sister's frayed nerves. Needless to say, it would be really bad if she snapped during your escape. "[kinu.isInari |It's okay, it's all right; I'm here now. I'm sorry to have kept you waiting |Shush... there, there. I apologize for having kept you waiting for so long ]." With your sister less of a nervous wreck, you turn to the field hands. All six of them seem to have made it in one piece, although the unspoken word goes that everyone's quite harrowed by the experience. Well, with any luck they'll be safe soon and the night will be over... for them, that is. "[kinu.isInari |Are you all ready to go |Is everyone prepared to depart ]?" Aya turns her ears down and to the side. "Let's get out of here, [silly |nee-sama |big sis ]." |all three of your siblings hiding off by the side in the shadow of the trees, within view of the waterfall grotto. Aya, Tatsumi and Asagiri are huddled by the roots of one of the largest specimens in the grove, the former two circling their little white-furred sister protectively; as they see you arrive, Asagiri detaches herself from the trio and gives you a hug, wrapping her arms about your waist and burying her face in you with a soft sigh. "Does it still hurt, Asagiri?" "...Yes..." Despite the quiet calm of your little sister's voice, she must still be in considerable pain, even if the worst of it has passed. Good thing, then, that you're getting out of here and getting help.[kinu.isInari | Or at least, they are... ] "And you two? Are you ready to go?" Aya and Tatsumi share a glance, then turn to you and nod wordlessly. |all of your siblings hiding off by the side in the shadow of the trees, within view of the waterfall grotto. Aya and Tatsumi are keeping watch while Asagiri fusses over the rest of the kits, huddled by the roots of one of the largest specimens in the grove. As everyone sees you arrive, Asagiri detaches herself from the group and gives you a hug, wrapping her arms about your waist and burying her face in you with a soft sigh. "Does it still hurt, Asagiri?" "...Yes..." Despite the quiet calm of your little sister's voice, she must still be in considerable pain, even if the worst of it has passed. Good thing, then, that you're getting out of here and getting help.[kinu.isInari | Or at least, they are... ] "All right, then. Quick roll call, just to make sure no one's missing." [kiyoko.numKits 12 |With so many brothers and sisters, it takes a moment for everyone to sound off, but you want to be absolutely sure no one's missing. It's so much like gathering up everyone for a family outing with Mother... oh, but if only it were. ]The roll call's done quickly and quietly, and when you're satisfied that everyone's accounted for you turn to Aya and Tatsumi and give them a nod. "And you two? Are you ready to go?" Aya and Tatsumi share a glance, then return the nod. |the field hands hiding off by the side, within view of the waterfall grotto. All six of them seem to have made it in one piece, although the unspoken word goes that everyone's quite harrowed by the experience. Well, with any luck they'll be safe soon and the night will be over... for them, that is. "[kinu.isInari |Are you all ready to go |Is everyone prepared to depart ]?" "Yes, Lady Otomo. Please, lead the way?" ]
rows.translation: 终于，它在这里了。你需要在柿子树林里稍微搜索一下，不过找到它并不会花费太长时间。 [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 4 5 |阿雅和那些藏在树荫下的农夫们，他们的位置正好能看到瀑布洞穴。当你走近时，你的妹妹立刻冲过来，紧紧搂住你的腰，把脸埋在你的怀里。 我真是松了一口气， [silly |姐姐大人 |大姐 ]我还以为你永远都不会来了呢！ 很抱歉让您等待了。 你回复完毕，然后转向那些在场的手部下。他们六个人似乎都平安无事地回来了，不过大家都默默地承认，这次经历确实让他们受到了不小的惊吓。嗯，但愿他们能尽快安全回来，这样这个夜晚也就该结束了……至少对他们来说是这样。 "[kinu.isInari |你们都准备好了吗？ |大家都准备好出发了吗？ ]?" 阿雅将耳朵转向一侧。 我们赶紧离开这里吧， [silly |nee-sama |大姐 ]." |你的兄弟姐妹们，还有那些躲在树荫下的农夫们，都位于瀑布洞穴的视线范围内。当你看到他们时，你的妹妹立刻冲过来，搂住你的腰，把脸埋在你的怀里。 我真是松了一口气， [silly |姐姐大人 |大姐 ]我还以为你永远不会来了呢！ 她一直都在抽泣，不停地哭着念你的名字。 龙美走到你身边，补充道。 "[kinu.isInari |别责怪她，龙美；为了生存，她不得不屈服于饥饿的折磨。 |她并没有错，龙美。任何人在这种几乎面临生死存亡的危机之后，都会变得如此不安，容易陷入混乱之中。 ]." 你叹了口气，轻抚着艾雅的头部，低声说着些甜言蜜语，试图安抚妹妹那已经变得紧张不安的情绪。不用说，如果她在你试图逃跑的时候发脾气，那后果肯定非常严重。 "[kinu.isInari |没关系，一切都好了，我现在在这里。很抱歉让你们等待了。 |嘘……好了好了，真的很抱歉让你们等了这么久。 ]." 既然你妹妹不再那么紧张不安了，你就把注意力转向了那些在野外工作的人。他们六个人似乎都平安无事地回来了，不过大家都默默地承认，这次经历确实让他们受到了很大的心理冲击。嗯，只要运气好的话，他们应该很快就会安全回来，这场夜晚也会因此而结束……至少对他们来说是这样。 "[kinu.isInari |你们都准备好了吗？ |大家都准备好出发了吗？ ]?" 阿雅将耳朵转向一侧。 我们赶紧离开这里吧， [silly |nee-sama |大姐 ]." |你的三个兄弟姐妹都躲在树荫下，就在瀑布洞穴的视线范围内。绫、龙美和朝雾聚集在树林里最粗大的那棵树的树根旁，前两个姐妹保护性地围在她们那只白色毛发的妹妹身边；当她们看到你到来时，朝雾从她们中间走出来，拥抱了你，双手部环住你的腰，把脸埋在你的怀里，同时轻轻叹了口气。 现在还疼吗，浅雾？ ……是的…… 尽管你妹妹的声音听起来很平静，但她肯定仍然在忍受着相当大的痛苦，即使最严重的情况已经过去了。幸好你正在离开这里去寻求帮助。[kinu.isInari | 或者至少，他们是这样的…… ] 那你们两个呢？准备好了吗？ 绫与龙美交换了一个眼神，然后转向你，默默地点了点头。 |你的所有兄弟姐妹都躲在树林的阴影中，藏在瀑布洞穴的视线范围内。绫和龙美在负责看守，而朝雾则在一棵最大的树木的树根旁照顾着其他的孩子们。当所有人都看到你到来时，朝雾从人群中走出来，拥抱了你，双手部环住你的腰，将脸埋在你的怀里，轻轻叹了口气。 还疼吗，浅雾？ ……是的…… 尽管你妹妹的声音听起来很平静，但她肯定仍然在忍受着相当大的痛苦，即使最严重的情况已经过去了。幸好你正在离开这里去寻求帮助。[kinu.isInari | 或者至少，他们是这样的…… ] 好吧，那我们就快速点名吧，确保没有人缺席。 [kiyoko.numKits 12 |有这么多兄弟姐妹，让每个人都发表意见确实需要一些时间，但你还是想确保没有人被遗漏。这真的就像和妈妈一起召集全家人去郊游一样……哦，要是真能那样该多好啊。 ]点名工作迅速而安静地完成了。当你确认所有人都到齐后，你就转向绫和龙美，向他们点了点头。 那你们两个呢？准备好了吗？ 绫与龙司交换了一个眼神，随后又点了点头。 |那些躲在瀑布洞穴附近的人，他们六个人似乎都平安无事地到达了那里。虽然大家都没有明说，但显然这次经历让他们都受到了不小的惊吓。不过，只要运气好的话，他们应该很快就能安全离开，夜晚也会因此而结束……至少对他们来说是这样。 "[kinu.isInari |你们都准备好了吗？ |大家都准备好出发了吗？ ]?" 是的，奥托莫女士。请带路吧。 ]

rows.original: The trip through the waterfall grotto is hushed and quiet; [kinu.isInari |while you use this exit every now and then in order to sneak into the native settlement to the south, none of your siblings have a reason to ever pass through here when the torii gate is a thing |you don't really use this exit often; no one does when the torii gate is a thing ]. The cold and damp are really getting to you, a small irony after the blazing heat of your home burning down... but it'll be over soon, right? Behind you, [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 4 12 |Aya and the field hands follow in silence; your sister tries to retain some of her bratty good humor, but it comes across as forced and half-hearted. The field hands trail behind, sticking close to you; it's true that everyone expects danger this far from civilization in the colonies... but not quite of this kind, and these are but common working folk. You'll have a talk with [kinu.isInari |Granny |Matron ] Komari later, see about rotating them out and giving the lot some time off in the bargain. They deserve it, after all, and you could take a holiday yourself, if you were to ever be allowed such a luxury. |Aya, Tatsumi and the field hands follow in silence; your sister tries to retain some of her bratty good humor, but it comes across as forced and half-hearted while Tatsumi looks a little brow-beaten. The field hands trail behind, sticking close to you; it's true that everyone expects danger this far from civilization in the colonies... but not quite of this kind, and these are but common working folk. You'll have a talk with [kinu.isInari |Granny |Matron ] Komari later, see about rotating them out and giving the lot some time off in the bargain. They deserve it, after all, and you could take a holiday yourself, if you were to ever be allowed such a luxury. |your siblings follow in silence; Aya tries to retain some of her usual bratty good humor, but with how forced and half-hearted it feels no one's buying any of it. Tatsumi's still fussing over Asagiri, who at least has stopped whimpering and is limping along, trying not to fall too far behind the three of you.[kiyoko.numKits 5 | Your other younger siblings huddle together, clearly frightened, but there's nothing you can do but get out of here. ] Bedraggled rats rather than foxes, skulking about trying to remain unseen... while you knew the colonies were supposed to be dangerous, the very idea of having your home invaded like this is surreal given your childhood in the Astral Plane. Sure, it happened to Mother, but why did it have to happen to you more than two centuries down the line? Why does anything happen? |your siblings follow in silence; Aya tries to retain some of her usual bratty good humor, but with how forced and half-hearted it feels no one's buying any of it. Tatsumi's still fussing over Asagiri, who at least has stopped whimpering and is limping along, trying not to fall too far behind the three of you. Your other younger siblings huddle together, small bundles of frightened fur; you can only hope no one gets lost or left behind with Tatsumi bringing up the rear. Bedraggled rats rather than foxes, skulking about trying to remain unseen... while you knew the colonies were supposed to be dangerous, the very idea of having your home invaded like this is surreal given your childhood in the Astral Plane. Sure, it happened to Mother, but why did it have to happen to you more than two centuries down the line? Why does anything happen? |the field hands follow in silence, sticking close to you and looking quite morose. It's true that everyone expects danger this far from civilization in the colonies... but not quite of this kind, and these are but common working folk. You'll have a talk with [kinu.isInari |Granny |Matron ] Komari later, see about rotating them out and giving the lot some time off in the bargain. They deserve it, after all, and you could take a holiday yourself, if you were to ever be allowed such a luxury. ] But the exit looms ahead, the roar of water crashing down into the pool, and you remember the choice you'd resolved to make. In a sense, that has already been decided for you; [kinu.isInari |as much as you want to go back and fight |looking at your charges ], there's no way they're making it through the forest alone as they are. A warrior would think differently, but you do not tread that path; as Mother likes to remind you, you are her heir. That means you have different priorities and responsibilities, and cannot live for yourself even if it means incurring shame in other areas... ...Or are you just making excuses to shy away from danger and almost certain death? Little matter, the worst of this nightmare is almost over. The roar of the waterfall is deafening at this point, drowning out all sound as you help [kiyoko.numKits 2 |Aya |one of your charges over the slippery rocks ]. Exhaustion has taken its toll on you, and although you have to keep up a strong facade for everyone at least you can relax a little more now — "Don't move, demons." The moment you break your head out of the curtain of water, you're greeted by the sight of burning torches and no less than fifteen bows levelled at you. [kiyoko.numKits 2 4 |Aya squeaks, looks for somewhere to duck behind, and finding no good cover, eventually settles for you |Asagiri mewls at the sight, clutching at your tattered clothes with both hands as if squeezing you will make the terror go away. It doesn't |You swallow hard and look back at your charges. All the field hands have expressions of weary resignation on their faces, as if inviting death to finally make it all end. Not exactly the best thing for your own morale ]. "And don't try to retreat, either. We have the other end of the passageway covered, too." "They're not lying," [kiyoko.numKits 3 |Tatsumi |one of the field hands ] calls out from the rear. "There are lights behind us." So in the end, is this how [kinu.isInari |Granny |Matron ] Komari felt? To fail despite one's best efforts, which were simply not good enough, and stare that failure in the face? They stand on the far edge of the waterfall pool, placing it between you and them; torches light up the forest, casting long shadows from the massed invaders as they form a cordon about the pool. Your mind races, trying to come up with some way in which you and your escape to safety, but comes up with nothing. "Now then, demoness, throw your weapon to the ground. One false move, and we fill your [kiyoko.numKits 2 |family |people ] full of holes. You might be able to get out of the way in time, but we won't miss everyone." "You'd kill unarmed children?" "We know what you can do, and none of you are children as we understand them. So, I'll not repeat myself: throw your weapon to the ground, demoness, or we fill your [kiyoko.numKits 2 |family |people ] with holes." They're no longer satisfied with merely killing you, they want vengeance for having suffered losses in raiding your home, and that stays their hand for the moment. Whether it's something you can turn to your advantage is another question entirely. [kinu.isInari |You snarl. "You're just going to kill us anyway." |You scowl in a most unladylike fashion. "I doubt you have any intention of allowing a single one of us to live." ] "Do you feel confident enough in your words?" You look at [kiyoko.numKits 2 |Aya, still trying to hide behind you |the field hands, who had all only signed up to help Mother rebuild her home and ended up being thrown into danger ][kiyoko.numKits 3 |, Tatsumi, his gaze distant and steely ][kiyoko.numKits 4 |, Asagiri, clutching at your clothes and whimpering softly ].[kiyoko.numKits 8 | The rest of your family, too... ] They followed you to the bitter end. They trusted you both as Mother's heir and because of their belief in your abilities, but you've doomed them. Now, though it's your duty to hold fast while others sink into despair, it's becoming more and more likely that you'll watch as their lives come to an end. And although [kinu.isInari |some wild part of you still wishes to die in a blaze of glory and defiance |you are cognizant of what is expected of you ], by virtue of who you are and where you stand... their lives are not yours to give, despite the shame it brings upon you. Reluctantly, you throw down your [kinu.weapon] by the pool's edge.
