rows.original:
More time passes, and you drift in and out of consciousness during that period; fear and hope alike send in their invoices in the ensuing hours and days, demanding repayment of lent strength with as much interest as you'd expect. People come in and out of the room, and you're vaguely aware of voices speaking around you while you lie in your convalescence; even when Mai comes in to change the dressings on your wounds, wipe you down and help you to the washroom it all feels like a delusion. You know it's not, but for the first time in your life you don't have any daily responsibilities, social obligations, or pressing matters to attend to.[kinu.isInari
            | They say there aren't any holidays on a farm... but the fields are and paddies are gone, burnt, and you don't even know if there's anything left to salvage.
        ]
        
        Even so, the deadening effect of winterstem can't block out all your thoughts and worries, drunk on the atmosphere of your chambers as you might be. You don't have any nightmares... but at the same extent, you don't have any pleasant dreams, either. Everything seems as illusory and transient as the morning fog, there one moment and gone the next; even keeping track of time eventually becomes impossible. [kinu.isInari
            |Sometimes, you become aware of Hitoshi besides you, completely silent but with his hand wrapped completely around yours. Those are your most lucid moments, when he comes in from the fields every evening and feeds you something or the other that he's prepared that day; the scent of dirt and sap that cling to him and the strength in his fingers are a welcome change from the constant gray dullness of winterstem smoke that numbs your senses and nerves.
            
            Hitoshi never says much, but then again you're not the best of conversationalists, either. You're just content to have his presence around you whenever possible.
            |Sometimes, you become aware of Nakano besides you, completely silent but with his hand wrapped completely around yours. Those are your most lucid moments, when he's finished with his duties in the evening and comes in to sit beside you. He talks while Miko works on you when she comes off shift, distracting your attention from her poking and prodding. The topics are never quite on point — sometimes it's about den matters, other times it's politics across the ocean, or something trivial yet interesting he managed to learn that day.
            
            Under no circumstance, though, does he ever speak of the aftermath of that day, or his own poetry, for that matter. Miko being around probably has something to do with that. You don't remember half of what he says, but you're glad for the attempt to keep you informed, and for keeping you company. His presence is enough, a welcome change from the constant gray dullness of winterstem smoke that numbs your senses and nerves.
        ]
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |Sometimes, you wonder if Mother will ever show up, but she doesn't — not by your side, and not in your dreams. But of course, she wouldn't be able to come, and neither would [pc.mf|Father|Mother] — the both of them are away saving the world, and you're here... 
            
            ... How long will it be before they're back, before they realize what's happened to their home in their absence? [kinu.isInari
                |Will they ever be back? [pc.mf|Father|Mother] was always gone, days, weeks, months... there were times when you swore that [pc.heShe] was sneaking around you while you were sleeping up on the hill, trying to leave without greeting you. Of course, you never said anything about it, dutiful kit as you were... and now Mother's gone as well.
                
                That's stupid... they'll be back, right? Only you remember waiting ten years, and then — 
                
                But in the end, that's why you needed to be independent. In the end, that's why you needed to grow up, and finally, hopefully soon enough, you'll be able to marry Hitoshi and be gone for good. And now it's been proven beyond any ability of yours to deny it that your best may not be enough... 
                
                You're not scared or anything. It's just exhausting to think of.
                |You were left in charge while they were gone, and look at the mess you've made of this whole thing. Of course, you know what your parents will say — that they're glad that [kiyoko.numKits 2
                    |everyone is alive and unharmed
                    |you're still alive
                ], but the den, the buildings, the fields... everything was either burned or stolen. That kind of shame... even if you're forgiven, that doesn't erase the stain in the least. Perhaps it even makes it worse... 
                
                The thought of Mother gone all the time fills you with a dark, sickening dread whether you like it or not. While it's true that Matron Komari is around to guide you in Mother's absence as her retainer, Mother herself has always been a presence in your life ever since you were a kit, until recently. And now look at what's happened... 
                
                It's just... exhausting to think of.
            ]
            |Mother drifts in and out of your convalescence chambers when she can, although by virtue of her position she can never stay very long. You can understand that perfectly; after all, you share many of the same responsibilities, if yours are smaller in scope. [kinu.isInari
                |Still, that doesn't prevent a knot of resentment from twisting inside of you, no matter how much you realize how petulant you're being
                |You're always glad for her presence, no matter how brief; it's always been this way since you were a kit. In a way, it brings you relief in a way winterstem can't
            ].
            
            You don't remember very many of the words she says during your brief time together, not with everything you perceive filtered through the smoky, medicinal haze, but you're sure that she's no delusion of a fevered mind and are glad for it.
            
            Everything just feels so exhausting.
        ] 
        
        In the times you're left alone to your thoughts, memories of [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 4
            |Aya rabidly half-reverted, fighting for her life
            |Aya rabidly half-reverted and Tatsumi tearing his scarf
            |Aya rabidly half-reverted, Tatsumi tearing his scarf and Aya's skin weeping
            |your home in flames
        ] surface from the depths of your consciousness, rising to the fore of your mind to torment you before sinking back again. You toss and turn in your futon, the ointments and medicated bandages needling and stinging you until winterstem and citrus claim you for the umpteenth time.
rows.translation:
时间一点点流逝，在那段时间里，你的意识时而清醒时而模糊；接下来的几个小时和几天里，恐惧与希望这两种情绪如同账单一般不断袭来，要求你偿还那些“借来的力量”，而且所要求的利息之多，完全超出了你的预期。 人们不断地进出这个房间，而你躺在那里养伤时，只是隐约能听到周围有人在说话；即使当舞进来为你的伤口换药、帮你擦洗身体、扶你去洗手间时，这一切也仿佛只是一场幻觉。 你知道其实并非如此，但这是你人生中第一次完全没有任何日常责任、社交义务或需要紧急处理的事情。[kinu.isInari
            | 人们都说，在农场里是没有节假日的……但那些田野和稻田都已经毁了，被烧成了灰烬，你甚至都无法确定是否还有什么可以抢救回来的。
        ]
        
        即便如此，冬日的沉闷气息也无法完全掩盖你心中的思绪与忧虑。你或许正沉醉于自己所处的环境之中，既没有噩梦……也同样没有美好的梦境。一切仿佛都像晨雾一样虚幻而短暂，转瞬即逝；甚至最终连时间的流逝都变得难以察觉。 [kinu.isInari
            |有时候，你会注意到Hitoshi就在你身边——他静静地站着，但他的手紧紧地握着你的手。那些时刻才是你头脑最为清醒的时候：每晚当他从田野里回来，会给你准备一些他当天采来的食物；他身上带着泥土和树液的气息，而他手指里蕴含的力量，与冬季那令人感官麻木的灰暗气息截然不同，这种变化让人感到无比愉悦。
            
            仁总是不多说话，不过话说回来，你本身也不是个很健谈的人。你只是希望他能在自己身边而已。
            |有时候，你会注意到站在你身旁的中野——他始终保持着沉默，但他的手却紧紧地握着你的手。那些时刻才是你头脑最为清醒的时候，因为那时他已经完成了晚上的工作，会过来坐在你身边。 当美子下班后开始对你进行各种“检查”时，他就会一边聊天，一边分散你的注意力，让你无法注意到她的那些动作。他聊的话题往往并不切题——有时是关于狗的事情，有时是关于远在大洋彼岸的政治新闻，又有时则是他那天偶然了解到的一些琐碎但有趣的事情。
            
            然而，他在任何情况下都不会提及那天发生的事情，也不会谈论自己的诗歌。米科在他的身边，或许与此有关。你其实并不记得他说的那些话中有多少是真实的，但你会为他努力让你了解情况、陪伴你的举动而感到欣慰。 他的出现本身就已经足够了，这与冬季烟雾那种持续不断的灰暗、沉闷气息形成了鲜明的对比——那种烟雾会麻痹你的感官和神经。
        ]
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |有时候，你会想知道母亲是否会出现，但她并没有——既不会出现在你身边，也不会出现在你的梦中。当然，她也不可能来到你身边，其他人也同样如此。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲] — 他们两个都去拯救世界了，而你却在这里…… 

            ……他们还要过多久才能回来？他们什么时候才会发现，在他们离开期间，自己的家发生了什么？ [kinu.isInari
                |他们还会回来吗？ [pc.mf|父亲|母亲] 总是不在，几天、几周、几个月……有时候你甚至会发誓 [pc.heShe] 当你还在山上睡觉的时候，它一直在你身边偷偷活动，试图不跟你说一声就离开。当然，你从来都没有说过什么，因为你一直是个尽职尽责的小家伙……而现在，妈妈也离开了。
                
                那太愚蠢了……他们总会回来的，对吧？只有你记得自己等了整整十年，然后——

但归根结底，这就是你为什么必须独立的原因。归根结底，这就是你为什么必须成长的原因。而最终，希望这一切能尽快实现，你就能嫁给Hitoshi，然后永远离开那里。 现在，事实已经证明：你再怎么否认，也无可否认——你的最佳表现可能仍然不够……

你并不害怕，也不是什么其他原因。只是想到这一点，就让人感到疲惫不堪。
                |他们不在的时候，你就被留下来负责这件事，看看你把整个事情搞得多么一团糟。当然，你也知道你的父母会怎么说——他们会说他们很欣慰。 [kiyoko.numKits 2
                    |所有人都安然无恙。
                    |你还没死。
                ]但是那个巢穴、那些建筑物、那些田野……一切都要么被烧毁了，要么被偷走了。那种耻辱……即使你得到了原谅，也丝毫无法抹去那道污痕。或许，这甚至会让事情变得更糟…… 
                
                无论你是否愿意，一想到母亲永远离开了，你就会感到一种阴暗而令人作呕的恐惧。虽然科玛丽夫人会在母亲不在的时候指导你，担任她的助手，但实际上，从你还是个婴儿的时候起，母亲就一直存在于你的生活中，直到最近才发生了改变。 现在看看发生了什么……

光是想到这些，就让人感到精疲力竭。
            ]
            |母亲一有空就会来到你的康复室来看你，不过由于她的身份关系，她每次待的时间都不长。你完全能够理解这一点；毕竟，你们承担着许多相同的责任，只不过你的责任范围相对较小而已。 [kinu.isInari
                |然而，无论你多么清楚自己的行为是多么任性，这都无法阻止一股怨恨在你心中逐渐积聚。
                |无论她的陪伴时间多么短暂，你总会感到欣慰；从你还是个孩子的时候起，就是这样的。在某种程度上，她的存在能给你带来一种冬茎无法给予的慰藉。
            ]在你们短暂相处的那些日子里，她说过的话，你其实并没有记住多少——毕竟你所感受到的一切，都笼罩在那种烟雾弥漫、带有药味的迷雾之中。但你可以确定，她并不是处于发热导致的幻觉状态，为此你感到庆幸。

总之，这一切真的让人感到精疲力竭。
        ] 
        
        在那些你独自沉思的时刻，那些回忆便会浮现在脑海中 [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 4
            |阿雅陷入了疯狂的状态，拼命挣扎着想要活下去。
            |绫亚疯狂地恢复了半原始状态，而龙司则扯碎了自己的围巾。
            |绫亚疯狂地恢复了半原始状态，龙司扯碎了自己的围巾，而绫亚的皮肤也开始渗出血来。
            |你的家园陷入火海
        ] 这些念头从你意识的深处浮现出来，闯入你的脑海，折磨着你，然后又再次沉入暗影之中。你在榻子上翻来覆去，那些药膏和药布不断地刺激着你，直到“冬茎”和“柑橘”的香气再次将你带入梦乡。

Those are your most lucid moments, when he comes in from the fields every evening and feeds you something or the other that he's prepared that day; the scent of dirt and sap that cling to him and the strength in his fingers are a welcome change from the constant gray dullness of winterstem smoke that numbs your senses and nerves.
            
            Hitoshi never says much, but then again you're not the best of conversationalists, either. You're just content to have his presence around you whenever possible.
            |Sometimes, you become aware of Nakano besides you, completely silent but with his hand wrapped completely around yours. Those are your most lucid moments, when he's finished with his duties in the evening and comes in to sit beside you. He talks while Miko works on you when she comes off shift, distracting your attention from her poking and prodding. The topics are never quite on point — sometimes it's about den matters, other times it's politics across the ocean, or something trivial yet interesting he managed to learn that day.
            
            Under no circumstance, though, does he ever speak of the aftermath of that day, or his own poetry, for that matter. Miko being around probably has something to do with that. You don't remember half of what he says, but you're glad for the attempt to keep you informed, and for keeping you company. His presence is enough, a welcome change from the constant gray dullness of winterstem smoke that numbs your senses and nerves.
        ]
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |Sometimes, you wonder if Mother will ever show up, but she doesn't — not by your side, and not in your dreams. But of course, she wouldn't be able to come, and neither would [pc.mf|Father|Mother] — the both of them are away saving the world, and you're here... 
            
            ... How long will it be before they're back, before they realize what's happened to their home in their absence? [kinu.isInari
                |Will they ever be back? [pc.mf|Father|Mother] was always gone, days, weeks, months... there were times when you swore that [pc.heShe] was sneaking around you while you were sleeping up on the hill, trying to leave without greeting you. Of course, you never said anything about it, dutiful kit as you were... and now Mother's gone as well.
                
                That's stupid... they'll be back, right? Only you remember waiting ten years, and then — 
                
                But in the end, that's why you needed to be independent. In the end, that's why you needed to grow up, and finally, hopefully soon enough, you'll be able to marry Hitoshi and be gone for good. And now it's been proven beyond any ability of yours to deny it that your best may not be enough... 
                
                You're not scared or anything. It's just exhausting to think of.
                |You were left in charge while they were gone, and look at the mess you've made of this whole thing. Of course, you know what your parents will say — that they're glad that [kiyoko.numKits 2
                    |everyone is alive and unharmed
                    |you're still alive
                ], but the den, the buildings, the fields... everything was either burned or stolen. That kind of shame... even if you're forgiven, that doesn't erase the stain in the least. Perhaps it even makes it worse... 
                
                The thought of Mother gone all the time fills you with a dark, sickening dread whether you like it or not. While it's true that Matron Komari is around to guide you in Mother's absence as her retainer, Mother herself has always been a presence in your life ever since you were a kit, until recently. And now look at what's happened... 
                
                It's just... exhausting to think of.
            ]
            |Mother drifts in and out of your convalescence chambers when she can, although by virtue of her position she can never stay very long. You can understand that perfectly; after all, you share many of the same responsibilities, if yours are smaller in scope. [kinu.isInari
                |Still, that doesn't prevent a knot of resentment from twisting inside of you, no matter how much you realize how petulant you're being
                |You're always glad for her presence, no matter how brief; it's always been this way since you were a kit. In a way, it brings you relief in a way winterstem can't
            ].
            
            You don't remember very many of the words she says during your brief time together, not with everything you perceive filtered through the smoky, medicinal haze, but you're sure that she's no delusion of a fevered mind and are glad for it.
            
            Everything just feels so exhausting.
        ] 
        
        In the times you're left alone to your thoughts, memories of [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 4
            |Aya rabidly half-reverted, fighting for her life
            |Aya rabidly half-reverted and Tatsumi tearing his scarf
            |Aya rabidly half-reverted, Tatsumi tearing his scarf and Aya's skin weeping
            |your home in flames
        ] surface from the depths of your consciousness, rising to the fore of your mind to torment you before sinking back again. You toss and turn in your futon, the ointments and medicated bandages needling and stinging you until winterstem and citrus claim you for the umpteenth time.
        "

rows.original: "We've finished the investigation, Great-Great-Grandmother," Nakano says as he strides into the chamber, helmet tucked under one arm. A flicker of disgust crosses his face as winterstem smoke hits him in the face, but he quickly corrects that moment of weakness. Mai sets down her pipe and covers the censer, then throws a glance at [kinu.isInari |Granny |Matron ] Komari off at a corner table, compounding yet another of the many poultices that've been applied to you over the past days. "You mean Azami finished the investigation while you seven ran around the countryside hunting down stragglers who knew nothing useful." "We couldn't take that chance." [kinu.isInari |Granny |Matron ] Komari sighs; it's one of those sighs that happens in all three of her official capacities as den matron, shrine mother and imperial governor. "Go on, then. Out with it. I know you're just making the report verbally so that Kinu here can overhear it, otherwise it'd be in the form of a written missive on my desk. Tell us the things that she doesn't already know, then, and I'll catch up on the rest in my own time." Nakano winces, [kinu.isHime |far more strongly than you've come to expect from his stoic exterior, ]and bows. "By all appearances, the attackers were natives of this land. However, their bodies have undergone considerable transformation to something more... foreign, or at least, a people not native to this part of the world. "They were by and large not professional combatants, but they were not untrained either, and judging by the methodical way they conducted their attack on High Lady Otomo's holdings there is some semblance of strategy there, even if it was not executed perfectly. A level of aptitude one might expect from conscripts, or a militia at best — but much better funded, equipped, and directed than expected." [kinu.isInari |"Wouldn't be surprised," you say, sitting up in your futon with a big yawn and stretching your limbs. Gods, are you stiff... "The bastard who led them looked like he had plenty of money to burn; too bad it's harder for money to buy people who aren't idiots, even if it's not impossible. Did you catch him?" |"Their ringleader was a man of considerable means, by the way he clothed himself in finery," you venture, sitting up and accepting the herbal brew Mai offers you. "Did you manage to apprehend him?" ] "It pains me to say that such is not the case, Lady Otomo. He... evaded us, although it was not without cost to him in terms of his people. Nevertheless, the man is still at large, and all that was taken from your home has not been recovered, either." [kinu.isInari |Granny |Matron ] Komari looks a lot more troubled at this than she should, which is saying quite a bit considering that it was Mother's — and thus her liege's — home that was invaded. She pressed her thumbs to her temples, gestures for Mai to come over and finish compounding the poultice in her stead, and walks over to grab Nakano by the wrist. "Outside, grandson. There are private instructions that his divine lordship have entrusted me to pass along to you in case of certain... circumstances. This is one of them. Now, outside." Nakano looks a little surprised, but bows and follows the den matron out, the door sliding shut behind them. You turn your gaze to Mai, working away with mortar, pestle and cloth, and rub your eyes. "[kinu.isInari |How long was I out |Might I ask how long have I been here ]?" "Oh. Eh. Ain't longer than three or four days. Yer young an' bouncy, an' ya done bounced right back no problem. The wounds ya might carry... they ain't in yer body." "I... [kinu.isInari |I've never been afraid in my life, and even if I have, I'm not about to let it cripple me |there is no point in lingering on it, once everything that can be done has been done ]." "Ya say that, an' it's easy to say. But take it from someone who's done been in a bad place: it ain't as easy as ya might think." Mai shakes her head. "Now, layin' down too long ain't good for ya none either. How d'ya feel?" "[kinu.isInari |Stiff and achy." "Go out an' work those joints, an' them pains should mellow out a lil'. Ya been in bed f'r this long, only reason ya wouldn't hurt none would be if'n ya were goin' numb |A little dizzy." "Ya been suckin' winterstem smoke f'r three straight days, I'd be surprised if'n ya weren't high as a kite at this point ]. Go out an' get some fresh air, an' I'll see ya back here in an hour."
rows.translation: 我们已经完成了调查，曾祖母。 中野一边大步走进房间，一边将头盔夹在手臂下。当冬茎烟的味道扑面而来时，他脸上闪过一丝厌恶，但很快便掩饰住了这种情绪。麻衣放下烟斗，盖住了香炉，然后瞥了中野一眼…… [kinu.isInari |奶奶 |女管家 ] 小麻坐在角落的桌子旁，正在为你这些天来所接受的众多治疗措施中的又一项进行操作。 你是说，当你们七个人在乡下四处搜捕那些根本不知道任何有用信息的残余人员时，阿兹米已经完成了调查工作。 我们当时不能抓住那个机会。 [kinu.isInari |奶奶 |女管家 ] 小麻里叹了口气——这种叹息，无论她是以巢穴女主人、神社祭司还是帝国总督的身份出现，都会不自觉地发出。 那就说吧。快说出来。我知道你只是口头汇报，就是为了让这里的绮奴听到，否则这份报告早就以书面形式放在我的桌上了。那就告诉我们那些她还不知道的事情吧，其余的等我有空再了解。 中野皱起了眉头。 [kinu.isHime |远远超出了你从他那坚忍的外表所能够预料到的程度。 ]然后鞠躬。 从种种迹象来看，这些攻击者都是这片土地的土著居民。然而，他们的身体已经发生了巨大的变化，变得更为……异类，或者说，他们属于这个地区以外的民族。 他们大体上并不是专业的战斗人员，但也不是毫无训练的。从他们有条不紊地进攻高阶女士奥托莫的领地这一行为来看，其中确实体现出一定的战略谋划，尽管执行得并不完美。这种能力水平，大概只适合征召来的士兵或民兵组织——但他们的资金投入、装备配备以及指挥体系，都远超人们的预期。 [kinu.isInari |一点也不会感到惊讶。 你说得对，坐在蒲团上，打了个大大的哈欠，然后伸了伸四肢。天啊，你真的僵得厉害…… 那个带领他们的混蛋看起来有的是钱挥霍；可惜，就算是有钱，也很难买到那些不是白痴的人的心，虽然并非完全不可能。你抓住他了吗？ |顺便说一下，他们的头目是个相当有钱的人，从他穿着的奢华服饰就能看出来。 你鼓起勇气，坐起来接受了梅子提供的草药茶。 你成功抓住他了吗？ ] 很遗憾，事实并非如此，奥托莫夫人。他……逃脱了我们的追捕，不过这对他的部下来说无疑是一场灾难。不过，那个男人仍然在逃，从您家中抢走的所有东西也至今没有被追回。 [kinu.isInari |奶奶 |女管家 ] 在这个时候，小麻里的表情显得比实际情况要更加忧虑，而考虑到被入侵的是母亲的家园——也就是她的主君的家园，这一反应确实说明了很多问题。她把拇指按在太阳穴上，示意舞过来替她完成药膏的制作，然后走过去抓住了中野的手腕。 在外面，孙子。有几位高人特意嘱咐我，在某些特殊情况下一定要将这些话转达给你。现在，就出去吧。 中野看起来有些惊讶，但还是鞠了一躬，跟着巢穴的女首领走了出去，门在他们身后关上了。你将目光转向正在用研钵、杵和布捣碎材料的舞，然后揉了揉眼睛。 "[kinu.isInari |我昏迷了多久啊 |请问我在这里已经待了多久了呢？ ]?" 哦，嗯，应该不会超过三四天吧。你年轻又有活力，肯定能很快恢复过来。那些伤口……其实并不在你身上。 我…… [kinu.isInari |我这辈子从来都没有害怕过，就算有过，我也绝不会让恐惧束缚自己。 |既然已经做了所有能做的事情，再纠结下去也没有意义了。 ]." 你说得容易，说起来确实简单。但作为一个曾经身处困境的人，我可以告诉你：其实并没有你想象中那么容易。 舞摇了摇头。 现在，躺得太久对身体健康也不好。你感觉怎么样？ "[kinu.isInari |浑身僵硬，还隐隐作痛。 出去活动活动身体，那些疼痛应该会稍微缓解一些。你已经卧床这么久了，唯一不会感到疼痛的原因，就是你的身体可能已经开始麻木了。 |有点头晕。 你已经连续三天抽冬茎烟了，如果现在你没有处于兴奋状态，那我反倒会感到惊讶呢。 ]出去呼吸一下新鲜空气吧，一小时后我在这里等你回来。

rows.original: "[kinu.isInari|...And that's about the long and short of it, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom].|...And that is the whole tale, [pc.mf|Father|Mother].]" For several moments, you look Kinu deep in the eye and wonder what's going on behind that carefully guarded gaze of hers, what it took her to tell you all this. [kinu.isInari |For someone as fiercely brave and self-determined as your daughter to admit fear, even if it was not for herself, but for others — that's something to be said for her sense of self here |For someone who prides herself on her duties and responsibilities like your daughter to admit failure and detail exactly her role in that failure and how it came about, especially when it came to impact others than herself ]. Your daughter slowly bows her head as you eye her, ears folding flat against head, and then in that moment everything you'd noticed in the den since coming to visit today makes sense, each and every one of the slight differences. Of course everything looks newer because it had to be rebuilt. Of course all the other kits still look a little harrowed. And of course, your firstborn daughter carries herself a little differently now. Who wouldn't? "[kinu.isInari |You're not upset with me, are you, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]? |You are not ashamed of me, are you, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]? ]" Of course you aren't. How could you be? Kinu squirms a little as you reach over and hug her, [kinu.isInari |clearly unused to such intimate contact on a regular basis |instinctively shrinking away from what would under normal circumstances be a breach of propriety ], but quickly relents and presses herself into your embrace. Because of all of Kinu's responsibilities and proclivities, it's sometimes hard to remember that your firstborn fox-daughter is only eighteen to nineteen summers of age. And yet that still is the case... others would have run away and saved themselves, but she didn't. If anything, you're the one who should be ashamed — first you missed her growing up, and now you weren't there to save her in her time of need. [kinu.isInari |Kinu sighs a little and pulls away from you, her eyes still downcast. "I know it's hard on you, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. It's hard on me as well. But as much as you might want to, you can't take care of me forever, and I don't want to be taken care of forever anyway. What happened that night was but a reminder of how little I truly am equipped to deal with the realities of the world. To forever hide under your protection would just mean none of us would ever move forward." Somehow, you fully expected that she would say that. "Don't feel guilty for not being here for me, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." Kinu gives you a thin and plainly forced smile. "Does it hurt sometimes? Of course it does. But life isn't about avoiding pain — I wouldn't be where I am, who I am, without it as well. I just wish... no one else had gotten dragged into that entire mess." |Kinu bites her lip and turns her gaze away from you. "Please do not grieve overlong regarding such matters, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. While I understand your remorse... when you hurt, I hurt, too. For our own sakes, let us not dwell on what is impossible to change, and move onto what is. For all that was stolen and destroyed that night, we all still have our lives and each other." Somehow, you fully expected your daughter dearest would say that. "Look, how quickly we have rebuilt the essentials of what was taken. Please, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]... do not fret overmuch about me. Please. I have been repeatedly assured that given the circumstances that I faced, there are few who could have done much better in defense of my home. I do not wish for you to worry, please." ] There's a quiet desperation in Kinu's words, one that perhaps even she herself doesn't pick up on. It's not that your fox-daughter doesn't believe what she's saying, but quite the opposite — that she believes it all far too much, and too intensely. ... It's probably not the time to pry into it now, but there is little doubt that the last vestiges of childhood innocence have been burned away from your daughter by the attempt on her life. And though how Kinu reacts to its loss is up to her to determine, its passing is a sign of... you can't quite put it into words, really. Perhaps it is selfish in a way, to want to keep your daughter stunted like that just to be able to enjoy that naive charm just a little longer, but emotions rarely make sense, do they? You smile and give Kinu a rub on the back, trying your best to be warm and affirming. Well, however she wants you to take this, there is something you can do for her. "That is?" If you ever see that Raphael bastard while out there in the wild, you'll gut him in the most horrible and excruciatingly painful way possible for daring to treat your daughter like that. She's no demoness, has never acted like what they're supposed to, and anyone who claims as much while acting in the way he did is a self-serving bastard of the highest degree. And that's getting in before what's going to happen to someone who so much as harms a single strand of fur on any of your children's tails. Kinu's thin smile widens. "[kinu.isInari |[pc.mf|Dad|Mom] |[pc.mf|Father|Mother] ]..." You'd move the world for her [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |and her sister |and her siblings ], make no mistake about that. So yes, if you ever do come across this man, he's in for a world of pain. "[kinu.isInari |Okay, okay, you've made your point, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]; I love you, too." Kinu perks up a little, and she swings herself to her feet. "I kind of feel better after all this, knowing that you're not just dropping everything to avenge me, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. Thanks for not babying me. "Well, there's still work to be done today, and the day isn't getting any longer. I'll see you later, okay?" With that, your daughter starts pacing down the path back to the fields, very pointedly not looking back, eyes forward, feet straight. You can only smile at the sight — it's so typical of strong-headed Kinu to act that way, even after such a harrowing experience. If that were to be torn from her... no, there's no point thinking about it. Even after all this, she's truly unafraid, and that's what makes her your beloved fox-daughter. |I will not deny that it is quite flattering to have a parent who is so devoted to your defense; I can only hope that I will feel the same way about my own future kits." Kinu perks up a little, and she swings herself to her feet. "And knowing that not just you, but everyone else, was so motivated to come to my aid when I needed it most — it only makes me feel like I ought to repay them all the more. This kind of trust and dedication, it is not something a man like that Raphael wretch could ever conceive of. The way he treated his underlings, continually pretending to be what he was not and forever looking over his shoulder — I am truly blessed. "But such blessings do not divest me of my duties, and I must depart now. The day is not getting any longer — if you will excuse me, please." With that, your daughter rises from her seat and excuses herself, departing from the room. You're left to finish the cooling tea and wonder at her sudden departure — that, and wonder about the future and safety of your fox-family. ]
rows.translation: "[kinu.isInari|大概就是这么回事了。 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈].|这就是整个故事了。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲].]" 有那么几刻，你紧紧地注视着绮奴的眼睛，想知道她那双看似平静的目光背后究竟隐藏着什么，又是怎样的经历让她决定向你倾诉这一切。 [kinu.isInari |对于你的女儿这样勇敢无畏、意志坚定的人来说，能够承认自己的恐惧，哪怕这种恐惧是出于对别人的关心而非为了自己，这一点确实值得称赞。这充分体现了她强烈的自我意识与责任感。 |对于一个像你女儿这样注重履行自己的职责与义务的人来说，能够承认自己的失败，详细说明自己在其中所扮演的角色以及失败是如何发生的，尤其是当这种失败还影响了他人时，实在是一件很不简单的事情。 ]当你注视着女儿时，她缓缓低下了头，耳朵紧贴在脑袋两侧。就在那一刻，自从今天来到这里之后，你在那个小屋里注意到的所有细节都变得合情合理了——那些细微的差别，每一个都解释得通了。当然，一切看起来都更加崭新，因为那些地方肯定已经被重新建造过了。当然，其他那些小工具看起来仍然有些陈旧。当然，你的长女现在的举止也有些不同了。谁会不这样呢？ "[kinu.isInari |你并没有生我的气，对吧？ [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]? |你并不为我感到羞愧，对吧？ [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]? ]" 你当然不是。你怎么可能会是呢？当你伸出手去拥抱她时，绮奴微微扭动了一下身体。 [kinu.isInari |显然，他还不习惯这种频繁的亲密接触。 |在正常情况下，这种行为本应被视为失礼之举，但人们会下意识地避开它。 ]但她很快又放弃了抵抗，主动投入了你的怀抱。 由于基努肩负着诸多责任，也有着一些特殊的性格特点，有时候人们很容易忘记——你的第一个狐狸女儿其实只有十八九岁的年纪而已。但事实就是如此……换作别人，或许早就逃走了，保全自己的性命，但她没有。相反，她 你是 真正应该感到羞愧的是你——当初你错过了她成长的过程，现在在她需要帮助的时候，你也没有出现在她身边。 [kinu.isInari |纪久轻轻叹了口气，然后从你身边拉开距离，她的目光依然低垂着。 我知道这对你来说很困难， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]这对我来说也很艰难。但无论你有多想这么做，你也无法永远照顾我，而我也并不想永远被人照顾。那天晚上发生的事情，只是提醒了我自己，实际上我根本没有能力面对这个世界的现实。如果永远躲在你的保护之下，那就意味着我们永远都无法前进。 不知为何，你完全预料到她会说出那句话。 不要因为没有陪在我身边而感到内疚， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]." 纪久露出一个勉强而苍白的微笑。 有时候会疼吗？当然会。但人生本来就不是为了逃避痛苦——如果没有那些痛苦，我也不会成为现在的自己。我只是希望……没有其他人也被卷进那团糟里。 |纪奈咬了咬嘴唇，然后将目光从你身上移开。 对于这类事情，请不要过度悲伤或忧虑。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]虽然我理解你的懊悔……当你受伤的时候，我也会感到痛苦。为了我们自己，让我们不要再去纠结那些无法改变的事情，而是把注意力放在当下能够做的事情上。对于那个夜晚被偷走和毁掉的一切，我们仍然拥有自己的生命，也还有彼此。 不知为何，你完全预料到你最亲爱的女儿会说出那样的话。 看，我们多快就重新建立起了那些被夺走的基本设施。请…… [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]请不要为我过于担心。真的，请相信，在我当时面临的那种情况下，能够更好地保护我的家园的人其实并不多。我并不希望你们为此烦恼。 ] 在纪奈的话语中，蕴含着一种隐忍的绝望，或许连她自己都没有意识到这一点。并不是说她的这个“狐狸女儿”不相信自己所说的话，恰恰相反——她是太相信了，而且相信得太过强烈。 ……现在或许还不是探究这个问题的时候，但毫无疑问，这次针对你女儿的谋杀企图已经彻底抹去了她身上最后一丝童真的痕迹。虽然绮奴会如何应对这种失去，由她自己来决定，但这种童真的消逝，无疑是一个重要的信号。…其实这种感觉很难用语言来表达。或许，在某种程度上，这种想要让女儿一直保持那种纯真状态，只为了能多享受一会儿她那天真的魅力，确实是一种自私的行为。但情感本身往往就是没有道理可言的，不是吗？ 你微笑着拍了拍绮奴的背，尽力用温暖而肯定的态度对待她。无论她希望你如何理解这件事，你总能为她做些什么。 那是？ 如果你在野外遇到那个拉斐尔混蛋，一定要用最残忍、最痛苦的方式杀了他——他竟敢那样对待你的女儿。她根本不是什么恶魔，也从未做出过那些该受谴责的行为。而任何做出那种事的同时还声称她就是那种坏人的人，都不过是些自私自利的混蛋罢了。 而这一切，都发生在那些哪怕只是伤害了你们孩子尾巴上的一根毛发的人身上之前。 绮奴淡淡的笑容变得更加灿烂了。 "[kinu.isInari |[pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈] |[pc.mf|父亲|母亲] ]..." 你愿意为她付出一切。 [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |还有她的妹妹 |以及她的兄弟姐妹们 ]这一点毫无疑问。所以，如果你真的遇到了这个男人，他将会陷入无尽的痛苦之中。 "[kinu.isInari |好吧，好吧，你已经把你的观点表达清楚了。 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]我也爱你。 纪久稍微振作了一下，然后站了起来。 经历了这一切之后，我知道你并不是为了为我报仇才放弃一切的，这种感觉让我觉得好受了一些。 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]. 谢谢你没有过分迁就我。 嗯，今天还有些工作没完成，而且时间也不多了。回头见，好吗？ 就这样，你的女儿开始沿着小路往田野方向走去，她坚决地没有回头，目光直视前方，足部步也走得笔直。看到这一幕，你只能会心一笑——对于性格坚强的绮奴来说，即便经历了如此可怕的事情，依然会这样行事，实在是再典型不过了。如果这种性格从她身上消失……不，想这些也没意义。经历了这一切之后，她依然毫无畏惧，正是这种勇气，让她成为了你心中最亲爱的狐狸女儿。 |我必须承认，拥有这样一位如此致力于为自己辩护的父母，确实是一件令人感到荣幸的事情；我只希望，当我自己的孩子长大后，我也能为他们做出同样的事情。 纪奈稍微振作了一下，然后站了起来。 而且，当我最需要帮助的时候，不仅是你，还有所有人，都如此热心地前来援助我——这让我更加觉得，自己有责任回报他们所有人。这样的信任与奉献，是像拉斐尔那样的卑鄙之徒永远无法想象的。他对待下属的方式，总是假装成另一个人，时刻提心吊胆、疑神疑鬼——我真是太幸运了。 但是，这样的恩赐并不会免除我的责任，我必须现在就离开。时间已经不多了——如果你们能原谅我的话，恳请允许我离开。 说着，你的女儿从座位上站起来，找了个借口离开了房间。你只好继续喝着已经凉掉的茶，同时思索着她突然离开的原因，同时也开始担心你的狐狸家族的未来与安危。 ]
rows.raw: " "[kinu.isInari|...And that's about the long and short of it, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom].|...And that is the whole tale, [pc.mf|Father|Mother].]" For several moments, you look Kinu deep in the eye and wonder what's going on behind that carefully guarded gaze of hers, what it took her to tell you all this. [kinu.isInari |For someone as fiercely brave and self-determined as your daughter to admit fear, even if it was not for herself, but for others — that's something to be said for her sense of self here |For someone who prides herself on her duties and responsibilities like your daughter to admit failure and detail exactly her role in that failure and how it came about, especially when it came to impact others than herself ]. Your daughter slowly bows her head as you eye her, ears folding flat against head, and then in that moment everything you'd noticed in the den since coming to visit today makes sense, each and every one of the slight differences. Of course everything looks newer because it had to be rebuilt. Of course all the other kits still look a little harrowed. And of course, your firstborn daughter carries herself a little differently now. Who wouldn't? "[kinu.isInari |You're not upset with me, are you, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]? |You are not ashamed of me, are you, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]? ]" Of course you aren't. How could you be? Kinu squirms a little as you reach over and hug her, [kinu.isInari |clearly unused to such intimate contact on a regular basis |instinctively shrinking away from what would under normal circumstances be a breach of propriety ], but quickly relents and presses herself into your embrace. Because of all of Kinu's responsibilities and proclivities, it's sometimes hard to remember that your firstborn fox-daughter is only eighteen to nineteen summers of age. And yet that still is the case... others would have run away and saved themselves, but she didn't. If anything, you're the one who should be ashamed — first you missed her growing up, and now you weren't there to save her in her time of need. [kinu.isInari |Kinu sighs a little and pulls away from you, her eyes still downcast. "I know it's hard on you, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. It's hard on me as well. But as much as you might want to, you can't take care of me forever, and I don't want to be taken care of forever anyway. What happened that night was but a reminder of how little I truly am equipped to deal with the realities of the world. To forever hide under your protection would just mean none of us would ever move forward." Somehow, you fully expected that she would say that. "Don't feel guilty for not being here for me, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." Kinu gives you a thin and plainly forced smile. "Does it hurt sometimes? Of course it does. But life isn't about avoiding pain — I wouldn't be where I am, who I am, without it as well. I just wish... no one else had gotten dragged into that entire mess." |Kinu bites her lip and turns her gaze away from you. "Please do not grieve overlong regarding such matters, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. While I understand your remorse... when you hurt, I hurt, too. For our own sakes, let us not dwell on what is impossible to change, and move onto what is. For all that was stolen and destroyed that night, we all still have our lives and each other." Somehow, you fully expected your daughter dearest would say that. "Look, how quickly we have rebuilt the essentials of what was taken. Please, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]... do not fret overmuch about me. Please. I have been repeatedly assured that given the circumstances that I faced, there are few who could have done much better in defense of my home. I do not wish for you to worry, please." ] There's a quiet desperation in Kinu's words, one that perhaps even she herself doesn't pick up on. It's not that your fox-daughter doesn't believe what she's saying, but quite the opposite — that she believes it all far too much, and too intensely. ... It's probably not the time to pry into it now, but there is little doubt that the last vestiges of childhood innocence have been burned away from your daughter by the attempt on her life. And though how Kinu reacts to its loss is up to her to determine, its passing is a sign of... you can't quite put it into words, really. Perhaps it is selfish in a way, to want to keep your daughter stunted like that just to be able to enjoy that naive charm just a little longer, but emotions rarely make sense, do they? You smile and give Kinu a rub on the back, trying your best to be warm and affirming. Well, however she wants you to take this, there is something you can do for her. "That is?" If you ever see that Raphael bastard while out there in the wild, you'll gut him in the most horrible and excruciatingly painful way possible for daring to treat your daughter like that. She's no demoness, has never acted like what they're supposed to, and anyone who claims as much while acting in the way he did is a self-serving bastard of the highest degree. And that's getting in before what's going to happen to someone who so much as harms a single strand of fur on any of your children's tails. Kinu's thin smile widens. "[kinu.isInari |[pc.mf|Dad|Mom] |[pc.mf|Father|Mother] ]..." You'd move the world for her [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 |and her sister |and her siblings ], make no mistake about that. So yes, if you ever do come across this man, he's in for a world of pain. "[kinu.isInari |Okay, okay, you've made your point, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]; I love you, too." Kinu perks up a little, and she swings herself to her feet. "I kind of feel better after all this, knowing that you're not just dropping everything to avenge me, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. Thanks for not babying me. "Well, there's still work to be done today, and the day isn't getting any longer. I'll see you later, okay?" With that, your daughter starts pacing down the path back to the fields, very pointedly not looking back, eyes forward, feet straight. You can only smile at the sight — it's so typical of strong-headed Kinu to act that way, even after such a harrowing experience. If that were to be torn from her... no, there's no point thinking about it. Even after all this, she's truly unafraid, and that's what makes her your beloved fox-daughter. |I will not deny that it is quite flattering to have a parent who is so devoted to your defense; I can only hope that I will feel the same way about my own future kits." Kinu perks up a little, and she swings herself to her feet. "And knowing that not just you, but everyone else, was so motivated to come to my aid when I needed it most — it only makes me feel like I ought to repay them all the more. This kind of trust and dedication, it is not something a man like that Raphael wretch could ever conceive of. The way he treated his underlings, continually pretending to be what he was not and forever looking over his shoulder — I am truly blessed. "But such blessings do not divest me of my duties, and I must depart now. The day is not getting any longer — if you will excuse me, please." With that, your daughter rises from her seat and excuses herself, departing from the room. You're left to finish the cooling tea and wonder at her sudden departure — that, and wonder about the future and safety of your fox-family. ] "

rows.original: And now, back in the present
rows.translation: 现在，让我们回到现实之中。

rows.original: As you approach Kinu, your fox-daughter [kinu.isInari |brightens up and comes up to you in a brisk jog. You catch her in a hug, taking the chance to pat her on the back and ruffle her hair |graces you with a small smile and gives you a genial half-bow, a gesture you feel compelled to return ]; she certainly is in a good mood today. And that's good. For all that's happened to her given what she told you on your last meeting, it's good to see her smiling again; [kinu.isInari |you know your fox-daughter well enough to understand it's nigh-impossible for her to wear an emotion on her sleeve that she doesn't truly feel. The smile on her face may not be absolutely beaming, but it is genuinely warm, and her ears and the rest of her body language follow suit. "Ah, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]!" Kinu squirms out of your embrace and clears her throat. "Okay, that's enough, sheesh. There's something I've got to give you." |while you know that it's one of her informal tasks to put on a pleasant face so the people around her don't worry, there's still something to be said for the clothes making the man — or the fox, in her case. Kinu's expression betrays her true emotions less and less these days, but you've never known her to intentionally deceive you. Aah, look at you. Doubting your daughter like that... "A fortuitous arrival, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. I was just thinking of you — there is something that I must pass along to you. I was concerned that there might not be another opportunity to do so within a reasonable timeframe." ] Oh? A gift? "[kinu.isInari |Well, kind of sort of |Not as such. To say it is a gift would imply mindful intent behind the giving, and it is not as much; rather, I am passing along something from the Den Matron to you ]." Hmm... "[kinu.isInari |Granny Komari and her pet madman artificer just finished dealing with most of the evidence we collected from the attack on our home, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. There're a bunch of bits and bobs that the invaders left during their retreat that can be recycled, but they also left this that I think might be useful to you out there. I don't really care about these kinds of magic, but even I can tell that it's more valuable as-is than broken down for components |The den matron and honorable artificer have finished analysing the evidence gathered from the attack on our home, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. Most of it can be dumped, repurposed or broken down, but there are a few objects that are more valuable as-is, such as this one. It may be helpful to you on your adventures[pc.ra kitsune | in his divine lordship's service ] ]." With that said, your fox-daughter reaches into her clothes and draws out a silver rod, capped at both ends with rubies but otherwise plain in appearance. It's perhaps as long as your forearm, retracts into itself to about half its length with a pin to either hold it extended or collapsed, and as thick as a finger.[pc.isMage | You instinctively recognize this as a spell focus after a fashion and give it a quick look-over; while you don't detect anything lingering on it that might be harmful, you're not entirely sure about the wisdom of repurposing such tools. ] Kinu notices your hesitation, and gives you a nod. [kinu.isInari |"Don't worry, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], it's safe. If Granny Komari's pet madman says there won't be a problem, it'll be fine." |"Its origin should not be a concern, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. The honorable Fukuisumi may have his eccentricities, but if he has given the go-ahead then I have confidence that it is safe to use." ] What's this, anyway? "[kinu.isInari |Granny says it's what was used to jam shut the torii gate from our side. That Raphael bastard certainly wasn't any kind of magician, but someone must've supplied him with this and it kept the spell of whatever primed until he was ready to use it. Now that it's expended, all that's left is a focus, and a pretty decent one at that." You see. "Hey, if you don't want it, I'll be passing it along to Miko and Mai. [kiyoko.numKits 4 |Since Asagiri's going to be joining them soon, it might as well go towards her education if you're not going to be using it out in the field, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom] |They've expressed interest in wanting another magical doodad for... whatever shenanigans they get up to when no one's looking ]. You want it or not?" |The matron has determined that this was what used to disable the torii gate from our side, preventing speedy response to the attack. The invaders' leader was no magician, but someone supplied him with this and the spell contained within, primed and ready to be unleashed at a moment's notice. Now that the magic has been expended, it has reverted to being a simple focus." Ah. "If you decline, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], there are other less pressing uses I could put this to, of course; Mikoto and Miyuki have expressed interest in acquiring it for themselves. [kiyoko.numKits 4 |Since Asagiri is going to be joining them soon enough, they will probably reserve such for her extended education |I have little doubt they will find some way to get into trouble with it, inadvertently or otherwise, but we have all come to expect as much from those two ]. Now then, would you like to requisition this for yourself, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]?" ]

这真是太好了。考虑到她在上次会议中告诉你的那些事情，她能够再次露出笑容，实在是一件值得欣慰的事情。 [kinu.isInari |你太了解你的那个“狐狸女儿”了，所以你应该明白，她几乎不可能表现出与自己真实感受不符的情绪。她脸上的笑容或许不是灿烂到极点，但确实是发自内心的温暖，而她的耳朵以及其他的肢体语言也都在印证这一点。 啊， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]!" 说着，你的狐女儿从衣服里拿出一根银棒，两端都镶嵌着红宝石，其余部分则显得十分普通。这根银棒的长度大概和你的前臂差不多，可以通过一根小针来控制它的长度——想要让它伸展开来，就拔出针；想要让它缩回去，就把针插回去。它的厚度大概和一根手指相当。[pc.isMage | 你本能地意识到这是一种法术专注道具，于是快速地扫视了一下；虽然没有发现任何可能带来危害的残留物，但你仍然不太确定将这样的道具重新用于其他用途是否明智。 ] 纪久注意到了你的犹豫，于是点了点头。 [kinu.isInari |别担心， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]没问题的，很安全。只要科马里奶奶的宠物疯子说不会有麻烦，那就肯定不会有事的。 |它的起源并不值得关注。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]虽然尊贵的福岛先生有些古怪，但既然他已经批准了，我相信使用它是没有问题的。 ] 这到底是什么东西？ "[kinu.isInari |奶奶说，这就是以前用来把东西紧紧关上的东西。 鸟居 这是从我们这边设下的机关。那个拉斐尔混蛋显然不是什么魔法师，但肯定有人帮他准备了这个东西，正是它让那个咒语处于待释放状态，直到他准备使用的时候。现在这个东西已经被消耗掉了，剩下的只有一个聚焦点，而且还是一个相当不错的聚焦点。 你瞧。 嘿，如果你不要的话，我就把它交给美子和舞吧。 [kiyoko.numKits 4 |既然浅雾很快就要加入他们，如果这些资金不会被用于实际应用，那么把它们用来她的教育倒是不错的选择。 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈] |他们表示有兴趣再得到一件魔法小道具，这样在没人注意的时候，他们就可以用它来搞各种鬼把戏了。 ]不管你愿不愿意，这都是你必须接受的。 |女管家确定，这就是曾经导致系统失效的原因。 托里 这一障碍从我们这边造成了阻碍，使得我们无法迅速应对这次攻击。入侵者的首领并非什么魔法师，但有人为他提供了这个道具，以及其中蕴含的魔法咒语——这些都被预先设置好了，随时可以被释放出来。如今，这些魔法已经被消耗殆尽，它们又变回了普通的普通物品而已。 啊。 如果你拒绝的话， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]当然，我还可以将这个用于其他一些不那么紧急的用途；美琴和美雪也表示有兴趣将其据为己有。 [kiyoko.numKits 4 |既然浅雾很快就会加入他们，他们很可能会为她的进一步学习预留这样的机会。 |我毫不怀疑，他们肯定会想办法因此惹上麻烦，无论是无意中还是故意的，但对于那两个人，我们早就预料到会这样了。 ]那么，您是否想要将这个物品申请归为己有呢？ [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]?" ]
rows.raw: " As you approach Kinu, your fox-daughter [kinu.isInari |brightens up and comes up to you in a brisk jog. You catch her in a hug, taking the chance to pat her on the back and ruffle her hair |graces you with a small smile and gives you a genial half-bow, a gesture you feel compelled to return ]; she certainly is in a good mood today. And that's good. For all that's happened to her given what she told you on your last meeting, it's good to see her smiling again; [kinu.isInari |you know your fox-daughter well enough to understand it's nigh-impossible for her to wear an emotion on her sleeve that she doesn't truly feel. The smile on her face may not be absolutely beaming, but it is genuinely warm, and her ears and the rest of her body language follow suit. "Ah, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]!" Kinu squirms out of your embrace and clears her throat. "Okay, that's enough, sheesh. There's something I've got to give you." |while you know that it's one of her informal tasks to put on a pleasant face so the people around her don't worry, there's still something to be said for the clothes making the man — or the fox, in her case. Kinu's expression betrays her true emotions less and less these days, but you've never known her to intentionally deceive you. Aah, look at you. Doubting your daughter like that... "A fortuitous arrival, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. I was just thinking of you — there is something that I must pass along to you. I was concerned that there might not be another opportunity to do so within a reasonable timeframe." ] Oh? A gift? "[kinu.isInari |Well, kind of sort of |Not as such. To say it is a gift would imply mindful intent behind the giving, and it is not as much; rather, I am passing along something from the Den Matron to you ]." Hmm... "[kinu.isInari |Granny Komari and her pet madman artificer just finished dealing with most of the evidence we collected from the attack on our home, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. There're a bunch of bits and bobs that the invaders left during their retreat that can be recycled, but they also left this that I think might be useful to you out there. I don't really care about these kinds of magic, but even I can tell that it's more valuable as-is than broken down for components |The den matron and honorable artificer have finished analysing the evidence gathered from the attack on our home, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. Most of it can be dumped, repurposed or broken down, but there are a few objects that are more valuable as-is, such as this one. It may be helpful to you on your adventures[pc.ra kitsune | in his divine lordship's service ] ]." With that said, your fox-daughter reaches into her clothes and draws out a silver rod, capped at both ends with rubies but otherwise plain in appearance. It's perhaps as long as your forearm, retracts into itself to about half its length with a pin to either hold it extended or collapsed, and as thick as a finger.[pc.isMage | You instinctively recognize this as a spell focus after a fashion and give it a quick look-over; while you don't detect anything lingering on it that might be harmful, you're not entirely sure about the wisdom of repurposing such tools. ] Kinu notices your hesitation, and gives you a nod. [kinu.isInari |"Don't worry, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], it's safe. If Granny Komari's pet madman says there won't be a problem, it'll be fine." |"Its origin should not be a concern, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. The honorable Fukuisumi may have his eccentricities, but if he has given the go-ahead then I have confidence that it is safe to use." ] What's this, anyway? "[kinu.isInari |Granny says it's what was used to jam shut the torii gate from our side. That Raphael bastard certainly wasn't any kind of magician, but someone must've supplied him with this and it kept the spell of whatever primed until he was ready to use it. Now that it's expended, all that's left is a focus, and a pretty decent one at that." You see. "Hey, if you don't want it, I'll be passing it along to Miko and Mai. [kiyoko.numKits 4 |Since Asagiri's going to be joining them soon, it might as well go towards her education if you're not going to be using it out in the field, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom] |They've expressed interest in wanting another magical doodad for... whatever shenanigans they get up to when no one's looking ]. You want it or not?" |The matron has determined that this was what used to disable the torii gate from our side, preventing speedy response to the attack. The invaders' leader was no magician, but someone supplied him with this and the spell contained within, primed and ready to be unleashed at a moment's notice. Now that the magic has been expended, it has reverted to being a simple focus." Ah. "If you decline, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], there are other less pressing uses I could put this to, of course; Mikoto and Miyuki have expressed interest in acquiring it for themselves. [kiyoko.numKits 4 |Since Asagiri is going to be joining them soon enough, they will probably reserve such for her extended education |I have little doubt they will find some way to get into trouble with it, inadvertently or otherwise, but we have all come to expect as much from those two ]. Now then, would you like to requisition this for yourself, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]?" ] "

rows.original: Yeah, you'll take it. If you actually managed to use this against that bastard Raphael and his flunkies, wouldn't that be a pretty ironic note — defeated by their own weapons. And if not... well, it might still come in handy. Adventuring is partly about keeping one's options open, and having more options in reserve can never hurt. [kinu.isInari |"Well, here you go, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. Hope it can be of some use to you.[silly | Of course, what I know you're going to do is to take one look at this stuff's stats and probably either hawk it or sell it to the nearest vendor first chance you get, but you can't itemise gear such that it's good for everyone, can you? At least this game doesn't give you the option to disenchant it in front of me, that would just make me mad. Psh. ]" |"If that is your desire, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. Here, may it serve you well over the course of your tasks.[silly | Of course, you would not be the kind to take one look at the statistics this has and either sell it to the nearest merchant or leave it to collect dust in storage, would you? Ah, we know the answer to that question — but then, one cannot itemise equipment such that it is desirable to everyone, such is the nature of providing options to players. Well, at least there is not the option of having you disenchant the item in front of me after I just handed you your quest reward. That would just make me quite unhappy, I assure you. ]" ] Kinu hands you the rod, and you tuck away the rod with your other possessions. It's cool to the touch and quite solid despite being light and compact; must be the tubular design. [kinu.isInari |"Right, that's that done and over with. Now then, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], what did you need me for today?" |"And that is settled. With that, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], can I assist you in any way today?" ]
rows.translation: 没错，你肯定会用得上它的。要是你真的能用这个东西来对付那个混蛋拉斐尔和他的手部下们，那该有多讽刺啊——被他们自己制造的武器给打败了。而就算没用上……嗯，它总归还是有可能派上用场的。冒险嘛，其实就是要在关键时刻保留多种选择，多准备一些应对方案总不会有坏处。 [kinu.isInari |好吧，给你吧。 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]希望这些内容能对您有所帮助。[silly | 当然，我知道你看到这些装备的属性后，肯定会立刻想把它们卖掉或者卖给最近的商人。但是，不可能有哪种装备对每个人都适用吧？至少这款游戏没有给我提供在别人面前分解这些装备的选项，不然我真会生气……哼。 ]" |如果那是你的愿望， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]在这里，愿它在你执行各项任务的过程中为你带来帮助。[silly | 当然，你不会是那种看到这些数据后，立刻把装备卖给最近的商人，或者让它被堆在仓库里积灰的人，对吧？啊，我们其实知道这个问题的答案——但是，毕竟不可能有某种装备能让所有人都觉得满意，这就是为玩家提供多种选择所带来的必然结果。 嗯，至少在我刚刚把任务奖励交给你的时候，你不会要求我在你面前拆解那个物品。我向你保证，那样会让我非常不高兴的。 ]" ] 绮奴将这根棍子交给你，你便把它和其他物品一起收好。它的触感很凉爽，虽然重量轻且体积小，但却相当结实——这肯定要归功于它的管状设计。 [kinu.isInari |对，就是那样。 那个 彻底结束了。那么，接下来 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]今天找我有什么事吗？ |就这样决定了。事已如此， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]今天有什么可以帮到您的吗？ ]

rows.original: "[kinu.isInari |Huh, you don't want it, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]?" You think you're well-equipped enough for your adventures that you don't need the cast-offs of some bastard who tried to humiliate and murder your daughter. "Ah, okay. Yeah, when you put it that way I can see where you're coming from. I wouldn't want to keep it around if I were to look at it that way, either." Kinu puts the rod back into the folds of her work clothes. "I'll hand this over to Mai when I drop by the shrine this evening, then. [kiyoko.numKits 4 |I'm not exactly sure what part of Asagiri's upcoming education as a shrine maiden would find this useful, but then again what do I know? I'm just there to make offerings |I'm sure they'll be getting up to all kinds of no good with this, and to be frank I'm kind of curious as to what trouble they'll be making ]." |If that is your wish, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]." You think you're well-equipped enough for your adventures that you don't need the cast-offs of some bastard who tried to humiliate and murder your daughter. "That is... right. When you put it that way, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], I suppose just looking at the thing overlong with that thought in mind does indeed provoke a sense of revulsion. I would not want it near me for any length of time, let alone trust it to carry me in a time of need." Kinu looks pensive for a moment, and then tucks the rod back into the folds of her finery. "Please, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], accept my apologies for so thoughtlessly offering such to you." Oh, she doesn't have to apologize. You know that your darling daughter only meant well. "Even so." Kinu stiffens. "I suppose I will have this over to Mai when I make my absolutions this evening, then. [kiyoko.numKits 4 |While I am not entirely sure how this will be helpful in Asagiri's incipient education and training as a shrine maiden, I have no reason to distrust the sisters |Lacking the aversiveness you and I have to this rod, certainly the sisters will be better able to put it to good use than you or I will ]." ] Agreed. While the rod may appear innocuous, you don't want it around you, and don't have need for it. [kinu.isInari |"Right, that's that done and over with. Now then, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], what did you need me for today?" |"And with that, the matter is settled. Now, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], can I assist you in any way today?" ]
rows.translation: "[kinu.isInari |哈，你不要它啊 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]?" 你认为自己已经准备充分，足以应对各种冒险，因此根本不需要那些试图羞辱并杀害你女儿的混蛋留下的东西。 啊，好吧。嗯，你这么一说，我确实明白你的意思了。如果从这个角度考虑的话，我也不会想继续保留它了。 纪奈将那根棍子放回她工作服的褶皱里。 那么，今晚我去神社的时候会把这个交给舞吧。 [kiyoko.numKits 4 |我其实不太确定，作为神社少女，浅雾即将开始接受的这些教育中，哪一部分会用到这些知识呢？不过，我又有什么资格知道呢？我只不过是负责献祭的人罢了。 |我敢肯定，他们肯定会利用这个机会干出各种坏事来。说实话，我其实挺好奇他们会惹出什么麻烦来的。 ]." |如果那是你的愿望的话， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]." 你认为自己已经准备充分，足以应对各种冒险了，因此根本不需要那些试图羞辱并杀害你女儿的混蛋留下的东西。 嗯……确实是这样。你这么一说，我就明白啦。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]我想，如果一直带着这样的想法去仔细观察那东西，确实会让人感到厌恶。我根本不愿意让它靠近我，更不会指望它在我需要的时候帮助我。 基努沉思了一会儿，然后将那根棍子重新收进她那华丽的服饰褶皱中。 拜托了， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]请接受我的歉意，我如此欠考虑地提出了这样的要求。 哦，她根本不需要道歉。你知道，你亲爱的女儿只是出于好意而已。 即便如此。 绮奴的身体僵硬了起来。 我想，今晚在向大家告辞的时候，我会把这个交给舞吧。 [kiyoko.numKits 4 |虽然我不太确定这对浅雾作为神社少女所接受的初步教育和训练能起到多大的帮助，但我没有理由不信任这些姐妹们。 |既然你们和我对这种鱼竿并没有那么反感，那么姐妹们肯定能比我们更好地利用它。 ]." ] 同意。虽然那根棍子看起来似乎没什么危害，但你其实并不希望它出现在你身边，也没有任何需要使用它的理由。 [kinu.isInari |对，就是那样。 那个 彻底结束了。那么，接下来 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]今天找我有什么事吗？ |就这样，这件事就解决了。现在， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]今天有什么可以帮到您的吗？ ]

rows.original: If it can be of better use elsewhere, you'll pass on it.
rows.translation: 如果它在其他地方能发挥更大的作用，你一定会把它转交给别人。
rows.raw: "If it can be of better use elsewhere, you'll pass on it."

rows.original: "Well, I think that's about it," Kiyoko says, stepping in to break the tension. "Kinu, would you please pick up the board and play elsewhere? Your [pc.mf|father|mother] and I have some business to discuss in private." Kinu bows. "As you wish, Mother." "Thank you." With that, Kiyoko starts along the path back to the cabin, and you quickly fall in step beside her, both of you walking in silence until you reach the door. "Kinu is so bright, she scares me sometimes. A child like that — the Astral Plane is far too small a realm for someone like her to grow up in. She needs to be able to experience more." You'd better hurry up and get everyone out then, eh? "It would be appreciated, but don't do anything rash." With a quiet sigh, Kiyoko ushers you into the sitting room, then proceeds with the familiar ritual of getting out the tea and candies. "So, to what do I owe the honor of your visit today?"
rows.translation: 嗯，我想就这些了吧。 清子开口说道，试图打破这种紧张的气氛。 绮奴，你能把棋盘拿走，到别的地方去下棋吗？你的 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲] 我有些事情需要私下讨论。 绮奴鞠了一躬。 如您所愿，母亲。 谢谢。 就这样，清子沿着小路朝着小屋的方向走去，你也迅速跟在了她的身后。两人一路上都没有说话，直到终于走到了门口。 绮奴太耀眼了，有时候她真的会让我感到害怕。像她这样的孩子，星界这样的小地方实在不适合她成长。她需要去体验更多的事情。 你最好赶紧把大家都救出来，嗯？ 如果你们能这样做就再好不过了，但请千万不要贸然行动。 基代子轻叹一声，将你领进了客厅，然后开始按照惯例准备茶点和糖果。 那么，我究竟做了什么，才让您今天专程前来拜访我呢？

rows.original: You're on your way through the hilltop clearing just before Kiyoko's cabin when you spy some movement off by the side of the path, a rustle of movement at one of the parasol tables. Stepping closer to take a look, you find Kiyoko and your daughter sitting in the shade of the parasol, focusing furiously on a board game laid out between the two of them. You've never seen this particular game before — presumably it's something from Kiyoko's homeland — but it's gripped the attention of both mother and daughter to the point where the plate of salted peanuts by their side has gone completely untouched. Not wishing to disturb the duo, you step up as quietly, just in time as your daughter slaps a white piece down on the board. "I think that's the last move, Mother." "Yes." The tension drains from Kiyoko's body, and she sags with relief. "Yes, it is. You played well, Kinu." "But Mother, you won. You have more territory." "Not by much. At this rate, it won't be long until you surpass me." You look down at the grid etched onto the wooden board, as well as the black and white pieces laid out on it; while you can't make heads or tails of it, Kiyoko's motion that mother and daughter are evenly matched certainly seems plausible. You clear your throat, and both of them look up at you. Kiyoko smiles. "[pc.name]. How kind of you to join us. Please, meet your firstborn daughter, Kinu." Kinu rises from her seat, a three-tailed kitsune of about seven or eight summers, judging by her appearance. And speaking of appearances, she's practically the spitting image of her mother, from the large ears, the sleek, fluffy tails practically begging to be touched, and the snow-white locks which flow down her shoulders and by the sides of her face. The rest of her hair has been braided about her back and tied with a violet ribbon. "I'm honored by your presence, [kinu.Dad]." And perfectly and impeccably polite, too. Reaching out, you ruffle Kinu's hair and scratch the backs of her ears, the loving petting eliciting a childish, overjoyed squeal of delight from the kitsune kit. "Kinu and I were just having a game of go," Kiyoko explains. "I've been trying to teach her the game for a while now — she may resemble me in appearance, but she's inherited your immense aptitude for learning, [pc.name]. It hasn't been that long since she picked up the game, but she's already giving me a run for my money." You look down at Kinu, the little kitsune still fussing happily over your scritching, and... yeah. She may look like her mother, but there's plenty of you behind those eyes, tempered by her mother's nature. You're not really sure what to make of that. "I know! I know!" Kinu pipes up, looking at you with big, pleading fox-kit eyes. "Do you want to play a game of go, [kinu.Dad]? Do you? It's really easy to pick up — I can explain the rules really quick!" You cast a glance at Kiyoko, who just shrugs and shakes her head, an exasperated smile on her lips. Guess this decision's your call...
rows.translation: 当你即将穿过基约科的小屋前的山顶空地时，你注意到小路旁有动静——遮阳伞下的桌子上有人正在活动。你走过去仔细一看，发现基约科和你的女儿正坐在遮阳伞的荫凉下，全神贯注地玩着摆在他们面前的桌游。 你以前从未见过这款游戏——大概它是来自清子的故乡吧——但这款游戏确实吸引了母女两人的注意力，以至于她们旁边的那盘咸花生完全被忽略了，无人动过。 你不想打扰这对母女，于是悄悄地走上前，正好在女儿把一块白色棋子放在棋盘上的那一刻赶到。 我想那就是最后的手段了，母亲。 是的。 清子的身体里的紧张感渐渐消失了，她松了一口气，整个人都软了下来。 是的，你做得很好，绮奴。 但是妈妈，你赢了。你的领地更多了。 差得不多。照这个速度，用不了多久你就能超过我。 你低头看着木板上刻着的棋盘以及摆放在上面的黑白棋子；虽然你完全看不懂这些棋局是怎么回事，但清子所说的“母女双方实力相当”这个说法似乎确实有道理。你清了清嗓子，这时他们俩都抬头看着你。 清子微笑了。 "[pc.name]您能加入我们真是太好了。请来见见您的长女，绮奴吧。 纪奈从座位上站了起来，从她的外表来看，她应该是一只有着三条尾巴的九尾狐，年龄大概有七八岁左右。说到外貌，她简直和她母亲一模一样——那对大耳朵、那些柔软蓬松、仿佛在邀请人触摸的尾巴，还有那垂落在肩头、环绕在脸庞两侧的雪白长发。她剩下的头发都被编成辫子，用一条紫色的丝带系在背后。 能得到您的光临，我感到无比荣幸。 [kinu.Dad]." 而且 你的举止也极其得体、毫无瑕疵。你伸手轻抚基努的头发，挠了挠她的耳背，这种充满爱意的抚摸让这只狐妖幼崽发出了天真无邪、欣喜若狂的叫声。 我和绮奴刚刚在下一盘围棋。 清子解释道。 我这段时间一直在尝试教她这个游戏——虽然她的外表和我有些相似，但她继承了你那种非凡的学习能力。 [pc.name]她刚开始玩这个游戏，但已经让我感受到了竞争的压力。 你低头看着绮奴，那只小狐妖仍在开心地抚摸着你被抓挠的地方……没错，她虽然长得像她的母亲，但她的双眼中依然流露出你的影子，只不过这些特质被她母亲的性格所影响了。 你其实并不确定该如何理解这一点。 我知道！我知道！ 绮奴开口说道，那双大而充满恳求的狐妖般的眼睛正注视着你。 你想下一盘围棋吗？ [kinu.Dad]是吗？其实这个游戏很容易上手，我很快就能把规则解释清楚！ 你瞥了眼清子，她只是耸了耸肩，摇了摇头，嘴角带着一丝无奈的微笑。看来这个决定还是由你来做吧……

rows.original: You know what? Why not? All you have to lose is your dignity, after all[pc.isDK|, and you're pretty sure you don't have any of that remaining anyway|]. Sure, you're game for a game. "Yay!" Quickly sweeping away the remnants of the last game, Kinu quickly explains the rules to you while she separates the go stones into black and white. It sounds almost deceptively simple — to make a long story short, place stones, encircle territory, and the player with the most territory when the board is filled wins. Your daughter is practically gleeful as she takes a seat, and with the white stones as your side, invites you to go first. After a few turns, it turns out that the game indeed is deceptively simple — it's one of those easy to pick up yet impossible to master things. [pc.cunningRange 0 50 80 |There's pretty much no contest here — your own daughter outmaneuvers you at every turn, blocking your advances and taking swathes of territory with ease. Maybe it's a fox's natural wiliness — or maybe you're just not as cunning as you'd like to be. Either way, the game is over posthaste, with Kinu looking more than a little disappointed at how quickly it went by. Faced with such a crushing defeat, there's no denying strategy board games aren't your forte; you simply aren't cunning enough to win on your first attempt at playing a game. "There's no shame in losing, [kinu.Dad]," Kinu pipes up. "Your strengths simply lie elsewhere." Aww, she's trying to make you feel better about losing to an eight-year-old. A prodigy of an eight-year-old, but that doesn't soften the sting any. What does soften the sting is the fact that at least it's your own daughter who beat you, for what it's worth. |You have some trouble at first, but soon begin to see patterns, and potential strategies birth themselves from the position of black and white stones. The corners appear to be good starting points, so you stick to that, trying to keep your stones clustered and easily defensible. Kinu, on her part, is clearly having plenty of fun playing against you, retaining that adorably sprightly air about her throughout the game. Wonder if this was what her mother was like in her youth... At the end of it all, though, the board appears to be more or less an even split between black and white, with a small hole of indeterminate territory between the two. Kiyoko quickly sums up the territory the both of you have captured, and clears her throat. "Kinu is the winner, by a small margin." You're not sure if you should be proud of your daughter, or to feel shame at being beaten by an eight-year-old — even if it is your first game of go. "Don't feel ashamed, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. It was your first game, and it could have gone either way. I, too, learned something from the match and saw room for improvement." |Despite your initial difficulty, though, your natural cunning quickly enables you to spy opportunities and openings, as well as instinctively formulate strategies on the fly despite this being your very first game. Starting at the corners as defensible positions, you take cues from Kinu and start shoring up your pieces — soon enough, Kinu stops toying with you, her expression growing deadly serious as the game proceeds apace. As more and more of the board falls to either side, first filling up by the edges and then to the center, the game becomes increasingly frantic, until at the last Kinu gives you a solemn nod. "There're no more moves which can be made, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. The game is over. You won." You did? "You captured more territory." Flickers of emotion pass over your daughter's expression, starting with disbelief before settling into something approaching, but not quite quiet reverence and respect. "Mother was right — you do possess an aptitude for fast learning. I'm honored to be able to partake of this inheritance." Maybe it was beginner's luck. "There's no need for such humility, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. I watched you piece together from first principles strategies that I had to be taught. There was a method to your moves; even though there were some blunders, I only realized them when it was too late to take advantage of such." ]
rows.translation: 你知道吗？为什么不呢？反正你最多失去的也只是自己的尊严而已。[pc.isDK|而且你也非常确定自己没有任何这类东西。 那个 无论如何，还是剩下的那部分。|]当然，你愿意尝试这个游戏。 耶！ 金努迅速清理掉了上一局游戏留下的残局，一边将棋子分成黑白两组，一边向你解释游戏规则。这些规则听起来似乎简单得令人难以置信——简而言之，就是放置棋子、占领领地，等到棋盘被完全填满时，拥有最多领地的玩家获胜。你的女儿坐在座位上时，脸上洋溢着兴奋的神情，她选择使用白色棋子代表自己一方，邀请你先走。 经过几轮游戏后，你终于发现——这个游戏其实 是 看似简单，但实际上却属于那种容易上手却很难精通的东西。 [pc.cunningRange 0 50 80 |在这里，几乎没有任何悬念——你自己的女儿总是在每一个环节上都比你更机灵，她会阻止你的行动，并轻松地占领大片“领土”。也许这是狐狸与生俱来的狡黠天性，又或许只是因为你并没有自己想象中那么聪明罢了。 无论如何，这场游戏很快就结束了，绮奴看起来对游戏进行得如此之快感到非常失望。 面对如此惨败，不得不承认，策略棋类游戏确实不是你的强项；你显然还不够聪明，无法在第一次尝试就赢得比赛。 失败并不可耻， [kinu.Dad]," 基努开口说道。 你的优势其实在其他方面。 哎呀，她其实是想让你因为输给一个八岁的孩子而感觉好受一点吧。那个八岁的孩子确实是个天才，但这也无法减轻这种挫败感啊……真是的。 做 至少是你的亲生女儿打了你，这一点也算是有点安慰吧。 |一开始你会遇到一些困难，但很快就会开始发现一些规律，而一些潜在的策略也会在黑白棋子的布局中自然而然地浮现出来。角落似乎是不错的起点，因此你选择从那里开始布局，努力让自己的棋子保持聚集状态，从而便于防守。 至于绮奴，她在与你对战的过程中显然玩得非常开心，整个游戏过程中都保持着那种活泼可爱的神情。不知道她母亲年轻时是不是也是这样的…… 不过，最终来看，棋盘上的局势似乎大致上是黑白双方势均力敌，只是中间还有一小块归属不明的区域。 清子迅速总结了一下你们两人所占领的区域，然后清了清嗓子。 基努以微弱的优势赢得了胜利。 你甚至不确定，自己是应该为自己的女儿感到骄傲，还是应该因为被一个八岁的孩子打败而感到羞愧 是 你的第一局围棋游戏。 不要感到羞愧， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]这是你的第一场比赛，结果本来可能朝任何方向发展。我也从这场比赛中学到了一些东西，并且意识到自己还有提升的空间。 |尽管一开始遇到了一些困难，但你的天生的机敏很快帮助你发现了各种机会和突破口，而且尽管这是你第一次玩这个游戏，你依然能够凭直觉迅速制定出应对策略。你从那些易于防守的位置开始，借鉴绮奴的做法，逐步巩固自己的棋局——不久之后，绮奴就不再和你玩闹了，她的表情变得异常严肃，游戏也进入了白热化阶段。 随着越来越多的棋盘区域被双方占据——先是边缘部分，然后逐渐扩展到中心区域——游戏节奏变得越来越紧张激烈，直到最后，绮奴会向你郑重地点头示意游戏结束。 已经没有其他可行的行动了。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]游戏结束了，你赢了。 你真的这么做了？ 你占领了更多的领土。 你女儿的表情中闪过一系列复杂的情感，起初是不相信，随后逐渐转变为一种近乎敬畏与尊重的神情。 妈妈说得对——你 做 我具备快速学习的能力，能够继承这一优势，我感到非常荣幸。 也许这只是新手运气罢了。 没必要这么谦虚， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]我看着你从最基础的原则出发，逐步构建出那些原本需要别人来教你才能掌握的策略。你的每一步行动都遵循着一定的方法；虽然也犯过一些错误，但直到为时已晚，我才意识到那些错误的存在。 ]

rows.original: "Aww, boo..." Kinu's ears flatten against her head, and the little kitsune sniffles. "Well, I suppose you have to play with Mother instead." Maybe another time, okay? Kiyoko pats her daughter on the shoulder. "I understand you're eager to test your wits against your [pc.mf|father|mother], Kinu, but this was rather sudden. You only come to me for games when I'm free, don't you?" It takes a while, but eventually Kinu does stop sniffling and looks appropriately chagrined. "Please forgive my impudence, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. I allowed my impulses to carry me away."
rows.translation: 哎呀，宝贝…… 犬夜的耳朵贴在脑袋上，那只小狐妖抽抽搭搭地哭了起来。 嗯，我想你只能和妈妈一起玩了。 也许下次吧，好吗？ 清子轻拍了一下女儿的肩膀。 我明白你很想测试一下自己的智慧 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]，绮奴，但是这个 是 有点突然吧。你总是在我有空的时候才来找我玩游戏，不是吗？ 虽然花了一些时间，但最终绮奴终于不再抽泣了，看上去也确实显得很懊恼。 请原谅我的冒昧， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]我让自己的冲动控制了自己。

rows.original:
[rand
        |Kinu is here under the shade of a parasol, lying on her stomach atop a bench as she leafs through a thick, heavy book. Her mother would definitely have something to say about decorum and propriety were she to see your daughter like this, but your daughter is so engrossed in whatever she's reading that it's hard to find the heart to rebuke her for being so relaxed... 
        
        As Kinu continues to read, your firstborn daughter's three silvery-white tails wave and waggle in the cool breeze, as if they were tall blades of grass. D'awww, that's adorable. 
        |As you pass over the hilltop, you spy Kinu napping on the freshly-cut grass. Your firstborn daughter is lying spreadeagled with a happy smile on her little face, limbs stretched out in all directions to drink in as much of the warm sunlight as she can. Her yukata is a rumpled, grass-stained mess, and there's little doubt that Kiyoko is going to give her an earful when she returns home.
        
        You're content to watch over her for a few moments, the little kitsune's ears flicking and tails swishing as she mumbles in her sleep. Still, you know Kinu's a light sleeper , so waking her should be easy; napping might be nice for your firstborn daughter, but you know she enjoys your visits more.
        |You spy little Kinu sitting under the shade of a parasol, elbows firmly planted on a table as she studies the board before her. [pc.bg scholar|You think you recognize the game she's playing — shogi, was that the name? It's certainly not something that's popular in this part of the world; you only know what you do from having perused a couple of foreign texts in your time as a scholar.|What she's playing is some kind of strategy game, although of what sort is unclear to you. It's certainly not something that's seen in this part of the world, that's for sure.] Brows furrowed in concentration, Kinu is playing both sides of the game, taking well over a minute between moves.
        
        Unsurprisingly, she's fought herself to a stalemate.
        |Kinu is out on the hilltop, struggling with a basket of laundry half her size, plus a stepladder in the bargain. As you watch, your kitsune daughter hangs out different articles of clothing to dry in the gentle breeze — while a couple are Kiyoko-sized, the vast majority of laundered clothing consists of children's garments, particularly those in Kinu's blues and purples. Well, if your daughter is the one creating all this dirty laundry, it only makes sense that her mother would make her wash it all by herself... 
        |You spy Kinu napping under one of the trees, curled up into a little white ball of fluff with the tips of her three tails tickling her nose. At least she isn't trying to filch any of the fruit... until she wakes up, that is.
        
        [flags.KINU_NIGHT_DONE||Your daughter is a pretty light sleeper, so waking her up if you wanted to play with her shouldn't be a problem at all.]
        |As you draw closer, you spy Kinu tending to the berry bushes scattered about the sun-warmed hilltop, pruning dead leaves and branches with a small pair of clippers while filling a large basket with sweet berries. Sure, your firstborn daughter might not favor berries as much as she does peaches, but the sticky purple stains about her mouth and fingers betray her recent indulgences. Perhaps you ought to talk to Kiyoko about that... or perhaps not. She looks so adorable this way.
        |Kinu is out under the shade of one of the parasols, accompanied by a tall cup of peach juice and a bowl of lightly salted rice crackers. Your firstborn daughter doesn't seem to be doing anything important at the moment, simply content with staring into empty space and batting at the air every now and then while her ears and tails go on autopilot. It's quite obvious that she's inherited her mother's vivid imagination, although in a far more innocent way.
        |Out of the corner of your eye, you spot Kinu milling about the hilltop with a large basket and trowel, as well as several other gardening implements. Looks like Kiyoko's sent her out to do a little weeding and mulch-spreading. Sure, she could do it in the blink of an eye with a spot of magic, but that isn't the point, is it? 
        
        Well, with the way your firstborn daughter is digging around in the dirt and getting it all over herself, the price of getting Kinu a well-rounded education is a very grimy kitsune. Hope her mother doesn't mind the washing up that's going to come after... 
    ]
rows.translation:
[rand
        |纪奈坐在长椅上，身体趴在椅子上，手中拿着一本厚厚的书仔细阅读。如果她妈妈看到她这个样子，肯定会有话要说，关于礼仪和规矩的问题。不过，纪奈实在太专注于她的阅读了，以至于根本没人有心思去责备她如此放松的样子。当绮奴继续阅读时，你长女那三条银白色的尾巴在凉爽的微风中摇摆着，仿佛是高高的草叶。哇，真是太可爱了。 
        |当你翻过山顶时，你看到绮奴正在新割的草地上小睡。你的长女躺在那片草地上，脸上洋溢着幸福的笑容，四肢伸展开来，尽可能多地吸收那温暖的阳光。 她的和服皱巴巴的，还沾满了草屑，毫无疑问，当清子回到家时，一定会狠狠地训斥她一顿。

你很乐意陪她待上几分钟，那只小狐妖在睡梦中嘟囔着，它的耳朵不停地动来动去，尾巴也摇来摇去。 不过，你知道绮奴睡觉很轻，所以叫她起床应该很容易吧；让你的长女小睡一会儿也不错，不过你知道，她其实更喜欢你来看她。
        |你看到小绮奴坐在遮阳伞下，双肘牢牢地放在桌子上，正仔细研究眼前的棋盘。 [pc.bg scholar|你以为自己认识她正在玩的那款游戏——是叫将棋吗？这种游戏在这个地区肯定不常见；你之所以知道它的存在，只是因为在求学期间偶然读过几篇关于外国游戏的文章而已。|她正在玩的是某种策略游戏，不过具体是哪种类型，你并不清楚。可以肯定的是，这种游戏在这个地区是前所未见的。] 布罗斯皱着眉头全神贯注地观察着，基努正在同时操控游戏中的双方角色，每次行动之间都要花费超过一分钟的时间。

毫不奇怪，她最终将自己逼入了僵局。
        |纪奈站在山顶上，费力地拖着一篮比她体型小一半的洗衣物，还得顺便提着一把梯子。你看着女儿将各种衣物挂在微风中晾干——其中有些衣物确实适合纪代子穿，但绝大多数都是儿童的衣物，尤其是那些蓝色和紫色的衣服。嗯，如果这些脏衣服都是你的女儿弄脏的，那么让她自己把它们都洗干净，当然是再理所当然不过的事情了…… 
        |你看到基努在一棵树下打盹，她蜷缩成一个小小的白色绒球，三条尾巴的尖端轻轻触碰着她的鼻子。至少在她醒来之前，她并没有试图偷吃任何水果……至少现在是这样。
        
        [flags.KINU_NIGHT_DONE||你的女儿睡眠很浅，所以如果你想和她一起玩，把她叫醒应该根本不是什么问题。]
        |当你渐渐靠近时，你看到纪奈正在阳轻型照耀的山顶上照料那些散布在周围的浆果灌木丛。她用一把小剪刀修剪着枯叶和枯枝，同时将那些甜美的浆果装进一个大篮子里。当然，你的长女可能并不像她那样喜欢浆果，而是更偏爱桃子，但她嘴角和手指上残留的紫色粘液显然说明她刚刚吃了很多浆果。或许你应该和清子谈谈这件事……不过也许也没必要。她现在这个样子看起来真是太可爱了。
        |纪奈坐在遮阳伞下，手边放着一杯桃汁和一碗微微加盐的米饼。她的长女此刻似乎并没有在做什么重要的事情，只是呆呆地望着前方，偶尔挥动双手，而她的耳朵和尾巴则自动保持着活动状态。很明显，她继承了母亲丰富的想象力，只不过这种方式要纯真得多。
        |你眼角的余轻型看到绮奴正拿着一个大篮子和一把铁锹，还有几件其他的园艺工具，在山顶上忙碌着。看来是清子让她出去除草和铺覆盖物的。 当然，她只要施展一点魔法，瞬间就能完成这件事，但关键并不在于此，对吧？

嗯，鉴于你的大女儿现在正在泥地里玩耍，把全身都弄得脏兮兮的，要想让绮奴接受全面的教育，代价就是让一只脏兮兮的狐妖来帮忙了。 希望她的母亲不会介意之后会有一大堆碗筷需要清洗…… 
    ]

        |As you pass over the hilltop, you spy Kinu napping on the freshly-cut grass. rows.original: [rand|"[kinu.Dad]!" Kinu squeals the moment she catches sight of you. Practically falling over herself in excitement, the little kitsune scampers up, dropping to all fours in her haste to get to you, and gives you a big hug to the legs. "You've come to visit again!" So you have. And has she been a good girl when you were away? "Um... yes! For a certain definition of good, anyway." Well, children are children, and kitsune children doubly so. As long as she doesn't exasperate her mother too much... Kinu contrives to stare at you wide-eyed, those big ice-blue eyes of hers radiating vulpine innocence. "I don't know what you mean, [kinu.Dad]. I've been good, after all!" Yes, yes, so she has. You pick up Kinu, give her fluffy white ears a good rubbing, then set a very squirmy and hyperactive floof back down on the ground. A little voice in the back of your mind voices the fact that your daughter is being deliberately endearing and saccharine sweet, but seriously, who gives a damn about that? The fact that she's an adorable little thing is good enough for you. "So! So! I know you're here to see Mama, but can you stop to play with me for a while?" That's why you're here, right? Otherwise you'd just have kept on walking past her. For such a smart fox, she can be a little silly at times. |The moment you start towards Kinu, your daughter springs to her feet and breaks into a jog, making a beeline for you. The little kitsune doesn't stop until she crashes straight into your legs and rolls into a big, fuzzy heap before finally coming to a halt at your side. "[kinu.Dad]! You came!" Yes, you're here. "I was just thinking how nice it would be if you dropped by to visit, and here you are all of a sudden! It's like magic — only it isn't, because I'd know if it were!" Well, you were intending to go and see her mother, but then you caught sight of your precious little foxy daughter on the way in and couldn't resist her cute charms; you just had to stop and say hello. "Eehee!" Kinu starts hopping on the spot, her three tails bouncing up and down behind her. "Can you play with me a bit, [kinu.Dad]? I don't get to see you very often... or at least, not as often as I'd like." If she promises to behave in between now and your next visit. Does she promise? Your daughter makes a big show of pretending to consider the offer, then nods so fast her head's a blur. "Okay! Okay! I pinky promise to be good! Will you now play with me?" Mm-hm. Time's a wasting — let's get started! ]
rows.translation: [rand|"[kinu.Dad]!" 一看到你，绮奴就尖叫起来。这只小狐妖兴奋得几乎摔倒在地，它急忙跑过来，四足着地，然后紧紧地抱住了你的腿。 你又来拜访我了！ 所以你有了。那么在你不在家的时候，她表现得像个好女孩吗？ 嗯……是的！至少在某种对‘善良’的定义下是这样。 嗯，孩子就是孩子，而狐妖的孩子更是如此。只要她不惹恼自己的母亲 太 昆努努力地睁大眼睛盯着你看，她那双冰蓝色的大眼睛中流露出天真的神情。 我不明白你的意思 [kinu.Dad]毕竟，我一直都表现得很不错啊！ 是的，没错，她确实是这么做的。你把绮奴抱起来，好好揉揉它那毛茸茸的白色耳朵，然后再把它放回地上——它肯定会变得特别活跃、到处乱动。你心里会默默想：你的女儿故意表现得这么可爱、这么甜腻，但说真的，谁会在意这些呢？ 那个她这么可爱，这一点就足以让你满意了。 所以！所以！我知道你是来看妈妈的，但能不能先陪我玩一会儿呢？ 这就是你来到这里的原因，对吧？否则你早就直接从她身边走过去了。这样一个聪明的狐妖，有时候也会表现得有点傻乎乎的。 |就在你朝着绮奴方向前进的那一刻，你的女儿立刻站了起来，开始小跑着朝你奔来。这只小狐妖一直跑着，直到直接撞到了你的腿上，然后滚成一个毛茸茸的一团，最后才在你身边停下来。 "[kinu.Dad]你来了！ 没错，你来对地方了。 我刚才还在想，要是你能来看看该有多好，结果你竟然真的来了！简直就像魔法一样——不过其实并不是魔法，因为如果是魔法的话，我肯定能察觉到的！ 嗯，你本来是打算去见她母亲的，但在路上却看到了你那可爱的小女儿，实在无法抗拒她的魅力，所以你忍不住停下来跟她打了招呼。 嘻嘻！ 基努开始在原地跳来跳去，她那三条尾巴在身后上下晃动。 能陪我玩一会儿吗？ [kinu.Dad]我很少有机会见到你……至少，没有我期望的那么频繁。 如果她承诺在下次你来访之前会守规矩，那么她真的这么承诺了吗？ 你的女儿装作在认真考虑这个提议，然后快速地点头，以至于她的头都快转晕了。 好啦！好啦！我发誓会听话的！现在你能陪我玩吗？ 嗯，时间不等人了——我们开始吧！ ]
