rows.original: "Waaaah! A tummy tickle! I haven't had one of those for soooo long! Mama won't give me any more — she says I'm too old for those, that I have to act with some level of propriety..." Well then. Seems like it's up to you to indulge little Kinu. So long as she doesn't tell anyone, everything should be just fine. "A tummy tickle!" Your daughter is practically bubbling over on the spot with sheer excitement, a stupid, toothy grin plastered all over her face. Without warning, she darts forward, hugs both of your legs, and starts vibrating intensely. "C'monc'monc'monc'mon!" Gods, is she excitable. Has she been pilfering peaches on the sly again? "No! No! I just really really wanna a tummy tickle! You can't tease me by promising tummy tickles and not making good on the promise, [kinu.Dad]! It's not nice!" Sheesh. Although knowing who your daughter is and what she's going to become in the future, it really shouldn't be surprising that Kinu shares this weakness with her mother. All right, all right — you'll give her a tummy tickle. "Yaaaaaaaaaay!" Grinning impishly, Kinu lets go of your legs and flops down on the ground, lounging lazily on the sun-warmed grass. Tails curling up around her from underneath, your daughter looks up at you eagerly with big blue eyes. With the help of hands and tails alike, Kinu undoes the purple sash about her midriff, then open the fabric so her bare midriff is exposed. "Pet me! Pet me!" You kneel down, reach for Kinu's tummy, then tickle the smooth, pale skin with a few light strokes of your fingertips. The effect is instantaneous — your daughter's big, stupid smile only gets wider, and she starts wriggling and flopping on the spot like a fish out of water. It only gets more intense as you start petting and tickling her tummy in earnest, lightly planting the heels of your palms into her midriff and pushing into the delicate skin with your fingertips. "Eeeee! It tickles! It tickles!" Giggling madly, Kinu arches her back and pushes herself against your fingers, urging you to go on. Her three tails writhe about madly under her, trying to grab hold of your wrists and draw you closer to her. "It feels soooo good..." Quite so. Kinu is such a soft and delicate thing, and her tummy is doubly so. You have to carefully restrain yourself from accidentally pushing down too hard on your daughter, instead settling for broad, flowing strokes with your fingertips. Kinu whimpers and yips as you shower her with loving affection, her right leg kicking at the air like a dog thumping its leg while being petted. The two really aren't that different, are they? Kinu's really quite foxy when she gets into this hopelessly happy state. Is she enjoying herself? "Mrrrrhhh..." You'll take that as a yes, then. Bit by bit, your daughter succumbs to melty bliss as she wallows in the warmth of your touch. First her ears droop flat against her head, then her gaze grows unfocused and her eyes half-lidded, and even her tails fall still save for the occasional twitch. All the tension in Kinu's body turns into syrupy ooze as you scratch her exposed tummy, her petite body still save for the steady thumping of her right leg kicking away at the air. In time, though, even that comes to a stop, her leg falling limply to the side as she lets out one final whimper and starts to snore softly. Her ears and tails are still twitching a little, but here in your shadow and on the sun-warmed grass, little Kinu has nodded straight off without a care in the world. Seems like you've discovered how to deactivate a kitsune. Now that that's taken care of, it's time to go visit her mother.
rows.translation: 哇啊！肚子被挠痒了！我已经好久没有这种感觉了！妈妈不再给我挠了——她说我年纪太大了，应该表现得更加得体一些…… 那好吧，看来就得由你来满足小绮奴的愿望了。只要她不告诉别人，应该就不会有什么问题吧。 肚子在痒啊！ 你的女儿兴奋得几乎要在当场跳起来，脸上挂着灿烂的笑容。突然间，她冲上前去，抱住了你的双腿，然后开始剧烈地颤抖起来。 快点，快点，快点！ 天啊，她这也太容易兴奋了吧？该不会又偷偷去偷桃子了吧？ 不！不！我真的真的很想要别人挠我的肚子啊！你不能先答应我会挠我的肚子，然后却又不履行这个承诺的 [kinu.Dad]这样可不好！ 哎呀。既然知道你的女儿是谁，也知道她将来会成为什么样的人，那么绮奴和她母亲有这样的弱点也就不足为奇了。好吧，好吧——你就轻轻挠挠她的肚子吧。 耶——！ 金努坏笑着松开了你的双腿，然后扑通一声躺在了地上，懒洋洋地躺在被阳轻型晒热的草地上。她的尾巴从身体下方卷曲起来，你的女儿用那双蓝色的大眼睛急切地望着你。金努用手部和尾巴一起解开了她腰间的紫色腰带，然后将布料拉开，露出了她裸露的腹部。 摸摸我吧！摸摸我吧！ 你跪下来，用手部轻轻触碰女儿的腹部，用指尖轻轻挠了挠她那轻型滑、苍白的皮肤。效果立竿见影——你的女儿露出了更加灿烂的笑容，开始在原地扭动身体，就像一条离开水面的鱼一样。当你更加认真地抚摸和挠她的肚子时，这种反应变得更加激烈了。你轻轻地将手部掌根部压在她的腹部，再用指尖继续轻轻按摩那娇嫩的皮肤。 哎呀！好痒啊！真的好痒！ 金努狂笑着，弓起背部，用自己的身体挤压你的手部指，催促你继续下去。她那三条尾巴在身下疯狂地扭动，试图抓住你的手部腕，将你拉得更靠近她。 这种感觉真是太棒了…… 确实如此。绮奴这么柔软娇嫩，她的腹部更是如此。你必须格外小心，避免不小心用力过猛，而应该用指尖轻轻、平稳地抚摸她。 当你充满爱意地抚摸她时，绮奴会发出呜咽和尖叫的声音，她的右腿会在空中乱蹬，就像一只被抚摸时兴奋地乱踢腿的狗一样。其实，它们俩并没有什么区别，对吧？当绮奴处于这种无比快乐的状态时，她真的显得非常可爱。 她玩得开心吗？ 呜呜…… 那么，你可以把这理解为一种同意吧。 渐渐地，你的女儿会在你温柔的抚触中陷入那种愉悦的状态。起初，她的耳朵会平贴在头上；接着，她的目轻型会变得呆滞，双眼也会半闭；就连她的尾巴也会停止摆动，只有偶尔才会轻微地抽动一下。 当你轻轻挠她裸露的腹部时，基努全身紧绷的肌肉都仿佛化成了黏稠的液体般松弛下来。她那娇小的身体依然在不停地动着，右腿不断地在空中蹬来蹬去。 然而，过了一会儿，这种动作也渐渐停止了。她的腿无力地垂在身体一侧，发出一声最后的呜咽，然后开始轻轻打着鼾息。 她的耳朵和尾巴还在微微抽动，但在这里，在你的荫蔽下，躺在被阳轻型照暖的草地上，小绮奴已经安心地睡着了，完全没有任何烦恼。 看来你已经知道如何让一只狐妖安静下来了。 现在既然 那就是 事情已经处理妥当了，是时候去看看她的母亲了。
rows.raw: " "Waaaah! A tummy tickle! I haven't had one of those for soooo long! Mama won't give me any more — she says I'm too old for those, that I have to act with some level of propriety..." Well then. Seems like it's up to you to indulge little Kinu. So long as she doesn't tell anyone, everything should be just fine. "A tummy tickle!" Your daughter is practically bubbling over on the spot with sheer excitement, a stupid, toothy grin plastered all over her face. Without warning, she darts forward, hugs both of your legs, and starts vibrating intensely. "C'monc'monc'monc'mon!" Gods, is she excitable. Has she been pilfering peaches on the sly again? "No! No! I just really really wanna a tummy tickle! You can't tease me by promising tummy tickles and not making good on the promise, [kinu.Dad]! It's not nice!" Sheesh. Although knowing who your daughter is and what she's going to become in the future, it really shouldn't be surprising that Kinu shares this weakness with her mother. All right, all right — you'll give her a tummy tickle. "Yaaaaaaaaaay!" Grinning impishly, Kinu lets go of your legs and flops down on the ground, lounging lazily on the sun-warmed grass. Tails curling up around her from underneath, your daughter looks up at you eagerly with big blue eyes. With the help of hands and tails alike, Kinu undoes the purple sash about her midriff, then open the fabric so her bare midriff is exposed. "Pet me! Pet me!" You kneel down, reach for Kinu's tummy, then tickle the smooth, pale skin with a few light strokes of your fingertips. The effect is instantaneous — your daughter's big, stupid smile only gets wider, and she starts wriggling and flopping on the spot like a fish out of water. It only gets more intense as you start petting and tickling her tummy in earnest, lightly planting the heels of your palms into her midriff and pushing into the delicate skin with your fingertips. "Eeeee! It tickles! It tickles!" Giggling madly, Kinu arches her back and pushes herself against your fingers, urging you to go on. Her three tails writhe about madly under her, trying to grab hold of your wrists and draw you closer to her. "It feels soooo good..." Quite so. Kinu is such a soft and delicate thing, and her tummy is doubly so. You have to carefully restrain yourself from accidentally pushing down too hard on your daughter, instead settling for broad, flowing strokes with your fingertips. Kinu whimpers and yips as you shower her with loving affection, her right leg kicking at the air like a dog thumping its leg while being petted. The two really aren't that different, are they? Kinu's really quite foxy when she gets into this hopelessly happy state. Is she enjoying herself? "Mrrrrhhh..." You'll take that as a yes, then. Bit by bit, your daughter succumbs to melty bliss as she wallows in the warmth of your touch. First her ears droop flat against her head, then her gaze grows unfocused and her eyes half-lidded, and even her tails fall still save for the occasional twitch. All the tension in Kinu's body turns into syrupy ooze as you scratch her exposed tummy, her petite body still save for the steady thumping of her right leg kicking away at the air. In time, though, even that comes to a stop, her leg falling limply to the side as she lets out one final whimper and starts to snore softly. Her ears and tails are still twitching a little, but here in your shadow and on the sun-warmed grass, little Kinu has nodded straight off without a care in the world. Seems like you've discovered how to deactivate a kitsune. Now that that's taken care of, it's time to go visit her mother."

rows.original: Kinu squeals and bows her head as she sees you reaching for her, clearly expecting to be petted between the ears. What she gets, though, are your fingertips as they brush aside the soft white hair and fur that lies over her brow, gathering up her bangs between your fingers into something pettable. Your daughter lives up to her namesake as her silky smooth fur flows through your grasp, faint traces of warmth tickling your touch as you roll her hair between thumb and forefinger. "Ah! [kinu.Dad]..." Kinu's excited expression turns into a sheepish smile, her perky ears starting to curl and flatten against her head. Unbidden, her eye on the side you're petting closes, although the other still has its mischievous attention on you. "Ehe..." From there, you slide your touch down the side of Kinu's hairline to her cheek, allowing her hair to fall away through your fingers. Once more, you're reminded of why Kiyoko named your daughter such — her face is adorably soft as you pet it, cheekbone to chin and back again. Back and forth, back and forth, until Kinu's cheeks have grown warm and color's risen into them. Eyes closed, ears twitching, Kinu nuzzles aggressively against your hand, a big, stupid smile on your foxy daughter's face as she luxuriates in the joy of wholesome human contact. There, there. There's no need to think too deeply — for a moment, she can just forget about the responsibilities of being [kiyoko.numKits 2|Big Sister|her mother's daughter] and relax. "I-if it means I can get petted like this every time you visit, [kinu.Dad]..." If she'll be good and obey her mother when you're not around. "I-I will!" Kinu is practically leaning into your touch now, her eyelids aflutter, her three tails wrapped about her legs as if trying to keep her from falling over. Little soft yips escape her lips, not too unlike that of a fox kit, and for a moment you see your kitsune daughter's silhouette shiver, as if she were having trouble keeping her human form intact. That's a sign that you should probably stop before Kinu loses it altogether — you finish up the petting with a final noogie to her brow, eliciting a sigh of satisfaction as she melts onto the grassy ground and curls up into a squirmy ball of white fur and fluff. "[kinu.Dad]..." There, there. There's a good girl. Now that Kinu's satisfied and out of the way, it's time to go and see her mother.
rows.translation: 当金看到你伸出手来时，她发出了吱吱的叫声，然后低下了头，显然期待着你能抚摸她的耳朵。然而，你触到的是她柔软的白毛——那些覆盖在她的眉毛上的毛发被你的指尖轻轻拨开，你的手指将她的一绺刘海聚拢起来，这样她就成了一个适合被抚摸的对象。你的女儿果然名不虚传，她那丝滑柔顺的毛发在你手中流动，当你用拇指和食指轻轻揉搓她的头发时，那种微妙的温暖感让你的触觉感到十分愉悦。 啊！ [kinu.Dad]..." 纪奈原本兴奋的表情立刻变成了害羞的微笑，她那灵活的耳朵也开始弯曲起来，然后贴在脑袋上。不知不觉中，你正在抚摸的那一侧的眼睛闭上了，而另一只眼睛却依然调皮地盯着你。 嘿嘿…… 从那里开始，你将手指沿着绮奴的发际线滑向她的脸颊，让她的头发从你的指缝间垂落下来。此刻，你再次明白了为什么清子会给你们的女儿取这样的名字——当你轻轻抚摸她的脸庞时，你会觉得她的皮肤柔软得令人心生喜爱，从颧骨到下巴，每一处都是如此。 来来回回，反复不已，直到纪奈的脸颊变得通红，颜色逐渐加深。她闭着眼睛，耳朵微微抽动，用头拼命蹭着你的手。你那聪明伶俐的女儿脸上露出了灿烂的笑容，她正尽情享受这种温暖而亲密的人与人之间的互动带来的快乐。 好了好了，没必要想得太复杂——暂时，她完全可以忘记自己所承担的责任。 [kiyoko.numKits 2|姐姐|她母亲的女儿] 放松下来吧。 如果这意味着每次你来访的时候我都能得到这样的抚摸 [kinu.Dad]..." 要是你不在的时候，她能听话、服从她妈妈的话就好了。 我、我会的！ 现在，绮奴几乎完全依赖你的触碰来保持平衡，她的眼皮不停地颤动，三条尾巴紧紧缠绕在她的腿上，仿佛在努力防止她摔倒。她嘴里不时发出轻柔的叫声，听起来简直就像一只小狐妖。有那么一瞬间，你仿佛看到你那只狐妖女儿的身影在微微颤抖，仿佛她正在努力维持自己的人类形态。 这是个信号，说明你最好在绮奴彻底失控之前停下来吧——你最后轻轻揉了揉她的额头，她满意地叹了口气，然后瘫软在草地上，蜷缩成一团白色的毛球。 "[kinu.Dad]..." 好了好了，真是个乖女孩。现在绮奴已经满足了，也没有再惹麻烦了，是时候去看看她的妈妈了。

rows.original: "You want to play with me? Hooray! I like playing with me, too! Sometimes it's best to play alone or just with another person; then if that person knows you're choosing to share your time with only them, they feel special! Like I am now! So, what do you want to play, [kinu.Dad]?"
rows.translation: 你想和我一起玩吗？太好了！我也喜欢和你一起玩！有时候，独自玩或者只和一个人一起玩会更好；因为如果那个人知道你特意选择和他们共度时光，他们会觉得自己很特别！就像我现在这样！那么，你想玩什么呢？ [kinu.Dad]?"
rows.raw: "\n \"You want to play with me? Hooray! I like playing with me, too! Sometimes it's best to play alone or just with another person; then if that person knows you're choosing to share your time with only them, they feel special! Like I am now! So, what do you want to play, [kinu.Dad]?\""

rows.original: All right. It's time to make your little foxy daughter even more saccharine sweet by filling her up with delicious, wholesome fruit. What do you have in mind today?
rows.translation: 好了，是时候用美味又健康的水果来让你的小狐狸女儿变得更加甜美可爱了。今天你打算准备些什么水果呢？
rows.raw: "\n    All right. It's time to make your little foxy daughter even more saccharine sweet by filling her up with delicious, wholesome fruit. What do you have in mind today?"

rows.original: Hmm. You're not one for sitting around today, so why don't the both of you go out into the woods that surround the hill? She can show you all the things in that enchanted forest that she's discovered while you're gone, perhaps get some exercise while you're about it. You spend so much time with Kiyoko when you do come and visit her in the astral plane; exploring the rest of this pocket dimension with a little guide at your side would be quite the treat. "Okay! Come with me, [kinu.Dad] — I'm going to show you something really cool!" Without waiting for a reply, Kinu takes hold of one of your hands and starts tugging insistently, making a beeline for the forest's edge. Your foxy daughter leads you down trails and over roots, practically bouncing along like she's had one too many peaches. Come to think of it, she probably has... [var3|The both of you end up by the bank of a rocky river, its channel wide and flat, the water clear and sluggish. Barefoot as always, Kinu wades out into middle without so much as a thought, the water coming up to her waist. "See, [kinu.Dad]? There are fish in here! Most of them aren't really big enough to be eaten on their own, but if you take them home and pound them whole into fish paste they go really well on rice! Especially when you mix them with onions and ginger! You don't even need to gut them!" Mm. You notice she's got nothing to fish with, though. Kinu beams. "You catch them by hand, that's what makes it so fun! C'mon, give it a try!" As you watch, your daughter rolls up her sleeves, stoops down into the water and turns into a predator, albeit a small and fuzzy one. Looking every part of the fox kit on the prowl, her big blue eyes watch the waters intently, her hands hidden beneath the surface. And then, lightning-quick, the waters foam, and — "Hee hee! Look! Look!" Wriggling about in Kinu's cupped hands is a small, silvery fish, no bigger than your thumb. "See? All you have to do is be faster than they are! C'mon, I'll show you!" You spend the next couple of hours wading about in the shallows with Kinu, your daughter trying to teach you the fine art of hand fishing. [var0|While you try your best under Kinu's patient guidance and even manage to land a few catches here and there, most of your attempts come up empty-handed. The fish are just too quick for you — you're just not trained for this kind of thing. "Don't worry, [kinu.Dad]," Kinu reassures you with a pat on your side. "I get that you don't do this often, and that's okay. Being with you is still lots of fun!" Aww, cripes. You think you just got something in your eye... |[var1|Even for someone who doesn't do this often, you make a fairly good showing, landing more than a dozen small fish over the course of those two hours. Kinu is a slow and patient teacher, pointing out your mistakes and giving you encouragement where warranted; every now and then, you step back to see her demonstrate how to flip one of the river fish out of the water. While it's true that you don't have the natural agility and reflexes she has, her tutelage makes you feel as if you're truly accomplishing something. "See? See? Nothing to it! I've got a cloth with me; we can wrap all this up and take it home to Mama! Then out comes the salt, the mortar and the pestle, and we'll have so much fun! Not immediately, though — I'm all wet and my fingers and toes are wrinkly." |Unsurprisingly, you take to this little exercise like a fox-girl to sweet peaches, and are flipping little fishies out of the water and into your hands in no time at all. Kinu hangs around you for a little while to make sure you've got the technique down right, but soon splashes off to do her own hand fishing when she's sure you've got things down pat. By the time the two hours are up, you've managed to gather quite the pile of freshwater anchovies between the two of you. Stepping out of the river shallows, Kinu shakes herself dry, then wraps the lot in a cloth. "Wow, you're really good at this, [kinu.Dad]!" Guess you're just a natural, eh? "I'm going to have to take this home to Mama. We'll pound them and put the lot on hot rice tomorrow, and it's going to taste great!" ]] |Eventually, the trees part into a wide forest clearing, sunlight pouring in from the clear blue sky; the scents of several different species of blossoms greets you as you step into the knee-high grasses with Kinu at your side. Indeed, a spread of color unfurls before your eyes as you take in the sight, a small pond in the middle of the clearing serving as its centerpiece. "Isn't this amazing? I need to get some flowers for my flower arrangement lessons with Mama tomorrow. Since it's for my education and all..." Should you help her? "Umm... not really. I don't know very much about flower arrangement yet, but Mama says it's important to carefully remove them so they stay alive for as long as possible when we put them in vases. I just want you to watch me and take in this place, [kinu.Dad] — for some reason, this is so much more fun when you're around!" If she says so, but you're not going to let your hands go idle, either. While Kinu scampers off into the flower field, you find a large mossy log and take a seat. Kiyoko may be teaching your daughter about blossoms from the perspective of her culture, but that doesn't mean you can't do the same. There, these'll serve as a pretty decent base... maybe a few of these... and a dash of color with these, too... Time passes, and you're just about done when Kinu returns, a large bunch of flowers in her hands. She's dirty, she's sweaty, there're grass stains on her knees and clothes, and you suspect she might have waded out into the pond at least once. But then again, she wouldn't be Kinu if she didn't do all these things. "Ta-daaaaah!" Your little fox-daughter shoves the impromptu bouquet in your face. "This looks great! I don't know their meaning, but they look great nevertheless!" Indeed, they do. And while she was gone, you made something for her. See? As Kinu tilts her head up, you plonk the flower crown you made straight on her brow, using her large fox ears to hold it firmly in place. She squirms a little, but discomfort soon gives way to hyperactive excitement as she scoots over to the pond to look at her reflection in the water. "Eeeee! This is really great, [kinu.Dad], and it smells sooo nice on my head! How do you get the flowers to hold together like that? All the flowers look really good against my fur!" Ha, you're just glad that she likes it well enough. It's not the best, since it's only what you could cook up on a moment's notice, but anything you put on your darling daughter is going to look great. "Hee hee, I love being praised! Now I gotta repay you! Gonna give you a great big hug, and there's nothing you can do about it!" Kinu is good to her word, the little kitsune flumphing against you and squeezing your legs with her little arms. Petals fall from the flowers she's picked and from the crown on her brow, but she holds on until she's finally satisfied. "Maybe we should be heading back now, [kinu.Dad]. You still have to visit Mama before the day is out, right?" Yeah... and she has to show off her flower crown to everyone while the blooms are at their best. "Hee hee!" |So, where are you going this time? "To find some bees! Wild honey is great, but I'm not tall enough to reach hives in trees... if I stood on your shoulders, though, I could totally get to them! I spotted a few good ones some days ago, and have been itching to get at the honey... and then you come along, [kinu.Dad]!" [pc.bg hunter barbarian|You nod; you've had to do this a couple of times yourself out in the wilds as [a] [pc.background]. While it's not without its dangers — getting stung by a swarm of angry bees being only one of them — wild honey's pretty great. Besides, Kinu's a smart girl, and you'll be here to supervise her every step of the way. Now this is the kind of education that your daughter won't be getting from Kiyoko. |You're not entirely sure about this. Isn't she worried about being stung? Kinu looks up at you incredulously. "Stung? Me? Don't be silly, [kinu.Dad]. Oh, I got stung the first dozen times I tried raiding beehives, but I'm pretty confident in my abilities now. Just help me, okay?" The first dozen times? "I think there's a saying, something along the lines of 'nothing worth doing was ever easy?' Anyways, wild honeycomb is totally worth it, and besides, you're here! You'll keep me safe, won't you [kinu.Dad]?" Well, your daughter seems to know what she's doing, and she's right in saying that she isn't just any old fox kit. Besides, this is the kind of education that she won't be getting from her mother... ...You're probably going to regret this, aren't you? ] "Here! Here we are! I saw this one yesterday, but I couldn't reach it!" You look up at where Kinu's pointing, and indeed, there's a hive on one of the lowest boughs of a nearby pine tree, sticking out like the gills of a fish or some kind of gigantic fungus. Sequestered in the crook between bough and trunk, the support both have afforded has allowed the hive to grow to considerable proportions, though still well out of Kinu's reach; the buzzing of bees is deafening even at this distance, and your daughter gives you a big, maddened, and above all, mischievous grin. "Isn't it great? It's really big, and there's so much exposed honeycomb!" And there're so many bees. At least they're bees, and she didn't mistake a wasp's nest for a hive... "Just gotta find some pine needles! Help me, [kinu.Dad]?" Looks like there's no backing out now. The two of you scrounge about in the forest underbrush for a while, collecting some dry deadwood and handfuls of pine needles. Kinu is quick on her feet and even quicker with her hands, taking the deadwood from you and lashing the needles to them with long blades of grass to fashion a long-handled smokestick. [pc.bg hunter barbarian|Looking at her work away, you can't help but feel your heart swell with pride. Your daughter might take after her mother in appearance, but she's [a] [pc.background] at heart; it's nice to see once more that Kinu inherited your spirit, if not your appearance. |Seeing her work with practiced ease, you relax a little. At least this clearly isn't the first time your daughter's done this, although it does raise some questions as to whether her mother knows she's been raiding beehives... ] A snap of your daughter's fingers, and a gout of pale blue foxfire washes over the smokestick's tip, setting it alight. A moment's concentration, another snap of her fingers, and a gentle breeze starts up in the direction of the beehive. "Okay, [kinu.Dad]! This is where teamwork is important — I need to stand on your shoulders so I can smoke out the hive and get us some honeycomb! You ready?" As ready as she'll ever be. You crouch down, and Kinu scrambles up your back and onto your shoulders. It's a bit of a balancing act, but she's a little fox and pretty light to boot; with your hands on her calves and her natural agility, she's able to keep upright while you start at a brisk walk towards the hive, all three of her tails looped under your arms for extra support. "Slowly does it, [kinu.Dad]. No need for any sudden moves. Just act natural." [pc.bg hunter barbarian|Oh, you know. This might not be her first time doing this, but neither is it yours. Although you do have to wonder if wild honey here tastes different from that of the waking world... |Act natural, she says. Easier said than done, especially when there're so many of the little terrors buzzing about you. ] "Oh-kay. We're almost there. Almost there..." You don't dare to look up, but ahead of you, Kinu lets the thick, roiling clouds of white smoke emanating from the end of her smoke stick to envelop most of the beehive, allowing the smoke to stew for about a minute before making her next move. Working deftly, she draws a small knife from the folds of her yukata, eyes the beehive through the smoke, then slices deeply and pries loose a section of honeycomb as long as her forearm. You're half-expecting either of you to be stung at any moment, but no sharp pinpricks of pain come to assail you or Kinu. As the smoke begins to clear, you see the bees clustered about their hive, still seemingly placated; a few buzz angrily in the air, but aren't up for pressing an attack. "See? That wasn't so bad." Kinu lets go of you, hops off your shoulders, and does a little somersault in the air before landing on her feet with a flourish. She stomps out the smokestick on the soft forest soil, then presents the filched honeycomb for your approval. "It's called teamwork!" My, that's a pretty big one. "And I couldn't have done it without you, [kinu.Dad]. Come on, let's go find someplace where we can wash this, then I'll open it up!" So it comes to pass that the two of you wind up by the shallows of a forest stream; Kinu washes off bits of wax from the comb, then splits it in half with her knife and cuts off the top. Ears wiggling, a big smile on her face, your kitsune daughter presents you with your share of the spoils. "Ta-daaaah! You've got to love this stuff. It's light and tasty without being cloyingly sweet like candies are! You can really taste the flowers in them — that's why I only cut off a bit of the comb each time, so that the bees don't move away and there's always more to be had!" Right, that's pretty forward-looking of her. [pc.bg hunter barbarian|Well, no time like the present, then. You've had wild honey before, but somehow this particular comb promises to be much better than most you've sampled in the past. Maybe it's because your daughter worked so hard to get it for you... Yeah, that's probably why it smells so great. "I want to do this again sometime, [kinu.Dad]. Standing on your shoulders makes me feel really tall! I can get to so many places I couldn't before... the possibilities are endless!" |One thing, though. It does smell pretty great, but is it okay to eat the honey straight from the comb? She did wash it in the stream, but... "Well... I could go home with it and put it through Mama's sieve, but then she'd notice and make me share. Also, it loses some of its flavor and becomes thicker, and I don't like that. I kinda prefer surprises in my honeycomb! "Don't worry about it, though, you won't get sick or anything. Did you know you can put honey on bandages, and they'll stop the wound from getting infected? I read that in one of Mama's books!" ] Mm-mm-mm. Without further ado, Kinu tears into the honeycomb with undisguised glee, her three tails curled about herself as she empties the beeswax cells of their precious contents. Sweet wild honey gets all over the little kitsune's face, chin and fingers as she polishes off the lot, getting everything all sticky. Despite all this, your daughter is deliriously happy as she savours her spoils, polishing off the last of the honey with her tongue and sucking on her fingers to get as much of it into her as possible. While you know she's not usually a fan of sweet things, the light, fruity aroma of the honey has clearly changed her mind. You have to admit it's good. There's a little bit of loose beeswax here and there and some of the honey has crystallised, but it's still pretty tasty. The point that no one really needs to eat here pipes up in the back of your mind, but that isn't the point — the point is spending a lovely time out here with your hyperactive rapscallion of a foxy daughter. "Did you want the rest of that, [kinu.Dad]?" Naaah, you'll be having it all. You worked as hard as she did for it. "Okie! Just give me the leftover comb so I can wash it out, there's plenty of stuff you can do with beeswax!" By the way she's looking, she ought to wash herself out as well. Kiyoko's going to be pretty mad if she turns up on the doorstep all sweet-smelling and sticky. "Hee hee!" |Where does she intend to take you this time? Any good sights of late? As far as you can understand it, the forest is practically infinite — yet whenever you want to return to the cherry blossom tree, it's never more than a few dozen paces away... "We're going to be picking mushrooms! A certain kind, in fact." Oh? What kind? "Do you know what a matsutake is, [kinu.Dad]?" [pc.bg hunter barbarian|As Kinu rattles off the description to you, realization slowly dawns: you do know this mushroom. The ones that grow in the Frost Marches have white caps instead of the brown ones your daughter is describing, but are edible enough, and they certainly don't have the aromatic scent that's got Kinu so excited. Either way, they should be pretty safe, you think — it's not as if anything you eat here counts as real, right? |As you listen to Kinu excitedly rattle off the description, a small worm of doubt finds its way into your mind: eating wild mushrooms isn't generally the best of ideas, or at least that's what you've always been told. Nevertheless, your daughter is a smart cookie, and seems to know what she's doing. Trusting her should be fine, right? Oh well, it's not as if anything you eat here is for real, isn't it? Could you even get sick from dream food? Every time you've had a meal with Kiyoko, that's never carried into the waking world... ] "...You find them about the roots of pines! I'll show you! They're supposed to be really seasonal, but Mama kinda controls things here, so they pop up every so often! Then we'll get lots and lots of them, cook up some for ourselves, then give the rest to Mama! Isn't that amazing?" You ruffle Kinu's hair and tickle her ears. She is really excited about some mushrooms, isn't she? "Ehehe. They're really good. Mama likes to slice them and cook them with rice, but I prefer them roasted over a fire. I think food tastes better when it's more natural, [kinu.Dad]." So long as that doesn't mean she's eating her food raw... or at least, that which isn't meant to be eaten raw. "Okay! We're here! We're here!" Indeed, here you are. Tall, thick-rooted pines tower above this section of the forest; judging by the looks of them, if they were real they'd have to be centuries old to get this big. Kinu hops excitedly from dirt mound to dirt mound, then drops to her hands and knees and starts crawling away from the trail and into the underbrush. Nose to the ground, tails swishing behind her, Kinu clambers over roots and across soft mats of old pine needles, scrounging in the dirt and getting stains all over her yukata. Pick up the trail yet? "Ssh! I'm concentrating!" This goes on for perhaps five more minutes, Kinu's face a mask of absolute seriousness as she crawls all over the forest floor in a winding, snaking pattern. Just when you start wondering if she's going to get anywhere, your daughter pounces on one particular spot that doesn't seem any different from any other, then starts digging through dirt and old pine needles with her bare hands. "It's here! It's here! Come and see, [kinu.Dad]!" Now you see it too — a rounded cap amidst the underbrush, poking its way out of the soft forest soil. With all the utmost care of a mother tending to her newborn, Kinu unearths the mushroom, digging away at the surrounding dirt with her fingers until she's exposed enough of the treat to wrench it free. "Hee hee, this is great! Look! Look!" Grinning madly, Kinu holds up the mushroom for you to see. Long and thin, a pale brown cap veined with white — even freshly dug from the earth, you can smell it[pc.ra lupine|, and what a scent it is to your lupine nose. Whatever else you might call it, it's strong; there's little doubt that you'd be able to track this kind of scent pretty well|]. "Now it's your turn to hunt for matsutake, [kinu.Dad]! I'll help you! I've got a good nose, after all!" [pc.bg hunter barbarian|Oh, you're game. If the brown-capped variety is anything like the white-capped one, then this shouldn't be too hard. Besides, you've got your floofy, squishy daughter at your side helping you, right? |All right, all right. This sort of thing isn't exactly what you were raised to do, but you're willing to give it a go for your floofy daughter. Besides, she loves showing off how much she knows about things, right? Perfect for her to flaunt her knowledge of mushroom hunting. ] Under Kinu's direction, you follow her lead, getting down on all fours to creep close to the forest floor like what she's doing. [pc.ra lupine|It feels a little silly to be doing this, but then again, it's for a good cause. Now that you've scented what that mushroom smells like, though, it's hard to miss it. Earthy, spicy, not altogether unlike cinnamon in some respects — lupines are great at catching scents, and you're no exception. Before long, you're ahead of Kinu, pushing aggressively through the underbrush in search of the source of the scent. "Where are you going, [kinu.Dad]?" Ssh! You're concentrating! Kinu gets the hint and falls silent, following along behind as you track down your quarry. It's getting closer and closer, and... yes, there, behind that fallen log! "Oh! Oh! I smell it too!" Kinu doesn't need any encouragement, scampering forward and pushing at the log with all her might. It shifts, it moves, and she scrounges about in the dirt until she's unearthed a pine mushroom as long as your hand. So, how'd you do? "Not bad, not bad! You have a really good nose, [kinu.Dad]!" Aw, shucks. So, who's got the better sense of smell, the fox or the hound? "We'll see! Since you clearly don't need me to teach you anything, we'll see who can get more, okay?" The two of you spend the next hour or so rooting about in the shadow of the pine trees, covering a pretty wide swathe as you uncover more mushrooms, large, firm, and with that heady aroma that Kinu promises is a harbinger of delectable things to come. Between your nose and hers, you manage to fill your daughter's pockets with all manner of sharp-smelling pine mushrooms. "'Eehee! Guess I can't beat you, [kinu.Dad]. Truth be told, I'm kinda jealous of your nose..." You smile and ruffle Kinu's hair. She's not half bad herself. "Guess we ought to be heading home now. You still have to visit Mama before you go, right? I have to put all of these matsutake down and wash them, too — watch out for me the next time you come visit, okay? We'll roast them up and have a feast!" Of course, of course. There's a good girl. |[pc.bg hunter barbarian|Your time as [a] [pc.background] meant that you'd have to live off the land in the past, and this isn't even amongst the top three awkward things you've done in order to bring home dinner. Although there is something to be said for food you don't have to clean the dirt off of before cooking... "Smell anything, [kinu.Dad]?" Not really — you don't have a nose like hers. Nevertheless, you can make an educated guess from what you know of forestry and wilderness survival; mushrooms and fungi all share some basic needs, and combined with what she's told you about these matsutake mushrooms and their habits, you can use your time and energy in the most efficient manner. At this point, Kinu has fallen largely silent, watching your movements intently as you go about your search. Now this is another way to get an education, instead of sitting around with books and scrolls all day. Aha. Now that spot in the shade of that tall pine... still on all fours, you shuffle over and brush away some rotting bark and old pine needles. Barely have you begun when that same spicy smell greets you, and Kinu rushes over to dig up your find while you stand and dust your hands off. "Ha-ha! You're really great, [kinu.Dad]! Of course, I knew it was there, but I wouldn't have if it weren't for my nose." Say, why don't the two of you work together? You can look out for likely spots and direct her to them, and she can check them out without needing to go to all the trouble of clearing or digging. Teamwork, it's called. "Teamwork!" Without skipping a beat, Kinu's face is down to the ground once more, sniffing away as she crawls forward through the underbrush. She really is like a little fox, isn't she? Between the two of you, though, you have a grand old time; with you surveying the surroundings and Kinu checking out particular locales, squeezing into cramped spots with her petite form, it's easy to cover a wide swathe of forest. Between your daughter's nose and energy and your own experience, it's not long before you've filled the pockets of her yukata to bulging with spicy-smelling pine mushrooms. "This is great!" Kinu says as she finally gets to her feet, stained and dirty all over. "We picked so many today!" Mm-hm. She should be sure to give them some time to recover on their own, or there probably won't be as many the next time she comes around. Then she'll have to ask her mother to do something about it, and that would be awkward, wouldn't it? "Ehe..." You smile and ruffle Kinu's hair. Come now, it's about time you started heading back — she has to put down her find, and you have to go see her mother. |[var2|While this isn't exactly what you thought you'd be doing with your life, it's always good to try new things, right? Kinu's excitement is palpable as she shepherds you between the tall pines, stopping every now and then to explain the intricacies of mushroom hunting to you. "You have to watch out for the squirrels, they're sneaky little thieves. They won't just eat the matsutake out of the ground, but leave your find alone for a bit and they'll come down from the trees and try to steal them. That's why I always know where the nearest pine cone is; that way I can shoo them off at a distance. I can hit them pretty often!" [pc.isDK|There's your girl — nailing those nasty, thieving squirrels! Little fuzzy bastards getting what's coming to them.|Well, when you look at it from the squirrels' point of view, she's the one stealing the mushrooms from their forest.] Really makes one think, doesn't it? Kinu sticks her tongue out at you. "We should have a throwing competition sometime, [kinu.Dad]. But for now..." Yes, but for now, what's that over there? Your daughter's gaze follows your pointed finger, and then she stops and sniffs the air. "Hey, you're right, [kinu.Dad]! C'mon, c'mon!" Without waiting for so much as a reply, Kinu breaks away from you, hops over a rotting log, and bounds over to the spot you pointed out. Her face a mask of furious concentration, Kinu grubs about in the dirt, digging with her fingers until she pulls out a long-stalked mushroom from the cool earth. "Ta-daaaah!" Hey, that one's pretty big. "So it is! You have pretty good eyes, [kinu.Dad]! Almost as good as mine!" Almost as good, she says? Why, whose side of the family does she think she got that amazing eyesight from? "Ehehe. C'mon, then — let's go find some more! With two pairs of amazing eyes and my nose, we'll be unstoppable!" The next hour or so is filled with all sorts of dirty, earthy fun with Kinu. You'd never thought mushroom hunting would be your sort of thing, but having a bouncy, noisy eight-year old kitsune child along with you makes it all worthwhile — Kinu is clearly the more experienced one at this, but your eyes are sharp enough for you to make a good number of finds on your own. Eventually, the two of you gather enough pine mushrooms to fill Kinu's pockets, and the both of you are quite thoroughly stained all over with what the forest has to offer. "This looks pretty good, [kinu.Dad]," Kinu says as she unloads her haul onto a mossy, flat-topped rock and counts the mushrooms one by one before packing them away. "I'll have to take them home and wash them, of course, but it shouldn't be more than a day or two before I can have them ready to be roasted. You'll be there too, right?" Uh... "I know you're busy out there trying to save everyone, so it doesn't matter if you're too busy," Kinu continues, her ears turning downwards. "But I would really, really like it if you'd drop by the next time you visit, okay? Will you keep that in mind, [kinu.Dad]?" Oh all right, you will. In the meantime, you should probably be taking her home. You still need to see her mother before your time here is up, after all. |You've little doubt that you look quite silly bumbling about like this, and that feeling soon turns to embarrassment at how well your daughter is doing in spite of you. Kinu practically bounds from spot to spot on the soft carpet of dirt and dry pine needles, pouncing on suspicious heaps, and when she does find one of those coveted mushrooms, running up to present it to you with pride. Untrained and with none of the natural advantages that Kinu has, mushroom hunting is more easily said than done. This is your daughter's world — and you're more aware than ever that it isn't yours. Yet being invited to play with her in it, if only for a little while... it makes it all worth it? "Look, [kinu.Dad]! I found another one!" Kinu races up to you with a long, thick brown-capped mushroom in her hands, fresh dirt still on it. "Aren't I amazing?" Mm-hm. She sure is a clever girl. Truth be told, you're not sure if you're just weighing her down. Your daughter preens at the praise, ears twitching all the while. "Ehe... I don't mind, [kinu.Dad]. Just having you watch me makes me want to do my best... so you're still helping, even if you don't manage to find any matsutake!" Gods, when did she learn to be so sweet and adorable? "I mean, it's fun to go out into the forest and play, but it's always more fun when you play together with someone else. Mama can't come out with me all the time since she's so busy, but you'll do just as well!" You sigh and ruffle Kinu's hair, eliciting a happy squeal from your daughter. Yeah... she's right. Out of the mouths of babes, as the saying goes. "Don't worry, [kinu.Dad]. Even if you're not very good at it, matsutake hunting is still fun, and I'll help you! I'm a good helper!" Your daughter is good to her word. Even though you're content to step back and leave the bulk of the work to her, Kinu urges you forward through the underbrush with all the eagerness of a bright-eyed puppy. She sniffs out each hidden mushroom, lets you dig out the firm, earthy prize, then the both of you take turns savouring the unique spicy, cinnamon-like aroma of these brown-capped pine mushrooms before she tucks them away into her yukata. "It's okay to not know things," Kinu explains as she sniffs about clumps of old pine cones and needles alike. "I wasn't born knowing very much, either. If you won't admit to yourself that you don't know things, then you won't learn anything, so there's nothing wrong with that. Watch and learn, [kinu.Dad]!" You get the feeling she's relishing the chance to show off as much as you are in watching her, but who's complaining? It's a nice walk in the woods with your kitsune daughter, having a leisurely chat with her, and feeling the cool dirt on your fingers as you dig up her next prize... Gods, how long has it been? An hour? Two? You still need to visit Kiyoko before your time's up, and Kinu is thoroughly dirty and scruffy at this point. Perhaps it's time to head back. "All right, [kinu.Dad]. I didn't get as many as I'd hoped to, but it's all right because I got to spend time with you! Look, once I get these matsutake all washed up and prepared you can come look for me, okay? Then we can roast them up and have a feast! It should only take a day or two, please tell me you can come! I know you're really busy, but..." Unf. It's hard not to say yes to Kinu and her big blue eyes... all right, you'll see what you can do, but she should go ahead if you don't manage to visit soon. No point in letting the mushrooms spoil. "Yaaaaaay!" ] ] ] ]
rows.translation: 嗯，你今天似乎不太适合待在屋里，那么你们俩为什么不一起去山周围的森林里走走呢？在她不在你的时候，她可以带你看看那片神奇森林里她发现的所有有趣的东西，你们也可以顺便锻炼一下身体。每次你去星界拜访清子时，你们都会花很多时间在一起；现在有她这个向导陪着你探索这个小维度世界，肯定也会是一段很愉快的经历吧。 好的！跟我来吧。 [kinu.Dad] 我打算给你们展示一些非常酷的东西！ 不等你回答，绮奴就抓住你的手部，开始坚持不懈地拉着你，径直朝着森林边缘走去。你那个调皮的女儿带着你穿过小径，跨过树根，一路上蹦蹦跳跳的，仿佛吃了太多桃子一样开心。仔细想想，她很可能确实吃了不少桃子…… [var3|你们俩最终来到了一条多岩石的河流岸边。这条河的河道宽阔而平坦，河水清澈且流动缓慢。像往常一样，绮奴赤脚走进河中，毫不犹豫地走到河中央，水已经淹到了她的腰部。 看， [kinu.Dad]这里面有鱼！虽然大多数鱼体型都不大，不适合单独食用，但如果你把它们带回家，把整个鱼捣成鱼泥，用来搭配米饭的话，味道会非常美味！尤其是再加入洋葱和生姜一起烹饪的话！其实甚至不需要把鱼的内脏取出来呢！ 嗯，不过你注意到她根本没有什么可以利用的东西吧。 绮奴开心地笑了起来。 用手部去抓它们，这才是这么有趣的地方啊！来吧，试试看吧！ 你看着女儿卷起袖子，蹲进水里，然后变成了一只捕食者——尽管只是一只体型小巧、毛茸茸的小捕食者。她仔细观察着水中每一处可能藏有猎物的地方，那双大大的蓝眼睛紧紧地注视着水面，双手部则隐藏在水下。紧接着，快如闪电，水面上泛起了泡沫，而—— 嘻嘻！看啊！看啊！ 在基努的双手部捧合之中，有一条小小的、银色的鱼在游来游去，它的体型不会比你的拇指大。 看吧？你只需要比他们动作更快就行了！来吧，我教你！ 接下来的几个小时，你和女儿绮奴一起在浅水区里摸索着学习手部工捕鱼的技巧。你的女儿一直在努力教你这个本领。 [var0|在绮奴耐心指导下，你虽然竭尽全力，也确实偶尔抓到了几条鱼，但大多数尝试都以失败告终。那些鱼实在太快了——你显然没有接受过针对这种情况的训练。 别担心， [kinu.Dad]," 基努轻拍着你的肩膀，让你放心。 我明白你并不经常这样做，不过这也没关系。和你在一起依然非常开心！ 哎呀，天哪。你以为只是眼睛里进了什么东西而已…… |[var1|即使对于一个不经常做这种事情的人来说，你的表现也已经相当不错了——在那两个小时里，你捕获了十几条小鱼。绮奴是一位耐心细致的老师，她会指出你的错误，并在适当的时候给予鼓励；偶尔，你也会退后一步，观看她演示如何将河里的鱼抓出来。虽然你确实没有她那样的天生敏捷性和反应速度，但她的指导让你觉得自己真的在取得进步。 看吧？真的没什么大不了的！我带了块布，我们可以把这一切包起来，带回家给妈妈看！然后我们再拿出盐、研钵和杵来，一定会玩得很开心！不过现在还不行——我全身都湿透了，手指和脚趾也都皱巴巴的。 |毫不奇怪，你对待这个小游戏的态度就像狐狸姑娘对待甜桃子一样热情洋溢，很快就轻松地将小鱼儿一条条抓到手中。绮奴会在你身边待一会儿，确保你真正掌握了这个技巧，但一旦确认你已经熟练掌握了，她就会立刻离开去自己玩“手抓鱼”游戏了。 两个小时的时间一过，你们俩就已经收集到了相当多的淡水凤尾鱼。离开河边的浅水区后，绮奴把身上的水抖干，然后把那些鱼用布包起来。 哇，你真的在这方面很擅长啊。 rows.raw: " Hmm. You're not one for sitting around today, so why don't the both of you go out into the woods that surround the hill? She can show you all the things in that enchanted forest that she's discovered while you're gone, perhaps get some exercise while you're about it. You spend so much time with Kiyoko when you do come and visit her in the astral plane; exploring the rest of this pocket dimension with a little guide at your side would be quite the treat. "Okay! Come with me, [kinu.Dad] — I'm going to show you something really cool!" Without waiting for a reply, Kinu takes hold of one of your hands and starts tugging insistently, making a beeline for the forest's edge. Your foxy daughter leads you down trails and over roots, practically bouncing along like she's had one too many peaches. Come to think of it, she probably has... [var3|The both of you end up by the bank of a rocky river, its channel wide and flat, the water clear and sluggish. Barefoot as always, Kinu wades out into middle without so much as a thought, the water coming up to her waist. "See, [kinu.Dad]? There are fish in here! Most of them aren't really big enough to be eaten on their own, but if you take them home and pound them whole into fish paste they go really well on rice! Especially when you mix them with onions and ginger! You don't even need to gut them!" Mm. You notice she's got nothing to fish with, though. Kinu beams. "You catch them by hand, that's what makes it so fun! C'mon, give it a try!" As you watch, your daughter rolls up her sleeves, stoops down into the water and turns into a predator, albeit a small and fuzzy one. Looking every part of the fox kit on the prowl, her big blue eyes watch the waters intently, her hands hidden beneath the surface. And then, lightning-quick, the waters foam, and — "Hee hee! Look! Look!" Wriggling about in Kinu's cupped hands is a small, silvery fish, no bigger than your thumb. "See? All you have to do is be faster than they are! C'mon, I'll show you!" You spend the next couple of hours wading about in the shallows with Kinu, your daughter trying to teach you the fine art of hand fishing. [var0|While you try your best under Kinu's patient guidance and even manage to land a few catches here and there, most of your attempts come up empty-handed. The fish are just too quick for you — you're just not trained for this kind of thing. "Don't worry, [kinu.Dad]," Kinu reassures you with a pat on your side. "I get that you don't do this often, and that's okay. Being with you is still lots of fun!" Aww, cripes. You think you just got something in your eye... |[var1|Even for someone who doesn't do this often, you make a fairly good showing, landing more than a dozen small fish over the course of those two hours. Kinu is a slow and patient teacher, pointing out your mistakes and giving you encouragement where warranted; every now and then, you step back to see her demonstrate how to flip one of the river fish out of the water. While it's true that you don't have the natural agility and reflexes she has, her tutelage makes you feel as if you're truly accomplishing something. "See? See? Nothing to it! I've got a cloth with me; we can wrap all this up and take it home to Mama! Then out comes the salt, the mortar and the pestle, and we'll have so much fun! Not immediately, though — I'm all wet and my fingers and toes are wrinkly." |Unsurprisingly, you take to this little exercise like a fox-girl to sweet peaches, and are flipping little fishies out of the water and into your hands in no time at all. Kinu hangs around you for a little while to make sure you've got the technique down right, but soon splashes off to do her own hand fishing when she's sure you've got things down pat. By the time the two hours are up, you've managed to gather quite the pile of freshwater anchovies between the two of you. Stepping out of the river shallows, Kinu shakes herself dry, then wraps the lot in a cloth. "Wow, you're really good at this, [kinu.Dad]!" Guess you're just a natural, eh? "I'm going to have to take this home to Mama. We'll pound them and put the lot on hot rice tomorrow, and it's going to taste great!" ]] |Eventually, the trees part into a wide forest clearing, sunlight pouring in from the clear blue sky; the scents of several different species of blossoms greets you as you step into the knee-high grasses with Kinu at your side. Indeed, a spread of color unfurls before your eyes as you take in the sight, a small pond in the middle of the clearing serving as its centerpiece. "Isn't this amazing? I need to get some flowers for my flower arrangement lessons with Mama tomorrow. Since it's for my education and all..." Should you help her? "Umm... not really. I don't know very much about flower arrangement yet, but Mama says it's important to carefully remove them so they stay alive for as long as possible when we put them in vases. I just want you to watch me and take in this place, [kinu.Dad] — for some reason, this is so much more fun when you're around!" If she says so, but you're not going to let your hands go idle, either. While Kinu scampers off into the flower field, you find a large mossy log and take a seat. Kiyoko may be teaching your daughter about blossoms from the perspective of her culture, but that doesn't mean you can't do the same. There, these'll serve as a pretty decent base... maybe a few of these... and a dash of color with these, too... Time passes, and you're just about done when Kinu returns, a large bunch of flowers in her hands. She's dirty, she's sweaty, there're grass stains on her knees and clothes, and you suspect she might have waded out into the pond at least once. But then again, she wouldn't be Kinu if she didn't do all these things. "Ta-daaaaah!" Your little fox-daughter shoves the impromptu bouquet in your face. "This looks great! I don't know their meaning, but they look great nevertheless!" Indeed, they do. And while she was gone, you made something for her. See? As Kinu tilts her head up, you plonk the flower crown you made straight on her brow, using her large fox ears to hold it firmly in place. She squirms a little, but discomfort soon gives way to hyperactive excitement as she scoots over to the pond to look at her reflection in the water. "Eeeee! This is really great, [kinu.Dad], and it smells sooo nice on my head! How do you get the flowers to hold together like that? All the flowers look really good against my fur!" Ha, you're just glad that she likes it well enough. It's not the best, since it's only what you could cook up on a moment's notice, but anything you put on your darling daughter is going to look great. "Hee hee, I love being praised! Now I gotta repay you! Gonna give you a great big hug, and there's nothing you can do about it!" Kinu is good to her word, the little kitsune flumphing against you and squeezing your legs with her little arms. Petals fall from the flowers she's picked and from the crown on her brow, but she holds on until she's finally satisfied. "Maybe we should be heading back now, [kinu.Dad]. You still have to visit Mama before the day is out, right?" Yeah... and she has to show off her flower crown to everyone while the blooms are at their best. "Hee hee!" |So, where are you going this time? "To find some bees! Wild honey is great, but I'm not tall enough to reach hives in trees... if I stood on your shoulders, though, I could totally get to them! I spotted a few good ones some days ago, and have been itching to get at the honey... and then you come along, [kinu.Dad]!" [pc.bg hunter barbarian|You nod; you've had to do this a couple of times yourself out in the wilds as [a] [pc.background]. While it's not without its dangers — getting stung by a swarm of angry bees being only one of them — wild honey's pretty great. Besides, Kinu's a smart girl, and you'll be here to supervise her every step of the way. Now this is the kind of education that your daughter won't be getting from Kiyoko. |You're not entirely sure about this. Isn't she worried about being stung? Kinu looks up at you incredulously. "Stung? Me? Don't be silly, [kinu.Dad]. Oh, I got stung the first dozen times I tried raiding beehives, but I'm pretty confident in my abilities now. Just help me, okay?" The first dozen times? "I think there's a saying, something along the lines of 'nothing worth doing was ever easy?' Anyways, wild honeycomb is totally worth it, and besides, you're here! You'll keep me safe, won't you [kinu.Dad]?" Well, your daughter seems to know what she's doing, and she's right in saying that she isn't just any old fox kit. Besides, this is the kind of education that she won't be getting from her mother... ...You're probably going to regret this, aren't you? ] "Here! Here we are! I saw this one yesterday, but I couldn't reach it!" You look up at where Kinu's pointing, and indeed, there's a hive on one of the lowest boughs of a nearby pine tree, sticking out like the gills of a fish or some kind of gigantic fungus. Sequestered in the crook between bough and trunk, the support both have afforded has allowed the hive to grow to considerable proportions, though still well out of Kinu's reach; the buzzing of bees is deafening even at this distance, and your daughter gives you a big, maddened, and above all, mischievous grin. "Isn't it great? It's really big, and there's so much exposed honeycomb!" And there're so many bees. At least they're bees, and she didn't mistake a wasp's nest for a hive... "Just gotta find some pine needles! Help me, [kinu.Dad]?" Looks like there's no backing out now. The two of you scrounge about in the forest underbrush for a while, collecting some dry deadwood and handfuls of pine needles. Kinu is quick on her feet and even quicker with her hands, taking the deadwood from you and lashing the needles to them with long blades of grass to fashion a long-handled smokestick. [pc.bg hunter barbarian|Looking at her work away, you can't help but feel your heart swell with pride. Your daughter might take after her mother in appearance, but she's [a] [pc.background] at heart; it's nice to see once more that Kinu inherited your spirit, if not your appearance. |Seeing her work with practiced ease, you relax a little. At least this clearly isn't the first time your daughter's done this, although it does raise some questions as to whether her mother knows she's been raiding beehives... ] A snap of your daughter's fingers, and a gout of pale blue foxfire washes over the smokestick's tip, setting it alight. A moment's concentration, another snap of her fingers, and a gentle breeze starts up in the direction of the beehive. "Okay, [kinu.Dad]! This is where teamwork is important — I need to stand on your shoulders so I can smoke out the hive and get us some honeycomb! You ready?" As ready as she'll ever be. You crouch down, and Kinu scrambles up your back and onto your shoulders. It's a bit of a balancing act, but she's a little fox and pretty light to boot; with your hands on her calves and her natural agility, she's able to keep upright while you start at a brisk walk towards the hive, all three of her tails looped under your arms for extra support. "Slowly does it, [kinu.Dad]. No need for any sudden moves. Just act natural." [pc.bg hunter barbarian|Oh, you know. This might not be her first time doing this, but neither is it yours. Although you do have to wonder if wild honey here tastes different from that of the waking world... |Act natural, she says. Easier said than done, especially when there're so many of the little terrors buzzing about you. ] "Oh-kay. We're almost there. Almost there..." You don't dare to look up, but ahead of you, Kinu lets the thick, roiling clouds of white smoke emanating from the end of her smoke stick to envelop most of the beehive, allowing the smoke to stew for about a minute before making her next move. Working deftly, she draws a small knife from the folds of her yukata, eyes the beehive through the smoke, then slices deeply and pries loose a section of honeycomb as long as her forearm. You're half-expecting either of you to be stung at any moment, but no sharp pinpricks of pain come to assail you or Kinu. As the smoke begins to clear, you see the bees clustered about their hive, still seemingly placated; a few buzz angrily in the air, but aren't up for pressing an attack. "See? That wasn't so bad." Kinu lets go of you, hops off your shoulders, and does a little somersault in the air before landing on her feet with a flourish. She stomps out the smokestick on the soft forest soil, then presents the filched honeycomb for your approval. "It's called teamwork!" My, that's a pretty big one. "And I couldn't have done it without you, [kinu.Dad]. Come on, let's go find someplace where we can wash this, then I'll open it up!" So it comes to pass that the two of you wind up by the shallows of a forest stream; Kinu washes off bits of wax from the comb, then splits it in half with her knife and cuts off the top. Ears wiggling, a big smile on her face, your kitsune daughter presents you with your share of the spoils. "Ta-daaaah! You've got to love this stuff. It's light and tasty without being cloyingly sweet like candies are! You can really taste the flowers in them — that's why I only cut off a bit of the comb each time, so that the bees don't move away and there's always more to be had!" Right, that's pretty forward-looking of her. [pc.bg hunter barbarian|Well, no time like the present, then. You've had wild honey before, but somehow this particular comb promises to be much better than most you've sampled in the past. Maybe it's because your daughter worked so hard to get it for you... Yeah, that's probably why it smells so great. "I want to do this again sometime, [kinu.Dad]. Standing on your shoulders makes me feel really tall! I can get to so many places I couldn't before... the possibilities are endless!" |One thing, though. It does smell pretty great, but is it okay to eat the honey straight from the comb? She did wash it in the stream, but... "Well... I could go home with it and put it through Mama's sieve, but then she'd notice and make me share. Also, it loses some of its flavor and becomes thicker, and I don't like that. I kinda prefer surprises in my honeycomb! "Don't worry about it, though, you won't get sick or anything. Did you know you can put honey on bandages, and they'll stop the wound from getting infected? I read that in one of Mama's books!" ] Mm-mm-mm. Without further ado, Kinu tears into the honeycomb with undisguised glee, her three tails curled about herself as she empties the beeswax cells of their precious contents. Sweet wild honey gets all over the little kitsune's face, chin and fingers as she polishes off the lot, getting everything all sticky. Despite all this, your daughter is deliriously happy as she savours her spoils, polishing off the last of the honey with her tongue and sucking on her fingers to get as much of it into her as possible. While you know she's not usually a fan of sweet things, the light, fruity aroma of the honey has clearly changed her mind. You have to admit it's good. There's a little bit of loose beeswax here and there and some of the honey has crystallised, but it's still pretty tasty. The point that no one really needs to eat here pipes up in the back of your mind, but that isn't the point — the point is spending a lovely time out here with your hyperactive rapscallion of a foxy daughter. "Did you want the rest of that, [kinu.Dad]?" Naaah, you'll be having it all. You worked as hard as she did for it. "Okie! Just give me the leftover comb so I can wash it out, there's plenty of stuff you can do with beeswax!" By the way she's looking, she ought to wash herself out as well. Kiyoko's going to be pretty mad if she turns up on the doorstep all sweet-smelling and sticky. "Hee hee!" |Where does she intend to take you this time? Any good sights of late? As far as you can understand it, the forest is practically infinite — yet whenever you want to return to the cherry blossom tree, it's never more than a few dozen paces away... "We're going to be picking mushrooms! A certain kind, in fact." Oh? What kind? "Do you know what a matsutake is, [kinu.Dad]?" [pc.bg hunter barbarian|As Kinu rattles off the description to you, realization slowly dawns: you do know this mushroom. The ones that grow in the Frost Marches have white caps instead of the brown ones your daughter is describing, but are edible enough, and they certainly don't have the aromatic scent that's got Kinu so excited. Either way, they should be pretty safe, you think — it's not as if anything you eat here counts as real, right? |As you listen to Kinu excitedly rattle off the description, a small worm of doubt finds its way into your mind: eating wild mushrooms isn't generally the best of ideas, or at least that's what you've always been told. Nevertheless, your daughter is a smart cookie, and seems to know what she's doing. Trusting her should be fine, right? Oh well, it's not as if anything you eat here is for real, isn't it? Could you even get sick from dream food? Every time you've had a meal with Kiyoko, that's never carried into the waking world... ] "...You find them about the roots of pines! I'll show you! They're supposed to be really seasonal, but Mama kinda controls things here, so they pop up every so often! Then we'll get lots and lots of them, cook up some for ourselves, then give the rest to Mama! Isn't that amazing?" You ruffle Kinu's hair and tickle her ears. She is really excited about some mushrooms, isn't she? "Ehehe. They're really good. Mama likes to slice them and cook them with rice, but I prefer them roasted over a fire. I think food tastes better when it's more natural, [kinu.Dad]." So long as that doesn't mean she's eating her food raw... or at least, that which isn't meant to be eaten raw. "Okay! We're here! We're here!" Indeed, here you are. Tall, thick-rooted pines tower above this section of the forest; judging by the looks of them, if they were real they'd have to be centuries old to get this big. Kinu hops excitedly from dirt mound to dirt mound, then drops to her hands and knees and starts crawling away from the trail and into the underbrush. Nose to the ground, tails swishing behind her, Kinu clambers over roots and across soft mats of old pine needles, scrounging in the dirt and getting stains all over her yukata. Pick up the trail yet? "Ssh! I'm concentrating!" This goes on for perhaps five more minutes, Kinu's face a mask of absolute seriousness as she crawls all over the forest floor in a winding, snaking pattern. Just when you start wondering if she's going to get anywhere, your daughter pounces on one particular spot that doesn't seem any different from any other, then starts digging through dirt and old pine needles with her bare hands. "It's here! It's here! Come and see, [kinu.Dad]!" Now you see it too — a rounded cap amidst the underbrush, poking its way out of the soft forest soil. With all the utmost care of a mother tending to her newborn, Kinu unearths the mushroom, digging away at the surrounding dirt with her fingers until she's exposed enough of the treat to wrench it free. "Hee hee, this is great! Look! Look!" Grinning madly, Kinu holds up the mushroom for you to see. Long and thin, a pale brown cap veined with white — even freshly dug from the earth, you can smell it[pc.ra lupine|, and what a scent it is to your lupine nose. Whatever else you might call it, it's strong; there's little doubt that you'd be able to track this kind of scent pretty well|]. "Now it's your turn to hunt for matsutake, [kinu.Dad]! I'll help you! I've got a good nose, after all!" [pc.bg hunter barbarian|Oh, you're game. If the brown-capped variety is anything like the white-capped one, then this shouldn't be too hard. Besides, you've got your floofy, squishy daughter at your side helping you, right? |All right, all right. This sort of thing isn't exactly what you were raised to do, but you're willing to give it a go for your floofy daughter. Besides, she loves showing off how much she knows about things, right? Perfect for her to flaunt her knowledge of mushroom hunting. ] Under Kinu's direction, you follow her lead, getting down on all fours to creep close to the forest floor like what she's doing. [pc.ra lupine|It feels a little silly to be doing this, but then again, it's for a good cause. Now that you've scented what that mushroom smells like, though, it's hard to miss it. Earthy, spicy, not altogether unlike cinnamon in some respects — lupines are great at catching scents, and you're no exception. Before long, you're ahead of Kinu, pushing aggressively through the underbrush in search of the source of the scent. "Where are you going, [kinu.Dad]?" Ssh! You're concentrating! Kinu gets the hint and falls silent, following along behind as you track down your quarry. It's getting closer and closer, and... yes, there, behind that fallen log! "Oh! Oh! I smell it too!" Kinu doesn't need any encouragement, scampering forward and pushing at the log with all her might. It shifts, it moves, and she scrounges about in the dirt until she's unearthed a pine mushroom as long as your hand. So, how'd you do? "Not bad, not bad! You have a really good nose, [kinu.Dad]!" Aw, shucks. So, who's got the better sense of smell, the fox or the hound? "We'll see! Since you clearly don't need me to teach you anything, we'll see who can get more, okay?" The two of you spend the next hour or so rooting about in the shadow of the pine trees, covering a pretty wide swathe as you uncover more mushrooms, large, firm, and with that heady aroma that Kinu promises is a harbinger of delectable things to come. Between your nose and hers, you manage to fill your daughter's pockets with all manner of sharp-smelling pine mushrooms. "'Eehee! Guess I can't beat you, [kinu.Dad]. Truth be told, I'm kinda jealous of your nose..." You smile and ruffle Kinu's hair. She's not half bad herself. "Guess we ought to be heading home now. You still have to visit Mama before you go, right? I have to put all of these matsutake down and wash them, too — watch out for me the next time you come visit, okay? We'll roast them up and have a feast!" Of course, of course. There's a good girl. |[pc.bg hunter barbarian|Your time as [a] [pc.background] meant that you'd have to live off the land in the past, and this isn't even amongst the top three awkward things you've done in order to bring home dinner. Although there is something to be said for food you don't have to clean the dirt off of before cooking... "Smell anything, [kinu.Dad]?" Not really — you don't have a nose like hers. Nevertheless, you can make an educated guess from what you know of forestry and wilderness survival; mushrooms and fungi all share some basic needs, and combined with what she's told you about these matsutake mushrooms and their habits, you can use your time and energy in the most efficient manner. At this point, Kinu has fallen largely silent, watching your movements intently as you go about your search. Now this is another way to get an education, instead of sitting around with books and scrolls all day. Aha. Now that spot in the shade of that tall pine... still on all fours, you shuffle over and brush away some rotting bark and old pine needles. Barely have you begun when that same spicy smell greets you, and Kinu rushes over to dig up your find while you stand and dust your hands off. "Ha-ha! You're really great, [kinu.Dad]! Of course, I knew it was there, but I wouldn't have if it weren't for my nose." Say, why don't the two of you work together? You can look out for likely spots and direct her to them, and she can check them out without needing to go to all the trouble of clearing or digging. Teamwork, it's called. "Teamwork!" Without skipping a beat, Kinu's face is down to the ground once more, sniffing away as she crawls forward through the underbrush. She really is like a little fox, isn't she? Between the two of you, though, you have a grand old time; with you surveying the surroundings and Kinu checking out particular locales, squeezing into cramped spots with her petite form, it's easy to cover a wide swathe of forest. Between your daughter's nose and energy and your own experience, it's not long before you've filled the pockets of her yukata to bulging with spicy-smelling pine mushrooms. "This is great!" Kinu says as she finally gets to her feet, stained and dirty all over. "We picked so many today!" Mm-hm. She should be sure to give them some time to recover on their own, or there probably won't be as many the next time she comes around. Then she'll have to ask her mother to do something about it, and that would be awkward, wouldn't it? "Ehe..." You smile and ruffle Kinu's hair. Come now, it's about time you started heading back — she has to put down her find, and you have to go see her mother. |[var2|While this isn't exactly what you thought you'd be doing with your life, it's always good to try new things, right? Kinu's excitement is palpable as she shepherds you between the tall pines, stopping every now and then to explain the intricacies of mushroom hunting to you. "You have to watch out for the squirrels, they're sneaky little thieves. They won't just eat the matsutake out of the ground, but leave your find alone for a bit and they'll come down from the trees and try to steal them. That's why I always know where the nearest pine cone is; that way I can shoo them off at a distance. I can hit them pretty often!" [pc.isDK|There's your girl — nailing those nasty, thieving squirrels! Little fuzzy bastards getting what's coming to them.|Well, when you look at it from the squirrels' point of view, she's the one stealing the mushrooms from their forest.] Really makes one think, doesn't it? Kinu sticks her tongue out at you. "We should have a throwing competition sometime, [kinu.Dad]. But for now..." Yes, but for now, what's that over there? Your daughter's gaze follows your pointed finger, and then she stops and sniffs the air. "Hey, you're right, [kinu.Dad]! C'mon, c'mon!" Without waiting for so much as a reply, Kinu breaks away from you, hops over a rotting log, and bounds over to the spot you pointed out. Her face a mask of furious concentration, Kinu grubs about in the dirt, digging with her fingers until she pulls out a long-stalked mushroom from the cool earth. "Ta-daaaah!" Hey, that one's pretty big. "So it is! You have pretty good eyes, [kinu.Dad]! Almost as good as mine!" Almost as good, she says? Why, whose side of the family does she think she got that amazing eyesight from? "Ehehe. C'mon, then — let's go find some more! With two pairs of amazing eyes and my nose, we'll be unstoppable!" The next hour or so is filled with all sorts of dirty, earthy fun with Kinu. You'd never thought mushroom hunting would be your sort of thing, but having a bouncy, noisy eight-year old kitsune child along with you makes it all worthwhile — Kinu is clearly the more experienced one at this, but your eyes are sharp enough for you to make a good number of finds on your own. Eventually, the two of you gather enough pine mushrooms to fill Kinu's pockets, and the both of you are quite thoroughly stained all over with what the forest has to offer. "This looks pretty good, [kinu.Dad]," Kinu says as she unloads her haul onto a mossy, flat-topped rock and counts the mushrooms one by one before packing them away. "I'll have to take them home and wash them, of course, but it shouldn't be more than a day or two before I can have them ready to be roasted. You'll be there too, right?" Uh... "I know you're busy out there trying to save everyone, so it doesn't matter if you're too busy," Kinu continues, her ears turning downwards. "But I would really, really like it if you'd drop by the next time you visit, okay? Will you keep that in mind, [kinu.Dad]?" Oh all right, you will. In the meantime, you should probably be taking her home. You still need to see her mother before your time here is up, after all. |You've little doubt that you look quite silly bumbling about like this, and that feeling soon turns to embarrassment at how well your daughter is doing in spite of you. Kinu practically bounds from spot to spot on the soft carpet of dirt and dry pine needles, pouncing on suspicious heaps, and when she does find one of those coveted mushrooms, running up to present it to you with pride. Untrained and with none of the natural advantages that Kinu has, mushroom hunting is more easily said than done. This is your daughter's world — and you're more aware than ever that it isn't yours. Yet being invited to play with her in it, if only for a little while... it makes it all worth it? "Look, [kinu.Dad]! I found another one!" Kinu races up to you with a long, thick brown-capped mushroom in her hands, fresh dirt still on it. "Aren't I amazing?" Mm-hm. She sure is a clever girl. Truth be told, you're not sure if you're just weighing her down. Your daughter preens at the praise, ears twitching all the while. "Ehe... I don't mind, [kinu.Dad]. Just having you watch me makes me want to do my best... so you're still helping, even if you don't manage to find any matsutake!" Gods, when did she learn to be so sweet and adorable? "I mean, it's fun to go out into the forest and play, but it's always more fun when you play together with someone else. Mama can't come out with me all the time since she's so busy, but you'll do just as well!" You sigh and ruffle Kinu's hair, eliciting a happy squeal from your daughter. Yeah... she's right. Out of the mouths of babes, as the saying goes. "Don't worry, [kinu.Dad]. Even if you're not very good at it, matsutake hunting is still fun, and I'll help you! I'm a good helper!" Your daughter is good to her word. Even though you're content to step back and leave the bulk of the work to her, Kinu urges you forward through the underbrush with all the eagerness of a bright-eyed puppy. She sniffs out each hidden mushroom, lets you dig out the firm, earthy prize, then the both of you take turns savouring the unique spicy, cinnamon-like aroma of these brown-capped pine mushrooms before she tucks them away into her yukata. "It's okay to not know things," Kinu explains as she sniffs about clumps of old pine cones and needles alike. "I wasn't born knowing very much, either. If you won't admit to yourself that you don't know things, then you won't learn anything, so there's nothing wrong with that. Watch and learn, [kinu.Dad]!" You get the feeling she's relishing the chance to show off as much as you are in watching her, but who's complaining? It's a nice walk in the woods with your kitsune daughter, having a leisurely chat with her, and feeling the cool dirt on your fingers as you dig up her next prize... Gods, how long has it been? An hour? Two? You still need to visit Kiyoko before your time's up, and Kinu is thoroughly dirty and scruffy at this point. Perhaps it's time to head back. "All right, [kinu.Dad]. I didn't get as many as I'd hoped to, but it's all right because I got to spend time with you! Look, once I get these matsutake all washed up and prepared you can come look for me, okay? Then we can roast them up and have a feast! It should only take a day or two, please tell me you can come! I know you're really busy, but..." Unf. It's hard not to say yes to Kinu and her big blue eyes... all right, you'll see what you can do, but she should go ahead if you don't manage to visit soon. No point in letting the mushrooms spoil. "Yaaaaaay!" ] ] ] ]"

rows.original: As the two of you make the trek back to the hilltop, Kinu suddenly brightens. "Oh, right! I had so much fun playing that I almost forgot! We gotta clean up before entering the house!" Before you can reply, Kinu snaps her fingers, and the dirt and damp of the forest falls away from the two of you, leaving you feeling refreshed, a faint scent of mint lingering on your [pc.skinFurScales]. Hey, that's a pretty neat trick. Your daughter beams. "Mama usually doesn't want me using magic to clean up, but I think this warrants an exception. You've got to look your best while playing with Mama, right? It's the least I can do to thank you for taking the time to play with me, [kinu.Dad]." No, no. You had fun too and even if you wouldn't have, seeing her happy makes you happy, too. "Aww, that's so sweet. I'm supposed to be the sweet one here!" Kinu makes a pouty face, but can't hold it as the little kitsune breaks into giggles. "Why don't you go ahead, [kinu.Dad]? I think I can see home from here — I know Mama would like some time alone to play with just you, okay? Don't let me get in your way! Byebye!" Leaning forward, your foxy daughter gives you a little kiss on the side, then turns tail — all three of them — and scampers up the hillside, soon disappearing from sight. For someone who's just spent hours playing in the forest, she sure has a lot of energy...
rows.translation: 当你们两人开始往山顶走去时，绮奴突然亮了起来。 哦，对了！玩得太开心了，差点忘了这件事！在进屋之前，我们得先把东西收拾干净才行！ 还没等你来得及回答，绮奴打了个响指，森林中的尘土和湿气立刻从你们身上消失了，你们顿时感到神清气爽，身上还残留着一丝淡淡的薄荷香气。 [pc.skinFurScales]嘿，这个技巧真是太棒了。 你的女儿开心极了。 妈妈通常不让我用魔法来打扫，但我觉得这次应该是个例外。当你和妈妈一起玩的时候，你肯定想看起来最漂亮吧？能感谢你抽出时间陪我玩，这也是我至少能做的吧？ [kinu.Dad]." 不，不。你也很开心，而且即使你没有开心，看到她开心，你也会感到开心的。 哇，太贴心了。本来应该是我来表现贴心一面的才对啊！ 绮奴做了个撅嘴的表情，但很快就忍不住笑了起来，因为那只小狐妖突然开始咯咯地笑起来。 你为什么不继续呢？ [kinu.Dad]我想从这里应该就能看到家了……我知道妈妈肯定想有段时间能单独和你一起玩，好吗？别让我妨碍你们哦！再见！ 你那机灵的女儿向前倾了倾身子，在你的脸颊上轻轻一吻，然后三个人一起转身，快步跑上了山坡，很快就消失在了视线之外。对于一个刚刚在森林里玩了几个小时的人来说，她确实精力充沛得很……
