rows.original: For a moment, silence falls over the birthing chamber as Kiyoko takes a moment to catch her breath, resting the newborn kit on her slightly smaller belly. Then, on the edge of your hearing, a shuffling noise as the screen door is drawn aside, and - "Mama?" Weakly, Kiyoko rolls her head over to take in the sight of little Kinu peering into the verdant birthing chamber, and her face becomes even paler. "Kinu! You're not —" But it's too late. Kinu's pale blue eyes are as wide as dinner plates as she takes in her mother's panting, naked form, the mess that's the afterbirth, and finally, the little fox kit in Kiyoko's arms. Swallowing hard, the little kitsune focuses furiously on the last, while studiously ignoring the first two. "I-I'm sorry, Mother. I just wanted..." Kiyoko sighs. "Well, you're here now. What did you want?" "I... I wanted to hold the baby. While they're still small. So when I heard that you were indisposed, I snuck in..." Kinu swallows hard again as she looks down at the mess of afterbirth. "Did... did all that come out of your tummy?" "It's what helps the kit grow while they're in my tummy, yes. But now they don't need it anymore." Kiyoko looks unsure for a moment, then beckons Kinu over. "I suppose since I'm teaching you how to care for your siblings, you should learn about this as well. After all, it was how you were born, and you'll have to go through it yourself someday. [pc.name], would you please help clean up?" "I... this looks yucky." "Of course it is," Kiyoko replies, giving you a nod as you move to pick up one of the damp towels and clean up the mess from the birth. "It's also exhausting, painful, and mind-numbing, at least for the first few times it happens. But it's worth it. You don't regret being born, do you?" Kinu says nothing and just looks down at her feet. She stays like that for half a minute or so, then looks up at her mother and sticks out her arms expectantly. Kiyoko considers her, then carefully hands over the newborn kitsune kit, making sure Kinu's grip is secure before letting go completely. The little kit mewls and snuffles about in Kinu's arms, a small, tightly-wrapped bundle of fluff. Kinu practically bounces in place, petting and stroking her newborn sibling all over. "Eeeeee! So cute! I want one of my own!" "Even knowing where they come from and how they come out?" "I can do it!" Kiyoko can't help but laugh weakly at that. "You'll have to be a lot older before you can get started on that, love. That, and babies don't grow up so quickly outside of the astral plane. You'll have to feed and care for a helpless little kit for more than just a few moments, you know. They'll cry, they'll need to be changed, they'll wake you up when you need sleep the most." "I know." Kiyoko smiles and ruffles her eldest daughter's ears. "You need the right temperament to be a den mother, if you want to be like me. Beauty fades, strength weakens, but a well-cultivated temperament and good-natured attitude will last you for the whole of your life." Kinu hugs the newborn close to her for a little while longer, then looks to her mother worriedly as the little kit begins to wail, a tiny, high-pitched screaming ringing in the air. Despite all the cradling and shushing that she's applying to her little sibling, the fox kit's screaming just gets louder. "Mama! Mama! What do I do?" "Improvise, of course. You'll be having to deal with this a lot when you grow up if you want to be like your mama." Kinu pouts. "That's not very useful..." "It's more an art than a science, which is why you're getting started while you're young. Both experience and instruction are important, but the former counts for more than the latter. Now, let me show you how it's done." Kinu looks a little uncertain, but hands back the newborn to her mother. Exhausted but relieved, Kiyoko cradles her child and shushes the little one's wailing with a few gentle earpets, then turns to Kinu. "You need to be a little more gentle. Babies are delicate." Kinu frowns, then looks up at her sibling snuffling at her mother's breast once more. Several moments of silence pass as Kiyoko slowly recovers a little while longer, then Kiyoko gives her daughter a nod. "You should be going." "But..." "If you want additional lessons on child-rearing, dear, I can make some time for that. At the very least, it'll keep your little hands away from the peach grove. But right now, your mother wants some time alone with your new sibling and your [pc.mf|father|mother]." That doesn't quite satisfy Kinu, but at least the little kitsune is wise enough to let it go. She stiffens up, gives Kiyoko a very formal bow, then slips out of the birthing chambers; the last you see of your daughter are her three silvery-white tails vanishing around the corner.
rows.translation: 一时间，产房里陷入了寂静。清子稍作休息，调整呼吸，将刚出生的小生命放在自己略显隆起的腹部上。随后，你几乎听不见的微弱声响传来——屏风门被轻轻拉开 妈妈？ 基代子无力地转过头，看到了小纪努正从那片翠绿的产房中探出头来，她的脸色变得更加苍白了。 基努！你不可能—— 但为时已晚。金色的淡蓝色眼睛瞪得像餐盘一样大，她看到了母亲那气喘吁吁、赤裸的身体，看到了那些产后的残骸，最后也看到了清子怀中的那只小狐妖幼崽。小狐妖艰难地咽了口唾沫，拼命地注视着最后那个，而刻意忽略了前两个。 对、对不起，妈妈。我只是想…… 清子叹了口气。 好吧，你现在来了。你到底想要什么？ 我……我想在宝宝还小的时候抱抱他们。所以当我听说你身体不适时，我就偷偷溜进来了…… 金子再次艰难地咽了咽口水，低头看着那一团胎盘残渣。 那些……那些都是从你肚子里出来的吗？ 没错，正是这种物质在它们还在我肚子里的时候帮助它们成长。但现在，它们已经不再需要它了。 清子犹豫了片刻，然后招手部让纪久过来。 既然我在教你如何照顾你的兄弟姐妹，那你也应该了解一下这个。毕竟，这是你与生俱来的责任，总有一天你也必须亲自经历这个过程。 [pc.name]你能帮忙打扫一下吗？ 我……这个看起来真恶心。 当然是了。 清子点了点头，你便拿起一条湿毛巾，开始清理分娩后留下的凌乱景象。 至少在最初几次经历这种时候，这确实会让人感到精疲力竭、痛苦不堪，甚至会让人感到麻木。但这一切都是值得的。你不会后悔自己来到了这个世界上，对吧？ 纪奈什么也没说，只是低头看着自己的足部。她这样保持了好半分钟左右，然后抬起头看着母亲，满怀期待地伸出双臂。清子仔细地看了看她，然后小心翼翼地将那只新生的狐妖幼崽递到她手部中，确保纪奈握得稳当之后才松开手部。小狐妖在纪奈的怀里喵喵叫着、抽抽鼻子，就像一个被紧紧包裹起来的小绒球。纪奈高兴得在原地跳来跳去，不停地抚摸和轻拍她的新弟弟妹妹。 哇塞！太可爱了！我也想要一个！ 即使知道它们从哪里来，又是如何形成的？ 我能做到！ 清子听到这话，不禁弱弱地笑了起来。 亲爱的，你得再长大一些才能开始做那些事。而且，在星界之外，婴儿的成长速度并不会那么快。你知道的，你得照顾这个无助的小生命，这个责任可不会持续短短几分钟而已。他们会哭闹，需要换尿布，还会在你最需要休息的时候把你吵醒。 我知道。 清子微笑着，轻轻挠了挠女儿的耳朵。 如果你想成为像我这样的人，就必须具备合适的性格特质。外貌会消逝，力量也会减弱，但良好的性格修养和友善的态度会伴随你一生。 基努又将新生儿紧紧抱在怀里片刻，然后忧心忡忡地看向她的母亲——那只小狐妖开始大声哭闹起来，那细小的、高亢的哭声在空气中回荡。尽管基努不停地安抚着她的弟弟妹妹，但它的哭声却越来越大。 妈妈！妈妈！我该怎么办？ 当然，要即兴发挥。你得想办法解决这个问题。 很多 等你长大了，如果想成为像你妈妈那样的人的话。 绮奴 makes a pout. 那没什么用处…… 这更像是一门艺术，而非科学，因此你需要在年轻的时候就开始学习。经验和指导都很重要，但经验的重要性要远远超过指导。现在，让我来告诉你具体该怎么做。 纪奈看起来有些犹豫，但还是把新生儿交还给了她的母亲。基代子虽然疲惫，但心中却感到宽慰。她轻轻抱起自己的孩子，用几句温柔的话语安抚着婴儿的哭声，然后转向纪奈。 你得再温柔一点，婴儿可是很脆弱的。 纪夫皱了皱眉头，然后抬头看着正在母亲怀里抽泣的女儿。几秒钟的沉默之后，清子终于慢慢恢复了平静，于是她点了点头，示意女儿可以停止哭泣了。 你该走了。 但是…… 亲爱的，如果你想了解更多关于育儿的知识，我完全可以抽时间陪你学习。至少这样，你的小手部就不会再去碰那些桃树了。不过现在，你的妈妈想要和一些时间单独和你的新弟弟/妹妹待在一起 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]." 这并没有让绮奴完全满意，但至少这只小狐妖还算聪明，没有继续纠缠下去。她挺直身体，向清子行了一个非常正式的鞠躬，然后悄悄地离开了产房；当你最后一次看到你的女儿时，只见她那三条银白色的尾巴在转角处消失了。
rows.raw: ' For a moment, silence falls over the birthing chamber as Kiyoko takes a moment to catch her breath, resting the newborn kit on her slightly smaller belly. Then, on the edge of your hearing, a shuffling noise as the screen door is drawn aside, and - "Mama?" Weakly, Kiyoko rolls her head over to take in the sight of little Kinu peering into the verdant birthing chamber, and her face becomes even paler. "Kinu! You're not —" But it's too late. Kinu's pale blue eyes are as wide as dinner plates as she takes in her mother's panting, naked form, the mess that's the afterbirth, and finally, the little fox kit in Kiyoko's arms. Swallowing hard, the little kitsune focuses furiously on the last, while studiously ignoring the first two. "I-I'm sorry, Mother. I just wanted..." Kiyoko sighs. "Well, you're here now. What did you want?" "I... I wanted to hold the baby. While they're still small. So when I heard that you were indisposed, I snuck in..." Kinu swallows hard again as she looks down at the mess of afterbirth. "Did... did all that come out of your tummy?" "It's what helps the kit grow while they're in my tummy, yes. But now they don't need it anymore." Kiyoko looks unsure for a moment, then beckons Kinu over. "I suppose since I'm teaching you how to care for your siblings, you should learn about this as well. After all, it was how you were born, and you'll have to go through it yourself someday. [pc.name], would you please help clean up?" "I... this looks yucky." "Of course it is," Kiyoko replies, giving you a nod as you move to pick up one of the damp towels and clean up the mess from the birth. "It's also exhausting, painful, and mind-numbing, at least for the first few times it happens. But it's worth it. You don't regret being born, do you?" Kinu says nothing and just looks down at her feet. She stays like that for half a minute or so, then looks up at her mother and sticks out her arms expectantly. Kiyoko considers her, then carefully hands over the newborn kitsune kit, making sure Kinu's grip is secure before letting go completely. The little kit mewls and snuffles about in Kinu's arms, a small, tightly-wrapped bundle of fluff. Kinu practically bounces in place, petting and stroking her newborn sibling all over. "Eeeeee! So cute! I want one of my own!" "Even knowing where they come from and how they come out?" "I can do it!" Kiyoko can't help but laugh weakly at that. "You'll have to be a lot older before you can get started on that, love. That, and babies don't grow up so quickly outside of the astral plane. You'll have to feed and care for a helpless little kit for more than just a few moments, you know. They'll cry, they'll need to be changed, they'll wake you up when you need sleep the most." "I know." Kiyoko smiles and ruffles her eldest daughter's ears. "You need the right temperament to be a den mother, if you want to be like me. Beauty fades, strength weakens, but a well-cultivated temperament and good-natured attitude will last you for the whole of your life." Kinu hugs the newborn close to her for a little while longer, then looks to her mother worriedly as the little kit begins to wail, a tiny, high-pitched screaming ringing in the air. Despite all the cradling and shushing that she's applying to her little sibling, the fox kit's screaming just gets louder. "Mama! Mama! What do I do?" "Improvise, of course. You'll be having to deal with this a lot when you grow up if you want to be like your mama." Kinu pouts. "That's not very useful..." "It's more an art than a science, which is why you're getting started while you're young. Both experience and instruction are important, but the former counts for more than the latter. Now, let me show you how it's done." Kinu looks a little uncertain, but hands back the newborn to her mother. Exhausted but relieved, Kiyoko cradles her child and shushes the little one's wailing with a few gentle earpets, then turns to Kinu. "You need to be a little more gentle. Babies are delicate." Kinu frowns, then looks up at her sibling snuffling at her mother's breast once more. Several moments of silence pass as Kiyoko slowly recovers a little while longer, then Kiyoko gives her daughter a nod. "You should be going." "But..." "If you want additional lessons on child-rearing, dear, I can make some time for that. At the very least, it'll keep your little hands away from the peach grove. But right now, your mother wants some time alone with your new sibling and your [pc.mf|father|mother]." That doesn't quite satisfy Kinu, but at least the little kitsune is wise enough to let it go. She stiffens up, gives Kiyoko a very formal bow, then slips out of the birthing chambers; the last you see of your daughter are her three silvery-white tails vanishing around the corner.'

rows.original: Hmm. You don't often get the chance to do things as a family, so you're actually considering asking her mother to come out and play as well. That should make it more fun, right? [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |For a moment, you see something flicker across your daughter's face that's not sweet, saccharine joy — hesitation, disappointment, unease, perhaps all of the above in varying amounts. It's gone as soon as you realize it's there, but there's no doubt as to its presence. Kinu's adorable smile returns with enthusiastic vigor, her little body wiggling from side to side as she makes a show of considering the matter. "Okay! Let's go and get her, [kinu.Dad]!" |Your daughter's face brightens up at the suggestion, her soft white ears twitching like mad. "Yeah, that sounds like a really good idea, [kinu.Dad]. Mama is always saying that she's got so much work to do, but if you ask her along with me, she won't be able to say no! Come on, then — let's go!" ] With that, Kinu takes off across the open hilltop, your fox-daughter's short little legs a blur as she makes a beeline for the cabin. Pausing barely long enough to wipe her feet at the threshold, she pushes open the door and hops in with you hot on her heels. "Mama! Mama! [kinu.Dad] wants you to come out and play with us! It's such a nice, sunny day, I —" The hallway is empty, with only silence greeting the two of you as you step indoors. Your daughter is quick to start searching and snuffling about, getting to all fours like an actual fox and sniffing the air. She definitely knows what she's about, for it doesn't take too long for her to lead you to Kiyoko. Eventually, you find your fox-wife [rand |out back by the well, a bucket of water freshly spilled all over the grass as she clutches at her huge pregnant belly |on her knees at the bottom of the stairwell landing, panting and sweating as she pats her massive baby bump, clearly in pain |in the kitchen doubled over and supporting herself on a counter as she groans ]. Her broken waters stain her skirts and thighs, but she clearly hasn't had the time to clean up or even do anything of use. "Mama! Mama!" "Oh." Kiyoko's eyes flick from Kinu to you. "Oh." Oh, indeed. Sad to say, it looks like you won't be able to play with Kinu today. Her mother's going to have a kit... if she would give the two of you some space? This probably isn't something a girl her age should see close up... Your fox-daughter looks away, but doesn't complain. "I'll be just outside in the garden if you need me then, [kinu.Dad]." Please. Kiyoko forces a pained chuckle. "Such a precocious child. She'll have to go through the same thing when she grows up, but she can be as innocent as she can be for now. I'm sorry for ruining your time with our daughter, as it appears..." Never mind that. It doesn't look like she's been here long, but how much time does she have left? You know Kiyoko's body is rather speedy about such maternal matters. Grabbing your foxy fluff-wife by under her arms, you haul her upright and start marching her off to the verdant balcony where she usually goes to give birth. "Not much, but I can handle things myself if need be. You can help with the other preparations if you'd like." You have little doubt that Kiyoko's capable of handling popping out a fox kit all by herself, but at the same time there's still value in staying here and making sure that she's not alone in this. Do you want to insist on staying with her?

rows.original: At your response, Kiyoko sighs and groans, clutching her swollen, overstuffed womb. "Sometimes, I don't think I'll ever understand some aspects of northerners no matter how much I'm around them. None of the hopeless boys back home would've stuck around, and no prospective mother would've allowed it anyway." Silence. And then, her voice softens, almost as if she's relieved you didn't leave. [var1 |"Fine. Help me get out of my clothes." Kiyoko might be a little clumsier than she usually is, but between the two of you her yukata and silken smallclothes are quickly off her and folded into a pile against the wall under a loaded towel rack. |"If you want to stay and finish the job, I won't stop you. Help me get comfortable here." You guide Kiyoko over to the futon she's prepared for this purpose and ease her down onto it with care. ] Taking a few deep breaths of the balcony's subtle floral scent, Kiyoko calms down a little and takes a more level-headed approach to the situation. Propping herself up against the wall with a couple of cushions, the kitsune sinks back and tries to make herself as comfortable as possible, legs spread and fluffy tails pillowing her body. So, anything in particular she'd like you to do? "Be here for me." That's what you're here for. "Then do that." All right. You find a stool, sit down beside Kiyoko, and begin ruffling her long hair and fluffy, foxy ears with broad, powerful strokes. Comforting, not teasing; Kiyoko herself looks a little more relaxed for what it's worth. There's nothing really left now but to let nature take its course, which it does with rapid succession. [kiyoko.numKits 0 1 4 16 32|"Ugh!" Bracing herself against the wall, Kiyoko squeezes her eyes shut in pain and effort as contractions wrack her body, starting from her lower back and rippling across the taut skin of her belly before retreating once more. She shakes her head, says something breathlessly in her mother tongue, then sinks back against the cushions as the wave of contractions passes. "That was a strong one... it hurts, damn it... is this how Mother felt?" Like she said, she's no stranger to this, right? "Right, right. But there's... there's a difference between seeing Mother handle things, and going through it myself." Kiyoko stops a bit to catch her breath and prepare for the next wave of contractions. "It never happened so quickly for her, either. I can practically feel myself stretching open inside." Now, maybe that's a bit more than you strictly need to know. You ruffle her ears a bit more, tell her to focus on breathing, and unless she feels something's wrong, just let what will happen — well, happen. "I know that, but the thought's... appreciated. Damn it!" It certainly is a bit of a juxtaposition, seeing the usually impeccably polite or playful Kiyoko give in to cursing, but you continue comforting her as best as you can. Bit by bit, you can see the swell of the kitsune's pregnancy slip downward, her womb visibly contracting as it squeezes down on the kit inside, then swelling back out as the contractions pass. It's a very two steps forward, one step back process for lack of a better way to describe it, and as time drags on Kiyoko becomes increasingly exhausted and breathless. By now, sweat is beading on the kitsune's forehead and on her chest, and the contractions are coming hard and fast, almost constantly as her nethers begin to bulge. "I know how this is supposed to happen," Kiyoko whimpers breathlessly, more to herself than anyone else. Tears well up in her eyes as nature takes its course, running down her cheeks. "I've seen it so many times. I've helped with it so many times. But... "But... "I'm still scared..." When it does happen, it happens all at once. As the petals of Kiyoko's womanly flower part to bear fruit, you first see the top of the kit's head, followed by her ears. Another tremendous push that leaves you barely enough time to get into position, and then you're holding a tiny mewling fox kit in your hands, still wet from birth fluids and with her eyes closed as she snuffles around. It's a girl! Kiyoko doesn't have the presence of mind to reply, instead concentrating on finishing up the job at hand. There should be some warm water in the kitchen. Get that for me, for starters. Also, some of that soothing incense from the storeroom in the back. [kiyoko.numKits 2|And if you run into any of the children while you're on your way, please do your best to soothe their nerves. While they do know that they're going to have another sibling soon, they're not quite sure what's involved and can get quite... excitable. ]" All right. You'll be back soon. "Take your time. I'm not going anywhere." That's one way of putting it. Kiyoko is too dignified to scream, but the kitsune is definitely exhausted and under considerable pressure, to put it mildly. Still, if she doesn't want you to see her during the process, and you're okay with helping her in another way... best not to linger on it. Pushing aside the screen door, you step out into the hallway and break into a run. It takes a little time for you to assemble the two things that Kiyoko asked for — they are on opposite ends of the cabin, and you can't help but wonder if the kitsune specifically asked for them because she knew you'd be out for as long as possible. [kiyoko.numKits 4|It doesn't help that you bump into a few of your children out in the hallways; they look at you, saying nothing, but clearly look torn between tension and excitement at what's going on upstairs. ] By the time you've retrieved both a basin of warm water and the incense, Kiyoko is already done; as you enter, she greets you with a weak, exhausted smile and a mewling fox kit swaddled in a towel. "Come and meet your new [var0|son|daughter], [pc.name].[kiyoko.numKits 1|| She's so soft and smooth, so warm to the touch... just like silk. I'll call her Kinu.]" Setting down the basin of water and jar of incense by her side, you take a moment to hold and fuss over the newborn while Kiyoko lights the incense with a flicker of foxfire. A sharp yet soothing aroma wafts over the balcony, vaguely reminiscent of citrus, and the kitsune looks better for it. She's all right, isn't she? "I told you that I was perfectly capable of handling things on my own, [pc.name]. It's really sweet that you're concerned for me, but there's really no reason to doubt my abilities. My own mother would drop a kit in the morning and be out working the fields in the afternoon." All right, if she's sure she's fine. You hand your new [var0|son|daughter] back to Kiyoko, grab a towel off the rack, then proceed to clean up the worst of the birth fluids and afterbirth from the floor with the towel and warm water. "You know, Mother would say how she used to get this gloriously relieved feeling every time she made an addition to the family. I never quite understood it before, but I do now.""

rows.original: If she's asking you to leave and help in another way, you could take the graceful retreat and avoid the mess.
rows.translation: 如果她其实是希望你离开，然后以另一种方式提供帮助，那你大可以体面地退出，从而避免惹上麻烦。
rows.raw: "If she's asking you to leave and help in another way, you could take the graceful retreat and avoid the mess."

rows.original: Hmm. You don't often get the chance to do things as a family, so you're actually considering asking her mother to come out and play as well. That should make it more fun, right? [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |For a moment, you see something flicker across your daughter's face that's not sweet, saccharine joy — hesitation, disappointment, unease, perhaps all of the above in varying amounts. It's gone as soon as you realize it's there, but there's no doubt as to its presence. Kinu's adorable smile returns with enthusiastic vigor, her little body wiggling from side to side as she makes a show of considering the matter. "Okay! Let's go and get her, [kinu.Dad]!" |Your daughter's face brightens up at the suggestion, her soft white ears twitching like mad. "Yeah, that sounds like a really good idea, [kinu.Dad]. Mama is always saying that she's got so much work to do, but if you ask her along with me, she won't be able to say no! Come on, then — let's go!" ] With that, Kinu takes off across the open hilltop, your fox-daughter's short little legs a blur as she makes a beeline for the cabin. Pausing barely long enough to wipe her feet at the threshold, she pushes open the door and hops in with you hot on her heels. "Mama! Mama! [kinu.Dad]'s come to visit today, and we want to play! Come on out, okay? It's such a nice day outside!" With your daughter zipping around at high speeds, it doesn't take long for the two of you to home in on Kiyoko; your fox-wife is [rand |out back behind the tree hanging up laundry from a big basket. As Kinu bursts onto the scene, she serenely secures the last garment onto the clothesline, then steps off the low stool and turns to you. |by the well, drawing a bucket of water. She startles a little when Kinu bursts in on the scene, but softens her expression as she sees you coming in hot on the heels of the little ball of fluff, setting down the empty bucket by the well's side. "Oh my, oh my. If you work her up like this all day, [pc.name], she won't be able to sleep at night." Well then, you'll just have to tire Kinu out so thoroughly that she'll drop like a rock the moment she's put to bed. Does she want to help? It could be fun. |on her hands and knees in one of the hallways, polishing the wooden floor to a shine. It's amazing how she can do such a thing with merely what looks to be a simple rag and water, but Kiyoko is always full of surprises. She sets aside the rag and looks up as Kinu approaches, annoyance creasing her features, but sighs and relents as she sees you hot on your daughter's heels. "It's good that I was just finishing up, because otherwise I'd have to worry about what mischief the both of you were up to while working." Mischief? Well then, it looks like you'll have to make her an accomplice as well and get her to partake in your dastardly deeds. That way she can have some much-needed fun while keeping an eye on the both of you. "Ehehe." Acquiescing resignation crosses your fox-wife's face as she puts aside the rag and bucket. "We do need to do more things together as a family, I suppose." ] "So! So! You'll play with us, Mama?" Little Kinu bounces up and down on the spot. "Oh, all right. [kiyoko.pregStage 3 |But don't expect me to chase you all over the place. You know I'll never be able to catch you when all I can do is waddle around." Kiyoko pats her big, round tummy for emphasis. "If you want to play, let's play something more... calm, shall we?" "Hee hee." "Don't you giggle at me like that, young lady. Soon enough you'll be in my shoes and you'll remember what your mother said when you were a girl. |It's not that often that your [pc.mf|father|mother] visits, after all, and we ought to tire you out nicely so you don't bother us when we're having our time alone. ]" "Eh, okay! So, [kinu.Dad], what do you want to play?" Well, that's up to her, isn't it? She's in charge of entertaining her parents and making sure everyone has a good time, and that's a pretty big responsibility. "Hmm... I know! I know! Follow me!" Kiyoko sighs a little as she [kiyoko.pregStage 3|waddles|starts] off after Kinu. "Well, here we go again." You just smile, take your fox-wife's hand in yours, and putter off to see where your daughter will lead you.
rows.translation: 嗯，平时大家很少有机会一起做些事情，所以你甚至在考虑邀请她的妈妈也一起来一起玩。这样应该会更有乐趣吧？ [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |有那么一瞬间，你看到你女儿的脸上掠过一种情绪——那并非甜蜜、矫揉造作的喜悦，而是犹豫、失望、不安，或许这些情绪都以不同的程度同时出现在她的脸上。当你意识到这种情绪的存在时，它就已经消失了，但毫无疑问，它确实出现过。不过，绮奴那可爱的笑容立刻又重新出现了，她兴奋地摇动着小身体，假装正在认真考虑这件事。 好的！我们去找她吧。 [kinu.Dad]!" |听到这个建议，你女儿的脸立刻亮了起来，她那柔软洁白的耳朵也兴奋地抽动着。 是啊，这听起来确实是个好主意。 [kinu.Dad]妈妈总是说她有太多工作要做了，但如果你邀请她和我一起去的話，她肯定不会拒绝的！那么，我们走吧！ ] 说着，绮奴便飞快地跑上了开阔的山顶，你那位狐狸女儿短短的腿足部在奔跑中一闪一闪，直奔小屋而去。她只在门口稍作停留，擦了擦足部，然后推开门，紧跟着你跳了进去。 妈妈！妈妈！ [kinu.Dad]他们今天来拜访我们了，我们想一起玩游戏吧！快出来吧，好吗？外面的天气这么好！ 当你的女儿以极高的速度四处奔跑时，你们很快就把目标锁定在了清子身上——你的那位狐狸妻子啊 [rand |在树的后方，有人正用一个大篮子晾晒衣物。当绮奴突然出现在现场时，她镇定自若地将最后一件衣物挂到晾衣绳上，然后从低矮的凳子上下来，转向你。 |她正在井边打水。当绮奴突然出现在现场时，她有些惊慌，但看到你紧随那个毛茸茸的小家伙之后赶来，便立刻放松了表情，然后将空水桶放在井边。 哦天啊，哦天啊。如果你一整天都这样刺激她的话 [pc.name]那样的话，她晚上就没法睡觉了。 那么，你就得把绮奴累得精疲力尽，让她一上床就能立刻睡着。她想帮忙吗？这样应该会挺有趣的。 |她正跪在走廊里，用一块看似普通的抹布和水把木地板擦得闪闪发亮。真不可思议，她仅凭这些工具就能完成这样的工作——不过，清子总是能带来各种惊喜。她放下抹布，抬头看到纪奈走过来，脸上立刻浮现出不悦的神情，但看到你也紧跟着你女儿的足部步时，她终于叹了口气，放弃了抵抗。 还好我刚好忙完了，否则我就得担心你们两个在工作时又在搞什么鬼把戏了。 调皮吗？那看来你得让她也成为你的同伙，让她参与到你的恶作剧中来。这样她就能在监督你们的同时，享受到一些她非常需要的乐趣了。 嘿嘿。 当你妻子放下抹布和水桶时，她脸上露出了顺从而无奈的表情。 我想，我们作为一家人，确实需要一起做更多的事情。 ] 那么！那么！妈妈，你会和我们一起玩吗？ 小基努在原地上下跳动着。 哦，好吧。 [kiyoko.pregStage 3 |但别指望我会到处追着你跑。你们知道，我根本抓不到你们，因为我只会摇摇晃晃地走来走去而已。 清子轻轻拍了拍自己圆滚滚的大肚子，以此来强调这一点。 如果你想玩的话，我们就玩点更……轻松点的游戏吧，怎么样？ 嘻嘻。 小姐，别那样对我笑。不久之后，你也会处在我的位置上，到那时你就会想起你母亲在你小时候说过的话了。 |这种情况其实并不常见。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲] 毕竟，这些都是来访者，我们应该把他们弄得精疲力尽，这样当我们想要独处时，他们就不会来打扰我们了。 ]" 呃，好吧！那么， [kinu.Dad]你想玩什么游戏呢？ 嗯，这得由她来决定，不是吗？她负责招待她的父母，确保每个人都能玩得开心，这确实是一项相当重要的责任。 嗯……我知道了！跟我来吧！ 清子轻轻叹了口气，然后 [kiyoko.pregStage 3|摇摇摆摆地走|开始] 在基努之后离开。 好吧，又开始了。 你只需微笑着，握住你那位狐狸妻子的手部，然后随她去看看你的女儿会带你去哪里吧。

rows.original: [rand |With Kinu headed off, your lovely fox-wife turns and gives you a wide smile. "Ah, to be young again. I wish you were here more often to see our daughter grow..." Yeah, you agree. Still, days like this help make up for it. "Mm-hmm. But the day is still far from over, as you might imagine. Come now, I think that after all this exertion, you and I have earned a little time together, don't you think?"|As Kinu scampers off, your beautiful fox-wife slinks up to you, draping herself across your [pc.chest] and planting her hands on your shoulders. "Ah, our daughter is such a rapscallion. Children are always so cheeky and playful... up until you want an afternoon nap. "Now... how about we go in and get some alone time?"] Of course, of course. Tire out the daughter first, then you get the mother all to yourself. A perfect strategy. "Ehehe." Kiyoko leads you back into the cabin, down the hallway and to the familiar sight of the sitting room. You set up the cushions while she brews the tea and gets the candies, and it's not long before the two of you are relaxing in silence, just savouring the sweetness of each other's company. Keeping up with that energetic fluffy snowball sure has taken it out of the both of you... but that's part and parcel of being a parent, isn't it? "Now," Kiyoko says as she finishes her tea, [kiyoko.pregStage 2 4|then moves her hands to rest on her increasingly pregnant tummy, having trouble fitting the fertile bump between her and the table.|the kitsune's immensely gravid tummy resting on her knees as she loosens her muscles and make herself comfortable.|then turns and gives you a warm smile.] "Shall we begin? If you play with our daughter but neglect to play with me, I might get jealous, you know..."
rows.translation: [rand |在绮奴离开后，你那位可爱的狐狸妻子转过身来，对你露出了灿烂的笑容。 啊，要能再年轻一次就好了。真希望你能多来看看我们的女儿，看看她是怎么成长的…… 是啊，你也是这么认为的。不过，这样的日子还是有助于弥补那些不足的。 嗯，不过正如你想象的那样，这一天还远未结束。来吧，我觉得经过这一切努力，你我确实应该好好享受一些属于我们的时光，不是吗？|当绮奴飞快地跑开时，你那位美丽的狐狸妻子悄悄地走到你身边，然后依偎在你的怀里 [pc.chest] 然后将双手部放在你的肩上。 啊，我们家女儿真是个调皮鬼。孩子们总是这么调皮捣蛋、爱玩耍……直到你想要小睡一会儿的时候。 现在……我们进去单独待一会儿怎么样？] 当然，当然。先让女儿累坏了，然后再把母亲据为己有。这策略太完美了。 嘿嘿。 清子带你回到了小屋，穿过走廊，来到了那熟悉的客厅。你摆好靠垫，而她则去泡茶、拿糖果。不久之后，你们俩便静静地坐在一起，尽情享受彼此的陪伴所带来的温暖与愉悦。照顾那个精力充沛的小雪球确实让你们都累坏了……但这也是为人父母不可避免的一部分，不是吗？ 现在， 清子一边喝完茶，一边说道： [kiyoko.pregStage 2 4|然后，她将双手放在逐渐隆起的腹部上，发现自己的手已经很难再把那圆鼓鼓的腹部与桌子隔开来了。|那只狐狸将那颗明显已经怀孕的肚子搁在膝盖上，放松肌肉，让自己处于最舒适的位置。|然后转过身来，对你露出温暖的微笑。] 我们开始吧？如果你和我们女儿一起玩，却忽略和我玩，我可能会吃醋的，你知道的……

rows.original: As it turns out, Kinu leads the both of you around to the little garden by the back of the cabin, treading between rows of sprouts and dark, fresh-turned earth. "Ehe. There's been something I've been wanting to show the both of you!" Well, let's see it, then. What kind of surprise does she have for you? "Give me a moment, okay?" With those words, Kinu nips off and disappears behind a nearby open-air shed, reappearing in a minute with a cloth apron tied about her waist and a nice little kerchief on her head. Practically bouncing up and down with excitement, your daughter hands both you and Kiyoko a trowel each, keeping one for herself. There's a nice outfit she's got there. "Mama says to be properly dressed when I mess with the garden, because having to wash my clothes when I come in from the forest is already enough to give her conniptions." You chuckle and turn to Kiyoko, who sniffs. "Have you ever tried to remove grass stains from wool? It's an uphill task, even with good ash soap." Ah, how precocious. So now, what does little Kinu need you to do? "I need you and Mama to help me dig up a turnip, [kinu.Dad]. I've had one in the ground for a little while now, and while I don't know how big it exactly is, I'm not quite able to pull it out by myself. So, I need some help!" Three people to pull out a turnip? Just how big is this thing supposed to be, anyway? "Well, I probably don't need both you and Mama, but I want both you and Mama to be around." Sounds a lot like work... Kinu sticks her tongue out at you. "It's not work if you have fun doing it." Haha, that sounds like something her mother would have taught her. Did she? "It's a positive attitude for anyone to take," Kiyoko says very matter-of-factly, donning a pair of thin gloves. All right, then. Let's get down to work. "Yaaaaay!" So it comes to pass that you end up on your knees by a row of turnips, carefully digging away the dirt from one particularly hefty specimen. Kiyoko instructs you on how to properly handle the trowel, while Kinu digs away like a particularly enthusiastic dog. You can tell your daughter is trying not to get dirt everywhere, especially since she's got her mother's eyes on her, but it's probably kind to say that her efforts at remaining clean leave something to be desired. This goes double when you notice that unlike her mother, she isn't wearing gloves, plus she far prefers to dig with her fingers... This is normal for her, isn't it? The vegetable gardening and all? Your fox-wife folds her arms, her expression carefully neutral. "Hmm. Back in the Old Country, flower gardening is an acceptable pastime for a young woman like her, as is bonsai. Working with mere vegetables, though, is probably going to cause some consternation if her relatives on that side of the family were to ever discover it." Well, it's a good thing she's likely to never meet them, then, what with the whole two hundred and fifty years having passed in the waking world and all. "Perhaps. Just the other day, she was pestering me to get her a rice field. I had to carefully explain to her that not only would such a thing take up far too much space, but also it would involve more work than what a single child like her was capable of. I fear that I may have just put off the problem for some years, but at least I don't have to deal with such an impossible, childish request now." She seems so enthusiastic about it, though. "If only she would display that kind of energy during her archery practice, alas. She merely puts in barely enough effort to avoid being reprimanded." The more dirt you clean off the offending vegetable, the more imposing the task reveals itself to be. What looks like a simple turnip with a few greens sticking above ground turns out to be far more than that, more and more of the root vegetable's impressive girth revealed the more the three of you dig. At length, you've uncovered an enormous white turnip, crisp to the touch, its leaves still wet with the morning dew. It's the biggest that you've ever seen, and to think so much of it was hidden under the earth. Kinu does a little excited dance. "It's humongous! Ginormous! Look, [kinu.Dad], Mama! Isn't it amazing? And so crisp, too!" You turn the massive, head-sized turnip in your hands and smile. Sheer mass aside, it doesn't have a speck of rot or blemish on it — for someone who can judge these things, it really is a work of art. Nature must really love Kinu. Kiyoko dusts off her hands, crumbs of dirt falling from her gloves. "I will admit it is something, considering the effort that went into it. I have to tell our daughter here to wash up well before coming in everyday, because she always smells of compost by the time evening comes around." "Aren't I amazing? Praise me! Praise me!" Hahaha. That sounds really familiar — like mother, like daughter, as they say. For all they try to be different on the surface, Kiyoko and Kinu really are quite similar where it counts. "Hm. I don't know..." Now, there's no need to be grumpy. It'll be but a short decade or so before her daughter wakes up one morning and realizes she's turned into her mother — exactly like her mother before her. Until then, though... Kiyoko gives you a small smile and smacks you lightly on the back of your head. "Jokes are fine in moderation, dear, but that one cut just a little too close to home." Oh no, can she ever forgive you for your indiscretions? A chuckle. "You can make it up to me when we're alone later."
rows.translation: 原来，绮奴带着你们俩来到了小屋后面的小花园，她穿梭在一排排幼苗和刚刚翻过的黑土之间。 嘿嘿，有样东西我一直想给你们俩看看！ 那我们就拭目以待吧。她究竟会为你准备什么惊喜呢？ 给我一点时间，好吗？ 说完这些话，绮奴迅速跑进了附近的一间露天棚屋，不一会儿就回来了，她腰间系着一条布围裙，头上还戴着一块漂亮的小头巾。她兴奋得几乎跳了起来，然后递给了你和清子每人一把铲子，自己也留了一把。 她穿的那身衣服可真漂亮啊。 妈妈说，我在花园里玩耍的时候一定要穿得整齐些，因为等我从森林里回来后还得洗衣服，这已经足以让她大发雷霆了。 你轻笑一声，然后转向清子，而清子则抽了抽鼻子。 你有没有试过去除羊毛上的草渍？即使使用质量好的灰皂，这也是一件非常困难的事情。 啊，真是早熟啊。那么，现在，小绮奴需要你做些什么呢？ 我需要你和妈妈帮我去挖一个萝卜。 [kinu.Dad]我在地里埋了一个东西，已经有一段时间了。虽然我不知道它到底有多大，但我一个人实在拔不出来，所以需要一些帮助！ 三个人才能拔出一颗萝卜？这东西到底得有多大才行啊？ 嗯，其实我大概并不需要你和妈妈两个人都陪在我身边，但是 想要 希望你和妈妈都能一直在我身边。 听起来像是在工作…… 绮奴对着你吐了吐舌头。 如果做这件事的过程中你能感到乐趣，那就根本不算工作。 哈哈，这听起来像是她妈妈会教她的东西。她真的这么做过吗？ 这种积极的态度，任何人都应该采纳。 清子若无其事地戴上了一副薄手部套，说道：“好吧，那我们开始工作吧。 耶耶耶！ 于是，你最终跪在了一排萝卜旁边，仔细地挖开其中一颗特别大的萝卜上的泥土。清子教你如何正确使用铁锹，而绮奴则像一只异常热情的狗一样拼命地挖着。 你可以看出，你的女儿正在努力不让自己弄得满身都是污垢，尤其是当她妈妈一直在注视着她的时候。不过，说实话，她保持清洁的努力还是有些不够到位。尤其是当你注意到，与她的母亲不同，她并没有戴手部套，而且她更喜欢用手部指来挖东西。这对她来说很正常吧？种菜这些事情…… 你的狐狸妻子双臂交叉抱在胸前，表情刻意保持中立。 嗯，在老家，像她这样的年轻女性，从事花卉园艺或盆景制作确实是一种可以接受的消遣方式。不过，如果她那边的亲戚知道了她只是在种植蔬菜，恐怕会感到非常惊讶吧。 嗯，幸好她很可能永远都不会遇到他们，毕竟在现实世界里已经过去了250年啊。 也许吧。就在前几天，她还缠着我让她弄一块稻田。我不得不仔细地向她解释，这样的东西不仅会占用太多空间，而且所需的工作量也超出了她这样一个孩子的能力范围。虽然我可能只是把这个问题暂时推迟了几年，但至少现在我不用再处理这种不切实际、幼稚的要求了。 不过，她看起来对此确实非常热情。 要是在射箭练习时她也能拿出这样的劲头来该多好啊，可惜她只是稍微花点力气，只是为了不受到责备而已。 你清理掉这种蔬菜表面的污垢越多，就会发现这项任务其实越发艰巨。原本看起来只是个长着几片叶子、埋在土里的简单萝卜，实际上远比想象中复杂得多——你们三个人挖得越深，就越能看到这种根茎类蔬菜惊人的体积。 终于，你发现了一个巨大的白色萝卜，触感脆嫩，叶子上还带着晨露。这是你见过的最大的萝卜，想想看，竟然有这么多东西隐藏在地下。 纪久兴奋地跳起了小舞。 它大得离谱！大得惊人！看， [kinu.Dad]妈妈！太神奇了吧？而且口感还这么脆嫩！ 你手部中拿着那个巨大的、有脑袋那么大的萝卜，脸上露出了笑容。除了体积庞大之外，它上面没有一点腐烂或瑕疵——对于一个能够辨别这些细节的人来说，这确实是一件艺术品。大自然一定非常喜爱绮奴。 清子拍掉手部上的灰尘，手部套上掉下了些许泥土碎屑。 我得承认，考虑到为此付出的一切努力，这个成果确实不错。我得告诉我们的女儿，每天回来之前一定要好好洗澡，因为到了晚上，她身上总是会有一股堆肥的味道。 我不是很厉害吗？快赞美我吧！赞美我！ 哈哈哈，这听起来真是太熟悉了——就像人们说的，有其母必有其女。尽管表面上她们试图表现出不同，但在关键方面，清子和小雪其实非常相似。 嗯……我也不确定…… 现在，没必要再生气了。大概再过十年左右的时间，她的女儿某个早晨醒来时会发现自己已经变成了她母亲的样子——和她母亲一模一样。不过，在那之前…… 清子对你微微一笑，然后轻轻拍了拍你的后脑勺。 亲爱的，适度的玩笑没什么问题，但那个玩笑确实有点太触到痛点了。 哦不，她能原谅你的那些轻率行为吗？ 一阵轻笑。 等我们以后单独在一起的时候，你可以补偿我。
rows.raw: ' As it turns out, Kinu leads the both of you around to the little garden by the back of the cabin, treading between rows of sprouts and dark, fresh-turned earth. "Ehe. There's been something I've been wanting to show the both of you!" Well, let's see it, then. What kind of surprise does she have for you? "Give me a moment, okay?" With those words, Kinu nips off and disappears behind a nearby open-air shed, reappearing in a minute with a cloth apron tied about her waist and a nice little kerchief on her head. Practically bouncing up and down with excitement, your daughter hands both you and Kiyoko a trowel each, keeping one for herself. There's a nice outfit she's got there. "Mama says to be properly dressed when I mess with the garden, because having to wash my clothes when I come in from the forest is already enough to give her conniptions." You chuckle and turn to Kiyoko, who sniffs. "Have you ever tried to remove grass stains from wool? It's an uphill task, even with good ash soap." Ah, how precocious. So now, what does little Kinu need you to do? "I need you and Mama to help me dig up a turnip, [kinu.Dad]. I've had one in the ground for a little while now, and while I don't know how big it exactly is, I'm not quite able to pull it out by myself. So, I need some help!" Three people to pull out a turnip? Just how big is this thing supposed to be, anyway? "Well, I probably don't need both you and Mama, but I want both you and Mama to be around." Sounds a lot like work... Kinu sticks her tongue out at you. "It's not work if you have fun doing it." Haha, that sounds like something her mother would have taught her. Did she? "It's a positive attitude for anyone to take," Kiyoko says very matter-of-factly, donning a pair of thin gloves. All right, then. Let's get down to work. "Yaaaaay!" So it comes to pass that you end up on your knees by a row of turnips, carefully digging away the dirt from one particularly hefty specimen. Kiyoko instructs you on how to properly handle the trowel, while Kinu digs away like a particularly enthusiastic dog. You can tell your daughter is trying not to get dirt everywhere, especially since she's got her mother's eyes on her, but it's probably kind to say that her efforts at remaining clean leave something to be desired. This goes double when you notice that unlike her mother, she isn't wearing gloves, plus she far prefers to dig with her fingers... This is normal for her, isn't it? The vegetable gardening and all? Your fox-wife folds her arms, her expression carefully neutral. "Hmm. Back in the Old Country, flower gardening is an acceptable pastime for a young woman like her, as is bonsai. Working with mere vegetables, though, is probably going to cause some consternation if her relatives on that side of the family were to ever discover it." Well, it's a good thing she's likely to never meet them, then, what with the whole two hundred and fifty years having passed in the waking world and all. "Perhaps. Just the other day, she was pestering me to get her a rice field. I had to carefully explain to her that not only would such a thing take up far too much space, but also it would involve more work than what a single child like her was capable of. I fear that I may have just put off the problem for some years, but at least I don't have to deal with such an impossible, childish request now." She seems so enthusiastic about it, though. "If only she would display that kind of energy during her archery practice, alas. She merely puts in barely enough effort to avoid being reprimanded." The more dirt you clean off the offending vegetable, the more imposing the task reveals itself to be. What looks like a simple turnip with a few greens sticking above ground turns out to be far more than that, more and more of the root vegetable's impressive girth revealed the more the three of you dig. At length, you've uncovered an enormous white turnip, crisp to the touch, its leaves still wet with the morning dew. It's the biggest that you've ever seen, and to think so much of it was hidden under the earth. Kinu does a little excited dance. "It's humongous! Ginormous! Look, [kinu.Dad], Mama! Isn't it amazing? And so crisp, too!" You turn the massive, head-sized turnip in your hands and smile. Sheer mass aside, it doesn't have a speck of rot or blemish on it — for someone who can judge these things, it really is a work of art. Nature must really love Kinu. Kiyoko dusts off her hands, crumbs of dirt falling from her gloves. "I will admit it is something, considering the effort that went into it. I have to tell our daughter here to wash up well before coming in everyday, because she always smells of compost by the time evening comes around." "Aren't I amazing? Praise me! Praise me!" Hahaha. That sounds really familiar — like mother, like daughter, as they say. For all they try to be different on the surface, Kiyoko and Kinu really are quite similar where it counts. "Hm. I don't know..." Now, there's no need to be grumpy. It'll be but a short decade or so before her daughter wakes up one morning and realizes she's turned into her mother — exactly like her mother before her. Until then, though... Kiyoko gives you a small smile and smacks you lightly on the back of your head. "Jokes are fine in moderation, dear, but that one cut just a little too close to home." Oh no, can she ever forgive you for your indiscretions? A chuckle. "You can make it up to me when we're alone later."'

rows.original: It doesn't take long to realize where Kinu is leading you: back to the cabin and up atop the porch. You'd imagine an active little thing like her would want to play outside, but evidently your daughter has other ideas. Stopping at the door, the little fluffball waves at you to wait on the porch, then disappears inside. "Wait here, okay? I'll go bring it out!" Bring what out, you may ask? "I have an idea," your foxy wife purrs as she lowers herself into her rocking chair. "I've never been a fan of letting kits have very many toys... much as the way I was raised myself, I far prefer to let them use their imaginations when it comes to playthings. Although..." Although? The pattering of feet on floorboards returns, and Kinu bursts back out onto the porch with something in her hands. It looks vaguely like a wooden gavel or mallet, only there's a spike at the top and a ball tied to it with string. Your firstborn fox-daughter is practically hopping on the spot, vibrating with excitement as she waves the toy about. "Ah, kendama," Kiyoko says as she rocks back and forth in the rocking chair. A small smile plays upon her lips as she [kiyoko.pregStage 3|snuggles up with her big, pregnant belly|gathers her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails in her lap] and makes herself comfortable. "Roughly translated, 'sword and ball.' Our daughter's really taken to the toy." Haha, you can see that for yourself. Kinu's delight is scrawled messily all over her face — genuine, innocent, childish joy you'll probably never see again once she grows up. "I want to show you some tricks, [kinu.Dad]!" You lean down and pet your squirmy fox-daughter between the ears. Oh, really. And where did she learn those tricks from? "Well, Mama taught me some. But I came up with most of them myself!" Oh, really. You look back up to Kiyoko, who's blushing slightly as she looks away, refusing to meet your eyes. She's always so calm and serious — you didn't think she was the kind for children's toys. "Kendama... it didn't come from my homeland, you know. One of my juniors — a peppy maiden named Komari — came up with it after watching two wolf pups play with a similar toy, carved the first piece from a fallen log. She got so excited about having a new toy to play with, she practically forgot we were supposed to be at war... to be fair, we needed some kind of distraction to take our minds off what was going on not too far from where we'd holed up. "Komari was always so excitable, just like our daughter — she insisted that I learn all the little tricks she'd come up with watching the wolf pups play with their little ball-and-cup game. So I did... we turned it into a drinking game. If you made a mistake, you took another shot of sake — I ended up under the table most nights." Hm... Kiyoko clears her throat and continues. "I don't mind our daughter playing with the kendama, really. If nothing, it's really helped her wrists and hand-eye coordination, as well as flexibility in general. It's really noticeable when put her through the forms during weapons practice." "Are you two done talking already? I wanna show you what I can do, [kinu.Dad]!" Kiyoko just chuckles. All right, all right. You crouch down so you're level with Kinu, and look her in the eye. Since she's such hot stuff, she can flaunt what she's learned. "Eeheehee! Okay, then!" For an eight year-old kit, it really is fairly impressive. Kinu's hand and wrist are a blur as she runs the gamut of a array of tricks. She starts simple, catching the wooden ball in the handle and both ends of the hammer-like head, then moves to more and more elaborate displays of manual dexterity — balancing, catching, twisting her grip mid-trick so as to allow her wrist the range of motion it needs, even going as far as to swap hands while the wooden ball's in the air. Eventually, Kinu ends up juggling the ball between both ends of the head and the handle at a rapid pace, singing a little tune in Kiyoko's mother tongue to help keep her timing. When she's done, she catches the ball in the biggest cup and lets the clack of wood hitting wood ring out over the porch. The whole affair definitely looks like one of those %"easy to pick up, incredibly difficult to master" things. Kiyoko smiles, tuts a little, and slowly claps thrice. "Decently impressive, Kinu. Why don't you let your [pc.mf|father|mother] have a try?" You? "Yeah, [kinu.Dad]! It's fine, I'll teach you!" "Look at her, she's so fired up; you don't see our daughter like that every day," Kiyoko purrs, still rocking in the chair. "You wouldn't want to disappoint little Kinu, would you? Or do you think that you can't outdo our daughter when it comes to a child's game?" Ooh, that's some nasty verbal arm-twisting she's got right there. Mother and daughter ganging up on you like that... well, it looks like you've got no choice but to acquiesce and do your best, right? "Yaaaay!" Kinu happily hands over the kendama to you, and you test the wooden toy's weight in your hand, getting a feel for it. [pc.agilityRange 50 80|It's not that bad once you get a feel for it — but for a child's toy, the kendama is surprisingly complex to handle. Kinu walks you through a number of the basics, such as juggling the ball in the air and catching it with the cup on the bigger head; it takes you a little while but you do eventually get the hang of it. When she moves on to the more complex tricks and motions, though — that's when the difficulty begins. Increasingly, you find yourself messing up more and more, with the ball slipping out of the cup, the string catching on the spike or on your wrist, your wrist shaking, or any other number of small but ultimately fatal errors that mess up your momentum. Of course, this amuses Kiyoko to no end. Even though she's trying to hide the smile behind her hand, you're pretty damn sure it's just a fig leaf and she jolly well wants you to know her mirth at you making quite the silly fool of yourself in front of your daughter. "Ehehehe. Don't worry, [kinu.Dad]," Kinu says after you fail for the last time at a particularly complex motion. Standing on tiptoe in order to reach your shoulder, she gives you a series of reassuring pats before plucking the toy from your hands. "You're actually pretty good at this. Not as good as Mama or I am, but then again you haven't had much experience with the kendama. Don't worry about it too much." Yeah, she's right. Besides, it was fun having her trying to teach you something for once, and that's what really matters here.|It may not be an extension of your body, but you do as much as you can within the moment's notice that you have. Kinu walks you through some of the basics — catching the ball in each of the three cups, spearing the ball through its hole with the pointy end — then quickly moves on to more complex tricks when you quickly and easily master the basics. "Eeheehee. I know I'm supposed to be the one who picks things up quickly, [kinu.Dad], but this is pretty good. Let's see if you can do this..." And you do. You flip, twist and turn your wrist, moving through the tricks that Kinu demonstrates first, then has you copy after careful observation. The clack-clack-clack of wood against wood sounds in the air, and before long you're flipping the cup-and-ball toy with ease, catching the ball on the side of the head and following your daughter's lead. Kinu squeals in delight and claps her hands together. "Ehe, [kinu.Dad], you're great at this!" Are you, now? One supposes that when one possesses such finesse with weapons as you do, something as simple as a child's toy is, well, child's play. You improvise a couple more tricks, much to Kinu's delight, then flip the kendama's handle in your grip and offer it back to Kinu. "Wooooow..." Heh, that wasn't so bad. At times, Kinu is really easy to impress.|If it were anything like the hammer or mallet it so resembles, the kendama would be easy for you. Of course, it's nothing like such. Kinu is ever patient, but while you manage to the first few simplest tricks she shows you down, the rest has you struggling with increasing complexity — and the more annoyed you grow with your repeated failure in front of your foxy wife and daughter, the harder it is to keep your fingers from trembling and wrist from shaking. At length, you feel eyes on the back of your neck, and turn to find Kiyoko amused to no end. Even though she's trying to hide the smile behind her hand, you're pretty damn sure it's just a fig leaf and she jolly well wants you to know her mirth at you making quite the silly fool of yourself in front of your daughter. Catching your eye, she gives you a small wink, clearly telling you that there's no point trying to save face in front of Kinu here. Even so... you have to try, if it's only for your sweet daughter's sake. And so you do, for a few more tries until Kinu gives you a sheepish smile and plucks the kendama from your hand. "It's fine, [kinu.Dad]. I just need more practice in tutoring others — it's a skill I've got to cultivate." How sweet of her to offer you a way out without disgracing yourself further. Sighing, you pet Kinu between the ears, and offer her a few empty words of encouragement. She'll get better at this, you're sure of it. Or at least, you might... ] "I know, I know! You have a go too, Mama! Everyone else already has!" Kiyoko swivels her gaze towards her daughter and chortles. "Oh, you want me to join in?" Well, it's a family affair. Besides, since your lovely fox-wife is so adorable, it only makes sense for her to be young at heart, isn't it? After all, being sprightly inside and able to see the fun in things will only reflect well upon her complexion when it shines forth from her. "Please, Mama!" "Ah, well. Since I'm being ganged up upon, I suppose I have no choice. [kiyoko.pregStage 3|I'll go ahead and make a fool of myself, being as unwieldy as I am right now.|I'll entertain the two of you with a little of what I know.]" With that, Kiyoko reaches out for the kendama with one of her tails. Kinu is quick to pass it along to her mother, and your lovely kitsune wife turns the wooden toy over in her hand, a small, wistful look in her eyes. "Oh, Komari. You must be long dead by now..." Still reclining in the rocking chair, Kiyoko gives the kendama's handle a small kiss, then sets herself into motion. Like Kinu and you beforehand, she starts with a series of simple catches with all three cups on the toy, then starts juggling the ball with skilled expertise. [kiyoko.pregStage 3|Even with her huge pregnant belly in the way|Even leaning in the rocking chair as she is], Kiyoko is considerably adroit at fiddling with the children's toy, the red wooden ball a blur as it spins and clacks away. "Eh, Mama, you're great!" "Oh my, that's the first praise I've had from you in a while. Usually it's the other way round, as it should be, but I still feel all good and warm inside. Well then, watch this." Kiyoko still doesn't move from the spot, but that's no issue when one has tails as lovely as hers. Your kitsune wife tosses the kendama into the air, and the tip of one of her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails curls about the handle and catches the toy perfectly. Kinu squeals and claps, and you yourself can't help but smile, too — perhaps recalling all the other things these fluffy tails are capable of... Still, you have to admit it's rather impressive how prehensile these fox tails are. Your kitsune wife passes the toy from one tail to the other, tossing it up and down in the air behind her, then eventually flips it into her left hand and twirls it with a flourish, spearing the wooden ball right through on the spike. Wow, truly impressive. "Why, thank you. Both Komari and I got completely wasted when playing against each other back in the day. Those were good times, and long, long past. A dim memory..." With that, Kiyoko pushes herself out of the rocking chair, [kiyoko.pregStage 3|a small sigh of effort escaping her lips as she steadies herself with her tails|a small sigh of contentment rising from her as she limbers her joints]. "Ah, that was fun, and I needed a sit-down. Kinu?" "Mama?" "Go and play for the rest of the day[kiyoko.numKits 2|, and tell the others to stay out of the house until dinnertime]. You don't have to return until the sun starts coming down — I have some business to attend to with your [pc.mf|father|mother]. Understood?" "Good girl." Kiyoko hands the kendama back to Kinu, then shoos your daughter off with a gentle push to the back.
rows.translation: 没过多久，你就明白了绮奴想要带你去哪里：回到小屋，然后来到门廊上。你可能会觉得像她这样活泼的小家伙应该更喜欢在外面玩耍，但显然你的女儿有别的想法。她在门口停了一下，冲你挥了挥手部，示意你在门廊上等着，然后就走进了屋内。 在这里等着，好吗？我去把东西拿过来！ 你可能会问：这究竟能激发出什么来呢？ 我有个主意。 你那位狡黠的妻子摇着摇椅坐下时，发出满足的呼噜声。
