rows.raw: " It doesn't take long to realize where Kinu is leading you: back to the cabin and up atop the porch. You'd imagine an active little thing like her would want to play outside, but evidently your daughter has other ideas. Stopping at the door, the little fluffball waves at you to wait on the porch, then disappears inside. "Wait here, okay? I'll go bring it out!" Bring what out, you may ask? "I have an idea," your foxy wife purrs as she lowers herself into her rocking chair. "I've never been a fan of letting kits have very many toys... much as the way I was raised myself, I far prefer to let them use their imaginations when it comes to playthings. Although..." Although? The pattering of feet on floorboards returns, and Kinu bursts back out onto the porch with something in her hands. It looks vaguely like a wooden gavel or mallet, only there's a spike at the top and a ball tied to it with string. Your firstborn fox-daughter is practically hopping on the spot, vibrating with excitement as she waves the toy about. "Ah, kendama," Kiyoko says as she rocks back and forth in the rocking chair. A small smile plays upon her lips as she [kiyoko.pregStage 3|snuggles up with her big, pregnant belly|gathers her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails in her lap] and makes herself comfortable. "Roughly translated, 'sword and ball.' Our daughter's really taken to the toy." Haha, you can see that for yourself. Kinu's delight is scrawled messily all over her face — genuine, innocent, childish joy you'll probably never see again once she grows up. "I want to show you some tricks, [kinu.Dad]!" You lean down and pet your squirmy fox-daughter between the ears. Oh, really. And where did she learn those tricks from? "Well, Mama taught me some. But I came up with most of them myself!" Oh, really. You look back up to Kiyoko, who's blushing slightly as she looks away, refusing to meet your eyes. She's always so calm and serious — you didn't think she was the kind for children's toys. "Kendama... it didn't come from my homeland, you know. One of my juniors — a peppy maiden named Komari — came up with it after watching two wolf pups play with a similar toy, carved the first piece from a fallen log. She got so excited about having a new toy to play with, she practically forgot we were supposed to be at war... to be fair, we needed some kind of distraction to take our minds off what was going on not too far from where we'd holed up. "Komari was always so excitable, just like our daughter — she insisted that I learn all the little tricks she'd come up with watching the wolf pups play with their little ball-and-cup game. So I did... we turned it into a drinking game. If you made a mistake, you took another shot of sake — I ended up under the table most nights." Hm... Kiyoko clears her throat and continues. "I don't mind our daughter playing with the kendama, really. If nothing, it's really helped her wrists and hand-eye coordination, as well as flexibility in general. It's really noticeable when put her through the forms during weapons practice." "Are you two done talking already? I wanna show you what I can do, [kinu.Dad]!" Kiyoko just chuckles. All right, all right. You crouch down so you're level with Kinu, and look her in the eye. Since she's such hot stuff, she can flaunt what she's learned. "Eeheehee! Okay, then!" For an eight year-old kit, it really is fairly impressive. Kinu's hand and wrist are a blur as she runs the gamut of a array of tricks. She starts simple, catching the wooden ball in the handle and both ends of the hammer-like head, then moves to more and more elaborate displays of manual dexterity — balancing, catching, twisting her grip mid-trick so as to allow her wrist the range of motion it needs, even going as far as to swap hands while the wooden ball's in the air. Eventually, Kinu ends up juggling the ball between both ends of the head and the handle at a rapid pace, singing a little tune in Kiyoko's mother tongue to help keep her timing. When she's done, she catches the ball in the biggest cup and lets the clack of wood hitting wood ring out over the porch. The whole affair definitely looks like one of those %"easy to pick up, incredibly difficult to master" things. Kiyoko smiles, tuts a little, and slowly claps thrice. "Decently impressive, Kinu. Why don't you let your [pc.mf|father|mother] have a try?" You? "Yeah, [kinu.Dad]! It's fine, I'll teach you!" "Look at her, she's so fired up; you don't see our daughter like that every day," Kiyoko purrs, still rocking in the chair. "You wouldn't want to disappoint little Kinu, would you? Or do you think that you can't outdo our daughter when it comes to a child's game?" Ooh, that's some nasty verbal arm-twisting she's got right there. Mother and daughter ganging up on you like that... well, it looks like you've got no choice but to acquiesce and do your best, right? "Yaaaay!" Kinu happily hands over the kendama to you, and you test the wooden toy's weight in your hand, getting a feel for it. [pc.agilityRange 50 80|It's not that bad once you get a feel for it — but for a child's toy, the kendama is surprisingly complex to handle. Kinu walks you through a number of the basics, such as juggling the ball in the air and catching it with the cup on the bigger head; it takes you a little while but you do eventually get the hang of it. When she moves on to the more complex tricks and motions, though — that's when the difficulty begins. Increasingly, you find yourself messing up more and more, with the ball slipping out of the cup, the string catching on the spike or on your wrist, your wrist shaking, or any other number of small but ultimately fatal errors that mess up your momentum. Of course, this amuses Kiyoko to no end. Even though she's trying to hide the smile behind her hand, you're pretty damn sure it's just a fig leaf and she jolly well wants you to know her mirth at you making quite the silly fool of yourself in front of your daughter. "Ehehehe. Don't worry, [kinu.Dad]," Kinu says after you fail for the last time at a particularly complex motion. Standing on tiptoe in order to reach your shoulder, she gives you a series of reassuring pats before plucking the toy from your hands. "You're actually pretty good at this. Not as good as Mama or I am, but then again you haven't had much experience with the kendama. Don't worry about it too much." Yeah, she's right. Besides, it was fun having her trying to teach you something for once, and that's what really matters here.|It may not be an extension of your body, but you do as much as you can within the moment's notice that you have. Kinu walks you through some of the basics — catching the ball in each of the three cups, spearing the ball through its hole with the pointy end — then quickly moves on to more complex tricks when you quickly and easily master the basics. "Eeheehee. I know I'm supposed to be the one who picks things up quickly, [kinu.Dad], but this is pretty good. Let's see if you can do this..." And you do. You flip, twist and turn your wrist, moving through the tricks that Kinu demonstrates first, then has you copy after careful observation. The clack-clack-clack of wood against wood sounds in the air, and before long you're flipping the cup-and-ball toy with ease, catching the ball on the side of the head and following your daughter's lead. Kinu squeals in delight and claps her hands together. "Ehe, [kinu.Dad], you're great at this!" Are you, now? One supposes that when one possesses such finesse with weapons as you do, something as simple as a child's toy is, well, child's play. You improvise a couple more tricks, much to Kinu's delight, then flip the kendama's handle in your grip and offer it back to Kinu. "Wooooow..." Heh, that wasn't so bad. At times, Kinu is really easy to impress.|If it were anything like the hammer or mallet it so resembles, the kendama would be easy for you. Of course, it's nothing like such. Kinu is ever patient, but while you manage to the first few simplest tricks she shows you down, the rest has you struggling with increasing complexity — and the more annoyed you grow with your repeated failure in front of your foxy wife and daughter, the harder it is to keep your fingers from trembling and wrist from shaking. At length, you feel eyes on the back of your neck, and turn to find Kiyoko amused to no end. Even though she's trying to hide the smile behind her hand, you're pretty damn sure it's just a fig leaf and she jolly well wants you to know her mirth at you making quite the silly fool of yourself in front of your daughter. Catching your eye, she gives you a small wink, clearly telling you that there's no point trying to save face in front of Kinu here. Even so... you have to try, if it's only for your sweet daughter's sake. And so you do, for a few more tries until Kinu gives you a sheepish smile and plucks the kendama from your hand. "It's fine, [kinu.Dad]. I just need more practice in tutoring others — it's a skill I've got to cultivate." How sweet of her to offer you a way out without disgracing yourself further. Sighing, you pet Kinu between the ears, and offer her a few empty words of encouragement. She'll get better at this, you're sure of it. Or at least, you might... ] "I know, I know! You have a go too, Mama! Everyone else already has!" Kiyoko swivels her gaze towards her daughter and chortles. "Oh, you want me to join in?" Well, it's a family affair. Besides, since your lovely fox-wife is so adorable, it only makes sense for her to be young at heart, isn't it? After all, being sprightly inside and able to see the fun in things will only reflect well upon her complexion when it shines forth from her. "Please, Mama!" "Ah, well. Since I'm being ganged up upon, I suppose I have no choice. [kiyoko.pregStage 3|I'll go ahead and make a fool of myself, being as unwieldy as I am right now.|I'll entertain the two of you with a little of what I know.]" With that, Kiyoko reaches out for the kendama with one of her tails. Kinu is quick to pass it along to her mother, and your lovely kitsune wife turns the wooden toy over in her hand, a small, wistful look in her eyes. "Oh, Komari. You must be long dead by now..." Still reclining in the rocking chair, Kiyoko gives the kendama's handle a small kiss, then sets herself into motion. Like Kinu and you beforehand, she starts with a series of simple catches with all three cups on the toy, then starts juggling the ball with skilled expertise. [kiyoko.pregStage 3|Even with her huge pregnant belly in the way|Even leaning in the rocking chair as she is], Kiyoko is considerably adroit at fiddling with the children's toy, the red wooden ball a blur as it spins and clacks away. "Eh, Mama, you're great!" "Oh my, that's the first praise I've had from you in a while. Usually it's the other way round, as it should be, but I still feel all good and warm inside. Well then, watch this." Kiyoko still doesn't move from the spot, but that's no issue when one has tails as lovely as hers. Your kitsune wife tosses the kendama into the air, and the tip of one of her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails curls about the handle and catches the toy perfectly. Kinu squeals and claps, and you yourself can't help but smile, too — perhaps recalling all the other things these fluffy tails are capable of... Still, you have to admit it's rather impressive how prehensile these fox tails are. Your kitsune wife passes the toy from one tail to the other, tossing it up and down in the air behind her, then eventually flips it into her left hand and twirls it with a flourish, spearing the wooden ball right through on the spike. Wow, truly impressive. "Why, thank you. Both Komari and I got completely wasted when playing against each other back in the day. Those were good times, and long, long past. A dim memory..." With that, Kiyoko pushes herself out of the rocking chair, [kiyoko.pregStage 3|a small sigh of effort escaping her lips as she steadies herself with her tails|a small sigh of contentment rising from her as she limbers her joints]. "Ah, that was fun, and I needed a sit-down. Kinu?" "Mama?" "Go and play for the rest of the day[kiyoko.numKits 2|, and tell the others to stay out of the house until dinnertime]. You don't have to return until the sun starts coming down — I have some business to attend to with your [pc.mf|father|mother]. Understood?" "Good girl." Kiyoko hands the kendama back to Kinu, then shoos your daughter off with a gentle push to the back."

rows.original: As it so happens, your daughter leads you back to the cabin, clambering up to the porch with the both of you on her heels. Throwing open the front door, she peeks inside, then darts in. "Wait here, okay?" "Kinu! Make sure your feet are clean! You're the one who's going to have to polish the floor later, you know!" "Okay!" comes Kinu's fading reply. Shaking her head and tutting, Kiyoko leans against you and wraps one of her tails about your leg, pressing the warmth of her body against you through her silken garments.[kiyoko.pregStage 3| Your lovely fox-wife snuggles the warm weight of her big pregnant belly against your side, bringing back memories of where Kinu came from to begin with.] "Ah, children." She's a handful? "She is indeed a handful." And as things turn out, Kinu returns with a handful of her own, a handful of small beanbags to be precise — five in total. Brightly colored and of the same make as Kiyoko and Kinu's clothes, the tightly sewn things gleam slightly in the warm sunlight as they sit in your daughter's cupped hands, the little floof herself looking up hopefully at the both of you. "Can we play otedama, Mama?" "Um, well." Kiyoko clears her throat. Is something the matter? Did Kinu make yet another breach of the convoluted web of kitsune etiquette? Kiyoko blushes, the bridge of her nose coloring as your foxy wife looks down and away. "No, nothing like that. I'm merely a little too old for otedama..." "And yet you taught me how to sew the beanbags and play the game, Mama." "Well... you're still young, my daughter. It fits you more... that, and the songs I taught you were passed down to me by my grandmother. Traditionally, you'd be taught all this by your own grandmother... but since you don't have one around, I filled in for her. It wouldn't do if you didn't learn them as the next den mother in line." "...That's still years off, though..." Kiyoko pets Kinu's ears, eliciting a happy squeal from your daughter. "All the better for you to learn everything I have to teach, then. Even with your talents, it'll take a long time." That's beyond the point, though. Here and now, you'd love it if she played a silly children's game with your daughter, no matter how juvenile it's supposed to be. A gentle sigh of mock exasperation. "But for now... I suppose I can play with the two of you." "Yaaaaay!" "Come along now, the both of you. Let's get started." Kiyoko dusts off one side of the porch by the rocking chair, then settles down on her knees[kiyoko.pregStage 3|, resting her full dome of her pregnancy in her lap]. Kinu settles in beside her mother, spilling the beanbags to the ground before her, leaving a conveniently empty spot in the circle for you to fill. It's a little awkward to sit on your knees like Kiyoko and Kinu are doing instead of on the floor like you're used to, but as the saying goes, when in Khor'minos... So, how is this played, anyway? "Watch closely, [kinu.Dad]. I'll show you!" With that, Kinu begins, bursting into a cheery children's song in her mother tongue. You don't know the words, but Kinu's definitely inherited her mother's voice... and her mother can make anything sound beautiful, let alone a language like this. With the upbeat simplicity of it all, you can't help but break into a smile as Kinu flips the beanbags up into the air one by one, catching each before it falls to the floorboards. When she reaches five, she lets them all fall to the floor, whereupon the process repeats itself. Ah, a simple children's juggling game, then. As the game progresses, the tune picks up pace, with Kinu's hands moving ever faster and faster in time with her singing — until she misses a catch, and the little beanbags come tumbling out of her hands. Your fox-daughter grins, rubs the side of her head, and sticks out her tongue at the both of you. "I messed up..." Oh, there's no need to be that serious. It's just a game, after all. "Still, when I wanted to impress [kinu.Dad] and Mama..." "Well then. I suppose it's my turn." Bending forward[kiyoko.pregStage 3| over her baby bump], your fox-wife scoops the beanbags towards her and picks one up to study it. "This brings back memories..." It's not often that you see her melancholy like this. "Just a moment's remembrance for times gone by." Kiyoko smiles a small, thin-lipped smile, and then starts the game, her beautiful, flute-like voice breaking into lively song as she starts tossing the beanbags into the air and catching them. It's not long before Kinu joins in the singing alongside her mother, and as the pace of game and melody alike pick up you can't help but start clapping along, too. Your fox-wife lasts a good while longer than your daughter does, her hands moving with easy alacrity as she tosses and catches the beanbags, her fingers a blur. After about eight rounds of this, though, she simply can't keep up with the music and fumbles, beanbags scattering all over the floor; bosom heaving from the exhilaration of it all, Kiyoko settles back and pushes the beanbags towards you. "Your turn, [pc.name]. [kiyoko.pregStage 3|That took a lot out of me... expectant mothers aren't supposed to move this quickly, ehehe.|I'm all tired out, but then again, this is a game for young girls...]" You look between your fox-wife and daughter, and the big smiles on their faces. Yep, there's no way you're squirming out of this one. "Come on, [kinu.Dad], give it a go!" It's rather embarrassing, since you don't know the language... "Oh, is that all?" Kiyoko snuggles up to you, chuckling. "We'll sing for you, if that's what you want." Well... "Well, [kinu.Dad]?" Well, you wouldn't mind. Far from it being you to deny your daughter when she asks so politely. "Ehehehe. Okay!" As one, mother and daughter break into song, the upbeat, lively music ringing in the porch as you start juggling the little beanbags in time with it. Sure, you may not know a word of the language, but the tune is enough to make your fingers feel light and set your heart skipping — there's a certain peace to the world like this, just tossing and catching little beanbags in front of your foxy family while they sing and clap along. [pc.agilityRange 40 80 |Strangely enough — or perhaps not — it's fun. The motions of juggling the brightly colored silk beanbags in the air is repetitive enough that you can really bask in this soothing atmosphere; mother and daughter make a great duet when they actually try to work together. [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0|If only they were comfortable with doing it more; their voices are truly heavenly. Truth be told, you ought to be honored; it's not that often that mother and daughter work together spontaneously like this — and all for you.|You'd ask them to sing for you more, especially in this native language of theirs, but requesting it specifically would... well, it wouldn't feel like it came from the heart, would it?] They're not picking up the pace of the tune as quickly as they ought to, you can tell. You may not be as familiar with this odetama game as they are, but that much is obvious to you; they want to drag it out as much as you do. It's both flattering and heartwarming at the same time. Up and down, up and down; each time all five beanbags find their way into your hand, you roll them out onto the floor again, and the game begins anew at a faster tempo. The movements of the silken beanbags through the air are strangely slow, the singing about you strangely hypnotic. You aren't the clumsiest of people around, but even so you're not wholly sure you expected to last this long in this little game. There always comes a moment, though, when the flesh fails the spirit, and that moment is now. You throw a beanbag up, it falls down, and you see the entire motion in painful detail as the silk slips off your fingers and falls to the floorboards with a very final hiss of dry beans. The three of you stare down at the beanbag for what can't be more than a moment or two, but achingly feels like forever; then, both your foxy wife and daughter are upon you. Giggling all the while, they swat at you with their fluffy tails good-naturedly, teasing you at Kinu gathers up the fallen beanbags. "That wasn't so bad, [kinu.Dad]. You might not be as good as Mama is, but I could see you putting in the effort and taking it seriously, and that's what matters here, right?" Hah, when it comes to your cute little daughter, you'll take even play seriously. Kiyoko just chuckles. "Oh, if you would only be as serious with some other things." |After the first few rounds of juggling the beagbags one by one, the game starts to pick up in earnest. You're pretty sure that your foxy family is turning up the rhythm of their song faster than they were doing for each other, but you can't help but smile at that. Let them play at their shenanigans all they want — you'll simply outpace them with sheer skill and determination. Kinu is the first one to give in, wheezing and panting as her little voice simply can't keep up with the fast-paced tempo. Your daughter doubles over, patting her little chest as she grins sheepishly, ears folded down against her head. "Wow, [kinu.Dad]..." Kiyoko lasts three more rounds of this, and despite you giving everything you have, you're starting to feel a little hard-pressed yourself, too. As it so happens, you and your fox-wife flub your tasks at the exact same moment, you with your fingers and she with her tongue. The little beanbags fall to the floorboards as Kiyoko's melody stumbles, and for a moment silence reigns on the porch as the both of you trade mischievous glances. Looks like it's a draw, if you were ever competing to begin with. "Well," Kiyoko says as she catches her breath, her [kiyoko.numKits 16|ample|pert] bosom heaving, "at least I know where our daughter's propensity to run all over the place comes from, and it's not from my side of the family." "Eeheehee." Kinu squirms on the spot and blushes, little rosy patches fading into existence on her cheeks. "That was amazing, [kinu.Dad]! I didn't think you would be so great at odetama!" Wasn't it? These hands of yours have to fight monsters and get you out of all kinds of trouble, so it's only natural that they're great at doing what they do. See, she can discover that for herself... reaching out, you pinch your fox-daughter's cheeks lightly. They're so soft and squishy, and Kinu giggles and squeals when you tease her, her three silky tails wagging back and forth in a blur. Kiyoko just laughs behind a hand. "Oh my. If you get her worked up like this, dear, I'll have so much trouble settling her down to sleep tonight. |Sure, you're not the best at this, but you give it your all for the sake of your foxy family. Eyes trained on the thumb-length beanbags, you start tossing and catching them, perhaps moving a little more stiffly than what you'd have liked to. Kiyoko and Kinu keep time with their singing and clapping as you throw and catch, throw and catch; every time you have all five beanbags in hand, you loose them back upon the floorboards, and the game repeats itself at a faster pace. To your surprise, you last longer than you'd expected to. Maybe it's the joyous faces of your fox-wife and daughter staring intently at you, maybe it's their beautiful singing, maybe it's the fact that your body feels lighter than the poor, normally clumsy thing has any right to be. Whatever's the case, you really want to do right by Kinu, and put in every iota of furious concentration you have into this children's game, trying desperately not to fumble your movements. It's on the fifth or sixth iteration that you finally slip up and make a mistake — the beanbags are small, and you were pretty tired before heading to bed, and you really need to stop making excuses for yourself. Whatever the case, the next thing you know there's silk sliding off your fingers, and both your fox-wife and child are giggling and giving you affectionate pats. "There, there," Kiyoko says, running fingertips across your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. "It's all right. You lasted longer than I did when I was a girl learning the game at my grandmother's knees." You chuckle and shake your head. Oh, that's a high bar to clear all right. "You really tried, [kinu.Dad]," Kinu adds. "I could see it." Oh, really? Kinu sticks out her tongue teasingly. "When you [kiyoko.numKits 4|have as many little siblings as I do|get a good eye for it], it's not that hard to tell. Figuring out when someone's not really trying isn't that hard, [kinu.Dad]" "It takes one to know one." Kiyoko chuckles and pats Kinu between the ears as your little three-tailed daughter pouts. "Jokes aside, that was entertaining. I haven't felt such genuine levity in a while now." "You should smile more, Mama," Kinu pipes up. "It'll be good for your beauty." "So young, and you're already learning how to flatter. Oh, what am I to do with you? ] "All right, then, young lady. Put back your toys, and you can have the rest of the day off outside. Your [pc.mf|father|mother] and I would love to have some time alone to ourselves.[kiyoko.numKits 4| Tell your siblings that we're occupied, and not to be disturbed unless it's an absolute emergency.]" For a split second, Kinu looks as mischievous and calculating as can be, but that expression's quickly hidden by one of quiet deference as Kinu picks up the beanbags in both hands and scoot off back indoors.
rows.translation: 巧的是，你的女儿带着你们回到了小屋，她爬上门廊，你们跟在她的后面。她猛地推开门，往里面瞥了一眼，然后迅速跑了进去。 在这里等着，好吗？ 基努！一定要把你的足部擦干净！以后可是要由你来擦地板的，知道吗？ 好的！ 基努微弱的回应传了过来。 基代子摇着头，发出“啧”的一声，然后靠在你身上，将她的一条尾巴缠在你的腿上，透过她那丝滑的衣物，将她身体的温暖传递给你。[kiyoko.pregStage 3| 你那可爱的狐狸妻子将她那圆滚滚的、充满孕意的肚子紧贴在你的身侧，这一幕让人不禁回想起基努的起源之地。] 啊，孩子们。 她真是个难对付的人？ 她确实是个难对付的人。 结果，绮奴带回了几个这样的小东西，确切地说，是五个颜色鲜艳的小豆袋。这些豆袋与清子和绮奴的衣服采用同样的材质制成，缝线非常结实。当它们被放在你女儿的掌心中时，在温暖的阳轻型下会微微闪烁着轻型芒，而那个小小的毛茸茸的生物也会满怀期待地抬头看着你们俩。 妈妈，我们能玩抓人游戏吗？ 嗯，好吧。 清子清了清嗓子。 “是不是出了什么问题？难道纪奈又违反了那些复杂的狐族礼仪规范吗？” 清子的脸颊顿时泛起了红晕，她低下头，将视线移开了。 不，并非那样。只是我年纪有点大了，已经不适合玩‘おてだま’游戏了…… 可是妈妈，是你教会了我如何缝制这些豆袋，以及如何玩这个游戏的。 嗯……你还年轻，我的女儿。这些更适合你……而且那些歌曲也是我祖母传给我的。按照传统，这些都应该由你自己的祖母来教你……但既然你没有祖母在身边，我就来代替她吧。如果你不能作为下一任族长的女儿来学习这些，那可不行。 不过，那还是需要好几年的时间才行…… 清子轻轻抚摸着纪子的耳朵，这让你的女儿开心地发出了吱吱的叫声。 那样的话，你学会我所有要教你的东西反而会更好。即便你有这样的天赋，也需要花费很长时间才能掌握。 不过，这已经超出了讨论的范围了。此刻，你肯定希望她能和你的女儿一起玩一些幼稚的儿童游戏，无论这些游戏看起来有多简单、多适合小孩子玩。 轻轻地叹了口气，假装显得有些无奈。 不过目前来说……我想我可以和你们两个一起玩。 耶耶耶！ 快点吧，你们两个。我们开始吧。 清子将摇椅旁的门廊打扫干净，然后跪了下来。[kiyoko.pregStage 3|将她整个隆起的孕肚放在腿上休息]基努坐在她母亲旁边，把豆袋子散落在她面前，这样圆圈里就留出了一个空位，让你可以坐上去。像清子和小基努那样跪着坐，确实有点不太习惯，因为你们平时都是坐在地板上的……但俗话说，人在异乡…… 那么，这个游戏到底是怎么玩的呢？ 仔细看好了， [kinu.Dad]我这就给你看！ 就这样，绮奴开始用她母亲的母语唱起了一首欢快的儿童歌曲。你可能听不懂那些歌词，但绮奴无疑继承了她母亲的声音……而她母亲的声音，确实非常动听。 任何东西 听起来太美妙了，更何况这是一种如此优美的语言。它的简洁明快让人不禁会露出微笑——当绮奴一个接一个地将豆袋抛向空中，然后在它们落回地板之前接住它们时，这种感觉更是如此。 当她五岁的时候，她会让那些小物件全部掉到地上，然后这个过程就会重新开始。 啊，原来这只是一个简单的儿童杂耍游戏罢了。 随着游戏的进行，节奏会逐渐加快，绮奴的手部也会随着她的歌声变得越来越快——直到她有一次没能接住那些小物件，它们就会从她手部中掉出来，四处滚落。 你的狐妖女儿咧嘴一笑，揉了揉自己的脑袋，然后对着你们俩吐了吐舌头。 我搞砸了…… 哦，没必要那么严肃吧。毕竟这只是一场游戏而已。 不过，每当我想要给人留下深刻印象的时候 [kinu.Dad] 还有妈妈…… 那么，我想现在该轮到我了。 弯下腰来[kiyoko.pregStage 3| 凸出的腹部]你的狐妖妻子把那些豆袋子捡起来，拿了一个仔细端详起来。 这让人回忆起许多往事…… 你很少见到她如此忧郁。 只是为了纪念那些已经逝去的时轻型。 清子微微一笑，嘴角带着一丝淡淡的笑意，然后开始玩游戏。她那优美如笛声般的嗓音随着将豆袋抛向空中又接住它们的动作而变得活泼动听起来。不久之后，纪奈也加入了母亲的行列，一起唱起歌来。随着游戏节奏和旋律的加快，你也不由自主地开始跟着拍手部起来。 你的狐妖妻子比你的女儿坚持得久多了——她灵活地抛接着豆袋，手部指动作快得让人看不清。然而，经过大约八轮这样的游戏后，她终究跟不上节奏，动作变得笨拙起来，豆袋纷纷散落在地上。基约子兴奋得胸口剧烈起伏，随后她把那些豆袋推到了你的面前。 轮到你了， [pc.name]. [kiyoko.pregStage 3|那真的让我累坏了……孕妇本来就不应该这么快就做这些动作的，嘿嘿。|我累坏了，不过话说回来，这也挺正常的吧 是 一款专为年轻女孩设计的游戏……]" 你看着自己的狐妖妻子和女儿，她们脸上洋溢着灿烂的笑容。没错，这次你绝对无法逃避这个责任了。 来吧， [kinu.Dad]试试看吧！ 这确实有点尴尬，因为你并不懂这种语言…… 哦，就这些吗？ 清子依偎在你身边，轻声笑着。 如果你们愿意，我们可以为你们唱歌。 嗯…… 嗯， [kinu.Dad]?" 嗯，你肯定不会介意的。女儿这么礼貌地提出请求，你当然不会拒绝她。 嘿嘿嘿，好的！ 母女俩一起唱起歌来，欢快明亮的旋律在门廊里回荡，而你也开始跟着节奏抛接那些小豆袋。当然，你可能完全不懂这种语言，但这段旋律足以让你手部指变得灵活，让心跳加速——在这样的时刻，世界仿佛变得格外宁静，只需和你的家人一起唱歌、拍手部，一边抛接那些小豆袋罢了。 [pc.agilityRange 40 80 |说来也怪——或许也不怪吧——就是如此。 有趣在空中抛接那些色彩鲜艳的丝质沙袋的动作十分重复性，因此你真的可以沉浸在这种舒缓的氛围之中；当母女俩真正尝试齐心协力时，她们组成的组合简直太完美了。 [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0|要是她们能更乐意经常这样做该多好；她们的声音真的太美妙了。说实话，你们应该感到荣幸——母女俩能像这样自发地一起合作，而且都是为了你们，这样的机会其实并不多见。|你会希望他们再为你演唱几次，尤其是用他们自己的母语来演唱，但如果特意提出这样的要求的话……嗯，这样做似乎就显得不够真诚了，不是吗？] 你可以看出，他们并没有按照应该的速度来跟上节奏。虽然你可能不像他们那样熟悉这款游戏，但这一点你还是能明显感觉到的——他们和你一样，都想把游戏的过程拖得越长越好。 这既让人感到受宠若惊，同时又十分温暖人心。 一次又一次，每次那五个豆袋都顺利落入你的手部中，你又会把它们重新摊在地板上，于是游戏又以更快的节奏重新开始。 我也希望能有段时间能单独相处，只有我们两个人。[kiyoko.numKits 4| 告诉你们的兄弟姐妹，我们现在很忙，除非有真正的紧急情况，否则不要来打扰我们。]" 有那么一瞬间，绮奴看起来显得既调皮又充满算计，但这种表情很快就被一种安静的顺从所取代了。绮奴双手部拿起那些豆袋，然后迅速跑回了室内。
rows.raw: " As it so happens, your daughter leads you back to the cabin, clambering up to the porch with the both of you on her heels. Throwing open the front door, she peeks inside, then darts in. "Wait here, okay?" "Kinu! Make sure your feet are clean! You're the one who's going to have to polish the floor later, you know!" "Okay!" comes Kinu's fading reply. Shaking her head and tutting, Kiyoko leans against you and wraps one of her tails about your leg, pressing the warmth of her body against you through her silken garments.[kiyoko.pregStage 3| Your lovely fox-wife snuggles the warm weight of her big pregnant belly against your side, bringing back memories of where Kinu came from to begin with.] "Ah, children." She's a handful? "She is indeed a handful." And as things turn out, Kinu returns with a handful of her own, a handful of small beanbags to be precise — five in total. Brightly colored and of the same make as Kiyoko and Kinu's clothes, the tightly sewn things gleam slightly in the warm sunlight as they sit in your daughter's cupped hands, the little floof herself looking up hopefully at the both of you. "Can we play otedama, Mama?" "Um, well." Kiyoko clears her throat. Is something the matter? Did Kinu make yet another breach of the convoluted web of kitsune etiquette? Kiyoko blushes, the bridge of her nose coloring as your foxy wife looks down and away. "No, nothing like that. I'm merely a little too old for otedama..." "And yet you taught me how to sew the beanbags and play the game, Mama." "Well... you're still young, my daughter. It fits you more... that, and the songs I taught you were passed down to me by my grandmother. Traditionally, you'd be taught all this by your own grandmother... but since you don't have one around, I filled in for her. It wouldn't do if you didn't learn them as the next den mother in line." "...That's still years off, though..." Kiyoko pets Kinu's ears, eliciting a happy squeal from your daughter. "All the better for you to learn everything I have to teach, then. Even with your talents, it'll take a long time." That's beyond the point, though. Here and now, you'd love it if she played a silly children's game with your daughter, no matter how juvenile it's supposed to be. A gentle sigh of mock exasperation. "But for now... I suppose I can play with the two of you." "Yaaaaay!" "Come along now, the both of you. Let's get started." Kiyoko dusts off one side of the porch by the rocking chair, then settles down on her knees[kiyoko.pregStage 3|, resting her full dome of her pregnancy in her lap]. Kinu settles in beside her mother, spilling the beanbags to the ground before her, leaving a conveniently empty spot in the circle for you to fill. It's a little awkward to sit on your knees like Kiyoko and Kinu are doing instead of on the floor like you're used to, but as the saying goes, when in Khor'minos... So, how is this played, anyway? "Watch closely, [kinu.Dad]. I'll show you!" With that, Kinu begins, bursting into a cheery children's song in her mother tongue. You don't know the words, but Kinu's definitely inherited her mother's voice... and her mother can make anything sound beautiful, let alone a language like this. With the upbeat simplicity of it all, you can't help but break into a smile as Kinu flips the beanbags up into the air one by one, catching each before it falls to the floorboards. When she reaches five, she lets them all fall to the floor, whereupon the process repeats itself. Ah, a simple children's juggling game, then. As the game progresses, the tune picks up pace, with Kinu's hands moving ever faster and faster in time with her singing — until she misses a catch, and the little beanbags come tumbling out of her hands. Your fox-daughter grins, rubs the side of her head, and sticks out her tongue at the both of you. "I messed up..." Oh, there's no need to be that serious. It's just a game, after all. "Still, when I wanted to impress [kinu.Dad] and Mama..." "Well then. I suppose it's my turn." Bending forward[kiyoko.pregStage 3| over her baby bump], your fox-wife scoops the beanbags towards her and picks one up to study it. "This brings back memories..." It's not often that you see her melancholy like this. "Just a moment's remembrance for times gone by." Kiyoko smiles a small, thin-lipped smile, and then starts the game, her beautiful, flute-like voice breaking into lively song as she starts tossing the beanbags into the air and catching them. It's not long before Kinu joins in the singing alongside her mother, and as the pace of game and melody alike pick up you can't help but start clapping along, too. Your fox-wife lasts a good while longer than your daughter does, her hands moving with easy alacrity as she tosses and catches the beanbags, her fingers a blur. After about eight rounds of this, though, she simply can't keep up with the music and fumbles, beanbags scattering all over the floor; bosom heaving from the exhilaration of it all, Kiyoko settles back and pushes the beanbags towards you. "Your turn, [pc.name]. [kiyoko.pregStage 3|That took a lot out of me... expectant mothers aren't supposed to move this quickly, ehehe.|I'm all tired out, but then again, this is a game for young girls...]" You look between your fox-wife and daughter, and the big smiles on their faces. Yep, there's no way you're squirming out of this one. "Come on, [kinu.Dad], give it a go!" It's rather embarrassing, since you don't know the language... "Oh, is that all?" Kiyoko snuggles up to you, chuckling. "We'll sing for you, if that's what you want." Well... "Well, [kinu.Dad]?" Well, you wouldn't mind. Far from it being you to deny your daughter when she asks so politely. "Ehehehe. Okay!" As one, mother and daughter break into song, the upbeat, lively music ringing in the porch as you start juggling the little beanbags in time with it. Sure, you may not know a word of the language, but the tune is enough to make your fingers feel light and set your heart skipping — there's a certain peace to the world like this, just tossing and catching little beanbags in front of your foxy family while they sing and clap along. [pc.agilityRange 40 80 |Strangely enough — or perhaps not — it's fun. The motions of juggling the brightly colored silk beanbags in the air is repetitive enough that you can really bask in this soothing atmosphere; mother and daughter make a great duet when they actually try to work together. [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0|If only they were comfortable with doing it more; their voices are truly heavenly. Truth be told, you ought to be honored; it's not that often that mother and daughter work together spontaneously like this — and all for you.|You'd ask them to sing for you more, especially in this native language of theirs, but requesting it specifically would... well, it wouldn't feel like it came from the heart, would it?] They're not picking up the pace of the tune as quickly as they ought to, you can tell. You may not be as familiar with this odetama game as they are, but that much is obvious to you; they want to drag it out as much as you do. It's both flattering and heartwarming at the same time. Up and down, up and down; each time all five beanbags find their way into your hand, you roll them out onto the floor again, and the game begins anew at a faster tempo. The movements of the silken beanbags through the air are strangely slow, the singing about you strangely hypnotic. You aren't the clumsiest of people around, but even so you're not wholly sure you expected to last this long in this little game. There always comes a moment, though, when the flesh fails the spirit, and that moment is now. You throw a beanbag up, it falls down, and you see the entire motion in painful detail as the silk slips off your fingers and falls to the floorboards with a very final hiss of dry beans. The three of you stare down at the beanbag for what can't be more than a moment or two, but achingly feels like forever; then, both your foxy wife and daughter are upon you. Giggling all the while, they swat at you with their fluffy tails good-naturedly, teasing you at Kinu gathers up the fallen beanbags. "That wasn't so bad, [kinu.Dad]. You might not be as good as Mama is, but I could see you putting in the effort and taking it seriously, and that's what matters here, right?" Hah, when it comes to your cute little daughter, you'll take even play seriously. Kiyoko just chuckles. "Oh, if you would only be as serious with some other things." |After the first few rounds of juggling the beagbags one by one, the game starts to pick up in earnest. You're pretty sure that your foxy family is turning up the rhythm of their song faster than they were doing for each other, but you can't help but smile at that. Let them play at their shenanigans all they want — you'll simply outpace them with sheer skill and determination. Kinu is the first one to give in, wheezing and panting as her little voice simply can't keep up with the fast-paced tempo. Your daughter doubles over, patting her little chest as she grins sheepishly, ears folded down against her head. "Wow, [kinu.Dad]..." Kiyoko lasts three more rounds of this, and despite you giving everything you have, you're starting to feel a little hard-pressed yourself, too. As it so happens, you and your fox-wife flub your tasks at the exact same moment, you with your fingers and she with her tongue. The little beanbags fall to the floorboards as Kiyoko's melody stumbles, and for a moment silence reigns on the porch as the both of you trade mischievous glances. Looks like it's a draw, if you were ever competing to begin with. "Well," Kiyoko says as she catches her breath, her [kiyoko.numKits 16|ample|pert] bosom heaving, "at least I know where our daughter's propensity to run all over the place comes from, and it's not from my side of the family." "Eeheehee." Kinu squirms on the spot and blushes, little rosy patches fading into existence on her cheeks. "That was amazing, [kinu.Dad]! I didn't think you would be so great at odetama!" Wasn't it? These hands of yours have to fight monsters and get you out of all kinds of trouble, so it's only natural that they're great at doing what they do. See, she can discover that for herself... reaching out, you pinch your fox-daughter's cheeks lightly. They're so soft and squishy, and Kinu giggles and squeals when you tease her, her three silky tails wagging back and forth in a blur. Kiyoko just laughs behind a hand. "Oh my. If you get her worked up like this, dear, I'll have so much trouble settling her down to sleep tonight. |Sure, you're not the best at this, but you give it your all for the sake of your foxy family. Eyes trained on the thumb-length beanbags, you start tossing and catching them, perhaps moving a little more stiffly than what you'd have liked to. Kiyoko and Kinu keep time with their singing and clapping as you throw and catch, throw and catch; every time you have all five beanbags in hand, you loose them back upon the floorboards, and the game repeats itself at a faster pace. To your surprise, you last longer than you'd expected to. Maybe it's the joyous faces of your fox-wife and daughter staring intently at you, maybe it's their beautiful singing, maybe it's the fact that your body feels lighter than the poor, normally clumsy thing has any right to be. Whatever's the case, you really want to do right by Kinu, and put in every iota of furious concentration you have into this children's game, trying desperately not to fumble your movements. It's on the fifth or sixth iteration that you finally slip up and make a mistake — the beanbags are small, and you were pretty tired before heading to bed, and you really need to stop making excuses for yourself. Whatever the case, the next thing you know there's silk sliding off your fingers, and both your fox-wife and child are giggling and giving you affectionate pats. "There, there," Kiyoko says, running fingertips across your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. "It's all right. You lasted longer than I did when I was a girl learning the game at my grandmother's knees." You chuckle and shake your head. Oh, that's a high bar to clear all right. "You really tried, [kinu.Dad]," Kinu adds. "I could see it." Oh, really? Kinu sticks out her tongue teasingly. "When you [kiyoko.numKits 4|have as many little siblings as I do|get a good eye for it], it's not that hard to tell. Figuring out when someone's not really trying isn't that hard, [kinu.Dad]" "It takes one to know one." Kiyoko chuckles and pats Kinu between the ears as your little three-tailed daughter pouts. "Jokes aside, that was entertaining. I haven't felt such genuine levity in a while now." "You should smile more, Mama," Kinu pipes up. "It'll be good for your beauty." "So young, and you're already learning how to flatter. Oh, what am I to do with you? ] "All right, then, young lady. Put back your toys, and you can have the rest of the day off outside. Your [pc.mf|father|mother] and I would love to have some time alone to ourselves.[kiyoko.numKits 4| Tell your siblings that we're occupied, and not to be disturbed unless it's an absolute emergency.]" For a split second, Kinu looks as mischievous and calculating as can be, but that expression's quickly hidden by one of quiet deference as Kinu picks up the beanbags in both hands and scoot off back indoors."

rows.original: It's not hard to see where Kinu is leading the both of you — back to the open hilltop where you met her earlier. You can't help but wonder what kind of game she has in mind; there doesn't seem to be anything nearby but the occasional bench and parasol off in the distance. Kiyoko brings up the rear, [kiyoko.pregStage 3|huffing a little as she waddles as fast as her feet will take her. If she weren't so adamant about going the distance herself, you might very well have offered to carry her.|managing to move elegantly even at this speed.] [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |"Smaller steps, Kinu!" Kiyoko calls out after the hyperactive ball of white fur that's your daughter. "We may be in more relaxed circumstances, but even so!" It's an open hilltop, though, and Kinu's making a good show of displaying her athleticism. Is it the time and place to be minding one's elegance? Your fox-wife taps her chin. "I'd be more lenient if she minded her manners more in her everyday life. As things stand, she's already acting far too freewheelingly for someone who'll have to take on important responsibilities later on in life. Let her get used to it, and it'll be an uphill task to change this attitude once it becomes ingrained into her personality." You understand. Still, it's kind of killing the mood... "Needs are as needs must, dear."|"Our daughter is certainly full of energy today, isn't she? Have you been giving her sweet things when I'm not looking, dear?" Well, denying it would be pointless. Yes, on occasion, and definitely in moderation. There is a line between spoiling Kinu and spoiling her rotten. "Hm." Why, is your daughter not usually energetic? "She's mature enough to know that there's a time and place for exuberance, and another for careful refinement. I'm actually quite proud of how she's learned to read situations and act accordingly. She'll need the skill, considering the responsibilities she'll be taking on later in life along with her station." ] You're about to ask more, but your attention's drawn to Kinu, who's come to a stop atop the very crest of the hill. Beaming brightly, your fox-daughter turns towards Kiyoko and you, stretching her arms wide to give the both of you a big hug about the legs — or at least, as much as her arms will allow. Ah. So this is the game that — Without warning, Kinu whistles, a short, sharp sound that rings out over the hilltop. Nothing happens for a couple of seconds, and then you see multiple sets of big, fluffy fox ears pop up from seemingly impossible places — under the benches, out of the ground, around the crest of the hill, out of little foxholes, and more. Where you thought you were alone, a small horde of Kinu's siblings have lain in wait, ready to pounce at the signal. "Kyaaaah!" That's all that Kiyoko manages to say, a most unladylike yelp as your kits swarm the both of you from all directions. Within seconds, you're smothered by a tide of squirming fluffiness, warm bodies piling up against your fox-wife and you until you're drowning in a sea of soft fur. Sure, while you know you've put quite a few kits inside of Kiyoko by now, it's nevertheless at least a little intimidating, if not sobering, when they're all gathered in one place. "[silly|Mofu mofu|So fluffy]!" Kinu squeals, nuzzling her face against your legs even as she retains her little death grip on you. "How do you like this surprise, [kinu.Dad], Mama? I took so long coordinating everyone in working together to set it up for you!" [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0|Kiyoko whimpers, sweat beading on her forehead as your fox-wife forces a weak smile. "I think my soul just tried to escape out of my mouth back there..." |Kiyoko wipes the sweat from her forehead and sighs, forcing a smile. "I can't say this is unpleasant, but at the same time I think my heart missed a beat there."] "Eehee. That's how you know you're still alive, Mama." "I feel like I should get angry at that, but I can't seem to find the heart for it. And what about you, dear?" You might have said something, but you're too busy being tickled and poked by the fluffy mass of ears and tails. Shit, each and every one of your kits is as soft and warm as their mother is... the sensation of comfortable joy is similar, but not exactly the same as the one Kiyoko manages to instil in you. It's enough to make you feel sleepy... "Okay, that's enough. I think [kinu.Dad] and Mama are kind of overwhelmed at this point..." A small chorus of disappointed voices rings out over the hilltop. "...But it felt really good while it lasted, right?" Yes. Yes, it did. Kinu's still hugging your feet and Kiyoko's to boot, and you reach down to pat her on the head. That sparks a similar demand from the nearest of your fox children, which you're obliged to fulfill, then another one, and another... Kiyoko's still breathing heavily, a little overwhelmed, but settling down fine enough. You didn't expect this from her, really. Doesn't she see the kits far more regularly than you do? You'd have imagined your positions here would be reversed. "Oh, I do, I do. But roll call is far more orderly than this. That, and it brings back other unsavoury memories. I'm fine, and I do appreciate this for what it is, so don't let me spoil your mood." Kinu snuggles in against the two of you one last time, apparently completely oblivious to the conversation taking place over her head. Her ears wiggle cutely again, and you can't help but pet them for the umpteenth time. "I love you, Mama." [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |Kiyoko deflates. "For all that you exasperate me sometimes, daughter, I do love you too." |Kiyoko gives your daughter a noogie on the forehead with her thumb. "I appreciate the sentiment, daughter, and return it just as keenly." ] Isn't that just adorable. All right, all right, that's enough for now; there is such a thing as too much of a good thing. Gently, you pry a wiggly Kinu off the two of you and set her down on the grass. You'd like to be alone with her mother for a little bit, get some private time with her. "Okay, [kinu.Dad]!" Be a good girl and take her siblings off to play, okay? With so many hands, you're sure she can find a good, fun game to keep everyone occupied. "Eehee. Okay, everyone! We've still got plenty of time in the day, so..." It's kind of awe-inspiring how your firstborn daughter simply sweeps through her siblings, the sea of warm, fluffy bodies parting to let her through as she storms to the fore and starts leading them away. By and large, the mass of warm, fluffy kits departs, leaving you and your fox-wife on the hill, thoroughly and utterly fluffified. Sheesh, and to think all that came out from between her legs. [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |Kiyoko rubs up against you and croons, trailing a finger about your shoulder. "Now, now. They may have come out of there, but I have proof right here that someone had to put so many lovely kits inside of me in the first place." |Kiyoko just purrs and cradles the huge swell of her fox-taut womb. "There's only going to be more of where that came from, you know... you're a wholehearted accomplice in this entire matter, I'll have you know." |Kiyoko sticks her tongue out at you. "I'll take that as a great compliment, then. You've been neglecting to praise me plenty of late." ] Well, she's right — you're not completely blameless. You'll call it a shared responsibility, and leave it at that. "Pervert." Guilty as charged.
rows.translation: 不难看出，绮奴正在把你们俩引向哪里——那就是你们之前相遇的那片开阔的山顶。你不禁会想知道，她究竟在策划什么；附近似乎什么也没有，只有远处偶尔出现的长椅和遮阳伞。而清子则走在最后面。 [kiyoko.pregStage 3|她气喘吁吁地加快脚步匆匆前行。要是她不是那么坚持要自己走完这段路，你很可能就会主动提出背她吧。|即使以这样的速度移动，它依然能够保持优雅的动作。] [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |步子小一点，绮奴！ 清子朝着那个活力四射、浑身覆盖着白色毛发的“小家伙”喊道——那其实就是你的女儿啊。 虽然我们现在所处的环境可能更加宽松，但即便如此！ 不过，那是一片开阔的山顶，基努正在尽情展示她的运动能力。在这种时候，还讲究什么优雅呢？ 你的狐狸妻子轻轻敲了敲自己的下巴。 如果她在日常生活中能更加注意自己的言行举止，我会对她宽容一些。但目前来看，对于一个将来必须承担重要责任的人来说，她的行为已经太过随意了。让她慢慢习惯吧，因为一旦这种态度深入她的性格，想要改变它将会非常困难。 你明白的。不过，这样确实有点破坏气氛了…… 需求就是需求，亲爱的。|我们女儿今天确实精力充沛，不是吗？亲爱的，我不在的时候你是不是给她吃了些甜食？ 嗯，否认这一点是没有意义的。没错，偶尔这样做确实没问题，而且一定要适度。在“稍微宠溺绮奴”和“把她宠坏”之间，是有一条界限的。 嗯。 怎么，你的女儿平时不都是充满活力的吗？ 她已经足够成熟，懂得什么时候该表现得热情洋溢，什么时候该谨慎而内敛。她能够根据不同场合选择恰当的行为方式，这一点让我感到非常自豪。考虑到她将来所要承担的责任以及她的社会地位，这种能力对她来说确实非常重要。 ] 你正想继续提问，但你的注意力被站在小山顶上的绮奴吸引住了。你那聪明伶俐的狐狸女儿正欢快地笑着，转向清子和你，她张开双臂，试图给你们两个一个紧紧的拥抱——至少，是她的手部臂能够达到的最大范围吧。 啊，原来这就是那个游戏…… 突然，绮奴发出了一声短促而尖锐的口哨声，声音在山顶上回荡开来。几秒钟内什么动静都没有，然后你就会看到许多一对对大大的、毛茸茸的狐狸耳朵从一些看似不可能的地方冒出来——从长椅下面、从地面中、从山顶上、甚至从那些小狐狸洞里…… 就在你以为只有自己一个人的时候，其实有一小群基努的兄弟姐妹一直在暗中等待，一旦接到信号，它们就会立刻扑上来。 哇啊！ 基约科只能发出这样一声叫声——这实在不符合一个淑女的身份。因为你的那些小家伙们从四面八方涌了过来，把你们俩都淹没在了一片柔软的毛丛之中。短短几秒钟内，温暖的身体堆满了你的狐狸妻子和你自己，你们简直被这柔软的毛皮淹没了。虽然你知道现在已经有不少小家伙钻进了基约科的身体里，但当它们全部聚集在了一起时，还是让人感到有些害怕，甚至会让人反思一些事情。 "[silly|软软的|真是太柔软了……]!" 绮奴发出吱吱的叫声，把脸贴在你的腿上，同时仍然紧紧地抓着你不放。 你觉得这个惊喜怎么样？ [kinu.Dad]妈妈，我花了好长时间来协调大家，让大家齐心协力为您准备这一切呢！ [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0|清子发出呜咽声，额头上冒出了汗珠，而你的狐狸妻子却强挤出一丝虚弱的笑容。 我觉得我的灵魂刚才差点从我的嘴里逃出来…… |清子擦了擦额头上的汗水，叹了口气，强挤出一个笑容。 我不能说这种感觉不好，但同时我也觉得自己的心跳在那一瞬间加快了。] 嘻嘻，妈妈，这就是证明你还活着的证据啊。 我觉得我应该为此生气，但却实在提不起那份劲来。你呢，亲爱的？ 你或许想说些什么，但你的注意力完全被那些柔软的耳朵和尾巴吸引住了，根本无暇他顾。天啊，你身上的每一处都被这些柔软的东西轻轻触碰着，那种感觉既舒适又愉悦……不过，这种感觉与清子带给你的那种愉悦感还是有点不同的。不过，这种感觉确实足以让你感到昏昏欲睡…… 好了，够了。我觉得 [kinu.Dad] 这个时候，妈妈和我都有点不知所措了…… 山顶上传来了几声失望的呼喊声。 ……不过在那些时刻里，那种感觉确实很棒，对吧？ 是的，确实如此。绮奴还在抱着你的足部，清子也是，于是你低头轻拍她的头。这一举动引发了你身边那些狐狸幼崽的类似请求，你不得不一一满足它们，然后又有一只幼崽提出了要求，接着又是一只…………清子的呼吸依然很急促，看起来有些不知所措，但总体来说已经慢慢恢复了平静。 你真的没料到她会做出这种事来。她不是比你更经常接触那些装备吗？你本来以为你们的处境应该是相反的才对。 哦，是的，确实如此。但是点名仪式可比现在这个有序多了。而且，它还会让我想起一些不太愉快的回忆。不过我没事的，我也确实理解你的做法，所以别因为我的话破坏你的心情哦。 基努最后一次依偎在你们两个人身边，显然完全没有注意到他们正在进行的谈话。它的耳朵又可爱地动了起来，你忍不住又第二次抚摸它们。 好事过头反而会适得其反。你轻轻地将那只扭动着的绮奴从你们两人中间分开，然后把她放在草地上。你想要和她的母亲单独待一会儿，享受一些属于你们的私人时光。 好的， [kinu.Dad]!" 好姑娘，带她的兄弟姐妹们去玩吧，好吗？有那么多人一起，她肯定能找到一些有趣的游戏，让大家都玩得开心。 嘿嘿，好了，大家！今天我们还有很多时间呢，所以…… 你的长女竟然能够如此轻松地穿过她那些兄弟姐妹们——那一片温暖、柔软的绒毛海洋自动为她让开道路，让她迅速走到最前面，开始带领其他小家伙们离开。总体来说，那些温暖、柔软的小家伙们全都离开了，只留下你和你的狐狸妻子站在小山上，浑身都被那些绒毛覆盖得软软的、暖暖的。 哎呀，想想看 那个 从她的双腿之间钻了出来。 [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |清子轻轻依偎在你身边，轻声呢喃着，同时用手指轻轻滑过你的肩膀。 现在，现在。他们可能已经从那里出来了，但我有证据证明，最初肯定有人把这么多精美的装备放进了我的体内。 |清子只是轻轻发出呜咽声，双手轻轻抚摸着自己那因怀孕而隆起的腹部。 这种情况只会越来越严重。 那个 你其实也是这件事的积极参与者，我必须让你知道这一点。 |清子朝你吐了吐舌头。 那我就把这当作一份很高的赞美吧。最近你确实很少夸奖我呢。 ] 嗯，她说得对——你也不能完全推卸责任。你就把这件事定义为一种共同的责任吧，就这样吧。 变态。 确实如指控的那样有罪。
rows.raw: " It's not hard to see where Kinu is leading the both of you — back to the open hilltop where you met her earlier. You can't help but wonder what kind of game she has in mind; there doesn't seem to be anything nearby but the occasional bench and parasol off in the distance. Kiyoko brings up the rear, [kiyoko.pregStage 3|huffing a little as she waddles as fast as her feet will take her. If she weren't so adamant about going the distance herself, you might very well have offered to carry her.|managing to move elegantly even at this speed.] [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |"Smaller steps, Kinu!" Kiyoko calls out after the hyperactive ball of white fur that's your daughter. "We may be in more relaxed circumstances, but even so!" It's an open hilltop, though, and Kinu's making a good show of displaying her athleticism. Is it the time and place to be minding one's elegance? Your fox-wife taps her chin. "I'd be more lenient if she minded her manners more in her everyday life. As things stand, she's already acting far too freewheelingly for someone who'll have to take on important responsibilities later on in life. Let her get used to it, and it'll be an uphill task to change this attitude once it becomes ingrained into her personality." You understand. Still, it's kind of killing the mood... "Needs are as needs must, dear."|"Our daughter is certainly full of energy today, isn't she? Have you been giving her sweet things when I'm not looking, dear?" Well, denying it would be pointless. Yes, on occasion, and definitely in moderation. There is a line between spoiling Kinu and spoiling her rotten. "Hm." Why, is your daughter not usually energetic? "She's mature enough to know that there's a time and place for exuberance, and another for careful refinement. I'm actually quite proud of how she's learned to read situations and act accordingly. She'll need the skill, considering the responsibilities she'll be taking on later in life along with her station." ] You're about to ask more, but your attention's drawn to Kinu, who's come to a stop atop the very crest of the hill. Beaming brightly, your fox-daughter turns towards Kiyoko and you, stretching her arms wide to give the both of you a big hug about the legs — or at least, as much as her arms will allow. Ah. So this is the game that — Without warning, Kinu whistles, a short, sharp sound that rings out over the hilltop. Nothing happens for a couple of seconds, and then you see multiple sets of big, fluffy fox ears pop up from seemingly impossible places — under the benches, out of the ground, around the crest of the hill, out of little foxholes, and more. Where you thought you were alone, a small horde of Kinu's siblings have lain in wait, ready to pounce at the signal. "Kyaaaah!" That's all that Kiyoko manages to say, a most unladylike yelp as your kits swarm the both of you from all directions. Within seconds, you're smothered by a tide of squirming fluffiness, warm bodies piling up against your fox-wife and you until you're drowning in a sea of soft fur. Sure, while you know you've put quite a few kits inside of Kiyoko by now, it's nevertheless at least a little intimidating, if not sobering, when they're all gathered in one place. "[silly|Mofu mofu|So fluffy]!" Kinu squeals, nuzzling her face against your legs even as she retains her little death grip on you. "How do you like this surprise, [kinu.Dad], Mama? I took so long coordinating everyone in working together to set it up for you!" [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0|Kiyoko whimpers, sweat beading on her forehead as your fox-wife forces a weak smile. "I think my soul just tried to escape out of my mouth back there..." |Kiyoko wipes the sweat from her forehead and sighs, forcing a smile. "I can't say this is unpleasant, but at the same time I think my heart missed a beat there."] "Eehee. That's how you know you're still alive, Mama." "I feel like I should get angry at that, but I can't seem to find the heart for it. And what about you, dear?" You might have said something, but you're too busy being tickled and poked by the fluffy mass of ears and tails. Shit, each and every one of your kits is as soft and warm as their mother is... the sensation of comfortable joy is similar, but not exactly the same as the one Kiyoko manages to instil in you. It's enough to make you feel sleepy... "Okay, that's enough. I think [kinu.Dad] and Mama are kind of overwhelmed at this point..." A small chorus of disappointed voices rings out over the hilltop. "...But it felt really good while it lasted, right?" Yes. Yes, it did. Kinu's still hugging your feet and Kiyoko's to boot, and you reach down to pat her on the head. That sparks a similar demand from the nearest of your fox children, which you're obliged to fulfill, then another one, and another... Kiyoko's still breathing heavily, a little overwhelmed, but settling down fine enough. You didn't expect this from her, really. Doesn't she see the kits far more regularly than you do? You'd have imagined your positions here would be reversed. "Oh, I do, I do. But roll call is far more orderly than this. That, and it brings back other unsavoury memories. I'm fine, and I do appreciate this for what it is, so don't let me spoil your mood." Kinu snuggles in against the two of you one last time, apparently completely oblivious to the conversation taking place over her head. Her ears wiggle cutely again, and you can't help but pet them for the umpteenth time. "I love you, Mama." [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |Kiyoko deflates. "For all that you exasperate me sometimes, daughter, I do love you too." |Kiyoko gives your daughter a noogie on the forehead with her thumb. "I appreciate the sentiment, daughter, and return it just as keenly." ] Isn't that just adorable. All right, all right, that's enough for now; there is such a thing as too much of a good thing. Gently, you pry a wiggly Kinu off the two of you and set her down on the grass. You'd like to be alone with her mother for a little bit, get some private time with her. "Okay, [kinu.Dad]!" Be a good girl and take her siblings off to play, okay? With so many hands, you're sure she can find a good, fun game to keep everyone occupied. "Eehee. Okay, everyone! We've still got plenty of time in the day, so..." It's kind of awe-inspiring how your firstborn daughter simply sweeps through her siblings, the sea of warm, fluffy bodies parting to let her through as she storms to the fore and starts leading them away. By and large, the mass of warm, fluffy kits departs, leaving you and your fox-wife on the hill, thoroughly and utterly fluffified. Sheesh, and to think all that came out from between her legs. [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |Kiyoko rubs up against you and croons, trailing a finger about your shoulder. "Now, now. They may have come out of there, but I have proof right here that someone had to put so many lovely kits inside of me in the first place." |Kiyoko just purrs and cradles the huge swell of her fox-taut womb. "There's only going to be more of where that came from, you know... you're a wholehearted accomplice in this entire matter, I'll have you know." |Kiyoko sticks her tongue out at you. "I'll take that as a great compliment, then. You've been neglecting to praise me plenty of late." ] Well, she's right — you're not completely blameless. You'll call it a shared responsibility, and leave it at that. "Pervert." Guilty as charged."

rows.original: You pull out a handful of wild berries from your possessions, and your eyes widen as you realize they're nothing like the berries you remember acquiring in the waking world. Here in the Astral Plane, the clump of simple, sweet berries has turned into a bountiful mound of fruit still wet with morning dew, an abundance of rich reds, deep purples and every other color in between. Heaped high in your hand, the berries threaten to roll off and fall to the ground at any moment, and it's with this in mind that you quickly pass the lot to Kinu, who receives them with girlish, mischievous glee. She gives them a small sniff, then her already wide smile grows downright greedy. "These smell safe enough to eat. Uguu... and they have a lovely scent, [kinu.Dad]." [pc.ra lupine|Indeed. They smell just as great to you — a wonderful medley of flavorful skins and sweet insides.|You don't have as sharp a sense of smell as Kinu does, but the joy written all over her face is good enough.] Watching Kinu eat when she's not restraining herself is a sight to behold. Not even bothering to pick the berries off the bunch, your daughter crams as much ripe fruit as she can into her mouth, pulling away and leaving but bare stems behind. Purple-red juice erupts from the corners of her mouth as she chews, trickling down her chin and running down to stain the front of her yukata; Kinu closes her eyes in giddy glee as she crushes every last drop of juice out of the berries, swallows, then opens her mouth as wide as it'll stretch to stuff another load of wild berries right in... ...Goodness, where are her manners? Another bite, and another, and then all the berries are gone. Only Kinu remains, still giddy with excitement and sticky from the slowly drying sweet juices all over her hands, mouth and clothes. "Ehehe." Her soft, white-furred ears fold forward a little. "Sorry I went a little overboard there, [kinu.Dad]. This is going to stain my clothes and fur really bad, isn't it?" Red and purple against white — oh yes, it's going to stain pretty bad, and her mother is going to make her clean it all out by herself. Kinu just grins as she squats down and wipes her sticky hands on the grass. "Ehe, it was totally worth it. Thank you for the gift, [kinu.Dad]! Do you wanna play now?"
rows.translation: 你从自己的物品中掏出一把野莓，当发现这些莓果与你在清醒世界中记忆中的那些完全不同时，你的眼睛顿时瞪大了。在星界这个地方，那些原本简单、甜美的野莓已经变成了一堆丰硕的果实，上面还挂着清晨的露水，呈现出丰富的红色、深紫色以及介于两者之间的各种色彩。 那些堆在你手部中的浆果随时都有可能掉下来，因此你赶紧把它们递给了绮奴。她接过来时，脸上带着少女般顽皮而愉悦的表情。她轻轻闻了闻那些浆果，然后她原本就宽大的笑容变得更加灿烂了，仿佛已经对它们垂涎欲滴。 这些闻起来完全像是可以食用的东西。呜呜……而且它们还散发着迷人的香气。 [kinu.Dad]." [pc.ra lupine|确实如此。对你来说，它们的味道也同样诱人——那是一种由美味的外皮与香甜的内馅共同构成的美妙组合。|你的嗅觉虽然没有绮奴那么敏锐，但她脸上洋溢着的喜悦已经足够让人满足了。] 看着绮奴在毫无节制地进食，真是让人忍俊不禁。她甚至都不费心去摘下那些浆果，只是把所有成熟的果实都塞进嘴里，然后走开，只留下光秃秃的果梗。 当她咀嚼时，紫红色的果汁从她的嘴角溢出，顺着下巴流下来，弄脏了她和服的前面；绮奴开心地闭上眼睛，把每一滴果汁都从这些浆果中榨出来，然后吞下去，接着又张大嘴巴，把更多的野生浆果塞了进去。……天哪，她这礼貌都去哪儿了？ 又吃了一口，再吃一口，转眼间所有的浆果都被吃光了。只剩下绮奴，她仍然兴奋得有些发晕，双手部、嘴巴和衣服上都粘满了逐渐变干的甜汁。 嘿嘿。 她那柔软的、覆盖着白色毛发的耳朵会微微向前折叠。 抱歉，我刚才有点做得过分了。 [kinu.Dad]这肯定会把我的衣服和毛发弄得很难看，对吧？ 红色和紫色搭配白色——哦，肯定会把衣服弄得很难洗，她的妈妈肯定会让她自己把所有东西都洗干净。 绮奴只是笑了笑，然后蹲下来，用草擦了擦自己粘糊糊的手部。 呵呵，真的非常值得。谢谢你送的礼物。 [kinu.Dad]现在想玩吗？

Purple-red juice erupts from the corners of her mouth as she chews, trickling down her chin and running down to stain the front of her yukata; Kinu closes her eyes in giddy glee as she crushes every last drop of juice out of the berries, swallows, then opens her mouth as wide as it'll stretch to stuff another load of wild berries right in... ...Goodness, where are her manners? Another bite, and another, and then all the berries are gone. Only Kinu remains, still giddy with excitement and sticky from the slowly drying sweet juices all over her hands, mouth and clothes. "Ehehe." Her soft, white-furred ears fold forward a little. "Sorry I went a little overboard there, [kinu.Dad]. This is going to stain my clothes and fur really bad, isn't it?" Red and purple against white — oh yes, it's going to stain pretty bad, and her mother is going to make her clean it all out by herself. Kinu just grins as she squats down and wipes her sticky hands on the grass. "Ehe, it was totally worth it. Thank you for the gift, [kinu.Dad]! Do you wanna play now?"'

rows.original: As you pull out the melon and present it to Kinu, you can't help but notice that it appears bigger and riper than it is in the waking world. Wild melons usually aren't that much to look at — most wild fruits aren't when compared to their domesticated counterparts — but the melon in your hands is heavy and dense, hints of gold and yellow amidst the green outer rind, far more ripe than it has any reason to be. Is this melon supposed to represent something, and if so, what? Your thoughts are cut short by Kinu hopping on the spot, arms outstretched as she tries to take hold of the melon in both hands. "Woooow, look at how big it is! It's huge! Enormous! Humongous! This has to be the bestest most greatest present in the whole world, peaches aside! Which do you think is bigger, [kinu.Dad], the melon or me?" Oh, come on. You're already going to give it to her, she doesn't have to lay it on that thickly. Besides, there's probably a reason why this melon is so huge; can she guess why? "Um..." Kinu wiggles on the spot and pretends to look thoughtful. "So that it'll last me for more than a day? That way I learn to carefully ration out my treats instead of eating them all at one go. It's a very important lesson for a child to learn, yes." No, it's because she'll learn to share with [kiyoko.numKits 4|her siblings and ] her mother. That's the lesson you wanted to impart — good effort trying to rationalise away keeping the entire melon for herself, though. "Ehe... do you have the power to read minds, [kinu.Dad]? Is that your special power?" If only. You just know her well enough to be able to guess at what she's thinking. Now then, what does she say when receiving a gift? "Thank you." There's a good girl. You hand the melon over to Kinu, who makes a show of struggling with it before setting it down on the grassy ground. The little kitsune concentrates for a moment, then with a wiggle of her three tails, the melon rises ever so slightly off the ground and begins to wobble back in the direction of the cabin. Does she promise to share it? She ought to know you'll check in with her mother about that. "Yes, [kinu.Dad]..." You reach down and give Kinu a pat between the ears. Very good. "So... do you want to play now?"
rows.translation: 当你取出那个甜瓜递给绮奴时，你不禁会发现，它看起来比在现实世界中要大得多，也成熟得更多。野生的甜瓜通常并没有那么好看——相比那些经过人工培育的果实，大多数野生水果都显得不够美观——但你手部中的这个甜瓜却显得格外重型，果肉紧密。它的绿色外皮中透出金黄色，成熟程度显然远超正常情况。 是的 这个 这个西瓜究竟代表着什么意义呢？ 就在你还在思考的时候，绮奴突然跳了起来，双臂伸开，试图用双手部抓住那个西瓜。 哇哦，看看它有多大！真的非常大！巨大无比！这绝对是全世界最棒、最了不起的礼物了，就连桃子也比不上！你觉得哪个更大呢 [kinu.Dad]这个瓜，还是我呢？ 哦，别这样。你本来就要把它给她了，她也没必要非得讨要才行。 那个 厚厚的。而且，这种瓜能长得这么大，肯定有原因吧；她能猜到原因吗？ 嗯…… 基努在原地扭来扭去，装作在认真思考的样子。 这样就能让我吃上一整天了吧？这样我就能学会有节制地享用这些零食，而不会一次性把它们都吃光。对一个孩子来说，这确实是一堂非常重要的课。 不，是因为她会学会与他人分享。 [kiyoko.numKits 4|她的兄弟姐妹们 ] 她的母亲。 那就是。 你想要传达的这个道理——不过，她试图通过理性分析来为自己保留整个“瓜”的行为，确实也体现了她所付出的努力。 呵呵……你有没有读心术的能力呢？ [kinu.Dad]那是你的特殊能力吗？ 要是那样该多好。你对她太了解了，完全能够猜出她在想什么。那么，当她收到礼物时，会说什么呢？ 谢谢。 有个好姑娘。你把那个甜瓜交给绮奴，她装作费了很大劲才把它拿到草地上。那只小狐妖集中精神了一会儿，然后轻轻摆动着她那三条尾巴，甜瓜就微微离地，开始朝小屋的方向摇晃着移动。 她会答应和你分享吗？她应该知道你会去问她妈妈的。 是的， [kinu.Dad]..." 你伸手部轻轻拍了拍基努的耳朵，说道：“做得很好。 那么……现在想开始玩吗？

rows.original: The moment you take the peach out of your possessions, Kinu freezes, your daughter's ice-blue eyes widening, her expression frozen in a stupid half-smile. Swollen till bursting with rich juice, the sweet, ripe peach looks far more delicious than anything to come out of the hilltop grove. Her ice-blue eyes as big as saucers, Kinu's gaze follows the peach unfailingly as you present it to her, completely transfixed by the treat. "Uwaaa..." Her knees are shaking and staring to go weak even as a thin thread of drool extends from her little pink tongue towards the ground. Gods, she really takes after her mother when it comes to her favorite food. She wants this, doesn't she? What does she say first? "Please?" No, in more words. "Please, may — may, um, may I have the peach?" There, there. Now she can have it. You tip the luscious, almost overripe peach into Kinu's hands, and the little kitsune lets out an overjoyed squeal of delight, ears perking up and reaching for the sky. "Oh, sweet, sweet fruit, what are you doing outside of my tummy? Let's fix that!" Hmm, you could swear you've heard that particular line before, only out of her mother's mouth... that thought is cut short, though, as Kinu wipes down the peach with the sleeves of her yukata and takes a greedy bite out of the peach, propriety all but forgotten as sweet-smelling juice erupts from the fruit and sprays into her face. Kinu giggles, practically delirious with happiness, then takes another bite, juices running all over her little face, dripping down her chin, getting into her clothes. Another bite, and another, and then she's devoured the entire thing save for the pit, which she tucks away into her clothes. "I'mf goin' to try grofwing this. Theynf whenf I'mf older, I'll be ayblef to get such yummy fruit allf day..." Well, that's one way to encourage planning ahead in a child like her. More importantly, though — what does she say after receiving a gift? "Frank oo." No, once more, this time with proper enunciation and without food in her mouth. "Thank you." For a moment, Kinu looks a little bashful, then perks up. "I promise to be good while you're away, so you can give me that as a present again someday, okay?" Now, she should know better than to beg to be bribed with food. One should exhibit good behavior not because one hopes to be rewarded, but out of one's desire for virtue. "Ehe... okay, okay, I get the idea, [kinu.Dad]. Can we go play now? I feel like I've got so much energy."
rows.translation: 当你把那个桃子从手部中拿出来的那一刻，绮奴愣住了，你女儿那冰蓝色的眼睛瞪得大大的，脸上的表情凝固成一种呆滞的微笑。那个熟透了的桃子胀得快要裂开，果汁丰富甘甜，看起来比从山顶果园里摘来的任何水果都要美味得多。绮奴的眼睛大得像碟子一样，当你把桃子递给她时，她的目光始终紧紧地盯着那个桃子，完全被这个美味的东西吸引住了。 呜哇…… 她的膝盖在颤抖，整个人似乎都快要支撑不住了，而那条细小的口水从她粉红色的小舌头上滴落到地上。 天啊，她在最喜欢的食物这方面，真的和她妈妈一模一样。她肯定是想要这个的，对吧？那她首先会说什么呢？ 请？ 不，换句话说。 请问，可以……可以让我来拿那个桃子吗？ 好了，好了。 现在 她可以拿走它。你将那个甜美得几乎有些过熟的桃子递到绮奴的手部中，这只小狐妖高兴地尖叫起来，耳朵竖得高高的，双手部伸向天空。 哦，甜美的水果啊，你们为什么不在我的肚子里呢？让我们把你们重新放回去吧！ 嗯，你简直会以为自己之前听过这句话，只不过是出自她母亲之口……不过，这个念头很快就被打断了，因为绮奴用和服的袖子擦了擦桃子，然后迫不及待地咬了一口。甜美的果汁从桃子中迸发出来，溅到了她的脸上，让她完全忘记了礼仪的存在。 纪奈咯咯地笑着，开心得几乎发狂，然后又咬了一口，果汁溅满了她的小脸，顺着下巴流下来，还浸湿了她的衣服。她又咬了一口，再咬一口，最终把整个东西都吃光了，只有果核被她收进了衣服里。 我打算试着种这种水果。等我长大了，就能整天吃到这么美味的水果了…… 嗯，这对鼓励像她这样的孩子提前做好计划确实是个不错的方法。不过更重要的是——收到礼物后，她会说些什么呢？ 弗兰克哦。 不，再试一次，这次要发音准确，而且嘴里不能含任何食物。 谢谢。 有那么一瞬间，绮奴显得有些害羞，但很快又恢复了活力。 我保证在你不在的时候会表现得好好的，这样以后你就可以再送我这个礼物了，好吗？ 现在，她应该明白，不应该再乞求用食物来贿赂自己了。一个人应该表现出良好的行为，不是因为期望得到奖励，而是因为自己内心对美德的热爱。 呃……好吧，好吧，我明白你的意思了。 [kinu.Dad]我们现在能去玩吗？我感觉自己充满了能量。
