rows.original: Tell your little brother that his affections are misdirected, and that he should get rid of the ratty old scarf.
rows.translation: 告诉你弟弟，他的感情对象选错了，他应该把那条破旧的老围巾扔掉。
rows.raw: "Tell your little brother that his affections are misdirected, and that he should get rid of the ratty old scarf."

rows.original: Ugh, fine. You really can't stand to see Tatsumi like this — while you don't think he's consciously pulling on peoples' heartstrings like you know how to do, the end result isn't that much different, is it? Feeling your stomach tighten, you look at your little brother, down at the scarf in your hands, then back to him again. "All right, all right. I'll mend your scarf for you. It isn't going to do you much good, you know — either it's going to get caught up in the laundry, or Mama will get fed up enough to rip it off your neck. I suppose I can buy it a couple months' more time, but this can't last forever." "That'll be fine, [silly|Nee-Sama|Big Sis]." "Well, if you're all right with that. Help me pack up the go board, and we can head back to the house." Tatsumi obediently helps you pick up your game, and before long the two of you are off in the direction of home. Mother's out behind the house today, tending to the herb garden, so it's a rather simple matter for the both of you to nip in and get your sewing kit. "Right, I'll see what I can do about this. I'll try my best, but no promises, okay?" "No promises." The scarf is even more of a chore to work with than first appearances led you to believe. The holes can theoretically be patched up, but the surrounding material is so threadbare and frayed that it' hard to make your stitching stick. Then there's the matter of matching the color... inasmuch as your little brother's scarf has any kind of uniform color any more. Furious concentration grips your person as you work away, darning holes and tying up loose ends as you find them. It seems like a futile task, and you're tempted more than once to tell Tatsumi that the job can't be done, but you work away nevertheless, driven by the promise of an end that's nowhere in sight. While you work, you can't help but wonder: if you were to replace all of Tatsumi's old scarf with patches and sewn-together nonsense such that none of the old material remained, would it still be the same scarf? And if it were, what difference does that make between outright replacing it, then? You shake your head; you've got to remain focused lest you prick a finger and bleed all over the scarf, or worse. It's a good couple of hours' worth of struggling with your sewing kit, but you've fixed things up as well as you think you can get them. It's nothing what Mother could have done, but Mother would've deemed it a waste of her time. You, on the other hand... You're getting too soft-hearted for your own good. In your mind's eye, you can see an endless line of broken, torn and otherwise damaged knick-knacks waiting, complete with attendant cries for your attention. "[silly|Nee-Sama|Big Sis]? You're spacing out again..." "Oh, sorry. Here you go!" If anything, the numerous patches on the scarf make it look even more worn that it was before, but Tatsumi beams as he takes it from your hands and runs his fingers down the soft fabric. It's kind of silly for him to be happy over so trivial and transient a thing, but you can't help but smile a little yourself at the sight. "Thanks, [silly|Nee-Sama|Big Sis]!" "Don't worry about it, and there's no need to consider repaying me," you say, patting your little brother on the head. "I think having the chance to do this is reward enough in itself." You know that look Tatsumi's giving you; it's the one he has when he's trying to figure out whether you're teasing him or not. Even if he never gets it right — well, not on purpose anyways — it's nice that he still makes the effort. "Ehh... I don't feel right not giving you anything in repayment. It's the Law, after all..." "Seeing you happy like this is reward enough in itself." "Now I know you're teasing me..." "Although if you really must insist, there're still some hours before dinner. If you're really that desperate to settle your debts, you can play go with me, can't you? Mama's often too busy these days..." Ha, that look on Tatsumi's face, the way he's cringing — pure comedy gold. And judging by the terrified fox noises... he really isn't that far from reverting himself. Silly little brother, but that's why you indulge him so.
rows.translation: 唉，好吧。你确实无法忍受看到塔ツミ这样的样子——虽然你认为他并没有像你那样刻意去触动别人的心弦，但最终的效果其实并没有太大区别，对吧？感到胃部一阵紧缩，你看着自己的弟弟，又低头看了看手部中的围巾，然后又把目光重新投向他。 好吧好吧，我帮你修好围巾吧。其实那围巾也没什么用——要么会被扔进洗衣篮里，要么妈妈会忍无可忍直接把它从你脖子上扯下来。我想我还能让它多用上几个月，但这种状况总不能永远持续下去吧。 那应该没问题的。 [silly|妮萨玛|大姐]." 好吧，如果你没意见的话，帮我把棋盘收拾好，然后我们就回屋吧。 龙美乖乖地帮你拿起了游戏，不久之后，你们俩便朝着家的方向出发了。今天妈妈不在家，她在屋后的菜园里忙活，所以你们俩进去拿针线包这件事就变得相当简单了。 好的，我会看看能做些什么。我会尽力而为，不过也不能保证一定能成功，好吗？ 不敢保证。 这条围巾的实际使用起来比乍看之下要麻烦得多。那些破洞理论上是可以修补的，但周围的布料已经破旧得厉害，缝线很难牢固地粘在布料上。 接下来就是颜色匹配的问题了……毕竟你弟弟的围巾现在已经完全变成了一种统一的颜色了。你全神贯注地开始修补那些破洞，把松开的线头都重新系好。 这项任务看起来似乎毫无希望，你也曾不止一次地想要告诉龙美，这个任务根本无法完成，但尽管如此，你还是继续坚持着，因为有一个遥不可及的终点在激励着你。 在工作时，你不禁会想：如果把龙美那条旧围巾上的所有旧布料都替换成补丁和拼接起来的碎片，直到原来的布料完全消失，这条围巾还会是原来的那条吗？如果还是原来的那条，那么与直接将其彻底替换掉相比，这又有什么区别呢？ 你摇了摇头，必须保持专注，否则手部指会被刺伤，鲜血就会溅得到处都是，甚至可能会更糟。虽然花了好几个小时来使用你的缝纫工具，但你觉得你已经把事情修好了。虽然这远不如你母亲能做到的那样完美，但母亲可能会认为这是浪费她的时间。 而你…… 你变得太心软了，这对你并没有好处。在你的想象中，有一长串破碎、撕坏或受到其他损坏的小玩意儿在等着你，同时还会发出各种声音，呼唤你的注意。 "[silly|妮萨玛|大姐]你又走神了…… 哦，对不起。给您吧！ 如果说有什么不同的话，那就是这条围巾上众多的补丁让它看起来比之前更加破旧了，但当龙美从你手部中接过它，用手部指轻轻触摸那柔软的布料时，他的脸上却露出了幸福的笑容。对他来说，为这样一件微不足道、转瞬即逝的东西感到高兴，似乎有点傻乎乎的，但看到这一幕，你也不由得会露出会心的微笑。 谢谢， [silly|妮萨玛|大姐]!" 别担心这个，也完全没有必要考虑偿还我。 你说得对，一边轻拍着弟弟的脑袋说道。 我认为，能够有机会做这件事本身就已经是一种足够的回报了。 你知道塔ツミ现在看着你的那种眼神吧？那就是他在试图弄清楚你是不是在逗他的时候会有的那种眼神。即使他永远都搞不清楚——至少不是故意的——但他还是会努力去尝试，这一点真的很不错。 呃……如果不给你些什么作为回报，我总觉得心里过意不去。毕竟，这是规矩嘛…… 看到你这么开心，本身就已经是一种莫大的回报了。 现在我 知道 你在逗我吧…… 不过如果你真的坚持的话，距离晚餐还有几个小时呢。如果你那么急着还清债务，可以陪我下围棋吧？这些天妈妈总是很忙…… 哈，龙司那副表情，还有他那副畏缩的样子——简直就是喜剧的黄金素材。再看看那只吓得直叫的狐狸……看来他真的快要恢复原状了。 傻弟弟，不过正因为这样，你才会一直纵容他吧。
rows.raw: " Ugh, fine. You really can't stand to see Tatsumi like this — while you don't think he's consciously pulling on peoples' heartstrings like you know how to do, the end result isn't that much different, is it? Feeling your stomach tighten, you look at your little brother, down at the scarf in your hands, then back to him again. "All right, all right. I'll mend your scarf for you. It isn't going to do you much good, you know — either it's going to get caught up in the laundry, or Mama will get fed up enough to rip it off your neck. I suppose I can buy it a couple months' more time, but this can't last forever." "That'll be fine, [silly|Nee-Sama|Big Sis]." "Well, if you're all right with that. Help me pack up the go board, and we can head back to the house." Tatsumi obediently helps you pick up your game, and before long the two of you are off in the direction of home. Mother's out behind the house today, tending to the herb garden, so it's a rather simple matter for the both of you to nip in and get your sewing kit. "Right, I'll see what I can do about this. I'll try my best, but no promises, okay?" "No promises." The scarf is even more of a chore to work with than first appearances led you to believe. The holes can theoretically be patched up, but the surrounding material is so threadbare and frayed that it' hard to make your stitching stick. Then there's the matter of matching the color... inasmuch as your little brother's scarf has any kind of uniform color any more. Furious concentration grips your person as you work away, darning holes and tying up loose ends as you find them. It seems like a futile task, and you're tempted more than once to tell Tatsumi that the job can't be done, but you work away nevertheless, driven by the promise of an end that's nowhere in sight. While you work, you can't help but wonder: if you were to replace all of Tatsumi's old scarf with patches and sewn-together nonsense such that none of the old material remained, would it still be the same scarf? And if it were, what difference does that make between outright replacing it, then? You shake your head; you've got to remain focused lest you prick a finger and bleed all over the scarf, or worse. It's a good couple of hours' worth of struggling with your sewing kit, but you've fixed things up as well as you think you can get them. It's nothing what Mother could have done, but Mother would've deemed it a waste of her time. You, on the other hand... You're getting too soft-hearted for your own good. In your mind's eye, you can see an endless line of broken, torn and otherwise damaged knick-knacks waiting, complete with attendant cries for your attention. "[silly|Nee-Sama|Big Sis]? You're spacing out again..." "Oh, sorry. Here you go!" If anything, the numerous patches on the scarf make it look even more worn that it was before, but Tatsumi beams as he takes it from your hands and runs his fingers down the soft fabric. It's kind of silly for him to be happy over so trivial and transient a thing, but you can't help but smile a little yourself at the sight. "Thanks, [silly|Nee-Sama|Big Sis]!" "Don't worry about it, and there's no need to consider repaying me," you say, patting your little brother on the head. "I think having the chance to do this is reward enough in itself." You know that look Tatsumi's giving you; it's the one he has when he's trying to figure out whether you're teasing him or not. Even if he never gets it right — well, not on purpose anyways — it's nice that he still makes the effort. "Ehh... I don't feel right not giving you anything in repayment. It's the Law, after all..." "Seeing you happy like this is reward enough in itself." "Now I know you're teasing me..." "Although if you really must insist, there're still some hours before dinner. If you're really that desperate to settle your debts, you can play go with me, can't you? Mama's often too busy these days..." Ha, that look on Tatsumi's face, the way he's cringing — pure comedy gold. And judging by the terrified fox noises... he really isn't that far from reverting himself. Silly little brother, but that's why you indulge him so."

rows.original: Indulge your little brother and mend the scarf for him.
rows.translation: 满足你弟弟的愿望，帮他修好那条围巾吧。
rows.raw: "Indulge your little brother and mend the scarf for him."

rows.original: Perhaps a more balanced approach will work better. Tatsumi can keep his scarf, but he also ought to understand that it's not valuable in and of itself. "I don't think I'm going to be able to mend this for you, Tatsumi." Your little brother bites his lip. "Y-you won't?" "It's really worn and threadbare. Mama would definitely make you throw it out, so I'd probably get into trouble if I were to even try and mend it for you. I can see where Mama's coming from; if you were a parent, would you let your kits go running around wearing worn clothes? The both of you would be soundly shamed, and rightly so." "I guess I see what you're saying, [silly|Nee-Sama|Big Sis]... and if you're saying it's okay to toss it out, I guess I don't mind if I absolutely must..." No, your dear little brother doesn't see it at all. "I'm not saying that. Sure, I'd probably get in trouble if Mama found out I'd darned your scarf, but if you do it yourself I can honestly tell her that I didn't mend it for you. See how this works?" Tatsumi's eyes light up as realization dawns, then his ears turn downwards again. "Eh... I don't know how..." You just pat him on the head. "That's why I'll teach you. I know you're a boy, but it's still good to know these things just in case you don't manage to get a wife-consort that quickly after you grow up." Keros' tails, the way he turns red all the way to his fingertips, you can't just help but tease him. You might take after [pc.mf|Father|Mother], but Tatsumi really takes after Mother, or at least in adorableness. Yeah, he's not going to stay this way forever, but that just means you should enjoy it while it lasts. "Okay..." "Come on, then. Help me pack up the board and we'll go get my sewing kit." For a moment, Tatsumi looks like he's going to protest, then tries to save himself by changing his shoulder slump into a shrug and easy grin. Together, the both of you put away the game and before long are headed for home. Mother's out behind the house today tending to the herb garden, so it's a rather simple matter for the both of you to nip in and get your sewing kit. From there, it's but another short trip back up the hill, where you lay out the tools of the trade on a bench and briefly wonder if you brought enough material to patch such a worn scarf with. "What now, [silly|Nee-Sama|Big Sis]?" "Right. So, let's begin..." Teaching Tatsumi basic needlework is exhausting, to put it lightly. Then again, every single one of your past attempts to teach anyone anything has been mentally and emotionally draining. You know you should be patient with your little brother, but each and every one of his mistakes is immensely aggravating — how can he not see the obvious when it's in front of his eyes? Explanations that should have been brief drag on forever as you have to painstakingly explain every step to him, and eventually wind up guiding his fingers when he nearly pricks them with the needle more than once. That would have caused problems, especially if the blood stained his clothes... like it or not, Tatsumi is just incapable of the intuitive leaps that you are. Well, he can leap well enough, just not land where he'd like to. Sure, it'd have been easier if you'd just taken up the needle yourself and mended his scarf with your own two hands. However, he wouldn't learn anything that way... While you know you're doing the right thing, you didn't — no, that's not right. You knew this was going to be tiring when you agreed to this. Right? Right? By and large, though, he manages. The scarf doesn't look any better than it did before — in fact, if Mother saw it right now she'd probably make him throw it out on the spot. Still, the garment feels like it has a few more months' use in it than it did before, so it's not all of a loss. Still, looking at Tatsumi trying so hard... Keros' tails, you're getting too soft-hearted for your own good. It was a good learning exercise for you, too — years down the line, you're going to have to do this for your own kits, and knowing the way things sake out it's highly unlikely all of them are going to turn out like you. Perhaps it would be wise to invest some time in finding a way to effectively communicate with those who are slower... "What do you think, [silly|Nee-Sama|Big Sis]?" You force a smile and hope it looks genuine enough. "That'll do. That'll do. It doesn't look good, but it'll hold for a while longer. Tatsumi, you know you're going to have to let go of it sooner or later, right? Mama isn't going to stand for something so threadbare around your neck." Your little brother looks sheepish at that, even as he winds the worn old scarf about his neck and starts putting back the needle and thread. "Yeah, I'll have to make sure Mama doesn't see it." "You know, it's not the scarf that's important, it's that we had fun today." Yeah, about that — the sky's taken a lovely golden color. How many hours did you spend out here with him again? "There's a lot more to learn, but at least you can try mending things yourself in the future, right?" Tatsumi nods. "I'm not so sure, but I can try..." "Well, it's about time for dinner. Let's go and put back my sewing kit, then head in — I think Mama's making inarizushi today. She's been making that a lot recently."
rows.translation: 或许采取一种更为平衡的方法会更有效。龙美可以保留他的围巾，但他也应该明白，这条围巾本身并没有什么价值。 我想我没办法帮你解决这个问题了，龙美。 你弟弟在咬嘴唇。 你、你不会吗？ 这件衣服已经破旧得不能再穿了。妈妈肯定会让你把它扔掉的，所以如果我试着帮你修补，恐怕也会惹上麻烦。我完全理解妈妈的立场；如果你是父母，你会允许自己的孩子穿着破旧的衣服到处跑吗？你们俩都会因此受到责备，这也是理所应当的。 我想我明白你的意思了。 [silly|妮萨玛|大姐]……如果你说把它扔掉也没关系，那么我想，如果实在非得这么做的话，我应该也不会介意…… 不，你亲爱的小弟弟根本没看到这一点。 我并不是这个意思。当然，如果妈妈发现是我弄坏了你的围巾，我可能会惹上麻烦，但如果你自己动手部修，那我就可以诚实地告诉她，并没有帮你修理它。这样不就行了吗？ 当塔ツミ意识到这一点时，他的眼睛亮了起来，但随后他的耳朵又重新耷了下去。 呃……我也不知道该怎么做…… 你只需要轻轻拍拍他的头而已。 这就是为什么我要教你这些。我知道你是个男孩，但掌握这些知识总没有坏处，万一你长大后没能很快找到妻子的话。 凯罗斯的尾巴，还有他那会一直红到指尖的反应，真的让人忍不住想逗他玩。说不定你以后也会变成这样呢 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]不过，龙美确实很像他的母亲，至少在可爱这一点上是一样。没错，他不会永远保持这样的状态，但这就意味着你应该在这段时轻型里好好享受它吧。 好吧…… 那好吧，来帮忙我把棋盘收拾好，然后我们去拿我的缝纫工具吧。 有那么一刻，龙司看起来像是要提出抗议，但随后他便改变了自己的姿态，耸了耸肩，露出轻松的笑容，试图让自己保持冷静。你们俩一起收起了游戏，不久之后便朝着回家的方向走去。 今天妈妈在房子后面打理草药园，所以你们俩去拿针线包应该没什么问题。之后再沿着小路爬上山坡，把工具放在长凳上，稍微想想是否带了足够的材料来修补那条破旧的围巾就行了。 现在该怎么办呢？ [silly|妮萨玛|大姐]?" 好的，那么，我们开始吧…… 说实在的，教龙美基本针线活简直让人精疲力竭。不过，回想你过去每一次尝试教别人任何东西的时候，都会在精神上和情感上带来巨大的负担。你也是这样吧？ 知道 你应该对你弟弟有耐心，但他犯的每一个错误都让人感到非常恼火——明明那些显而易见的事情就摆在他眼前，他怎么就看不见呢？本该简短的解释却要拖上很长时间，因为你不得不耐心地把他每一步该怎么做都解释清楚，最后甚至在他几次差点被针刺到的时候，还要亲手部帮他引导手部指的方向。 那个 那肯定会引起麻烦的，尤其是如果血液弄脏了他的衣服的话……不管你愿不愿意承认，龙司就是缺乏你那种直觉能力。嗯，他的跳跃能力其实挺不错的，只是总是落不到他想要的地方。 当然，如果你亲自拿起针线，亲手部为他修补围巾，事情会简单很多。但是，那样他根本学不到任何东西…… 虽然你心里明白自己做得是对的，但实际上你并没有那么做——不，这么说也不对。 知道 当你同意做这件事的时候，我就知道会很麻烦吧？对吧？ 对吧？ 不过，总体来说，他还是应付得来。这条围巾看起来并没有比之前好多少——事实上，如果妈妈现在看到它，她可能会让他立刻把它扔掉。不过，这件衣服 感觉起来…… 虽然这件物品还能再使用几个月，所以也不算完全是浪费。 不过，看到塔茨米那么努力……克罗斯，你这样心软反而不利于你自己。这对你来说也是一次很好的学习经历——将来当你需要为自己的小家伙们做同样的事情时，了解事情的发展过程会让你明白，并不可能所有事情都能像你希望的那样顺利完成。 或许，花一些时间去寻找一种与那些学习速度较慢的人有效沟通的方法，会是明智之举…… 你怎么看？ [silly|妮萨玛|大姐]?" 你强挤出一丝微笑，希望它看起来足够真诚。 这样就可以了。虽然看起来不太好看，但应该还能再用一段时间吧。龙美，你知道迟早还是得把它扔掉吧？妈妈可不会容忍你脖子上戴着这么破旧的东西的。 你弟弟看到那一幕，显得有些尴尬，他一边把那条破旧的围巾围在脖子上，一边开始把针和线放回原处。 是啊，我得确保妈妈不会看到它。 你知道，重要的不是那条围巾，而是我们今天度过了愉快的时轻型。 是啊，关于那个……天空已经变成了美丽的金色。你又和他一起在这里待了几个小时呢？ 还有很多东西需要学习，但至少将来你可以尝试自己解决问题，对吧？ 龙美点了点头。 我不太确定，但我可以试试看…… 嗯，差不多该吃晚饭了。我们先把我的缝纫工具收起来，然后再进去吧——我想妈妈今天会做鱼籽寿司，最近她经常做这个。

"There's a lot more to learn, but at least you can try mending things yourself in the future, right?" Tatsumi nods. "I'm not so sure, but I can try..." "Well, it's about time for dinner. Let's go and put back my sewing kit, then head in — I think Mama's making inarizushi today. She's been making that a lot recently.""

rows.translation: 让你弟弟自己学会修理他心爱的围巾吧。
rows.raw: "Teach your little brother to mend his beloved scarf himself."

rows.original: Some time ago and somewhere else... It's a nice, warm day — perfect for picking peaches. While it usually wouldn't have been put off this long, there've been other things to do in the past few weeks, and as such the harvest has been delayed to this point. The fruit is swollen, almost overripe, the boughs are heavy and bend ever so slightly with the weight of delicious peaches as young foxes climb up to fill baskets of delicious fruit. Except you, of course. Mother's smarter than to let you have free rein of the peach orchard with a ladder of your own. A kit having a snack or two on the job is an unavoidable part of fruit being in season; a kit stuffing herself to the point of immobilisation and severe stomachache despite knowing better is another. Getting out of work by virtue of a vice is one of the more ironic things you've come across, but you'll take it where you find it. That, and Mother didn't say not to go in and pester your younger siblings for sweet, sweet fruit... Voices. Ah, right, that's Asagiri and Aya... and between them, your little sisters have almost filled the basket, having stopped for a small break. Maybe you can wheedle a peach out of them... the sound of their voices gives you pause, though. "Hey, Asagiri..." "Hmm?" "I want to be pretty like you. How do you do it? What do I have to do?" Asagiri leans against the filled basket and thinks a moment. "Hmm... there're a lot of our sisters who're prettier than I am. Why don't you go ask them?" "Such as?" "Hmm... Shizu?" "Too skinny. She looks like the wind's going to blow her away any moment." "Well then... how about Kasumi?" Aya scowls. "Too unfriendly." "Oh well..." Asagiri thinks a moment. "Well, what about our [silly|onee-sama|big sis]? She's really pretty [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0|like a wildflower, and always active|and elegant, plus she's really refined to boot]. Mother aside, I don't think I can come up with a better example than her." Aya drops the peach she'd been holding and bursts out laughing, big, knee-slapping belly laughs as she leans against the basket. "Are you serious, Asagiri? [silly|Onee-sama|Big sis]? [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0|She's a hick, she reeks of fertiliser all the time, plus her clothes suck|She's such a fake, painting her nails, she uses far too much makeup, plus she tries to copy Mother too much with her choice in clothes]!" "..." "You see, Asagiri? You're the only one I can ask — how can I be as pretty as you are?" All right, you've had enough. Stepping out from behind the tree, you creep up behind your reprobate of a little sister, the freshly-cut grass masking your footfalls. It's but a few footsteps before you're looming behind Aya, hands folded behind your back. Asagiri's eyes go wide. "Um... uh... er..." "What's the matter, Asagiri? You've gone as white as your fur." "Aya, behind you!" You smile as your little sister spins around, your gaze locking with hers. "No wonder my ears were twitching this morning. Even if Mother didn't teach you not to badmouth others behind their backs, I should've stepped in to fill that gap in your education... ultimately, it's my fault." "D-does that mean you're not mad, [silly|onee-sama|big sis]?" You widen your smile enough to fully display your canine teeth. "Let me guess... you're reeaaallllyy mad?"
rows.translation: 很久以前，在另一个地方…… 今天天气晴朗温暖，正是采摘桃子的理想日子。虽然通常情况下采摘工作不会推迟这么久，但在过去几周里有一些其他事情需要处理，因此采摘工作才被推迟到了现在。这些桃子已经长得很大，几乎快要熟透了，树枝因为挂满了美味的桃子而变得重型，微微弯曲着；小狐狸们也会爬上树枝，把篮子装得满满的。 当然，除了你。妈妈可不会傻到让你拿着自己的梯子随意进入桃园。在工作时吃上一两样零食，这是水果当季时不可避免会发生的事情；但明知这样不好，却还是吃得撑得动弹不得、肚子疼得厉害，那就是另一回事了。 因为某种坏习惯而失业，确实是一件相当具有讽刺意味的事情，但你也只能接受这样的现实吧。另外，妈妈也没说过不准你去缠着你的弟弟妹妹们要那些甜美的水果啊。声音……啊，对了，那是浅雾和绫……而你们的小妹妹们也差不多把“篮子”装满了，只是暂时停下来休息了一下。或许你可以想办法从她们那里“骗”到一个桃子来……不过，听到她们的声音，你却有些犹豫了。 嘿，朝雾…… 嗯？ 我也想变得像你一样漂亮。你是怎么做到的？我需要做些什么呢？ 朝雾靠在装满东西的篮子上，思考了一会儿。 嗯……我们当中有很多姐妹都比我漂亮。你为什么不去问问她们呢？ 比如？ 嗯……静？ 太瘦了，看起来好像一阵风就能把她吹走似的。 那么……香澄怎么样？ 绫雅皱起了眉头。 太不友好了。 好吧…… 朝雾思考了一会儿。 那么，我们的……怎么样呢？ [silly|姐姐大人|大姐]她真的非常漂亮。 [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0|像野花一样，始终充满活力。|既优雅又高贵，而且她确实非常有修养。]除了我的母亲，我想想也找不到比她更合适的例子了。 阿雅扔掉了手部中拿着的桃子，突然放声大笑起来，那笑声响亮而开怀，她靠在篮子上，笑得前仰后合。 你是认真的吗，浅雾？ [silly|姐姐大人|大姐]? [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0|她就是个乡下人，身上总是散发着化肥的味道，而且她的衣服也很难看。|她真是个虚伪的人，涂指甲油时用的量多得离谱，还总是化很多妆；而且她在穿衣打扮上也总是试图模仿她妈妈。]!" "..." 你看，朝雾，只有你才能问我这个问题——我该如何才能变得像你一样美丽呢？ 好了，你已经受够了。你从树后走出来，悄悄地靠近你那个不听话的妹妹，新鲜的草丛掩盖了你的脚步声。没走几步，你就站在了绫的身后，双手部背在身后。 浅雾的眼睛瞪得大大的。 嗯……呃……那个…… 怎么了，浅雾？你的脸色变得和你的毛色一样白了。 阿雅，在你身后！ 当你看到妹妹转圈圈的时候，你露出了微笑，你们的目光在那一瞬间交汇在了一起。 难怪今天早上我的耳朵一直在发痒。就算妈妈没有教导过你们不要在别人背后说坏话，我也应该出面弥补你们这方面的教育缺失……归根结底，这都是我的错。 那…那是说你并没有生气吗？ [silly|姐姐大人|大姐]?" 你的笑容变得如此灿烂，以至于所有的犬齿都完全露了出来。 让我猜猜……你是不是真的非常生气？

rows.original: You loose a small, dangerous chuckle, leaning in close enough to press your nose to your little sister's. "Oh, I'm absolutely furious. But at the same time, at least you're able to speak your mind honestly, Aya. I'd rather have you be honest with disparaging words than lie to my face in order to avoid hurting my feelings. My failure to help you deal with your failings is one matter, but at least you didn't further compound them. I can give you as much credit for that." "E-eh." Aya shifts her eyes. "Does that mean you'll let me off?" "It means I'm giving you a three-second head start. Three." "H-hey. C'mon, [silly|onee-sama|big sis], it was just a joke, really —" "Two." Aya gets the hint. Squealing, she turns tail and tears off into the trees, kicking over the basket of peaches in her haste to get away. Maybe it was an accident, maybe she's trying to distract you from your vengeance with the promise of delicious fruit, but the end result is the same: Asagiri cries out in dismay, racing to save the peaches as they roll all over the grass. "One." Your bratty little sister is but a dot in the distance right now, her two tails streaming behind her as she breaks off at top speed, but that's fine. The pursuit wouldn't be any fun if it were over too soon. Taking a deep breath, you break into a sprint, feeling energy flow into your limbs and cool grass part underfoot as you tear off after Aya. Oh, this is going to be a treat all right, especially when — not if, when — you get your hands about that little pipsqueak's neck. This is so much better than chasing squirrels.
rows.translation: 你发出一声轻微而略带危险的轻笑，然后凑近了一些，把鼻子贴在了妹妹的鼻子上。 哦，我真是气炸了。但同时，至少你能够坦诚地表达自己的想法，Aya。比起为了不伤害我的感情而当面撒谎，我更希望你能用直白的言辞来说出真相。我没能帮助你改正自己的缺点，这是我的失误；但至少你没有让这些缺点变得更加严重，这一点我必须给予你肯定。 呃…… 阿雅移开了视线。 这是不是意味着你会放我走？ 这意味着我会给你三秒钟的领先时间。三秒。 嘿，等等，来吧 [silly|姐姐大人|大姐]真的，只是开个玩笑而已…… 二。 阿耶明白了这个意思。她尖叫着转身就往树林里跑去，慌忙之中还踢翻了装满桃子的篮子。也许这只是个意外，也许她是想用美味的桃子来转移你对她复仇的注意力，但结果都是一样的：朝雾绝望地叫喊着，赶忙去捡那些散落在草地上的桃子。 一。 你那个调皮的小妹妹现在只不过是远处的一个小点，她两条尾巴在身后摇摆着，正以最快的速度追赶着你们，不过这也没关系。如果追逐太快就结束了，那就太没意思了。你深吸一口气，开始全速奔跑，感受到能量涌向四肢，脚下的青草也被你踩得沙沙作响，你紧追着Aya不放。哦，这次追逐一定会非常有趣，尤其是当……不，是当 当……的时候 — 把那个小不点掐住脖子。 这样可比追松鼠有趣多了。

rows.original: "You know, despite everything you said, I'm still glad you expressed yourself honestly."
rows.translation: 你知道，尽管你说了那么多，但我还是很高兴你能够坦诚地表达自己的想法。
rows.raw: '"You know, despite everything you said, I\'m still glad you expressed yourself honestly."'

rows.original: You just chuckle and give Aya a pat on the head. Your bratty little sister cringes, clearly expecting you to have hammered her or something equally vicious, but looks surprised when the expected blow doesn't come. "[silly|Onee-sama|Big sis]?" "It's fine. I don't have to hit you or anything. The worst thing I can really do at this point is to let you go as you are, because you'll never be pretty with that rotten attitude of yours." "..." You lower your voice to a conspiratorial whisper. "You know, my dear little sister, it doesn't matter how well-proportioned you are, or how exquisite your features. So long as you harbour all these horrible thoughts in your head and let them fill your waking hours, they'll show themselves. On your face. In your posture. In your mannerisms. There's no fur oil, no skin cream that'll be able to hide resting bitch face. No matter what you do, they'll hang around you like an aura, poisoning everything you say and do." "......" "The bitterness, the sourness, the resentment, it'll pile up, snowball into a situation far worse than it began with. You won't be any more than twenty-two summers, but you'll already have the countenance of a hag. No man will agree to be your consort — at best, you might end up a concubine, and not a favored one at that. At worst, you'll just be passed around like a particularly unappetising dish that no one wants to take responsibility for." "...Bwaaaaah!" Sniffling, tears streaking down her face, your bratty little sister turns tail and streaks off into the peach grove as quickly as her little legs can take her, not looking back. You can't help but feel a small twinge of satisfaction as you stand there with arms folded, watching the inevitable play out. Asagiri winces as she watches the crying Aya vanish amidst the trees. "[silly|Onee-sama|Big sis], that wasn't just mean, that was downright cruel..." "Was it, now? Maybe it was. But if it weren't true, my words would have been utterly empty. Aya knows the truth of it — I don't think she was looking for beauty tips from you as-is, but simply validation for her rotten attitude." "You've got that little smile on your face again, [silly|onee-sama|big sis]. It's scary... you look just like Mother." "Ah. Oh. Well." You take a moment to reassert your expression, then ruffle Asagiri's fur. "Anyway, since you're all alone now and Mother's forbidden me from picking any peaches, I think you've gathered enough to head back. With a basket this big, you won't be able to fill it and drag it back all by yourself. If Mother asks, tell her I take responsibility." With that, you turn and leave, taking care to swish your tails behind you. Today's definitely going to be a good day...
rows.translation: 你只是轻笑了一声，然后拍了拍阿雅的脑袋。你那个调皮的小妹妹明显以为你会揍她或者做出什么类似的事情，但当预期的惩罚并没有发生时，她看起来很是惊讶。 "[silly|姐姐大人|大姐]?" 没关系。我并不一定要打你或者采取什么激烈的措施。在这个时候，我最糟糕的做法其实就是任由你保持现在的样子，因为以你那种糟糕的态度，你永远都不会变漂亮。 "..." 你压低声音，用一种充满阴谋意味的低语说道。 你知道吗，我亲爱的小妹妹，无论你的身材多么匀称，五官多么精致，只要这些糟糕的想法一直存在于你的脑海中，占据你的清醒时光，它们就会表现出来——体现在你的脸上、你的举止中、你的行为里。没有任何护发素、任何面霜能够掩盖这些负面情绪。无论你做什么，它们都会像一种阴霾一样笼罩着你，毒害你说的每一句话、做的每一件事。 "......" 那种苦涩、酸楚与怨恨会不断累积，最终像滚雪球一样，使情况变得比最初还要糟糕。你才二十二岁出头，可脸上的皱纹已经像老妇人的那样多了。没有哪个男人会愿意娶你为妻——往好了说，你最多只能成为一个妾室，而且很可能还不是个受宠的妾室；而往坏了说，你只会被别人像对待一道没人想负责的难吃菜肴一样，随意地传来传去。 ……哇啊啊啊！ 抽泣着，泪水顺着脸颊流下，你那个调皮的小妹妹转身就以最快的速度跑进了桃树林，连头都不回头。你双臂交叉站在那里，看着这一幕不可避免地发生，不禁感到一丝暗爽。 浅雾看着哭泣的绫在树林中消失，不禁皱起了眉头。 "[silly|姐姐大人|大姐]那样做不仅残忍，简直就是恶毒至极…… 真的是这样吗？也许吧。但如果不是真的，我的话就完全毫无意义了。Aya知道真相——我觉得她向你寻求的并不是真正的美容建议，而只是想得到对自己那种恶劣态度的认同罢了。 你的脸上又露出了那抹微笑， [silly|姐姐大人|大姐]太可怕了……你看起来简直和妈妈一模一样。 啊。哦。好吧。 你花了一点时间重新整理自己的措辞，然后轻轻揉了揉朝雾的毛发。 不管怎样，既然你现在一个人在这里，而且妈妈也不让我再去摘桃子了，我想你应该已经摘够了可以回去的量了。这么大的一个篮子，你肯定装不下所有的桃子吧。 以及 你自己把这件事拖得这么久。如果妈妈问起来，就告诉她我来负责吧。 说完，你就转身离开了，还特意让尾巴在身后甩来甩去。今天肯定会是美好的一天……

rows.raw: '"You\'ll never be pretty with that kind of rotten attitude."'

rows.original: You loose a small, bitter chuckle. "Oh no, my dear sister. Like I said, your lack of temperament and horrid attitude towards others reflects poorly on both Mother and I. He's not going to be holding off these shitheads for very much longer now — not someone like him.
    
    Time for you to save the day. A brisk but measured pace, a drawing of your [pc.weapon], and you're upon them, a monster out of the darkness. River's eyes widen as he sees you, and that gives the cultists enough warning to turn and see you bear down upon their sorry asses with all the terror in the world.
rows.translation:
你不用走太远就能惹上麻烦——前方城镇广场上传来了喊叫声，那里矗立着那位老马歇尔男爵的雕像。我从来没记清他的名字，但他确实是现任男爵夫人的父亲……

里弗就在那边，站在长凳上，他的身影在黑暗中显得格外渺小，周围还有四个人；其中两个人正在阻止他，另外两个人则爬上了那座巍峨的雕像，试图夺取那面盾牌。 其中一个人拔出了匕首，不断地砍击那块宝石，试图将其从镶嵌处撬出来。

“破坏公物的人！白痴！”

“快走开！主人命令我们必须把那颗宝石带给他！”

对于这样的距离，那个小猫人用的弓根本派不上用场，他只能用手握住箭杆，把箭当作一根巨大的针一样，刺向那些穿着黑袍的邪教徒。 他再也无法忍受这些混蛋了——像他这样的人，根本不可能长期忍受这种行为。

现在，是你们该挺身而出拯救局面的时候了。动作要迅速，但也要冷静而有条不紊 [pc.weapon]就在你即将抓住他们的瞬间，一道黑暗中的怪物出现了。里弗看到你的那一刻，眼睛瞪得大大的，这一下子让那些邪教徒有了足够的反应时间，他们立刻转身，看到你正带着世间所有的恐怖之力朝他们冲过来。
rows.raw:
"
    You don't have far to go to find trouble — shouts come up from ahead in the town square where the statue of the old Marcher baron stands. Never caught his name, but he was the current baroness's father... 
    
    River is out there, standing atop the bench, a small silhouette in the darkness surrounded by four more; two of them are holding him off while the other two clamber onto the impressive statue, going for the shield. One of them has a dagger out and is hacking at it, trying to pry the gleaming blue stone free of its setting.
    
    "Vandals! Cretins!"
    
    "Go away! The master has commanded that we bring him the gem!"
    
    The little catboy's bow is worthless at this range, and he's reduced to jabbing at the black-robed cultists with his arrows, holding it by its shaft and using it like some kind of oversized needle. He's not going to be holding off these shitheads for very much longer now — not someone like him.
    
    Time for you to save the day. A brisk but measured pace, a drawing of your [pc.weapon], and you're upon them, a monster out of the darkness. River's eyes widen as he sees you, and that gives the cultists enough warning to turn and see you bear down upon their sorry asses with all the terror in the world.
    "

rows.original: It's done. All four of them lie dead at your feet; it really wasn't any kind of challenge. Whatever Tollus might have put into these kids' heads might have motivated them to fight to the death, but it wasn't enough to make up for their plain lack of skill and sheer bloody-mindedness. You wipe your [pc.weapon] clean on their clothes of black-dyed sackcloth and sigh, feeling your anger subside just a tiny bit.
rows.translation: 搞定了。那四个人全都死在了你足部下；这根本算不上什么挑战。不管托卢斯在这些孩子脑子里灌输了什么思想，或许那些思想确实激励他们誓死战斗，但这些都不足以弥补他们毫无战斗技巧以及那种纯粹的鲁莽性格。你擦了擦手 [pc.weapon] 他们脱下了那些染成黑色的粗麻布衣服，叹了口气，感觉你的怒火稍微消退了一些。

Whatever Tollus might have put into these kids' heads might have motivated them to fight to the death, but it wasn't enough to make up for their plain lack of skill and sheer bloody-mindedness. You wipe your [pc.weapon] clean on their clothes of black-dyed sackcloth and sigh, feeling your anger subside just a tiny bit.\n    "

rows.original:
"Hey, you!"
    
    The cultists may be able to ignore River's shout, but they can't ignore the arrowhead in one of their number as the little catboy leaps up and jabs the barbed arrowhead straight into the closest neck. That's enough of an opening for you to press a counterattack, driving the remaining three against the statue and cracking their skulls open in short order. Seeing no more foes arriving on the scene, you allow yourself a moment to catch your breath, feeling your anger subside just a tiny bit.
    
    Damn, that was harder than it ought to have been.
    
    River comes up beside you and gives you a thin smile despite his obvious trepidation. "One too many spiced wines these last three or four years, eh?"
    
    "Ha ha. Ha."
rows.translation:
嘿，你！”

那些邪教徒们或许可以忽略里弗的呼喊，但他们绝对无法忽视自己队伍中的一名成员——那只小猫人突然跃起，将那支带倒钩的箭直接刺入了离他最近的那个人的脖子里。 这正是你发动反击的好机会——将剩下的三名敌人逼向雕像，很快就能将他们的头颅敲碎。看到没有更多的敌人出现后，你稍作休息，让怒火稍微平息了一些。
    
    该死，这难度其实应该再低一些才对。

里弗走到你身边，尽管明显有些紧张，但还是勉强挤出了一个微笑：“过去三四年里，我喝的加香葡萄酒实在太多了，嗯？”

“哈哈，确实如此。 哈。

rows.original:
Mumbling to himself, River turns away from you and checks the corpses, sighing. "Why..."
    
    "Why does anything happen, cat? Shit happens. You should know as much."
    
    "Yes, but even so..." River clenches his fists and uncovers the hoods from three of the four bodies. "Lomias. Miches. Rilian. Two months ago, they laughed and clapped at my music, patted me on the head and told me I was a good kitten. Miches even bought me milk every week from your place."
    
    "I remember."
    
    "And now they're dead, because we killed them."
    
    "...You having regrets about wanting to live?"
    
    "No. But... I'll go check on the statue." He scampers over the likeness of the old baron and inspects the shield, taps the blue gem a couple of times to ensure it's still firm in its setting. "It looks fine. Thanks for helping me out back there."
    
    "Why do you give a shit about that statue, anyway?"
    
    "It's an important part of our history."
    
    "I mean, I understand that, but you were willing to throw your life away to defend it. Fuck, you've been sitting under that statue since the first day of the village's founding."
    
    River scampers down from the statue's plinth, very pointedly not looking at the bodies cooling in the snow. "Like I said, Gweyr, it's important. Besides, if Tollus wanted the gem, that's more than enough reason to deny him it."
    
    "That I can understand."
    
    River shakes his head. "Go, Gweyr. Sanders came through here not too long ago. I think he needs your help."
    
    "You're not coming with? You're an okay shot, I wouldn't mind you covering me."
    
    "I... I've got to protect the statue, in case more of... more of them show up."
    
    The way he's looking at the bodies, you can tell that he's plainly lying, but you're not going to pursue it; this isn't the time for that. The village's eastern gate lies off in the shadowed distance, beckoning, waiting.
    
    There's nothing left for you here.
rows.translation:
River自言自语着，转身检查那些尸体，叹了口气：“为什么……”

“为什么总会发生这种事呢，小猫？糟糕的事情就是会发生的，你应该很清楚这一点吧。”

“是的，但即便如此……”River握紧拳头，掀开了四具尸体中的三具的兜帽。“洛米亚斯、米切斯、里利安……两个月前，他们还为我演奏的音乐鼓掌，拍着我的头，夸我是一只乖巧的小猫。米切斯甚至每周都会从你那里给我买牛奶。
    
    我记得。”

“而现在他们死了，因为是我们杀死了他们。”

“……你对自己当初想要活下来这件事感到后悔吗？”

“不。但是……我去看看那座雕像吧。”他快步走到那位老男爵的雕像前，仔细检查了那面盾牌，还轻轻敲了敲那颗蓝色的宝石，确认它仍然牢固地镶嵌在盾牌上。“看起来没什么问题。谢谢你当时帮了我的忙。
    
    你究竟为什么要在乎那座雕像呢？”

“它是我们历史中重要的一部分。”

“我明白你的立场，但你们竟然愿意为保护它而付出生命的代价。天啊，从这个村庄建立的第一天起，你们就一直生活在那座雕像的阴影下。
    
    河流从雕像的基座上湍急地流下来，那人刻意避开了那些在雪中冷却的尸体。“就像我说的，格韦尔，这件事很重要。而且，如果托卢斯真的想要那颗宝石，那么这完全就是拒绝他的充分理由。”

“这一点我能够理解。
    
    里弗摇了摇头：“去吧，格韦尔。桑德斯不久前从这里经过，我觉得他需要你的帮助。”

“你不一起去吗？你的枪法还不错，我倒不介意你在我后面掩护我。”

“我……我必须保护那座雕像，以防还有更多……更多那样的东西出现。
    
    从他看那些尸体的方式来看，很明显他在撒谎，但你不会去追究这个；现在不是追究的时候。村庄的东门隐匿在远处的阴影中，正在召唤着你，等待着你。

你在这里已经无事可做了。

rows.original: You see them; they're trying to hide in the shadows of walls, wagons and haystacks. Not that it matters; even if you couldn't see them, you can smell them anyway. You stand in the middle of the road, ready your [pc.weapon], and growl. "Come on out, then. I've walked straight into your trap, aren't you going to press the advantage?" One of them calls out from the darkness. "The master — " "Yeah well, fuck him. Are you going to try and kill me while I'm surrounded, or not? Gotta throw you a bone, or else it'll be a complete walkover." That gets them out of hiding, emerging one by one from their inept attempts to conceal themselves. Some of them, you might have once recognised as kids you knew, perhaps even liked. Now, though... You eye the approaching figures as kitchen knives and reshaped ploughshares glint in the dim light. "Now that we can see each other, I'm going to tell you once, and once only. If there's anything left of the pups that I once served drinks to at the Hound within your thick skulls, you're going to drop those toys you call weapons and run; I'll pretend I never saw you here. "Move one inch closer and I'll take pleasure in gutting you all." "For the master! The night of the ritual must not be interrupted!" They never learn.
rows.translation: 你能看到它们；它们正试图躲在墙壁、马车和干草堆的阴影里。不过其实也没关系；即使你看不见它们，你也依然能察觉到它们的存在。 气味 无论如何，你都站在马路中间，准备好了 [pc.weapon]那你就出来吧。我明明是走进了你的陷阱，你们难道不打算利用这个优势吗？” 其中一个人从黑暗中喊道：“主人——” “去他的吧。既然我已经被包围了，你们到底要不要动手杀我？ 总得给你点好处，否则这场战斗简直就是一边倒。” 这句话让他们不再躲藏，一个个从那些拙劣的藏身之处走了出来。其中有些人，你或许曾经在小时候认识他们，甚至可能喜欢过他们。 现在，不过…… 那些逐渐靠近的身影，在昏暗的轻型线下，看起来就像厨房刀具或是被重新锻造的犁头。“既然我们现在能够看清彼此了，我就只说这一次。如果你们那些厚厚的脑袋里还有一丝良心，还记得我曾经在‘猎犬酒吧’里为那些小狗们倒过酒的话，就赶紧放下你们那些所谓的‘武器’，赶紧跑开吧；我会装作根本没在这里见过你们。 再靠近一寸，我就很乐意把你们全都杀得片甲不留。” “为了大师！仪式的夜晚绝不能被打扰！” 他们永远都不会吸取教训。

rows.original: The last of the dark-robed so-called cultists falls to the dirt road, and doesn't get up again. You look at the mess you've made — kitchen knives and ploughshares hastily beaten into crude ritualistic implements, robes cut and sewn together from their old clothes and sackcloth. Blood soaking the dirt, on your gambeson and fur, melting the lightly falling snow.
rows.translation: 最后一个穿着黑袍的所谓邪教徒倒在了土路上，再也没能站起来。你看着自己造成的这一片混乱——厨房刀具和犁头被匆忙改造成简陋的祭祀工具，旧衣服和麻布被剪裁缝制在一起制成袍子。鲜血浸透了泥土，也浸湿了你的铠甲和毛皮，使得轻轻飘落的雪花都融化了。

rows.original:
When the next of the dark-robed so-called cultists falls to the dirt road, the rest lose their nerve and run — not back into town, as you might've hoped, but towards the eastern gate.
    
    "Flee!" one of the kids screeches — or at least, attempts to with that stupid high, squeaky voice of hers — grabbing the closest one still standing other by the shoulder and turning to run. "We must warn the master!"
    
    You're tempted to run them down, to chase them into the alleys and make sure they never get to their destination, but there's no warning they can give that Sanders already hasn't by his clomping around.
rows.translation:
当下一个那些身穿黑袍的所谓“邪教徒”倒在那条土路上时，其余的人顿时失去了勇气，开始逃跑——但他们并没有往城镇方向跑，而是朝着东门跑去。

“快跑！”其中一个女孩尖叫道——至少，她是用自己那尖细得让人难受的声音试图喊出这句话的——然后抓住旁边还站着的一个人，一起开始奔跑。 我们必须警告主人！”

你很想追上他们，把他们逼进小巷里，确保他们永远无法到达目的地，但他们发出的任何警告，桑德斯那笨重的脚步声早就已经把消息传达到了。

rows.original:
Children playing at being in the cool club... except it wasn't playing, it was never playing, and the bastard who'd lured them into his fold by means of his words and promises. The faces are the same, but the people are different; they'd died sometime in between then and now. Ghouls wearing bodies as skin suits and demanding respect... 
    
    It's all fun and games until someone dies.
rows.translation:
孩子们假装自己属于那个酷炫的俱乐部……但实际上他们从来都没有真正属于过那里，只是被那个用言语和承诺将他们吸引过来的混蛋所欺骗罢了。那些面孔依然相同，但这些人已经变了——在从那时到现在这段时间里，他们已经死了。那些披着人类外皮、却要求别人尊重的怪物……

直到有人死去，这一切才真正变成了一场残酷的游戏。

rows.original: [pc.Weapon] at the ready, you step up besides Sanders. He acknowledges your arrival with a grunt, not daring take his eyes off the village lads and lasses — or at least, that's how he thinks of them. That's Sanders for you, always believing that people deep down just really want to be good, that anyone can be saved if you really just try long and hard enough and that the fact that he actually sometimes kills people is just incidental to said saving. It's an attitude that you don't deny is necessary, especially in the village's early days, but here and now... "I'm here. Hope I didn't keep you waiting." "It's okay." "I'd have come earlier, but things happened, people tried to kill me. You know." Sanders has no reply for that, so you look back and forth over this stand-off — they're stalling you, you know that. The longer you're kept here, the further these assholes take Rianna off to whatever fate that awaits her in that pale elf ruin; you haven't seen much of that girl, being from one of the newer families to arrive in town, but she hadn't fallen in with this lot yet. A good girl who doesn't deserve any of this... ...But deserve's got nothing to do with it, as you know full well. Taking a deep breath, you summon up your old commanding voice and let your growls echo into the night. "All right, so here's the deal, same one which I gave the others: I'm going to tell you once, and once only. I know all your faces. I know most of your names. If you even give a shit about the folks who're waiting for you lot to come home, who wonder what went wrong with their sons and daughters who would let a bald fucker sway them with promises of — I don't know, mountains of electrum in the baroness's vaults — you drop the act right here and slink on back home. I don't know what could ever possess you lot to still believe you're doing the right thing after your dumbass master and his thugs kidnapped a girl to be sacrificed, but I don't care; I'll pretend I never saw you here, not even when I'm serving you drinks at the Hound. "On the other hand, choose to get in my way, and I'll sign each and every one of your death warrants with my own two hands." There's that moment, that singular blink of an eye where things could go either way; for the sake of these dumb kids, you hope that they'll make the right choice — not just for their sake, but for everyone's sake. You flex your fingers upon the grip of your [pc.weapon], waiting. "I know you're stalling for time, so I'm going to count to three. One." Silence. "Two." "She's bluffing. She wouldn't kill us!" You can hear Sanders' breath whistle through his teeth, the man's gaze flicking between the thirty or so warm bodies massed by the gate and you. "What do we do, Gweyr? They're barely more than kids — I can't kill children!" "No, but I can." Your [pc.weapon] is already wet with blood, what's a little more? "Here's what I think of people who use human shields, Sanders." "Gweyr! No!" He reaches for you, but you're already ahead of him, and as the poor bastards come to meet you you're walking and swinging and walking and swinging and —
rows.translation: [pc.Weapon] 随时准备行动，你走到桑德斯的身边。他只是哼了一声表示注意到你的到来，却不敢将目光从那些村里的男孩女孩们身上移开——至少他是这么认为的。这就是桑德斯，他始终相信人们内心深处其实是渴望成为善良之人的，只要付出足够的努力，任何人都是可以被拯救的；而事实上，他有时会杀人，这些也只是实现拯救这一目标过程中的偶然现象罢了。 这种态度确实必不可少，尤其是在村庄发展的初期阶段。但如今…… 我到了。希望没有让你等待太久。” “没关系。” “我本来想早点来的，但发生了一些事情，有人试图杀我，你懂的。” 桑德斯对此无言以对，于是你们就这样僵持着——他们其实是在拖延时间，你心里明白的。 你们把她关在这里的时间越长，这些混蛋就会把瑞安娜带到那个苍白精灵的废墟里，让她遭遇更糟糕的命运。你们其实不太了解那个女孩——她只是最近才来到这个小镇的家族之一，不过她还没有跟这些人混到一起。 一个如此善良的女孩，根本不应该遭受这些…… 但是，如你们所知，‘应得’与这件事毫无关系。深吸一口气，你重新用出了那副威严的声音，让你的怒吼在夜色中回荡。 “好吧，事情是这样的：我和之前对其他人说的一样，我现在只会告诉你们一次，仅此一次。 我认识你们所有人，也知道你们大多数人的名字。如果你们真的在乎那些正在等待你们回家的人，那些担心自己的儿子女儿出了什么问题的人，那些会被某个秃头混蛋用各种承诺所迷惑的人——比如什么女男爵的保险库里藏着堆积如山的电银之类的鬼话——那么就别再装模作样了，赶紧滚回家去吧。 我不知道你们这些人究竟是怎么想的，明明你们的那个蠢货老板和他的手部下绑架了一个女孩来作为祭品，你们却还坚信自己在做正确的事情。但我不在乎，我就当从来没在这里见过你们，哪怕我在“猎犬酒吧”为你们服务时也是如此。 另一方面，如果你们执意要阻挠我，那么我会亲自动手部签署每一个人的死亡判决书。” 就有那么一刻，那么短暂的一瞬间，事情可能会朝着任何方向发展；为了这些愚蠢的孩子们，你真心希望他们能做出正确的选择——不仅仅是为了他们自己，也是为了所有人。 你活动着手部掌上的手部指。 [pc.weapon]我在等着。我知道你是在拖延时间，所以我数到三。一。” 沉默。 “二。” “她在虚张声势。她不会杀我们的！” 你可以听到桑德斯的气息从牙缝中呼出，他的目光在聚集在大门旁的三十来个年轻人和你之间来回扫视。“我们该怎么办，格韦尔？他们不过是一些孩子而已——我不可能杀害孩子！” “不，但是 我 可以。”你的 [pc.weapon] 已经沾满鲜血了，再多一点又有什么关系呢？‘对于那些利用人类当盾牌的人，我这样看……’，桑德斯。” “格韦尔！ 不行！他试图追上你，但你早已走在了他前面。当那些可怜的家伙们试图与你相遇时，你却继续一边走一边挥动手部臂，就这样不停地走，不停地挥动手部臂……
rows.raw: " [pc.Weapon] at the ready, you step up besides Sanders. He acknowledges your arrival with a grunt, not daring take his eyes off the village lads and lasses — or at least, that's how he thinks of them. That's Sanders for you, always believing that people deep down just really want to be good, that anyone can be saved if you really just try long and hard enough and that the fact that he actually sometimes kills people is just incidental to said saving. It's an attitude that you don't deny is necessary, especially in the village's early days, but here and now... "I'm here. Hope I didn't keep you waiting." "It's okay." "I'd have come earlier, but things happened, people tried to kill me. You know." Sanders has no reply for that, so you look back and forth over this stand-off — they're stalling you, you know that. The longer you're kept here, the further these assholes take Rianna off to whatever fate that awaits her in that pale elf ruin; you haven't seen much of that girl, being from one of the newer families to arrive in town, but she hadn't fallen in with this lot yet. A good girl who doesn't deserve any of this... ...But deserve's got nothing to do with it, as you know full well. Taking a deep breath, you summon up your old commanding voice and let your growls echo into the night. "All right, so here's the deal, same one which I gave the others: I'm going to tell you once, and once only. I know all your faces. I know most of your names. If you even give a shit about the folks who're waiting for you lot to come home, who wonder what went wrong with their sons and daughters who would let a bald fucker sway them with promises of — I don't know, mountains of electrum in the baroness's vaults — you drop the act right here and slink on back home. I don't know what could ever possess you lot to still believe you're doing the right thing after your dumbass master and his thugs kidnapped a girl to be sacrificed, but I don't care; I'll pretend I never saw you here, not even when I'm serving you drinks at the Hound. "On the other hand, choose to get in my way, and I'll sign each and every one of your death warrants with my own two hands." There's that moment, that singular blink of an eye where things could go either way; for the sake of these dumb kids, you hope that they'll make the right choice — not just for their sake, but for everyone's sake. You flex your fingers upon the grip of your [pc.weapon], waiting. "I know you're stalling for time, so I'm going to count to three. One." Silence. "Two." "She's bluffing. She wouldn't kill us!" You can hear Sanders' breath whistle through his teeth, the man's gaze flicking between the thirty or so warm bodies massed by the gate and you. "What do we do, Gweyr? They're barely more than kids — I can't kill children!" "No, but I can." Your [pc.weapon] is already wet with blood, what's a little more? "Here's what I think of people who use human shields, Sanders." "Gweyr! No!" He reaches for you, but you're already ahead of him, and as the poor bastards come to meet you you're walking and swinging and walking and swinging and — "

rows.original:
You've seen this before, been here before in some of the battles the Crossed Swords were hired to fight. Peasant conscripts, unskilled, undisciplined, sometimes full of bravado that more often than not happened to be absolutely false. Grist for the mill, that's all they turned out to be, meat for the grinder. Still, it's true that they're more fanatical than you'd have given them credit for, and you can't help but wonder if the bald bastard — Tollus, that was his name — has them in some kind of mind-meld... but does it matter? At this point, it's all the same.
    
    You just keep on crunching and smashing and crunching and smashing — names, faces, limbs blurring into a bloody mess, screams as you press twitching bodies underfoot. The deep ochre of fresh blood wets your fur as you press into milling bodies even as they swarm you, making it stick to your skin. You crush another skull, sink your jaws into a neck — did they think you were bluffing when you said you'd kill them all if it came to that?
    
    But the thing is, one of the things you learned at your father's knee was to never make threats you didn't intend to follow up on, and it's good advice that's served you well for years.
    
    The last warm body falls into a twitching mess upon the blood-soaked earth, and you whirl around, expecting more. But there aren't any — they're dead, they're all dead. You kick away the nearest bodies, making some space for yourself; it doesn't feel like it's over yet.
rows.translation:
你以前见过这样的场景，在那些Crossed Swords被雇佣参与的战斗中，你也曾经来到过这里。那些农民征召来的士兵，没有技能，缺乏纪律，有时虽然满口豪言壮语，但实际上那些勇气往往完全是虚张声势。 只不过是一些可供利用的材料罢了，不过是用来喂机器的肉而已。不过，确实可以说，他们的狂热程度超出了你的预期；你不禁会想，那个光头混蛋——他的名字是托卢斯——是否对他们进行了某种精神控制。…但这真的重要吗？在这个阶段，一切都已经无所谓了。
    
    你不断地碾压、粉碎，名字、面孔、四肢全都混成了一团血肉模糊的烂泥；当你将那些还在抽搐的身体踩在脚下时，尖叫声此起彼伏。新鲜的血液呈现出深赭色，浸湿了你的毛皮；即使它们成群地围上来攻击你，你依然继续碾压那些挣扎的身体，使得血液粘在你的皮肤上。又一颗头骨被你碾碎了，你的下颌紧紧咬住了一条脖子——当你说如果必要的话，会把他们全部杀死时，他们难道以为你在虚张声势吗？
    
    但问题是，你在父亲身边学到的最重要的一点就是：永远不要发出那些你并不打算真正付诸行动的威胁。这个建议非常有用，这些年来它一直帮助你度过了许多难关。

最后一个还活着的人倒在血迹斑斑的地上，身体不断抽搐着。你迅速转过身去，期待着还会有更多人出现。然而，已经没有人了——他们全都死了。你踢开那些最近的尸体，为自己腾出一些空间；你感觉，这场战斗还没有结束。

rows.original: You just keep on crunching and smashing and crunching and smashing — names, faces, limbs blurring into a bloody mess, screams as you press twitching bodies underfoot. There're just so many of them, maybe too many of them as you start running out of breath; maybe life as a tavernkeeper and mother has made you soft, maybe you're just out of practice. They're more fanatical than you'd have given them credit for, and you can't help but wonder if the bald bastard — Tollus, that was his name — has them in some kind of mind-meld... but does it matter? At this point, it's all the same. Then, just when you think it might be best to take a step back and put a little breathing distance between you and this seething mass of flesh and cloth, they break. Enough of the cultists, the village lads and lasses, whatever Sanders wants to call them this fine day, have died for the rest of them to finally lose their nerve and break ranks. They go scattering in all directions, screaming, panting — they obviously thought you were bluffing to begin with, and weren't really prepared for you to really wade in and cause some carnage. But the thing is, one of the things you learned at your father's knee was to never make threats you didn't intend to follow up on, and it's good advice that's served you well for years. Run, that's right, run. Stay alive. You tighten your grip on your [pc.weapon], wondering if this is a feint and they're going to circle around and come back at you, but it looks like they've truly lost their nerve and are gone.

rows.original: "Worthless. Worthless, the lot of you! More than twenty, and you can't even kill one woman?" Your ears perk up. You know that voice. "Leold, you fucking asshole." "Why yes, I've been doing a lot of fucking of late, and yes, some of them were assholes. Kind of you to notice." You narrow your eyes. Like all of the others who'd thrown their lot in with this Tollus man, Leold looks... different. He was always a bit of a troublemaker, the 'mander, but he wasn't a bad man and did good work when he could stay sober... ...But something's changed, and it's not just the single black gauntlet he now wears on his right hand. You eye Leold's lithe frame up and down, but he doesn't have any obvious weapons on him — not unless you count the massive spiked gauntlet, of course. "Are you here to stall for your so-called master too, or did you come to be gutted like all the others?" He snorts. "Judging by the way things are, you led them into this, Leold. You set up this fucking human shield, knowing Sanders wouldn't dare to kill the lads and lasses of the village. For that, I'm going to feed you your own sorry ass, piece by piece; don't worry, though, I won't make you eat it raw. "Come on, then. I'm here." "Having trouble, Leold?" "Master. I just..." "No matter, their souls will further empower the ritual. Their sacrifices will not be in vain." This must be Tollus, then. You eye the man, sizing him up, the way he moves, carries himself — clearly some kind of wizard or the like. This is the first time you've seen the man up close, and he's no prettier at this distance than he was from afar, not with that tattooed face of his. Then again, you can hardly say that you're easy on the eyes as you are right now... "The sacrifice is secured; the others have the girl. Once the Conjunction of Worlds is done and the promised power is granted us, we'll march upon the baroness's vault and help ourselves to the riches within, riches that she's been withholding from you despite the hard times your little village has fallen upon." Tollus gestures at the gauntlet bound to Leold's hand. "You'd like more of where that came from, wouldn't you?" "Y... yes, master." "Now then, the local tavernkeeper. Welcome, welco — " Tollus's voice is cut off in a shriek as you rampage forward, interrupting his little monologue. He raises a hand, clearly intending to form some spell, but you grab the smug little fuckwit by the fingers and bend backwards until you hear the satisfying pop of his fingers breaking. A good old standby for dealing with wizards — Tollus's bladed staff falls to the ground with a clatter as he screams and babbles, and you're pretty sure he's pissing himself at the moment. Too bad you have to let go of him, though, for Leold's gauntlet comes smashing into the space where your head was a moment ago. "Kill her!" Tollus shrieks, scrambling away from the two of you and down the road, clutching both his broken fingers and bladed staff alike. "Kill her!" You whirl back upon Leold, the 'mander drawing his fist back for another blow at you, and show him your teeth. If you smiled at him, there's no humor in it. "You know, you should've been more diligent about paying your tab. Still, I guess I'll be taking what you owe me for those two rye beers you had a couple months ago off your dead body."
rows.translation: 一文不值。你们这些人全都一文不值！二十多人了，却连一个女人都杀不死？” 你们的耳朵立刻竖了起来。你们 知道 那个声音。 “利奥尔德，你这个该死的混蛋。” “没错，最近我确实干了不少该死的事，而且其中确实有些行为很混蛋。你能注意到这点，还真是挺不错的。” 你眯起了眼睛。就像所有那些支持这个托卢斯人的人一样，利奥尔德看起来…… 不同他一直都是个爱惹麻烦的人，那个“捣蛋鬼”，但他其实并不是那种 糟糕 那个人在能够保持清醒的状态下，确实做了一些不错的工作…… ……但是，有些事情 改变了而且，他右手戴的那只黑色护手也并非唯一的武器。你仔细观察莱奥德的体型，会发现他身上并没有任何明显的武器——当然，除非你把那只巨大的带刺护手也算进去。 “你是来为你的所谓主人拖延时间的，还是像其他人一样，来送命的？ 他哼了一声。 “看现在的情形，这都是你造成的，莱奥德。你故意设置了这个人类盾牌，明知桑德斯不敢杀害村里的那些年轻人。为此，我会把你自己那可怜的屁股一块一块地喂到你嘴里；不过别担心，我不会让你生吃它的。 那好吧，我在这里等着你。” “遇到麻烦了吗，莱奥德？” “大师，我只是……” “没关系，他们的牺牲会让仪式更加圆满。他们的付出绝对不会白费。” 那么，这里一定是托卢斯了。你仔细观察着这个男人，注意他的动作和举止——显然他是个巫师之类的角色。这是你第一次近距离看到他，从这个距离来看，他的样子并不比远处看时更漂亮，尤其是他那脸上那些纹身。 话说回来，以你现在的样子，也很难说自己是个“赏心悦目”的人吧…… “牺牲品已经到手了，其他人也已经得到了那个女孩。等‘世界交汇仪式’完成，我们得到了承诺中的力量之后，就会攻打女男爵的藏宝库，把里面那些财富据为己有——那些财富，尽管你们这个小村庄经历了那么多艰难困苦，但她却一直瞒着你们不把它们分给你们。”托卢斯指了指莱奥德手上的护手。“你肯定还想知道，那些财富到底是从哪里来的，对吧？ 是……是的，主人。” “那么，现在来谈谈那个当地的酒馆老板吧。欢迎啊——”托卢斯的话还没说完，你就猛地冲了上去，打断了他的讲话。他抬手似乎想要施展什么法术，但你一把抓住了那个自鸣得意的混蛋的手指，用力一扭，直到听到他的手指啪地一声断裂，你才松手。 对付巫师们，有一个非常有效的手段——托卢斯的带刃法杖会“哐当”一声掉在地上，而与此同时，他也会发出尖叫和胡言乱语，你完全可以肯定，他此刻肯定吓得尿裤子了。不过，可惜你还是不得不放开他，因为莱奥德的护手已经狠狠地砸在了你刚才还在的位置上。 杀了她！”托卢斯尖叫着，一边抓着自己的断指和那根带刃的法杖，一边从你们两人身边逃开，沿着道路奔去。击杀 哼！” 你迅速转向莱奥德，只见他正准备再次挥拳攻击你，于是你露出了牙齿。如果你对他笑了，那绝对不是出于幽默。“你知道，你本应该更认真地支付你的账单才对。不过，我想我还是会从你的尸体上拿走你几个月前欠我的那两杯黑啤酒的钱。

You set up this fucking human shield, knowing Sanders wouldn't dare to kill the lads and lasses of the village. For that, I'm going to feed you your own sorry ass, piece by piece; don't worry, though, I won't make you eat it raw. "Come on, then. I'm here." "Having trouble, Leold?" "Master. I just..." "No matter, their souls will further empower the ritual. Their sacrifices will not be in vain." This must be Tollus, then. You eye the man, sizing him up, the way he moves, carries himself — clearly some kind of wizard or the like. This is the first time you've seen the man up close, and he's no prettier at this distance than he was from afar, not with that tattooed face of his. Then again, you can hardly say that you're easy on the eyes as you are right now... "The sacrifice is secured; the others have the girl. Once the Conjunction of Worlds is done and the promised power is granted us, we'll march upon the baroness's vault and help ourselves to the riches within, riches that she's been withholding from you despite the hard times your little village has fallen upon." Tollus gestures at the gauntlet bound to Leold's hand. "You'd like more of where that came from, wouldn't you?" "Y... yes, master." "Now then, the local tavernkeeper. Welcome, welco — " Tollus's voice is cut off in a shriek as you rampage forward, interrupting his little monologue. He raises a hand, clearly intending to form some spell, but you grab the smug little fuckwit by the fingers and bend backwards until you hear the satisfying pop of his fingers breaking. A good old standby for dealing with wizards — Tollus's bladed staff falls to the ground with a clatter as he screams and babbles, and you're pretty sure he's pissing himself at the moment. Too bad you have to let go of him, though, for Leold's gauntlet comes smashing into the space where your head was a moment ago. "Kill her!" Tollus shrieks, scrambling away from the two of you and down the road, clutching both his broken fingers and bladed staff alike. "Kill her!" You whirl back upon Leold, the 'mander drawing his fist back for another blow at you, and show him your teeth. If you smiled at him, there's no humor in it. "You know, you should've been more diligent about paying your tab. Still, I guess I'll be taking what you owe me for those two rye beers you had a couple months ago off your dead body." "

rows.original: You smack the blunt end of your [pc.weapon] straight into Leold's jaw, sending him staggering back. He glowers at you again, rubbing his chin with his hand, then moves to send in a swift right hook with the cruelly spiked gauntlet. "So, the boy has a toy," you snarl, sidestepping the blow. "But does he know how to use it? Doesn't look like he does." "Shut up! How the fuck aren't you out of breath already?" "All the magic shit a wizard can give you won't make up for the fact that you're outmatched, Leold. Just surrender already and throw yourself on Sanders' mercy, because I certainly don't have any of the like." Leold roars and the swing goes wide; it's not much of an opening, but it's enough for you to step in into his reach and deliver upon him a good blow to the shoulder, blood spurting out into the cold night air. He groans, takes a staggering step towards you, and falls to the ground with all the other cultists. Is it over? You kneel down and check if Leold's breathing; he isn't. But just to make sure, you run him through with your sword anyway, sheathing the blade in crimson. Can't be too certain when it comes to these things. All right... now it's over.
rows.translation: 你用棍子的粗端敲打了 [pc.weapon] 这一拳直接击中了莱奥德的下巴，使他踉跄后退。他再次怒视着你，用手揉着下巴，然后迅速挥出了戴着带刺护手的那记右勾拳。 “原来这小子还有个‘玩具’啊……”你咬牙说道，同时巧妙地躲过了这一击。 但他知道怎么使用它吗？看起来他并不知道。” “闭嘴！你他妈怎么还没喘上气来？” “无论巫师能给你什么魔法，都弥补不了你实力不如对手这个事实，莱奥德。 干脆投降吧，任由桑德斯处置你吧，因为我可没有那样的耐心。” 莱奥德怒吼着，挥动棍棒的力量也变得更大；这个攻击虽然不算特别有力，但已经足够让你进入他的攻击范围，给他肩膀上一记重击，鲜血顿时喷溅到寒冷的夜空中。 他发出一声呻吟，踉跄着朝你走来，最终和其他那些邪教徒一起倒在了地上。 就这样结束了吗？ 你跪下来检查莱奥德的呼吸情况——他已经没有气了。但为了确认无误，你还是用剑刺了他一下，然后将剑收回鞘中，剑身被染成了猩红色。 在这些事情上，确实很难做到百分百确定。 好吧…… 现在 一切都结束了。

rows.original:
Snarling, Leold steps up and delivers a swift uppercut to your jaw; you see it coming, but he corrects the blow and the spiked gauntlet comes crashing into your skull nonetheless. You may not have lost a tooth there, but a handful have definitely been loosened from that — not to mention the spikes driving into your flesh.
    
    "Not so tough are you now, bitch? That's for all the times you've hounded me for my tab!"
    
    You spit, and it's tinged with blood. "Maybe if you could actually handle money worth a shit, you wouldn't drink to the point where you end up owing other people money for it."
    
    "That mouth of yours is real pretty, bitch — guess I need to rearrange it some more."
    
    Grimacing, you raise your [pc.weapon] to parry the blow, but it never comes. Leold looks surprised, then gazes down towards the glowing point of the lance that's entered his back and is now protruding from his chest. The 'mander tries to say something, but it only comes out as a blood-frothed gurgle before Sanders withdraws his lance with a flick of his wrist.
    
    You gasp. "About time you decided he was evil enough to warrant killing."
    
    "We're taught not to take lives hastily."
    
    "Yeah, okay."
rows.translation:
莱奥德咆哮着上前，迅速一记上勾拳击中了你的下颌；你虽然预感到了这一击，但他巧妙地调整了出拳的角度，那些带刺的手套还是狠狠地砸在了你的头骨上。虽然你可能没有掉掉任何牙齿，但肯定有几颗牙齿被震得松动了好几颗——更不用说那些刺入你肉中的尖刺了。
    
    现在你倒厉害起来了，贱人？这都是因为你以前一直缠着我讨要我的零花钱！”

你吐出来的口水里带着血丝。“要是你真能好好理财，就不会喝得烂醉如泥，最后还欠别人钱了。你的嘴真漂亮啊，贱人——看来我还得再调整一下它才行。”

你皱着眉头，抬起了你的 [pc.weapon] 试图格挡这一击，但它始终没有到来。莱奥德露出惊讶的表情，随后低头看向那支刺入他背部、如今正从他的胸前伸出来的长矛。那个“指挥官”试图说些什么，但最终只发出了一阵含血的咕噜声，随后桑德斯便手腕一抖，将长矛拔了出来。

你倒吸了一口凉气：“你终于认定他坏到足以被杀死的地步了，真是迟到了。”

“我们被教导过，不要轻易夺走别人的生命。”

“是啊，好吧。

rows.original: Breath ragged, lungs heaving, you stand in place a moment more, half-expecting Tollus to emerge from the darkness; little backstabbing shits like that are prone to trying tricks. But no sneak attack comes, no bolt from the blue; as your eyes rove over the slaked earth and numerous bodies that litter your surroundings, you see no sign of the so-called master. He must've fled up the mountain, towards the old ruin, and that's where you're going as well — up until you see a willowy wyld elf girl by the side of the road and River kneeling down at her side, undoing her bonds. Once the ropes are loosened, he lets her lean on him despite the elf having more than a head of height on the little catboy. The poor thing is sobbing as the pair approach the gate — you can still see the rope marks on her wrists and ankles — but when she takes in the sight of the blood-soaked earth, the bodies littering the ground and you in the middle of it all, she screams and shrinks back from you. River looks down at the carnage, then up at you with a grimace on his face. You stare him down unapologetically for several moments, then step forward, your feet making wet noises upon the earth. "I see you got the girl." "I did. Leold and the Tollus creep were watching her, but since you drew them away I was able to sneak around and get her." "And of that Tollus asshole?" "He went up the mountainside, towards the foothills. I loosed a few shots at him, but he got away. I don't think he'll return to the temple, but we'll need to make a sweep of the old ruin just to make sure." "Maybe he's gone for good." "I doubt it. I've fought enough of his kind in my time — creatures like that don't have the grace to die on their own." Sanders makes a frustrated noise as he steps up. "I wish he could reconsider his ways, but the sad truth is that someone so steeped in evil is likely to rationalise away his misdeeds. If only we'd been able to capture him..." "... Hmph." "But that's not important now." Sanders' face creases in anger, true anger from such a man twinged with disappointment. "In the gods' names, Gweyr, what have you just done?!" "I did what I said I would, Sanders. I showed them exactly what I thought of human shields. Tollus and Leold, they clearly knew of your oaths as a Warrior of White, and that you wouldn't lift a finger against people you still thought of as poor misguided kids. You were just going to stand right there like an idiot until they sacrificed the girl to whatever horrible abominations they worship, and once they learned you could be cockblocked like that they'd just keep on doing it over and over again." "I don't think you get my point, Gweyr. In one night, you have killed more than half the youth in Hawkethorne!" Sanders roars, grabbing you by the shoulders and shaking you — and he does have the strength for that. "Does that mean absolutely nothing to you?" "And whose fucking fault is that that things have gotten to this point? If we'd kicked them straight out of town like I wanted to begin with over any protests their folks might've had, shit wouldn't have gotten to this point. I get it, you want to believe that people are basically good and that everyone deserves a second chance, Sanders. And sure, all those people, no one wants to see their kin run out of town. So things just stewed until they grew from bad to worse and half the fuckers thought they'd join the winning team, while the others hid in their homes while Tollus and his ass had the run of the village. That sure isn't what you and those kids' folks wanted, Sanders, but it sure as fuck is what happened! "You're just too nice for your own good, Sanders. It's not a failing for someone who used to be a holy warrior like you, but it does mean I've got to do the jobs you won't." Sanders grits his teeth and points down to the heaped bodies about your feet. "You. Call. This. A. Job." "You've known Garth and me for a decade now, Sanders; your order's hired the Crossed Swords more than once, they still do. So then, the question remains: what were you going to do while those assholes went and dragged off the girl up the mountain?" "I'd have thought of something that didn't involve such blatant butchery." "Really, now." The townsfolk are emerging from their homes now, peering out cautiously to see what the commotion is all about. One family's weeping tears of joy as River returns Rianna to her family, but so many, many more are weeping for another reason. Some of them have their eyes on you, red-hot needles of hate and resentment; though they dare say nothing to you, the monster with blood smeared over her fur and tail and with [pc.weapon] in hand, you know what's going on in their minds. "So, this is what it's come to, huh. Too afraid to act and hiding in your own homes while Tollus and his fuckers have the run of the town and openly talk of overthrowing the baroness, yet so swift to turn on the woman who gave enough of a shit to do something about it despite none of her own kin being personally involved in this mess. "At least Sanders has principles and is a good man. You lot are just chickenshits. Want to lynch me? Who's going to be first? For months, years, I served you lot drinks, played midwife for you, held Gwyn and Garret while you told me they were cute, and today — " "Gweyr. Please don't make this any worse." River's returned from handing off the elf girl to her folks and is tugging on your gambeson. "Please." Gods, your bones ache. With the heat and rush of battle finally beginning to fade, your recent exertions are starting to catch up to you, and yet everything feels far heavier than it should be. "So, that's it," Sanders spits. "You did the job that none of us were willing to do." "Yes." "I know why you did this, Gweyr. That, and it's my fault for thinking you could help the situation in the first place. It's why I'm not running you through this very moment, and why I'm not going to let these people try and hang you. "You have three hours, which is more than what your own customs dictate. Get your things and get out of here, because if you stay one night in this town someone is going to try and kill you in your sleep for what you've done tonight." "You're sending me to walk the ice." Sanders nods. "I am. There are no more jarls and the baroness isn't here, so I'll have to do."
rows.translation: 你气喘吁吁地站在原地，心中还在期待着Tollus会从黑暗中现身——这种背信弃义的家伙总是喜欢使出诡计。然而，并没有任何突然的袭击发生，周围散落的泥土和众多尸体中，也没有任何关于那个所谓的“大师”的踪迹。 他肯定已经逃上了那座山，朝着那片古老的废墟去了，而你也要去那里——直到你在路边看到一个柳枝般柔美的野精灵女孩，以及跪在她身边的里弗，正在为她解开束缚。当绳子被松开后，里弗让她依靠在自己身上，尽管这个精灵女孩的身高比那个小猫男孩要高出一大截。 当那两人走近大门时，那个可怜的女孩正在哭泣——你仍然能看到她手腕和足部踝上留下的绳索痕迹——但当她看到那片被鲜血浸透的土地、地上散落的尸体，以及站在这一切中央的你时，她突然尖叫起来，然后吓得退缩了回去。 里弗低头看着那一片惨状，然后抬起头，脸上带着一丝苦涩的表情看着你。你毫不愧疚地与他对视了片刻，接着向前迈了一步，你的足部步在湿漉漉的地上发出声响。 “看来你把那个女孩带走了。” “是的。莱奥德和那些托卢斯怪物一直在监视她，但因为你把他们引开了，我才能够悄悄地把她带走。 那个叫托卢斯的混蛋呢？” “他往山腰那边跑了，朝着山足部的方向。我朝他开了几枪，但他逃掉了。我觉得他应该不会再回到神庙里去了，不过我们还是得把那些古老的废墟仔细搜查一遍，以确保万无一失。” “也许他已经永远离开了。 我可不这么认为。这些年来，我遇到过太多他这种人了——这种生物根本没有尊严，连自杀的勇气都没有。”桑德斯沮丧地说道，一边向前走去。“我真希望他能改过自新，但事实就是，一个如此沉溺于邪恶之中的人，很可能会为自己的恶行找各种借口。要是我们当时能抓住他的话…… ……哼。” “但现在这已经不重要了。”桑德斯脸上布满了愤怒，这样一个男人真正的愤怒中还夹杂着失望。“看在诸神的份上，格韦尔，你刚才到底做了什么？ 完成我确实做到了我说过的话，桑德斯。我向他们清楚地表明了我对‘人肉盾牌’这种行为的看法。托卢斯和利奥尔德显然知道你作为‘白色战士’所立下的誓言，也知道你不会对那些你仍然认为只是些被误导的孩子们动一根手指头。 你只会像个白痴一样站在那里，直到他们把那个女孩献给他们所崇拜的那些可怕的东西；而一旦他们发现你可以被那样轻易地阻止，他们就会一再重复这种行为。我认为你并没有理解我的意思，格温尔。就在一个晚上里， 你已经杀害了鹰棘镇地区超过一半的年轻人！桑德斯怒吼着，抓住你的肩膀摇晃你——然后他 做 有足够的实力去做那件事。“这是否意味着绝对 没什么 这是谁的错，事情才会发展到这种地步？如果当初我按照自己的想法把他们赶出小镇，不管他们的家人会怎么抗议，事情也不会变成现在这个样子。 我明白，你愿意相信人们本质上是善良的，每个人都应该得到第二次机会，桑德斯。当然，没有人愿意看到自己的亲人被迫离开这个小镇。于是，事情逐渐恶化，越来越糟。有一半的人以为自己会加入胜利的一方，而另外一半人则躲在家里，任由托卢斯和他的那些同伙掌控整个村庄。 桑德斯，这肯定不是你和那些孩子们的家长所希望看到的，但事实就是如此！ 桑德斯，你太善良了，这种性格反而会给你带来麻烦。对于你这样曾经是个正义战士的人来说，这或许不是什么缺点，但这也意味着有些工作必须由我来完成——那些你不愿意去做的工作。” 桑德斯咬紧牙关，指着你足部边那些倒下的敌人说道：“就你，来把这份工作做完吧。 桑德斯，你和加斯已经认识十年了；你的团队不止一次雇佣过‘十字剑’组织，现在依然在雇佣他们。那么问题来了：当那些混蛋把那个女孩拖上山去的时候，你到底打算做什么？” “我本应该想出一些不会导致如此残忍暴行的办法来。 真的，就是现在。” 镇上的居民们纷纷从家中走出，小心翼翼地张望，想要弄清楚这场骚动究竟是怎么回事。当里弗将里安娜带回她的家人身边时，有一家人正喜极而泣；但还有许多人，他们流泪的原因却截然不同。其中一些人正用充满仇恨与怨恨的目光注视着你——虽然他们不敢对你说出口，但那个身上沾满鲜血、毛发和尾巴上都带着血迹的怪物 [pc.weapon] 现在你终于明白他们心里在想什么了。 “所以，事情就是发展到这一步了，哈。他们太害怕采取行动，只能躲在自己的家里，而Tollus和他的那些手下却在整个镇子上为非作歹，公然宣称要推翻女男爵的统治。然而，当有一个人不顾自己家族与这场混乱毫无关联，仍然挺身而出试图改变现状时，他们却立刻转而攻击她。 至少桑德斯有原则，是个好人。而你们这些人简直就是一群懦夫。想 lynch 我吗？谁会第一个动手？这些个月来，这些年来，我一直为你们准备酒水，帮你们解决各种麻烦，还帮你们照顾格温和加勒特，你们还总说他们很可爱……可今天—— 格韦尔，求你别让事情变得更糟了。”里弗在把那个精灵女孩交给她的家人后回来了，她拉了拉你的护肩，恳求道：“求你。” 天啊，你的骨头都快疼死了。随着战斗的激烈与紧张逐渐消退，你最近付出的努力开始让你感到疲惫不堪，然而一切却似乎比预想的要沉重得多。 所以，就是这样，”桑德斯咬牙说道，“你做了我们所有人都不愿意去做的事情。” “是的。” “我知道你为什么这么做，格韦尔。这也是我的错——当初我竟然以为你能帮助改变这种局面。正因如此，我现在才没有严厉责备你，也不会让这些人试图把你陷害。 你有三个小时的时间，这个时间比你们自己的习俗所规定的还要长。收拾好你的东西，立刻离开这里，因为如果你再在这个小镇多待一个晚上 有人 他们肯定会趁你睡觉的时候杀了你，就因为你今晚所做的那些事。” “你是在逼我去送死。” 桑德斯点了点头：“没错，我确实是在逼你去送死。现在再也没有酋长了，女男爵也不在这里，所以这个任务就只能由我来做。

"He went up the mountainside, towards the foothills. I loosed a few shots at him, but he got away. I don't think he'll return to the temple, but we'll need to make a sweep of the old ruin just to make sure." "Maybe he's gone for good." "I doubt it. I've fought enough of his kind in my time — creatures like that don't have the grace to die on their own." Sanders makes a frustrated noise as he steps up. "I wish he could reconsider his ways, but the sad truth is that someone so steeped in evil is likely to rationalise away his misdeeds. If only we'd been able to capture him..." "... Hmph." "But that's not important now." Sanders' face creases in anger, true anger from such a man twinged with disappointment. "In the gods' names, Gweyr, what have you just done?!" "I did what I said I would, Sanders. I showed them exactly what I thought of human shields. Tollus and Leold, they clearly knew of your oaths as a Warrior of White, and that you wouldn't lift a finger against people you still thought of as poor misguided kids. You were just going to stand right there like an idiot until they sacrificed the girl to whatever horrible abominations they worship, and once they learned you could be cockblocked like that they'd just keep on doing it over and over again." "I don't think you get my point, Gweyr. In one night, you have killed more than half the youth in Hawkethorne!" Sanders roars, grabbing you by the shoulders and shaking you — and he does have the strength for that. "Does that mean absolutely nothing to you?" "And whose fucking fault is that that things have gotten to this point? If we'd kicked them straight out of town like I wanted to begin with over any protests their folks might've had, shit wouldn't have gotten to this point. I get it, you want to believe that people are basically good and that everyone deserves a second chance, Sanders. And sure, all those people, no one wants to see their kin run out of town. So things just stewed until they grew from bad to worse and half the fuckers thought they'd join the winning team, while the others hid in their homes while Tollus and his ass had the run of the village. That sure isn't what you and those kids' folks wanted, Sanders, but it sure as fuck is what happened! "You're just too nice for your own good, Sanders. It's not a failing for someone who used to be a holy warrior like you, but it does mean I've got to do the jobs you won't." Sanders grits his teeth and points down to the heaped bodies about your feet. "You. Call. This. A. Job." "You've known Garth and me for a decade now, Sanders; your order's hired the Crossed Swords more than once, they still do. So then, the question remains: what were you going to do while those assholes went and dragged off the girl up the mountain?" "I'd have thought of something that didn't involve such blatant butchery." "Really, now." The townsfolk are emerging from their homes now, peering out cautiously to see what the commotion is all about. One family's weeping tears of joy as River returns Rianna to her family, but so many, many more are weeping for another reason. Some of them have their eyes on you, red-hot needles of hate and resentment; though they dare say nothing to you, the monster with blood smeared over her fur and tail and with [pc.weapon] in hand, you know what's going on in their minds. "So, this is what it's come to, huh. Too afraid to act and hiding in your own homes while Tollus and his fuckers have the run of the town and openly talk of overthrowing the baroness, yet so swift to turn on the woman who gave enough of a shit to do something about it despite none of her own kin being personally involved in this mess. "At least Sanders has principles and is a good man. You lot are just chickenshits. Want to lynch me? Who's going to be first? For months, years, I served you lot drinks, played midwife for you, held Gwyn and Garret while you told me they were cute, and today — " "Gweyr. Please don't make this any worse." River's returned from handing off the elf girl to her folks and is tugging on your gambeson. "Please." Gods, your bones ache. With the heat and rush of battle finally beginning to fade, your recent exertions are starting to catch up to you, and yet everything feels far heavier than it should be. "So, that's it," Sanders spits. "You did the job that none of us were willing to do." "Yes." "I know why you did this, Gweyr. That, and it's my fault for thinking you could help the situation in the first place. It's why I'm not running you through this very moment, and why I'm not going to let these people try and hang you. "You have three hours, which is more than what your own customs dictate. Get your things and get out of here, because if you stay one night in this town someone is going to try and kill you in your sleep for what you've done tonight." "You're sending me to walk the ice." Sanders nods. "I am. There are no more jarls and the baroness isn't here, so I'll have to do." '

rows.original:
"You're not taking any weapons?"
        
        You shake your head. "I won't need them where I'm going. Give them to the pups as a reminder of their mother, although I won't blame them if they don't want to have anything to do with me. If that happens... I don't know, just pass them off them to someone who needs them more or something, I don't care."
        
        Garth sighs. "They turned on you so quickly..."
        
        "I understand why they did it. It's cowardly and chickenshit, but that doesn't stop me from understanding as much. Take care of the kids, okay? Make sure they grow up right." 
        
        "Gweyr, you're being sent away to walk the ice! How can you be so — so calm about it?"
        
        "I..." It's truly hard to find words that can encompass everything you're feeling right now. You knew something like this was going to happen once the townsfolk elected to simply do nothing and hope for the best, but... oh, Garth, poor dear that he is... how can you ever explain as much to him? "I'll be going. My time's almost up."
        
        "What will you do?"
        
        "I've got unfinished business with that Tollus asshole. And then after that... well, we'll see."
        
        "Gweyr...!"
        
        You have no reply for your husband as you turn your back on him and stride out of the home you built together. Snow's still falling and the streets are empty, although you can feel many eyes on you; as you pass through the eastern gate, you note that some of the bodies are gone, Leold's included. Their families must have claimed them... either that, or Sanders is busy filling graves. Barely have you gone three steps beyond the arch, though, that you hear a voice.
        
        "Mom?"
        
        Oh no, oh no... you crouch down so that you're on eye level with Garret and give your son a rub on the back; he likes that. The boy's still soft and fuzzy, but he's already starting to look like your father about the face and ears. "What are you doing out here, kid? You should be in bed."
        
        "I heard you and Dad talking, and couldn't sleep. Mom, you smell of blood."
        
        Ha, just like him to say it outright as if it were the most natural thing in the world. "...Yeah. I didn't have time to wash."
        
        "I heard you're going on a journey."
        
        "Yeah, kid."
        
        "Will you be coming home soon?"
        
        "...I'll be home as soon as I can, kid; I just have some business to take care of. Look after your sister, and your dad, too — he may not look like it, but he's actually a big [silly|simp|softy]. You can do that, yes?"
        
        Ever eager to please, your boy nods so fast his head's a blur. He's so young, you wonder if he'll ever remember this conversation when he gets older... "Are you going to bring back something good, mom?"
        
        "I'll see if I can't find something, kid. All right, back to bed with you; your dad is going to worry if he discovers you've slipped out of the house just to send me off." You smile and place your hands on Garret's head, rolling your palms down to his face and squeezing his cheeks lightly; he squirms on your grasp, clearly liking it but just a bit too full of himself to admit as much. His grandfather was the same way... the blood's strong in this one. "Go on then, shoo."
        
        There's an obvious reluctance in Garret to peel away from you, but you give him a firm swat on the back and that sends him on his way. Time for you to get moving, too — if you linger any longer, you'll be tempted to stay, one way or another...
rows.translation:
你不带任何武器吗？”

你摇了摇头：“我去的地方并不需要它们。把它们交给那些小狗吧，让它们能记住它们的母亲……不过，如果它们不愿意和我有任何瓜葛，我也不会责怪它们。如果真的发生了那种情况……我也不确定，就把它们交给更需要它们的人吧，我并不在意。
        
        加斯叹了口气：“他们这么快就背叛了你……”

“我明白他们为什么这么做。这种行为很懦弱，也很卑鄙，但这并不妨碍我理解他们的动机。一定要照顾好孩子们，好吗？一定要确保他们能够健康成长。”

“格韦尔，你被派去冰原上执行任务了！你怎么能表现得这么……如此冷静呢？
        
        我……”真的很难找到合适的词语来表达你此刻的所有感受。当你看到镇上的居民们选择什么都不做，只是寄希望于最好的结果时，你就知道这种事情会发生……但是，哦，加斯，可怜的加斯……你要怎么向他解释这一切呢？“我得走了。我的时间差不多快用完了。
        
        你打算怎么做？”

“我还有些事情没跟那个叫托卢斯的混蛋算清。等办完那些事之后……嗯，到时候再看看吧。”

“格温尔……！”

你没有回答丈夫的话，只是转身走出了你们共同建造的家园。 雪仍在飘落，街道上空无一人，但你能感觉到有许多目光在注视着你；当你穿过东门时，你注意到有些尸体已经不见了，包括利奥尔德的。他们的家人肯定已经来领走了这些尸体。要么就是那样，要么就是桑德斯正在忙着填坟墓。然而，你刚走过拱门三步远，就听到了一个声音。
        
        妈妈？”

哦不，哦不……你蹲下来，让自己的视线与加勒特处于同一水平线上，然后轻轻拍拍儿子的背，他很喜欢这样。这个男孩的皮肤还是柔软而绒毛茸的，但他的脸型和耳朵已经开始有点像你父亲了。“孩子，你在这里干什么呢？你应该去睡觉的。
        
        我听到你和爸爸在说话，就睡不着了。妈妈，你身上有血腥味。”

哈，他就这么直截了当地说出来，好像这是世界上最正常的事情一样。“……是啊，我没时间洗澡。”

“我听说你要去旅行了。
        
        嗯，孩子。”

“你很快就会回家吗？”

“……我会尽快回家的，孩子；我只是有些事情需要处理。你要照顾好你的妹妹，还有你的爸爸——他看起来可能不太像，但实际上他是个很坚强的人。 [silly|简单易懂的东西。|软弱的人]你能做到，对吧？”

你这个总是急于讨好别人的孩子，连头都忙得不停地点头，简直快把脑袋点晕了。他还这么小，你不禁会想，等他长大后，是否还能记得这次谈话……“妈妈，你一定会带回来一些好东西吧？我看看能不能找点东西给你，孩子。好了，你回去睡觉吧；要是你爸爸发现你只是为了送我走才偷偷溜出家的，他肯定会担心的。”你微笑着把双手部放在加勒特的头上，然后轻轻地将手部掌向下移动到他的脸上，轻轻捏了捏他的脸颊；他在你的怀里扭来扭去，显然很喜欢这个举动，但又因为太自负而不好意思承认这一点。 他的祖父也是这样的……这种血脉确实很有力量。“那你就快去吧，快走。”

加勒特显然很不情愿离开你，但你轻轻拍了他一下后背，他就只好走了。 你也该动身了——如果你再拖延下去，迟早会忍不住想要留下来的……
